Avec ses alliances changeantes, ses trahisons, ses combats dynamiques et ses détenus asymétriques, chaque partie raconte une nouvelle histoire derrière les barreaux.

────────────────────

-description from designer

name: Grand Plan: New York City
description:
New York City is one of the most iconic and influential cities in the world. While the city was founded in the 1600s by Dutch settlers, over the next few centuries New York City transformed from a small trading post into a global center of commerce, culture, and innovation.

In Grand Plan: New York City, players are urban planners who build this city from the 1600s through the early 2000s against the backdrop of historical events. A unique system of historically based chronicle cards allows new rules to come into effect and expire over the course of the ten turn game.

Players lay out the grid plan of Manhattan across the island and into the sky, developing new neighborhoods, placing influence, and engaging with the news of the day.

—description from the publisher

name: Anne Bonny's Malediction
description:
Welcome to Anne Bonny's: Malediction! Embark on an epic adventure on the high seas, where treasure and intrigue are intertwined in every wave. In this exciting game of interaction and strategy, you will face the ultimate challenge: join the legendary crew of Anne Bonny, one of the most feared pirates of all time. Your mission is simple but challenging: roll the dices and do the actions using your cards to collect 20 gold coins meanwile other players try to change the type of your dices, steal your cards and your money. Earn Anne Bonny's respect and trust and secure a place on her intrepid crew. But be careful: in this world of pirates, betrayal lurks around every corner and every decision you make could determine your destiny. Do you have what it takes to overcome your opponents and join the legend of Anne Bonny? Get ready to set sail and find out in Anne Bonny's: Malediction!

—description from the publisher

¡Bienvenidos a "Anne Bonny's: Maldición"! Embárcate en una aventura épica en alta mar, donde el tesoro y la intriga se entrelazan en cada ola. En este emocionante juego de interacción y estrategia te enfrentarás al desafío definitivo: unirte a la legendaria tripulación de Anne Bonny, una de las piratas más temidas de todos los tiempos. Tu misión es simple pero desafiante: tira los dados y realiza las acciones usando tus cartas para recolectar 20 monedas de oro mientras otros jugadores intentan cambiar el tipo de tus dados, robar tus cartas y tu dinero. Gánate el respeto y la confianza de Anne Bonny y asegúrate un lugar en su intrépido equipo. Pero ten cuidado: en este mundo de piratas, la traición acecha en cada esquina y cada decisión que tomes podría determinar tu destino. ¿Tienes lo necesario para superar a tus oponentes y unirte a la leyenda de Anne Bonny? ¡Prepárate para zarpar y descubrirlo en "Anne Bonny's: Malediction"!

—description from the publisher (Spanish)

name: Antiques
description:
The big day has finally arrived! As a representative of a prestigious family of art curators with generations of refined taste, your mission is to acquire the finest pieces at auction. You will create irreverent collections that challenge artistic boundaries, leading to temporary exhibitions in the world's most renowned museums.

But you're not alone in this pursuit! Other prominent families are also vying for deals with artists, galleries, and museums. In this high-stakes world of art collecting, golden opportunities can vanish in the blink of an eye, and only the most decisive curators will prevail.

In Antiques, you take on the role of a museum curator competing to become the most prestigious art gallery owner. Through strategic auction bidding and careful collection assembly, you will create temporary exhibitions in renowned museums and international galleries to showcase exquisite pieces. The game is played in sequential turns around the table until a player completes their required number of temporary museum exhibitions, which is based on the player count. After final scoring, the curator with the most points wins.

name: Rivals of Rock
description:
In Rivals of Rock, you are a musician and the leader of an ambitious, hard-working rock band in a small town with an up-and-coming music scene. A world-touring rock festival is coming to your city in a year, and they're looking for one band to headline the festival!

Over the course of three seasons, you will build up your rock band by recruiting and leveling up musicians, rehearsing to gain skills and write songs, and performing your songs at different venues to gain fans, popularity, and other juicy rewards in hopes of gaining more fame than rival bands.

When performing gigs, you have to carefully consider which songs to play at different venues based on the rival bands you're competing against and based on what the audience at the venues want to hear. Rock 'n' roll isn't all sunshine and rainbows, though. You also have to keep an eye on your musicians' needs and maintain a healthy level of band drama compared to rivals. At the end of the game, the leader of the band with the most fame wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Stellaris: Infinite Legacy
publisher: Academy Games, Inc.; Apollo Games; Paradox Interactive AB (I)
description:
The Galaxy is vast and full of wonder

Academy Games introduces the 4X board game based on the hit video game Stellaris. Experience everything you love about Stellaris in a fast paced 2 hour board game for 2 to 4 players (up to 6 with the Empires Expansion).

—description from the publisher

name: Antscape
description:
In Antscape, players represent competing ant colonies trying to expand their territory in a shared landscape. The goal is to claim as many valuable areas as possible, recruit new ants, and use the queen wisely to score points!

How does it work?
Each turn follows three simple steps:

     Take an action (optional)
     Choose to either claim a region or recruit an ant
     Refill your hand to four cards


Areas are claimed by playing the right combination of cards, while recruiting ants grants access to stronger cards and more options in later turns. As the game progresses, the conquered areas together form a colony, contributing to the final score. Bonus cards add unique twists and strategies, while each player’s special terrain-shift card lets you reshape the landscape to your advantage — creating rich tactical choices every game

The game ends once all areas have been claimed or when the queen areas remain unused. When the dust settles, the colony with the highest total score wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Defenders of the Dictionary
description:
You may notice that your daily communications are filled with abbreviations, shorthand, and emojis, which are often auto-corrected by predictive technology. Thankfully, there is a task force dedicated to celebrating and preserving the richness of our language.

Your mission, as a defender of the dictionary, is to protect the diversity of language from the forces that seek to oversimplify it. Armed with your collective wisdom, you must use your words to navigate the city and stop the villains from diminishing the beauty of language. After all, knowledge is power, and it must be cherished.

In Defenders of the Dictionary, players will cooperate to navigate the city of Wordopolis via letter-and-grid-based wordplay. For each mission, you need to achieve a specific task and follow a particular direction with your words before running out of turns. Completing a mission helps you gain valuable intel about the villains and advances your campaign.

Defenders of the Dictionary takes the familiar gameplay of grid-based word games and flips it on its head. You will need to collaborate together within this system, navigate specific directions, and overcome the challenges and obstacles set by the villains.

The campaign is composed of many short games where each game represents a mission.  Each mission may include some new and some previously introduced mechanisms.  The campaign is designed with gamer group flexibility in mind so it's not necessary to play every mission with the same group of people. Complete all the missions to determine which villain was the mastermind, and face-off with them in the final showdown.

-description from designer

name: Apex
description:
In this fast-paced pyramid-stacking showdown, there are no turns, just simultaneous action. Both players race across the board, moving diagonally, orthogonally, or leaping like knights, all to build the tallest tower.
Move your ever-growing tower onto a pyramid, then snatch another matching one and place it on top. But be careful... if the other player steals your next move out from under you, your game ends in an instant.

In order to play a round of Apex, you need:

     20 Looney Pyramids from Looney Labs (6 trios of preferably one colour + 2 small pyramids in two different colours)
     9 tiles (or pieces of cardboard, beer mats, etc.)


The game begins with a countdown or a signal (to be agreed upon beforehand). Movement works as follows:

1) Move your player pyramid/tower onto a neutral pyramid on a different tile. You can move

     1 or 2 tiles orthogonally
     1 or 2 tiles diagonally
     in an “L” shape, like a Knight in chess


2) Take a neutral pyramid of the same size from a tile that is reachable with the same movement pattern you just used. Place it on top of your tower.

The game ends 

     when both players are unable to make any further moves (tallest tower wins)
     if a player’s tower crashes without any involvement from the other player (intact tower wins)
     if a player is involved twice in a collision that results in the other player’s tower crashing (disqualification – the other player wins automatically)

name: Gnomeville
description:
Deep within the enchanted forest, your gnome village was flattened after a devastating troll raid. Now, you must race to forge a new home--one strong enough to withstand relentless enemies and stand above the rest. Outwit the trolls, out-build your rivals, and build the legendary town of Gnomeville!

Gnomeville is a captivating bag-building game for 1-4 players that brings a fresh twist by blending strategic tile placement, dopamine boosts from match-3 puzzles, with the tactical depth of tower defense. This is all wrapped up with a layer of press-your-luck, simultaneous bag-building play we all know and love for a uniquely magical experience.

Choose your build sites, prepare for the upcoming troll’s attack, spawn new gnomes and graduate them from academy, craft some swords and hammers, and prove that your village can withstand any attack!

—description from the publisher

name: Aphelion
description:
The Aphelia; expanses of deep space, out of reach of the long-arm of the Union, reachable only through mysterious warpgates. The aphelia are the new frontier for individuals looking to make a new life and corporations looking to expand their wealth. They are the backwaters of the civilized universe, populated by outlaws, anarchists, traitors, and runaways. Scenarios have players hunting down exotic creatures and discovering the source of a mysterious signal, but exploring the frontier doesn’t come without risk. How you deal with the beings in your way is up to you - will you use diplomacy, bribes, and deception, or put ‘em down the old fashioned way?

In Aphelion you’ll play as Grims - those who have set out to the aphelia to make a name for themselves. Aphelion is fully co-operative, and players take turns simultaneously. Each turn players gain actions by activating the tech on their ship or suit, calling on their crew’s talents, and using unique Grim abilities. Based on their adventures and exploits, players gain credits and notoriety allowing them to purchase and unlock powerful abilities and tech. Aphelion is designed to be extremely replayable; each of the 5 grims has a unique deck of asset and milestone cards, there are hundreds of different cards to add to your tableau, the board is modular and has a random configuration each game, and there are endless strategies to pursue.

Each time you play Aphelion you choose from a variety of scenarios with a range of playtimes from 60-240 minutes. Since each scenario has different goals and challenges, your win condition changes from game to game.

—description from the publisher

name: Apistocracy
description:
Dearest Player, you have been invited, at the behest of your titled host, to make your debut during the 1851 social season of Victorian London.

Apistocracy is a 2-4 player game featuring worker placement, as well as a trick-taking game based on Whist. Each player has a season host with a unique ability. The hosts provide influence to open the first doors of the season, but players must make connections, thus building influence, to gain invitations to the most coveted events. Over the course of four weeks, players climb to the top of the social beehive to become Queen Victoria's favorite, commission painting sets in the gallery to become the artist's muse, make valuable connections in the ballroom to become the favored guest, learn secrets in the tea room, and curate their hand for the final whist game in the parlor. The player with the most Victoria points at the end of the season is named the "season's favorite" and wins.

The game offers players nuanced action selection, with opportunities for strategic decision making. Do you spend your resources to move up the beehive? Do you dance in the ballroom to gain a valuable card for your player mat? Do you commission your portrait and complete your painting set? Regardless of your choice, the main goal is to have fun! If you happen to create a buzz and become the season's favorite in the process, then bravo! If you do not achieve the coveted title, you need not give up — there's always next season!

—description from the designer

name: Apothebakery: The Culinary Alchemists
description:
In a land filled with perilous dungeons and treacherous monsters, take on the legacy of an Apothebaker — an ancient lineage of culinary alchemist healers. Sought after far and wide by adventurers in desperate need of salvation.

With the help from your trusted Forries, collect ingredients and valuable resources from the wilderness. Brew elixirs and bake cakes of salvation to heal and rejuvenate adventurers on the brink of doom.

Over the course of 6 rounds, players compete for the most reputation by strategically achieving objectives, healing adventurers and casting powerful spells. There are 3 phases per round; Foraging, Alchemy and Healing.

Embrace the role of an Apothebaker, accumulating reputation for each adventurer you heal and every bake you undertake. The player who gains the highest reputation by day’s end will claim victory!

—description from the publisher

name: Aqualuma
description:
In the realm of Aqualuma, you can explore five fantastic underwater worlds, each with its own unique magic and history, but one day, a dark fog descends and threatens everything that lives beneath the surface of the sea. Each world sends out its bravest heroes and heroines — and that's you! With your magical abilities, you can hold back the darkness for a while, but you can defeat it only if you combine your powers. Find the powerful balls of light hidden in the five worlds.

In the dice-placement game Aqualuma, players fill the magic strip of each world with dice in order to be rewarded, and each player has a special ability that can help everyone. To win, you must collect a light ball in each of the five underwater worlds, then activate them with dice.

name: Tatsumi
description:
In Tatsumi, the island celebrates you as their guardian dragon, their Tatsu. Your calling is to restore the elements on your island and renew good fortune for your people.

Drafting resources, collecting sets, and scoring bonuses in Tatsumi relies on the position of your dragon avatar on the seaboard, creating a more immersive and believable abstract strategy experience. The seaboard randomizes and stages the entire game's resources into a 3-dimensional central board so you can strategically look ahead planning when to collect and when to score.

The tile-placement in Tatsumi has a puzzly yet satisfying feel through a clever combination of engine-building, instant scoring, and elemental inspired end game tile-placement bonuses for you to maximize.

Each player may play with a symmetric setup for learning or competition, or a fully asymmetric island and dragon combination for tons of replayability.

Fans of games like Azul, Harmonies, and Splendor will appreciate the intuitive gameplay, elevated componentry, and additional features specifically developed to extend beyond gateway games in this genre for gamers that enjoy solo-play, symmetric and asymmetric combinations, and a multigame feel packed into a single box.

—description from the publisher

name: 2 Win
publisher: Blue Orange (EU); Albi; Blue Orange Games; MEBO Games; Pegasus Spiele; Rebel Sp. z o.o.
description:
2 Win is a simultaneous card game in which players create increasing two-digit numbers using colorful digit cards. Each round, everyone passes one card to the left, then secretly chooses two cards to form a number. From the second round onward, each new number must be higher than the one previously played—otherwise, the player is eliminated.

After revealing numbers at the same time, players may draw cards for meeting certain conditions: having the highest number, playing more stars than opponents, forming a double (e.g., 33), or completing a three-card color sequence in their tens or units stack. Drawing extra cards helps players stay in the game longer.

Players who cannot pass a card or form a valid higher number drop out immediately. The last remaining player wins. If all remaining players are eliminated in the same round, the player with the most cards in hand wins, with ties broken by the lowest final number.

—description from the publisher

name: Arborius
description:
Arborius is an abstract strategy game that takes place over a recursive fractal board shaped by the pieces themselves, warping and deforming and reorganizing itself as pieces jump in and out of battle.

Compose your ultimate hero by nesting units together, determining your abilities and combining tiles together without limits.  Battle for domination over your opponent, and be the last standing to win.

Each collectible tile snaps and stacks together vertically.  Tiles have a direction that effects where they can move and attack.  Tiles can move inside allied or even enemy tiles, taking advantage of their abilities, and those can in turn move inside other tiles.

—description from the designer

name: Archives of the Fallen World
description:
Archives of the Fallen World is a PnP Solo Strategy Board Game set in the final days of a collapsing dystopian town.

The core game tells the story of Leon, a former librarian. As the world collapses, he collects books to preserve the last pieces of human knowledge in his underground shelter. Your goal is to help Leon collect 32 books by completing various quests across 12 locations scattered throughout the town.

Solve quests, trade, steal, or search the ruins - there are many ways to recover the books. But beware! The streets are patrolled by local militia, and every time you get too close, you get into trouble and lose Faith- a precious resource that keeps your morale high and can be spent on risky or questionable actions.

Every day is a fight for survival. Your character needs food to stay active. Earn money to buy it, volunteer at the community garden, search the ruins, or dig through rubbish bins - do whatever it takes to eat, or lose a large part of your daily energy. And every night, the bombs fall. Buildings collapse, quests disappear, and time runs short. The longer you wait, the fewer opportunities remain. Plan your routes carefully. Use your energy wisely. Balance between growing hunger and fading hope.

You have 12 days before the doors of your bunker close.

name: Archwynd
description:
Archwynd is a competitive, asymmetrical fantasy card game for 1-4 players, age 13 and up. Archwynd offers Solo, Team and PvP modes.

In this game, you choose a Hero who sets forth to save the land of Archwynd from a monstrous invasion. The King will pay a bounty for each monster killed.

Along the way, you will collect magic and treasure to help you buff up for fights, heal lost health, or avoid traps and damage from encounters. The bounty you collect may also be used to make your Hero stronger.

You win the game by being the last Hero standing. There can be only one! If your Hero dies, you lose. But all may not be lost, as special cards, like Raise Dead, can help your Hero live to fight another day.

—description from the designer

name: Archéo
publisher: Gigamic; Cranio Creations; Gém Klub Kft.
description:
Cooperate to discover the remains of the past with your Ventouse shovel.

Dig on 4 levels, reconstitute your discoveries and try to get 10 stars. But beware, get rid of your pebbles before they break your shovel.

name: Arcology
description:
We are at the dawn of a new era. Architects and environmentalists have come together to design the Arcology: a self-sufficient high-tech building to house large populations in a sustainable environment. Huge construction sites are underway to shape the home of tomorrow. You have been chosen to build these Arcologies and welcome citizens to their new home.

Type of game:
Arcology is both a competitive and cooperative card management game.

Description:

     Administer 3 boards at once: your Arcology board and 2 shared boards.
     Upgrade your board to house citizens, collect victory points and generate resources for your other boards.
     Cooperate with neighbouring players to collect victory points together.


Goal:
The player with the most victory points on these 3 boards wins the game.

Conclusion:
A highly interactive game, where each player has the pleasure to contribute to the progress of the game. Despite all this complicity, only one of them will be chosen to guide humanity towards this ecological transition.

—description from the publisher

name: Are You More Like
description:
Are You More Like is a hilarious party game that lets you see just how well your friends and family know you! (It is also a fantastic get to know you game for a first date)

First the Active Player is selected. Then, all other players look at their cards in hand and choose a number of cards to play face down in the middle based on the Quick Start Chart. Then if needed, add cards from the deck until there are at least 5 cards in the middle (again see the Quick Start Chart).

After all cards are submitted, the Active Player mixes the cards up and turns them over face up and puts them in a row. The Active Player will then secretly choose from the options which one they personally are “Most Like” AND which one they are “Least Like” and write it down. (Note: This is NOT which one do you like the most? It is which one are you most like?) At the same time all other players are secretly writing down what they predict the active player will choose for Most and Least about themselves.

Once all players have made their decisions, all non-active players reveal their choices at the same time by placing their (Most Token) and (Least Token) below each of the respectively chosen cards. The Active Player will then place their (Most Token) and (Least Token) above each respectively chosen card. After points are awarded, discard the cards from the middle, everyone restocks their hand to five cards and the next player become the Active Player.

The points needed to win varies on based on number of players.

name: Arigatō
description:
All the villages in the land are bustling with excitement as in just twelve days, it will be the Shogun's birthday! Gather your best artisans, craft magnificent offerings, and deliver them on time to earn his favor.

Arigatō is a strategic and competitive card game in which you play as the leader of your village and try to combine the best artisan cards to claim victory. Each of twelve rounds consists of three phases, all of which are played simultaneously:


     Dawn: Secretly choose the role of each of your five artisans in hand: one resident, two travelers, and two crafters.
     Day: Reveal your artisan cards and collect the objects provided by the producer artisans. Trigger the effects of your resident artisans, if applicable. Manage your objects and try to gather those required by your residents to prepare offerings for the Shogun.
     Dusk: Check whether you've fulfilled the Shogun's whims for the day, and earn additional favors.


After twelve rounds, the player who has accumulated the most favors — which are earned through offerings, effects, and objectives — wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Arizona: Great Buy! 99 The Game
description:
Join AriZona in their fight to stop inflation! Use your cents card to reach 99 cents without going over. On you turn, play 1 card and announce the new total, then draw back up to 4 cards. If you hit 99 cents, you get a can, and the round continues at 99. Keep it at 99 cents: get a can! Go over 99 cents: lose a can, start a new round. Collect your favorite AriZona tea flavors including green tea, watermelon & sweet tea!

Rules:

     Add your cents cards to the center pile to raise the pot to 99, but don’t you dare go over
     Get to 99 by throwing down special cards to influence the pot
     For every 99 cents you hit, you get a refreshing can token
     First to 4 cans wins


—description from the publisher

name: Arkham Horror: Lovecraft Letter
publisher: Z-Man Games; ADC Blackfire Entertainment; BoardM Factory; Delta Vision Publishing; Hobby World; Lord of Boards
description:
Step into the eerie town of Arkham with Arkham Horror: Lovecraft Letter, a chilling twist on the classic deduction card game. Delve into the madness of the Lovecraftian universe as you face eldritch horrors and uncover allies tainted with madness in this gripping battle of wits. Can you maintain your sanity and outwit Cthulhu, or will you succumb to the creeping darkness that lurks within?

Arkham Horror: Lovecraft Letter is a game of push-your-luck, deduction, and risk for 2-6 players that uses the award-winning Love Letter system.

Arkham Horror: Lovecraft Letter is played over a series of rounds. Each round, you collect clues to investigate an eldritch mystery while trying to hold onto your sanity—or embracing the horror.

The card in your hand represents the clue you’re currently investigating. Each turn, you draw 1 new card, then play 1 of your 2 cards. Playing certain cards will drive you Insane, which gives you access to powerful Insane effects on cards you play but also forces you to make a Sanity check each turn to see if you break down completely.

This is an updated version of the popular Lovecraft Letter with Gameplay and visuals that are reimagined for Arkham Horror.

—description from the publisher

name: 6 nimmt! Baron Oxx
publisher: AMIGO; 999 Games; Albi; Brain Games; Broadway Toys LTD; Gigamic; Kikigagne?; Korea Boardgames; Möbius Games; Rebel Sp. z o.o.; Swan Panasia Co., Ltd.
description:
6 nimmt! Baron Oxx features gameplay similar to 6 nimmt!, with players trying to avoid taking cards in order to keep their score low.

Each player has a hand of cards, and five rows of cards are started on the table with a single random card from the deck. Each card is numbered and features one or more colored bullheads. Each turn, players simultaneously choose a card from their hand, then reveal it. Whoever revealed the lowest card adds it to a row in which the last card features a bullhead of the same color; if several rows feature a matching bullhead, the player chooses the row. As soon as a row has six cards or at least six bullheads of the same color, whoever added the most recent card to that row claims all other cards in it. Baron Oxx is a special character that shows all colors, meaning you can play it on any row...but it can also cost you many points.

Once all players have placed a card, from low value to high, you all reveal another card. After all the cards have been played, whoever has the lowest score wins.

name: Army of the Potomac: Campaigns of 1862 and 1864
description:
Army of the Potomac: Campaigns of 1862 and 1864 is the second volume in the Civil War Heritage series and the follow-up game to the innovative and acclaimed Rebel Fury. Army of the Potomac uses the same core rules as Rebel Fury, so players familiar with Rebel Fury will be able to jump right into the action. Each battle in Army of the Potomac is quick-set-up, quick-playing, and deeply interactive. The density of counters in each scenario is low, allowing you to see and experience the big picture of the battle.

Army of the Potomac covers the battles of Spotsylvania II, North Anna River, Cold Harbor, and the entire Seven Days battle (McClellan vs Lee), including the prelude Seven Pines (McClellan vs Johnston) when Johnston's wounding brought Lee into the command of the Army of Northern Virginia. Each battle places you, the player, in the role of the Army Commander (Grant, McClellan, Lee, Johnston). You maneuver your army to find the enemy’s flanks, concentrate your forces for an attack, and determine where to commit your artillery assets.

Units are portrayed at the Infantry/Cavalry division level. The Civil War Heritage series game system features a new Zone of Influence/Zone of Control mechanic that controls unit formation (March/Battle) based on their proximity to your opponent. As your units close with the enemy, your forces naturally break into battle formation, where they then maneuver the last distance to engage. Unlike most hex and counter wargames, this system allows you total freedom to move units in any order multiple times, unleashing the full range of historical tactics in a simple and clean format.

Combat features a differential combat system with few but significant factors that capture the key features of Civil War division level combat. Units are rated for quality, artillery support, supporting units, and terrain. The game features artillery duels with the occasional Exploding Caisson result. The Civil War Heritage series combat system accurately depicts the ability of units to launch multiple waves of attacks on the same position, capturing the back-and-forth nature of many famous combat duels.

Army of the Potomac also includes a set of campaign rules that allow you to conduct operations from Spotsylvania to Cold Harbor featuring logistics and attrition. Also included are two bonus scenarios to allow owners of Rebel Fury to also fight Spotsylvania II and begin the Campaign scenario from Wilderness to Cold Harbor using their original Rebel Fury map.

Components:
    Five Paper Maps
    Three Countersheets
    Two Player Aids
    Two Off Map Displays
    One Turn Record Track
    Two 10-sided dice
    One custom 6-sided die
    One Rulebook
    One Playbook
    One 2" Box

-description from publisher

name: Arrival Push: A Game of Vectors
description:
Dive into becoming air traffic controllers, taking over airspace and airplanes from another controller. As air traffic controllers, players must vector their aircraft across their respective airspace, around other airplanes and nasty weather to Approach Control. All airplanes move every round and new events pose challenges to controllers and their airplanes. The closer the airplanes get to the airport, the more limited airspace becomes. Maneuvering quickly becomes difficult or nearly impossible without the help of neighboring controllers. Players must work together: When one player struggles, it affects everyone around them. Players score by handing off airplanes to Approach Control. Approach Control will only take one airplane per player per round, so players must work carefully to sequence their arrivals. After 15 rounds (12 at high player counts), the next controller comes back from break; whoever has the most points wins and earns the right to take a break.

—description from the designer

name: Artefacts
description:
Two thousand years old, the Artefactorum, a secret society governed by the Council of Grand Master-Artefactors, brings together scientific elites from all over the world around one ambition: to achieve the ultimate knowledge of the mechanisms of the Universe.

Every ten years, the Council announces when and where the next Grand Tournament will be held, allowing them to choose from their peers the person who will have the honor of joining their institution. Each time, the exceptional event attracts the most daring Master Artefactors, flocking from all continents to demonstrate that they deserve the title of Grand Master.

The Grand Tournament takes place over a whole astral year, during which the contenders for the illustrious distinction will each have to build a Machine-Artefact, by combining Water, Fire, Earth, Air and Lightning with skeletons. of metal. Each Master Artefactor will have to design and build his machine, which will compete against those of his competitors in confrontations. But only one of them will get a place on the Council...

Machine-Artefacts will be evaluated on their construction qualities and their results during rounds of combat. Nevertheless, it will be necessary to be a good strategist to thwart the traps posed by his opponents, not to mention the low blows that certain Masters, less scrupulous, are already preparing in the shadows. Skillful negotiators can also hope to succeed by establishing alliances. Ingenuity, tenacity and cunning will therefore be required in order to hope to become the next Grandmaster.

ARTEFACTS The Boardgame combines resource management, worker placement and tactical confrontations, for 2 to 4 players, with the theme of Steampunk aristocracy from the late 19th century.

—description from the designer

name: Artisimo
description:
At the beginning of each round, an exciting art challenge is revealed. In Artisimo players take on the role of abstract artists and secretly submit bold, stunning, and downright ridiculous artwork in an attempt to impress the judge and score big!

With 200 unique challenges and 150 amazing abstract artworks, every round is packed with bold choices, brilliant masterpieces, and unexpectedly fun emotions. Get ready to outshine and outcreate 
your opponents in the ultimate art showdown!

—description from the publisher

name: Artistry
publisher: Dux Somnium Games; Choo Choo Games; Red Square Games
description:
It is the height of the Art Nouveau movement that is taking the world by storm, and you, an intrepid young artist of much ambition and…well…no fame, are determined to make your workshop the talk of all the latest artistic journals. If only you could decide WHAT to make.

Should you begin with ceramics? Dabble in glass work? Create new textiles? Work with metal? Paint!? There are so many options, but you must begin somewhere. Surely, once you find your muse, other talented artisans will flock to your studio to find their creative outlet by your side. There’s no use daydreaming, though! Gather your materials, find your inspiration, and create the patterns for the artistic masterpieces that will turn your studio into one of the most renowned art houses the world has ever seen!

Each round players will take turns using their artisans to draft material tiles in specific shapes from the market and using those tiles to craft patterns for renown. As each player crafts more patterns, they will gain new artisans or advance their existing artisans from apprentice to journeywoman to master crafter, giving them access to new shapes and better options when drafting from the market. At the end of the game, players tally their renown based on the artisans they have gained and patterns they have crafted, and the player with the most renown wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Arydia: The Paths We Dare Tread
description:
Arydia: The Paths We Dare Tread is an open world, campaign-based, co-operative, fantasy-based, "green legacy" role-playing board game. The game of Arydia is built on four design pillars: Exploration, Progression, Combat, and Role-playing.


    Exploration — Make your way across the world map, discovering new locations, interacting with memorable characters, fighting vicious monsters, and scavenging long-lost treasures. The world pulls you in through detailed descriptions and artwork for each place you visit. Every location is unique, not randomized, and is built piece by piece as you explore.



    Progression — Arydia is played as a campaign over the course of a number of game sessions; you start each session right where you left off! As you play, the game keeps track of your actions and decisions. Your characters will grow in power, collecting new items, weapons, and skills. NPCs and locations will change, depending on how you interact with them. All of this progression is done using a simple, but powerful, index system, which allows for quick and easy set-up and tear down.



    Combat — Arydia features a tactical, co-operative combat system. Enemies are controlled by game cards and dice, while you and your companions work together to defeat them.



    Role-playing — Take on the roles of a wide cast of characters as you encounter them throughout your journeys. The incentive-based role-play system encourages you to engage in dramatic storytelling, without being intrusive.


As a "green legacy" game, Arydia features all the hallmarks of a legacy game — packages to open, hidden information, progression, discovery, exploration — but allows you to reset the game when you have completed it so that you can start again or pass it on to someone else.

name: Blind Jack
publisher: Bandjo; Albi; Blue Orange Games; Buró; GaGa Games; Game Harbor; GateOnGames; Gém Klub Kft.; Hobby Japan; HUCH!; Mercurio
description:
Blind Jack is a fast-paced team game where players guess numerical answers to quirky trivia, aiming to get as close as possible to 21 without going over. Teams take turns estimating the answer to a card’s question—ranging from the number of legs on a crab to the number of colors on Superman’s costume—while the real answer is revealed only to the opposing team.

Players must balance risk and strategy, deciding whether to keep drawing cards to reach 21 or stop before going over. The team whose total is closest to 21 wins, with ties and overages resolved through clear rules.

Simple to learn but full of tense, hilarious moments, Blind Jack challenges estimation, teamwork, and quick thinking in every round. Perfect for small groups, it offers a mix of trivia, strategy, and suspense that keeps players guessing until the very last card.

—description from the publisher

name: Ashfall
description:
Ashfall is a 1-4 player coop deck building sci-fi narrative driven miniatures board game – take control of powerful unique characters, recruit  allies, find and buy rare equipment and fill your deck with powerful action cards. Explore diverse terrains from deserts to mysterious alien facilities and make use of Pelagium – a dangerous new resource. The centrepiece is an epic character and narrative driven cooperative campaign. You can also play standalone scenarios.

The Core Lands Protectorate (CLP), an expansionist state based on the southern two continents in the world, has for the past 40 years slowly absorbed all neighboring nations. With its powerful military and vast industrial base, the CLP has faced little organized opposition. Major Mak Yerrym and his group of special operations soldiers is sent to deal with the latest uprising in Artusa, a recently conquered nation. There, he discovers disturbing evidence that threatens to destabilize an uneasy peace between the two superpowers of the world.

The Yarangan Union (YU) is a scientifically advanced nation based in the northern archipelagos with unmatched naval power - fleets of advanced self-sufficient ships known as Umiaqs powered by Pelagium (a rare and powerful resource). In the past several decades the YU’s Pelagium research has rapidly advanced under the supervision of renowned scentist Toerwahn Tijksyn. With his recent disappearance, research has stalled. His daughter, Mira Tijksyn, is sent on an expedition escorted by members of the secretive YU State Security. There, she begins to understand the source of her father’s discoveries.

As players, take on the role of characters on both sides of the developing conflict and together uncover a vast conspiracy that threatens to bring the world into a devastating war that could destroy both nations, or worse.

—description from the publisher

name: Aspens
description:
Aspens is a quick-playing strategy board game for two players, where you harness the wind and sun and carefully balance growth with expansion to outgrow and outwit your loved ones.

In Aspens, players compete to grow the largest forest on a shared board - having to balance how much they invest in building their "engine" to increase the odds of generating trees on future turns, with the pressure of needing to expand to claim territory and ultimately be crowned the winner.

Players start by seeding and growing a forest space adjacent to each water tile. This is where players determine their initial strategy and appetite for risk. Then play begins.

On your turn, you roll the sun die, and BOTH players generate trees for spaces they have grown tall enough to capture the sun. Then you roll the wind die, determining which directions you can grow outward in. The active player then plants their trees, balancing between growing existing spaces UP with more trees, or expanding OUTWARD from their forests, following the wind. This is the core crux of tough decision making and strategy comes in - balancing future investment with rapid expansion.

Play continues until all spaces are claimed, and the player with the most spaces is crowned the winner!

—description from the publisher

name: Assault: Sicily '43 – Gela Beachhead
publisher: Assault Games; Sound of Drums GmbH
description:
Mediterranean sea, southwest coast of Sicily island. It was the early morning of 10 July 1943 when the first landing craft dropped their ramps at Gela and the first units of US Rangers set their boots on Italian soil. Together with the British and Canadian units that had landed further east, the Western Allies launched an unprecedented landing operation to push open the gate to Fortress Europe. The night before, on 9 July, American and British airborne troops had already dropped into enemy territory behind the planned beach landing zones to occupy important positions. This was to prevent or delay timely counterattacks by Italian and German troops on the day of the landing. This operation, called Husky, was the beginning of the end of the Italian army as an ally of the German Wehrmacht. It was the additional front, long demanded by Stalin, and thus brought the necessary relief of the Eastern Front.

Assault Sicily 43 is the second volume in a planned series of tactical level wargames in which players lead historical units into battle during the landing and airborne operations around Gela Beachhead in July 1943. Americans, Italians and Germans fight bitterly for the backdoor Sicily as a launchpad for the invasion of the continent.

Game Scale: Squad and team level infantry units, individual vehicles and artillery
Turn time: 5-20 minutes
Game time: 1 hour – 3+ hours, scenario dependent
Complexity: 4 -6 out of 10 (medium)
Optional rules that ease the entry into the game system
Replay value: 10 out of 10
This game can be combined with the Eastern Front module: Assault Red Horizon 41

name: Assertion: The Three Kingdoms
description:
Reclaim the Land. Reshape the Legend.

The Han Empire has fallen.

Dong Zhuo rules from the shadows of the throne. The Yellow Turban Rebellion spreads like wildfire across the provinces. And as the realm descends into chaos, the great forces of Wei, Wu, and Shu-Han rise to claim their place in the storm to come.
But not all stories are written in the scrolls of history.
In ASSERTION: The Three Kingdoms players step into the turmoil of a fractured China, drawing from the legendary Romance of the Three Kingdoms to explore a bold, re-imagined path through one of history’s most turbulent eras. New warlords rise. Loyalties shift. The fate of the land may yet be shaped by unexpected hands.

Command armies, court favour, reshape alliances and navigate the ambitions of kingdoms and emperors alike. The path to power is yours to carve, in battle, in diplomacy, and in shadows. The world is at war. This is your story. What part will you play in the legend?

—description from the publisher

name: Assyria: Second Edition
description:
Before uniting to become one of history's great empires, the ancient Assyrian people expanded as smaller nomadic tribes along the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. Here they fished, farmed, and flourished, despite the lingering threat of flooding. They claimed new land, constructed great ziggurats, and cultivated their influence with surrounding civilizations. Now it's time to bring your offerings and gather your gold! May your feet find favor wherever they go.

The aim of Assyria is to be the player with the most victory points (VP) at game's end. You gain points primarily by building huts and ziggurats, making offerings, and increasing your influence. Each round, players bid for turn order, expand on the map, and take various actions. After the third and sixth rounds, a flood will occur, wiping away everything along the two rivers. After the final flood, the player with the most points wins.

This second edition of Assyria is a redeveloped and redesigned edition of the 2009 release Assyria.

—description from the publisher

name: Asteria
description:
Asteria is a strategic level card  wargame in which players compete for the domination of the galaxy through military, commercial, and technological objectives.

Using multi-purpose cards, collect resources to enhance your military power, research new technologies, and explore new areas of the galaxy in a game with great variety and replayability.

Each Asteria card incorporates the 4X (Extract, Expand, Explore, and Exterminate) elements. Choose which of the four sides of the card to play on one of the open planets to determine the effect and military power being deployed.

Use combinations of cards to modify plans with technologies and cards that rotate others already in play. Play your own way to earn points by fulfilling various objectives and emerge victorious with the Galaxy in your hands in Asteria!

—description from the publisher

name: Crash Derby
description:
The core element of the game, designed by Olda Rejl, Ondra Cigánek and Ivan Dostál, is a fresh and rewarding system of three gears which determine what actions you can or must perform in each round.

Crash Derby is being developed in collaboration with Prusa Research and it's a title explicitly designed with the intention of allowing the community to create new content for it, like additional cart models, obstacles or entirely new gameplay elements.

At launch, a range of expansion elements will already be available to print at home on the Printables website, with more to come. That way, soon there won’t be a two copies of Crash Derby that would be the same.

Crash Derby is designed for 2 to 4 players aged 8 and up, and one game will take approximately 45 minutes to play.

—description from the publisher

name: Astraea: The Seraphim Paradox
description:
Within the turbulent plane of Astraea, peace is a fleeting dream. Wars rage, tragedy strikes, and the battlefield becomes a canvas of strategy and power. Amidst the chaos, commanders rise, guiding their troops through a dance of tactical prowess, seeking victory by morale or complete annihilation. As a player, you'll immerse yourself in this intricate dance, orchestrating your forces' movements, launching attacks, assembling versatile constructs, and leveraging unique formations to create devastating combos. Each decision carries weight, as the path to triumph requires both foresight and adaptability.

Astraea: The Seraphim Paradox invites two players into a strategic skirmish on a grid-based battlefield. Armed with a meticulously crafted faction of 20 cards - comprising 10 units, 6 constructs, and 4 formations - players are given the choice of deploying units for a robust offensive or holding some back for greater command flexibility. More troops on the field might amplify your battle presence, but holding onto cards can increase your available actions. Success hinges on strategic foresight and timely decisions.

With its initial release, Astraea: The Seraphim Paradox provides an ever-rich tapestry of lore and strategy, featuring five distinct factions. The "Shields of Genmar" stand as the stalwart defenders of the capital city's ideals, ever-ready to lay down their lives for the realm. Opposing them are "The Risen," Genmarian rebels who've embraced forbidden magics to challenge the very fabric of their world. Meanwhile, the "Seraphim Kestral's," sky-toned enigmas from beyond, bring with them a paradox that not only fractured the realm but thrust them into this relentless war. New contenders await your discovery... Choose your allegiance, and let the battle to restore Astraea begin!

name: Astraios: Starlight
description:
One day, all the stars vanished from the world.
Children, chosen by Astraios bring the light back into the world.

Players take turns placing a tile one at a time to connect the stars into an enclosed shape to create a nebula.  Players now work with 3 tiles in their hand, and all information is open to all players.  At the end of the game players only score points for stars in their constellations.

Astraios: Starlight is a new glow-in-the-dark edition with changes to the gameplay strategy.  Play competitively up to 3 players.  With 4 players, play in 2 teams to control the sky.

—description from the publisher

name: Astralia Chronicles
description:
Astralia Chronicles in an trading card game with classic game design and anime aesthetic. Its easy to learn, hard to master gameplay and stratified lore will provide an immersive game experience for both new and expert card gamers.

Astralia Chronicles is a game that is played between 2 and the objective of the game is to win by defeating the opponent Lead card.

Each player choose a Protagonist (his companion during the battle: it determine the cards that player can put in the decks and who will start the game), a Persona Deck (a 5-card deck that represents the idendity of the Lead and are the heart of the strategy, usable via Protagonist unique skill) and the Main Deck (a 45-card deck with all other Characters and action that player can play during the game). Each Protagonist has a peculiar gameplay, strength and weak points.
Each player has a field of 6 slot, where they can call cards from their hand. There are 3 types of cards: Characters (that can fight with other Characters, Scenography or Protagonist), Scenography (cards that remain on the field but they cannot attack or block) and Actions (cards that can be played in both turn with immediate effects).
Each card has a fragment cost, a resource that is granted simultaneously to both player at the start of each first-player-turn.

—description from the designer

name: Asturias 1936-1937
description:
Wargame of the Asturias Front in the Spanish Civil War.
Asturias 1936-1937 can be played on full campaign or one of the three scenarios: Insurrection, Grado Corridor and Final Offensive.
Asturias was the last Loyalist stronghold in the Northern Front, so the Nationalist player will try to break the defensive lines and reach Oviedo and Gijon to win this game.
The board shows the Asturias province a point-to-point map, and the counters are battalion-size units. 
The Nationalist player will count with the help of Colonial units, also Italian and German planes.

—description from the designer

Juego sobre el Frente de Asturias en la Guerra Civil Española.
Contempla toda la campaña completa, desde la Sublevación hasta la Ofensiva Final, aunque pueden jugarse tres escenarios de manera independiente: Sublevación, Pasillo de Grado y la Ofensiva Final.
Asturias fue el último baluarte de la República en el Frente Norte, y el jugador Nacional debe tratar de romper las defensas republicanas para socorrer Oviedo y, si es posible, conquistar Gijón para liquidar este frente.
El tablero muestra la región de Asturias y provincias limítrofes en un mapa punto-a-punto, mientras que las fichas muestran unidades tipo batallón. El jugador nacional cuenta con el apoyo de unidades del Ejército de África, y las aviaciones italiana y alemana.

—description from the designer (Spanish)

name: Asuntos Internos
description:
"Attention to all units, a murder has occurred". Witnesses immediately alerted the Homicide Division of the city's Police Station. The crime scene is being investigated without knowing that among the officers is the Killer. Furthermore, there might be an Accomplice diverting the investigation so that the culprit is never revealed. Will they manage to uncover the murderer in time?

"Asuntos Internos" is an exciting hidden roles game for 4 to 8 players that puts them in the shoes of forensic detectives investigating a mysterious murder. One player secretly takes on the role of the killer, while the rest of the players act as investigators working together to solve the case.

The main objective of "Asuntos Internos" is to solve a murder by accusing the killer before time runs out. Players must collaborate to identify the killer and gather enough evidence to bring them to justice.

The Killer wins the game if, by the end, they haven't been discovered (if there are Accomplices in the game, they also share the victory as the Killer wasn't uncovered).

The Innocent Police win the game if they manage to discover the Killer, revealing their role through Evidence and Investigations.


“¡Atención a todas las unidades, ha ocurrido un asesinato!” Testigos inmediatamente dieron aviso a la división de homicidios de la Policía de la ciudad. La escena del crimen está siendo investigada sin saber que entre los uniformados está el Asesino. Además, podría haber un Cómplice que esté desviando la investigación para que nunca se sepa el culpable. ¿Lograrán descubrir al asesino a tiempo?

Asuntos Internos es un emocionante juego de roles ocultos de 3 a 8 jugadores que los sitúa en el papel de detectives forenses que investigan un misterioso asesinato. Uno de los jugadores asume en secreto el papel del asesino, mientras que el resto de los jugadores representan a los investigadores que trabajarán juntos para resolver el caso.

El objetivo principal de Asuntos Internos es resolver un asesinato acusando al asesino antes de que el tiempo se agote. Los jugadores deben trabajar juntos para identificar al asesino y recopilar pruebas suficientes para llevarlo ante la justicia.

• El Asesino gana la partida si al final del juego no logró ser descubierto (si hubiera Cómplices en la partida, estos también comparten la victoria debido a que el Asesino no logró ser descubierto).

• Los Policías Inocentes ganan la partida si logran descubrir al Asesino, revelando su Rol por medio de Evidencias e Investigaciones.

name: Auch schon clever: Dschungelparty
description:
You want to get your hands on everything you can at the jungle party: bananas, coconuts, rings, flowers, and butterflies! Will you be able to grab more than all the other partygoers?

Auch schon clever: Dschungelparty (German for "Also Pretty Clever: Jungle Party") features gameplay similar to Ganz schön clever, with one player rolling dice on their turn, then choosing what they want while everyone else gets something from what's left behind.

On your turn, roll the five dice. The faces of these dice show a joker symbol or an icon on one of four colored backgrounds. Choose all the dice of one background color, taking any jokers at the same time, then use the symbols on these die faces to mark off items in this colored area of your score sheet:


    Flowers are in the green area, for example, and you must pair each flower you take with a butterfly, which shows in which row you can mark the flower.
    For the rings in the blue area, you take all of the dice showing elephants, then re-roll them; you choose a background color on these re-rolled dice, then mark one ring for each die of this color.
    Bananas in the purple area can be marked off only in bunches, with you needing, say, three bananas at once to mark a bunch of three bananas.
    Coconuts in the pink area, and each pink side of a die shows two half coconuts in different patterns; for each whole coconut in a single pattern, mark the next coconut in the area.


Each other player then chooses dice of a single background color that you didn't take — and players can choose the same or different colors — and marks off what they can.

If you mark off a circled item, the two flowers surrounding a circle, or a row next to a circle, you can immediately cross off an item in the section of the same color as that circle. Crossing off this item might give you another bonus!

When a player marks off all items in one area, the game ends at the conclusion of that turn. Various items or rows that you complete have rainbow stars connected to them, and whoever collects the most rainbow stars wins!

name: Auction Land
description:
Welcome, fellow islander! Let's auction some Land and build our dream island together!

Imagine beaches perfect for sunbathing, a sprawling theme park for endless fun, cosy houses for residents to rest, and lush gardens to enjoy the fresh air.

And what's a paradise island without peace, love, and music? Let's spread them far and wide across our beautiful island!

				
				
					========In this game, you'll claim Land, maximise Bonus Land opportunities, and, of course, auction off Land!

Money flows from player to player as bidders try to get more Land at reasonable prices, while the auctioneer's job is to stir excitement—after all, they keep the proceeds!

If the winning bid isn't satisfactory, you always have the option to buy back the Land. Plus, as the winning bidder, you’ll receive this payment!
Align tiles perfectly and win bonus tiles! An extra layer of strategy and joy.

				
				
					========Turn Summary:

1. Claim Land: Each turn, pick your Land tiles and place them where they’ll score the most.
2. Earn Bonus: If you place the 4th tile in a row or column, you earn Bonus Land; an exciting twist -every tile has value!
3. Auction: Start an open auction for Land, turning the room into a lively bazaar.
4. Endgame: If anyone fills up a 4x4 grid, the game ends. If not, reveal new Land and keep going.

				
				
					========A game about claiming Land, auctioning Land, and building Land to maximise points.

Features:
• Dynamic Market Row; choose tiles that vary in prices from free to expensive.
• Closed economy with a novel buyback system for added tension and interaction
• Gentle-but-deep strategy with dramatic realtime auctions
• A mixture of absolute scoring -for personal satisfaction- and relative scoring -for greater interaction.
• As the game progresses, Bonus Land accelerates the pace and adds a new dimension to the placement puzzle.

2-6 players; works great in every player count! We promise!

The more players, the more you’ll find yourself in a bazaar!
With 2 players, the auctions become a 1-bid auction and things become even more strategic.

Full Rulebook: Follow link

				
				
					========In 2024, Bez sold the rights to this game to Doruk, who continues to tweak it and is pitching it to various publishers.

—description from the designer

name: Auctions of Alchemists
description:
Auctions of Alchemists is a new unique mystical auction game set in a fantasy world by Tanax Games. Players race to create six elixirs by compounding four colored ingredients obtained through strategic bidding.

Each round one player will get the choice : to auction or to perform an alchemy action.  
During the auction they the ingredient type (color) is revealed, but 1 card that shows the amount of liquid is placed face down so only the active player knows.  Players take turns bidding and the player who bid the highest wins both ingredients.  
But watch out!  The unknown amount of liquid could push your test tubes limit over the top, or cause all the liquid to be lost.

If they choose to perform an alchemy action they can either transmute for gold, convert ingredients to another, or combine and create their elixirs.

Every time someone does an alchemy action day changes to night, and night to day and the value of ingredients will change.

You'll need to time your alchemy actions wisely, and outwit your opponents in the auctions to gain the ingredients you require.  
The first to create six elixirs wins!

Auctions of Alchemist uses a very clever and interesting way of auction and managing your resources!

—description from the publisher

name: Audience
description:
In Audience, 2 to 6 players compete to earn the most 'Share' points and become the most influential radio station! It’s a highly interactive game that combines trick-taking with majority mechanics.

Each radio station has a team of six speakers, and each speaker has its own wave power, which can be either one or two. A speaker may also have a special effect that could disrupt their opponents' plans. All the speaker decks are the same in terms of effects and power. Each player starts the game with all their speaker cards available.

The Audience cards are displayed in a line (or a grid in the advanced mode) and represent the listeners that players are competing for.

During their turns, players can either play a speaker card into a column or draw their entire discard pile. A column is considered saturated when the total wave power played into it is at least 4. The player with the highest wave power in a saturated column wins the Audience card. In case of a tie, the winner is the player with the topmost speaker card.

The audience is divided into 6 categories, each of which awards points at the end of the game to the player who collects the highest number of symbols in that category.

Some event cards from the audience deck may appear, representing sponsorship opportunities. Each event card will assign points to the player who obtains it, each with its unique scoring method.

Audience can also be played in teams: 2 vs 2, 2 vs 2 vs 2, or in teams of 3 players each.

—description from the publisher

name: Avant Après
description:
Avant Après (meaning "Before After") is an investigation game in two pictures.
In this cooperative game, half the players see the picture of a scene happening "Before", while the rest see the aftermath of the events pictured.
Communicate between the two groups to understand what happened between the two timestamps and answer the question cards right.

Contain 6 cases.

name: Dirt & Dust
publisher: Albi; Albi Polska; Cranio Creations; Grok Games; Maldito Games
description:
In Dirt & Dust, players are rally drivers racing through dynamic stages at breakneck speeds. Every turn and acceleration is a thrilling test of skill and finesse, pushing both the car and the driver to their limits.

At the start, each player holds five basic action cards along with five unique pilot cards. As the race unfolds, participants will acquire additional action cards to fine-tune their vehicles, adjust dampers, check tire pressure and geometry settings, or modify the active differential. Dice rolls determine each driver's ability to execute these actions, enhancing their chances of maintaining control on the challenging tracks.

The journey kicks off along a stunning coastal road where breathtaking views are matched only by the treacherous hairpin turns. Next, players navigate the tight streets of a European city, mastering roundabouts and sharp corners. As they hone their racing skills, they'll be ready to tackle iconic races set in breathtaking mountain landscapes, shaded forest trails, and the exhilarating depths of nighttime racing.

Dirt & Dust blends deck-building mechanisms with strategic dice placement, delivering an adrenaline-fueled rally surviving experience. Skillful driving is essential, but only those who can overcome obstacles and achieve better times than their opponents will triumph.

—description from the publisher

name: Avec Infini Regret IV
description:
Avec Infini Regret IV - French Wars of Religion, 1562 - 1598

JARNAC (March 13, 1569): the Protestant rearguard led by Admiral de Coligny is threatened by the entire Catholic army crossing the Charente near Jarnac. The heavily outnumbered Huguenots put up a desperate fight. Threatened with being turned on their right by the reîtres, the Protestants retreated in good order.
Condé, at the head of 300 lances, threw himself into the battle to delay the enemy's advance. The gendarmes only managed to push the Catholics back for a short time.  At the height of the charge, Condé was unhorsed; immobilized, he handed his sword to a Catholic gentleman as a sign of surrender.  Then Montesquiou, captain of the King's guard, intervened, shouting “Tuez...Mordiou...Tuez!” and fired a pistol at point-blank range, killing the Prince instantly. 
In control of the battlefield, the Royal Army was unable to capitalize on this victory.

ARQUES (September 21, 1589): Henri IV is waiting near Dieppe for reinforcements and money from England. The Ligueurs, led by the Duke of Mayenne, wish to prevent this landing and attack the royal troops entrenched at the junction of two valleys. The Ligueurs' attack, led by cavalry on the front and lansquenets on the left wing, broke through the Royalists' solid defenses. The latter counter-attacked and drove the enemy back to their original positions.
With no way of breaking through the defenses, the Ligueurs withdrew, leaving the victory to the King. The King expressed his joy to his comrade-in-arms who was absent that day: “Brave Crillon, pendés-vous de n'avoir été icy près de moy ...”.

—description from the designer

name: Aventuria: Chalices of Power
description:
Aventuria: Chalices of Power is a cooperative adventure card game campaign for 1 to 6 players. Choose one of 10 exciting heroes and compete for the seven magical chalices against wild monsters, devious villains and deadly demons. The campaign consists of 10 adventures with almost 20 acts and a playing time of approx. 60 hours. Gain experience points, treasures, companions and new equipment, and improve your heroes. Aventuria gives you a true role-playing experience in the form of an outstanding card game. Are you ready to become legends?

—description from the publisher

name: Aventuria: Curse of the Desert
description:
Aventuria - Curse of the Desert is a solo adventure card game campaign in which you lead a single hero through two thrilling adventures set in the Aventurian version of the Tales of the Thousand and One Nights. Face dangerous opponents and exciting encounters to free the caliph's daughter Nedime and avert the curse of the dark magician Borbarad. The game lasts approx. 30 hours. The box contains a hero, the Tulamydian Blessed One of Phex, in two alternative versions, as well as all the rules and game materials required for the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Avoid the Cats!
description:
Avoid the Cats! is a family trick taking/avoidance game where players play as rats trying to avoid the cats, who will chase players that goes for specific cheese. Will you be able to score points avoiding them? Or, even better, will you face them all for even more of points?

Using some simplified mechanics from Cheez-Tricks, players play trick-taking hands, following usual trick-taking rules (must follow, trump, etc). In each round, though, some cats should be avoided. For example, the player should not get the Parmesan 7.

Points are awarded according to cats avoided. After three rounds, the player with the most points is the winner.

—description from the designer

name: AVíO
description:
AVíO is a trick-taking game in which you must choose wisely which cards to play, and even more which one to keep, in order to win.

The cards in AVíO, as in other trick-taking games, have a value and a suit. The special feature is that they also contain an objective to be fulfilled (an avio). In each round, players are dealt 9 cards and 8 tricks are played. The card that is not played determines the objective of each player in the round and the points he/she gets if he/she fulfills it.

The first player to score 30 points wins the game.

name: Awry: The Forest
description:
AWRY: The Forest, a pocket sized horror card game for 1 to 4 players, created by James Ginn.

Everything has gone awry... I don’t know how to explain what happened... This was supposed to be a scientific expedition, but it turned into a nightmare. Last night something monstrous attacked us. We found Dolph hanging from the branches, mutilated beyond recognition. There was blood everywhere. It was a clear message...

Whatever did this was huge and ruthless. And that’s not all! Tech is useless here. Our GPS, radio, watches...none of them work. BUT weirder...even the map is wrong- it’s like the forest is alive and shifting around us.   We have to get out of here!

We ran with only the essentials. I’m writing this journal as a last resort, in case we don’t make it. Maybe someone will find it and learn from our mistakes.

If that's you, it means I’m gone and you are in mortal peril. Pay attention to every word. And may your God, luck and all the wisdom of the world be with you.

The goal of the games is to escape the forest. Your individual
progress is represented by forest cards which can be obtained during the game.

Each round is divided into three phases;
Dawn: Players draw 4 cards.
Day: Players interact with each other.
Dusk: Players resolve any threat cards,

There are nine types of cards: Navigation, Shelter, Provisions,
Threat, Stress, Junk, Weapon, Cursed and Illumination.

During the round, it is crucial players obtain Shelter and Provisions. Players lose 1 Life Token for each one they do not spend during the Dusk phase.

As well as Shelter and Provisions, Players can spend Navigation cards to draw from the Forest deck. This is how you obtain Forest cards. Each player has their own row of forest cards to track their progress and location. The game ends once all players have either escaped with their lives or perished.

—description from the designer

name: Garden Lake
description:
Garden Lake offers a relaxing and rewarding experience. Players build their garden lakes with water lilies and koi fish using pentomino tiles. The catch is that on their turn, players always place one tile, but they can earn additional tiles by completing various objectives, which allows them to chain moves and strategize their way to victory.

—description from the publisher

name: Ayacucho 1824: End of the Spanish Empire
description:
The battle of Ayacucho was the last big and important clash or arms between the Royalist (defenders of Spanish Monarchy) and the Patriots ( American pro-independence troops) in December 9th of 1824 in Peru.

The result of this decisive battle was the victory of the patriots and the independence of Spanish America and the consequent end of the Spanish Empire.

Uses a game system rarely seen in wargames, suitable for the battles of Spanish America, which are like Napoleonic pocket battles.

On their turns, players must activate Division generals who then can move the battalions along the marked positions for each one. Then combat takes places while players may use the event cards to surprise the enemy and modify the results.

The battle ends when the morale of one of the armies reaches cero, and the other army will be the winner.

—description from the designer

name: Removal
description:
Removal is a fast-paced family game with easy-to-learn rules, designed by Michał Reszka, illustrated by Victor Wong. It’s to be played with 2 to 4 players, age 8 and up and you should be able to play it within 30 to 45 minutes.

Each player takes on the role of a Removal company’s workers, trying to fill their car with all sorts of junk without breaking anything. Players gradually rummage through the house in an attempt to transport the most valuable objects and not drive around with empty car. Some objects cannot lie on their sides, others can be broken if you transport them not carefully, and some are so heavy that they cannot be carried anywhere but on the bottom.

—description from the publisher

name: Azul Duel
publisher: Next Move Games; ADC Blackfire Entertainment; Belleville (Бельвіль); Enigma (Bergsala Enigma); Galápagos Jogos; Gém Klub Kft.; Hobby Japan; MIPL; One Moment Games; Rebel Sp. z o.o.; Zvezda
description:
Decorate the magnificent ceilings of the palace. Will the vaults look more beautiful by day or by night? Azul Duel invites you to play with light and pit opposites against each other.

This competitive strategic game for two players retains the purity and elegance of the original Azul while adding an extra tactical dimension in which you determine the pattern in which tiles will be placed, in addition to drafting tiles to complete that pattern.

name: B-17 Flying Fortress: The Bloody 100th Board Game Edition
description:
B-17 Flying Fortress: The Bloody 100th Board Game Edition invites you to step into the boots of a WWII bomber crew, managing every facet of a harrowing mission deep into enemy-controlled Europe. This cooperative board game tests tactical mettle and communication under fire as you:

Survive the onslaught: Endure intense flak bombardments, outmaneuver Luftwaffe fighters, and manage critical aircraft damage.

Coordinate critical roles: Pilot, bombardier, gunner—every crew member’s task is vital to keep your Fortress flying strong.

Balance resources: Carefully manage fuel, emergency kits, repairs, and morale as you stare down impossible odds.

Lead escort squadrons: Command protective fighters as they shield your crew from enemy interceptions.

Work as a team or crumble in chaos: Communication is your lifeline; the mission hangs by threads of teamwork and strategy. Every mission throws fresh challenges and tests your limits. Will you return as war heroes—or fall in flames?

—description from the publisher

GAMEPLAY

The game is designed for 1–4 players, with a strong solo experience that mirrors the intensity and immersion of classic MicroProse flight sims. Cooperative play lets multiple players take on different crew roles aboard the same aircraft. A typical mission lasts 2-4 hours, depending on player count and how deep you go into mission planning and combat detail. A full campaign can span multiple sessions as your crew gains experience, faces tougher missions, and (hopefully) makes it home.

RULEBOOK

You can read the latest rulebook draft here: https://www.microprose.com/downloads/manuals/100th-board/b-17-flying-fortress-bloody-100th-rulebook_v081.pdf

RELEASE

There are currently no plans for a retail release. B-17 Flying Fortress: The Bloody 100th Board Game Edition is being developed as a Kickstarter-exclusive project, and backers will have the first and possibly only opportunity to secure a copy during this campaign. Fulfilment is scheduled for May 2026.

GAME DESIGNER

The B-17 Flying Fortress: The Bloody 100th Board Game edition was designed by Etherfield in partnership with MicroProse. It is fully supported and endorsed by the 100th Bomb Group Foundation.

name: Baby Party
description:
Baby Party is a hilarious party and dexterity game where players go head-to-head to complete challenges drawn from a deck filled with baby-themed mini games. The winner is the first player to land all three of their tiny, colorful baby figurines onto an ever-growing dance floor of cards at the same time.

The theme is a chaotic baby nightclub called Bottles & Beats, complete with a mini disco ball, a baby bottle, and a shiny bouncer who might bounce you right out the door.

Each challenge is paired with a well-known baby-related phrase, like “Hasta La Vista, Baby,” where a player flicks a baby off their thumb like a marble, or “Baby Bump,” where two players fist bump and drop one of their babies onto the table. Other challenges, like “Baby Shampoo,” might involve dropping your baby off your forehead, or “Baby Face,” where all players stare at one of their babies — and whoever blinks last gets to drop theirs alongside yours.

After each mini game, the completed challenge card is flipped and added to the table, expanding the dance floor. As the nightclub fills with more cards and more babies, the game crescendos in chaos and fun, building toward a cheer-out-loud finale.

—description from the designer

name: Backstab Heroes
description:
Those who dedicate themselves to a life of adventure have only one goal: to become disgustingly rich quickly – and without taking any risks, please!
In Backstab Heroes, you become part of a ‘hero group’ that loves nothing more than pushing each other to the front line so that someone else can keep the monsters busy. While the others take the hits, you lurk in the shadows, waiting for the big loot.
But beware: if no one is brave enough to defeat the monster, the whole group will come away empty-handed. Fame and glory? Forget it – only gold counts!

Backstab Heroes is a chaotic and comical card game for 3–6 players in which anti-heroes try to outsmart each other to grab treasures – without fighting, of course. Fame is worthless; only gold counts. All players choose their actions simultaneously, keeping the game dynamic and unpredictable. Those who find the right balance between cooperation and betrayal will go home with the biggest loot at the end!

—description from the publisher (translated)

Wer sich dem Leben als Abenteurer verschreibt, hat nur ein Ziel: schnell widerwärtig reich werden – und das bitte ohne jedes Risiko!

In Backstab Heroes wirst du Teil einer „Heldengruppe“, die nichts mehr liebt, als sich gegenseitig in die vorderste Reihe zu schubsen, damit jemand anderes die Monster beschäftigt. Während die anderen einstecken, lauerst du in den Schatten auf fette Beute. 
Doch aufgepasst: Wenn niemand mutig genug ist, das Monster zu besiegen, geht die ganze Gruppe leer aus. Ruhm und Ehre? Vergiss es – nur Gold zählt!

Backstab Heroes ist ein chaotisch-komisches Kartenspiel für 3–6 Spieler, in dem Anti-Helden sich gegenseitig austricksen, um Schätze abzugreifen – natürlich möglichst ohne selbst zu kämpfen. Ruhm bringt nichts, nur Gold zählt. Alle Spieler wählen gleichzeitig ihre Aktion, wodurch das Spiel dynamisch und unberechenbar bleibt. Wer das richtige Maß zwischen Kooperation und Verrat findet, geht am Ende mit der dicksten Beute nach Hause!

—description from the publisher

name: Reptile Tank
description:
Reptile Tank is drafting tableau-building game designed and illustrated by Michal Peichl. It’s for 1 to 6 players, ages 8 and up and one game lasts between 20 and 30 minutes.

In Reptile Tank the players draft the cards with various species of lizards, snakes and tortoises and place them in the grid - the eponymous Reptile Tank. At the end of the game, once all grids have been completed, the players will count their points and check who has made their reptiles the happiest.
