All the eyes of the galaxy will be watching this decennial event celebrating the unification of our systems under Silo Supremacy.

ORBIT (Orbital Race Between Interstellar Tourists) is a 24th century tactical space race with simple turns, yet challenging possibilities. Players compete to visit all planets of the system, then return to their starting planet first.

On your turn, you play a card, activate its actions in any order, then draw back up to your hand size. Cards allow you to do a combination of things: move your ship, collect energy for bonus movement, advance planets along their orbit, or even reverse the orbital direction of a planet.

Players can enjoy a randomized set-up across two unique game boards. The game also includes a few variants: two-player dual ship mode, four-player partnership mode, and a stationary planet.

ORBIT is the third and concluding game in the Cosmic Silos Trilogy by Reiner Knizia.

—description from the publisher

name: Empire of Grass: The Conquests of Genghis Khan
description:
Empire of Grass: The Conquests of Gengis Khan is a Solitaire Card-Wargame of the Mongol invasion of Eurasia in the twelfth century under Genghis (Chinggis) Khan.

You play the Great Khan, commanding his armies as he conquers territories, recruits other nomads into his army, and either garrisons or razes cities.

The map of your conquests is made through placing cards which represent the regions of Eurasia that the Mongols conquered (or tried to). As you expand you have to take care as neighbouring kingdoms may appear to challenge you and your allies can desert or even rebel.

An optional game allows for an uncertain world with the cards randomised.

—description from the designer

name: SILOS
description:
It is the year glork-too-vleep, or mid-20th century according to Earthling time. We recently stumbled across this planet called Earth and discovered intelligent, albeit primitive, life. The most intelligent and valuable of these specimens are the creatures known as cows. Alas, for our galactic goals we must settle upon the second-most intelligent form of life on Earth: the human being. These creatures are just intelligent enough. Their brains appear eager to be molded, and their civilization perfect for our siloing.

Aliens have come to silo humans — brainwash, steer, and preserve human civilization — for their cosmic purposes! In SILOS (Secret InterLopers from Outer Space), players control competing factions of aliens who abduct and brainwash humans and cows while secretly invading their community. Players tussle for majority influence in the key locations of this small town as they seek to activate location powers and control human specimens for societal power.

Players take turns repositioning their alien figures and activating an event card. The objective is to collect a complete set of humans: politicians, government operators, influencers, and professionals. A complete set will earn a player a societal power emblem, and the first player to earn five emblems wins the game. Cows are particularly valuable and thus count as wild tokens toward forming a complete set.

SILOS is a remastered edition of Reiner Knizia's Municipium that introduces many innovations by:


     Restructuring the player psychology via clear, public, and easy card counting
     Increasing the gameplay variety and strategies with modular location power tiles
     Enhancing tactical considerations with powerful leader figures
     Broadening the appeal of the theme and presentation with wacky alien conspiracy art by Kwanchai Moriya and Brigette Indelicato
     Enlivening the production with disguised alien figures, abductable cows, and a roaming UFO


The separate Crop Circles Expansion introduces more elements of long-term strategy through the crop circles module, while also featuring diverging asymmetry through the permanent skill tiles module.

—description from the publisher

name: End of the Line: Post-Apocalyptic Family Survival
description:
Outlast your neighbors as you send your nuclear family out to collect vital resources in the ruined world. Simultaneous play, deadly drafting, light programming and dark humor combine to form a Rube Goldberg Machine of DOOOOOOM.

The new edition is quicker to learn, just as dangerous, and updated with more pop-cultural references and new game mechanics. Without the ability to directly target your adversaries, this is a passive-aggressive interpretation of “take that.” You must survive every kind of awful that you'd inflict on others.

Welcome to the End times! Warning: none of you may survive.

—description from the publisher

name: Arribada
description:
In Arribada, players lay out turtles during a mass nesting event known as an arribada, “arrival by sea.” The goal of the game is to place turtles in groups (sequences or sets) to score points and to make sure as few of your turtles as possible are left stranded by the end of the game. Family means no turtle gets left behind!

Arribada is an approachable strategy game with surprising depth and layered interaction. It’s satisfying and easy to build sets and sequences of your turtles, but things get even more interesting when players begin to fight over the same turtle! Some turtles are better at scoring you quick points, while others are super effective for capturing opponent tiles or gaining bonus turns. When you capture an opponent turtle, it becomes a wild to help you build even more lucrative groups! Meanwhile, players are competing for presence and majorities across the four quadrants for massive end-game points. But be careful, any stranded turtles at game end will hurt your score!

Players take turns placing a turtle tile, claiming a neutral tile, or capturing an opponent tile. The game end is triggered when a player places out their last turtle shell.

—description from the publisher

name: Engine Thieves: The Andrews Railroad Raid of 1862
description:
On April 12, 1862, the charismatic Union agent James Andrews and his band of raiders stole the train powered by the locomotive, “The General,” from under the noses of about 3000 Confederate troops training at Big Shanty (Kennesaw), GA. Their risky mission was to cut telegraph wires, burn railroad bridges, and damage track between Atlanta and Chattanooga, thus severing communications, reinforcements, and supplies between the two cities. This was as Union General Mitchel advanced his forces upon Chattanooga with the aim of capturing it and splitting the Confederacy in two. The raiders needed to bluff their way through the Confederate railroad stations and even pass through Chattanooga to meet the advancing Union force in Bridgeport!

Engine Thieves covers this courageous Civil War raid. Play as the Union raiders in a solo game as you race against time, and the Confederate soldiers on your tail, to get to Bridgeport. With two players, one of you will play as the Confederates and try to stop your opponent from reaching Bridgeport or at least minimize their destructive sabotage. Follow the adventure and real path these raiders took on their daring ride north!

As the solo player in charge of Andrews and the Union raiders, you must accumulate at least 25 Victory Points by some combination of burning bridges, cutting telegraph wires, damaging track, bringing the stolen train to Bridgeport, and defeating Confederate units that get in your way, all while minimizing raider casualties. Reaching Bridgeport is a high priority since without that accomplishment, General Mitchel would likely call off his attack on Chattanooga. Mitchel might be otherwise unaware of the Raiders’ successes!

The game ends when the Raiders player either passes through Chattanooga and reaches Union General Mitchel in Bridgeport, must abandon the stolen train, all Raiders are killed or captured, or the time track reaches 4:00pm.

In the Two-Player version of the game (which was not included in the Print-on-Demand edition), as the Confederate player your goal is to keep the Raiders from accumulating Victory Points by relentlessly pursuing them, inflicting casualties, minimizing their ability to carry out sabotage, and keeping them from reaching Bridgeport before the game’s end.

name: Enthrone
description:
An ages-old game of intrigue, guile and deduction for two players.

You are the silent hand. One of 8 unwitting pawns will be your key to securing ultimate power. But your rival hides their own machinations to challenge you. Can you deduce their identity and eliminate them? Remove three key political targets? Or simply waltz in undetected and seize the throne?

ENTHRONE is an abstract, two-player deduction game. The roughly octagonal, diecut board is ringed by 8 beautifully crafted figures, busts representing the potential heir to the throne; the reigning King, the Priestess, the Knight, the Jester, the Demon, the Assassin, the Archer and the Wizard.

Each player is dealt three identity cards, each showing one of the above pawns. You will choose one whom you intend to Enthrone. You also know the other two identities you did not choose - are not the identity of your opponent. They have the same knowledge - and two identities are left forever unknown by any player.

You win if you can advance your pawn to the throne space at the center of the board. OR you can win by deducing who your opponent is and capturing and eliminating their pawn. OR you can have the three target identities listed on the bottom of your card eliminated from the game (by you or your opponent's handiwork).

But the magic of the game is which pieces can be activated each turn - and what they are capable of, based on their position on the tile track. Hex Tiles on the bottom three positions are locked and cannot be moved. The top five can move by placing the tile on the bottom of the Hex tiles and pushing all tiles above it up one notch. Tiles in the top two spaces are the only ones capable of capturing and eliminating a piece. Tiles in the top three positions are the only once who can be moved to the Throne space (so long as it is YOUR pawn). Manipulating and strategizing how to move and position these tiles to suit your agenda is critical. Keeping your identity secret, while unveiling your opponents is the tension. 
An abstract strategy game like no other - and absolutely stunning on the table. A game fit for Kings - or those who would enthrone them.

—description from the publisher

name: Epilogue
description:
You wake up in an endless desert, with only a door on the horizon.

What happened?! Is this - the great beyond? Why are your friends here? And HOW ON EARTH did you get here??

In Epilogue you'll form words using fragments to cooperatively tell the story of your group's final moments. Was it shenanigans? Tragedy? Or a whole factory of banana peels? How does your story end?

name: Epochs: Course of Cultures
publisher: ICE Makes; GaGa Games; TLAMA games
description:
When history becomes your canvas, how will your legacy be written?

Epochs: Course of Cultures is a strategic 4X civilization game for 2 to 4 players where you guide your society across 3 epochs: Ancient, Medieval, and Modern. Each decision shapes your path as you expand territory, research inventions, build wonders, and develop your civilization.

Over multiple rounds, you draw invention cards, take actions, and manage cities, trade, and military strength on an evolving map. You may focus on culture, innovation, or conquest, but every choice carries lasting impact.

At the end of the final epoch, the player with the most prestige from achievements, expansion, and development becomes the greatest ruler.

—description from the publisher

name: Epona
description:
Welcome to Epona, an immersive, tableau-building card game for 1-6 players in which you step into the boots of an ambitious equestrian entrepreneur in Central Europe in the 1920s, a time of relative peace and prosperity. Now is the time to finally invest in your dream: to build the most prestigious and successful horse business in the land. But will Epona, the Roman and Gallic goddess of horses and fertility, bring you good fortune as you set out on this endeavor?

Over six rounds, you'll acquire new locations for your stables, hire expert staff, purchase essential equipment, and build everything you need, from training arenas to thrilling race tracks. Of course, you'll need horses, too, but choose them wisely as each one brings different ways to score points.

Want to go the extra mile? Breed your horses to create future champions and secure your name in equine history! Every choice matters, and every card you add to your tableau brings you closer to greatness — or leaves you in the dust. Will your stables rise above the rest?

—description from the publisher

name: EPOS: A Gentes Game
description:
Throughout history, the Mediterranean was inhabited by many different peoples and city-states. In EPOS: A Gentes Game, you lead your people to prosperity to secure a fitting place in history.

EPOS is a "game collection" set in the Gentes universe that consists of:


    A base game
    Eight scenarios
    A campaign game (with different lengths and challenges)


You can play the scenarios in any order, repeating them or skipping them as you like, or once you're familiar with the base game, you can dive into the campaign. The scenarios are:

1. Kingdoms
People start to establish their first settlements, cities, and eventually kingdoms. Help your people grow and expand, and send your pioneers to as many territories as possible.

2. Tributes
The competition among your different peoples for resources and power steadily increases, so ask your gods for their help. Whose achievements will find a place in history?

3. Infrastructure
After the founding of cities, trading posts are important for the exchange of goods on important trade routes. Increasingly, these routes alone become lucrative sources of power and wealth, surpassing some cities in their importance.

4. Expeditions
Curiosity and the need to discover new regions lead brave explorers to distant lands where they create new opportunities for their own glory and for the benefit of their people. Expeditions and the development of your population propel your people to unprecedented prosperity and increase your wealth.

5. Trade
As you start to transport increasingly valuable goods over long distances, they become a popular form of currency. Depending on the demand, prices of goods fluctuate, so make sure you trade at the right time to prevent shortages.

6. Progress
Kingdoms are connected by trade networks. Your people continuously develop new technologies and improve skills.

7. Turbulent Times
After years of prosperity, times get a bit tougher for your people. Enemies at your borders and internal unrest, natural disasters, and plagues afflict them — truly turbulent times! Only together can you fight and overcome these problems, which require you to invest time and resources.

8. New Era
Your people have experienced several changes in fortunes and survived turbulent times. Now they stand on the threshold of a new era! It is time to explore new paths, but each people must find its own way. Only those who keep their population in good spirits, using culture and luxury goods, will acquire eternal glory: Panem et Circenses! Embark on the new era in the Mediterranean for generations to come!

For the EPOS campaign game, you play either all eight scenarios or a random selection of four.

name: Equation Hi-Lo
description:
Test your math skills and strategy in Equation Hi-Lo, the ultimate blend of poker-style betting and equation-building fun! Compete to create equations that get as close as possible to 1 (low) or 20 (high) while outsmarting your opponents. Do you have what it takes to claim all the chips?

How It Works

Bet & Build: Use randomly dealt numbers from 1-10 and arithmetic operation cards (plus, minus, divide, multiply, square root) to construct equations that are close to 1 or 20. Bluff or go bold—your strategy could make or break the game!

Two Ways to Win a Hand: Bet on low (closest to 1) or high (closest to 20) and have the equation that is closest to that value. You may even be able to win a hand on a bluff. Feeling confident? Swing bet on both by making two equations!

Why You’ll Love It

Challenging & Rewarding: Perfect for math lovers and strategy enthusiasts alike.
Simple setup: No complex and dense rules – get started in 5 minutes!
Replayable: Each round is different, keeping players engaged every time!

Equation Hi-Lo is great for families, friends, students learning math and adults who want to dust off their skills and keep their mind sharp! Similar to the game played in Devil’s Plan on Netflix'

—description from the designer

name: ERA
description:
In Era, you will lead a special historical group on the brink of greatness or ruin.  Using the leaders, inventions, and technology of that time period, you must successfully unfold the events that made that nation or culture forever remembered in history.  But your opponent, leading a different Era, will be trying to do the same.  As each of you works in your separate time periods, you will both throw unexpected catastrophes, powerful invaders, and obstacles at each other’s plans.  Which player will lead their Era to greatness first?

Era is a strategy card game that features a unique, 3-pile card management system to let you build, expand, and defend your unique historical group. Era is a symbols-only, no-text game system that provides a large amount of information-at-a-glance for quick and effective gameplay.

The first player to score 15 progress points or deal 3 destruction tokens to his opponent, wins.

Other features of Era:  

     Each Era deck contains conflict cards that represent your Era’s weakness or dangers. These cards are given to your opponent, and they give you theirs.  These cards are then shuffled into your decks for you to play against each other.
     Each Era deck has "keys" that unlock new cards or symbols, allowing you to relive the progression of historical events as they really happened.

name: Ernesto Capybara
description: Ernesto Capybara is a quick, chaotic card game for 2–6 players about capybaras who dream of revolution — but would rather nap through it. It mixes take-that mechanics with light strategy and timing. Play cards to pass stress, stir unrest, and push others closer to burnout. When the Revolution finally breaks out, the calmest capybara wins. Simple rules, expressive art, and plenty of passive-aggressive humor make it a perfect filler for players who enjoy a bit of friendly sabotage.

name: Escape from Labyrinth
description:
Escape from Labirynth is a roll-and-write adventure for any number of players. This game is in print and play format. In Escape the Labyrinth you're the fearless leader of six daring heroes, they are all racing to escape a twisted, trap-filled labyrinth. Your mission? Guide your heroes to the exit as cleverly and quickly as possible - and whatever you do, don’t leave anyone behind.

Each turn, you’ll draw a tile onto your game sheet, adding new corridors to the maze. Every path will connect to another - so watch where you place your pieces! One wrong move can block the way or send your heroes spinning in circles forever. Your escape skills will be put to the test - and yes, you'll be judged! So plan smart, draw tiles, and aim for the top score.

—description from the publisher

name: Escape from Projekt Riese
description:
Escape from Projekt Riese is the sequel stand alone game to Escape from Stalingrad Z. It is a solo/coop campaign game of tactical combat which is set in the horrific zombie plague of World War Two. It is 1943, the location, a secret underground Nazi base somewhere under the Owl Mountains. Your heroes are the survivors of a allied strike team, fighting to complete their crucial mission. Rendezvous with, and extract the spy, the eccentric genius and the resistance cell who have aided them.  Then, on the way out, blow everything all to hell. The stakes – a cure for the zombie plague and a chance to finally tip this war in the favour of the free world.  Your heroes must work together to find the best path, each scenario giving them options on which way to go next.

Escape from Projekt Riese is a choose your own adventure style game. A player's choices determine the fate of their heroes, for better or worse. The game plays out over a series of linked scenarios, a campaign with several different outcomes. Results and events in each Campaign scenario affect the start of the next, creating an ongoing and evolving story.

THE MISSION
Escape from Projekt Riese takes you to Festungsandlage Nr 8, a hidden underground complex where twisted Nazi science seeks to unlock and weaponize the secrets of the zombie plague. In these labyrinthine chambers beneath a Templar fortress, the products of Ahnenerbe experimentation and the newly risen dead, hungering for fresh bodies to add to their ranks, stalk the halls. You are in charge of whether your heroes survive or perish.

Your choices and tactical skills will be tested along with the ingenuity of your heroes. The survival of each of your unique combat specialists depends upon your ability to conserve resources and exploit the zombies' weaknesses. You will need to choose your tactics wisely; sometimes stealth is more important than firepower.

You may fail the first attempt at escape but with experience and proven tactics, you will advance towards the victory the free world needs.

—description from the publisher

name: Escape from Tibbles Tower
description:
Escape From Tibbles Tower is fast-paced, small box board game where players are all Tibbles, the infinite God of time, who also happens to be a moustached tuxedo cat. Trapped within the tower by your evil self Diadaxis, and his army of corrupted kittens! You must compete to be the first Tibbles to find the exit and break out of the tower before Diadaxis, or the other players, use reality bending powers to make kitty litter of your plans!

Players will reveal tower tiles, draw, and play cards to explore the tower, and cause havoc for the other players. Compete to be the first to make it to the exit tile and escape from Tibbles Tower!

—description from the publisher

name: Escape Master
description:
Escape Master is a fast-paced real-time speed card game that blends elements from classic speed card games like Dutch Blitz and modern games with a theme and storyline. The game experience was designed for maximal fun, screams, and fierce competition.

Escape Master is set in the Vapor Isles where each player takes on the role of an Escape Leader. Each Escape Leader competes to set the most captives free from the clutches of the Doom Master while committing the fewest blunders. Too many blunders and the Doom Master discovers and destroys the only way of escape ending the game.

The basic mechanic is simple. Players play numbered cards in ascending or descending order on stacks as fast as possible in order to be the first player to play every card in their hand. Any cards left in a player's hand at the end of a round count as blunders against them. The player with the fewest blunders when the blunder breaking point is reached wins. Special cards such as traps and dead ends add a twist to the game making it more difficult for players to escape. Various card combinations and asymmetric Escape Leader abilities also add an additional level of complexity and fun to the game.

—description from the designer

name: Escape Room Tycoon
description:
Escape Room Tycoon beckons you into the captivating world of escape room management, where every decision you make shapes your destiny.

In this thrilling medium-weight euro game, you don the hat of an aspiring escape room entrepreneur. Your mission? To craft, curate, and conquer the escape room scene. The game unfolds over four intense rounds, each mirroring a distinct business season. Your expertise, represented by cubes, is your currency for action. Spend it wisely to construct ingenious rooms, adorn your venue with exclusive enhancements, host unforgettable events like graduations and birthday parties, hire talented Game Masters, run promotional campaigns, and strive for the most glowing reviews. But beware, as the rounds progress, the cost of your ambitions escalates. Keep a vigilant eye on your rivals' strategies while advancing your own to secure your place at the pinnacle.

Escape Room Tycoon is the world's first board game that immerses you in the riveting realm of escape room management. It's your chance to become the ultimate escape room mogul.

—description from the designer

name: eShop
description:
eShop is a strategic economic game where 2-4 players manage competing online stores over four rounds. Players draw item tokens from a bag to stock their shops, then fulfill customer orders by spending matching goods. The core challenge lies in balancing inventory management with order completion while adapting to changing market demands.

Each round consists of two phases: stocking your shop with items, then fulfilling orders or removing unwanted inventory. Players earn money by completing order cards, which require specific combinations of colored item tokens. The key strategic element is collecting sets of same-colored order cards to form valuable collections - three or more cards of one color double in value and become protected from competitors.
The game features a dynamic turn order system where players with fewer savings go first, creating tension between spending money and maintaining advantageous positioning. Special star tokens provide discounts when fulfilling matching-color orders, adding another layer of strategic planning.
The climactic final round shifts focus to direct competition as players buy order cards from each other at fixed prices, racing to complete valuable collections before the game ends. Victory goes to the player with the most money from completed orders, active star bonuses, and remaining savings.

—description from the publisher

name: Essence of Eternity
description: Choose your avatar, and race to find the Essence of Eternity, the secret to eternal life. Journey through the forest wilderness and majestic mountains before risking the perils of the underworld realm to find the precious runes needed to become immortal. Battle fearsome monsters and cast powerful spells. But beware! Your opponents have powers and control monsters of their own. Are you cunning enough to outwit them? Immortality is within your grasp, but at what cost? A very uncooperative fantasy card game for 2-6 players.

name: Azure
description:
The Lung Mei, or dragon paths, are lines of energy that cover the Earth. They are derived from the Four Auspicious Beasts: the Azure Dragon of the East, the Vermilion Bird of the South, the White Tiger of the West, and the Black Tortoise of the North. When a path runs in a straight line, that energy builds in power, but these paths can be broken up by barriers such as mountains, which diffuse the energy. Invoke the power of the Four Auspicious Beasts, carefully channel their energy through the Earth, and triumph in this battle for qi and wisdom that will shape your destiny and intertwine it with the Beasts of legend.

In Azure, players position their stones to gather qi (cards) and wisdom (points) from the realm. They also compete to bring the Auspicious Beasts to their aid. The first player to reach the end of the path of wisdom wins.

Players take turns placing a stone, gathering boons from the space they cover, and gaining the favor of Auspicious Beasts. In order to place a stone in a space, the player must be able to pay the qi cost. The color of the domain (board) tells you the color of qi needed, and the number of boon symbols in the space tells you the amount of qi needed. Through careful management of the qi cards in your hand, you'll be able to grow in power.

Thanks to the four double-sided boards that can be connected, flipped, and oriented in any way in a 2×2 grid, Azure features over 24,000 different layouts. Azure also includes the Gifted module for experienced players — a variable one-time-use ability that can help turn the tides in your favor.

—description from the publisher

name: Etherium
description:
Etherium is a planet like no other, home of a unique resource: the Ether. This substance acts directly on gravity and space-time, affecting the laws of physics through its unique properties, and reshaping the rules that apply to the rest of the universe.

A few thousand years ago, a collision with an asteroid almost shattered the planet, which now holds together only thanks to the power of the Ether. Since this cataclysm, the planet's landscape has become a succession of inhospitable platforms gravitating to the rhythm of cosmic currents. Born of this collision, six natural satellites - Mauhea, Reces, Hivalia, Ertis, Meinas and Psolos - orbit Etherium in a chaotic ballet. These moons' erratic revolutions disrupt the rhythm of the seasons and strongly influence the development of life on Etherium. A calendar year sees the seasons pass in random order, making it difficult for life to develop.

Each of these moons is home to a people with very specific characteristics. These orbiting microcosms have developed a unique relationship with Etherium, which has significantly shaped their evolution.

Strongly linked, the natural satellites are connected to Etherium by gravity-defying etheric corridors, allowing the various people to move easily to the mother planet in the hope of harvesting the precious Ether.

All people need Ether to develop, but it exists in only one place on Etherium, within reach of all hands and at the center of all greed. Until now, the balance has been maintained, but as all people become more eager each passing season, everything is about to change.


The 3D board of Etherium is made of cardboard "boxes", easy to set up & to store for each game. 6 tribes to mix & play, with their own unique abilities.

Each turn, which represents a season, players will program their actions (7 seasons to play): development, attack or defense, resource optimization or mitigate luck, and even production.

Multiple victory conditions: earn victory points in many different ways through the game.


     victory tokens in limited quantity to earn
     special abilities to develop, units to upgrade
     and of course, Ether you gather

name: Gold Country
description:
Eureka! Gold flows like an endless sea in the rich hills and forests of California, and countless would-be prospectors have flocked to the lush landscape to stake their claim and make their fortune. Gather your pickaxe and pan, scout the land, and invest in the richest mines to collect the most gold!

Gold Country is a new California Gold Rush strategy game created by Reiner Knizia and gorgeously illustrated by Beth Sobel. While the design is inspired by a cult-classic Knizia game called Spectaculum, it has undergone extensive redevelopment by Reiner Knizia (closely collaborating with Bitewing Games) to become the ultimate stock market manipulation game. It features a completely reworked core game, all-new maps, exciting tactical abilities, and the lush landscapes of California.

Each turn, you’ll develop mining companies, buy and sell shares of those mining companies, spend your money on powerful abilities cards, and more! Gold Country enables shared incentives, encourages tactical pivoting, and rewards strategic foresight amid its simple rules and challenging decisions. The game ends once all the gold veins have been discovered, then the richest player wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Ethnos: 2nd Edition
publisher: CMON Global Limited; BoardM Factory; Reflexshop
description:
In the faraway land of Ethnos, a new Age is dawning. The ashes of the old Age have left the Six Regions empty, and the twelve Clans scattered to the winds. Now is the time for a clever leader to unite them into a powerful alliance, skillfully using the unique talents of each Clan to control the Regions.
Do you have the wit and the wisdom to become the next Emperor of Ethnos and usher in a Golden Age?

Unite the Clans to Control Ethnos

What was old has been made new again. The land of Ethnos has been rendered empty and a new Age is beginning. Someone must take up the mantle of Emperor. Will it be you?

In Ethnos 2nd Edition, players must take control of the various clans of Ethnos, gathering members and unleashing them into the six regions. Each clan has different special abilities, and depending on who you choose to lead your groups, different strategies can be employed. 2nd Edition includes updated rules and rules for Solo mode.


     STRATEGIC AREA CONTROL GAME — In Ethnos 2nd Edition, players gather members of various clans and compete for control of six regions, utilizing each clan’s unique abilities to dominate the land.



     UNIQUE CLAN ABILITIES — Each clan in Ethnos offers distinct powers, adding deep strategy and diverse playstyles as you choose which clan leaders will guide your groups to victory.



     COMPETITIVE OR SOLO PLAY — Whether you’re challenging friends or conquering regions solo, Ethnos 2nd Edition provides endless strategic opportunities for players of all experience levels.



     FOR 1-6 PLAYERS — Perfect for game nights or solo sessions, Ethnos 2nd Edition is designed for 1-6 players, offering dynamic and exciting gameplay for ages 14 and up.



     UPDATED RULES & SOLO MODE — The 2nd Edition features updated rules for streamlined gameplay and introduces a new solo mode, allowing players to enjoy the game on their own.

name: Europe At War 1940: Solitaire
description:
Europe at War 1940: Solitaire, the sister wargame to Pacific War 1942, places the player in the role of the Axis high command during the first 18 months of World War II.

The game introduces some new concepts important to the war in Europe.  Each side has a limited number of tank units to add strength to some front armies.  The axis has a paratrooper unit that can help with hazardous operations.  Choosing when and where to place them can be a major decision.  Also control of air spaces on fronts becomes an important factor.  And, ports on sea zones are affected by sea zone control.  Crossing bodies of waters on a front is a major effort.

As the axis do you try to take London before turning east against the Russians?  Should you help out the Italians in the Balkans?  Or do you turn your tanks loose in the deserts of North Africa?

name: EVE: War for New Eden
description:
Galactic Glory Awaits! Step into the cosmos like never before with EVE: War for New Eden. Based on the online game, this board game captures the boundless possibilities and immense combat of the EVE Online universe. Use diplomacy, deception, and direct warfare to engage your rivals in a grand game of cosmic chess. Make the first move today!

You begin by choosing a faction and start with limited territory, spaceships, and resources. Build your faction, expand your empire, build your economy, own epic spaceships and fight spectacular battles to achieve your final victory.

Your goal is to grow your empire and acquire 10 Victory Points to get to the Verge of Ascendancy. Beware, as when you do, you will have to endure the ruthless final round to emerge victorious.

name: Everbloom
description:
As the final flower unfurled its petal and the pollinating factions surged forth into every biome, the plight awakened Anteri, the legendary dragon of abundance. She begins her journey across the lands, bestowing her petals upon chosen creatures in every biome, transforming them into wondrous hybrids of flora and fauna. Recognizing the potential for rejuvenation, pollinators from every corner of the world converge on these hybrid beings to attract them to their respective habitats. The Everbloom has begun again.

In Everbloom, lead one of six pollinating factions: Bats, Bees, Butterflies, Hummingbirds, Lemurs, and Lizards to create an abundant habitat full of hybrid beings. Each round you'll send pollinators from your faction into the wilderness to landmarks in the hopes of attracting hybrid beings to your habitat, eventually pollinating their flora in exchange for nectar and points. Along the way, you’ll complete blooms and gather nectar cards to make sure your habitat flourishes. After the final round, you will gain points for the nectar you've collected in each biome as well as your progress on the bloom track, the faction with the most points wins!

–description from the designer

name: Moytura
description:
The battle of Moytura has begun. As a leader of the Tuatha Dé Danann, spread your influence across the land to succeed in your quest to become High Ruler of Ireland, invoking the powerful deities of the Tuatha Dé Danann to aid you in your cause with their command of water, travel, war, and creation — but the road will not be easy for in your path to legend stand the sinister Fomorians and other mythical beings hungry for battle, not to mention a rival clan with ambitions of their own. Steel yourself and prepare for a legendary struggle. Rewrite the myths of Ireland, chieftain, and take your place as the true High King!

In Moytura, you and your opponent command competing factions of the Tuatha Dé Danann, but you are not the only ones struggling for control of ancient Ireland. Three enemy clans act together as a third opponent faction that competes with the players and scores points. Points are gained by having the most influence across Ancient Ireland at the end of each era. Within each of the eleven regions, the faction with the most or second most units across all the spaces of a region will score the indicated points. After two eras, the faction with the most points wins.

Each round, the two players and the enemy faction each take a turn. On their turn, a player selects a deity tile (possibly spending worship tokens to reach it), then performs that deity's actions. When used, a deity tile resets to the most expensive position in the track. Deity tiles let players expand their influence and battle enemies according to the deity's unique abilities On the enemy faction's turn, an activation card is revealed from the deck that expands one of the three clans. Some activation cards are stronger than others, and players must carefully track which clans are most likely to attack and where. Only the player who cleverly outmaneuvers their opponent while carefully keeping the enemy faction in check will be able to secure the victory.

Moytura features seven map set-ups for any combination of clans. The game also includes three special enemy clans that replace 1-3 of the standard Fomorian clans. These special clans introduce more challenging foes with asymmetric abilities: the Ellén Trechends (three-headed beasts) expand in all directions, the Oilliphéist (sea serpents) expand rapidly along the coast, and the Banshees invade targeted regions instead of spreading out from their largest group.

You can also enjoy a solo / cooperative variant if you prefer playing that way! Thanks to the intuitive enemy faction system built into the main game, Moytura lends itself easily to these optional variants.

—description from the publisher

name: Seagrass
description:
In Seagrass, players take on the role of marine naturalists, exploring the many reefs and colonies of creatures that thrive among these expanding and diverse “rainforests of the sea.”

Seagrass is an approachable strategy game with surprising depth and layered interaction. On your turn, simply expand a colony of aquatic creatures or expand a reef. Your colonies score you more points the bigger they get, and they help you compete for majorities around reefs. Expanding reefs will increase their point value and help you replenish your hand of tiles, but expanding a reef will also make it a more juicy target for your opponents! Playing out multiple tiles of the same type will grant powerful turns, but spreading out your plays will allow you to score the same colonies more times! Decisions are a tricky strategic balance in this underwater ecosystem.

Seagrass is the next title in Bitewing Game’s Crown Jewel Selection. The game is an evolution of Trevor Benjamin and Brett J. Gilbert’s Maya, introducing many innovations by:


     Providing two game boards featuring tight interaction
     Introducing special creature tiles with powerful abilities
     Focusing the end-game trigger to be more exciting and impactful
     Hiding and balancing the scoring for a more tense competition
     Creating tough trade-offs with the new Discovery expansion
     Broadening the appeal and approachability with stunning aquatic illustrations by Alisha Giroux


—description from the publisher

name: Everest Go!
description:
In Everest Go! we will become mountaineers competing to conquer the highest peak in the world, Everest!
Equip your mountaineer with clothes and special items and play action cards against your rivals. Whoever has more equipment points at the end wins the game.

Each participant builds their mountaineer with the 6 character cards and places it in their playing area. These cards make up your mountaineer.

On your turn, you must do one of the following three options: Play one garment card or play one action card or improve your hand.

When you have at least one garment card on each of your 6 character cards, and your climber is not being affected by the action card “Hypothermia”, you will have the option to say on your turn EVEREST! This will immediately end the game and give you a bonus of 3 points.

Each player then counts their total score by adding up the points of all their garments (visible and hidden) and the special items of their mountaineer. The winner is the one with the highest score.

—description from the publisher

name: Totally Human
Evoke
description:
In Evoke, players are members of different warring guild factions and were thrown into a dungeon for illegal use of magic. Someone cast a spell which erased everyone's memories and now players can't remember which guild everyone is a member of!

Use your time and resources wisely to try to learn about the other players and yourself... and escape with who you assume are your fellow guild members.

Players will need to figure out who to trust and when to provide correct (or false) information to influence the outcome of the game. Each player starts the game with 3 memory cards which contributes to the loyalty of a faction. Over time, more information will be revealed, but trust will need to be placed without perfect information, since there is a small window of time for escape. Players who are chained up at the end of the last round will not contribute to their guild's win condition.

—description from the designer

name: Exceed and Exchange
description: A shedding game in which you play cards from your hand according to specific rules and aim to win by playing all your cards as quickly as possible. Use the power chips you can earn by passing and manipulate your rank to overcome unfavorable situations.

name: Executive Producer
description: In Executive Producer, players take control of a Hollywood movie studio, buying Scripts and hiring Actors and Directors to appear in them with the goal of earning box office profits, critical acclaim and prestigious awards! Players can also use their unique studio abilities to gain an edge, or play Hollywood News cards to improve their movies - or sabotage opponents!

name: Etherstone
publisher: ThunderGryph Games; Blackrock Games; CrowD Games; Ghenos Games
description:
Nobura is a forgotten planet shrouded in mystery. The story told that a cosmic being sacrificed its divine essence to breathe life into its desolate lands. Etherstones shaped the planet's biomes and interconnected all living beings with nature. Yet, the lurking threat of the Vacuous, a parasitic force born from the depths of Nobura, poses a challenge to life on the surface, weaving a tale of divine sacrifice. Nobura has always been part of a paradoxical loop of life and death, where the forces of creation and destruction dance in an eternal cosmic struggle.

In Etherstone, players embody faction leaders uniting forces to avert the impending extinction, striving to gain the most victory points through various means, such as summoning cards, overcoming threats, and utilizing their abilities as effectively as possible.

The first stage of the game will be drafting your hand of 7 cards and your leader card. Alternatively, for the first few matches, players can take a pre-made hand of cards with the matching Leader. Leaders have a set number of life points, a strength value, and a persistent asymmetric ability.

During your turn, you can take only one action among the following: Dice Draft, Summon, Attack, Rest, Void Pact.

Players will win by gaining victory points while doing several different actions and the game will end if any of the end-game conditions are met:

    The active player has no cards left in their hand.
    There are no cards left in the Threat deck.
    The victory point pool has no more tokens in it.


—description from the publisher

name: MicroMacro: Kids – Crazy City Park
publisher: Edition Spielwiese; Blackrock Games; Hobby Japan; Lucky Duck Games; MINDOK; SD Games; White Goblin Games
description:
In MicroMacro: Kids – Der verrückte Stadtpark ("The Crazy City Park"), you are investigators! Mysterious things are happening in a huge hidden object scene, and here are some of the questions you need to answer: How did the big dinosaur bone disappear? Who can stop the rampaging robot before it destroys the whole city? And how did the diamond thief escape the police?

To solve these cases, you investigate together as a team. You will follow clues, solve puzzles, and pursue suspects — just like real detectives!

name: EXIT: The Game – Family: The Trophy Case/Night at the Carnival
description:
A cool team of animal superheroes – Milo the cat, Häm the hamster, Bella the dog, Nele the parrot, and Luis the bug – has formed a secret club in EXIT: The Game – Family: The Trophy Case/Night at the Carnival in order to solve a pair of puzzly adventures.

In "The Trophy Case", they investigate an animal talent show where a thief is planing to steal the show's trophy. Can the crew enter the talent show undercover, stop the thief, and save the show?

In "Night at the Carnival", mysterious power outages keep occurring, threatening to leave our heroes in the dark. The team suspects sabotage and sets out to solve the mysterious incidents.

name: EXIT: The Game – The Circus Mystery
description:
The circus is in town, and performers and artists can't wait to show the audience their stunts and tricks — but something seems to be amiss under the big top as a series of high-profile burglaries have occurred in each of the cities where the circus performed.

Is this all a coincidence? Or can you find a connection and solve EXIT: The Game – The Circus Mystery?

name: Exodus from Reynoldsworld
description:
Reynoldsworld is under threat from an encroaching alien armada. Millions of people need to be somewhere else. Fast. You will build an ark and ferry the population and the supplies they need to nearby habitable worlds. Will your efforts be remembered as the saviours of Reynoldsworld, or just were you there to help out? Exodus is a print at home roll & write game in which you design a ship and then brave dangerous space to save a planet full of people!

In the first few rounds you design your ship, then in later rounds you will chart a route through dangerous space to deliver as many colonists and supplies to the planets that are worth the most.

—description from the designer

name: Exploding Kittens: The Board Game
publisher: Exploding Kittens; Rebel Sp. z o.o.
description:
There's never been a board game like this before! Your goal is to make it to the end of the board without landing on the Exploding Kitten. To do that you'll play cards and plot strategies to sabotage your opponents. But don't get too cocky because one wrong move can cause the board to flip. This completely transforms the board to reveal a new path where every move could be your last. You have to think fast, form alliances, play smart, and avoid the Exploding Kittens at all costs.

The stakes are high but the rules are simple… Just beware, danger, and betrayal, and pee your pants laughing moments lurk around every corner.

What other game lets you play as a TacoCat, SushiCat, or GnomeCat? Who else would give you the power of Meatpants, a Litterbox Sandworm, or a Butterfly Punch?

—description from the publisher

name: Exploding Pigeon
publisher: Exploding Kittens; Rebel Sp. z o.o.
description:
Exploding Pigeon is a little like Pictionary, a little like Charades, a little like a hot potato, and a LOT of chaotic fun! Exploding Pigeon is the rapid-fire challenge passing family game that'll change your parties forever. Shake the Pigeon to reveal your hilarious challenge -- it could be drawing, miming, or a quick round of rock, paper, scissors. Hurry and do it before passing the Pigeon to the other team! Scramble to complete as many challenges as you can, just don't get caught with the Pigeon when the timer runs out!

How to play:

     Start the timer.
     Act, draw, or battle … but whatever you do, DO IT FAST!
     Pass the pigeon before it explodes!


—description from the publisher

name: EXPO 1889
description:
Become the architect of the 1889 World's Fair!
Like Gustave Eiffel or Ferdinand Dutert, step into the shoes of a visionary and design the iconic attraction of this global event. Relive the construction of this historic World's Fair, where Adolphe Alphand, its organizer, entrusts you with a major mission: to create the most spectacular venues and attractions in celebration of the centennial of the French Revolution.
It is in this very context that the Eiffel Tower is born, becoming the iconic symbol we know today. ?
A reedition of Roll Through the Ages, a game by Matt Leacock, the renowned designer of Pandemic.

The game is played over several rounds. In each round, all players take one turn. Once every player has completed their turn, the round ends and a new one begins.
On their turn, a player may perform all of the following actions, if possible (and/or required by the dice roll):


     Roll the dice, then collect resources and worker wages
     Pay the workers and resolve any disaster effects
     Recruit workers and/or build monuments
     Purchase one (and only one) development
     Discard excess resources (beyond six) and pass the dice


—description from the designer

name: Exquisite Corpse
description:
Exquisite Corpse is a visual puzzle made up of 52 drawings of different body parts. Cards all connect at small or large openings, unlocking zillions of weird and unexpected combinations. It's a game that changes every time you play—whether solo or with friends.

With 4 distinct game modes, you can build corpses collaboratively, competitively, or alone in your room at 2am.

OPTION 1 (1-10 PLAYERS)
Build a giant corpse using all 52 cards. 
No bandaids. 

OPTION 2 (1-10 PLAYERS)
Build a corpse without using any end cards. 
Can you use 10 or more connector cards? 
Can you use all 30?

OPTION 3 (2-6 PLAYERS)
Take turns adding cards to a collaborative corpse, with bandaids and end cards offering special moves.
Win points by playing your cards right and closing off the last loose end.

OPTION 4 (2-4 PLAYERS)
Divide the deck evenly among players and race against time to build as many corpses as possible with the cards you are dealt. Leftover cards are penalized, so make sure to tally your points before calling it!

—description from the publisher

name: Exscape
description:
Embark on a spine-chilling adventure like no other with Exscape, the ultimate test of teamwork and nerve. In this heart-pounding cooperative card game for 2-5 players, you find yourself trapped in a haunted house with only one goal – escape before it's too late.

As you navigate the eerie corridors and dimly lit rooms of the haunted mansion, all communication is lost to the void. Players must rely solely on intuition and deduction to decipher clues and select the correct door leading to freedom. But beware, not all doors are created equal – only one leads to safety, all others to certain doom.

Exscape challenges players to work together seamlessly to outsmart the house's malevolent spirits and traps. With each turn, tension mounts as players make critical decisions without uttering a single word. Can you overcome fear itself and lead your team to salvation, or will you become another victim of the haunted house's sinister secrets?

No words, just choices - Exscape or succumb to the darkness.

—description from the publisher

name: Extreme Mission
description:
Extreme Mission / エクストリームミッション is a card game in which players select one of four levels of missions and clear the game by drawing color and number combinations from their hands as instructed, aiming to clear all levels of missions as quickly as possible.

However, some missions are so difficult that it is hard to believe that you can succeed, such as "All the numbers from 1 to 9 must be in the same color, and all the colors must be the same".

Such missions are made possible by the five co-operators that accompany each player. By turning the co-operator cards inside out, they can be used as all-mighty cards, and any number of such cards can be used at once. However, each of them must be paid for by a certain amount of cards to be put back into their normal state.

However, to clear the game, all co-operator cards must be returned to the foreground, in addition to clearing all stages of the mission, so the use of powerful co-operator cards can greatly affect the outcome of the game.

name: F1 Racing Simulation
description:
F1 Racing Simulation is a dice-driven lap-by-lap F1 simulation. The unique feature of this simulation is that each driver does not race on a traditional track or board, but on their own individual card on your tabletop!

Available seasons: 1951, 1960s (1963-1966), 1976, 1981, 1986, 1990, Late 1990s (1995-2000), 2003, 2008, 2024 and 2025.

Please do not purchase our simulation if you are looking for a game where you control a car or influence the outcome through strategic decisions. Although each race includes a few, sometimes important, decisions, the race itself runs on its own. This is a simulation - like watching a race on TV, where your favourite drivers compete realistically against each other on various tracks!

Each driver has five fixed driving attributes and one flexible one. These are activated depending on the track and race progress, triggering an unpredictable race event. Everything that defines this racing series is represented in this simulation.

During the race, individual drivers are occasionally presented with a choice between two options — for example, during the start phase, pit stops, or overtaking maneuvers. These choices are few, but can sometimes be strategically decisive. However, there is also the option to not intervene in the race at all and simply watch the race unfold.

Qualifying and Pre-Race need about 10 minutes, the race about 40 minutes. If you're playing the game for the first time, it might take twice as long.

The game includes all drivers and tracks from the 2024 season. With seven different drivers taking multiple wins and four teams winning races, the grid saw renewed competitiveness.

—description from the designer

name: Fable Fury
description:
Fable Fury: Endless Misadventure AwaitsAs unlikely heroes, you’ll journey through whimsical yet dangerous realms. Exploring unknown lands, battling unconventional enemies, dodging silly traps, and uncovering monster runes hidden within ancient shrines. Collect all three runes to unlock the final portal and confront the monstrous threat threatening the realms!

Choose your hero, gather your starting gear, and dive into your first realm.

				
				
					Game FlowEach realm follows three steps:


    Explore
    Level Up
    Shop


				
				
					Realm Setup6 Story cards | 4 Enemies | 2 Traps | 1 Shrine | 1 Portal

Shuffle the cards face-down and place them to match a random map card layout.

				
				
					ExplorePlayers take turns acting as the Party Leader, choosing which unexplored location to reveal next. Discover the Shrine to heal and unlock new hero skills.

				
				
					Level UpEach Hero mat has a unique color-coded skill profile. At the Shrine:


    Draw 3 Skill cards of the same color



    Choose 1 to add to your hero



    Strengthen your build to complement your team’s strategy


				
				
					ShopAfter exiting the realm through the Portal, visit the Gift Shop. Spend your hard-earned coins on quirky, powerful loot like pool noodles, toast, headphones, and more. Upgrade your weapon, boost your stats, and prepare for the next realm.

Collect all three runes to unlock the ancient portal and face one of three final monsters!

				
				
					Area TypesStory
Varied encounters: sometimes helpful, sometimes harmful. Make choices, roll dice for outcomes, and use skills or items to navigate the event.

Trap
Always dangerous. Each Trap features a unique effect, a chance to dodge, and specific damage outcomes.

Enemy
Test your build and teamwork. Enemies attack in different ways, and victory rewards you with coins and items. Attack using your weapon dice, loot, and skills.

Shrine
Level up your hero, heal the team, and revive fallen allies.

Portal
Exit the realm and travel to the next. Visiting the Gift Shop is mandatory, stock up before continuing your quest.

				
				
					How to WinComplete three realms to collect the three monster runes. The next portal leads to a showdown with one of three Final Monsters. Defeat the monster to save the realms and win the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Fablefall
description:
Fablefall is an Asymmetric Euro War Game with inspirations from Root and Rising Sun. Within the game, Forces (Order, Industry, Myth, and Rebellion) vie for control of the narrative by gaining victory points called Fable Points.

As you recruit soldiers, invade and defend territories, and battle opponents, you must also learn to achieve objectives that influence certain narrative arenas -  the lore of your exploits, the art produced concerning your deeds, and the people’s respect for your actions. All of these give you points each round and whoever has the most points at the end, wins the game. Excel at determining the Fables told of you and your deeds, and you’ve controlled not just a region on a map, but the hearts and minds of its people. Wars will either see the combatants' efforts forgotten to time, or cemented in stories.

name: Skyjo Voyage
description:
Every player has 12 hidden cards (3x4). Cards are ranked from -2 up to 12. Two are turned face up. On your turn you can take the top card from the discard or draw pile. You can exchange one card (hidden or open) from your display. Round ends when one player has only open cards. (equal turns). All card will be revealed. Add the numbers of the card for scoring. Game ends after one player has 100 or more points. Whoever has the lowest number wins.

Special rule: Whenever one column of 3 cards all have the same value, they will be discarded and no longer scored.

name: Fair Enough
description:
Meeps has made a long list what he wants to collect from the worlds greatest game fair - the Spiel in Essen. But time is running so fast, and if you can't secure what you got before the day is over, you get nothing. Calculate your risk in this great card game by famous Friedemann Friese.

—description from the publisher

name: Snake Charmers
description:
Truth, traps, treachery — Who can you trust? And for how long?

Snake Charmers is a bluffing deduction game in which trust has an expiration date!

Together you must drive away the night, but they lurk among you: the snake charmers. To win, you must uncover who is playing WITH you, and who is PLAYING you. Can you root them out in time? Or will you become one yourself?

name: Fake Crime
description:
Fake Crime is an intuitive yet innovative game where the art is part of the gameplay! Play clue cards to exonerate suspects by naming an object that appears on both cards. Other investigators must follow suit as everyone scrambles to be the first one to catch the killer. Pick your suspect and pit your sleuthing skills against your rivals in this simple yet sophisticated game of mystery and murder. Don't have any rivals? Try the solo mystery challenge mode.

These cards can be used as a traditional tarot deck to examine the evidence locker of your mind. Structurally similar to the Rider-Waite tarot, with a thematic twist. The Guidebook has concise, approachable interpretations with a forensic flair. Sometimes we hide information from ourselves, these cards can help you uncover the clues.

—description from the publisher

name: Falcons: The US Air Force Academy Board Game
description:
Welcome to the United States Air Force Academy! From now on, you are a Cadet! You will be tested physically and mentally, competing against other players to graduate at the top of your class. Be prepared to march, study, train, and compete head-to-head against other cadets. Join Doolie Training Sessions, walk Tours, and prepare your Capstone Project so you can score the most points and graduate as the Academy's Top Grad.

Falcons is a family-friendly board game where each player is a cadet at the United States Air Force Academy. Using a variable turn order, players march their cadets around the Academy’s Terrazzo to train and compete in a variety of academic, physical, and military competitions. Competitions involve simultaneous card selection and a variety of tactical action cards. Cadet time is always limited, so acquired cards are in short supply. Cadets must also develop their character by earning hidden character tokens. At the end of the game, character tokens are revealed, and the player with the least character is expelled before final scoring.

Falcons was designed by real academy graduates to be an authentic depiction of Air Force Cadet life. Prior Air Force knowledge is not required to play. Players may use the included companion glossary to learn more about the Air Force Academy's activities, slang, and traditions.

—description from the publisher

name: Falling Edge
description:
Players fight for battlefield control in this super fast card-placement game set in the dystopian sci-fi world of Falling Edge.  Compete using the core rules for super fast rounds or utilise the enhanced ruleset for strategic depth with faction based combat and abilities. Play 2-4 players competitive, team-based 2v2 (or even combine multiple games to play 5+ player tournaments).

Use characters and abilities from the different factions in Falling Edge:
The Chosen, powerful humans carrying the souls of ancient heroes that try to protect the weak.
The Cult, an underground organisation willing to sacrifice anything (or anyone) for the sake of power.
The Wanderers, nomad tribes accustomed to the harsh conditions outside of the few remaining cities.
AI, the robotic beings working together as one connected mysterious artificial intelligence.
Soldiers, the military forces of 'The Cooperation' that controls the remaining human cities and the life within.

—description from the designer

name: Famous: Stage I
description:
Now available Electriclute.com

You are a dreamer - with a fire in your heart and a melody in your head. Posters obscure your bedroom walls, and vinyl records cover the floor. But you have a plan to complement that dream. With the local studio booked a mere 12 weeks from now, you’ll have to hustle...

'Famous: Stage I' is a theme-first strategy adventure for 1-4 players. Every element of the game makes thematic sense - as you spend your precious Hours managing your Band’s personnel, bookings, services, songwriting, rehearsal, equipment, supporters, and promotion. If you spend your resources wisely, seize opportunities at the right moments, and keep an eye on the big picture, you will become the most famous player at the table!

Prepare your Band over twelve rounds (“Weeks”) by collecting the best Song cards, upgrading your Musicians’ Skill, earning Cash at Gigs and with Merch, pursuing rewarding Prospects, hiring powerful Services, and achieving your Musicians’ individual Personality goals. And although some of it will derive from this main stage of the game, approximately 75% your Fame (the game’s Victory Points) will come from the end-game scoring “Finale” - wherein your well-laid plans will finally pay off!

name: Fantastic Age
description:
Fantasic Age is a dice-manipulation fantasy adventure game where the goal is to earn as much fame as possible during the adventurers entire lifespan.

Players start out as young adventurers, and go through adult and elderly age. Each turn, the players choose skills to improve their character, and choose a dungeon on the map to try to conquer. Each encounter is represented by a card, and solving all the encounters in the dungeon allows the player to encounter a boss.

As adults, players get to build a House on the map, and as Elderly, they get to enter a Clan, both of which largely enhance the player's abilities to earn fame. Player skills revolve around dice manipulation: changing die results, getting extra results for certain rolls, or adding dice. Players also have a Class that influences their chances in the dungeons in various ways.

The game can also be played solo, aiming for a certain fame score.

—user summary

name: Fantastic Trails
description:
Fantastic Trails challenges you to help ants through the forest by creating valuable trails that will cover lots of ground, ideally picking up honeydew along the way.

To set up, each player choose two of four random forest floor cards and places these cards in front of themselves. Shuffle the number and pattern decks separately.

On a turn, reveal the top number and pattern card, placing them side by side. Each player can then write the indicated number in spaces showing the indicated pattern. Jokers are in each deck, allowing you to write the number of your choice in the indicated pattern or vice versa. An anteater is also in each deck, and if an anteater is revealed, no one writes anything that turn, and you reveal new cards.

You start with four worker ants and can spend them to adjust the value of a number or let you write in any pattern you wish.

If you finish a task written on a forest floor card, such as surrounding a space or filling a line or section, you receive the indicated bonus, some combination of worker ants, honeydew, and the ability to mark indicated spaces.

After the number and pattern decks are empty, score points equal to your honeydew, then receive a new forest floor card. Do this again at the end of the second round, then after the third round score honeydew a third time, then score a trail on each card. To create a trail, mark a continuous line on each card through adjacent spaces with the numbers on this line being the same or one higher than the previous number; score points equal to the number of spaces covered.

name: Fantasy Brewers
description:
In a far-away land, dwarven Brewmasters are competing to make the most delicious drinks for the upcoming Orctober BeerFest! Players take on the role of one of these Brewmasters, managing their brewery, farm and workers.

With just months until Orctober, players will have to buy and sell goods at the best prices, build and convert buildings, and hire more helpers. At the end of the game, the Brewmaster who was awarded the most Victory Points will win the Golden Stein at the BeerFest and win the game!

Fantasy Brewers is an action selection and resource management game. Players will take turns placing different sized workers at action spaces, queuing them up to await their turn to buy and sell goods, brew beer, distill whisky, extend the brewery and decorate for the festival!

—description from the designer

name: Fantasy Realms: Greek Legends
description:
In the standalone card game Fantasy Realms: Greek Legends, you build your realm, one card at a time, as you collect heroes, quests, monsters, and more! Each card is unique, and scores points based on the other cards in your hand. You start with seven cards, and each turn, you draw a new card from the deck or discard area, then discard one card from your hand, always trying to improve your realm. Whoever's realm scores the most points wins.

Fantasy Realms: Greek Legends takes the classic Fantasy Realms formula and adds new twists to match its theme. In addition to combining the right suits and attribute tags, you will:


    Send cards to the afterlife, costing precious points but unlocking powerful abilities
    Complete quests with unique card combinations
    Vanquish legendary monsters with the right heroes


-description from designer

name: Fantasy Zoo
description:
Have you always wanted your own zoo? Now’s your chance! Fantasy Zoo is a fast-paced, easy-to-understand card game where you build unique enclosures and populate them with magical, imaginary creatures.

Build your dream zoo in Fantasy Zoo!

Forest, mountain, desert, and aquatic enclosures are waiting for their residents – cute, dangerous, or incredibly rare beings! The animal cards and enclosures are on both sides of the same card, so you’ll need to make clever decisions: expand your zoo or welcome a new resident?

Language-independent and with easy-to-understand rules, you can dive into the game right away. But if you're looking for a real challenge, the advanced game mode offers extra excitement!

—description from the designer

Mindig is szerettél volna egy saját állatkertet? Most itt a lehetőség! A Fantasy Zoo egy pörgős, azonnal érthető kártyajáték, amelyben egyedi kifutósorokat építesz, és varázslatos, képzeletbeli állatokkal népesíted be őket.

Építsd meg álmaid állatkertjét a Fantasy Zooban!

Erdei, hegyi, sivatagi és vízi kifutók várják lakóikat – cuki, veszélyes vagy éppen elképesztően ritka lényeket! Az állatkártyák és kifutók ugyanazon kártya két oldalán találhatóak, így ügyesen kell döntened: bővíted az állatkerted vagy inkább egy új lakó érkezik?

Nyelvfüggetlen és gyorsan érthető szabályok garantálják, hogy azonnal belevethesd magad a játékba, de ha igazi kihívásra vágysz, a haladó játékmód extra izgalmakat tartogat!

—description from the designer (translatred)

name: Auf die Eier
description: Be the first to score at least 100 points by rolling the best combinations of hard-boiled eggs, fried eggs and chickens, but beware of rotten eggs, they might spoil your breakfast!

name: Far Far West
description:
FR : Far Far West est un jeu utilisant les mécaniques de collection de carte, engine deck et arbre de techonologie.

Chaque joueur tentera de récupérer le plus de points d'influence pour devenir le prochain gouverneur.

Étape
1. Récupérez des cartes dans la rivière
2. Utilisez vos cartes pour récolter des ressources
3. Échangez vos ressources pour construire des monuments qui vous octroierons des bonus permanents

EN : Far Far West is a game using card collection, engine deck and techonology tree mechanics.

Each player will try to collect as many influence points as possible to become the next governor.

Step
1. Collect cards from the river
2. Use your cards to collect resources
3. Exchange your resources to build monuments that will grant you permanent bonuses.

name: Farm Hand
publisher: (Web published); Gém Klub Kft.; Grail Games
description:
Farm Hand is a fun and engaging 21-card micro game for 1-5 players in 15-20 mins.  A game that neatly fits in your pocket or purse and can be played almost anywhere.

The game has 6 asymmetric suits ranging from 1 card through to 6 cards, with values 1-7 spread across the suits. Gameplay includes trick-taking, publicly visible suits, and simultaneous bidding.

Played across 6 rounds, each round players are dealt a hand that increases by 1 card (1x card in round 1, 2x cards in round 2, etc.)

With all suits openly visible to all players, everyone must try to predict how many tricks they will win in the round - they bid simultaneously by revealing a number of fingers.

The bids are recorded and the trick-taking phase commences.

Everyone plays their cards using standard must-follow trick-taking rules, however, the highest card wins the trick, regardless of suit.  BUT... if cards of the same number are played, they cancel each other out and the next highest card wins the trick.  This often leads to surprise outcomes and plenty of laughs and groans.

Points are awarded based on whether players correctly predicted their bids or not:

     If your Bid and Tricks match EXACTLY, score points equal to the Current Round
     If your Bid and Tricks DO NOT MATCH, score -1 point per Difference


The dealer moves clockwise. Gather all the cards, shuffle and deal again.

Play 6 rounds. The winner is the player with the highest score.

—description from the designer

name: Fart Drop
description:
Fart Drop is a hilarious and fast-paced party card game where players pass around a dangerous secret: the dreaded fart card. Each round is filled with bluffing, laughter, sabotage, and the constant fear that the stink might land in your lap.

Players take turns drawing, passing, or playing cards, all while trying to avoid ending the game holding the fart. But watch out—special cards can flip the game at any moment! Use gas masks to block it, unleash a backdraft to bounce it back, or drop a stink bomb for an instant win.

The game features a cast of over-the-top characters and 50 special cards that add chaos, strategy, and variety to every match. With only a few used per game, no two playthroughs are ever quite the same.

Designed for quick rounds, big laughs, and endless replayability, Fart Drop is the ultimate game for families, friends, and anyone who isn’t afraid to play dirty.

—description from the designer

name: Fate of Witches
description:
The Council of Witches is in turmoil. The Grand High Witch is dead and the witches are fighting among themselves for the right to succeed her. But only the most powerful witch can ascend to such a high status. Meanwhile, people are disappearing and there are reports of strange happenings. With fear and suspicion rife, the villagers have called for the Witch Hunter and his trusted Hound. 

Fate of Witches is a coven-building card game for 1-4 players. Plan, recruit, build, and combo your way to highest-scoring coven before the end of the game. Fate is in your hands. You’ll need your wits about as you take on the role of a head witch trying to build the highest-scoring coven. Recruit strange characters, fire up your cauldron, salvage magical items from the well, and turn to the dark arts to gain an advantage. All while evading the Witch Hunter, hell-bent on burning every witch in his way.

The game is played over several rounds, each consisting of three phases: Dawn, Day and Night.

Dawn Phase: Each round (except the first round) starts with repopulating the Village Square and passing on the Witch’s Coin.
Day Phase: Starting with the Witch’s Coin holder and proceeding clockwise, each player takes their turn to perform the following two actions: Draft & Coven actions.
Night Phase: The current Witch’s Coin holder draws a card from the Event Deck.

Ending the Game
Once all Event Cards have been resolved, this triggers the end phase. Once the end phase has concluded, players add up their covens, and the player with the highest score wins the game and becomes the Grand High Witch.

name: Fate: Defenders of Grimheim
publisher: FryxGames; Elznir Games; Intrafin Games; Maldito Games; MeepleBR
description:
Freyja, the Norse goddess of fertility, joins Thor in Asgaard for a wedding along with all the proven warriors from Grimheim. You’re not one of them. Loki, the trickster god, sees his chance to destroy Freyja’s sacred well in Grimheim. Soon, monsters appear from all directions, advancing towards the small village where you are now the only defenders left. Kill monsters to gain experience and upgrade your hero, solve quests to discover weapons and equipment, and stand shoulder to shoulder with your friends against the mighty monsters of Norse mythology. The fate of Grimheim is in your hands.

Fate is a cooperative game where players who take the roles of talented but unexperienced heroes. Together, they defend Freyja’s well against trolls, the dead, and the fire horde monsters approaching from all sides of the game board. Each time a monster enters Grimheim, a town piece is destroyed. All players lose if the town is completely destroyed, but they win if at least Freyja’s Well remains when she returns at the end of the game

—description from the designer

name: Fifty Fruity
publisher: Blue Orange (EU); Blue Orange Games; HUCH!; PaperGames (III); ToyCo
description:
To win Fifty Fruity, you want to have the most bananas in your collection, and to get them you might have to lie.

On a turn, the active player draws two cards from the deck, then shows them to another player, who either truthfully says what's on both cards (but not which is which) or lies about one card while saying the truth about the other. The active player then keeps one of the cards and gives the other to the player who spoke.

Some cards have only bananas on them, while others have green bananas, mangoes that ripen the green bananas, coconuts with special powers, bombs that blow up coconuts, a banana split, and more.

name: Fathom
description:
Fathom is a tile-laying, pattern-building game of deep-sea exploration in which you take on the role of marine biology teams competing to uncover the secrets of an uncharted, underwater ecosystem around a fictional island. The depths are vast and time is limited, so savvy decision-making under pressure is crucial to a successful expedition. Choose wisely which creatures to investigate as those you don't pursue may be discovered by your opponents.

Over six rounds of simultaneous play, guide your team's boat and submersible across the ocean. Scan the unmapped depths, and place tiles representing signs of marine life. Descend into the darkness and reveal these tiles to discover remarkable creatures.

At game's end, you gain points based on the scoring criteria of species you've discovered. Some thrive in a homogenous environment; others fare better surrounded by diversity. The solitary life may suit certain creatures, but straying from the safety of a group spells disaster for others.

Discover the most synergistic ecosystem to win!

—description from the publisher

name: Faunian
description:
Faunian is a strategy and adventure board game that transports you to a fantastic medieval world, where decay and magic intertwine in every corner.

Take on the role of a brave Faunian commander, leading your anthropomorphic animal faction in a quest to restore the glory of your realm. Gather resources, forge alliances, and engage in tactical battles as you navigate through treacherous landscapes and face formidable foes.

With every decision, you shape the destiny of your faction, combining cunning strategies and hand management to outsmart your opponents.

Will you rise to power and reclaim your land, or will the forces of decay prevail? Dive into Faunian and embark on an unforgettable journey of strategy and adventure!

—description from the designer

name: Faust vs Mephisto
description:
