However, every bird is unique, and every player is jostling for position in the same space, so they need to build off each others’ moves, adapt to the constantly-changing island, and carefully deploy Ability Tokens to reshape the terrain and get their birds on the table. The simple but elegant placement system sees mountains, forests, and cliffs form organically through play, and no two islands will ever be the same. Players are also encouraged to make up a ‘Fun Fact’ about each species as they play, adding a light-hearted element of creative improv to the play experience.

The game contains 52 species of real-world birds from across the world, each with detailed artwork and unique placement conditions. Isle of Feathers also has a dedicated solo mode with multiple challenge levels, reframing the gameplay into a bite-sized spatial puzzle.

When the last tile is placed, the game ends. Every bird placed earns points and the player with the most points wins.

—description from publisher

name: Isles of Odd
description: Navigate your crew through an ever changing archipelago in Isles of Odd. Your goal is to collect 7 gold and deliver it to the port before the other players. Maximize your dice rolls in clever ways to move your ships around and place new tiles to build out the map. Take careful note of your positioning however, because if enemy players can find an opportunity to capture your ship and steal its precious loot, they will. Never forget to recruit new crewmates either, as the unique abilities of these oddities can give you the engine you need to take your victory.

name: Israel 1948: The First Arab-Israeli War
description:
A 2-player game covering the 1948 Arab-Israeli war. One player plays the Israeli forces and the other plays the Arab League forces. There is a hex map of Israel and surrounding countries. The units are mostly brigades - about 20 on the Israeli side and 30 on the Arab side.

There are 3 scenarios which correspond to the 3 main phases of the war:

Scenario 1 "Onslaught": Covers the invasion of the new state of Israel after the British withdrawal from 15th May 1948 to the first truce of 11th June 1948.
Scenario 2 "Ten Days": Covers the Israeli counter-offensive from 9th to 18th July when there was the second truce.
Scenario 3: "End Game": Covers the October 1948 fighting after the end of the second truce which concluded the war.

It is also possible to link 2 sequential, or all 3 scenarios into a larger campaign game of the whole war.

-description from publisher's website

name: It's Been Emotional
description:
by Crocodog GamesIt's Been Emotional a new strategic card game; unleash powerful armies against your opponents, ride the emotional roller coaster, fend off attacks, survive the onslaught.....ruin their mood!

The game includes a massive 170 Cards with an 120+ Cards in the works through expansion packs

EMOTIONS: There are 80 emotional character cards, 10 cards per 8x emotional families or army; each colour with their own unique power traits. These include both Unique Characters or Hidden Emotions which are required to unlock powerful effects

Features game-changing  ⬆️PICK ME UP's & ⬇️PUTDOWN's, which boost or hinder your chances.

Change the course of the game with random DRAMA cards, because who doesn't like a bit of chaos and let's not forget the all-powerful BRAINFART cards to block your opponents at every turn.

Up the ante by playing MISSION mode with specific win conditions for the ultimate test.

Expansion packs with another 120 cards which also introduce new complex emotions game mechanics with new powers that will literally blow your mind!!!
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
LAUNCHING soon - see below for ways to support us

Join in the conversation and follow here:

Instagram  https://www.instagram.com/been_emotional
Facebook  https://www.facebook.com/BeenEmotional/ 
Our Website https://beenemotional.com/ 
TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@its.been.emotional

				
				
					In the Box		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
EMOTIONS (80 Cards): 10 cards per 8 emotional families or army- each colour with their own unique power traits. These include both unique Characters or Hidden Emotions which are required to unlock powerful effects 
DRAMA(23 cards) : when laid, unleash havoc on the game in a series of random events 
PICK ME UP (15 Cards): Their powers are activated when added to your MOOD, giving you an advantage over other players...but be warned they can be stolen or destroyed at any moment 
PUT DOWNS (15 Cards) : Play these against opponents who are forced to add to their MOODS and experience dreadful side effects...... but remember what comes around goes around... 
BRAINFART (14 Cards): There are currently 14 cards, these can be played instantly during any players turn to wreck plans, seek revenge or just to cause chaos! These cards stack: other BRAINFART's can cancel the BRAINFART and undo the chaos - so on and on it goes! 
MISSION (15 cards): Choose to play with or without these special objective cards of which there are 15. Drawn at random and assign to each player - these will set specific and difficult WIN conditions such as collecting four of one colour to win or play the whole game without using certain cards.

Rules Leaflet and Quick Reminder Cards:  a leaflet containing the rules... and cards which act as a quick reminder of the rules!

1 x Rules Leaflet and
8 x quick reminder cards

				
				
					- HOW TO PLAY		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
				
				
					Who goes first
 The most emotional of course.... alternatively the youngest, smallest, tallest or shortest - You decide!

Each player takes a turn moving clockwise and each turn is made up of 4 different phases:

START: Use powers activated in your MOOD
DRAW: Take 1 card from the DECK / DRAW pile
PLAY: Play 1 card or DRAW 1 additional card
END: DISCARD any additional cards above the maximum of 8 cards in your hand

				
				
					-KEY TERMSHAND: Cards in your hand, not in the MOOD
MOOD: Store cards to activate them and win
DISCARD: Take from HAND, add to DISCARD pile
DRAW Take from the DRAW pile
SUPPRESS: Take from MOOD, add to DISCARD pile
DESTROY:  Take from another players MOOD, add to DISCARD pile

				
				
					-ARMIES / EMOTIONSThe game is made up of 8 core EMOTION family's identified by colour banners at the top of the card.  Each family has its own unique POWER trait.

JOY: If DESTROYED, take cards from DISCARD pile
TRUST: When added to MOOD, choose from DISCARD pile
FEAR: Certain cards have no effect on your MOOD
SURPRISE': t’s a surprise… shh!
SADNESS: SUPPRESS cards for yourself or others
DISGUST: Force players to DISCARD cards from HAND
ANGER: DESTROY, DESTROY,  DESTROY …Mwhahahaha
ANTCIPITAION Search DRAW pile or DRAW extra cards

				
				
					-GAMECHANGERSPICKMEUP: A positive effect added to your MOOD. If you forget to use effects….too bad!
PUTDOWN: A negative effect used against opponents. Players must store in their MOOD & adhere to the effects.
BRAINFART: Play during anyone’s turn to stop play.  Reversed by another BRAINFART. All in- play cards go to DISCARD pile.
DRAMA: Change the course of the game, effecting one or more players. After being played add to DISCARD pile.

				
				
					HOW TO WINThe first to collect 8 EMOTION cards (+ meet MISSION objectives) in their MOOD wins.

Make the victory sweeter by exclaiming: "It's Been Emotional"

				
				
					OUR STORYA long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away… wait, wrong story!

The idea for "It’s Been Emotional" began during one of our family game nights back in 2020, at the height of the COVID pandemic. ?? Like many families, our lives had become a bit disconnected – the kids (then 11 and 13) were glued to their consoles or tablets ?, and quality time together was becoming harder to find.

One evening, we decided to shake things up with a family game night, and what followed was a memorable rollercoaster of emotions. ? There were moments of laughter , tactical alliances that formed and crumbled , some tears (mostly mine! ?), and a healthy dose of good-natured chaos.  We crowned victors , debated strategies , and dove right into another round or tried a new game. It was one of those nights that reminded us how much joy and connection games can bring. ✨❤️

As we talked about the characters, silly names, and what we loved (or would change) about the games we played, someone jokingly said, "We should just make our own game!" ? That spark of an idea grew into a full-fledged family project, and, well… the rest is history.

We dove headfirst into creating "It’s Been Emotional", pouring ourselves into every detail – the artwork , the characters ?, the game mechanics . Through countless drafts and revisions , we’ve crafted a game that we believe is not only fun but also deeply relatable.

We’re incredibly proud of what we’ve created and can’t wait to share it with you.

Whether you’re a family looking to reconnect, friends seeking laughs , or just someone who loves a great game, we hope "It’s Been Emotional" brings you the same joy and unforgettable memories that inspired its creation.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Let’s play, laugh, and make it emotional!

				
				
					EXPANSION PACKSNew Characters & Game Mechanics

We’re thrilled to announce 3 exciting expansions for It's Been Emotional, each bringing new complex emotion mechanics and 35-40 fresh cards to elevate your gameplay experience! These powerful combinations of emotions unlock supercharged abilities and add even more depth to the game. Get ready to explore:

1️⃣ WRATH

2️⃣ LOVE

3️⃣ HORROR

name: Italy '43
description:
Italy '43 is a two-player game depicting the U.S. Fifth Army’s advance from Naples to the Gustav Line in 1943. The game (picking up where Salerno ’43 left off) covers the time period from October 2 to December 31st, 1943.

It includes four scenarios: Across the Volturno, The Barabara Line, The Mignano Gap, and the full Campaign Game.

Italy '43 uses the same game system used in Salerno ’43 with some modifications and rule improvements, and it uses the exact same map and unit scale as Salerno '43 and Normandy '44.

As in other 19xx games, the rules include ZOC Bonds, Determined Defense, Extended Movement, and a straightforward CRT. New rules include: Construction of Defense Lines, Mountain units, and two new attack options: Prepared Offensives and Sustained Attacks.

Players will find the game and order of battle extremely useful in understanding what happened in this campaign. It allows players to experience and understand how a depleted German army was able to slow and then stop the Fifth Army at the Gustav Line.

Time scale: 2-3 days per turn
Map scale: 3.8 km per hex
Unit Scale: Battalion, Regiment, and Brigade
Players: 1-2

Components:

- One PAPER Map: 25.5" x 22"
- One Countersheet
- One Rules Booklet
- One Allied Setup/Reinforcement card
- One German Setup/Reinforcement card
- Two Scenario cards
- Two (identical) Player Aid cards
- Two six-sided dice

—description from publisher's website

name: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Game
description:
Players take turns acting as the Mads, and set up experiments (through memorable Movie Moment cards from classic cheesy movies!) for the other players.

Players have a hand of Riff cards they can look through and choose the card they think:
Best responds to the Movie Moment.
The Mads would like the most.

Then they pass their Riff card face down to the Mads.

Players also have a set of 3 Betting tokens valued 1, 3, and 5. They choose one of these and place it face down in front of them when they submit their Riff card. The number they select is the amount of points they stand to win this turn. If you feel your Riff is strong, bet on yourself to earn higher rewards!

The Mads will shuffle and then read each submitted Riff one at a time, and eventually choose their favorite of the bunch.

Then, all non-Mads players flip over their betting tokens they picked for this experiment. Whoever submitted the card that the Mads picked earns that many points and advances their standee around the Scoreboard of Love on the game board. Each player’s chosen token is left face up in front of them and cannot be used again until they have used all three of their tokens.

There is a twist—

If the player who wins points in an experiment uses their 3 or 5 token, the Mads pick up on the BIG BRAIN ENERGY through their mind monitoring and get some data points as well, scoring 1 point from a 3, and 2 points from a 5 that won. They then move their standee on the score track.

Once that’s all done, the player with the Mads token passes it to the player on their left, each player refills their hand to 5 Riff cards, and they begin the next experiment. After all players have been the Mads, the round is over and the Round tracker is advanced.

The game is played over 3-4 rounds depending on your group size, with an Invention Exchange after the second round where you can swap out some cards in your hand for new ones. Whoever is the furthest on the score track with the most points at the end is the winner!

For the more adventurous players, we have included special Oversized Riff cards and dry erase markers to replace the Riff deck so that you can write in your own responses!

Also, the game is meant to be fully compatible with any movie. Simply leave those Movie Moment cards in the box, and your remote control becomes your Mads token! You and your friends choose a film to use for that game, and then the Mads player gets to pause the film after a good scene or worthy moment occurs on their turn. Play for a normal game length or the duration of the film!

COMBINE the two variants above! As close as you can get to a competitive version of MST3K!

—description from the designer

name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide – The Card Game
description:
The dark and gritty action of Warhammer 40,000: Darktide slips from the screen to the tabletop in a new card game by Cubicle 7 – publishers of tabletop RPG Imperium Maledictum and more. Darktide: The Card Game is a fast and deadly cooperative caper for one to four players, battling hordes of Chaos-warped monsters and traitorous Guardsmen across six missions decreed by their merciless Inquisitor.

The set includes over 260 cards, six player boards, and all the rules and tokens you need to play out missions packed with nerve-wracking decisions – after all, you’re merely Rejects, and the mission must succeed at any cost. If you’re up for a shorter experience, you can also tackle the terrors of Hive Tertium in solo and single mission game modes.

—description from the publisher

name: Backstabbers
description:
Backstabbers is a battle royale game set in Solara, a new world discovered and corrupted by humans in their way to escape the total destruction they made on Earth.

In Backstabbers you're gonna use the power of more than 40 characters to eliminate your competitors. Eliminating players and being the last one standing will grant you coins, 5 coins will make you the Supreme, the most rich and powerful in the new world.

It is a game to 3-8 players within 45 min average where eliminated player still have a role in the game!

DON'T TRUST ANYONE, NOT EVEN YOURSELF!

—description from the publisher

name: Iwo Jima: Hell On Earth
description:
THE HISTORICAL CONTEXT
The Battle of Iwo Jima, a pivotal momentin the Pacific Theater of World War II, stands as a testament to the indomitable spirit of the human will and the immense cost of victory. This brutal conflict, fought between the United States Marine Corps and the Imperial Japanese Army, unfolded on the small volcanic island of Iwo Jima, a mere 660 miles south of Tokyo.

From February 19 to March 26, 1945, American forces waged a relentless assault against a well-fortified enemy, determined to seize control of the island’s strategic airfields. Iwo Jima was crucial to the Allied war effort, serving as a vital base for fighter planes escorting long-range bombers on missions to the Japanese mainland.

The battle was marked by fierce resistance from the Japanese defenders, who had meticulously constructed a network of underground tunnels and fortifications.The Marines faced relentless attacks, as they fought their way across the island’s rugged terrain. The iconic image of Marines raising the American flag atop Mount Suribachi became a symbol of American determination and sacrifice.

The Battle of Iwo Jima was one of the bloodiest battles in Marine Corps history, with thousands of American and Japanese soldiers losing their lives. The island’s volcanic ash and the intense fighting conditions made it a grueling ordeal for both sides. Despite the heavy casualties, the Marines ultimately achieved their objective, securing Iwo Jima and bringing the United States one step closer to victory in the Pacific War.

GAMEPLAY AT A GLANCE
In “Iwo Jima: Hell on Earth,” your mission as the commander of US forces is to conquer the island of Iwo Jima to secure its three airfields and the iconic Mount Suribachi. The game simulates the 36-day battle in nine turns, with each turn representing approximately four days.

Objective and how to win:
Victory is determined at the end of Turn 9 by calculating your Victory Points (VPs).
You earn VPs by: Eliminating Japanese units, Capturing key objectives on time, Japanese surrender.
You can lose VPs if: You play too many Special Orders and/or You suffer too many US casualties.

Your final VP score will give you an assessment of your performance, ranging from a “pen-pushing job” (1 or less to 5 VP) to an “incredible victory” (19-20 VP)

Sequence of play:
The game is played over nine turns, and each turn follows the sequence below:
1. Weather Phase: A die is rolled to determine the weather conditions for the turn, which can affect bombardment points and unit movement. Turn 1 always has “Good Weather”.
2. Bombardment Phase: Both US and Japanese forces bombard enemy units. First, each side’s bombardment points (BP) are determined, which can be modified by weather or airfield control. Then bombardments are resolved, US first, then Japanese, by selecting targets and rolling dice to determine hits.
3. First Movement Phase: US units can attempt to recover from retreat markers (rally) and then move across the map, choosing between normal or strategic movement.
4. First Attack Phase: US units that have not performed a previous action can conduct a Reconnaissance-in-Force (Recon) or an Assault against adjacent Japanese units. They can also provide Combat Support to an assault. During assaults, hidden Japanese units will reveal their response, which may include a Banzai Attack or a Redeployment. The combat ratio is calculated, and results are applied.
5. Raid Phase (Japanese): Japanese forces react with limited attacks, carrying out raids against nearby US units.
6. Second Movement Phase: This phase is a repeat of the First Movement Phase for US units.
7. Second Attack Phase: Similar to the First Attack Phase, US units can perform Reconnaissance or Assaults. At the end of this phase, all situation markers are removed.
8. Command Phase (Skipped on Turn 9): US units attempt to rally again with a +1 modifier. Command Points (CPs) are gained by rolling a die, which can be spent on reinforcements, unit deployment, or to obtain special command markers. The Japanese side also resolves a limited command step, where their single-step units can attempt to gain a step or perform a Banzai attack.
9. Organization Phase: The turn marker is advanced. US units on the turn track can move to the Reserve Area or recover steps. Reaction markers are put into the red bag, and Command markers can be drawn if the turn space is highlighted.

At the end of Turn 9, the player’s performance is assessed based on criteria such as Japanese units eliminated, capture of key objectives, special order markers played, and US casualties.

Key decision/challenges:
US units have a dual role, acting as both direct assault regiments and providing various combat support types (Flamethrowers, Tank, Artillery). This requires careful planning to combine their direct combat strength with support for optimal attacks.

Assaults against hidden Japanese units are resolved using a chit-pull system: Intelligence markers are drawn to determine Japanese defense, support, and unpredictable “Banzai” attacks or “Redeployments” via tunnels. This random element ensures high replayability, making each game fresh.

The game is designed to be very difficult to achieve a significant victory, reflecting the brutal historical battle.

WHAT’S IN THE BOX?
1 Mounted Map
120 Counters
2 6-sided dice
4 Player Aid Sheets
2 Cloth bags
1 Rulebook

—description from the publisher

name: IYE
description:
The clan’s Shaman has gotten long in the tooth; it is time for him to pass on his drum. The drum shall be passed down to either one
of his apprentices. The successor shall be chosen not through a competition nor a contest, but through a traditional ritual of calling
and gathering the İye. The Shaman candidates, raised through apprenticeship, shall prove themselves capable of being the clan’s
new spiritual leader. Albeit they are in a way competing against one another, cooperation is still a necessity. For such is the way to
build a bridge between men and İye.

In this game, the two Shaman candidates endeavour to gather the İyes through the beat of the Shaman’s drum. The candidates need
to calculate which İye shall be left to their opponent; moreover,they need to make the most logical choice on when to ask the İye
to lend a hand and to let them go. The one who proves to be the most skilful in gathering the İye and utilising their abilities shall be
appointed as the clan’s next Shaman.

İye (pronounced EE-yeah): Belonging to the animist mythologies
of Central Asia, İye are nature spirits that inhabit various things.
It is believed that they are the protectors of whatever object
or part of nature they inhabit, and hold extraordinary powers.
Kam (pronounced like English word ‘come’): A shaman in the Altaic,
Mongol and Turkic cultures. They serve as the sages and spiritual leaders
of their clans. They handcraft their own drums with which they contact
the İyes. Utilising the power of an İye is described as “asking the İye to lend
a hand”.

GAME STRUCTURE AND RULES
The first player is the one who is most interested in Shamanism.
You can also use any other method to determine the first player.
On their turn, a player chooses to perform a
A: “Natural Movement”
or an B: “İye Tile Movement” to move the Shaman’s drum.
Whichever İye Tile the drum moves onto is given to the opponent
along with the turn.
When there is but a single İye Tile left on the game board, the
cycle ends and scoring begins.

Natural Movement: The players can move the Shaman’s drum for
1 or 2 spaces on a vertical or horizontal axis. The drum cannot be
moved diagonally through a Natural Movement, only vertically
or horizontally. The drum cannot be placed on an empty tile, but
it can move over them. Moving over an empty tile still counts as
moving 2 spaces.

İye Tile Movement: The İye Tiles that have been gathered on previous
turns can be utilised by the players to move the Shaman’s drum beyond
what is naturally possible. In such an instance, whichever İye Tile the
drum lands on is still given to the opponent. An İye Tile that has been
utilised thusly is spent and ‘discarded’ next to the game board. It will
not be included in scoring. The number and types of discarded İye Tiles
musty always be visible to both players.

The Premature End Of A Cycle
If a player is unable to execute any legal moves during their turn, the cycle ends then and
there. The player who was last able to execute a movement, becomes the winner. This can
only occur if a player has no possible “Natural Movement” to execute and no applicable İye
Tiles that can be used for an “İye Tile Movement”.

End of a cycle and scoring
If a cycle ends because a player was not able to move, the player
who played the last move wins the cycle. In this case, there is no
need for scoring.
If a cycle ends because there is a single İye Tile left on the game
board, scoring ensues. Each type of İye is scored separately.
Whoever holds the greatest count of a particular type of İye,
receives all the points for that type. If both players hold an
equal number of tiles regarding a type of İye, neither player wins
any points. Moreover, any İye Tile that was used for an “İye Tile
Movement” is not counted during scoring; it has been spent and
‘discarded’.

name: Jack
description:
In Jack, you’ll explore the foggy streets of 1800s London, uncover clues, and follow a dark trail of mystery. Your mission: catch Jack before he strikes again. Trace the path on the map, defeat the criminals you encounter, and find the clues that will lead you to the place where Jack will strike. Stop him before he succeeds in his evil plan.

To play, print the map, the 8 cards, and the 8 tokens. You’ll also need a pencil and two six-sided dice. Shuffle the cards to create the deck and place it face down on the table.

Start from the designated starting point on the map and trace the paths you take as you explore. When you reach a point of interest marked with a number, draw a card and try to capture the enemy using your skills and the dice. If you succeed, you’ll earn a clue.

Once you’ve collected 3 different clues, compare your combination with the table in the rulebook. It will tell you where to go on the map to face the final boss, “Jack.” Defeat Jack to win the game!

—description from the designer

name: Jano: A Pawsome Adventure
description:
Jano is a heartwarming, nature-themed board game where players join a curious Hungarian Vizsla on an enchanting journey through farms, forests, and lakesides. By collecting resources, forming friendships with animals, gathering flowers, and completing secret missions, players earn victory points and create their own unique adventure. The player who embraces nature and friendship most skillfully becomes the happiest explorer of all!

—description from the publisher

name: Jarama: The Battle For Madrid
description:
Immerse yourself in the heart of the Spanish Civil War with Jarama: The Battle For Madrid, a captivating two-player simulation game that recreates the pivotal Battle of Jarama. This operational showdown pits the Nationalist forces, led by General Varela, against the determined Republican defenders, as they clash in a desperate struggle for control of Madrid.

The Battle of Jarama, fought from February 6 to 27, 1937, marked the third and bloodiest attempt by the Nationalists to capture Madrid, the heart of the Republican resistance. As the Nationalists sought to sever Madrid's lifeline to the Mediterranean port of Valencia, the Republicans stood firm, determined to protect their capital and the cause of the Republic.

In Jarama, each player assumes the command of either the Nationalist or Republican forces, maneuvering their troops across the battlefield in a tactical dance of conquest and defense. The game utilizes a very particular chit-activation system, ensuring that each decision carries weight and every move has the potential to alter the course of the battle. The chit-activation systems makes this game suitable to be played solo by playing both sides of the conflict.

As the Nationalist player, your primary objective is to cut off the Valencia road, effectively isolating Madrid and crippling the Republican war effort. To achieve this, you must skillfully employ your forces, utilizing their strengths and exploiting enemy weaknesses. Seize historical key cities and hills along the way, for they will not only bolster your strategic position but also provide valuable victory points.

If you command the Republican forces, your mission is to halt the Nationalist advance, protect the vital Valencia road, and ultimately launch a counteroffensive to push the enemy back to their starting positions. This will require unwavering resilience, strategic planning, and the ability to adapt to the ever-changing tides of battle.

—description from the publisher

name: Jefe De Jefes
description:
Jefe De Jefes is a Mexican Drug Cartel inspired card game where players run their own cartel and destroy the competition to become the ultimate drug lord. In order to win, players use their action cards strategically, spend loads of drug money, and negotiate deals with opposing cartels. In the end, there can only be one boss.

—description from the designer

name: Jewels
description:
In Jewels we will compete to be the best jewellery designer in the country, choosing the precious stones to compose the moulds of earrings, bracelets, rings and pendants.

Then you have to polish, set, clean, shape and shine each delicate piece so that they can be displayed in the most incredible collections of the most important jewellery shops.

Jewels is a dice and card selection game with outstanding and elegant components that will delight all types of players due to its simplicity and depth.

In each round there is a jewellery design phase and a jewellery making phase. In the first one you choose the dice (representing gemstones) and in the second one you transform them into jewels. These jewels are cards that will form your collection that will give points at the end of the game based on the gems used, sets and targets to form the best collection.

Obtain the best collection of jewels and complete the given objectives to be the player with the highest score at the end of the indicated rounds to become the most prestigious master jeweller in the guild.

name: Jim Henson's Labyrinth: The Board Game – 40th Anniversary Collection
description:
Will Sarah manage to defeat Jareth and his Labyrinth, or will the Goblin King turn little Toby into a goblin babe? You have thirteen hours to find out!
Relive your favourite movie with the Collector’s edition of Jim Henson’s Labyrinth: The Board Game! New “Humongous” expansion, exclusive miniatures, revised rules, and a unique box to keep your collection!

The complete collection includes:
Core Game
Goblins Expansion
Fireys! Expansion
Humongous Expansion
Revised Rulebook
Card Game
Adventure Game
Ready, Steady, Worm!
Exclusive Miniatures Set
Exclusive Collector’s Storage Box

The main expansion is of course the Humongous expansion, featuring a giant miniature, a game board and a set of cards that allow you to play a very strategic and yet fun mini-game, either on its own, or integrated with your games of Labyrinth the boardgame. 
 Then, the next most exciting new expansion we think is the ‘Play as the Worm’ expansion, which adds a new character/player sheet to the game. Now you can play as the Worm, which has a very peculiar set of rules – a very different profile from the other main characters… as you can imagine he does not excel in Brawn or Speed, but his knowledge of the Labyrinth (and therefore his Wit) is without peer! And comes with the customary two cards for his Strength (‘Cup of Tea?) and his Weakness (‘I’m just a Worm!).
 The last two expansions are the Trash Lady and the Wiseman. These follow the same principle and format as the Goblins! and Fireys! expansions, providing new rules that you can use alongside the new miniature to modify the normal boardgame.
 The Wiseman is more static, he remains where he is drawn, and is potentially a source of helpful information that will boost your Willpower… but there is a risk that he will just waste your time with infuriatingly useless gibberish!
 The Junk Lady is more dangerous, she will challenge you as normal when drawn, but if you manage to resist her powers, every turn there is a chance that she will chase Sarah around the board to try again to sway her from her mission… watch out!
 Combined with the other expansions and the optional rules in the rulebook, these new characters allow you to enrich your experience of the Labyrinth boardgame and adapt it to your taste and level of experience. Have fun!

name: Solar Gardens
description:
Step into the radiant future of Solar Gardens!

Solar Gardens is a light-hearted, tile-drafting board game where players will take on the role of a visionary architect specializing in carbon-neutral engineering to build a rooftop garden in harmony with nature. Each square tile placed on your player board will require a sense of strategy and imagination to outwit your opponents and make your garden the most beautiful and environmentally conscious.

To create your own utopia and win the game, players must score the most points by using the tiles to build solar farms, windmill systems, water filters, and cultural hubs. This game uses principles of sustainability, innovation, and community, encouraging players to harness renewable energy to create tranquil garden environments.

Solar Gardens includes an easy-to-learn rulebook and 90 tiles for players to express their creativity.

—description from the publisher

name: A Familiar Find
description:
A Familiar Find: A charming, fast paced, strategic card game fun for the whole family.

The familiars are on an important mission for their spellcasters: gather rare ingredients from every corner of Exandria. But you’re not alone, competing familiars from rival summoners lurk nearby, setting traps, and attempting to sabotage your efforts!

In A Familiar Find, players collect ingredients from locations represented by piles of cards.

On their turn, a player takes all the cards from one pile and adds them to their collection. They then place three cards from their hand into any locations, distributing them among the piles. Two of the cards are placed face up and one is placed face down.

Over the course of the game, players attempt to set aside valuable cards for future turns while misleading opponents into taking piles filled with negative cards. Careful placement and timing are key to collecting the most valuable set of ingredients.

Can you collect the ingredients before your competitors? Or will their traps leave you tangled in a web of misfortune?

Fast-paced. Strategic. Fun for all ages.

—description from the publisher

name: Johari Bazaar
description:
​Convincing India's most famous gem merchant that your gem collection is the most valuable is no easy task. Especially, if this is also the goal of your opponent.
Players want to sell ​their gems for the highest possible price. The value of gems will be determined by their beauty and rarity.

The aim of the players is to place their gems in front of the merchant in such a way that their own collection is the most valuable and thus the deal is made.

​During the game, players will take turns, placing their gems on the outer spaces of the game board. ​If gems have already been placed in a row or column, the new one pushes them all towards the opposite side of the board by one space. With this, the value of individual gems changes continuously during the game.  Whoever has the highest total value of their gems at the final standing, is the winner.

The box contains two additional modules which can be added to the basic game, even together. With the Business Partners module, players are accompanied by a business partner who will provide a unique ability to them. While the Purses module brings an exciting set collection to the game.

—description from the designer

name: Jomsvikings
description:
In this tactical game with deckbuilding elements, 1-4 players  become one of the Jomsvikings - an elite mercenary group capable of  accomplishing even the most impossible tasks. You set off to different  planets of the Nine Realms to gain glory while figthing anything your  employers want you to fight!

The game consists of 3 rounds, during  which players fight the chosen monsters (each of them separately), but  can either help or hinder other players. Each round takes us to a  different planet, with various conditions, that can impact combat. By  investing in new cards and new equipment it can become much easier to  defeat them, but the ultimate goal lies in collecting the glory points  (received for defeating the enemies, finding the valuable artifacts, and  using the abilities skilfully).

Jomsviking can be played in 2-4 player free for all mode, solo mode or in 2-4 player coop mode.

—description from the designer

name: Cat Rescue (Second Edition)
description:
The cooperative card game Cat Rescue is back with an exciting Second Edition — now with a brand-new competitive mode! In this new edition, you'll work to rescue, foster, and adopt adorable cats, giving them a chance at a loving forever home.

Carefully place cats in the shelter, line them up for adoption, and make sure no foster home gets overcrowded. Play cooperatively or compete against friends, adding even more excitement to every rescue.

The game ends when all street cats have been rescued.  The player with the most points wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Kittens in Space
description:
The year is 2199, and the Moon is overrun with kittens. Stray kittens. On the Moon. It’s more of a problem than you’d think.

In Kittens in Space, humanity’s first Lunar Kitten Adoption Center is in crisis, struggling to manage a low-gravity furball of a situation. and it’s up to you to save the day! Wedged between sleek skyscrapers in a bustling lunar metropolis, the shelter makes brilliant use of vertical space—because hey, low gravity means high stacking. What looks cramped by Earth standards is actually a cozy, multi-level paradise for space kittens.

You and your fellow volunteers are working to rescue stray kittens and help them find loving homes. Kittens in Space is a fast and furry-ous card-shedding ladder game with multiple active stacks in play. The direction of the ladder shifts dynamically based on what players put down, and special cards let you restrict opponents’ options or completely change the flow. It’s a tactical race to empty your hand while causing just enough chaos to stay ahead.

The first to shed all their cards wins the round. Win multiple rounds to become the ultimate champion of lunar kitten rescue.

—description from the publisher

name: Ju 87 Stuka Ace
description:
Ju 87 Stuka Ace allows you to simulate Junker 87 (Stuka) operations throughout the course of World War II, from the beginning of the Blitzkrieg in Poland to the anti-tank operations in the Russian campaign.

What makes Stuka Pilot special is the brand-new game engine, built around what made the Stuka unique, the dive-bombing. This method of attack is very different from the standard bombing operated by other aircraft, and Ju 87 Stuka Pilot fully reflects this uniqueness. This is the attack sequence in JU 87 Stuka Ace: select the bomb release height, proceed with the dive, consider the current formation height and visibility, release the bombs at the set height and then execute the delicate pull phase. Each of these phases will be managed by making optimal use of the action cards in the player's hand, but you must carefully plan your play since you don’t immediately draw a new card after playing it.

Ju 87 Stuka Ace will allow you to fly your Ju 87 in almost all the theatres where the Stuka were used: Poland, France, England, Norway, the Mediterranean, North Africa, Italy, and Russia. The missions in the different theatres will have very different objectives: infantry units, artillery positions, tanks, transport ships, battleships are just some of the examples. Terrain and weather conditions will also play an important role in the missions; poor visibility, the scorching heat and the sand of the desert, and the frost and snow in the Russian winters: are elements the player will have to consider to succeed.  Ju 87 Stuka Ace includes even night operations: special rules will allow simulating Ju 87 D-5N attacks in Italy as members of "Night Battle Group" NSG9.

Nine Stuka models will be available to the player depending on the mission or on the progression of the campaign, including Ju 87 A, Ju 87B-1, Ju 87 R-1, Ju 87 D-3, Ju 87 D-5, and Ju 87 G-1. Depending on the capabilities of the aircraft, it will be necessary to select the most appropriate bomb load for the mission objective, evaluating both the number and the type of bombs to be used. And when flying the Ju 87 G-1, your pilot will use the Bordkanone 37 against the Soviet tanks: to better represent the Ju 87G-1 tank-buster role, a specific attack procedure has been introduced, always leveraging the player Action Cards.

If you have just a limited amount of time you can play single missions, choosing your preferred theatre of operations. If you are instead looking for a campaign game, Stuka Pilot has been designed to represent the entire career of the pilot, starting from his role as "rookie", then moving on to the roles of Kette Leader, Staffel Leader, and finally Gruppe Leader. As squadron or group commander, the player will have to coordinate the operations of his formation, defining the best approach to the attack, while still remaining in command of his aircraft; the outcome of the mission is always based on the result of your individual attack, do not expect to remain an observer while your formation is executing its dive attacks. As the campaign progresses, you will not only be able to climb the ranks of the Luftwaffe, but also improve your skills (customize your deck of Action cards) and get the coveted medals. The Golden Leaves are waiting for you aboard your Ju 87.

—description from the publisher

name: Judgemint of the Realm Lords
description:
The Realm Lords, powerful entities in charge of governing all aspects of life, have forsaken their posts. With nothing holding them back, the forces of evil and malice have risen, causing foul denizens to spread across the land. A hero must vanquish these corrupt beings and exact judgement upon the Realm Lords.

Judgemint of the Realm Lords is a solo fantasy adventure game that sees the player controlling a hero trying to save the realm, all contained within a small mint tin. It features a unique rock-paper-scissors combat system where the hero will have to predict the enemy’s behavior in order to counter them.

The hero will collect experience and gold by defeating enemies as they traverse the realm. They then can spend their gold and experience on new equipment and stat increases, respectively. As the hero levels up, they can take on greater foes to earn increased rewards. Each turn, there is a risk that the Doom Clock counts down, so time is of the essence. Players must defeat 3 Realm Lords, or get lucky enough to encounter and defeat the powerful Death Lord, before time runs out.

—description from the designer

name: Juggernaut
description:
Juggernaut is PvP Deck Building Roguelike board game. You and rivals are zealot that invited to the Ritual for choose an offering to the God. To become offering, beat your rival completely. Player must gather your Servant cards and enhance them, or customize the card abilities, generate items for your deck be more stronger, collect Relics, for show your Faith. Time is come...sharpen your deck as your sword.

The aim of Juggernaut is to be the player with the most Faith (Victory Point) at the game’s end. Faith are primarily gained by deal damage to your opponent in the Ritual step, and also Purchase some Relics. Each round, you enhance your deck by customize your card or gain new one from action in Blessing. Then battle your rival for gain Faith in Ritual. Repeat these 2 steps for 6 round, then game is end.

—description from the designer

name: Jujuman
description:
Jujuman is a single-sheet roll-and-write game of exploration and potion crafting. Each player becomes a mystical potion maker navigating a hex-based map.

On a turn, three dice (red, green, and black) are rolled for all players. Each player uses the dice to simultaneously fill potion bottles with strategic number placements, move across the map, and collect ingredients like mushrooms, feathers, and worms. Players score points by completing potion rows, collecting ingredients, and invoking the magical power of the number nine, with special abilities granted by ingredient rewards that can modify dice values.

Playable from 1-99 players, Jujuman offers a unique blend of dice management, spatial navigation, and magical theme, challenging players to become the most skilled potion maker by balancing precise bottle filling, strategic movement, and ingredient collection.

—description from the designer

name: Jungle Speed Donkey Kong
description:
The cult reflex game meets an iconic universe! Jungle Speed Donkey Kong is a fast-paced, hilarious twist on the classic game of observation, with a banana-filled mechanic that brings Donkey Kong’s chaotic energy to the table.

Players flip cards simultaneously. When two identical symbols appear, a duel begins! If the banana totem is on the barrel, grab the big banana and remove it.If the banana totem is off, grab a small banana and toss it into the barrel. First to react wins the round!

—description from the publisher

name: Lunar Skyline
description:
Get ready to blast off into the future with Lunar Skyline—the electrifying trick-taking card game where strategy meets high-stakes bidding and construction! 50 years after the Lunar Rush, where new wondrous materials were discovered on the Moon, the settlers are gearing up to build the first lunar metropolis. As one of a few visionary building and architectural firms, you’re competing to shape the skyline of the metropolis and leave your mark on the Moon for the ages!

In each game, the cards feature two suits/icons, giving you the flexibility to follow the lead card with either suit. You can also win tricks with expert ace pilots (which can be played high or low), or use your underground connections to smuggle in the resources you need. Every trick you take brings in valuable resources for your architectural masterpiece, but the real challenge is outpacing your competitors to complete your contract bids before they do. Nail those bids first, and you’ll get to pick from the lucrative bonuses that can launch you to victory.

In Lunar Skyline, the future of this metropolis is in your hands!

—description from the publisher

name: Junk Art Revolution
description:
New edition of the classic dexterity game. Revised rules, updated scoring system, wooden pieces and new cities.

Where some see trash, others see art. You are an emerging artist known for turning scrap into magnificent structures and transforming junk into impressive creations. This type of art, known as Junk Art, is booming, and other artists like you are beginning to showcase their extraordinary skills. The movement is gaining ever more followers worldwide, and every major city is hosting its own exhibitions.
It’s time to leave your studio and show your creations to the world. Embark on a world tour and achieve fame in the name of Junk Art.

Junk Art is a mix of steady hands, balance, and a bit of luck. Embark on a world tour and exhibit your works in different cities around the world, creating a unique structure in each city using the game pieces. Regardless of the location, your goal remains the same: increase your fame and become the artist of the hour.

—description from the publisher

name: Bim Bam Bum
description:
Can you say “Bim Bam Bum”? It sounds easy… until chaos takes over the table.

In Bim Bam Bum, your goal is simple: don’t mess up and be the first to get rid of all your cards. On your turn, place a card from your deck face up on one of the three piles on the table and say out loud the word on the card: Bim, Bam, or Bum.

What happens next depends on how many times that word appears on the table— and messing up is easier than you think. If the word appears once, just say it once and the turn passes to the next player. If it appears twice, you’ll need to say it twice and the next player loses their turn. If it appears three times, you’ll have to say it three times in a row and the direction of play will reverse.

And as if that wasn’t enough, whenever there’s a Bim, a Bam, and a Bum on the table (in any order), you must shout “Bim Bam Bum!” and everyone except you must slap their hand on the center of the table as fast as they can.

Every time a player makes a mistake, they must add cards to their deck.

Play fast, change the direction, skip turns, and race to be the first to run out of cards— while everyone else tries to do the same: don’t mess up.

- description from designer (spanish)

¿Sabes decir “Bim Bam Bum”? Parece sencillo… hasta que el caos se apodera de la mesa.

En Bim Bam Bum tu objetivo es simple: no equivocarte y ser el primero en quedarte sin cartas. En tu turno, coloca una carta de tu mazo boca arriba en uno de los tres montones de la mesa y di en voz alta la palabra que aparece: Bim, Bam o Bum.

Todo depende de cuántas veces esa palabra esté visible en la mesa, y equivocarse es más fácil de lo que parece. Si aparece una vez, solo tendrás que decirla una vez y el turno pasa al siguiente jugador. Si aparece dos veces, deberás repetirla dos veces y el siguiente jugador perderá su turno. Si aparece tres veces, tendrás que decirla tres veces seguidas y el sentido del juego se invertirá.

Por si fuera poco, cuando en la mesa hay una carta de Bim, una de Bam y una de Bum (¡en cualquier orden!), tendrás que gritar “Bim Bam Bum” y todos, menos tú, deberán poner la mano en el centro de la mesa lo más rápido posible.

Cada vez que un jugador se equivoque, tendrá que añadir cartas a su mazo.

Juega rápido, cambia el sentido del juego, salta turnos y sé el primero en quedarte sin cartas, mientras todos intentáis los mismo: no fallar.

- description from designer (spanish)

name: Jurassic Roll
description:
Jurassic Roll is a roll & write board game in which you will have to feed the dinosaurs surviving on an unexplored wild island, and keep them away from the erupting volcano in the center of the island.
Roll 5 dice each turn and at the same time players will use the dice values on their player sheet as they wish, being able to follow different scoring paths. 
You will be able to get dinosaur eggs with which to unlock new missions or rewards, explore fossils or get bonuses for rescuing groups of herbivorous, carnivorous or marine dinosaurs.
The player with the most victory points at the end of the game will be the winner.

—description from the publisher

name: Just One: New Version
publisher: Repos Production; Gém Klub Kft.; Maldón; Regatul Jocurilor
description:
Just One is a co-operative party game in which you all play together to get the best score! Your goal each round is to get one player — the active player — to guess a mystery word based on the clues given by teammates.

In more detail, everyone who is not the active player sees the mystery word, then each player independently writes a clue on their personal easel. Once everyone has finished, you reveal the clues to one another. All identical clues are removed from play, so try to be original!

After eliminating duplicate clues, reveal the remaining clues to the active player. If they correctly guess the mystery word, your team scores a point. If they decline to guess, you don't score the current card. If they guess wrong, you don't score the current card and you lose one of the points you had already scored. Thus, be original, but not so original that you don't help the active player guess correctly!

Can you achieve a perfect score by guessing all the mystery words?

Just One: New Version features the same gameplay as Just One, but features 550 new terms on its 110 cards and erasable crayons instead of dry-erase markers.

name: Juven Isle
description:
Juven Isle is a tile-laying (actually card-laying) game where you create a map of islands – building connections and deciding when to play your scoring tokens to maximize your score.

When you play a scoring token, you claim a port for one of the 6 factions, and score a point for each matching faction symbol that the new port can connect to. Or... you could play the scoring token as a pirate, which permanently disrupts the map and scores unclaimed ports.

When you score, you draw cards from the deck into your score pile. The total number of points available is limited by the cards remaining in the deck, so if you wait too long your opponents will have claimed them all.

—description from the designer

name: Kaijus From Space!
description:
Kaijus From Space! is a co-operative tabletop game in which up to five players dive into the chaos and city-wide destruction of a battle between giant monsters from outer space and heroic human defenders.

Players take on the role of unique kaijus, each with dynamic skills and support moves that evolve throughout the game, becoming increasingly more powerful and bizarre. As kaijus take damage, they grow angrier and stronger, shifting between three different forms that provide different advantages and dangers.

However, the human armies defending the city will fight back with a variety of countermeasures, ranging from unpredictable event cards to robotic champions and towering mechas, ready to face the monsters head-on. Players have to work together and act in synergy with their teammates to neutralize the defenses, damage the infrastructure, and earn enough destruction tokens to win the game.

Inspired by Japanese monster movies of the 1970s and 1980s, Kaijus From Space! mixes playful humor and a moderate level of complexity with gameplay that aims to strike a balance between accessibility and strategic depth. Pairing the social fun of a party game with mechanisms that reward planning and shared tactics, it focuses on physical interactions between players, whose real-world actions can affect the game and vice versa.

Stomp through the city and wreak havoc, taking advantage of overpowered moves and obvious plot holes. Knock down that pathetic skyscraper, and crush the puny humans!

—description from the designer

name: Kaiser Cucumber and the Gangs of McChanicle Corners
description:
A small box, tile stacking game of Masterminds & Mayhem!

McChanicle Corners is a city brimming not only with cogs and commerce but secrets and secret societies. The masterminds run the city entertaining themselves with hijinks and high society.

The Royal Museum has just received a large donation of priceless art, previously thought lost. Sergeant Bonnie and the rabbit police (AKA the Bunny Bobbies) have been tasked with its protection.

YOU are one of the Masterminds. Your goal: Out maneuver the rival masterminds and get the most points. On your turn: Hide a criminal or drop them into the action.

—description from the designer

name: Kalmár: Merchants in Buda
description:
In the early 15th century, a wealthy merchant of Buda, now in the autumn of his years, decides to hand over the leadership of his prosperous trading empire to the child most fit for the task. To determine the successor, he announces an unusual challenge: each heir will have one full week to prove their worth. The rival merchant brothers aim to maximise their wealth and prestige through the optimal utilisation of available opportunities. To succeed, they must not only deliver on their promises, but also donate generously and host banquets to forge valuable contacts. At the end of the week, the heir with the most prestige points will be the winner.
The game spans 7 rounds – one for each day of the week. Players have 7 action points to spend every day, and they start the game with a modest 7-thaler capital. Each day is divided into morning, daytime, and evening phases. The most important actions are in the daytime phase. In the morning and evening phases, automatic events take place – like ‘games within the game’ – which can significantly influence trading success. 
Players should make the most of every opportunity and plan ahead to build a fortune large enough for both investments and donations, while constantly deciding whether to take money or prestige points in exchange for their goods. Action points can be spent freely, but every turn begins with movement on the board – and each step costs an action point. At the destination – whether it is a townhouse, an institution, a craftsman’s workshop, or the bustling city gate – players may perform all available actions or what they are able to. Some actions are location-specific, while others can be carried out anywhere and at any time.
Within the city, the supply of goods is limited. However, the merchants can also rely on various other sources, such as the market (open three times a week), the ships docking at the harbour, a central storehouse, and even the black market – where goods from rural estates can also be found. Goods form production chains, which can be cleverly exploited during the game. But merchants must watch their warehouse stock: any items not delivered within three days are lost, at a heavy cost. On the other hand, a quick turnover of stock is rewarded with prestige points via an agility gauge. Additional points can be earned through two types of objective cards, as well as from partner cards gained at banquets, which grant one-time or permanent abilities.
Kalmár also offers a special two-player mode, featuring a new character that allows each player to control two merchant figures. A shorter version of the game is also included, covering only the last four days of the week – from Thursday to Sunday.

—description from the publisher

A 15. század elején egy gazdag budai kereskedő versenyt ír ki a gyermekeinek: arra bízza a kereskedőbirodalom irányítását, aki egy teljes hét leforgása alatt bebizonyítja a rátermettségét.  A rivalizáló testvérek célja, hogy a hét során felmerülő kereskedelmi lehetőségek optimális felhasználása révén minél nagyobb vagyont, tekintélyt és népszerűséget szerezzenek.  Ezért fontos, hogy ígéreteiket időben teljesítsék, bőkezűen adományozzanak, illetve bankettek rendezésével igyekezzenek hasznos támogatókkal bővíteni kapcsolataikat. A versengést az nyeri, aki a legtöbb presztízspontot gyűjti a hét során.

A játék 7 fordulóból  – azaz 7 napból – áll.  A játékosok minden nap 7 akcióponttal gazdálkodhatnak, és mindössze 7 garas induló tőke áll rendelkezésükre.  A napok reggeli, nappali és esti szakaszból állnak. A nappali szakaszban zajlanak a legfontosabb akciók. A reggeli és az esti szakasz eseményei egyfajta „játékok a játékban”, amelyek mindenki részvételével, automatikusan bekövetkeznek, és befolyásolhatják a kereskedelmi tevékenység eredményét.

Ezekből a lehetőségekből kell a játékosoknak előrelátó tervezéssel olyan vagyonra szert tenniük, amelyből befektetésekre, adományozásra is jut  –  ugyanis folyamatosan dönteniük kell: pénzt vagy népszerűséget  - presztízspontot  - válasszanak az eladott áruért cserébe. Mindenki szabadon oszthatja be az akciópontjait, de a kört mindig lépéssel kell kezdeni a táblán – és minden lépés akciópontba kerül. Az érkezés helyszínén, amely lehet egy városi polgárház, egy intézmény, egy mester műhelye vagy a forgalmas városkapu, minden akciót végrehajthatnak a játékosok, amire csak lehetőségük nyílik. Egyes akciók csak bizonyos helyszíneken, míg más akciók bárhol, illetve bármikor végrehajthatók.

A város területén szűk a kínálat. Szerencsére más forrásokra is támaszkodhatnak, mint például a heti háromszori piac, a kikötőbe befutó hajók, egy központi raktár – vagy akár a feketepiac, ahol a városon kívüli birtokokon termelt áruk is elérhetők.  A különféle áruk termékláncokat alkotnak, ami a játék folyamán ügyesen kihasználható.  Azonban oda kell figyelni a raktárban tárolt tételek lejáratára: komoly veszteségekkel jár, ha egy eladás vagy megrendelés három napon belül nem teljesül. Ugyanakkor a készletek gyors forgatását presztízsponttal jutalmazza egy erre szolgáló agilitásmérő eszköz. További pontszerzési lehetőséget ad kétféle célkártya, valamint a banketteken szerzett, egyszeri vagy állandó képességeket is nyújtó  partnerkártyák.

A Kalmár külön játékmódot tartalmaz két fő számára, melynek különlegessége, hogy egy új karakter is megjelenik, ezáltal a játékosok 2-2 figurát irányítanak.  Ezen kívül a játék rövidített verzióban is játszható, ami nem a teljes hetet, hanem csak a csütörtöktől vasárnapig terjedő időszakot öleli fel.

—description from the publisher (translated)

name: Kanata: The First Sacrament
description:
Escape the occult horrors of a forsaken town.

Kanata is a co-operative board game for 1-4 players where you must survive unexplained phenomenon and demonic manifestations before your time runs out.

Searching for a lost friend, you become trapped in a possessed town and must work together to gather the 4 items you need to destroy the hellish roadblock or be trapped there forever.

Will you maintain your sanity and survive?

—description from the publisher

name: KANPUR: El Desierto Florido
description:
KANPUR: El Desierto Florido ("KANPUR: The Flowering Desert") brings up to four players to the vast and wide Atacama Desert, to witness how many species of flowers, within the wonderful landscapes of the driest non-arctic desert on Earth, bloom before and when spring arrives.

Players represent the north winds; they take turns drawing seed tiles, revealing cards that determine where water and sunlight will fall, and then strategically placing and/or moving their tiles depending on the flowers' requirements to bloom. Every flower, even similar species, requires its own conditions to show its colors.

Blooming is the main way to score, as well as Trophy cards that work as boosts for players to gain even more VP. Players use their wooden flower markers to track their score, and once a player fulfills a Trophy mission, that player keeps the card and the VP involved!

Rounds in the game represent one year seasons, changing weather. In addition, the board has different heights in the middle, making gardening a bit harder than expected, but no worries: Nature is amazing, as this phenomenon is seen every year in the "Norte Grande de Chile" (Great North of Chile).

The game has 4 game modes: Free for All, 2 vs 2, Solo, and Cooperative with 3 difficulty levels: Easy, Standard and Hard. Cooperative and Solo modes are challenges to overcome with strategy and skill.

Play as you like and take a view on these beautiful flowers!

—description from the designer

name: Karakorum
description:
Ice axe? Check. Crampons? Check. Oxygen? Check. Radio? Check. Weather window? Confirmed... All right, we're ready to climb!

In Karakorum, you take on the role of an experienced mountain guide leading daring expeditions to three of the world's highest peaks in the Karakorum range. It's no walk in the park, though, as you'll need strategic planning when playing your summit cards, quick thinking to build up your expedition stacks, and a keen eye on your opponents' moves to reach your goals before they do.

At the end of the game, the expeditions that reached the highest point on each mountain will be recognized — but that doesn't guarantee victory! The winner is the player who manages to conquer all three peaks, or who leads all of their teams consistently high up the mountains.

name: Dodos Riding Dinos: First Race
description:
Dodos Riding Dinos: First Race is an exciting tabletop racing and skill game where you compete using a team of Dodos and Dinos, known as "Dodino". Launch projectiles at your opponents, test your luck advancing with dice, or hinder others by taking cards from their hand; everything counts to cross the finish line before anyone else!

This family-friendly version stands on its own from the original Dodos Riding Dinos game, offering a 20-minute experience for 2 to 6 players that is simpler and more frantic than ever.

—description from the publisher

name: Monster Nursery
description:
Monster Nursery ia a dexterity game where you take care of all the little monsters in your nursery as best you can so they don't cry. Some are hungry, others want to play or want to sleep.

In turns,  the active player selects 1 of the available monster tiles from the center of the table to its nursery board, trying to place it near to their friends and away from the little monsters it is angry with. The active playerthen tells everyone the icons marked on the selected tile, and simultaneously, each player tries to take care of their monsters by placing one finger of the same hand on each icon on the tiles that corresponds to the one indicated by the active player and with the other hand on the other icon to prevent them from crying.

All this while you take care of the sleepy little monsters. Some of them want to sleep and need to be carried, by placing them on your head, arm, hand, or shoulders, preventing them from falling and crying.

The player who best takes care of their little monsters will be the winner.

name: Kartini: From Darkness to Light
description:
In Kartini - From Darkness to Light, you manage schools for girls where girls from different islands of Indonesia come to be students. As they graduate, the students become politicians, fighters, patrons or teachers, further advancing education for women and supporting the fight for the nation’s freedom. Strategically manage your duits (money) and books to help as many girls graduate from your school while paying attention to your school’s reputation. After three rounds, the player with the highest points wins the game.

Kartini - From Darkness to Light celebrates the triumphs of girls’ education. The game takes place in Indonesia in the late 1800 to the early 1900, during the country’s struggle for independence from Dutch colonialism. This was the era where Indonesian young women were stepping up to the plate, leading battles and participating in politics for a free Indonesia. Realizing that the key to the nation’s eventual liberation lied in education, some of them built schools and advocated for more and more girls to be educated to then participate in the nation’s fight for freedom. Indonesian women’s yearning for education and to take an active role in the public life were encapsulated in a famous series of letters written by Kartini, a Javanese aristocrat, to her Dutch friends. These letters were later published as a book titled ‘From Darkness to Light’ from which the name of this game derived. Kartini’s letters are often credited as one of the cornerstones of Indonesian women emancipation movement and they served as profound inspirations for Indonesia’s fight for independence.

—description from the publisher

Additionally,  there is also a 'Curriculum Guide' available:

name: Pirate King!
description:
Prove your worth and become the Pirate King by facing challenges that will test your luck. In Pirate King!, every decision matters, and only those capable of mastering their ambition will claim the pirate throne. Across 7 rounds, you'll compete against other captains to build the best deck of cards while avoiding the dreaded curses lurking in the seven seas.

Each player starts by choosing a captain and an initial deck, while the market and monster cards are placed in the center of the table. Every captain is unique, so choose wisely, as their abilities will aid you on your journey.

During the game, players will simultaneously reveal cards from their decks, one by one, deciding each turn whether to keep risking or stop before luck turns against them. If a player reveals three curses (skulls), they explode and lose all the resources they’ve gained that round, falling to the last position.

Those who manage their luck well will gather valuable resources, such as gold and swords, to trade for powerful market cards or defeat terrifying monsters. These cards provide victory points and special abilities to help you get ahead of your rivals. However, greed is always lurking, and it could leave you empty-handed if you don’t play carefully.

After seven rounds, the player with the most victory points will be crowned the one and only Pirate King. Only one can claim this title—will it be you?

—description from the publisher

Demuestra tu valía y conviértete en el Rey de los Piratas enfrentando desafíos que pondrán a prueba tu suerte. En Pirate King, cada decisión cuenta, y solo aquellos capaces de dominar su ambición lograrán alcanzar el trono pirata. A lo largo de 7 rondas, competirás contra otros capitanes para construir el mejor mazo de cartas y esquivar las temidas maldiciones que acechan en los siete mares.

Cada jugador comienza eligiendo un capitán y un mazo inicial, mientras en el centro de la mesa se despliegan las cartas de mercado y cartas de monstruo. Cada capitán es único, así que elige bien, pues sus habilidades te ayudarán a lo largo de tu travesía.

Durante la partida, los jugadores revelarán a la vez las cartas de su mazo, una a una, decidiendo en cada turno si seguir arriesgando o detenerse antes de que la suerte los traicione. Si un jugador revela tres calaveras, explota y pierde todos los recursos obtenidos en esa ronda, siendo relegado al último lugar.

Aquellos que manejen bien su suerte podrán recolectar valiosos recursos, como oro y espadas, para canjear por poderosas cartas del mercado o derrotar a temibles monstruos. Estas cartas ofrecen puntos de victoria y habilidades especiales que te permitirán adelantarte a tus rivales. Sin embargo, la codicia siempre está al acecho, y podría dejarte con las manos vacías si no juegas con cautela.

Tras siete rondas, el jugador con más puntos de victoria será coronado como el único y verdadero Rey de los Piratas. Solo uno podrá reclamar este título, ¿serás tú el que lo consiga?

—description from the designer (Spanish)

name: Polaris
publisher: Fractal Juegos; Detestable Games; Evrikus; Maldito Games; Wonderbow Games
description:
Looking north, you see a bright star that doesn't change its position as the night goes on... It's the star at the north pole: Polaris.

In Polaris, you’ll have to position your Stars in the night sky to form constellations and accomplish the game's objectives. 5 scoring phases will be played, which will get shorter and shorter, where the different moon phases will be vital to know where you can place your stars in each of them. On your turn, you'll only have to perform one of three possible actions: Draw Cards, Play Cards, or Take Shooting Stars. Whoever earns the most Victory Points at the end of the game will win.

Contemplation of the night sky has been an essential part of our culture on this planet. Its constellations have brought us together since our dawn to tell the great stories that define us.

—description from the publisher

name: Katz Fatz
description:
In Katz Fatz, you try to get rid of your cat cards and score as many points as possible with happy cats. You can foist the grumpy cats and minus points on your fellow players. But be careful, there are cat toys in the game, and that confuses all the cats.

Katz Fatz is a card game in the style of Mau Mau, but here each player has their own discard pile. They can use this themselves, but so can the other players.

—description from the publisher

name: Kayros: A Game of Thieves
description:
The god Kayros has summoned all the best thieves from every age to confront each other in a great tournament that will establish, once and for all, who is the greatest thief in each universe. To win, Robin Hood, Arsène Lupin and the other thieves will have to travel through time and space to steal the world's most precious treasures.

"Kayros: A Game of Thieves" is a board game for 2-6 players (1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 2v2v2, or free-for-all).

Each player leads a Thief with unique abilities and statistics.

The game is played in turns, and at the end of each turn, players draw 2 cards from the Main Deck consisting of Tool and Event cards and earn 1 coin.

Tool cards are used to provide additional abilities and increase the Thief's statistics, while Event cards have an immediate effect and also contain objectives that, if completed, provide Victory Points. With Coins, players can buy Silver and Gold Tools, cards that will greatly enhance your character!

The main goal of the game is to steal the Treasures placed in the center of the table, but it is not the only way to win the game. In fact, many different factors contribute to Victory Points.

The game comes to an end when a player fills their Loot or steals two sets of Treasures (a set consists of three treasures of the same type). The final "special" turn is executed, and Victory Points are counted!

name: kCaloria: Namib Desert & Mouth of the Congo River
description:
Introduces 2 new sets of tiles with organisms from two new ecosystems: the Namib Desert and the Mouth of the Congo River. This expansion is standalone but can also be incorporated into any other biome set of kCaloria.

kCaloria gives you the chance to build an expansive and intricate food chain that must overcome obstacles at every turn!

The objective of kCaloria is to play greater and more complex tiles in order to increase your final score. You will alternate placing tiles with your opponents and expand your respective food chains to dominate the table!

Note: Each player needs their own 60-tile set with KCalorie counters.

name: Kebab
description:
"Fire up the grill and grab your skewers! In this fast paced, flavor-packed game, players compete to assemble the most appetizing Kebabs for their hungry (and picky) guests. Slide ingredients onto your skewer and be the player to best satisfy your guests' cravings."

Kebab is a simple drafting game where you are sliding ingredients onto a skewer and trying to score points by pleasing picky guests. New player-driven scoring conditions are revealed each round, creating a fun and evolving linear puzzle on your skewer.

name: Regroup! Panda Crew
description:
In Regroup! Panda Crew you organize panda painters to attack and defend from every other player. Only one panda captain will emerge victorious from the painting competition!

Each turn you choose a card and place it over another card on your grid seeking to match offensive/defensive melee or ranged pandas. Some cards have map pieces and if you arrange them in a specific pattern, you gain a bonus card that is stronger.

Once all the players have placed and organized their card, the round ends and the combat begins. Each player deals or absorbs damage (melee or ranged) based on the connected pandas of the same type. The last player standing, wins!

—description from the publisher

name: 365 Adventures: Cthulhu 1926
publisher: Sorry We Are French; asmodee; Devir; Galakta; Pandasaurus Games; Pegasus Spiele
description:
In the shadows of the ancient buildings and cobbled streets of Arkham, a city consumed by mysteries and age-old secrets, private detective John Miller finds himself confronted with unspeakable horrors. Rumors of inhuman creatures and dark cults are multiplying. Armed with his flashlight, a pistol, and his determination, John is prepared to delve into the darkness to unveil the horrors that lurk there.

365 Adventures: Cthulhu 1926 is a unique experience that combines a calendar and an adventure game, allowing you to embark on a cosmic year-long investigation! Day after day, guide your detective through the dark alleys of Arkham, exploring hidden secrets and confronting occult cults devoted to the Great Old Ones. Keep track of your monthly score, and unlock new rules and occult artifacts as you progress. You need only five minutes maximum each day to play:


     Move your investigator.
     Roll your dice up to three times.
     Choose an encounter to defeat.


At the end of the month, manage your madness, note your score, and advance to the next month, where new atmosphere text and a new rule await you.

—description from the publisher

name: Keyside
description:
Keyside takes place on a busy island with 12 harbours and a myriad of ‘quays’.

Each player controls a team of 18 workers, known as ‘keyples’, who will work in the farms, harbours, markets, quarry, wheat fields, and woods. Players use their 6 dice to either direct the boats to their chosen harbours or to join the other players on their turns and, in both cases, set their team of keyples to work.

Once the dice are played (phase 1), then the harbours are activated (phase 2) and players gain actions and resources where their keyples are present.

After three rounds (years), players score points depending on where their keyples are located, most notably in the harbours, and from the cottages, houses, and headlands they have built and from skills they have collected.

The player with the most points wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: 365 Adventures: The Dungeon – 2026
publisher: Sorry We Are French; Devir; Galakta; MTS Games; Pandasaurus Games; Pegasus Spiele
description:
Whispers of a dark force deep within the dungeon, the master of the undead, spread fear throughout the villagers. That's why Mira, armed with her magic, her bow and an unshakeable will, sets out into the dungeon. She knows that only by conquering these horrors can she bring peace to her homeland.

365 Adventures – The Dungeon 2026 is a unique experience that cleverly combines a calendar and an adventure game for 2026. This 2026 Dungeon brings new rules to discover !

Day after day, guide Mira through the Dungeon, exploring each floor and confronting the shackled undead and unexpected surprises. Keep track of your monthly score, upgrade your gear with magical items and unlock new rules as you progress.

You only need 5 minutes maximum each day to play.


     Move your hero to the current day
     Roll your dice up to 3 times
     Choose a monster of the week to fight


At the end of the month, note down your score and move on to the next month, where a new atmosphere text and a new rule await you.

—description from the publisher

name: Khlor
description:
The legendary dragon needs help. 
Demons threaten her egg and you are the chosen ones to protect it.
Fly through the valley catching demons and nesting in peaceful lands to restore the dragon empire.
The best of you will become the next guardian of Khlor.

The game will progress in turns. 
On your turns, you must always catch three Demon Tokens using a Polyomino. You can also remove a Dragon Egg and/or lay new ones
At the end of the game, you get Aura Points if you have caught the most, or second-most Demon Tokens of a color. 
Act wisely to make those colors give you as many Aura Points as possible!

name: Khromanima: Jeu de Deck-Building
description:
Watch your legion grow in strength as the battle unfolds! Plan ahead of enemy assaults, power up, and emerge triumphant to assert your dominance!

Objective: Outlast all rivals and be the last one standing.

Mechanics: Tame Animas to build your Deck, optimize your strategy, engage in thrilling clashes against other players, and emerge as the ultimate survivor! By assembling 4 Animas around your Core, you can unleash the power of the Khroma and inflige devastating blows upon your opponents.

—description from the publisher

name: Kick Off Deluxe
description:
Challenge your friends to Kick Off, the football card game that simulates the actions of a real match. Just like in football, based on actions built to get to the shot, Kick Off will allow you to score goals through combination of cards. The mixing of these two mechanisms, choosing the right cards to play with unpredictable reactions makes for a tense and engaging game. The Deluxe edition provides a multitude of new options, cards, and variant, which provide players with new paths to victory.

Match the cards to shoot, score a goal and get the famous Poker, that is, 4 goals. Each player will be able to choose the best cards to get to the shot, trying not to let the action be intercepted by the opponent. The player who starts the action is the Attacker, while the other is the Defender.
