The playable offensive cards are Action Cards and Special Cards, and each of them increases the opportunity to play the Shot Card and score a goal. Each offensive card corresponds to one or more defense cards which allow the defender to recover the ball and become the new attacker, as if a counterattack were triggered. To get to the Shot, the Attacker must play 3 cards consecutively without being intercepted by the Defender. To avoid the goal, the Defender can play the Block Card and start the action again as the new Attacker. Kick Off also allows you to combine Action Cards and Special Cards to create lethal actions. Each Special Card allows the Attacker to get to the shot more easily and, in some cases, to bypass the opponent’s ability to intercept cards.

—description from the publisher

name: Ace of Spades
description:
Your path of vengeance has led you to Sweet Haven, Arizona. You know that the necromancer who has ruined your life has taken over the cemetery as his base of operations and you are going to finish him off at all costs. You face Lord Overkill, a supernatural being, but your prowess as a gambler goes beyond sleight of hand.

Channel your magic through poker plays to take out Lord Overkill's minions one by one and descend into Hell itself to duel the monster who ruined your life.

Ace of Spades is a single-player game, or a two-player game if you prefer to play it in co-op mode, that uses poker mechanics to resolve dangerous duels against the worst spawns from Hell.

—description from the publisher

name: Kilia
description:
Kiel, Germany — the lively port city on the Baltic Sea — is the starting point for a project of the century: a canal from the Baltic Sea to the North Sea!

As influential citizens of the city in Kilia, you participate in the construction of the canal...while trying to make a little more profit than the competition. Improve your ships, accept lucrative contracts, influence the most important people on the city council: there are numerous ways to achieve your goals, but only those who use their influence in several places can ultimately win!

On each turn, you play only one card, but whether you use it to procure goods, exert influence, or build on the canal is entirely up to you! Every card can be used anywhere, but what will bring you victory this time?

name: Kinfire Council
description:
Kinfire Council is a competitive game of strategy and politics. As a member of the Council, you've been charged with rebuilding the great city of Din'Lux and defending it from the dangers of the Starless Nights.

Take turns sending your workers to collect resources, upgrade buildings, and construct new Kinfire lighthouses in the surrounding area, while the Cult of Altan interferes with your plans and undermines your authority. You'll vote on important city policies, arrest cultists, and dispatch your Seeker to thwart threats looming over the final bastion of civilization, the great city of Din'Lux.

While you vie for power among yourselves, you also track the Cult's progress. If they win the game, then the Cult Conspirator ends up being the victor.  Will you be a benevolent leader, working together with your fellow Council members, or will your plans take a more sinister turn?

—description from the publisher

name: King and Peasant
description: An asymmetrical 2-player 18-card microgame in which one plays the king and the other the peasants. The peasants are unhappy with the king and have employed an assassin to "retire" him. The king has found out about the plot. He must try to protect himself and catch the assassin before he is taken by surprise.

name: King Arthur's Curse
description:
King Arthur's Curse is an escape game with maximum freedom and fun. You can combine any cards, carve your own path, and choose your own ending. The puzzles are logical, the game mechanics are unique, and the stakes couldn't be higher!

In King Arthur's Curse, the cards function like a "choose your own adventure book", providing page numbers to lead the adventure.  The first few cards have a dual purpose of explaining the game and game mechanics - which eliminates a rule book.  The game end and win conditions will depend on player's choices during the game.

Disclaimer: I am a solo designer, making a little game for fun. I have used AI to make the artwork, as it is just not feasible to hire a real artist at my scale, and I couldn't draw to save my life. Only the artwork has been made with AI though. All the puzzles, the game mechanics, the graphic design and the whole storyline have been handcrafted with love. I even wrote the code myself for the digital game, which I guess is considered old school nowadays. If you're against AI, I respect that, this game won't be for you. If you can get past that though, you can enjoy a fun escape game with some unique game mechanics!

Try the digital demo (link below), it's completely free, and that'll give you a good feel for the game. Enjoy! ❤️

name: Kingdom Builder: Family & Friends Compact Edition
description:
This is the new compact version of the Spiel des Jahres of 2012 that might be smaller in size but actually offers more variety than the original game!

Instead of 8 game board sections there are only 4 now - usable on both sides for putting together the play area. The location tiles are not fixed to one game board section but can be put on any board, giving people more options during setup.

—description from the publisher

name: All Aboard!
description:
"We sink!" shouts the elephant, “That mouse is too heavy!” "Don't worry!" whispers the lion, "If I eat the giraffe, we can lose a little weight."

In All Aboard! you must get your gang of animals to safety in the different boats, but be careful not to exceed their capacity, or else they will sink. Designed by Paco Yánez and illustrated by Monsuros, this fun card game can be played as a couple or in groups of up to 5 players, from 7 years old, in games lasting about 20 minutes.

Before starting, each player receives a set of 12 cards with the 12 different animals in the game (mouse, peacock, fox, octopus, monkey, sloth, elk, zebra, giraffe, lion, bear and elephant). The game is played over 4 rounds and each one consists of two phases: boarding the boats and setting sail. In the boarding phase, players will place one of the animals face up in any of the boats, taking into account that there can be no more than 3 animals in each one. In the second turn, they will place a new animal in any of the available boats, but this time face down; Finally, in the third turn a third animal will board the available boats, again face up.

At the beginning of the setting sail phase, all animal cards that have been played face down are revealed and then a check is made to see if there are two or more animals of the same species. If there are 2, they both fall in love (and the players will receive points for it). If there are 3, they fight and the boat sinks. Next, the animals activate their effects and finally the sum of the weight of the animals on board the boat is checked. If the weight of the animals is equal to or less than the weight that the boat can withstand, the animals manage to set sail and will score at the end of the game. Each player takes their animals and places them in a pile of saved animals in their playing area. If, on the other hand, the boat sinks, the animals are discarded.

Knowing when to play each animal is one of the keys to the game. However, depending on how your rivals play the cards, unforeseen situations can arise on the ships. Each animal has its own power, which can unleash chaos or balance the scales. Will you be able to save as many animals as possible?

-description from the publisher

name: Kingdom of Dice
description:
Everyone wants to claim the crown of the Kingdom of Dice, but only one can! Roll the dice and take risks to rally powerful characters. And, if you have the most influential faction, you will be become the new monarch!

Players roll dice to achieve a valid result. If they succeed, they will place one of their markers on the board. At the end of each round, based on the positions of their markers, players will encounter kingdom inhabitants who grant points. At the end of the third round, the player with the most points wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Kingdom Reborn
description:
The land of Miralune stands at the dawn of a new era, a time of renewal and transformation. For centuries, the realm was ravaged by bitter wars between powerful kingdoms, each vying for control, land, and resources. The scars of these conflicts ran deep, leaving the people weary and the landscape fractured. However, after decades of strife, the warring factions, devastated by constant wars, have finally come to a fragile peace, signing a historic treaty that has brought an end to the violence. Now, with the ink still fresh on the accord, the people of Miralune look forward to a new beginning, as the golden age of prosperity dawns upon them.
    
Citizens of the warring factions, recognizing the unique opportunity before them, have decided to unite in a way that has never been done before. Rather than continuing to live in isolated territories, they have pledged to build a perfect empire—an unparalleled beacon of harmony, culture, and advancement—where settlers from every kingdom, of every race and creed, will live together in unity. It will be a place where innovation and tradition coexist, where knowledge and artistry are celebrated, and where a new generation of Miralune’s people will forge their shared destiny. A new island that will become the start of the empire was discovered. At the centre of the landmass, travelers discovered a giant magical crystal that could in the future become a hub for transport across the whole Miralune.
    
Kingdom Reborn is a roll & write pattern building game where you divide the land of your future empire between the settlers of five different tribes.  You are tasked with creating the empire in a way that will fulfill the needs of settlers of various fantasy races and cultures. Divide the land for your future citizens and bring forth the era of peace to the land that only knew conflict.

—description from the publisher

name: Kingdoms Forlorn: Dragons, Devils and Kings
description:
Kingdoms Forlorn offers an immersive co-op and solo dungeon crawl adventure experience! Quest through a dark medieval fantasy world, through deep, innovatively-structured stories and endless rogue-lite delves! Customize your knight and play with your core group or pack up and take your knight to gaming groups around the world! Co-op, solo, wandering from campaign to campaign, following a story or venturing for unscripted legendary hunts, you decide how you play!

Over 150 hours of narrative gameplay, over a 1000 unique illustrations, dozens of unique, giant miniatures, hundreds of cards.

Tactical, escalating battles with bosses and mobs, strategic delves into forgotten kingdoms, deep cooperation with hard co-op, branching adventures and deep, personal narratives. Unscripted hunts and a soloperative experience that allows you to play with your knight anywhere with anyone, regardless of campaign and level differences.

name: Kingdoms: The Battle of Five Realms
description:
The Kingdoms in the Realms of Ëravor are in disarray.
But hope is not lost. For the prophecy tells, "as the world begins to fall, one will emerge... Destined to rule all."

Kingdoms: The Battle of Five Realms is a strategy-driven game of conquest, diplomacy, and survival set in the immersive, lore-rich world of Ëravor. It is a time of rising kingdoms and ancient magic, of cunning assassins and valiant defenders, where players battle for dominance in a land divided by treacherous terrain and unpredictable powers.

In Kingdoms, each player commands an army seeking to conquer territories, claim kingdoms, and rule realms. Players will strategically deploy forces, utilize powerful Kingdom and World Cards, and leverage the unique benefits and dangers of Ëravor’s diverse terrains. With every decision, they must balance offense, defense, and resource management to outwit their rivals and secure their place as the ultimate ruler.

Each player begins the game with their armies in reserve, a hand of Kingdom Cards, and the opportunity to shape their strategy based on the dynamic terrain and their opponents’ actions. The game is driven by a combination of tactical moves and card play: players place armies using coordinate cards, disrupt opponents with assassins and conquerors, or protect their forces with defenders and spells. Meanwhile, the map’s active terrains—forests, mountains, rivers, and more—offer both rewards and threats, keeping gameplay unpredictable and interactive.

Kingdoms rewards skill and planning over luck. While World Cards introduce variability through natural disasters, terrain benefits, and other events, players have tools to mitigate these risks with careful preparation. Combat is resolved through calculated choices, not random rolls, making every battle a test of strategy rather than chance.

Victory comes from ruling realms. To dominate a realm, players must conquer and defend 2 out of its 3 kingdoms by occupying key spaces and linking their armies to the kingdom. The path to victory is fraught with danger, as opponents can use their own armies, and magic to overturn even the most fortified kingdoms. Players must adapt their strategies to evolving threats, seize opportunities to expand their influence, and make critical decisions about when to attack, defend, or retreat.

From the treacherous Scorched Wood to the resource-rich Emerald Isles, each terrain offers unique opportunities for players to shape their paths to victory. The dynamic interplay of army movement, card play strategy, and terrain effects creates a deeply replayable experience that feels fresh every time.

Kingdoms: The Battle of Five Realms is a game of relentless competition, clever tactics, and thematic immersion. Will you rise as the ruler of Ëravor, or will your armies fall to the chaos of war?

—description from the publisher

name: Kingless: the Festival of Explosions
description:
The festival of explosions brings a new chaotic and explosive energy to the classic Kingless formula. We’ve focused on new fun mechanics, all tying into our crazy festival theme to elevate everything you loved about Kingless to the next level.

The new stand-alone sequel adds a new card type; attachments, you can place attachment cards on dwarfs and items to change their influence and add gaming-winning effects. You can use attachment cards to strengthen your board or to weaken your opponents.

We have also added 4 new actions; game, duel, swipe, and refresh. These actions give our players new and exciting ways to win the crown and most importantly, to make your friends the fool.

—description from the publisher

name: Asterix & Co.
publisher: Alis Games; CoolPlay; Devir; Grok Games; Matagot; No Loading Games; Pendragon Game Studio; Rexhry
description:
Play as Gauls, Romans and more! Players take turns playing as iconic characters from the ASTERIX series, aiming to Win Battles and Collect Sesterces.

Use unique character abilities and clever strategies, including using magic potions and slapping fish, to turn the tide of battle and be the first to reach 50 sesterces!

—description from the publisher

name: Kittens Love Sushi 2: Feeding Frenzy
description: This is not an expansion, but a self-contained game that functions as a sequel. In the first game, the goal was to collect the most kittens, in this one, you're dealt a starting hand of three kittens, and must keep them by playing sushi cards, the goal being to be the last player to have kittens left.

name: Knight Moves
description:
In Knight Moves, your village is under threat from nearby monsters and you are the only hope! Armed with only your sword and your courage, you venture into the monster’s dungeon to take out their big bad boss. But first you have to get through a series of rooms filled with his minions and traps. Luckily there are some treasures to find along the way that will help you in your mission! Use your actions to move, attack, capture treasures and health, as you escape from one room to the next until you reach the final battle.

Determine your best path using movement and action cards to attack enemies, collect treasure, and advance from one level to the next. But here’s the twist: You can only use one of the two action spaces on each card, so you’ll have to choose wisely!

Strike the perfect balance between defeating enemies to level up and get stronger and collecting treasures to improve your deck with better movements and actions. Both are crucial if you want to beat the boss monster that awaits you!

—description from the publisher

name: Covenant
description:
The Dwarven King has issued an order to the houses of each clan. It is imperative to reclaim Karrak-cüm-Kazar, the sacred mountain, ancestral home of the Dwarves since the first Age of the Beard. For too long it has been occupied by the poison of the dark lords, with their creatures defiling the halls that once housed the noblest of all Dwarves. The insult cannot last any longer. The Dwarves return to the mountain.

Covenant is played in turns over three ages. During their turn, players will assign the Dwarves of their clan to different tasks that will allow them to explore the ancient halls of the ancestors and drive out their enemies while rebuilding their ancestral home. Your dwarf tokens and tools will allow you to do all kinds of actions: dig into the mountain, defeat the enemies that live there, and build all kinds of buildings that will bring the legendary dwarf city back to life. At the end of the game, the clan that has accumulated the most glory will take the recognition of the monarch and the victory.

—description from the publisher

name: Knights Over Stalingrad
description:
Knights Over Stalingrad is primarily a Solitaire Game, but can be played by two opponents, with one side playing the Axis units during combat and the other the Soviets.
 The game models the Air Combat in and around Stalingrad immediately following the encirclement of the Sixth Army following the highly successful Soviet Operation Uranus.  Operation Uranus kicked off on November 17th, 1942 and totally encircled the German 6th Army with the capture of Karpovka on November 24th, 1942.  The game continues through the Soviet Tormosin Offensive (Battle of the Chir River Bridgehead), Manstein’s German Counter Offensive (Operation Winter Thunderstorm), Soviet Little Saturn (that crushed the Italians and defeated the remaining Romanian resistance), and the Soviet Deep strikes at Tazinskaya and Morosovsky Airfields.  Overall, the game covers the time period of November 23rd through December 28th, 1942.

On the Axis side the player will have the choice of controlling German Bf 109G’s, Bf 110’s, Romanian IAR 80’s, or Romanian Bf 109E’s.  A Soviet player will have the option of controlling 1 of 6 IAP’s assigned to the Stalingrad area, featuring; Yak-1’s, LaGG-3’s, La-5’s, or Yak-7b’s.  
Axis Ju-52 transports and He 111 bombers will attempt to make their way through Soviet fighters and flak to airfields inside the Cauldron in an attempt to supply the German 6th Army.  Dive Bombers, Ground Attack aircraft, and bombers on both sides (Ju-87’s, IL-2’s, Pe-2’s, A-20’s, and more) will attempt to engage ground forces following their historic tracks, while fighters duel overhead.  Horrific losses were incurred by both sides, as some of the greatest Aces of WWII faced off in grueling air-to-air combat.

The player chooses the campaign’s duration, either 10 or 15 Missions, or they can play the entire Campaign from November 23rd through December 27th, 1942.  The player draws Squadron specific Mission Cards to determine the objective of each mission, some Mission Cards are date specific to highlight important battles and/or events.  The player’s flight moves across a historical map grid that encompassed the territory covered by Operations Uranus and Little Saturn, including Stalingrad and the Cauldron.  Combat is executed using an “Initiative Track” for up to three rounds of combat, where pilot skill, aircraft performance, Dogfight Cards, and most importantly – player decisions, all come into play to determine the outcome.

Can you keep your squadron together, will you be successful enough to keep up their fighting spirit in the face of such daunting foes?

—description from the designer

name: Deep Dreams
description:
Little Bruno has gone to sleep and will travel during the night between dreams. Our mission as dream guardians is to keep him immersed in the most pleasant dreams and assure us that he wakes up as little as possible during the night.

The goal in Deep Dreams is to score points playing and connecting dream cards, that show the four colors of the dream. You will need to create the largest color groups connected to score victory points, while making sure Bruno doesn't wake up by drawing a continuous path with the white lines and arrows through the cards. Some dream cards got powerful effects that will help players to get better combinations. And at the end, the longest path will have the greatest reward. Get ready to enter the world of dreams and ensure that Bruno has a quiet and peaceful night.

—description from the publisher

name: Know Thyself
description:
www.knowthyself.space

Know Thyself is a bold, original, and deeply human 60-minute transformative experience disguised as a game.

Designed for 2–4 players, Know Thyself uses universal personality archetypes to spark introspection, emotional honesty, and some of the most meaningful conversations players will ever have around a table. It is not about winning — it is about seeing and being seen.

Each round, players draw an archetype card representing a core human trait — such as Idealist, Provocateur, Caregiver, Rebel, or Visionary. Players then cast secret votes from 1 to 5, rating how strongly they believe themselves and each other embody that trait.

Votes are revealed one by one.

What follows is the heart of the game: players explain why they voted as they did — sharing stories, observations, blind spots, and moments of unexpected insight. Conversations naturally deepen. Assumptions are challenged. Laughter, vulnerability, and powerful emotional shifts emerge organically.

100% five-star reviews. Backed by nearly 2,000 supporters on Kickstarter. The game has been described by players as “a masterpiece," “unlike anything else on the market” and “the most meaningful game experience we’ve ever had.”

Beyond the tabletop, Know Thyself has attracted interest for use in therapy, marriage counselling, group facilitation, rehabilitation and prison reform, and other social and reflective settings.

Know Thyself is an entirely original concept, never previously attempted in modern board gaming:a game that replaces competition with reflection, strategy with empathy, and turns play into a mirror.

Pick up the game at www.knowthyself.space

name: Koboldjäger
description:
The kobolds have escaped, and guess who gets to recapture them? That's right: YOU! Are you ready to save Aventuria? If you want to become a kobold hunter, you need strong friends, the right equipment, and a generous dose of heroism. Do you have what it takes?

Chaos has broken out in Aventuria: a horde of malicious fiends has escaped from the secret lair of the legendary kobold hunter Egonimus Zittermoor. Kobolds and cunning monsters are wreaking havoc everywhere and turning everything upside down. Grab your sword, bow, and wand with your friends: the adventure begins!

Kobold hunter is a cooperative game in which you and your friends face cunning monsters together. By skillfully playing cards and with a little luck with the dice, you can defeat the fiends and lock them back into their magical jars.

Inspired by The Dark Eye.

—description from the publisher (translated)

Die Kobolde sind geflohen und rate mal, wer sie wieder einfangen darf? Genau: DU! Bist du bereit Aventurien zu retten? Wer Koboldjäger werden will, braucht starke Freunde, die richtige Ausrüstung und eine große Prise Heldenmut. Das bringst du mit? Perfekt!

In Aventurien ist das Chaos ausgebrochen: Aus dem Geheimversteck des legendären Koboldjägers Egonimus Zittermoor ist eine Horde boshafter Unholde entflohen. Überall treiben Kobolde und trickreiche Monster ihr Unwesen und stellen alles auf den Kopf. Schnappe dir mit deinen Freunden Schwert, Bogen und Zauberstab: Das Abenteuer beginnt!

Koboldjäger ist ein kooperatives Spiel, bei dem du dich gemeinsam mit deinen Freunden trickreichen Monstern stellst. Durch geschicktes ausspielen von Karten und ein wenig Würfelglück, verkloppst du die Unholde und sperrst sie zurück in die magischen Einmachgläser.

Inspired by Das Schwarze Auge.

—description from the publisher

name: EXIT: The Game – Adventures on Catan
publisher: KOSMOS; 999 Games; Brädspel.se; Devir; Dino Toys s. r. o.; IELLO; Thames & Kosmos
description:
Times are rough, and life in your village is getting harder than you ever imagined it could be. One day, seafarers tell you about the beautiful and fertile island of Catan. The people speak with admiration about the lush vegetation and the variety of resources. Hoping for better times, you set off with a few friends to explore this new world and settle down there.

But in EXIT: The Game – Adventures on Catan, numerous challenges and mysteries await you on this adventurous journey. Perhaps you'll be able to trade with residents to build out the island and discover more resources? Will you succeed in building a new life in a foreign land?

name: Kolin 1757
description:
The SYW Battle Series (SYWBS) games are playable grand-tactical studies of battles of the Seven Years War. The series’ intent is to show how command operates on the battlefields, using the weapons and tactics of the period. The system emphasizes command & control and playability.

The games all share the following characteristics:
Scale = 200-220 m/hex (219-240 yrd/hex)
Time = 30 min/Turn
Counter = 1 Brigade, 1 Battalion, 1 to 3 Squadrons, 1 Battery, 1 Leader
Each unit's historical flag and uniform are displayed on Counters, Orders/organizational Displays, and Orders of battle (in Playbooks).

Kolin 1757 simulates the battle fought on the 18th of June 1757 in Bohemia, near Prague, during the Seven Years War. F.M. Graf Leopold Daun commanded the Austrian army, with a contingent of cavalry from Saxony: 53,790 men (51 bns, 43 grenadier coys, 158 sqns) and 162 guns in total. King of Prussia Frederick II the Great commanded the Prussian army: 34,000 men (33 bns, 116 sqns) and 94 guns.

—description from the designer

name: Komm zum Punkt
description:
Komm zum Punkt is a cooperative storytelling game in the tradition of one-word stories, in which each person in turn says exactly one word, gradually creating a sentence. The special twist: everyone but you knows the secret word. You have to find it out. The others must therefore help you to steer the resulting sentence in the right direction. The group can even start more sentences than just one. However, when it's your turn and you name the secret word and it fits into this part of the sentence, you have mastered a round and get points. Try to get as many points after a total of 8 rounds.

—description from the designer

name: Korea: The Fight Across the 38th
description:
On June 25, 1950, the North Korean People's Army advanced in force across the 38th parallel. Its mission: the forcible reunification of the Korean peninsula.

Trevor Bender's Korea: The Fight Across the 38th recreates the opening salvos of the Korean War. It is the third volume of the C3i Combined Arms Series, after Battle for Kursk: The Tigers are Burning, 1943 and Desert Victory: North Africa, 1940-1942. The series rules have been adapted to capture the ebb-and-flow of operations as well as the rugged terrain and the logistical challenges faced by each side.

Korea: The Fight Across the 38th is featured in C3i magazine nr. 38, which also includes: 

     The Siege of Cadiz 1625, a solitaire design by Daniel Hernández Iniesta
     Battle for Moscow, a re-issue of Frank Chadwick's classic


Game scale
Units: Division
Map: 1 hex = 25 miles
Turns: One month
Playing Time: 2 to 3 hours

—description from the publisher

name: Kouba
description:
Cards, dice, and backstabbing… Welcome to Kouba, a game of cunning where betrayal and unexpected twists are at the heart of every match! Here, honor has no place—only the most devious, daring, and ruthless players will have a chance to win.

In Kouba, players compete in a merciless tournament, where every duel can turn the tide of the game. Roll the dice, use your cards wisely, and trap your opponents before they outplay you. But beware… every defeat earns you a KOUBA, a penalty that brings you dangerously close to elimination. Collect four KOUBAs, and the round ends! It’s time to count victory points and prepare your next strategy.

Bluff, manipulate, and betray at the right moment, because here, anything goes! A simple smile can hide a trap, and your “allies” this turn might become your worst enemies in the next.
A fun, fast-paced, and ruthless game, perfect for those who love strategy, deception… and especially the thrill of betraying their friends with a smile! So, are you ready to play? Or rather… ready to betray?

—description from the designer

name: Krafting Krowns
description:
GAME DESCRIPTION
King Krowfell of Krystalia is dead and left no heir. Now it's time to claim the throne by crafting nine Power Krystals to forge the ultimate Krown!
In Krafting Krowns, players deploy dice strategically and manipulate their values using cards from six powerful Klans. Transform Raw Krystals (dice showing 1) into Power Krystals (dice showing 3) through clever combinations of Magic, Master, and Menace cards.
The game features three distinct phases that create a compelling gameplay loop: Gathering (competitive bidding for cards), Snatching (last-chance card acquisition), and Krafting (strategic dice manipulation).
What makes Krafting Krowns unique:

Three-phase gameplay cycle with competitive card bidding using dice as currency
Dual-purpose dice: bid for cards in Gathering, then manipulate them in Krafting
Resource tension: Every Power Krystal you craft reduces your bidding power for future rounds
Self-balancing gameplay: Early leaders face disadvantages in later rounds, keeping games competitive
Immediate victory: Win the moment you place your 9th Power Krystal

VITAL STATS
Player Count: 2-4 players
Playing Time: 30 minutes to 90 minutes
Age: 14+
Complexity: Medium
COMPONENTS:

54 Krafting cards (Magic, Master, Menace across 6 Klans)
36 custom 8-sided dice (9 per player)
6 Klan zone cards
4 Krown cards
3 Turn Marker cards
4 Reminder cards

Core Mechanics:

Dice Rolling & Manipulation
Hand Management
Auction/Bidding
Area Control
Take That

THE SIX KLANS
Master the powers of six distinct magical factions, each with their own Klan zone:

SINGING SIRENS SHORE - Mystical shore dwellers with enchanting abilities
CURSED HUMANS CITY - Resilient village inhabitants with determined spirit
GRAVE UNDEAD YARD - Graveyard dwellers wielding dark powers
ELEMENTAL SPIRITS MOUNTAIN - Elemental mountain forces
MYSTIC FAERIES FOREST - Forest mystics channeling nature's magic
UNSACRIFICEABLE GOATS FIELDS - The stubborn guardians of the realm

GAME FLOW
The game cycles through three phases until a winner emerges:
Gathering Phase: Roll dice one at a time to bid on face-up and face-down cards. Rolling a 3 wins instantly, or accumulate dice totaling 3+. Dice on lost cards become "burnt" and unavailable until Krafting.
Snatching Phase: Re-roll idle dice for a final chance at remaining cards. Choose which dice to keep and which to re-roll, then place them strategically on remaining cards.
Krafting Phase: First allocate all dice to Klan zones (starting value: 1), then play cards to manipulate dice values. Combine Magic cards (flip to 2) with Master cards (add +1) to create Power Krystals. Menace cards disrupt opponents or provide tactical advantages.
Cards carry over between sessions, creating long-term planning opportunities and resource management decisions.

DESIGNER NOTES
"Krafting Krowns emerged from our desire to create a game where dice serve multiple strategic purposes. The dual-resource system means every decision ripples through multiple phases—aggressive bidding wins cards but leaves fewer dice for future rounds.
The self-balancing mechanism naturally prevents runaway victories. Players who craft Power Krystals early have fewer dice for subsequent Gatherings, while conservative players maintain stronger card acquisition potential. Victory goes to whoever best manages the delicate balance between immediate gains and future opportunities."
—Stefano Virgilli & Ernestas Jasilionis

PERFECT FOR

Players seeking meaningful decisions with dice manipulation
Groups that enjoy competitive bidding and resource management
Fans of tactical card play with "take that" elements
Game nights needing something fresh that plays in under an hour
Anyone who appreciates hand-crafted artwork (no AI art here!)

Launched at SPIEL Essen with the magical kingdom of Krystalia awaiting its next ruler. Crown not included, but glory guaranteed!

name: Krampusnacht: The Naughty List
description:
As St. Nicholas’s companions, players compete to see who can capture (or sacrifice) the most, and the naughtiest children. Characters use their strengths, upgrades, and action cards to help them capture the worst kids in town. The worse their behavior, the more points they are worth. Whoever has the most points when either the town is filled with nice kids, or when a Kid would need to be replaced, but there are none left in the deck, is the winner.

Pick a companion, receive their card and accessories. Shuffle the "kids" deck and place 6 upright to create the "Town," placing any nice kids to the side until the Town is full of naughty kids. Shuffle the Actions deck and deal three to each player.

Each turn is a Draw Phase, Play Cards Phase (as many as you can), Capture Phase to get kids in your sack, and watch out for St. Nicholas!!!

—description from the publisher

name: Fritanga
description:
Set in the Blind Business universe, Fritanga is a game for cooking lovers where the playing area is - a fryer! Players take control of various foods and try to survive at all costs, jumping from one side of the fryer basket to the other. When a player cannot move, they fall into the boiling oil, being fried, and (unfortunately) eliminated from the game. You must use all the cards you collect to survive and not become deliciously battered.

Fritanga has three game modes: free-for-all, suitable for 3 to 7 players; the mode against the chef, a semi-co-operative version for groups of 3 to 7 players, in which one will be the chef and will try to fry the rest of the players; and team mode, in which two equal groups compete to win. Each game mode has a few different cards to tailor the experience.

After assembling the central board with cards, which represent spaces on the fryer grid, players begin their turns, which are divided into two phases: playing cards and moving. The first phase allows you to play as many cards as you want, with the aim of improving the position in the fryer or annoying and attacking your rivals. The second phase allows you to move 1-2 cards away. At that moment, the card you reached is revealed, then either an effect is triggered or you can claim that card to use it later.

—description from the publisher

name: Kudos
description: In this fast-paced card game, the first player to get rid of all their cards wins! How? By making color and shape associations with the cards arranged clockwise in the middle of the table to achieve a perfect match. Kudos is a simple family card game in which associations and attacks are decisive for victory.

name: KUGO
description:
KUGO is a flick based dexterity game made out of all-natural, solid wood. But this isn't just one game. This is a box to make lots of games, You can create minute long flip tricks or trick shots or sets up longer team-based games like "Capture the Flag" or "KUGO K.O." And you even create your very own games!

KUGO gameplay centres around a saucer-shaped disc that we call "The Puck". Flick the puck through tricks, games and obstacles. It's that simple, if you can flick, you can play.

Built for all ages, built to last, use the pieces in the box to build games, create tricks and unleash your imagination in a world of flick-based fun!

—description from the designer

name: Kuldhara
description:
STORY:
The once-magnificent Kuldhara used to be a prosperous village in northern India. However, once it's Grand Vizier began making cruel and unrealistic demands of its people, threatening the village's destruction ... its inhabitants decided to raze Kuldhara themselves. The buildings burned, its riches scattered to the sands, and its people disappeared into the desert without a trace. Now Kuldhara is said to be a ghost town, where its former inhabitants roam the nights as specters … however, many of its treasures are still lost in the surrounding desert.

As an intrepid treasure hunter, your goal is to find Kuldhara's lost gemstones, load them up on your trusty camel, and head back to base camp to forge them into valuable jewellery. The days stretch long in the desert, but watch the sun's position carefully - because once night falls, the spirits of Kuldhara will rise again!

GAMEPLAY:
A full game of Kuldhara lasts 4 rounds, corresponding to one full 'day'. Every round, players replenish their water which is used to perform different actions; such as traveling with their camel through the desert, digging up gems in the ruins, and taking their gemstones back to basecamp. Each turn is fast and simple, with only 1 or 2 actions taken per player before they begin organizing collected stones on their personal workbench to craft jewellery.  When the active player has created the pattern displayed on the jewellery card, they can craft it, trading in the gemstones in exchange for taking the card and earning points. Not only that, but certain cards can grant 'protection tiles' which allow gemstones to be reused multiple times - meaning that through smart planning and a bit of luck, a player could even make 2 or 3 pieces of jewellery at once!

As the rounds progress, the position of the sun also changes - meaning that the traveling routes will change in cost over the course of a game. So you'll need to plan out your water usage carefully, in order to make the strongest amulets through well places combos on your own personal workbench. Ultimately, the player with the most points will win.

Kuldhara also comes with a dedicated Solo mode; a custom board and deck of cards for Kadhan, a spectre in Kuldhara. His turns are easy to run and have multiple difficulty levels, and almost always ends in close games where the final round really matters!

name: Kuroshio
description:
The Kuroshio is a warm Pacific current flowing northward from the equator past Taiwan to Japan. Its clear waters appear dark under the sunlight, and its swift flow attracts migratory and large predatory fish, making it a vital pillar of East Asia’s fisheries.
In this game, players take the role of fishing boats operating along the Kuroshio, gradually expanding the routes of fish schools on the table by playing cards, and catching marlins, mahi-mahi, and tuna to score points.

—description from the designer

name: Jungo
publisher: Cocktail Games; Broadway Toys LTD; Devir; Ghenos Games; Happy Baobab; Happy Camper; Hobby World; MIPL; PaperGames (III); Rebel Sp. z o.o.; Reflexshop; Rexhry
description:
Jungo is a hand-building game in which you try to be the first player to get rid of your cards.

From a deck of 64 cards, with eight copies each of 1-8, players get a hand of cards that they cannot rearrange. The starting player leads a card or set of cards with the same value — but they can play multiple cards only if the cards are adjacent to one another in their hand. If cards have been played on the table, to play you must play the same number of cards with a higher value or a larger set of cards, e.g., 2 < 5 < 3,3 < 6,6 < 2,2,2 < 1,1,1,1. When you overplay someone, you can pick up the cards you beat and add them to your hand where you wish, or you can discard them.

If you cannot or choose not to play, you must pass, drawing a card from a facedown pile; some cards have two values on them, e.g., 1/2 or 5/6, and can be played as either number. You either add this card to your hand where you wish, discard it, or — calling on the law of the "jungo" — play it immediately as part of a combination from your hand that beats what's on the table.

If all but one player pass, clear the table, with the player who last played leading to an empty table.

Whoever first empties their hand wins! Alternatively, since the game is short, play multiple rounds, with the first player to win two rounds winning the game.

name: Käpt'n Memo
description:
PORT, STARBOARD … OR off BOARD?!

With the power of their own memories, 2-5 sailors defy all dangers and salvage valuable treasures from the depths of the Memorian Sea.
All sailors on board! Captain Memo has the helm of the ship firmly in his hands. And because everyone takes over his role from time to time, his course manoeuvres may be best remembered, but not always in a good way.
Treasures lie dormant in the sea between reefs and giant squid. If the captain succeeds in lifting five of them per voyage, the sailors are happy too. However, if his nautical manoeuvres become too tricky for them, clever sailors leave the ship – or even call for mutiny, only to do much better as captain themselves … or not …

—description from the publisher

name: L'oaf
description:
A card game about collectively baking bread, while trying to let the others do the work.

You’re all employees in the L’Oaf bakery, but you’re just here to get paid with as little effort as possible. When it gets to baking bread, you rather let others do the work.  However, you don’t want the bosses to catch you loafing. If you collectively don’t bake enough bread, the lazy among you might just get fired!

Every round, players get an order with the amount of bread they collectively need to bake. Each baker secretly contributes a work card from their hand of cards, valued 0 through 11.  Failing to meet the order means the baker who contributed the least loses reputation with the bosses.

Otherwise, the baker who contributed the most will gain reputation. Once 5 orders have failed or 5 orders have succeeded, the baker with the most value left in their hand wins the game. However, if the group failed 5 orders, all bakers with a negative reputation are fired before scoring!

–description from the publisher

name: La Bataille de Kulm, August 29-30, 1813
description:
A new addition to the "La Bataille" series of Napoleonic battles, this game covers the dramatic 1813 Battle of Kulm. Following Napoleon's victory at Dresden, he ordered several columns to close in and try to capture the fleeing Allied armies. French General Vandamme commanded a corp full of conscripts and tried to "bag" the Allies around a series of villages, the largest being Kulm. But Vandamme ended up being swallowed by the retreating Prussian and Austrian troops and lost most of his corps, including being captured himself.

The defeat flipped the entire campaign and set up Napoleon's big loss later at Leipzig.

This intriguing battle is presented in the full "La Bataille" style, following the same production techniques as La Bataille de Vauchamps.

Time, map and unit scale, from the rules:

1.1.1 Each complete turn represents approximately 20 minutes of real time.
1.1.2 Each hex is approximately 100 meters across.
1.1.3 Each Increment point is equal to approximately 100 infantry men, 50 cavalry men (with mounts), or 4 artillery cannons.

IMPORTANT ERRATA (dated October 16, 2025):
13.7.2 (correction) When units advance into a vacated hex, they must maintain the same facing and formation (if multiple units in different facings and/or formations, only one must advance).

name: La Bataille de Lauban, 1945
description:
Launched on January 12, 1945, the Vistula-Oder offensive turned into an overwhelming victory in a few days. 
After a 600 km ride, the first Soviet armored points reached the Oder, the last major natural obstacle before Berlin... 
From the end of January, in order to cover Zhukov in charge of the main effort towards Berlin, Koniev's 1st Ukrainian Front began its offensive in Silesia. After the encirclement of Breslau, Rybalko and his 3rd Guards Tank Army advanced westward on February 16 with the objectives of taking Görlitz and Lauban, but were held in check by local forces. From February 25, the German high command considered counterattacking. The objective is twofold. First, on the military level, re-establish the defense of the Oder by striking the enemy's flanks and on the political level, the sector seemed conducive to a welcome success in the catastrophic context of February 1945. 
Operation Gemse – a classic pincer movement around Lauban – engaged two Panzerkorps and began on March 1.
Operation Gemse 1945 simulates the Soviet attack on Lauban and the subsequent German counterattack.


     Game turn: 2 days
     Units : batalion, regiments and brigades
     One hexagon = 2 km
     Complexity: 5/10
     Solitaire: 7/10
     Length of a game: approximately 3-4 hours 


—description from the publisher

name: La conquête de la Hongrie, 1526
description:
The seventh game of the Gold & Steel series, La Conquête de la Hongrie, 1526 is an Operational level historical simulation featuring one of the numerous Ottoman attempts to conquer the Kingdom of Hungary which conducts to the famous battle of Mohacs, August 29, 1526, where the army of Suleyman The Magnificent will slaughter most of the Hungarian army, their allies army and their King Laszlo II.

One player plays the role of the Hungarian Kingdom and its allies (Transylvania/Walachia,  Croatia, Moldavia, Poland-Lithuania, Germany, Bohemia) the other player plays the Ottoman Empire and its allies (Serbia, Bosnia, Crimean Khanate).
The objectives are to take control of the different territories (Pest, the main capital), to win pitched battles or major sieges, to eliminate units, leaders and the King!
This is both a strategic & tactical game with garrisons and armies evolving on the main strategic map showing the Balkan countries and units fighting on a tactical map featuring a typical XVIth century battleground.
Christians units are gendarmes (heavy cavalry), hussars (light cavalrymen), mounted archers, arquebusiers, bowmen, militia, pikemen, sword & bucklers  and cannons. The Ottoman units are Janissaries, Sipahis (medium cavalry), Kapikulu (heavy cavalry), mounted arches, militia from Anatolia and Roumelia and many cannons.
The ambience of that period is added with tactical chits with specific application for the fights – shooting and close-combat – (cavalry charge in line od deep ranks, bulwark shield, fight to death, waggonberg (enchained chariots), cannon battery, cannon fires, feint, arrows harassment, surround) and events such as rain, disagreement between chefs, betrayal, janissaries mutiny, ineffective artillery…
This a medium to high complexity 2 players game. One turn is 2 weeks, and the game is played in 12 turns, 120 minutes of play.

The complete sequence of a turn:
I/ Ottoman Empire
1) Reinforcement, replacement, withdrawal, recruitment
2) Strategic move
3) Attrition phase
4) Combat phase (battles & sieges)
II/ Hungarian Kingdom
 Same sequence
III/ Diplomatic phase
 Change of alliance
 Check for victory

—description from the designer

name: La Cour de Versailles
description:
La Cour de Versailles ("The Court of Versailles") is a historical drafting and collecting game set in the era of Louis XIV.

You are a young nobleman or woman who has just arrived in Versailles. Your goal is to join the King's Court and achieve the greatest renown by expanding your circle of friends to include increasingly high-ranking individuals. In this way, you're sure to win the favor of Louis XIV!

Choose the Character card from your hand that will enter your very select circle of friends, then give all the other cards to your neighbor on the left. Nine rounds will be enough to determine who has the greatest fame!

—description from the designer

name: La Cuenta
description:
In La Cuenta ("The Bill") you go tapas bar hopping with your little group.

At each bar someone will have to pay the bill - try not to be you! Inevitably, someone will run out of money. When that happens, whoever has the most money left wins.

Each bar you visit is represented by a round, and each round consists of an indeterminate number of turns (orders you place in the kitchen). In each turn, the player in turn must play 1 card from their hand.

If you cannot play 1 card in your turn, you must ask for the bill. Whoever has paid the bill starts the next round. If you start a round and cannot play any cards, discard your entire hand, re-draw your maximum cards and start again.

The game is over when someone runs out of savings. Immediately the winner is the one with the most savings. In case of a tie, whoever has the most actual money on them wins.

—description from the publisher

name: La Der des Ders: The War to End War
description:
La Der des Ders is a game that lets you relive the First World War at a strategic level, with each player controlling one of the two sides - the Entente or the Central Powers.

La Der des Ders can also be played solo, thanks to dedicated rules: the player then takes on the role of the side he wishes, while the “system”, called Athena, is their virtual opponent.

Each turn, players are awarded Resource Points, which they can allocate to different areas (reinforcements, technological research, offensives) to guide their overall strategy.

Victory is achieved by launching powerful offensives that sap the morale of enemy nations, forcing them out of the conflict. But each battle will also cost the attacker dearly.

One game turn is equivalent to four months of real time. A game can last up to 14 turns, unless the war is won – or lost - before then, or peace talks have started.

Historical events punctuate the games, allowing you to relive the historical unfolding of the First World War.

The rest is up to you!

—description from the designer

name: La Fleur
description:
Grandeur, love, and flowers! La Fleur is a strategy board game where you take on the role of a French Rococo garden enthusiast as you build your château, host garden parties, and gain prestige to hold the greatest of all garden gatherings, the Grande Soirée. Each player begins the game as one of a multitude of characters with a château that is rather, well....plain and empty. How will you ever attract visitors to your château and build your reputation if there are no fountains to admire, no paths to wander, and, most importantly, no flowers!

Each round you will send your artisans to different parts of Paris to acquire floral beauties, hire additional help, earn coins, commission new garden features for your château, and do many other things that artisans generally do. But be quick! Resources each round are limited, and the first artisan to each location gets their pick of the crème de la crème. Each round ends with a garden party, where visitors from across the globe come to shower you with prestige and opportunity. Be wary of your neighbors, though! If their château is more attractive than yours, some visitors may be more enticed to attend your neighbor’s garden party than yours. Sacrebleu! As word of the beauty of your competing châteaus spreads, more and more visitors will flock to your gardens. When one player gains enough Prestige, all players add their bonuses from their objectives and garden features, and the player with the most Prestige is declared the Host of the Grande Soirée!

—description from publisher

name: La Garde Veille!
description:
La Garde Veille! (The Guard is on Watch!) is a Tactical level original module for the Jours de Gloire series, set at battalion scale, inserted in VaeVictis magazine #178.

It covers Guard’s actions during the Battle of Eylau. The first scenario cover 1st Battalion of Grenadiers à pied regiment against a Russian column approaching Eylau’s cimetary and village. The second one is dedicated to the charge of the Grenadier à cheval regiment at the end of the famous Murat’s cavalry charge.

The scale is 100 m per hexagon and one Strength Point corresponds to about 200 infantry, 150 cavalry or 2 guns. The game includes two maps, one per scenario. The game lenghth is 4 or 5 turns, each covering 15 minutes of real time. A game of La Garde veille! should last around 1 hour.

—description from the designer

name: La guerre de Cent Ans
description:
The Hundred Years' War was a highly complex conflict in terms of its duration, the many players involved and the succession of wars and truces over a very long period of 116 years!

Chevauchee, pitched battles, sieges, ambushes, looting, assassinations and betrayals were all part of the story. So it was a challenge to simulate this complex, non-linear war. Few games exist on this subject. We chose to design the game on a strategic scale, while maintaining its excellent playability.

Choices had to be made, and not all the details dear to historians will be there, but you'll be immersed in the medieval atmosphere and feel the epic breath of your rides in late medieval France.

La guerre de Cent Ans ("The Hundred Years' War") is designed for 2 to 4 players: with 4, each player takes control of one faction; with 2, each player takes control of both factions on the same side; with 3, one player takes control of both factions on one side, while the remaining players each take control of one faction on the other side.

name: Mindbug: Battlefruit Galaxy
publisher: Nerdlab Games; Devir; Game Harbor; Ghost Galaxy; IELLO
description:
Mindbug: Battlefruit Galaxy is a stand-alone game of Mindbug about Plum Marines protecting the Galaxy from the invasion of Eggplant Space Whales and Celery Sandworms. Activate the Octonite energy of your Scifi fruits and crush your opponent with their crazy abilities in a galactical food fight. Being a stand-alone game, Mindbug: Battlefruit Galaxy can be played on its own, or mixed with any other Mindbug set.

This new set introduces Octonite abilities allowing you to use your Octonite counters to activate extremely powerful abilities. It also introduces the Charge mechanic allowing you to distribute your Octonite counters on any creature(s). Discover insane card combos and spend your Octonite on the right creatures to win.

In Mindbug, you summon hybrid creatures and send them to battle against your opponent. But be careful: your opponent may use one of their Mindbugs to take control of it.

name: Mindbug: Battlefruit Kingdom
publisher: Nerdlab Games; Devir; Game Harbor; Ghost Galaxy; IELLO
description:
Mindbug: Battlefruit Kingdom is a stand-alone game of Mindbug about a Kingdom of Pineapple Paladins fighting the mighty Lychee King. Plant your fruit and vegetable creatures, protect them from your opponent, and Harvest their crazy abilities. Being a stand-alone game, Mindbug: Battlefruit Kingdom can be played on its own, or mixed with any other Mindbug sets.

This new set introduces the Harvest mechanic allowing you to trigger extremely powerful abilities a few turns after a creature is played. It also introduces the new FAST keyword allowing some creatures to attack the same turn it's played. Pressure your opponent and protect your creatures to harvest their rewards.

In Mindbug, you summon hybrid creatures and send them to battle against your opponent. But be careful: your opponent may use one of their Mindbugs to take control of it. Outwit your opponent in a fascinating tactical duel in which having the best cards and playing them at the wrong time can be deadly for yourself.

Mindbug combines the accessibility and fairness of a simple card game with the strategic depth of a complex Strategy Card Game. The result is a skill-based dueling card game that feels utterly different from all the other card games you have played before.

name: Ladybugs
description:
Ladybugs is a delightful family game set in a vibrant flower field. Each player guides a team of ladybugs, spreading their colorful presence across the blossoms. By strategically placing ladybugs on flowers, players aim to gain control of the most flourishing areas.

Who can position their ladybugs most cleverly and create the most dazzling display in the meadow?

—description from the publisher

name: Moirai
description:
The Moirai (often called The Three Fates in English) are goddesses from Greek mythology. They have set their spinning wheel in motion to weave the destiny of humankind. Clotho spins together the thread of life, Lachesis uses her rod to measure the lengths of that thread, and Atropos is in charge of deciding when to cut a soul’s thread.

As commanded by the three Moirai, the players must create a loom with cards in which various lives will be woven together. On their turn, players choose to keep a card or take an entire discarded pile and place all those cards in their loom. At the end of Moirai, the players score points according to the scoring criteria of Clotho, Lachesis, and Atropos cards. Whoever does the best wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Lands of Amazement
description:
Creating fun takes hard work! As an aspiring amusement park designer you’ll need to build your portfolio by designing smaller parks before you can take on a top-tier megapark.

Design amusement parks by creating patterns that match the park’s needs while saving a few ideas each year for your final design. Stick to the schedule and complete the megapark to the required specifications to succeed!

Each round, draw a card and add it to one of your parks. Place icons to create required patterns. Match a pattern perfectly to get a special effect!

Set aside cards over the course of the schedule to use in your megapark. The better you can match the megapark’s requirements, the better your score!

name: One Round?
description:
What do the terms "work" and "banana" have in common? Perhaps the word "farmer"? What about "harvest"? And where does "fruit" fit in?

In the co-operative party game One Round?, you need to close the gaps in the word circle — quickly! — in order to win. The game is played with one hundred numbered cards on which you can write. Initially, three starting cards with the numbers 33, 66 and 100/0 are laid out in a circle, and each is labeled with a freely chosen starting word. Twelve of the remaining cards are placed face down in the middle of the table; these must be placed in the correct place in the circle over the course of the game.

On your turn, secretly look at the number on the top card, then think of a word that indicates the card's position among the cards on display. This requires quick creativity because you have only a short amount of time before the other players have to agree on a gap in the circle of words based on the tip. The more cards are laid down, the closer the distances between the numbers become and the more difficult it is to classify new cards correctly.

If the team places the last card correctly before it loses its three life markers, everyone wins.

One Round? includes a team variant so that players can compete against one another in groups, in addition to 28 entertaining challenges and word categories.

name: Orloj: The Prague Astronomical Clock
publisher: Perro Loko Games; Bohemian Games; Devir; DiceTree Games; Engames; Frost Bite Games; Frosted Games; GaGa Games; Galakta; Tesla Games; Vagabund; WindFans Games
description:
From the heart of Prague’s Old Town, the ancient Astronomical Clock, known as the Orloj, marks the passage of time with its intricate mechanism and enigmatic figures. A marvel of medieval technology that has endured to this day.

In this game, you take on the role of a master builder competing to leave your mark on history by adding the legendary and majestic calendar to the ancient Orloj. Precision, balance, and knowledge of the cosmos will be the keys to completing this complex task.

With every gear, sphere, and zodiac sign you assemble, you will be one step closer to finishing this masterpiece that will mark time in the city for generations.

Each turn, players will place workers on the clock's dial to gain resources and perform actions with the goal of building the Orloj calendar. In addition to hiring assistants, during the game, players will construct the apostles' carillon and develop their knowledge across three tracks where experience will enhance their abilities.

The game will end when the calendar is completed. The player with the most harmony points will win the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Quorum
description:
The Roman Empire has spread over all the known world. Its civilization has expanded and is influential in all aspects of life, from trade and architecture to the power of its army and its political intrigues. The presence of the gods is made clear in the events of human lives.

In Quorum, the players take on the role of Roman senators who share the power of Rome and its provinces with the aim of acquiring the greatest amount of influence possible. The goal is to be the most powerful and influential senator by gaining victory points, which are awarded in various areas of influence over the twelve rounds of the game.

On their turn, players take and play a card in front of them to affect one of the provinces. The turns continue in this way until all the players have twelve cards in front of them. At the end of the game, the combination of cards played and the influence accumulated in each of the provinces will award players victory points, which will then decide who wins. Ready to dominate the Empire?

—description from the publisher

name: Lava Run
description: A board game about saving your dinosaur from a volcanic eruption! Place tiles cleverly to guide lava down the volcano, and use special tiles to mess with your opponents or save yourself from demise, all while trying to be the first to dino escape!

name: Le Dernier Verset
description:
Le Dernier Verset uses the principles of the casino game Blackjack, adapting it to the needs of a solo card game.

You play a series of 10 duels during which you face off in a best-of-three round against an element of your past with which you are uneasy, instead of the classic casino dealer. These painful passages in your life are called Verses; there are 20 in the game, and for each duel, you must draw two and choose one.

You're not betting money, but the remaining fragments of your soul, and you'll have to try to recover as many as possible as you progress through the game if you want to achieve some form of redemption. Your game ends immediately if you run out of souls, at any time EXCEPT during a final bet. You are allowed to bet if you have 1 soul left.  Otherwise, the number of remaining souls at the end of the game determines your success.

name: Le village aux 5 dragons
description:
Le village aux 5 dragons is a game created by Clément Fournier and illustrated by Lucile Leca. It's a competitive exploration game for 1 to 5 players of 10 yo and more. It lasts 1 to 2 hours.

In this game, you're an adventurer traveling in strange dungeons always more dangerous. You'll gain treasures and experience to improve your skills and equipment. You'll fulfill quests and maybe kill one of the 5 dragons and take its treasure...

—user summary

Le village aux 5 dragons est un jeu créé par Clément Fournier et illustré par Lucile Leca. Il s'agit d'un jeu d'exploration compétitif inspiré du jeu de rôle, pour 1 à 5 joueurs de 10 ans et + et des parties allant de 1 à 2 heures.

Dans ce jeu, vous incarnerez un ou une aventurier-ère parmi 10 origines et 10 métiers possibles pour partir à l'aventure dans des donjons à la fois étranges et féeriques.
Accumulez des richesses et de l'expérience, remplissez des quêtes et améliorez votre équipement dans ce jeu d'exploration tactique !
Enfoncez-vous toujours plus loin dans les donjons afin de repartir avec un maximum de butin, mais attention à ne pas dépasser vos limites car les monstres seront de plus en plus dangereux à mesure que vous progresserez, et les dragons, de plus en plus proches ...

—description from the publisher

name: Leaders
publisher: Studio H; Evrikus; Galakta; GateOnGames; Reflexshop; TLAMA games; Wonderbow Games
description:
What is the secret of this kingdom, where peace has reigned for thousands of years?  Every spring, aspiring rulers recruit four allies and face off in unusual duels. No armies, no blood: the first to capture their rival wins. Your time has come. Tactical thinking, daring, and strategy will distinguish the true Leaders!

Create a team of unique Champions in order to defeat the opposing Leader! To win, either position two of your champions next to your opponent’s Leader to capture them, or skillfully maneuver so the opponent’s Leader is surrounded, leaving no adjacent empty spaces.

—description from the publisher

name: Leaping Lions
description:
No Chinese New Year celebration is complete without the lion dance. In a popular variation of the dance—especially in Malaysia—the lion dancers perform gravity-defying jumps between poles of increasing heights to the rhythm of beating cymbals, gongs, and drums.

Stage the best lion dance to win! Build platforms for your dancers to leap across as they move along the stage. Fill your dance with exciting complicated maneuvers to earn the crowd’s approval.

On your turn, choose a platform available to you based on your current star count.

Add the platform to your stage OR discard it to improve one of your existing platforms.

Use special abilities to enhance your performance and advance your lion along the platforms.

When the game ends, score your dance based on your lion’s position, sets of instruments, pairs of firecrackers and fans, and runs of ascending platforms. The player with the highest score wins the dance!

name: Legacy at Sea
description:
Given few options, many choose a life of plunder and strife. Life aboard a pirate ship is anything but easy. Cramped quarters, storms, rats and infested food, most will be lucky to survive. A few could even find fortune. Be skilled and your name may live on in history. How will you be remembered?

Features of Legacy at Sea

     Each turn, choose to sail to look for loot or dock at port to find prospects.
     Easy but interesting conflict resolution. Decide the method in which you would like to plunder.
     4 different Pirate Ship types.
     Upgrade your ships – You may add cannon, crew, and officers.
     Story Cards – Each card affects the entire theater. The world is bigger than you and Europe is reacting to the pirates.
     Based on historic events as you play from 1716 to 1718.

name: Legacy of Old Rus
description:
“Legacy of Old Rus” is a roll and write game that seeks to reproduce the feel of a full-fledged RPG. 
 There's a long legacy campaign consisting of multiple plot missions.

You can also play the game in the casual, "one-shot" mode.

Prepare your heroes for a challenging journey to Far Away Kingdoms.
Each player takes control of a unique hero. The game takes eight rounds. During each of these rounds, you roll four dice and use their results to receive magic items and explore the world of Far Away Kingdoms. You will also develop your hero's skills, use various items of equipment and unique abilities to your advantage. When exploring the world, you will visit many interesting places and meet different characters — friendly and hostile. 
 At the end of the game, the player who gained the most glory points wins.

-The demo play will be available on Essen 2021-

name: Legend Academy
description:
You are an ancient folklore character before their story was told. You and other characters are attending the prestigious Legend Academy to learn the skills and wisdom needed to take your place in history.

Legend Academy is a competitive euro-style game that combines deck-building, worker placement, and dungeon crawling. Players will build a deck of skill cards in the Academy, and then go on famous quests from ancient tales (The Jungle Book, Lost World, Gulliver's Travels, and more).

When on an adventure players play cards from their hand to move around the map and accomplish scenario specific goals, find treasure, defeat enemies, and try to impress the professor.

Players gain points by learning new skills, accomplishing goals, and finding treasure. The player with the most points at the end will become valedictorian and win the game.

–description from designer

name: Legend Academy: Deluxe Bundle
description:
Legend Academy Deluxe Bundle includes a copy of Legend Academy "Deluxe edition" with The Arthurian Legends Expansion & Chinese Legends Expansion both come with their own plastic trays inside of the base game box.  The All in Bundle - added other components that did not affect game play.


Chinese Legends Expansion: This expansion includes two new playable asymmetric characters from Chinese Folklore (Hua Mulan & Bai Shuzhen).

Hua Mulan: She's attacking focused and can make lots of combo attacks by manipulating her stamina line (reusing cards multiple times in a turn). She also has some great Wisdom Cards like "Ready Stance" that help her pull stamina cards from her discard pile back into her hand to do even more in a turn.

Bai Shuzhen: She is actually a demon transformed into a human body, so she has some demon-like abilities to manipulate enemies, making some epic turns. It was very different to develop her skills because she can transform into a snake; She has some very cool movement cards (some move cards can move very far but must be in a straight line).

Arthurian Legends Expansion: This expansion includes two new playable asymmetric characters from Arthurian Folklore.

Morgana Character: Morgana's story and character from Arthurian legends have been told many ways over the years, so we tried to pick and choose her story that fits most in this school setting. In some stories, she was initially a healer that eventually turned evil. We ran with that and gave her some skill cards that toyed with that "Darkness Within." She is a powerful sorceress and very different than other characters in the game. She's the most magical of all of the characters in the game.

Arthur Character: Arthur is a fearless leader. He is able to boost his attributes (Strength, Wisdom, Charisma, and Endurance) temporarily to have some incredible turns. He can improve his fellow classmates while also taking some of the credit for what they accomplish.

-description from Gamefound campaign

name: Red Carpet
description:
The stars shine on the red carpet. Once again, the Academy Awards ceremony is held and as a photographer you have the goal of capturing the best portraits of the most famous figures from the golden age of Hollywood. Get a good spot, find the perfect angle and take the photos that will be on the front pages of all the newspapers tomorrow.

In Red Carpet, you play as a photographer who seeks to capture the best portraits of the celebrities who arrive in limousines and parade down the red carpet to the awards gala.  Players will use their mobile phone, which they will place on pedestals around the board, to take the photos. Depending on a number of criteria (whether the celebrity is facing forward, whether they are in the foreground, whether there is advertising in the background, etc.), you will add or subtract points for each portrait. You will also influence the awards by voting for your favourite nominees in each category, and at the crucial moment of the awards ceremony, the value of the winners' portraits will be doubled.

In each turn, players will use cards to perform various actions, such as placing their tripod in a space in the press area or moving the characters parading down the red carpet. In addition to the celebrities, there will also be anonymous people in the scene, so it will be key to get the best angle to take the best portraits.

—description from the publisher

name: Legends Odyssey
description:
LEGENDS ODYSSEY: Choose Your Own Adventure Card Game !
NEXT GENERATION MODULAR CARD GAME

Embody an immortal legend blessed by the elemental gods on a quest for their odyssey.
Battles, riddles, quests, magical items, and elemental powers: Will you awaken the legend slumbering within you?

What is LEGENDS ODYSSEY?

     A collectible card game for 1 to 4 players
     Suitable for ages 12 and up 
     A modular game with 4 game modes, each playthrough is different
     A collection of over 500 cards available


Unique Features:

     Tarot-sized cards (70x120mm)
     Stunning illustrations and premium quality by Studio Juicy Games
     Imerian Compass (MOBILE APPS): scan your cards to discover exclusive content (Audiobooks, Mini-games, Gameplay tips, Advanced rules, Free Scenarios, etc.)! A mobile app for even greater immersion (optional, but highly recommended)


4 Incredible Game Modes:
1. Duel: Strategic 1v1 confrontations
2. Odyssey: Explore the lands of Imeria in story-driven games
3. Game Master: Challenge your friends, become the game master, and create your own scenarios
4. TCG Carnage: Discover a new approach to TCG

name: Legends of Expedition: The Crumbling Pyramid
description:
A diverse team of adventurers find themselves trapped inside a colossal, ancient  pyramid. Their initial exploration was driven by the promise of untold treasures, but they soon discover the pyramid is cursed and starting to collapse around them. 
As the pyramid begins to crumble, the team must navigate the chambers of the structure, testing their wits and bravery. 
With the pyramid rapidly deteriorating, the adventurers must decipher clues that hint at a hidden escape route.

Players will reveal cards as they explore. Each card will come with new challenges.

Roll your team member dice against expedition dice. Players must utilize strategy and a little press your luck in order to pass the card. Your supplies are limited but can be used to mitigate dice.

Reveal all rooms of the pyramid in order to reveal the escape path. This is a grand finally, roll against a lot of expedition dice.

—description from the publisher

name: Legends of Gadia
description:
The Most Epic Game You Can Play in 20 Minutes! Legends of Gadia is a highly thematic fantasy card game sprung from the pages of the upcoming fantasy novel series GADIA by Su Mon Han. As in -- this is the same game the characters actually play in the books (in taverns and what have you)!

Legends of Gadia (or "LoG") immortalizes the 12 historical heroes from the world of GADIA whose final quest saved all humankind from impending doom at the cost of their own lives. To honor their sacrifice, the people of their world created this card game bearing their 12 likenesses that keeps their stories alive in the very moves of the game itself.

For 2-4 players, LoG looks like a 48-card deck of beautifully illustrated fantasy tarot cards, but plays like a fast-paced, surprisingly strategy-rich and engaging card game along the lines of rummy or bridge, but with a thematic fantasy twist in the moves. With deep lore and extremely well-balanced game play perfected over 10+ years of playtesting, Legends of Gadia is bound to be your new go-to filler game as it plays in 20 minutes, but is so fresh, addicting and fun that you and your friends will be reaching for this game again and again.

—description from the publisher

name: Legends of ShenZhou
description:
Legends of ShenZhou is an immersive and strategic board game inspired by the legendary Chinese text Shan Hai Jing(The Classic of Mountains and Seas). This ancient text, dating back over 2,000 years, is one of the most famous works in Chinese mythology, filled with vivid descriptions of mythical creatures, divine beings, and fantastical landscapes. It serves as both a mythological map and an encyclopedia of strange beasts, gods, and the unknown corners of the world.

Set in a fantastical world drawn directly from the Shan Hai Jing, players embark on an epic journey as iconic characters from Chinese mythology. They will explore the mysterious regions described in the ancient text, from towering mountains to vast seas, encountering the legendary creatures and divine figures that have fascinated readers for millennia.
In this game, players must navigate diverse and treacherous maps, using tactical movement to gather skills, earn wealth, and outmaneuver rivals. Along the way, they will encounter legendary creatures from Chinese lore, battle powerful adversaries, and face off against fellow players. Victory comes through strategic decision-making, where players must carefully purchase weapons, shields, mounts, and essential supplies to gain the upper hand in combat.

The ultimate goal of Legends of ShenZhou is to challenge and defeat the divine beasts that guard the path to greatness. Only the most cunning and resourceful players will overcome these mythical foes and claim their place in history as a true legend of Shenzhou.

—description from the publisher

name: Legions of Steel: Reloaded
description:
A fast paced, squad level miniatures wargame rich in tactical decision making. Take control of either the highly trained human forces, United Nations of Earth Commandos or the fearless machine forces comprised of G12 Nightmare robots and the dreaded Mark VII Assault Fiend. Various scenarios are included in the boxed set which you win by completing the mission objectives.

Legions of Steel is played over a series of rounds each comprised of an Initiative Segment, 2 player turns and an end segment. At the beginning of each Round the players roll a d6, higher roller winning initiative. The player with the initiative decides who will have the first turn this round, themselves or their opponent. The person whose turn it is, is considered the active player.

The active player activates each of their figures moving and attacking. Once a figure has been activated and its actions are finished, a marker is place next to that figure to indicate its state. If the figure attacked, a fired counter is placed next to it. If it did not fire, it is considered Covering which means that it is holding its attack for future use, including during the opponent's turn. Attacking at an opponent is accomplished through rolling a 6 sided die (sometimes more depending on the weapon and your tactical decision). There are various options for attacks including auto-firing, spreading your attack to multiple targets, hand to hand engagement and more that add to the tactical decision process. In addition, some figures have special abilities like Leadership or Extra Lives. With leadership a Sergeant figure can influence die results, allow troopers to move farther or command them to attack out of turn. The Mark VII Assault fiend has an extra life as it takes 2 hits to eliminate it from the game.

The tactical decisions in this game are many with plenty of player interaction. You will be jockeying your forces for tactical advantage, trying to get the upper hand from round to round.

—description from the publisher
