There are many different types of manatees in the sea each with their own effects and after each player has finished using their cards everyone must feed all their hungry manatees! Once all manatees have been fed players will score points based on the number of manatees they have, their type, and the round they are in. At the end of 3 rounds whoever has the most points wins!

Manatee Sanctuary comes with multiple modules and play option for family's and hobby board gamers alike!

—description from the publisher

name: Manhattan Project: Energy Empire
description:
Manhattan Project: Energy Empire includes all the gameplay of the original edition, as well as the 'Cold War' expansion, the new 'UN Envoys expansion', and more!

From the ashes of war, nations rise to power in the atomic age! In Manhattan Project: Energy Empire, each player takes control of a nation struggling for power in the latter part of the 20th century. They build up their nation’s industry, commerce, and government by acquiring resources, building structures, and tapping sources of energy.

The major threat in Energy Empire is not war, but uncertain global impacts, that result from side effects of industrialization and pollution. Many actions come with a cost. So, as nations become more industrious, they also increase the amount of pollution in the environment. Careful use of science can mitigate the harmful effects of industry, and can also help avert global crises.

Energy Empire uses worker placement, tableau-building, and resource management mechanics. On each turn, a player can choose to either work or generate. On a work turn, a player plays a single worker on the main board, then uses workers and energy to activate cards in their tableau. Players may spend energy to use an occupied space on the main board, so no spaces are ever completely blocked. On a generate turn, players get to renew their supply of energy by rolling "energy dice" that represent nuclear, coal, oil, solar, and other forms of energy.

The back of the game board presents a way to play the base game and expansion seamlessly together as one big game. Note the new expansion content has not been released before and won't be available by itself.

—description from the publisher

name: Mankind Madness
description:
In Mankind Madness, a secret nationality, a trip around the world, and a bunch of prejudice cards you can use to your own advantage or against others help you race to the cities of the world. But beware, your actions can also damage the environment and ultimately lead to Armageddon, thus "Game Over" for everyone.

Each player in Mankind Madness starts with a secret identity and a random Ideology - which gives specific player traits.  The goal of the game is for players to visit a number of cities and be the first to return to your home city.

The gameplay is turn-based and begins with the first player. Turn-structure:
1. Draw-Phase: You always draw an Action and a Prejudice card to your hand.
2. Game-Phase: Now you can move your figure one space (for free), can play as many Prejudices or Action cards as you like and activate the ability of your Ideology. All activities in the game phase are optional, and you can carry them out in any order.
After you are done, it’s the next players turn in clockwise order.

If you have at least 6 victory points and your figure is standing on the capital of your nationality, you can reveal your secret nationality and win the game. But if the Armageddon card gets flipped before someone wins the game, its “Game Over” for everyone.

—description from the publisher

name: Manner of Death
description:
Step into the role of a forensic investigator in this competitive true crime autopsy game. Examine cadavers by removing layers of cards from specific body parts to uncover hidden clues, then scan QR codes to access lab results, witness interviews, and police reports. Use your tools and deductive skills to determine the manner of death before your opponents. With three unique cases, immersive storytelling, and realistic evidence, it’s a race to see who can solve the mystery first.

BECOME A FORENSIC INVESTIGATOR: Compete against others in a true crime game where you perform detailed autopsies, using only the physical evidence from the body to uncover the true cause of death.
INTERACTIVE AUTOPSY MECHANICS: Use the realistic scalpel to peel back layers of cards from specific body parts, revealing evidence and critical information buried within.
SCAN FOR REALISTIC CLUES: Unlock lab reports, police investigations, and witness interviews by scanning QR codes with your phone for a multi-layered, immersive experience.
RACE TO SOLVE THE CASE: The first player to correctly diagnose the manner of death wins — test your investigative skills and see who can crack the case fastest.
INCLUDES THREE IMMERSIVE CASES: Each cadaver offers about an hour of gameplay with unique storytelling, detailed clues, and authentic artifacts for a truly gripping experience.

—description from the publisher

name: Map Masters
description:
Map Masters is a dungeon-crawling card game in which you must create your path, card by card, through the dark rooms of your dungeon in search of legendary treasures.

Dive into Map Masters, a thrilling adventure in Solo, Cooperative, or Competitive mode.

In Map Masters Versus Mode, each player builds their own Dungeon using 5 cards. Once their Dungeon is created, each player draws their Path to collect as many Discoveries as possible that match the round’s Objective. Next, players count the points of Discoveries along their Path that match the Primary and Secondary Objectives in order to earn Victory Points (VP). Along the way, players also collect Coins, which they can use to purchase new Cards or Tokens from the Market. Each turn player will also chose to use the Optimizers they encountered and improve their deck.

In Map Masters Co-op Mode, Players will jointly manage groups of adventurers. In order to accomplish a mission, players should discuss strategy both before and during the game. After the setup and the market phase, players will explore the dungeon.Clockwise, each player will place a card on an empty space of the tableau and draw a new card. Once a group mini can be connected to an objective, players should trace its path. When the mission requirements have been fulfilled, the game is won!

Every game is a new challenge to overcome, every card a crucial decision.

Map Masters is a game for 1 to 5 players when played Co-op and for 2 to 5 players when played Versus.

name: Dice Throne: Vanguard
description:
Battles swift as steel. Boldly accessible. Heroically replayable.

Dice Throne Vanguard features four Vanguard heroes (druid, duelist, forgemaster and sun elf) that are compatible with all Dice Throne heroes, while ushering in fresh mechanisms and bringing legendary themes to the battle!

name: Lightning Train
description:
All aboard the Lightning Train!

Steer your railway company through a land of strategic opportunity in Lightning Train, a new bag-building train game from the creators of Clank! and Dune: Imperium.

Build your bag to improve your company's resources, then place your chips to open stations and train lines across eight regions of North America. There's a fortune to be made by delivering goods to the cities that need them...but will you work together, or look to cut out the competition? Which stations do you need to secure a route to victory? How can the powerful lightning trains accelerate you past your rivals?

All aboard the Lightning Train!

Bag-building train strategy!

Lightning Train is a bag-builder that plays like a deck-builder, with mechanically-unique chips that give you changing options from round to round.

The chips you acquire will shape your long-term strategy, so forward-thinking and clever planning are necessary to find a path to victory.

Components
Includes

Double-sided game board
31 wooden station markers
4 player boards
82 cards
400+ tokens
rulebook

name: Carnival of Sins
publisher: Actarus Editions; Cranio Creations; DSV Games; MM-Spiele; Tranjis Games
description:
Unleash your wild side in the heart of New Orleans, where masks hide the true intentions behind the city’s greatest sins.

’Carnival of Sins’, originally published by Tranjis Games, is a game of dice and deception, of temptation and fortune in which cunning and strategy are your best allies. The game lasts seven rounds, and at the start of each round the player holding the Devil card rolls the dice, then each player secretly chooses one of their seven sin cards to play. All cards are then revealed in order, triggering each sin’s effect to claim dice and rack up points — while messing with everyone else’s plans.

After seven rounds, the player with the highest score earns the title of Carnival Monarch. Use your wit and trickery in this festival of temptation to prove you’re the biggest sinner in the city!

name: Coming of Age
description:
In Coming of Age, you will start the game as a child, and as such, you will have a limited set of interests and skills that will determine your development. During this time, your parents' help will be important for your progress. As the years go by, you will grow and acquire new interests, gain more independence, and with it, access to other experiences that will allow you to achieve your own life goals.

In this journey through adolescence, you will form memories, shape different traits of your personality, make friends, fall in love, and try to manage frustrations with the goal of realizing yourself as a person by fulfilling your dreams and ambitions. Using a dice-management mechanism, you will visit different locations in the city, acquiring experiences that will modulate various aspects of your personality reflected on your personal board, with the goal of achieving the different life goals you will acquire during the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Countryside
publisher: Nanox Games; dlp games; DSV Games
description:
In Countryside, you are a farmer with a vision, and you want to build the most thriving and efficient farm the land has ever seen. To do so, you will expand your territory by playing area cards and cultivate it with trees, vegetables, animals, and more. Will you raise live-stock in lush meadows, plant trees in your garden, or focus on growing hearty crops? Every decision counts as the right combination of items, perfect timing, and smart planning will bring you step by step closer to your goal.

Balance your strategy and manage your resources wisely in this competitive game as you race to earn the title of the region's top farmer.

name: Deckscape: Dungeon
publisher: DV Games; 999 Games; ABACUSSPIELE; Albi; Mercurio
description:
A warrior, a sorceress, and an archer are the last hope to restore peace to the Three Kingdoms.

In Deckscape: Dungeon, you will move your heroes to explore the dungeon map and to solve puzzles, find the legendary Dragon Eyes, and defeat the shadows of Xemon!

name: MARVEL: Skirmish! In New York
description:
Old friends and enemies meet in the streets of New York, and an epic battle of good vs. evil erupts: Who will prevail? Doctor Strange and Hulk, or Ultron and Loki?

In MARVEL: Skirmish! In New York, each player takes one side of the battlefield in New York City, using their unique deck of either heroes or villains to control the landscape. Play your cards wisely, exploit the weaknesses of your opponent's cards, gather valuable artifacts, and seize strategically important locations.

name: Masterland
description:
Masterland is a PvP tactical card game that cuts mechanics to the bone. Strategic depth arises from minimal pieces and rules, thanks to clever planning and resource management.

Build your fantasy kingdom and assemble an unstoppable army: each turn you can gather a Resource, play cards and manage your hand. At turn hand, if you have deployed Units, you automatically attack the next player and steal their Energy. The last one standing wins!

The system has been designed with competition and replayability in mind: it supports intense head-to-head duels, as well as free-for-all multiplayer battles for up to 4 players.

A quick game loop and rewarding learning curve make it the perfect title to approach strategy card games, as well as an addictive filler for veterans!

—description from the publisher

name: Masters of Crime: Hollywood
description:
Murder in Hollywood! Who killed Olivia Grant, the famous actress who was the sister of a notorious motorcycle gang boss?

In Masters of Crime: Hollywood, players become gang members to investigate the murder by using Google Maps, writing emails, searching websites, and calling phone numbers. What dark secrets are the high society of Hollywood Hills keeping? Together, the gang members decide how the story will continue. Solve puzzles, combine facts, and question them: This is where real detective work comes into play!

name: Koi
publisher: 999 Games; DV Games; Gém Klub Kft.; KOSMOS
description:
In Koi, you build an authentic 3D koi pond, so the challenge is to bring your reservoir to life and make the most of the actions at your disposal to create something truly magnificent.
From the creators of Bonsai comes a brand-new, serene, strategic journey through nature.

The Japanese term “Koi” means multicolored carp, known as “swimming flowers”, considered living jewels, and a symbol of perseverance and virtue. Now you can welcome them into your pond and contemplate them to achieve luck and success!

Inspired by the peaceful elegance of Japanese gardens, Koi invites players to build stunning habitats, populate them with koi, and compete for harmony, beauty, and victory points.

Each turn unfolds with two core actions:
- Meditate: draw cards, earn coins, and acquire koi from the market.
- Work: use your Sensei’s abilities to shape your pond by placing your tiles.

With a highly customizable, multi-layer tile placement system and beautiful 3D elements like bridges and lanterns, no two games are ever the same. Complete dynamic goals, unlock new features, and gaze at your own stunning creation while it comes to life!

Includes a robust solo mode for peaceful solitary sessions.

name: Matcha: Strategy and Memory game
description:
Matcha is a two-player game where players aim to collect either 6 unique chips or a set of 3 identical chips.

During their turn, players have to flip over chips that follow given sequences (runs, matches and skips) in order to collect one chip from that sequence and / or one chip from the other player.

Players need to think strategically on which chip to collect and which chip to leave flipped over in order to win the game.

—description from the designer

name: Matchstick Tycoon
description:
In マッチ売りの大富豪 (Matchstick Tycoon), you want to be the first player to ditch your cards and your matchsticks.

Each player starts with one matchstick and a hand of cards, with cards going from 0 (low) to 8, then from A to F (high). The first player in a round plays one or more cards of the same strength, and each player in turn either plays the same number of cards of a higher strength or passes; when a player passes, they take a matchstick from the reserve, but they can play again if the round doesn't end before their next turn. When all players pass in turn, clear the cards, then whoever played last starts a new round.

You can use matchsticks to modify the value of your cards, and you can play cards with either end up, so a 6 can become an 8 by adding one matchstick to it, a 6 can become a 9 by flipping it, and a 1 can become an F by flipping it and adding two matchsticks.

If a player plays five cards of the same suit, a revolution takes place, and F is immediately the lowest value and 0 the highest.

When a player has no cards and no matchsticks remaining, they win. (If a player ditches all their cards but still has matchsticks, on each of their subsequent turns, they discard one matchstick.) Keep playing to determine all players' ranks.

name: Mate: The Party Game for Feral Naturalists
description:
Adventure into the world of animal mating! In Mate: The Party Game for Feral Naturalists, your team of fellow feral naturalists will analyze specimens, consider queries, estimate measurements, and craft illustrations — all exploring animal mating behaviors and anatomy.

Players join the Society of Feral Naturalists. Their field guide and notes facilitate a wild adventure into the world of animal mating.  But be careful, this adventure is not for the prudish!

In Mate, teams work together to analyze animal sexual anatomy, conjecture on absurd questions, and sketch ridiculous prompts.

     Sexual Selection: Which absurd choice is correct?
     Mutual Drawer-gasm: Race to sketch a hilarious prompt.
     Mystery Mate: Which creature’s parts are in the photo?
     Size Matters: Guess on a wild number query.


Set sail! The team that navigates around the compass first wins.

name: Math Knight
description:
Use simple math in unexpected ways to slay monsters, grow stronger, and save the day.

The Scarlet Mage has twisted the once-beautiful forest into a place few dare to enter. Mighty heroes have ventured in—some returning in haste, others never seen again.

Today, you step into the woods. Armed with a handful of basic moves and the belief that every obstacle has a solution, you'll face monsters that test your wits and adaptability. Each battle sharpens your skills, making you smarter, stronger, and more prepared.

But will it be enough to overcome the final challenge—the Scarlet Mage himself?

—description from the designer

The game was designed for the 2025 9-Card Nanogame P&P Design Contest, and it achieved the following awards:

1st place - Best Overall Game
1st place - Best Solitaire Game
1st place - Most Innovative Mechanic
2nd place - Most Thematic Game

name: Mattergy
description:
Mattergy is a strategic deck-building card game with direct player interaction and powerful card synergies.

The existence of everything is on the brink. The fall of the first shaper, escalated the fight for succession. Defend your standing as an aspiring shaper and fight the herds of rivaling pretenders.

The main resource in the game is matter, which you will transform into mighty creatures to build your following. All players have access to an updating market of creatures in the middle to build their deck. In your turn you will spend matter to create and play creatures of four unique factions, use their special abilities, combine and attack your opponents. 

Playing intelligent strategies will give you resources to obtain powerful progression cards that will strengthen you the rest of the game.

But be aware – every turn is a battle, and you have to defend yourself from the attacks of the other players! If you can't defend yourself, and you have no energy left, you lose.

To win, you will need to handle your resources wisely and launch devastating attacks to erase your opponents.

Mattergy's distinctive artworks and characters will open up a fantastical new world to explore.

-description from designer

name: Mayan Curse
description:
A group of archeologists just made the headlines.  After decoding an ancient Mayan manuscript, they found the location of a secret temple in the jungles of El Salvador. The document revealed the existence of an unknown secret city, that can only be seen from the top of a large, circular temple.  The secret passage to reach the temple is a set of very large stone slabs sitting on stone rolls. These sit above an ancient river, believed to be a passage from the living world to the Underworld.

Slide stone slabs and race to create a path to discover stelae (monuments) and perhaps even ascend the temple to view the ancient city. But beware of the boulders that will be triggered along the way.  You have to make it out before they all reach the entrance and block your only escape!

Includes a solo mode with 12 scenarios.

—description from the publisher

name: Medievallons
description:
The beloved monarch has died, creating a power vacuum.  Players compete to establish three guilds and dominate the capital to claim the crown. Choose guilds wisely, each with unique powers, for a strategic and fast-paced battle.  Can you outwit your rivals and seize control?

In Medievallons , fight to be the first to establish 3 guilds and harness their powers to dominate the capital and claiming the kingdom!  With 13 unique guild cards, players must balance strengthening their own position with disrupting others. A quick, strategic game lasts about 30 minutes.

Players draw a guild card each turn and must decide: play it for a powerful effect but lose it, establish a new guild at risk of attack, or add members to protect it but slow progress. The goal is to establish 3 guilds, each made of three matching cards. If a guild drops below three members due to interference, its cards return to the player’s hand.

The game ends when a player completes their third guild and claims victory.

–description from the publisher

name: Medu
description:
A two player abstract strategy game by Thai designer T-raz Bank Piamdumrongsak.
Players attempt to create one of the winning formations or push opponent to have no valid move to win the mysterious game of Medu.
Once the blocks are placed on the game board, they are shared pieces and not owned by any players.

name: Megabeast: Last Titans
description:
The prehistoric world is fierce, and only the strongest will dominate. In Megabeast: Last Titans, you control one of Earth’s final dinosaur giants, battling rivals and surviving prehistoric threats. Outfight, outmanoeuvre, and outlast your opponents in this fast-paced skirmish game where every move counts.

In MegaBeast: Last Titans, each player selects a unique megabeast and sets up according to a themed encounter that defines the win conditions and any special rules. Players secretly choose one of five ability cards each turn, then reveal them simultaneously to determine movement, actions, and turn order based on speed. Movement and attack ranges are determined by card stats and current life points, with combat resolved through simultaneous die selection and rolls. Cards cycle through a recovery phase, preventing repeated plays, and the game continues until the encounter is won or only one megabeast remains.

name: Lost in Adventure: The Curse of Jack Parrot
description:
In the co-operative game Lost in Adventure, you and your fellow players will explore an unknown world where your actions directly shape the unfolding narrative. As you progress, you reveal new areas by placing Scenario cards side by side, interact with characters, gather clues, and use objects strategically. Each decision can affect the outcome of the story, leading to one of multiple possible endings. Your ultimate goal is to complete all feats and finish the adventure with the highest possible reputation.

In Lost in Adventure: The Curse of Jack Parrot, players follow the trail of a legendary pirate whose name is wrapped in mystery and misfortune. Set in a tropical archipelago filled with secrets, the game introduces a branching narrative full of dangers, puzzles, and discoveries. The modular map grows as you play, revealing new scenario cards and interaction opportunities tied to both story and mechanics. Unique object-based interaction rules allow players to resolve situations based on item matching and contextual clues, rewarding observation and teamwork.
This title builds on the core system introduced in Lost in Adventure: The Labyrinth, adding new gameplay elements, a thematic shift to a pirate adventure, and increased narrative complexity.

name: Megapulse
description:
Megapulse is an adrenaline-filled futuristic racing game inspired by titles like Wipeout, F-Zero and Mario Kart. It features hand-building, simultaneous action selection, and a modular track.
Each player starts the game with a hand of 7 action cards. Each round, players simultaneously choose 2 cards to play from their hand and reveal them. Players then take their turns, using their chosen cards as well as their accumulated speed to catch up with opponents, drift, use their nitro, launch bombs and missiles, and use their precious special ability. But watch out! Curves are dangerous, and might damage your vehicle! Upgrade cards can be acquired to enhance your options, but sometimes require you to remove another card from your hand. The first to finish the last lap of the race wins it all.
Megapulse includes clever catch-up mechanics, and multiples game modes like Derby, Neon God, and Spellflux Ball.

—description from the publisher

name: Meister Makatsu
publisher: 999 Games; AMIGO; Gigamic; Giochi Uniti; Kikigagne?; Mercurio; MINDOK
description:
In Meister Makatsu, players compete with their ninjas for the favor of the renowned master by demonstrating their mastery of perfect timing and strategic moves.

Everyone has their own deck of 24 cards, with cards numbered 1-8 in three colors. You must play these cards wisely over three rounds because each turn whoever plays the highest card in a suit receives points equal to the round number. Played cards are removed from the game, whereas unplayed hand cards return to your deck for use in subsequent rounds.

In the end, whoever has the fewest points wins.

name: Mejor Pais del Mundo
description:
2-4 player card game that reimplements Fantasy Realms mechanics with some twists, using the Argentine current-at-the-time political scene from 2024.

Cards are political figures from Argentina, and players take turns in drawing and discarding cards in order to sum up as many points as possible in their hands before the game ends when the tenth card hits the discard pile.

—description from the designer

name: Menagerie: Unlock the Wonders of a Miniature World
description:
Unlock the wonders of a miniature world with the game Menagerie, in which you become an esteemed insect curator. Your goal is to score points by carefully arranging your terrarium, using captivating specimens from across the insect world. Expand your collection each turn using insect traits and benefactor abilities to fill your exhibits. At game's end, the player who nets the most points wins!

Can you outshine your rivals and emerge victorious? Menagerie can be played with up to four players but can also be played as a one player game. There are 70 unique insects to discover in Menagerie, including an exclusive "Flying Butterfly"!

—description from the publisher

name: Meow 10
description:
Meow10 is a quick, light-strategy card game for 2 to 5 players featuring colorful and quirky cat cards. The goal is to get rid of all your cards by matching either the number or the color of the card on the discard pile—or by using the powerful rainbow cat!

On your turn, you may play as many cards as the number shown on the discard pile’s top card, provided they match the color or number. If you cannot play, you must draw penalty cards. Special rainbow cards can match anything and offer tactical flexibility.

The game ends when a player empties their hand, the draw pile runs out, or a player collects 10 different cat types (shouting “Ten!”). Players then receive penalty points based on leftover cards. Meow10 is easy to learn, plays in under 15 minutes, and offers a delightful balance of luck and strategy.

—description from the publisher

name: Meow in a Row
description:
Meow in a Row is a cute and strategic abstract game where players take turns placing cat tokens on the board, aiming to be the first to line up five in a row—horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. With simple rules and quick playtime, it's perfect for both casual players and lovers of classic connection games, now with an adorable feline twist.

—description from the publisher

name: Meow Meow Dice
publisher: Playte; ㅎㅅㅎ Design Studio (hsh Design Studio)
description:
Be a lovely cat and get lots of treats from your butler!
The richest cat wins!

Yacht Dice with adorable cats.
Roll the cat dice, make combinations, and become the wealthiest cat to win!

Contents: 4 cat dice, 1 board, 2 punchboards, 60 cards

name: Meow-Cala
description:
Meow-CALA is a charming cat-themed twist on the classic game of Mancala. Players take turns picking up and sowing cat tokens around their board, aiming to collect the most in their store. While the core mechanics remain true to the timeless original, the cute artwork and playful theme bring a fresh and delightful energy to the strategic gameplay. Perfect for two players who enjoy clever, simple tactics with a feline flair.

—description from the publisher

name: Movie Fight
description:
Get ready for Movie Fight, the card game where you build the most epic cinema lineup! Strategically collect blockbuster films and key features to attract audiences and earn popcorn as victory points. Over 12 rounds, outwit your rivals, craft the perfect combinations, and prove your cinema reigns supreme. Will your strategy steal the spotlight, or will you fade into the credits?

On your turn, select a double-sided card and place it in your cinema as either a viewer or a movie on the screen. Viewers have specific requirements, while movies trigger effects that may also influence your opponents. Strategically combine elements in your cinema to maximize your victory points!

—description from the designer

name: Metbetoch
Meteor Shower
description:
Meteor Shower it’s a fresh, fast-paced experience built for players who love smart tactics, unexpected twists, and just a little bit of chaos. Every session is different, thanks to falling meteorites and dynamic strategies that keep everyone guessing (and plotting) until the very last move.

The goal of Meteor Shower is to be the first player to build an unbroken line (curve/polygonal/straight) of meteorites from the starting point to the opposite side of the board. For this purpose, players move the stones available on the game board to the cells they need. Initially, there are no meteorites on the game board, they will fall during the game.

Two gameplay modes: 
Quick Play Mode: Finished in about 10 minutes. 
Extended Play Mode: Runs 30 minutes or more.

—description from the designer

name: Metro Bingo
description:
Metro Bingo consists of pens, score sheets, and 42 tiles; the tiles are numbered 1-30, with two copies of #11-19, one wild, and two special tiles. Game play is similar to Bingo in that someone draws a tile and everyone must then write that number on their scoring sheet. This sheet contains a line of twenty spaces to be filled, and while these spaces can be filled in any order, if you can place the numbers in non-descending order – identical numbers placed side-by-side don't break a stream – you'll score points at the end of the game. The longer the stream of non-descending numbers, the more points you score for that stream.

Aside from the basic score sheet with twenty spaces in a line, Metro Bingo includes three other score sheets that feature crossing lines or a circular arrangement of spaces to be filled.

name: Mi Cielo
description:
Take flight with Mi Cielo, where strategy takes wing in a captivating race across the sky. Out-maneuver your opponent in an ever changing aerial arena, as you bounce and soar across the clouds to determine who is the master of the sky.

Move across a sky built of cards by jumping to balloons of your bird's color to occupy your opponent's starting cards. Watch out though, landing on a balloon can send out puffs of air which flips adjacent cards, constantly changing the playing field!

name: Miams
description:
Roll your dice to make the most beautiful fruit skewers, and fill your Hearts track before your opponents!

Combine powerful Yums cards to skew probabilities in your favor and create unique game situations!

name: Micro Hero: Hercules
description:
Step into the mythological and humorous world of Micro Hero: Hercules, a minimalist solo deck-building card game inspired by the 12 Labors of Hercules. As the legendary hero, you'll embark on an epic adventure, revisiting his mythical feats with a fresh, humorous twist. This compact and strategic game invites you to prove your strength and resilience as you face increasingly challenging obstacles.

Each game consists of twelve rounds, each representing one of Hercules' Labors. Using your deck of technique cards, you'll gather experience points (EXP) to improve your abilities, upgrade your cards, and overcome mythological foes. Master the balance between offensive and defensive stances, strategically chaining your card plays to unleash powerful combinations while minimizing the damage you take.

Your goal is to complete all 12 Labors of Hercules without succumbing to the burden of wound cards. To triumph in each round, you must reduce the Labor's health to zero by dealing enough damage while defending yourself from its attacks. Defeated Labors transform into blessing cards, which can be added to your arsenal for future rounds. Victory is achieved by completing all 12 Labors consecutively, while the game is lost if your deck becomes overwhelmed by wounds.

With its evolving card system and streamlined mechanics, Micro Hero: Hercules offers high replayability and minimal randomness, ensuring every decision is impactful. Each Labor takes about twenty minutes to complete, and the game can be paused between rounds, making it perfect for long campaigns or quick sessions.

—description from the designer

name: Micro Moonshine
description:
Welcome to Micro Moonshine, a thrilling board game that takes you back to the roaring 1920s, an era of prohibition, speakeasies, and clandestine operations. Players step into the shoes of ambitious moonshiners, navigating the dangerous world of illegal liquor production and distribution in the United States.

Your objective is clear: build an empire of forbidden spirits by hiring a skilled crew, producing high-quality moonshine, and establishing lucrative relationships with speakeasies. Every decision matters, from recruiting the right crew members, managing your resources to laundering your hard-earned money at just the right time.

Micro Moonshine is designed for 1-4 players, offering a dynamic and competitive experience that lasts approximately 60 minutes. Do you have what it takes to outsmart your opponents, produce the best liqueurs, and become the undisputed kingpin of the prohibition era? Prepare for a journey into the world of bootlegging, strategy, and high-stakes operations – where the pursuit of fortune is as intoxicating as the illegal spirits you produce. Get ready to experience the thrill of Micro Moonshine.

—description from the publisher

name: Micro Mycelium
description:
Micro Mycelium invites players to delve into the intricate world of a vibrant fungal forest, where they must strategically place tiles to expand their territory and maximize their points.

In this tile-placement strategy game, players must carefully grow, connect, and conquer as they navigate the dense mycelial network. With each turn, players strategically place tiles to expand their mushroom kingdom, earning points for their clever placement and strategic connections. The goal? To cultivate the most prosperous mushroom kingdom and emerge victorious as the ruler of the fungal forest.

During each round, players lay one tile down. When the last tile is placed, scoring begins.  The player with the highest score wins.

—description from the designer

name: Reforest: Old Growth
description:
Grow a forest from humble herbs to towering trees.

Reforest: Old Growth expands the original game with a new set of plants and animal visitors along with old growth trees, parasitic plants and terrain modules to alter the game.  It can be combined with Reforest: Plants of the Pacific Northwest Coast or played as a standalone game.

In Reforest, players compete to grow the healthiest forest by arranging a synergistic tableau of plants, each with their own unique traits and abilities. The game ends when all visitors have found a home. Each player's forest is scored for the value of their plants and for the visitors they host.

New elements introduced in this expansion include:


     Old growth trees than can reveal previously covered effects and regenerate stored plants. 
     Parasitic plants that can be played freely but feed off of existing plants. 
     Terrain cards that offer growing benefits to your elevation rows


—description from the publisher

name: Midnight Stalker
description: Midnight Stalker is a print-and-play escape room-style game in which you help a detective solve a cold case from the 70s that could save the life of an innocent.

name: Midsummer Night
description:
The moon is waning, and the fairy Puck, potion in hand, roams the forest to scramble the paths and affections of all he meets with mischievous delight. Can you untangle the chaos of this Midsummer Night?

In Midsummer Night, one or two players draw and place cards to expand their forest tableau, building paths and connecting characters to their goals. Some goals are natural, some require a drop of Puck's potion along the way. If you spot Puck in your forest, gain a Magic token, allowing you to shift a previously placed card. Magic also red-reveals potion bonuses during end-game scoring. Connect the most characters to score points and win the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Milch mit Abführmittel
description:
Too many people in your shared apartment but only one fridge?

Of course someone’s going to drink your milkshake! But don’t worry - you’ve got the perfect revenge: slip a little surprise in there with some laxatives. Just make sure you don’t end up drinking it yourself. And remember, think twice before “borrowing” someone else’s milk… they might have had the same idea!

name: Millennia: Tracks of Time
description:
Millennia: Tracks of Time is a competitive civilization game for 1-4 players.

The game’s setting spans several millennia, a time span of thousands of years. Players go through eight ages, from the ancient to medieval ages, to the modern age, and finally to the near future, until the player with most fame wins. The game features more than 300 unique cards with more than 200 distinct illustrations showcasing historical inventions, buildings, and wonders. Your goal is to acquire the most advantageous cards to advance different aspects of your civilization, like research, military, population, prosperity, and culture.

Millennia utilizes a mix of drafting, engine building, and set collection mechanisms, all while introducing a unique twist with the concept of obsolescence. As time progresses, acquired technology and building cards will become obsolete, lasting only one to four ages before they must be discarded. This feature allows for the pursuit of various strategies during gameplay and, combined with the vast array of buildings and wonders, variable setup, and rich thematic elements, creates an incredibly replayable experience.

Each age has several phases during which the players:


     draft new technology cards from that specific era
     acquire important buildings and famous wonders
     simultaneously use their technologies and buildings to increase various aspects of their civilization
     compare their military strength with that of their opponents to determine the strongest force


After 8 ages, the player with most victory points is crowned the winner!

name: Mimic Mansion
description:
Intruders have been breaking into your mansion and making off with your treasures.  So, you've decided to hide Mimics - monsters who can disguise themselves as objects - in the mansion to surprise your unwanted guests.

In Mimic Mansion, each player places three cards every round. A set number of gem tokens are distributed among the rooms, and then the player to your right chooses one of your placed cards. They receive the gems in that room but also take mental damage based on the card placed.

Gems acquired can be used to purchase new cards or donated to gain victory points. This process is repeated for 8 rounds.

At the end of the game, players total their remaining mental strength, victory points from donations, and mission points earned by dealing damage to the player on their right. The player with the highest total wins.

name: Mimir's Challenge
description:
Game OverviewEach player commands an identical army made up of Vikings, Valkyries, Wyrms, and Ravens. Using strategy and foresight, you'll compete for area majority across the mythical Norse realms!

At the start of each round, armies are placed face down, keeping your plans hidden from your opponents. Once everyone has finished placing their units, all armies are revealed at the same time. Then, it's time for special actions—clever moves that can shift control of a realm at the last moment.

Treasures are awarded based on who has the most Vikings in a realm. But be warned: ties are harsh. If you're tied with another player, you're bumped to the back of the line—if there's any treasure left for you at all...

After three rounds, players tally their points from collected treasures and forge powerful Norse artifacts for bonus points. The player with the highest total wins the title Master of Warfare!

		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		

				
				
					~~~ How to Play ~~~				
				
					IntroductionAt a recent feast, the Norse Gods and Goddesses once again found themselves in a lively argument about who among them is the greatest war leader. To settle the dispute, Mimir, the wise and all-knowing advisor, presented them with a challenge. In Mimir's Challenge, you take on the role of a Norse God or Goddess, striving to gather treasures and resources to earn the highest score.

The game unfolds over three rounds, each divided into four phases.

				
				
					The Phases of Each of the 3 Rounds
         Round Set-Up: Distribute Treasure Tokens among the Realms, and refill the Artefact Cards lineup. 
         Placement Phase: Players take turns placing two Army Tokens face down in a Realm of their choice. This continues until each player has placed a set amount of Army Tokens. Once all tokens are placed, they are revealed simultaneously, allowing everyone to see their opponents’ strategies. 
         Action Phase: If any Valkyrie, Wyrm, or Raven tokens are in play, players take turns deciding which token to activate and how to use its unique ability. These abilities can influence the game by moving Army Tokens or Treasure tokens between Realms, creating dynamic shifts in the competition.
         Collection Phase: In each Realm, the player with the most Vikings gets the first pick of the Treasure Tokens. The player with the second-most Vikings chooses next, and this continues until all Treasure Tokens in the Realm are claimed. However, watch out for ties — when two or more players tie for the most Vikings, their armies are too busy squabbling to claim any treasures.
    


At the end of each round, you’ll receive an Artefact Card that serves as a blueprint for crafting one of the legendary Norse Artifacts. To craft these items, you’ll need specific materials found on Treasure Tokens. While some Treasure Tokens offer high point values, others contain the resources needed to complete your Artefact Cards, creating a strategic choice between immediate points or future bonuses.

				
				
					ScoringAt the end of the third round, points from collected Treasure Tokens are tallied, and bonus points for completed Artefact Cards are added. The player with the highest score wins Mimir's Challenge and earns the title Master of Warfare!

				
				
					~~~ About the Game ~~~				
				
					Game ModesMimir's Challenge offers two game modes to suit different skill levels:


     Less Challenging – Ideal for beginners or those who prefer a more relaxed experience.
     Normal – The standard way to play, offering balanced difficulty.


For players seeking an even greater challenge, an optional advanced rule is included to increase the difficulty beyond the normal level.

				
				
					Language DependencyThe game is designed to be language-independent. All components use symbols or icons, so as long as one player knows the rules, everyone can play together. Rulebooks are included in English, German, French, and Norwegian.

				
				
					Vision AccessibilityEach player’s Army Tokens feature both a unique color and a distinct shape, making it easier for players with color vision deficiencies to distinguish them.

Additionally, the Realm Tiles are double-sided. One side offers a more stylized, high-contrast version of the Norse Realms, improving visibility and making it easier to see the Army Tokens during gameplay.

name: Shallow Sea
publisher: Bad Comet; DSV Games; GaGa Games; Gém Klub Kft.; Mosaico Jogos; Ogry Games; Rexhry; Strohmann Games
description:
In Shallow Sea, a multi-layered puzzle board game inspired by the breathtaking beauty of the Great Barrier Reef, players create their own vivid ocean landscapes by strategically arranging an array of marine life, colorful fish, and corals. Unlike typical puzzle games in which pieces merely stack up, the elements in Shallow Sea can activate, deactivate, and even move, creating exciting combos and thought-provoking dilemmas that keep you on your toes.

On your turn, choose tiles showing fish, coral, or sea life, and place them on an empty space on your board. When fish surround a coral of the same color, you flip over the completed coral, which becomes a home for fish. Choose which fish will inhabit the coral, keeping the puzzle and ecosystem cards in mind. Use seashells to lure fish and move them, ideally completing multiple coral at once if you build them strategically.

Invite other creatures to enrich your ocean, trying to match the distinct scoring requirements of the ecosystem cards in order to score the most points.

name: Space Lab
publisher: Studio H; DSV Games; GateOnGames; Gen-X Games
description:
Interest in space research is at an all-time high. Across the world, dozens of space labs launch, hoping to uncover the universe’s secrets!
Launch your very own international space station! Recruit members from the world’s four largest space agencies to create the ideal team and complete the most prestigious projects outer space has to offer!

Space Lab is an exciting and accessible tableau-building game full of interesting decisions. 
On your turn, collect all the cards from the same agency from the top of the deck or the recruitment center. Manage your hand and place your Lab cards around your Capsules intelligently to optimize their powers and your objectives. Watch the pace of the game to anticipate the end and maximize your score!

—description from the publisher

name: Storyfold: Wildwoods
publisher: Open Owl Studios; Board Game Circus; Bumble3ee Interactive; DSV Games; GaGa Games; HIT Games; Mosaico Jogos; MS Edizioni; TLAMA games; Ігромаг
description:
Storyfold: Wildwoods is an innovative solo & narrative adventure board game with beautiful art and an immersive story campaign.

Storyfold: Wildwoods is a narrative adventure game in which you play as a young girl named Luma, and her bear companion, Brom, as they set out to heal the forest from a dark and mysterious shadow.

In Storyfold: Wildwoods, you will use the innovative Storybook with its built in dashboard to progress in a replayable campaign. Each session of Wildwoods is a single scene, with multiple scenes forming a chapter. The choices you make will impact Luma’s journey across the chapters as she confronts her fears.

—description from the publisher

name: Mine 77
publisher: Dragon Dawn Productions; Dragon Dawn Games
description:
Factory 42 is a bustling hub of Dwarven innovation, where diligent Odrixian laborers work hard for the betterment of society. The Overseer frequently shouts, "More materials are needed for today's orders! We need to improve! The Motherland needs our best!" This prompts a worker, Isabella, to rush to the office under the watchful eye of the Commissar to fill out an acquisition order. As she starts to write, she happens to glance at the top of the page and sees the workers who will have to fulfill this order. It’s the workers at Mine 77. Isabella chuckles at the thought of them struggling with this demand, remembering her former experiences working in the mine. She recalls the vast complex of underground fields, caves, and caverns drilled through the city's bowels and the long weary days spent toiling there. In Mine 77, workers work four days in two shifts, with only a brief on-site rest to break the tedium. Fortunately, she is now too old to be sent back to the mine. Age has its perks.

Mine 77 is a prequel game to Factory 42 that simulates the inner workings of Odrixia's largest mine. It is here that the valuable resources are gathered for the Factory. As you play the game, you will experience the hard work, cunning, and outright shenanigans required to become a successful Overseer at Mine 77.

Mine 77 is a resource management, worker placement game played on two rondels representing the above ground administration and the below ground grind of the actual mine. Players compete to become the most productive Overseer, simultaneously playing their hand of work order cards to plan out their workers' activities for moving around the board and taking actions to mine, farm, ship goods or a number of other possibilities. There is also a deck building element for improving your work order options. The game comes with two solo NPC Overseers which  may also be used as an additional opponent in 2 player games.

The game can end in one of two ways:
- End of the Week: The most usual way for the game to end is after the Third or Fourth Night Shift.
- Disaster:  If, at any point, a player’s current Victory Points falls to -10 on the chart, the game ends instantly and proceeds directly to Final Scoring.

name: Mine Mine Mine
description: In Mine Mine Mine, players want to complete a set of nine matching cards as quickly as possible, with everyone trading cards simultaneously using only the word "MINE". Want to trade a card? Yell "MINE"! Want to swap two of the same cards? Shout "MINE MINE!" If another player is shouting the same number at the same time, trade! The first player to collect a complete set grabs the trophy and shouts "WINNER WINNER WINNER"!

name: Tear-a-Part
publisher: Red Cat Games; Denkriesen; DV Games; Hobby Japan; Lifestyle Boardgames Ltd
description:
Creating can be fun even if you have no actual artistic skill — gather your friends for a TEAR-A-PARTy and you’ll see!

Give free rein to your fantasy: rip, crumple, fold and twist a small piece of paper to make the other players guess your secret concept. Most probably you won’t become a renowned artist in the process, but you surely will have tons of fun (and maybe even TEARS of joy) while creating your artworks. Get started and TEAR it up!

Score as many points as possible by depicting your secret concepts using nothing but a small piece of paper and do your best to guess what your opponents were trying to show.

—description from the publisher

name: The Rookies
description:
The Rookies is a cooperative game that needs curious, young eyes with a flair for adventure. Follow the threads of any story, observe the cards, match the right elements, and discover the end of each adventure. It’s up to you to unravel the 4 mysteries during a day with the Rookies!

This game includes text that immerses young players in amazing adventures. Parents, now’s the time to warm up your beautiful voices and bring the chosen story to life! A story unfolds over several turns, in which kids would be your smart guides to follow. Taking turns, according to their choices, players will visit locations and try to combine cards to form shapes that unlock new cards to advance the story until the End card is found.

—description from the publisher

name: Mini Dungeons: The Mines and the Towers
description:
Immerse yourself in a fantasy adventure with Mini Dungeons. The game, with a strong narrative component, balances elements typical of role-playing games with board game dynamics, offering a portable but deep experience.   
 In Mini Dungeons each game is unique, providing ever-changing challenges and adventures.  
 Venture into the mysterious Mines and the imposing Tower, take on exciting challenges and quests that change with every game!
 Explore, make decisions and complete quests in solo or cooperative mode, taking advantage of the game's endless replayability.

—description from the publisher

name: Mini Moons
description:
Five magical kittens, your scientific creations and newfound family, are scattered across the moons after your space station exploded. But fear not, brave spacefarer! You've snagged your trusty spaceship and some precious resources from the fiery mess. Your mission? Reunite with as many lost kittens as possible and safely return them to your home planet.

Mini Moons is a Resource Management game with different actions you can take while exploring the moons! Actions include movement, mining for resources, trading resources, using special item/cat abilities, and flying your spaceship.

—description from the designer

name: Until Proven Guilty: Thirst for Justice
description:
Until Proven Guilty is a narrative co-operative game inspired by court-themed visual novels, television series, and video games.

Thirst for Justice is a standalone case in which the theft of money from a well-known nightclub hides many uncertainties. Using the available evidence in your role as attorney Peter Howard, sway the jury to your side and convince them of your client's innocence.

name: Mining Operations
description:
Age of Change: Mining Operations is a lightweight, family-friendly board game that transports players to the early 20th century, where they take on the role of miners in search of valuable resources. Designed for 2-4 players, this game is easy to learn and provides around 30 minutes of engaging playtime, making it a great choice for family game nights.

Warning Age of Change: Mining Operations is a gateway game to introduce friends and families to the world of boardgames without scaring them with a massive rulebook. This game is more based on "push your luck" and learning some mechanics than deep strategic gameplay.

Objective:
The aim of the game is to collect the highest value of gold, silver, and coal by exploring mine shafts and strategically navigating through various challenges.

Components:
80 Mine Shaft Tiles: Create a unique mining landscape each game.
Cloth Draw Bag: Contains gold, silver, and coal counters.
Two 6-sided Dice: One with numbers, the other with colors and quake icons.

4 Player Pieces: Represent the miners.
1 Starting Tile: The entry point into the mine.
20 Gold, 30 Silver, and 50 Coal Counters: The resources players will be mining.

Setup:
Place the starting tile at the center of the play area.
Each player selects a playing piece and places it on the starting tile.
Prepare the draw bag with all the mineral counters inside.
Shuffle and place the mine shaft tiles face down in piles.

Gameplay:
Each turn, players roll two dice. One die determines the number of tiles they can move, while the other indicates where to place new minerals or triggers a mine collapse. Players explore the mine by placing new tiles, collecting valuable resources, and avoiding obstacles. Strategic decisions about movement and resource collection are key to winning the game.

Mineral Placement: Draw minerals from the bag and place them on tiles of the corresponding color rolled.

Mine Collapse: If a quake is rolled, a mine shaft collapses, adding a layer of challenge.

Movement: Move through the mine, adding new tiles and collecting resources along the way.

Collecting Minerals: After moving is done (or skipped if you so wish), collect minerals from the tile you end up on, according to the rules.

Scoring:
Coal: 1 point each
Silver: 5 points each
Gold: 10 points each

End of Game:
The game concludes when the draw-bag is empty, all mine shaft tiles are placed or no more tiles can be placed in the mine. Players tally their points based on the resources they've collected, and the player with the highest score wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Circadia
publisher: Synapses Games; DSV Games; Gém Klub Kft.; Meeple On Board; Rexhry
description:
Long ago, the world of Circadia pulsed in perfect rhythm, each habitat watched over by its guardian spirit. But when Day lingered too long and Night grew restless, the strength of the guardians began to wane.

You are a Guide of the Dreaming Paths, tasked with leading the Winged Bear, the Rooted Axolotl, and the Cloud Goose back to their domains.

By weaving the powers of Spirit Creatures into harmonious gatherings, you will restore their connection to the Habitats. But only the Guide who brings the most balance back to Circadia will be remembered as the Keeper of the Eternal Cycle.

In this captivating card game, you and your fellow Guides compete as you restore balance to Circadia. On your turn, play Spirit Creature cards to create powerful sets. The stronger the set, the more valuable the Habitat you can claim. Each Habitat card brings you closer to victory by awarding Balance points. Carefully manage your hand and plan your sets to create a harmonious sequence of Day and Night cards. When one Guide reaches 15 Balance points, it is time for one final round. And the player with the most Balance points wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Mint-Tin Monster Mash-Up
description:
Take on the role of 1 of 4 Mad Scientists and create your Monster Champion by smashing together 2 out of 24 fantastical creatures.

Mint-Tin Monster Mash-Up combines dice, tactics, timing, and deceit into a portable dueling game that’s easy to learn and plays in 15 minutes!

Each Monster Card in the game has a Monster front on one side and a Monster back on the other.  Players will assemble a unique creature by combining a front and back.  The combination will not only determine its battle stats, but also create a unique "if-then" power that can be triggered to sway the tide of battle.

Players will roll dice to determine their Attack.  Energy and special powers can be used to manipulate the results.

Once the dice are locked in, players simultaneously reveal a hand signal.  They can add 0-5 Attack by "Boosting" (spending Energy), or they can Defend to reduce their Damage and regain Energy equal to their intelligence, or they can hit the "Panic Button" and force both players to re-roll.  BUT, if a player Defends against a Panic Button, they auto-kill their opponent's creature.

The loser of the battle takes damage equal to the Arena level plus any special attack damage.  The Arena gets increasingly deadly until a battle is resolved.  When a Monster is killed, the player's Mad Scientist flips over to their more powerful form, giving them an advantage in the next Battle.

The first player to kill 3 of their opponent's Monsters wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Miracle at Dunkerque: The British Withdrawal from France, May-June 1940
description:
In May of 1940 the German army invaded Holland, Belgium and France.  In a matter of a few weeks they rolled up the combined armies of Belgium, France and Great Britain.  The BEF (British Expeditionary Force) and other nearby Allied forces were forced to retreat toward the French coast, resulting in about 400,000 men being surrounded near the town of Dunkirk. Rescue operations commenced to evacuate these forces to England and Winston Churchill, the new Prime Minister of Great Britain, was hopeful that perhaps 30,000 men could be rescued from the trap.  Admiral Sir Bertram Ramsay was put in charge of “Operation Dynamo”, the goal of which was to send ships of all sizes and shapes to evacuate these beleaguered soldiers from the beaches of France and Belgium.  Through skill, efficient planning and poor German coordination (along with some fortuitous luck), the operation was able to rescue an incredible 330,000 men from the pocket. A true military miracle had been performed and by doing so, the future of the Second World War was forever altered.

Miracle at Dunkerque is essentially a solitaire game, but also includes a two-player option. It is meant to recreate the tense situation within the Dunkirk perimeter during those last eight days in May and June 1940.  The game design aims to capture the spirit of the difficult decision-making challenges faced by Allied commanders as they attempted to extricate the remnants of Britain’s last field army from certain capture or death. Historically-based Event Cards drive the action and create varying circumstances each turn. The besieging German forces (army, air and naval units) are controlled by these cards, which are specifically designed to place constant pressure on the player. Allied Player Actions must be allocated each turn for the defense of the perimeter, the creation of evacuee units and the loading of these evacuees from the beaches and moles to available ships and then sailed onward to the safety of England.  You obviously cannot save all the Allied units, so you must choose who stays to fight and who shall attempt to escape in order to continue the struggle against the Nazis another day.

Miracle at Dunkerque is designed by Hermann Luttmann and developed by Paul Fish. Chris Hansen provides additional development and playtesting support. This is the same team that put together the popular game, A Spoiled Victory. However, Miracle at Dunkerque represents a significant enhancement and expansion of that original design concept. The map is more extensive, the player now controls actual naval units that travel back and forth across the English Channel (hopefully loaded with evacuees), more combat units are provided to both sides and the air campaign is now represented. And of course there is the priceless added value of the incredible Legion Wargames production team. But just as importantly, the game system has been honed and polished so that despite the extra detail and chrome, this larger, deluxe edition of the game will play just as quickly as the original did.

The ultimate goal of the Miracle at Dunkerque game design is to provide a different kind of gaming experience for the player – one that is both an evacuation management game and a tough, nail-biting perimeter defense and fighting withdrawal wargame. In any case, we hope that you find it a challenging, unique and fun game that gives you the feel for the nearly impossible position in which the Allied troops found themselves and the true extent of the miracle that occurred on the beaches of France that spring of 1940.

name: Mirianth Pets
description:
Mirianth Pets is a thematic adaptation of the shedding game Ambiente Abissal/Planet etuC, set in the captivating world of Mirianth. In this game for 2 or 3 players, you will have the opportunity to control six fantastical animals from this magical universe, using their unique strength to win the game by getting rid of their hand.

The cards in the game represent the six mystical animals of Mirianth, each with different strengths and weaknesses, depending on the number of players. Each animal has a rank and power, allowing for various ways to outmaneuver your opponents' plays.

The game proceeds in turns, with players playing 1 or 2 cards to beat the current strongest play or passing. When all but one player has passed, the round ends, and the last player to play starts a new round.

When a player successfully plays all their cards, they earn points. Once a player accumulates a certain number of points, they are declared the winner of the game.

name: Mischief
description:
The faerie land of Tír na nÓg is split into two realms: the Realm of Eternal Spring, where the Seelie fae are governed by the ethereal Queen Titania, and the primeval Forest Arden, where the King of Autumn, Lord Oberon, rules over their Unseelie kindred. Oberon and Titania have decided to end their historic rivalry and join their kingdoms by getting married. They have each invited delegations from among their various vassal faeries to come and celebrate the royal wedding at the grandest feast ever seen in a wooded glade.

The players take on the roles of faerie nobility who stand to lose the most from this arrangement, as their position in this new political order is anything but certain. But if you're willing to indulge in some well-timed mischief, you can try to help things move along to your own advantage. The king and queen will be hearing toasts and compliments all night, and faeries are known for their penchant for practical jokes. If you can end the night aligned with the correct factions who managed to look good to the king and queen, you can come out with your position assured.

Mischief is the first title from Dan Cassar's Dream Cult Game Studio, an imprint he hopes to use to share a unique brand of games that is deep, elegant and accessible.

name: Frosted Blooms
publisher: Synapses Games; DSV Games; Elznir Games; Ghenos Games
description:
Welcome to Frosted Blooms

In the soft dawn of a Dutch spring, the last breath of winter lingers in the air, leaving a delicate frost upon the awakening fields. But beneath this shimmering chill, bold tulips begin to bloom vibrant, colorful, and full of promise.

You are one of the master gardeners, competing to create the most admired tulip garden of the season. Every choice you make, each landscape, windmill raised, and each thoughtfully arranged flowers will bring you closer to perfection.

Plan with care, cultivate with style, and let your tulip tapestry shine as the pride of the lowlands!

In Frosted Blooms, players compete to create the most harmonious and valuable tulip garden over the course of 10 rounds.

Each turn, you'll:

Select a Landscape Tile from the market,

Add it to your garden,

Play a Landscape Card from your hand to score based on patterns.

And, if you enclose empty spaces, fill them with Workers, Barns, or Windmills for big end-game bonuses.

By creating specific groups in your garden, and adding certain features, you can fulfill objectives that score additional points at the end of the game. At the end of 10 rounds, the player with the most points win the game!

—description from the publisher

name: Mission Amazonia
description:
In Mission Amazonia a strategic deckbuilding board game you are part of a Brazilian team of rainforest protectors. From your headquarters (e.g. Pôrto Velho) you go on different missions north and south of the Amazon to curb the illegal exploitation of the rainforest. The poaching of exotic animal species, the prohibited logging of tropical timber or the poisoning of rivers through illegal gold mining are your daily challenges. Now the race against time begins, and the question is whether you can collaborate effectively as a team and use your resources (such as vehicles, night vision devices, satellite images, GPS, etc.) and skills wisely to slow down or even stop the extinction of species and the ongoing deforestation.


     Explore the Amazon rainforest on realistic maps (covering the states of Rondônia, Pará and Amazonas) in 10 chapters where you can experience the deforestation in 5-year steps (starting from the late 1980s).



     Use your equipment (vehicles, satellite images etc.) wisely and purchase new tools (drone, night vision device, GPS, etc.) at the right time.



     The maps and new rules for every chapter are summarized in the 24-page chapter book. That allows players to jump in or out with ease.



     Get more experience as a team over a 10+ hour campaign.

name: Mission to Earth
description:
Word reached the spacestation Nexus-9 about a tiny planet called Earth. They have invented the one thing all lifeforms in the galaxy need. The five biggest corporations in the galaxy want the invention, and they want it first.

In Mission to Earth players play as one of five alien corporations trying to get to Earth first. Players have to buy three different upgrades for their spaceship in order to make it to Earth. Plus they need two pilots to fly through the tricky parts of space.

You mine, steal or trade crypto currency and you use this currency to gain the favour of pilots. But beware, the pilots are not the nicest people in the galaxy and they just might go with someone else. In the meantime try to hinder the other corporations by spying on them, seducing them or use "diplomacy" to sabotage their plans.

The first to have the three upgrades and two pilots on their side gets to Earth and wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Mission Zero
description:
Mission Zero is new climate-themed strategic card game designed for ages 9+ and adults, combining fast-paced strategy with real-world decarbonization education.

Think: renewable energy, carbon capture, disasters, and a bit of greenwashing sabotage — all packed into 20–40 minutes of fun.

—description from the publisher

name: Mission: Wild Life
description:
Mission: Wild Life - the trick-taking game with exciting challenges.
Off you go on exciting missions! This trick-taking game is all about wild animals. They need certain conditions to thrive. In an exciting competition, you compete with the help of sun, water, plants and co. to provide the animals with a habitat. Whoever has the most animals at the end wins the game.
With five different coloured cards from 1-8, you vie for the animals' favour. The giraffe wants the most 7s, while the desert fox is happy to have the fewest grey cards. Are you ready to set off on your adventure mission?

—description from the publisher

name: Model's Counterattack
description:
Eastern Front, Summer 1944: Soviet forces launch a major offensive, codenamed BAGRATION, which destroys a large portion of the German army positioned in the central sector. The Soviets advance as far as the Vistula River, reaching the outskirts of Warsaw. General Model, by rallying some relatively intact forces and counterattacking from various directions, manages to halt the offensive, at least temporarily. All this occurs as Warsaw rises up, and, a little further south in Magnuszew, other Soviet forces succeed in crossing to the western side of the Vistula, creating a dangerous bridgehead...

The game consists of ten turns in total.
Each turn represents one day of real time. Each hex represents a distance of about two kilometers from side to side. Units vary from brigades to battalions, most of them armored, mechanized or motorized.

Complexity is rated 2 out of 5 and an average game duration is about 4-5 hours.

GAME COMPONENTS

    1 standard box - 30x22x3.5 cm
    2 identical standard maps - 56x86 cm (22x34 inches)
    2 counter sheets, 14.5 mm counters - 176 counters per countersheet
    1 color rulebook (16 pages in English, 16 pages in Italian)
    5 A4 size cards
        1 table card in English and Italian
        1 setup and reinforcement card in English and Italian
        1 German events description card in English and Italian
        1 Soviet events description card in English and Italian
        1 German/Soviet tank guide
    
    2 dice


(from publisher's website, corrected by BGG user)

name: Modern Diplomacy
description:
Turn the page to the complex world of Modern Diplomacy, the ultimate solitaire bookgame that challenges you while navigating the complex landscape of global pressure and flash points. As the leader of the United States, you'll engage in strategic power plays using Economic, Diplomatic, and Military abilities on the world stage. Competing against a formidable AI opponent representing the combined might of Russia and China, you'll need to outsmart, outplan, and ultimately outmaneuver them to achieve world domination.

This game offers a unique perspective into modern political struggles, where every move counts and alliances can shift in the roll of a die. With immersive gameplay that blends strategy and diplomacy, Modern Diplomacy is perfect for those who appreciate a challenge and want to explore the intricacies of international relations in under 30 minutes. Each book provides 20 game plays.

Will you rise as the global superpower, or will you fall to the cunning strategies of your rivals? The world's fate rests in your hands; all you need is a die, a pen, and a sense of adventure.

—description from the publisher

name: Modern Mint
description:
Step into the high-stakes world of startups and investments with Modern Mint, the strategy board game that dares you to fulfill your entrepreneurial dream and mint a fortune. While many board games explore fantastical realms, Modern Mint pulls you into the tempestuous seas of innovation and investment. It's a strategy board game that finds adventure in the real world, where the stakes are as high as the rewards and you can build an empire from your wits and daring.

				
				
					Game OverviewIn Modern Mint, 3 to 6 players step into the roles of visionary Founders or shrewd Investors to compete and collaborate over a series of game rounds, each representing a full business year. The goal is simple: become the wealthiest player by building the most valuable business empire. Four Founders will work to turn their dreams into reality, while two Investors will use their capital and influence to back the most promising ventures for a handsome return.

The game unfolds through three key phases each round:

     Fundraising Phase: Founders pitch their grand visions to secure capital. This is a dynamic stage of negotiation where deals are struck, partnerships are formed, and investors decide who to back. Will you give up equity for a cash infusion or bootstrap your way to the top?
     Action Phase: With capital in hand, Founders get to work. Grow your company by launching new verticals, upgrading your team, investing in PR & Marketing, or seeking guidance from powerful Mentors. An innovative action-point system creates a strategic tension: the more you do this year, the later you'll act in the next, forcing you to balance short-term hustle with long-term positioning.
     Revenue Phase: The moment of truth! See how your business decisions paid off as you calculate your earnings. But beware—unpredictable Market Event cards can shake things up with economic booms, recessions, or industry-wide disruptions, forcing all players to adapt on the fly.


				
				
					Key Features
     Real-World Inspired Gameplay: Experience the authentic challenges of entrepreneurship. Negotiate deals, manage resources, and balance risk versus reward under pressure. Every choice carries weight, mirroring the real founder’s journey from a bold idea to a thriving enterprise.
     Dynamic Player Roles: Play as a visionary Founder, building a company from the ground up, or as a powerful Investor, funding startups and shaping the market. The tension and synergy between these roles create a rich, interactive experience.
     Engaging and Social: Modern Mint is designed for memorable table dynamics. Alliances will form and crumble, friendly rivalries will emerge, and you'll find yourself cheering, gasping, and laughing as fortunes are made and lost. It's the most fun you'll have screaming at your friends!
     Strategic Depth and Replayability: With multiple paths to victory, unique company ventures to launch, and unpredictable market events, no two games are ever the same. You'll learn, adapt, and refine your strategy with every play.
     Business with Heart & Brain: More than just a game, Modern Mint is a celebration of bravery and smart decision-making. It teaches strategic thinking, adaptability, and negotiation in a way that is both entertaining and empowering, leaving you inspired for your next tabletop adventure.



—description from the publisher

name: Modern Tactics #1: Afghanistan
description:
Modern Tactics: Afghanistan is a platoon-level system for asymmetric combat (2006–2009). Alternating impulse play captures battlefield friction as coalition patrols trade actions with a nimble insurgency across villages, vineyards, compounds, and wadis. Spend impulses to move, fire, breach, rally, or call support—your opponent answers, action for action.

Leaders extend command and steady morale; suppression and opportunity fire punish overexposure. Vehicles and air power slot cleanly into infantry fights: LAVs, MRAPs, tanks, mortars, off-board artillery, and gunships. Civilians, unknown contacts, IEDs, and rules of engagement keep the battlespace tense and human, rewarding careful positioning and measured tempo.

The scenario set ranges from raids and convoy escorts to set-piece assaults.

Game info: ~50 m per hex, turns of a few minutes; hex-and-counter with alternating impulses, leadership & morale, suppression, breaching, vehicles, OBA/air; scenario-driven.

name: Peacock
publisher: Unfringed; DSV Games; Oka Luda Editions
description:
The seasons are changing and these well dressed birds are looking for a new place to call home. Hard-headed Eagle Owls love company in warm weather but need some personal space when it’s cold. Regal Kingfishers and Determined Woodpeckers thrive together when food is plenty, but what happens when it’s scarce? Over three seasons, create sanctuaries as fetching as the birds themselves in this simultaneous drafting and bonus-driven set collection game.

Experience a novel take on seasonal change by rotating and upgrading location cards each round/season to reflect changing food availability, whilst carefully balancing a variety of bonuses, from bird buddy benefits to full flock freebies.

—description from the designer

name: Molly
description:
In the peaceful garden, little underground engineers are digging tunnels everywhere. There’s no time to waste—it’s time to uncover the adorable moles!

Gather sets of moles, but there’s a problem: as soon as you catch one, the others hide!

Form sets of three matching moles, trigger special effects, and explore the advanced mode where a friendly dog will help you in your search.

Who will become the best mole collector?

—description from the publisher

name: Molly House
description:
In Molly House, players take the roles of the gender-defying mollies of early eighteenth century London. Throw grand masquerades and cruise back alleys while evading moralistic constables who seek to destroy your community. Be careful, there may even be informers in your midst!

Players draft hands of vice cards representing the different gestures, desires, and encounters that were frowned upon by the Society for the Reformation of Manners, a citizen group that sought to stamp out any behavior it deemed deviant in late 17th and early 18th century London. These cards allow players to host festivities with the help of their fellow mollies and create joy. But, those same cards can also lead players to be arrested and to the ultimate ruin of the molly house.

As players encounter the Society’s enforcers, they will often have to pay bribes or may be coerced into becoming informers for the Society. Informers must try desperately to undermine the community around Mother Clap’s Molly House without being discovered by their fellow mollies.

name: Mongoose
description:
A small aggressive deduction game.

You have two animals hiding in the bush.  You can see everyone else’s animals but not your own!  By fighting or cooperating with other animals you can win food and clues as to which animals you have.

The winner is the first player to successfully guess both their animals or to accumulate four more food than every other player.

—description from the designer

name: Monikers: Family Edition
