As you complete encounters and travel through the Isles, your character evolves, allowing you to strategically customize your playstyle for future challenges.

●    EARN TROPHIES AND SCORE POINTS: Players earn trophies for completing the most encounters, visiting various locations, and mastering the art of battle on their quest. With multiple ways to earn points, every decision matters, making for a strategy game filled with competitive excitement and challenges!

●    COLLECT TREASURE, USE POTIONS, AND CONQUER MONSTERS: Treasure cards offer special rewards, while potion tokens provide an extra boost during tough encounters. Choose wisely as you enlist the help of treasures and potions at key moments to gain an advantage over your rival players in the battle for victory.

●    PERFECT FOR FANS OF STRATEGIC BOARD GAMES AND FANTASY: With its engaging mechanics, evolving characters, and immersive, whimsical setting, DragonIsles is a must-have for players who enjoy adventure games, dice-rolling strategy, and tactical decision-making. Whether you're a fan of the Dragon series or new to the enchanting world, this game offers endless replayability and fun for anyone aged 10+. Add it to your next family game night or social gathering for endless adventure.

—description from the publisher

name: Perfect Health Company
description:
As CEOs of pharmaceutical companies in Perfect Health Company, players control their production lines to carry out their "perfect" plans.

Each player has a profile sheet to track points and resources and a schedule sheet on which they'll move their pawn. The game starts with a planning phase in which you receive resources and mark spots on your schedule sheet.

In the production phase that follows, you roll two dice and pick one to move your pawn. If you move to a space with symbols — e.g., a liquid, capsule, or syringe — you add them to your profile sheet. When you stop at a shop, you can purchase additional points and add skills to your schedule sheet to make spaces more valuable. Moving your pawn faster than the other players or meeting the conditions on bonus cards revealed at the beginning of the game earns you additional points.

After a player completes three laps, the first round ends. Players then have a second planning phase to boost their schedule sheet, then you continue play, with the game ending after a player completes seven laps.

Manipulate your dice rolls, heal your employees, and make the most of the skills you have to carry out medicine production more perfectly than anyone else!

name: Lying Cheating Raccoons
description:
Welcome to the merciless world of Lying, Cheating Raccoons, where sneaky strategy and quick thinking will determine the ultimate trash bandit! In this fast-paced bluffing game, players roll their dice, hide their results, and then decide whether to tell the truth or lie their way to victory. Will you keep it safe, bluff, or challenge your opponents? Stay one step ahead of the competition, collect trash tokens, and prove you’re the craftiest raccoon in the group. But beware—call out the wrong bluff, and you might just lose it all! Are you ready to roll the dice and see how much you can get away with? Add Lying, Cheating Racoons to your collection of family board games and card games for a sneaky, good time!


     A FAST-PACED GAME OF BLUFFING, STRATEGY, AND TRICKERY: Lying, Cheating Raccoons challenges players to outsmart their opponents using deception, distraction, and a bit of luck! Bluff about your die roll, steal tokens, and keep your true intentions hidden as you fight to become the raccoon with the most delicious trash treats. 



     HIDE YOUR ROLL, MAKE YOUR CALL, AND KEEP A POKER FACE: Each player secretly rolls their raccoon die under their garbage can and decides whether to tell the truth or try to sneak their action of choice. Other players must choose whether to accept their move or call their bluff—get caught lying, and you face consequences!



     CHALLENGE YOUR OPPONENTS, STEAL TOKENS, AND CLAIM VICTORY! Players can attempt to take trash tokens from their left, right, or any opponent of their choice. But opponents can challenge the action. If your move is challenged, and your challenger is correct, you must forfeit your tokens.



     FUN, EASY TO LEARN, AND REPLAYABLE: Designed for fast rounds and endless replayability, Lying, Cheating Raccoons is perfect for family game nights, parties, after school, or any time you want an entertaining family party game. 



     PERFECT FOR FANS OF LIAR’S DICE AND LEFT, RIGHT CENTER: If you love bluffing games like Liar’s Dice and Luck Games like LCR, you’ll enjoy the mischievous, competitive nature of Lying, Cheating Raccoons. It’s a must-have for players who love deception, strategy, and cheating! 


—description from the publisher

name: Perfect Stranger
description:
Get to know your friends in this versatile and easy-to-pick-up party game from Pillbox. Draw a question card for the group to answer. Everyone places a YES or NO card face down. Take turns drawing number cards for how many YESes you believe is in the pile. The rulebook includes so many ways to play including a 1-on-1 variant.

—description from the publisher

name: Pergola
publisher: Rebel Studio; Galápagos Jogos; Gém Klub Kft.; MIPL
description:
In Pergola, players develop their gardens, grow new plants, and attract insects and small animals. On their turn, a player chooses one of the four available tools, picks the presented items, and arranges them in their garden. Then they perform the action corresponding to the chosen tool. Since players have a lot of freedom in arranging plants in their gardens, after fifteen rounds each garden looks completely different and scores differently. The player who accumulates the most points wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Persecuted: Kraków
description:
On September 6, 1939, German troops entered Kraków, beginning its occupation. Just 12 days later, on September 18, the first underground resistance newspaper was published, and soon after, more clandestine organizations began to form. In this game, your mission is to create a resistance movement. Sometimes, you will have the support of loyal friends, but beware — there may be traitors among you. Will you rise to the challenge?

In Persecuted: Kraków, players cooperate to search districts for useful items cards and boost their stats. They can also move using action points, try to  avoid German guards and control the amount of taxes. Another option is a day's work (rolling a die). Sometimes, players can also use their characters' special abilities. Victory is achieved when each player has 7 resistance points.

In competitive mode, players can try to claim a cooperative victory, but one false move and one of them can turn into a collaborator. From that point on, their task is to make all the other players collaborators and then beat them for points.

name: Forbidden Legacy
description:
You and your fellow adventurers have landed on an empty crumbling city floating high above the Earth. You must repair the portal, travel in time, all the while keeping the city afloat.

Will you survive long enough to uncover the secrets of the ancient city?

Forbidden Legacy hurls your team into a thrilling seven-episode quest where every choice counts. Work together through shifting moments in time, unlock abilities, reveal hidden components, and trigger lasting changes that reshape the game.

Like the classic Forbidden adventures, teamwork and daring moves are essential - but now the world evolves with you. New rules emerge, challenges escalate, and with each episode the city - and your path - transforms forever.

7 REPLAYABLE GAMES!
Seven linked episodes with choices that change the story each time you play.
UNBOX THE UNEXPECTED!
Open mystery boxes, hidden panels, and surprises as the story progresses.
COOPERATIVE FUN!
Team up to solve challenges and survive each episode together.
A STORY THAT REMEMBERS!
Your decisions carry over to the next game and then the next.
GRAPHIC-NOVEL GUIDED ADVENTURE!
The tale soars across the page in classic pulp fashion.
EASY TO LEARN GAMEPLAY!
Simple to start, with plenty of strategy as you go.

—description from the back of the box

name: Perspectópolis
description:
In this semi-cooperative game of strategy and deduction, the fate of the friends lies in your hands.

Embark on an extraordinary adventure in the whimsical world of Perspectópolis! When Alice and her friends stumble upon a mysterious wooden box bearing the inscription "Perspectópolis," they are transported to a dimension where reality bends and twists in fantastical ways.

As players, you must take on the roles of Alice, Ethan, Mark, Olivia, and even Whisper the cat as you navigate the mind-bending streets of Perspectópolis. Your mission? To find the elusive amulets, rescue Whisper, and unlock the portal back home. But beware, Perspectópolis is filled with enigmatic inhabitants and perplexing puzzles. Each turn, you'll explore the pentagonal-shaped board, seeking clues from the locals to uncover the whereabouts of the amulets and your companions.

Will you unravel the secrets of Perspectópolis and escape back to Villa Willowbrook, or will you be forever lost in this surreal dimension?

—description from the publisher

name: Pesky Island
description:
Under the white sand of Pesky Island there are many treasures to discover. Explore the entire island and collect as many precious stones as you can. Will you manage to have more than your opponents before the loot runs out?
Roll the dice, and pick up the precious stones, but take care with the other pirates and the skull, they try to pick yours!

—description from the publisher

Bajo la blanca arena de Pesky Island se encuentran numerosos tesoros por descubrir. Explora toda la isla y recoge las máximas piedras preciosas que puedas. ¿Conseguirás tener más que tus adversarios antes de que se termine el botín?
Lanza el dado y recoge las piedras preciosas, pero ten cuidado con los otros piratas y la calavera, ¡intentarán quitarte las que hayas cogido!

—description from the publisher (Spanish)

name: Pet Names: A Game of Endearments
description:
In Pet Names: A Game of Endearments, you'll be competing to create the best nicknames in each round- first to three wins the game!

There are 400 mini cards snuggled inside a plush fox bag called Charlie that you will use to create endless combinations of playful, charming, or hilarious nicknames. Bonus: Charlie the fox plush also doubles as a cute mini ba g- just attach your favorite strap to carry your hands free crossbody bag.

In each round, every player makes one pet name for the person holding Charlie using 2 to 4 cards from their hand. Make it funny, sweet, or silly—whatever you think fits them best! Players may also choose to draw from the pool of face-up cards on the table or a random card from Charlie. Always replenish the pool of face-up cards to five.

Once everyone has made their pet names, players read them aloud to the subject (the person holding Charlie), going clockwise.  The subject chooses their favorite pet name, and the player who created it wins the round.

The first player to have three winning nicknames chosen wins Pet Names!

—description from the designer

name: Petals
description:
In Petals, you'll have to create an enchanting garden where you'll combine Elemental Flowers while trying to maintain a delicate balance.  You'll have to earn points on four different Elemental Trackers. And you'll have to do so in a balanced way because... winning doesn't always mean victory.

Each Petals card contains parts of four Elemental Flowers of different colors, and each Flower contains a different number. On your turn, you will have two cards in your hand to choose which one to play, along with any cards already on the table.

Your goal will be to match numbers, colors, or both, and thus score points on each of the four Elemental Trackers, while a beautiful garden forms before your eyes.

In addition, some cards contain Elemental Symbols, which will allow you to score higher or even reposition a card that is already on the table to score again.

Lastly, you must have the highest score in at least one of the four Trackers, but you will only win if you have maintained balance in all of them.

Petals is a beautiful, simple, and challenging game. Each card is unique, and every game will be one of a kind.

—description from the publisher

En Petals, tendrás que crear un jardín encantador en el que combinarás Flores Elementales mientras intentas mantener un delicado equilibrio. Tendrás que ganar puntos en cuatro Marcadores Elementales diferentes. Y tendrás que hacerlo de forma equilibrada porque... ganar no siempre significa la victoria.

Cada carta de Petals contiene partes de cuatro Flores Elementales de colores distintos y cada Flor contiene un número diferente. En tu turno tendrás dos cartas en la mano para  elegir cuál te conviene jugar, junto a alguna carta que ya esté sobre la mesa.

Tu objetivo será hacer coincidir números, colores o ambas cosas, y así puntuar en cada uno de los cuatro Marcadores Elementales, mientras se va formando un precioso jardín ante tus ojos.

Además, algunas cartas contienen Símbolos de Elementos, que te permitirán incrementar tu puntuación o, incluso, coger una carta que ya esté colocada sobre la mesa y cambiarla de posición para puntuar de nuevo.

Y, por fin, para poder ganar tendrás que haber ganado en, al menos, uno de los cuatro Marcadores, pero solo ganarás si has conservado el equilibrio entre todos ellos.

Petals es un juego bonito, sencillo y exigente. Cada carta es única y cada partida será irrepetible.

—description from the publisher (Spanish)

name: KeyForge: Discovery
description:
KeyForge: Discovery is a set of more than 300 classic KeyForge cards chosen for their simplicity, intuitiveness, and fun factor. Every unique deck generated from this set provides an easy introduction to the game, with a focus on core game mechanics and only a minimal use of keywords.

There is just enough variety and depth to keep both new and veteran players excited and engaged in discovering what KeyForge has to offer.

Players will call upon the strength of these houses in the set: Brobnar, Dis, Logos, Sanctum, Shadows, Star Alliance, and Untamed.

name: Pets Against Humanity
description:
Pets Against Humanity is the adult party game where your dog’s balls, your cat’s attitude, and your parrot’s foul mouth take center stage. This game blends dark humor, pet shenanigans, and NSFW fun into one wild deck of laughs. (Publishers description)

Players draw the same amount of black answer cards each (e.g. 10). Then choose a judge who draws white card with pet-related question or fill-in-the-blank prompt. Each player gives their answer to judge who chooses the funniest combo. Winner gets the question card as a point. Then the next player is the judge. Winner is the player who gets most or agreed amount of point cards to win (e.g. 5).

name: Phantasmic
description:
Members of the elite Phantasmic Dueling Squad routinely test their skills against each other. Employ your knowledge of counterhexes to prove that you’re the best of the best.

Prove your magical prowess in this strategic bluffing game. Play spells and counterspells against each other in rotating duels. Make use of each spellcasting style’s abilities to turn the tables on your opponents and trick them into making a mistake!

Each turn the Leader picks a Challenger and targets them with a spell. The Challenger plays a counterspell and declares whether it is stronger or weaker than the Leader’s spell. The Leader must decide whether to believe the Challenger or not. The Challenger then reveals their card, resolving any revealed effects. If the Leader guessed correctly, they win the duel and keep the Leader role; otherwise they lose the duel and the Challenger becomes the next Leader. Play until someone wins or loses 3 duels. The first player to win 3 duels is the winner! Otherwise, if any player loses 3 duels, all other players win!

name: Phantom Epoch
description:
Phantom Epoch is a deep, big box campaign game that sets up in 5 minutes. It's played on heavy stock mission books and uses innovative HP Tracking Bases to keep all the necessary information on the map with minimal bookkeeping.

It's a fully cooperative tactical combat roleplaying board game with a persistent, choice-driven, 40+ mission campaign that blends sci-fi and fantasy themes.


In a galaxy where the secrets of interstellar travel have been lost to time and primitive peoples war over ancient technology, players are thrust into missions to stop an encroaching threat. As they play through missions on numerous planets with a variety of biomes, they will discover the true nature of their enemy, and will have the opportunity to unearth the rich story of the world of Phantom Epoch.

A wide range of character choices, including human and alien species which can be combined with a diverse set of classes, allows players to create and grow their own characters to match their own play style. Each mission has its own map, objectives, enemies, and challenges. Every map has a completely unique layout. No two missions will be the same, and players will have to adjust their strategies accordingly.

Outside of missions, players will need to gather resources to repair and restore functionality to the starship that serves as their headquarters. Doing so will unlock facilities to improve their characters with upgraded equipment, attributes, and skills. As secrets from the past are revealed, they will gain combat knowledge in the form of branching advanced classes that allow players to further customize and empower their characters.

Before missions, players prepare their equipment and Action cards that they'll bring with them on a mission. During a mission, players and adversaries simultaneously select Action cards at the start of each round. The selected cards determine the turn order for the round. During their turns the players and adversaries play the selected action cards one at a time. The campaign is made up of 40+ missions, and ends when the final story mission is played. As a fully cooperative game, players win a mission together by completing the mission objective, or lose together when all players are defeated or the objective is failed.

name: Phantom Ink: Arcana
description:
A standalone expansion to the party game Phantom Ink, Phantom Ink: Arcana adds 75 brand new question cards, over 200 new secret objects, a cooperative 2-3 player gameplay mode, and 22 fully-illustrated tarot-themed Arcana cards with unique special abilities to spice up gameplay.

Players form two teams, both competing to identify the same secret object. Teams take turns passing their spirit question cards, like “What would it have as a pet?” or “What is a jumbo version of it called?” Spirits know the secret object, and answer the questions in order to provide clues to help their mediums guess the secret object.

Each turn, the mediums can spend a crystal to play one of their Arcana cards, which gives their team a one-time or permanent bonus to help them figure out the object. For example, increasing their hand size of question cards they can choose from, or letting them secretly learn the next letter of one of their clues.

There’s a catch: the other team doesn’t see what question you asked, but they do see the answer. Mediums call “Silencio” when they know the Clue their Spirit is writing, to make it hard for the other team to learn anything from the Clue.

—description from the publisher

name: Phase
description:
Phase is heavily celestial in theme with moons, stars, and astronomical events such as: blue moons, meteor showers, and eclipses.

Gameplay is comprised on playing moon phase cards on a gameboard to make pairs and build moon phase sequences. There are also wildcards which can change aspects of gameplay; for instance: getting a second turn, scoring more points for pairs, removing cards from the board, and everyone discarding their hand.

To keep track of points, players use a pool of star tokens to denote which pairs or sequences they made. Other players may steal points by making a new pair or by adding to a sequence. Once a board is full, you gain any star tokens of your color and add them to the ones you've won during play. The goal of the game is to have the most star tokens (points).

—description from the designer

name: KeyForge: Prophetic Visions
description:
In KeyForge: Prophetic Visions you will use foresight and scrying to foil your opponents. Why? For more Æmber, of course!

KeyForge: Prophetic Visions is the ninth KeyForge set featuring the same great game system with tons of new cards and new game mechanics. It features these exciting new elements:


     Prophecy cards, an entirely new card type
     Fate effects
     200 new cards for the Dis, Logos, Sanctum, Saurian, Shadows, Star Alliance, and Untamed Houses


Beware, the rebellious House Redemption has been spotted usurping House Sanctum in select packs!

—description from the publisher

name: Mindbug x King of Tokyo
publisher: Nerdlab Games; GaGa Games; Game Harbor; Gém Klub Kft.; Ghost Galaxy; IELLO
description:
Mindbug invades Tokyo!
The unique card battler – now with Kaiju!

     Control powerful King of Tokyo monsters using the acclaimed Mindbug mechanic. 
     Roll the special die to trigger crazy attack effects.
     Spend energy to buy unique and game-changing Power cards!
     Playable alone or with all Mindbug sets.


—description from the publisher

name: Photo Tour: North America
description:
Photo Tour is a game that allows you to travel and take stunning photographs of beautiful places in the USA and Canada. As a photographer, you aim to capture attractions and place their cards in your traveler's diary (player's mat). Each photo taken has a unique ability that allows you to build a card engine to make each turn more efficient.

Players take turns and perform 1 of 4 basic actions:


     Planning. Choose 1 of the available attraction cards and take it in your hand to visit on one of your next moves.
     Movement. Choose 1 available transport dice and move across the game board by the chosen method - airplane, bus, or car.
     Photo Equipment Renting. Choose 1 available equipment token and place it in your travel journal to create more interesting photos during the photo shoot.
     Taking a photo. While in the right location, place the landmark card from your hand into your travel journal. You can enhance the photo by using camera tokens to gain additional victory points.


Build the card "engine" to activate bonus effects of visited attractions or use one-time bonuses of your travel journal. Use strong combinations of bonuses to make each turn better and better.

—description from the publisher

name: Aberration
description:
Step into a world veiled in darkness, where shadows and aberrations lurk. The sanctuary of your village is being threatened, and in this perilous hour, you stand as its last defense.

Aberration offers a thrilling cooperative tower defense experience. In this harrowing blend of horror and survival, you will find worker placement, bag building, and asymmetric player powers. Shadow and light intertwine in a fog-of-war mechanic that shrouds the truth and conceals lurking terrors. As the tainted forest succumbs to the influence of The Great Beast, each game unveils a unique and corrupted landscape, engulfing the map as you play. Adding tension and terror to every moment. But beware, for the forest's very essence transforms, as do players and enemies alike, ascending towards newfound power, but at what cost…

Join forces with veteran game designer Peter Lee (Lords of Waterdeep, Horrified, and Tyrants of the Underdark) as he summons you into this dark fantasy realm.

In the face of this unfolding nightmare, can you survive the night?

name: Pieland: Attack of the SNACs
description:
Roll your dice, collect your gear and take a tour of Pieland as you protect the Piesons against the dangerously delicious SNAC's (Spooky Nectar Affected Creatures).

Attack of the SNACs is a 2-4 player game that lets players play a light competitive adventure in less time then it takes to bake a pie. Intended to be a bridge game for players new to the hobby, Attack of the SNACs features many familiar euro mechanics  in American style trappings of push-your-luck monster slaying with an emphasis on player story telling and food puns!

Over several rounds players alternate between a hunting phase, going out into the wilderness to slay dangerous monsters, and a town phase, where players take their spoils from the hunt and improve their characters and complete quests.

Once the lands of Pieland has been cleared of monsters, the players count quests, monsters slain, secret quests and extra bonuses to see who will be the next Huntmasters Apprentice.

—description from the publisher

name: Pierwsza osada
description:
You are settlers in search of new lands. You have just discovered uninhabited islands! Each player takes control of one of them. It is up to you to decide how your islands will develop and how you will manage them.

Pierwsza osada ("First Settlement") is a card game in which players, on their turn, will choose cards from the market and their hand and add them to their play area—their settlement on the newly discovered island. The better you plan your settlement’s development, the more points you will earn—each type of card grants points in a different way. You can also gain additional points if merchants visit your island.

At the end of the game, each player’s settlement will consist of 16 cards. The player with the most points wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Pigeon Explosion
publisher: Cranio Creations; Broadway Toys LTD; Elznir Games; Muduko; Popcorn Games; TLAMA games; Tranjis Games
description:
Pigeons are always hungry and eat whatever they find in front of them: your task is to feed your pigeons to make them happy or feed opponent pigeons to make them explode!
The game is divided into turns, which proceed clockwise starting from the first player until the game ends. During your turn, choose to perform one of the following two actions:

Search - Draw 2 cards from the Search deck. If the deck is
exhausted, shuffle the discard pile and form a new draw pile.
or

Feed - Play up to 2 cards between Food and Action cards from your hand.
The only limitation in playing cards is that you can only play 1 Food card on opponent Pigeons each turn.

The goal of the game is to make your pigeons happy by feeding them with the correct amount of food and preventing them from exploding!
The first player to achieve 2 or 3 Happy Pigeons (depending on the number of players) will be the winner!

—description from the publisher

name: Pilgrims: Curious Adventures
publisher: Pink Troubadour; DiceTree Games; POTAM games; Vagabund
description:
Embark on a journey through a fairytale land as a wanderer seeking new experiences. A competitive family game where players collect useful items, meet unusual friends, and experience numerous adventures. Become the most seasoned wanderer with sleeves full of the best stories - the star of every campfire gathering! Based on the video game of the same name by Amanita Design, Pilgrims will speak to all its fans!

The game is played over 4 rounds and it is built around a movement-puzzle mechanic, where each turn presents a small riddle: how to best combine your party's movement abilities to navigate the map and collect the right cards. The players try to complete as many adventure cards as possible and gain victory points. These points symbolize the fame and wealth, both material and spiritual, that their group has acquired.

Each player will move their piece across the map to collect items and gain new companions for their group. By successfully combining their character and item cards, they can trigger additional actions. The collected items and companions will then be used to complete adventure cards. Each completed adventure rewards the player with victory points and a permanent upgrade that will help them throughout the game. The player with the most victory points at the end of the 4th round wins.

The game is being developed in cooperation between Pink Troubadour and Amanita Design.

name: Pili Pili
description:
Pili Pili is a trick-taking card game with variable missions. At the beginning of each round, players bet on how many tricks they expect to win. Special mission cards alter the rules from round to round, forcing players to adjust their strategy.

Players score if they meet their bet, but mistakes give them “pili” penalty tokens. Too many pilis, and the game is lost. The mix of betting, variable rules, and trick-taking creates a light and dynamic game suitable for families and larger groups.

name: Companion Quest
description:
Stibbles and his family of tiny gnomes have BIG trouble on their hands...

The mischievous creature, Gu'Gu, is up to no good. Opening portals across the land and causing chaos. These magic doors drop dangerous creatures everywhere they don't belong, and the many locations you'll venture through contain challenges the gnomes must face.

This band of unlikely heroes will need to team up with wild Companions along their journey, as well as collect resources and complete Quests with the helpful guidance of the legendary adventurer Stibbles! A long and magical path stands between the gnomes and the troublesome Gu'Gu, venture through the portals, and set things right!

Companion Quest is a cooperative game for 1-4 players, who take on the role of gnomes, tasked with preventing Gu'Gu from causing chaos. Players will collect magical Energy Cubes (dice), tasty Snacks (resources), and fantastical Companions (abilities) along the way. Each Companion has unique abilities that allow players to manipulate their dice to overcome the challenges they will face.

Complete quests before the Mischief Meter reaches the end of the track and things spiral out of control!

—description from the publisher

name: Apex Legends: The Board Game
publisher: Glass Cannon Unplugged; Albi; Board Bound; Delta Vision Publishing; Elznir Games; Rebel Sp. z o.o.
description:
Apex Legends: The Board Game is a highly competitive miniatures game, in which opposing squads of Legends—warriors with exceptional combat skills and abilities—airdrop onto a gradually shrinking battleground to compete for fame and glory in a series of matches. The players make use of a wide variety of weapons and actions at their disposal to work together with the squadmates and fulfill the ultimate goal of eliminating their opponents and being the last ones standing.

Taking place on the Kings Canyon map, the core experience focuses on the final zone, where the ultimate confrontation unfolds. Each player assumes the role of a unique Legend. The players activate team by team, trying to outmaneuver enemies in the heat of battle and recreate the unpredictable, unforgettable moments known from the source game—securing key positions on the map, snatching valuable loot seconds before an opponent, or diving behind cover or shielding a teammate just in time to save them from oblivion…

Every choice, every move, and every piece of ammo matters!

—description from the publisher

name: Pinball Dice
description:
Pinball Dice is a roll-and-write game that packs all the flashing lights and clattering chaos of a real pinball table onto paper.

Ramps? Check. Bumpers? Oh yes. Targets? Naturally. And yes, there’s even multiball madness and jackpots waiting to be hit. With just one sheet of paper, one pencil and four standard six-sided dice you have real roll and write pinball simulator.

name: Diablo: The Board Game
description:
Diablo: The Board Game is a co-op narrative-driven adventure board game in which players will gather a party of custom characters — known as Champions — and venture through the world of Sanctuary, help those in need, explore dungeons and tombs full of undead horrors, battle the legions of the Netherworld, and traverse the Realms of Creation.

—description from the publisher

name: Pink Soup Game
description:
A fun party and family card game. Become the kitchen chef and dive into a culinary battle! Search for ingredients and cook the strangest and most famous Lithuanian recipes to outsmart the other chefs. But be careful – your rivals are just waiting for a chance to sneak a chili pepper into your pot!

Wait... what did I just drop in there? A potato? An egg? A dessert?! Oh no! The kitchen battle has begun!

—description from the designer

name: Pintó
description: At Pintó, you will be an artist and an interpreter. You will have to draw original works, trying to ensure that not everyone can guess them, but be careful! You need at least one person to be able to do so. Simultaneously, you will have to guess the works of other artists; and so, amid laughter and doodles, you will seek to be the one who scores the most points to establish yourself as the Breakthrough Artist.

name: Piplus
description:
Players gather around to manipulate numbers with cards and dice, aiming to build combinations that outmatch their rivals. Each round becomes a tension-filled contest of intuition, risk-taking, and clever arithmetic where a single die roll can flip the balance of power.

Piplus is a climbing and dice-manipulation game for 2–6 players, where participants play numbered cards and augment their values with dice. Each card from 1 to 10 can be played singly or in sets of matching numbers, climbing over previous plays with equal-length sets of higher values. Dice can be rolled to either enhance card totals or replace card values entirely, adding an element of probability and timing to the standard climbing structure. Players continue rounds until one empties their hand; rankings determine how many dice each player receives in the next round. After three rounds, the player with the highest cumulative score wins.

name: Pipoca
publisher: Ludens Spirit; Samba Estudios; Grok Games
description:
Pipoca is a two-player game that doesn’t require a table or much space — you can play it standing up, leaning against a wall, or even while waiting in line at the movies. It’s perfect for passing the time while waiting with someone.

It’s 18-card game micro climbing game where the goal is to get rid of all your cards. You can play melds and upgrade your cards whenever your opponent beats them. Previously discarded cards return to your hand when you pass.

The first player to go out wins the round, and the overall winner is the first to win two out of three rounds!

—description from the designer

name: Dying Light: The Board Game
publisher: Glass Cannon Unplugged; Elznir Games; Pixie Games
description:
Stay human? In the City, it's easier said than done.

Based on the best-selling video game series, Dying Light: The Board Game sees 1-4 players assume the roles of "Runners" — daredevils trying to outlive the end of civilization in the post-apocalyptic setting of Villedor, the last human outpost on Earth. There, they have to work together to survive wave after wave of the unrelenting, zombie-like "Infected".

While maintaining an intuitive and easy-to-learn ruleset, the game aspires to provide a fresh take on the survival genre, offering both co-operative and true solo experiences. It boasts a sprawling, modular city map with spectacular 3D structures, interactive aids and hazards, an original, adrenaline-fueled parkour and combat system, a menagerie of ghastly enemies, and an impactful day-and-night cycle. Spicing things up is a dynamic narrative that sees the players struggling to stay on the good side of the different factions running the city, forcing them to swiftly adapt to newly revealed threats and rapidly shifting alliances.

name: Pistengaudi
description: On your boards, get set, go! Together, players discover a fast-paced ski route down the hill – over jumps, past huts and through forests. Place your cards strategically to create the fastest route through the valley. Working together could be beneficial, but in the end, it's your own strategy that counts, and whoever reaches the valley first wins. A fast-paced, tactical adventure full of surprising twists and turns and lots of fun for all winter fans!

name: Pitch Battles
description:
Whether it is Inter v. Milan, Madrid v. Atletico or Colchester v. Southend, nothing can match the passion and excitement of a derby football game. With a third of the season played and performances so far nothing to cheer about, old rivalries are rekindled as the days tick by to the biggest derby in the PB National League Top Tier – it's Blues v. Reds.

In Pitch Battles, as the manager of one of the two teams, you will pick your starting line up from your squad and chose your formation. Using you own deck, you will be playing cards to direct players, moving their tokens to tackle, gain possession, pass your way through the opposition’s defence and shoot for goal. You will look to your assistant coach to provide tactical guidance, whilst your team captain will try to inspire and rally the troops. Get the ref on your side and encourage your supporters to cheer and spur your team on. Maybe a bit of intimidation from the fans will sway things your way, encouraged by some  dubious challenges. To win the beautiful game you may need to play ugly. This is the local derby and winning is all that matters!

—description from the designer

name: Pitch Out: Under Vs Aquilies
description:
Pitch Out - Under Vs Aquilies is a box containing new teams for the Pitch Out system, with unique playstyles to refresh strategies. Each Pitch Out box can be played separately (2 players) or combined (3 and 4 players).

It is a disk-flicking game with tactical elements in which players try to take out or isolate the opponent's leader.

The game is played with a bunch of disks (5-8 for the base sets) and five "walls". In turns, players place their pieces and two walls on their side of the field. Then, they start flicking one disk per turn, trying to push the opponent's disks out of the field.
Each disk has a special power, for example the Assassin just needs to touch an opponent's piece to take it out, so players need to play tactically.
The first player to take out the opponent's leader or all their other pieces wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Pizza Roles
description:
Pizza Roles is a ten-minute "filler" hidden roles game where your role is what you want on your pizza but are too timid to say.  Play simulates a conversation about what kind of pizza to order with each player vying for what they want while trying not to seem overbearing.

Eight Topping cards represent the game state. Gameplay consists mostly of moving these Topping cards back and forth between the "not on the pizza" zone and the "on the pizza" zone. Each player is dealt a secret Role card showing their objectives in the game and a small hand of Conversation cards they can play to manipulate the Topping cards.

Players take turns either playing a Conversation card from their hand to change the Toppings or choosing to pass. Players can always choose to pass, but the game will end as soon as the majority of players pass in succession.

When the game ends, players reveal their secret Roles and any Toppings in the "on the pizza" zone will score. Points are totaled and all players with a positive score are joint winners.  Sometimes, everybody wins!

There is also a cooperative mode with slightly modified rules:  Players must work together to make sure that everybody is happy with a pizza because if a single player loses, ALL players lose.  Luckily, players make two pizzas instead of one and only score using the best pizza for each Role.

—description from the publisher

name: 12 Rivers
publisher: Good Games Publishing; A-Z kiadó; Pegasus Spiele
description:
You are the leader of a tribe whose people explore the fabled twelve rivers flowing from a mystical lake high in the mountains. Your goal? To find the magical coloured pearls that roll down the rivers in the current. Perhaps a helpful fairy may help you on your quest! Where the rivers converge there is a village where many people and animals live in harmony. There you can make life-long friends and deliver the pearls you have collected, to be used to heal, grow, and ensure another prosperous year for all.

In each of 5 rounds of play, take turns paying camp cards (resources) to place your 3 tribe tokens into various slots along the rivers, to get the magic pearls you need. Pay more camp card resources to place higher up the rivers to pick pearls earlier. However, with clever placement and use of camp card powers, you can still get valuable pearls efficiently downstream. Use your Tribe tokens to block then collect magic pearls that flow down the 12 rivers. Collect pearls needed by villagers to ensure prosperity for the village at the bottom of the 12 Rivers.

Once all tribe tokens are placed, release the magic pearls to roll down the rivers. Then collect a pearl at each tribe token you placed, and store it on your Alpaca for now. Remaining pearls roll downstream to be blocked and picked at other tribe tokens, or end in the lake.

Along the way you will pick up helpful fairy tokens, and try to match Alpaca goals that reward you with points for collecting sets of particular pearl colours first.

To score the pearls you collect, transfer them to villagers you recruit from the village, and strive to score their bonus goals too. After 5 rounds the player with the most points wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Plague of Dracula
description:
Plague of Dracula is a solitaire game that lets you live(?) the horror in Victorian London while Count Dracula casts his dark shadow across the city. The game faithfully recreates the events depicted in Bram Stoker's classic novel, from the moment of Lucy Westerna's first bite, to the climactic battle at Dracula's castle.

All of the main characters from the book are depicted in the game, including Jonathan and Mina Harker, Lucy Westerna, Doctor Seward, Arthur Holmwood, Quincy Morris, and of course, Professor Van Helsing. Dracula's mad minion Renfield is also depicted, causing trouble as the "hunters" seck to halt the spread of Dracula's plague.

Each turn, the plague spreads and the hunters per form a variety of tasks to help them in their efforts to stop it and eventually turn the tide against Dracula. But as they move into corrupted locations throughout London on a game board inspired by actual locations as well as those depicted within the novel, they draw the attention of the Count's ever growing army of the undead. Merciless attacks can only be turned by the use of occult weapons and failure may result in a hunter turning into a vampire and joining Dracula's side.

Although the game is designed as a solitaire effort, optional rules are included to allow for up to four additional players to join in as either a cooperative and/or antagonistic experience.

Can you, as the cadre of brave vampire hunters work together to turn back Dracula's attempts to turn London into a city of the living dead? Time is running out as London is under attack by the
Plague of Dracula!

—description from the publisher

name: Plakks Basketball
description:
Plakks Basketball is a fast finger-flick dexterity game for 2–4 players. From your side of the court you aim the small ball, flicking it so it bounces off the play surface and arcs into the rival hoop.

Each time you score a basket you advance one of your bench players onto the opponent’s half of the court.

The first coach to place five players in enemy territory wins, so every shot is a mix of skill and timing: take the safe two-pointer or risk a long bank that could turn the tide?

A full match runs 5–15 minutes, perfect for family nights, cafés or quick best-of-three showdowns.

All components are made from recycled materials—solid wood pieces, robust cardboard court and FSC-certified packaging—and meet EN 71 and ASTM safety standards.

With +6 languages on the pieces, anyone aged 6 + can jump straight in and start hearing the tabletop crowd roar.

—description from the designer

name: Playball
description:
Playball is an abstract ball game in which two players compete against each other in exciting and fast-paced matches. The simple rules provide a strategic challenge for players of all ages!

—description from the publisher

In Playball each of the 2 players controls a team of 3 playballers and tries to defend their endzone while getting the ball into their opponents endzone. On your turn you have 3 movement points which you can use all on 1 of your playballers or move 2 or 3 of them. Movement also includes jumping over your or your opponents playballers.

Whenever you move your playballer over the ball (or jump over any playballer who currently has the ball) you immediately take it with you.

You can also pass the ball in a straight line between your playballers as often as you like.

Whoever gains 3 goals first, by taking the ball into the opponents endzone, wins the game.

name: Cytress
description:
Welcome to Cytress. You play as a rebel merc who has zeroed in on one goal. To get into Stratos – Earth’s largest sky hub. It is in this sky colony where you will find Earth’s most powerful, wealthiest, and most influential individuals.

These people enjoy having the largest portion of the pie, not to mention toying with the lives of everyone else on Earth – the Underbelly, as the inhabitants of Stratos love to call it. But you are not the type who tolerates these kinds of apathetic, arrogant attitudes. You must challenge these oligarchs and get into Stratos; you consider this action to be a show of defiance, proof that the leviathan city is not exclusive to the powerful few. 
But first, you must establish a name in the Underbelly, a strategy that will help in getting you and your crew into Stratos. Unfortunately, this is a journey that's not free from danger. Stratos has tight security, and authorities have their eyes on the gates 24/7. Anyone caught entering illegally is subject to instant termination without trial.

Fortunately, you have found a way in. The Tubes – vertical shafts that serve as the city's waste chutes. The Tubes will be your one-way ticket to wonderland, your only chance of acquiring a large portion of the pie. Of course, you will need the help of your crew to get in. So hone your skills, upgrade your abilities, and procure as many supplies as possible to achieve your objective.

You must employ cunning strategies and pick the juiciest missions among the lot. Regardless of which faction you choose, remember to use their key abilities to your advantage. That’s how you can outwit the competition and eventually win the game. So do you have what it takes to become a part of Stratos' elite citizenry? Or do you want to live a continued oppressed existence in the Underbelly?

—description from the designer

name: Pluto Dinerama
description:
In Pluto Dinerama you’ve just opened your very own diner on podunk, wayside, last-chance-to-gas-up-before-you-leave-the-Solar-System Pluto. Now it's time to add to your menu, install new ambience, and hire talented employees in this fascinating to master 2-5 player tableau-building strategy card game.

Pluto Dinerama is both collaborative and competitive, as players will have to work together to defeat the mega-corporate Rival Diner before turning their attention to each other. Pluto Dinerama makes for a great gateway game; it has a rich underbelly of strategic choices and inter-diner trading mechanics, sure, but what makes it so special is how it strategifies party-game elements, making playing an inclusive and hilarious time.

—description from the publisher

name: Pocket Air War: Definitive Edition
description:
Pocket Air War is a fast game of aerial combat in WWII you can play anywhere you want.

Each plane comes with a specific Dashboard. It is the core tool for playing a plane because you can find all the needed information on it. You can also use it to measure distances during Movement and Combat.

The Definitive edition includes all the planes to re-enact the following Operations Theatres:

     Battle of Britain
     Strategic bombing campaign in Europe
     North Africa
     Mediterranean
     Italy
     North Sea
     Eastern Front
     Early and late Pacific
     Korean War


It also includes the new detailed damage model, solo play, crew skills and several other improvements.

—description from the publisher

name: Pocket Paladin
description:
Shadow has fallen over Lorehelm. The Denizens lay defeated. You, a lone Paladin, are what's left of the heroes of the Riverwide Alliance. Mere days remain until the evils of Nul Gador take permanent hold of the crystals. Their plans at the Castle must be stopped before all is lost.

You look Northward, squinting against the burning shadow. You whisper a prayer and take the first steps of your final quest.

Pocket Paladin is an epic solo overland adventure designed to be stored in a single card sleeve. Work your way across the landscape, interacting with map sites like storms, wandering enemies, Mage and Monster towers, secret tunnels, towns and caravans. Unlock new abilities, recruit allies and learn new skills to be prepared to take on more challenging enemies and--ultimately--the enemy's Castle. Complete your quest before time runs out to lift the cover of shadow and bring peace back to Lorehelm!

—description from the publisher

name: Pocket Train Game
description:
Pocket Train Game is a super compact, short 18XX style train game which still delivers a rich train game experience. Starting companies, running trains, companies owning companies, mergers, train rush, stock trashing, takeovers, special abilities and more.

Players invest in railroad companies and expand the railroad network by building and upgrading tiles with track and establish train stations. Build train stations and run trains between them with people and goods generate money to the company shareholders. The game lasts seven game rounds and the player with highest combined wealth in money and shares at the end of the seven rounds wins.

—description from the designer

name: Jisogi: Anime Studio Tycoon
publisher: Esper Game Studio; Choo Choo Games; Good Games Publishing
description:
Jisogi is a worker-placement board game. The theme is Anime, more specifically the hard-working folks and the crushing business behind it.

In this tycoon-style game, players use Staff members (cards placed in front of their personal Studio board) to select from a range of available actions (limited by the type of Staff). Their objective is to release an original Anime composed of 3 Script parts (Setting, Plot, and Twist). Whenever released, players will gain resources and points according to their popularity - determined by the technical level of the Anime and how many genre matches they have to rotating Trend cards.

"Jisogi" comes from 自転車操業, jitenshasōgyō, an expression that refers to barely keeping a business going (an analogy that a bicycle falls over when its wheels cease rotating). Get ready for a challenging tycoon-style game where you'll hustle to make your dream Anime against all odds.

name: Winds of Numa Sera
description:
A Kingdom-Building Strategy Board Game for 3-4 players that shares the same world and characters as the acclaimed graphic novel from Dark Horse.

Each player controls a different asymmetric kingdom that comes with a trio of unique heroes to play as and customize. There are four distinct paths to victory, and whoever is first to achieve any 2 of them, wins the game.

Vast, beautiful, and dangerous, the world of Ethera is full of unique cultures and kingdoms all vying for control of the landscape. From the ordained bloodline of Numa Sera to the valiant knights of Dena Vale, the majestic “cat people” of Meran, and the pillaging hordes of Siaa De’e, each force will stop at nothing to advance its power.

As the leader of your people, your goal is to amass resources and create the most powerful kingdom in all of Ethera so your name will be remembered long after you are gone. There are several ways to achieve this: by conquering strongholds, slaying your
opponents’ heroes, mastering skills, or earning new class titles. You can rule benevolently, cruelly, or anything in between. The choice is yours.

Whichever path you take, you will need to acquire assets to advance your heroes and grow your kingdom. Through exploration of Ethera’s many distinct environments, you will uncover rare items and enlist new allies to assist in your campaign. But exploration also has its risks: Ethera is a dangerous place, full of ancient secrets and hidden obstacles.

So be ever vigilant…

The winds of Numa Sera are blowing.

—description from the publisher

name: Bouba/Kiki
description:
Bouba/Kiki is a cooperative communication game based on the psychological Bouba/Kiki Effect, which is the finding that people tend to make the same associations between sounds and shapes, irrespective of their language or culture. For example, people will tend to associate the nonsense word bouba with a rounded shape and kiki with a spiky shape.

The cards in Bouba/Kiki display a nonsense word on one side, and a simple illustration on the other. In the basic game, you are faced with a set of three of these words and one shape, and must decide which word goes best with the shape. Points are earned by choosing the same target as your teammates.

The game contains six scenarios that expand on this idea, each containing five missions that gradually increase in difficulty and complexity. Each scenario presents a different communication-based setting, such as spacefarers making contact with an alien race, spirit mediums looking into the beyond, or toddlers playing together at a nursery.

—description from the publisher

name: Poker Peril
description:
2 Minutes to Learn. A Lifetime of Entertainment.

Build, bluff, and outplay your opponents in this quick-thinking card game where poker hands meet tactical grid-building.

Each player is dealt 5 cards and takes turns drawing 1 and playing 1, slowly crafting poker hands across their own felt. But you're not just playing your hand—you're watching everyone else's. Tension builds as the deck runs out...

When all sections are filled, it’s showtime. The strongest hands in each section win gold coins, and one step closer to victory.

Use the dynamic Peril Cards to enhance gameplay.

6-7 minutes of highly-strategic hands. 30-35 minutes to crown a victor. 45 minute games if you find yourself playing with Captain Wadoobie :)

Contents
4 Durable Poker Felts
(Double Sided 2-Player Print)
2 Quality Decks
(1 Childproof PVC)
2 Peril Decks
(1 Childproof PVC)
4 Wooden Card Holders
30 Coins w/ Bag
Instructions w/ QRs
Logo Game Bag

—description from the publisher

name: Poker's Rogue Reckoning
description:
Print and Play. Roguelike game using a 54-card deck, colored dice for tracking stats and resolving combat and a 2x2 or 3x3 room grid per
level. Cards are flipped to reveal enemies, potions, curses and money.

name: Pokémon GOITA
description: Pokémon GOITA has very simple rules: compete to see who can put out eight pieces the fastest. But its depth lies in the exquisite interplay of luck and reading each other's moves. While it's a two-on-two cooperative battle, the frustration of not being able to communicate with each other is also fun, and one of its charms is the ability to quickly build up excitement in a short amount of time. Whether your reading is correct or incorrect, you're sure to have fun laughing together!

name: Poland'39
description:
The Polish Campaign of 1939 begins when the German Army attacks Polish territory in September 1939. Also known as Operation Fall Weiss, it triggered World War II in Europe and ended the Second Polish Republic.

Poland'39 is a game for two or three players, one of them leads the Polish Army and the rest leads the German and/or Russian Armies, depending on whether they are two or three players.


                                
                            
                        
                    
                
            
        
    


La Campaña de Polonia de 1939 comienza cuando el Ejército alemán ataca el territorio polaco en septiembre de 1939. Conocida también como Operación Fall Weiss, fue el detonante de la II Guerra Mundial en Europa y acabó con la II República Polaca.
Poland’39 es un juego para dos o tres jugadores, uno de ellos lleva al Ejército polaco y el resto lleva a los Ejércitos Alemán y/o ruso, según sean dos o tres jugadores.

-description from designer

name: Polar Vortex: The Battle for Alaska's North Slope
description:
“According to a State Department representative, Russia is not getting back Alaska, which was sold to the United States in the 19th century. This is it, then. And we’ve been waiting for it to be returned any day. Now war is unavoidable.”—January 28, 2024 comment by Dmitry Medvedev, current Deputy Head of the Russian Security Council and close confidant of Russian President Vladimir Putin.

As Vladimir Putin’s regime continues, and as the war in Ukraine demonstrated, there are increasingly more reasons to be concerned with Russia using military force to intimidate and coerce any nation it deems a rival or a threat. Putin himself has frequently claimed that Russia reserves the right to “protect” the rights and interests of Russians and Russian property anywhere in the world, and this includes those in Alaska. As conflicts involving Russia endure or escalate in Ukraine and elsewhere, ways to “protect” Russia’s interests by lashing out and taking revenge cannot be ignored. One very cold place where matters can quickly turn hot is Alaska’s North Slope where the terminus of the Alaskan Oil and LNG Pipelines, and the tanker loading facilities for loading those materials, are located. Taking this vital economic resource would be a highly prized Russian military objective, and one that is vital for the US to defend.

Wargames can be excellent vehicles to explore “what ifs?” Can you do as well or better than your counterparts? Learn and enjoy!

—description from the publisher

name: Djinn Rummy
description:
You are the most powerful of ancient magicians and shapeshifters, but for a thousand years you have waited, sealed inside a meagre brass lantern, lost under the sands of time. A group of ardent archeologists have now uncovered your magical prison, and want to use your powers to grant them power and riches beyond belief. Polishing your lantern they have awakened not only your slumbering spirit, but your powerful cleverness and guile. Will you be able to grant these foolish mortals their hearts desires while outplaying them at their own game? Success for you means freedom from endless years of servitude and a return to earthly pleasures. Or is your fate sealed, like the burnished brass lantern which has been your solitary cell for centuries?

Djinn Rummy is a card game based on classic rummy depicting the battle of wits between a Genie and mortals. Mortals attempt to lay down runs and sets to score points and empty their hands of cards. The Genie plays differently, by playing a run from 1 to 10 (symbolizing the thousand years they have spent imprisoned), trying to empty their hand first. However, the Genie may take cards played by mortals by granting them "wishes" that possibly increase their chances to score and to win. If the Genie wins, they score alone; if any mortal wins, they score alone; but if a Genie grants three wishes to any mortal, that mortal and the Genie score, excluding all other mortals. At the end of each round, the Genie appoints a mortal as the new Genie to hinder their chances of winning.

—description from the publisher

name: Pompeii
description:
Shape a City. Share a Fate
Step into ancient Pompeii — a thriving Roman city known for its wealthy inhabitants and luxurious villas. In Pompeii, players lead their citizens to grow the city through smart planning, resourceful trading, and meaningful choices. Oh mighty player, set your subjects to work and and carve your legacy in the history of Pompeii.

However, in Pompeii it was ambition, greed and envy that angered the gods ... and buried the city beneath a smoldering layer of volcanic ash! Together players must share sufficient offerings to appease Vesuvius. If you fixate on your own wealth, you may also find yourselves buried under layers of suffocating and toxic ash.

Pompeii is a game of thoughtful strategy and shared responsibility. Can you guide the city to prosperity — and keep it standing? Or would you risk pursuing power, even if it brings downfall upon all?

Gameplay
Pompeii is a develoment game with a twist. A light-to-medium strategy game: easy to learn, full of meaningful choices. Each round, your workers can perform 1 of the following standard worker actions:

1. Gather raw materials
2. Produce refined goods
3. Construct buildings
4. Trade goods, or
5. Train specialists

Next to standard actions, you can also choose to take a card action: activated specialists and city locations with immediate actions or recurring actions.

The twist is in the two phases in which Pompeii is played: The Calm and The Awakening:


     During The Calm, players built the backbone of Pompeii while working on their strategy (gathering supplies, building a nice card engine, et cetera).
     However, during The Awakening, the Vesuvius is a force to be reckoned with: players have to negotiate shared offerings to the Vesuvius to prevent an eruption and possible loss of hard-earned goods.


The Looming Threat of Vesuvius
Vesuvius watches from a distance, and its patience is limited. During The Calm, Vesuvius is asleep. But when the first prestigious building is constructed, players' ambitions become clear and Vesuvius awakens. As of this moment, players must pay shared offerings to prevent an eruption of Vesuvius and thereby loss of valuable goods.

You’ll need to weigh your ambitions carefully — focus too much on personal gain, and you risk the wrath of the gods. Forget the volcano, and you may all fall together.

Pompeii challenges you not only to claim the city for yourself, but also to survive as a group!

A Balance Between Ambition and Harmony
While you grow your part of the city, others are doing the same. Each player has their own vision for Pompeii’s future, and everyone’s progress is interwoven. The most successful leader will station their army at the Castrum, the military camp outside the city gates, taking control of the city’s fate.

But remember: there’s more at stake than victory alone. Together, you must also keep the gods appeased. Greed and neglect can stir Vesuvius. Ignore this smoldering primal force, and your fate may take a very different turn.

What makes Pompeii so special?
Unique gameplay – You’ll face the ultimate dilemma: claim victory for yourself, but survive as a group. Will your ambitions lead to your personal triumph, or the city’s ruin? In Pompeii, your fate is tied to your rivals – and the looming threat of the volcano.

Relive Pompeii’s glory in a boardgame – See Pompeii come to life as you play. You build the city with every turn – from bustling workshops to grand public buildings. While you shape Pompeii, the evocative artwork breathes life into the ruins, capturing the city in its prime.

Beautiful hand-drawn illustrations using pencil and watercolor paint by Frederick van de Bunt – Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world, where every card is a miniature work of art.

Respect for history – Artwork and theme pay respect to the history and site of Pompeii. Historically accurate architecture and ethnicity of the citizens; every detail is thoughtfully crafted to honor Pompeii’s legacy. Experience the city’s final days with a touch of reverence and awe.

Gateway game – The game gradually increases in complexity, allowing you to ease into it. Whether you’re a casual player or a seasoned gamer, Pompeii welcomes all.

—description from the publisher

name: Pond
description:
Pond is a combinatorial abstract game similar to Tak and Go. Players place, move, and transform pieces on a square grid to create connected lines of matching symbols. Pieces are removed from the board and scored when matches are made.

Each piece is three-sided, and when transformed, pieces always advance through the three faces in the same order: Egg to Tadpole to Frog to Egg. Each face has unique movement rules. Because pieces can't transform in the backwards direction, players are never able to simply reverse their opponent's previous transformation.

One player uses light pieces, and the other dark. When matching pieces are removed from the board, each player scores their own pieces from the set, regardless of which player created the set. The ability to score for yourself and your opponent creates asymmetrical incentives in otherwise symmetrical board states.

Pond takes 2 minutes to learn and about 10 minutes to play. It can be played in the 4x4 "small" (小) pond for a shorter game with tight quarters, or in the 5x5 "big" (大) pond for a longer, more open game.

—description from the designer

name: Pond
description:
Lead your faction of adorable frog meeples across the pond in this area control deck builder for 2 to 4 players!


     Asymmetric faction powers for each of the 4 frog factions
     A classic deck builder with over 50 silly frog cards in the shop
     Build an engine by recruiting hero frogs that provide permanent abilities
     Play your frog cards to deploy, move, and fight with your army of frog meeples


—description from the designer

name: Endangered Rescue #2: Lemur Leaf Frog
description:
As a Philanthropist, you're volunteering as chairperson of a conservation fair to benefit the endangered Lemur Leaf Frog. It's almost time to open the fair to guests, but none of the vendors have arrived yet. Can you finish setting up in time for the event to go off without a hitch?

Endangered Rescue: Lemur Leaf Frog is part of the 18Escape line of games, each of which pack a full escape room game experience into a tiny package! As a group, you will solve a series of puzzles to unravel a mystery.

Puzzles may test your perception, wordplay, and lateral thinking. English language fluency is required.

When you have solved a puzzle on the cards, you will enter the answer into the companion website (compatible with all smart phones and computers) and it will check whether you are correct. If you are, the website will tell you which card or cards to take next. The website also contains a graduated hint system, so if you get stuck you can get just a small hint about the current puzzle to get moving again without giving too much away.

This system is non-destructible: some groups may choose to write on cards, but this is not required. A group cannot re-play the game, but can pass it on to another group for their use.

This entry in the series takes about an hour to solve, and is rated 1 out of 3 in difficulty.

—description from the publisher

name: Pontiac's War: Frontier Rebellion, 1763-66
description:
“I mean to destroy the English and leave not one upon our lands.”  Pontiac  “It is not in the Indian’s power to affect anything of consequence.” Major Gladwin.

Pontiac’s War 1763-1766 followed on the heels of the French and Indian War which ended in 1763. Thanks to Indian resentment over the French surrender of their lands and the harsh policies of General Jeffery Amherst, governor-general of British North America, 20+ Indian nations rose up under the charismatic leadership of the Ottawa sachem, Pontiac and the Lenape Holy Man, Neolin. Pontiac’s War attempts to recreate the reaction of Indian leaders to British mishandling of frontier politics and the impending colonial crisis it presaged. Building on the point-to-point system and loose Indian alliances used in King Philip's War, this design expands frontier conflict using Battle cards to introduce combat chaos, British expenditure on troops, Uncertain Indian Arms supply, siege rules, the capture of prisoners, French interference and trader influence.

The game offers five short introductory scenarios (15-30 minutes), three one-year campaign scenarios (2 hours), and one three-year grand campaign (5-6 hours). Although not a solitaire design, it is solitaire friendly. Components included a mounuted game map and large, 338 3/4" size punch-out counters.

Game Information:

Complexity: 4 out of 10
Solitaire Suitability: 5 out of 10
Time Scale: Seasonal turns (approx. 3 months per turn)
Map Scale: Point-to-Point map (approx. 60-75 miles between points)
Unit Scale: 30-50 men, 4-6 artillery guns, individual officers and sea vessels

—description from the publisher

name: POP!
description:
You are a colour guardian of the Kingdom of Colours. There's a big party coming up and a lot of colours are expected! There's likely to be an attendance record, and the wait to get in is sure to be explosive! 
You're part of the team stationed at the entrance. You'll need to be careful, because when two identical colours are next to each other, they explode and can cause a chain reaction! Arrange the colours skilfully so that the party doesn't turn into a fiasco before it even starts!

Set Up :
1) Shuffle all the Pop cards and place 5 of them in a line, face up.
There can’t be two identical colours next to each other.
2)Setting up your hand
Shuffle the remaining Pop cards and deal 9 cards to each player to form their hand.

4) Setting up the draw pile
Place the remaining Pop cards face down

5)Setting up the Multicolour Chief card

In a 2- to 4-player game, place the Multicolour Chief card next to the draw pile. It counts as a player.

A game is composed of 3 rounds, each containing several turns that progress as follows:

1) Select Pop cards
Each player chooses 1 Pop card from their hand and places it face down in front of them.
2) Reveal the Pop cards
All players reveal their card simultaneously.

3) Place the Pop cards and check the explosions
The player who played the Pop card that triggered the explosion collects all the exploding Pop cards and places them in front of them.

Different game mode : 1 player, 2 to 5 players with cooperative and competitive modes

—description from the publisher

name: PopCats Fighter
description:
PopCats Fighter is a 1v1  Take-That and Hand-Management card fighting game inspired by retro arcade fighting games! Build up combos, unleash your energized Super Moves, and power on Purrks to defeat your enemy!

To play, select your favorite PopCat Fighter character, with unique Purrks and Super Moves, to be your champion against your opponent! Build colorful combos by connecting Move Cards from your hand using COLOR/SHAPE to build the strongest combo you can, while avoiding making it too vulnerable to your opponent's defensive abilities!

The more combos you play, the stronger they get! The more Move Cards you add to your Combo, the higher chance you have to gain a valuable resource called Energy. Energy can help you get the most out of the abilities in your Move Cards, and lets you use unlock your Super Moves!

Danger slowly creeps up as your Health gets closer to zero, but fear not as you will unlock Raging Furry Mode when you health gets too low! That will give you an instant Bonus that might just give you the edge you needed to survive!

This is a medium weight game with layers of strategy. Select your PopCat Fighter from our roster that is made up of 8 contenders like Spawrkles, Purrserker, El Tigre, Clawdette and more! All characters come with 2 unique Purrks, and 2 unique Super Moves!

1v1: 30-60 Minutes

name: Popcorn
description:
In Popcorn, each player manages their own movie theater and tries to show the best combination of movies in order to attract guests to their seats.

The game plays out over nine rounds, and in each round you may acquire a new movie, build or upgrade your theater, and use advertising to attract new guests — then it's showtime, with you drawing guests at random from your bag to see who has shown up. Place guests in the right seats to activate special powers; match them with the right movies, and you get a movie bonus as well, thanks to their enthusiasm for your good taste.

After watching films in your theater, guests might be spirited away to other theaters thanks to ads presented by those theater owners - but you'll probably do the same to them, too.

The bonuses from a movie get worse the longer it runs, so be sure to bring in fresh films to keep guests on the edge of your seats. After all, happy guests can help your theater win awards in town; more importantly, they can keep the "popcorn" piling up in your coffers, and whichever theater owner fills their popcorn box the best wins.

name: Poppy Playtime: Factory Frenzy
description:
All the fun and surprise of Poppy Playtime has jumped out of the screen and onto a boardgame in the Poppy Playtime Factory Frenzy Game! Deep within the abandoned Playtime Co. factory, the toys have come to life. You'll have to use your wits as you grab toys and try to escape before Huggy Wuggy captures you! In this easy-to-learn "Chinese Checkers" format board game, the exclusive Huggy Wuggy attacking spinner/mover spins to point at his next victim and chases players around the board. It brings the "jump-scares" as players hurry to escape! The Factory Frenzy Game has 2 modes of play - Normal Mode and Lights Off Mode for increased intensity!

—description from the publisher

name: Popular
description:
Navigate the social hierarchy of a modern American high school, aiming to be the most popular kid while avoiding the jealousy of classmates. Players score points by winning tricks, earning higher scores when they match the number of tricks taken by other players.

—description from the designer

name: Portals & Champions
description:
The realm of Rolaria has been plunged into chaos by a war among Deities. The divine forces at play have created ruptures between dimensions & various locations within the realm. These portals hold the key to triumph over the other regions battling for control of Rolaria. As a player, you will assume the role of a Deity, commanding an army of Allies, strategically positioning them to secure access to these portals while simultaneously directing your Champions in the heat of battle. Prepare to unleash your divine power and lead your armies to glory in this epic fantasy-themed card game.

—description from the publisher

name: Portmanteau:  A Cooperative Game of Linguistic Fusion
description:
What exactly is a Portmanteau? It's the fusion of two words to create something entirely new. Take, for instance, the combination of "Spoon" and "Fork," resulting in the delightful "Spork."

In the game Portmanteau, players are working cooperatively as one "speaker" guides the group to select two icons displayed on the table by "fusing" a Portmanteau.

Here's the twist: the speaker doesn't employ actual words but, instead, utilizes the beginning letters of one icon and the ending letters of another. For example, merging "chocolate" and "baseball" yields the whimsical "chocball"!  Seems simple enough but the difficulty increases as players must solve different lengths of Portmanteaus to win the game!

—description from the designer

name: Holiday Hijinks #10: The Leprechaun Larceny
description:
The sun is shining, the air is crisp, and the festival you've been waiting for is finally here. But just as you’re about to dive into the day’s celebrations, a mischievous creature grabs your attention, begging for your help in a quest for a lost treasure. Strange happenings swirl around you, and you can’t shake the feeling that something magical is at play. Will you follow the clues, face the dangers ahead, and claim the gold hidden at the end of the rainbow before time runs out?

The Leprechaun Larceny, title #10 in the Holiday Hijinks line, is an escape room-style game in just 18 cards! As a group, you will solve a series of puzzles to unravel a mystery. Puzzles may test your perception, wordplay, and lateral thinking. English language fluency is required.

When you have solved a puzzle on the cards, you will enter the answer into the companion website (compatible with all smart phones and computers) and it will check whether you are correct. If you are, the website will tell you which card or cards to take next. The website also contains a graduated hint system, so if you get stuck you can get just a small hint about the current puzzle to get moving again without giving too much away.

This system is non-destructible: some groups may choose to write on cards, but this is not required. A group cannot re-play the game, but can pass it on to another group for their use. This entry in the series takes about an hour to solve and is rated 2 out of 3 in difficulty.

name: Postcards
publisher: Fenrir Games; Synapses Games; 999 Games; Elznir Games
description:
Bonjour, and welcome to Postcards, a board game about exploring the beauty of France — one postcard at a time!

Hop on your bicycle and set out on a picturesque adventure, as you compete with your friends to enjoy the most unforgettable holiday! Designed for 1-4 players, Postcards is a family friendly game that takes you on a journey across France, filled with inspiring culture, stunning landscapes, and delicious local cuisine.

The aim of the game is simple: cycle through the 13 different regions of France, visit as many iconic locations as possible, and share your travels by sending postcards back home. Each postcard you send brings you one step closer to victory, so grab your friends, get pedaling, and let the adventures begin!

On your turn, you'll be playing Travel cards to perform the different actions available: take a new Postcard, set up Camp, put a Stamp on one of your Postcards, or Move to a new region.

Postcards are the main way you'll be scoring points during the game, so be sure to look out for postcards from areas which match your travel itinerary objective! Certain Postcards are worth more points than others, but be careful: the higher its point value, the more stamps you'll need to send it off.

Stamping your Postcards uses up your precious Travel cards, limiting what you can do on your turn, so choose wisely… To send a Postcard, you have to be in the region it's from, so make sure you have enough Travel cards to get there!

All that cycling is hard work, so be sure to spend some time relaxing! The Camp action allows you to enjoy local attractions in the regions you visit, collecting souvenirs as you go, which give you extra points and bonuses during play.

The game ends when one player has sent their fourth postcard, and the winner is the player who’s collected the most points through their travels.

Are you ready to set out on a journey of a lifetime?

Postcards is a simple game that whole family can enjoy, but has plenty of strategy to keep you thinking as you play! Lovingly designed and illustrated by a team of self-professed francophiles, Postcards is sure to make you want to plan your own trip to France.

name: Potala Palace
description:
In 7th century, the Tubo king Songtsen Gampo gave orders to build a great palace on Red Mountain, name it “Potala”, means “the holy place”, in order to marry a noble chinese princess Wencheng from Tang Dynasty. According to legend, the princess Wencheng was a devout follower of Buddhism.
