The Axis player must keep open his side’s lines of communication, destroy as many Partisan units as possible and capture forced laborers for the German economy.

Each hexagon on the map represents 20 miles (32.4 km) from side to opposite side. The units of maneuver are Partisan “detachments” (company equivalents) and brigades. Axis units of maneuver vary in size from whole divisions down to
battalions. Each full turn represents two to three months, based on seasonality.

name: Qomet
publisher: Gigamic; Hachette Boardgames UK; Hachette Boardgames USA
description:
Create a square of any size connected by lines.

Each player starts with 7 stars. On your turn, you can play a new star of your color on the board or move a star of your color you played previously. If you move, you go to the next square connected by a line. If this square is empty, nothing else happens. If this square is occupied, push the star no matter its color. You can't push more than one star. You can push stars outside of the board.

name: Reef Gardens
description:
As courageous marine conservationists, in Reef Gardens you dive into the dazzling world of coral reefs and take on the mission to save these vital ecosystems. With a skillful hand, you plant new corals and create thriving reef landscapes while the clock ticks and the budget dwindles. To get more research money, you may have to part with existing reefs from time to time so that new ones can be planted.

Use your limited resources wisely because sometimes conservation means making difficult compromises...

name: Rollie
description:
Roll for the Cash... or the Krash!

Step right up, step right up, everyone can play!

Roll the dice, take your chances, collect your money, and don’t forget about those Bonus tokens! Do it all the right way, and you’ll end up the richest player. Push it too far, and you’ll Krash!

The turns are simple: The active player rolls the two dice, and everyone makes their choice.

If the values are different, players can either take a Bill from the bank, corresponding to one of the numbers on the dice, to add to their Stake, or they can secure their Stake by placing all their money into their Wallet. If the values on the dice are the same, all players with Bills of that value in their Stake immediately Krash! Those players lose ALL the money in their stake, and unaffected players get to Secure their Stake in their Wallet. Will you be able to make the right choices? Will you be too keen to protect your earnings, or will you stray into reckless risk to try to win it all? One thing’s sure: Rollie will keep you on the edge of your seat right to the final roll!

name: Symbiosis
publisher: Subverti; Evrikus; Hachette Boardgames USA; Mandoo Games; Old Dawg; Pegasus Spiele; Rocket Lemon Games
description:
Symbiose is a fast-paced, strategic card game where you must join forces with your neighbors to compete with your aquatic counterparts. The goal? Create the most prosperous pond in the region!

In this turn-based game, your goal is to strategically place your cards to maximize your overall score. But be aware, each card score depending of its placement: on the left, you score depending on your left neighbor ; on the right, depending of your right neighbor and in the center depending of your own cards. Choose wisely!

—description from the publisher

name: Mythologies
publisher: Super Meeple; asmodee; Elznir Games; Galakta; Ghenos Games; Hachette Boardgames UK; Hachette Boardgames USA
description:
In Mythologies, you are the founder of a young civilization, drawing spiritual strength and power from the mythologies of the world.

Build your own pantheon by invoking gods and legendary creatures from cultures across the globe — Greek, Egyptian, Norse, Hindu, Zulu, and more — and earn their favor in your race to divine supremacy.

Each game begins with a unique combination of four mythologies, creating a “Sanctuary” where players will compete to select powerful entities. You'll use your strategic wits to draft cards, invoke deities, activate special abilities, and complete divine trials. But choose carefully: placing a card might grant immediate rewards, but those depend on the pantheon level the card is placed in, and sometimes you need to sacrifice your creatures for a greater gain.

Throughout four fast-paced rounds, you’ll tactically deploy your chosen beings into your pantheon grid, managing resources while triggering synergies and stacking combos. Draft wisely, balance strategy with sacrifice, and unleash divine powers to complete trials and outwit your rivals.
With every game offering 70 different setup combinations of asymmetric mythologies, quick turns, and rich combos, Mythologies delivers epic replayability in just 30 minutes.

Will your civilization ascend to legend — or be forgotten among the myths?

—description from the publisher

name: Rejig
description:
Bringing word games out of antiquity, Rejig is the word game for the next generation.

Build your own crossword (or as a team) against family and friends as you race against a timer to score the most points through word count, round categories, bonus words, donuts, and more!

With 10 different ways to score, 3 of which are unique every round, the best strategy is always changing so everyone has a chance against even the most hardcore vocabulary geeks!

—description from the publisher

name: Relic Wars
description:
Relic Wars is a ruthless battler and exploration game set in a dark, fantastical world, featuring stunning medieval-inspired artwork with a sinister edge. It throws players into brutal combat on ever-changing battlefields, where no two games are ever the same. Victory demands either crushing your enemies or seizing three legendary golden chalices and surviving the chaos — but the moment someone holds that third chalice, the hunt is on. Every turn is a mix of tactical clashes, strategic spell combos, and game-changing upgrades, where even the best-laid plans can be shattered by Divine Intervention. The game’s perfectly paced length keeps tension high without overstaying its welcome, delivering an effortless, satisfying experience that always leaves players saying, “let’s play again.”

In Relic Wars, players become ruthless warriors, each with unique abilities and hidden motives, locked in a brutal battle for three golden chalices. The path to victory is yours to forge — crush your enemies in ruthless combat or seize the relics and outlast the chaos.

Explore a dynamic, ever-changing battlefield filled with treacherous terrain, powerful relics, and deadly encounters. Uncover arcane artifacts, master devastating spells, and upgrade your warrior as you fight to survive.

Two paths. One victor. Will you claim the chalices or be forgotten in the ashes of war?

name: Tag Team: Arthur's Legacy
description:
Tag Team is back with 6 new Fighters inspired by the legends of King Arthur!

Arthurian legends come to life in the Tag Team arena! Play as Morgan, Merlin, The Dragon, Perceval, The Green Knight... and even Excalibur! In Tag Team, we don’t sit around telling stories, though, we FIGHT!

Who will dominate the arena as these legendary characters engage in epic battles?

Tag Team is a cross between a tactical auto battler and a deckbuilder, inspired by the greatest classic arcade games, featuring awesome and charismatic Fighters, each with their own fighting styles and signature moves. Build your team of 2 and put together the ultimate synergies by combining their 2 unique decks!

Round 2… FIGHT!

-- All Tag Team expansions are compatible with the base game and each other. --

In more detail, in Tag Team, you start with a deck of only two cards, and the fight unfolds automatically: Flip your cards one at a time and apply their effects. At the end of each round, you get to turn up the heat on the opposing team by strategically adding new cards to program your deck — but without reordering the cards already present. Determine what makes your tag team tick, play devastating combos, and dominate your opponent by deftly blocking their attacks. Timing is everything if you want to emerge victorious and knock out your foe!

Tag Team: Arthur's Legacy is coming in 2026.

—description from the publisher

name: Renaissance and Write
description:
During the Renaissance, much regard was paid to reviving the arts: sculpture, painting, fabric, architecture, stage, and music. As a patron, your goal is to inspire the artists in your work shops to create Masterworks!

In Renaissance and Write, players will be choosing one six-sided die which they will attempt to use in all seven areas of their player sheet. Some of the choices are easier such as working to complete a Masterwork, while others may be more challenging such as which lesser work is the best choice for that round.

As players place their dice, they will find benefits with the Blessings area where a wide selection of dice yields a chance to change a die they chose into a different value, while lesser works are more specific in their choices, they can lead to points or other luck modifiers.

The game progresses and the players will have to decide is their star Artist is going to remain with them as the bonus card or if they will transition out of the workshops and allow the player to have an additional die of any value they choose for that turn only.

Clever play awaits 1 to 100 players, just print additional player pages and bonus cards to add as many players as you wish. Do you have what it takes to be the best patron in the land?

—description from the publisher

name: Reporter
description:
Reporter is an investigative game designed to immerse players in the thrilling world of journalism. It puts the players in the shoes of journalists and focuses in particular on the verification work necessary before publishing information: where does it come from, is it reliable, and sufficiently verified via cross-sources? It would be unthinkable for a good journalist to relay fake news! The game offers two distinct scenarios.

The first scenario, lasting 45 minutes, serves as an introduction and allows players to familiarize themselves with the basics of journalism. A strange photo is causing a buzz on social networks: there is a monster in Lake Geneva! Is it a hoax, a statue or even a disguise? Only the clever use of your investigative tools will lead you to the truth, which may surprise you!

The second scenario, lasting approximately 3 hours, deepens the skills acquired by introducing a more complex and elaborate plot. You are sent to the shores of Lake Constance to produce a report on the theme of the border. During your stay, you get informed of a large quantity of debris on a beach not far away. Given the weather, the hypotheses are quite limited, but as you investigate, you find yourself immersed in an immersive story taking you around the lake.

Designed to be accessible without preparation or prior knowledge, Reporter is ideal for a family or educational experience, but also for playing with friends. This unique experience combines entertainment, learning and awareness of the challenges of modern journalism, while offering a captivating adventure through Switzerland and beyond.

—description from the publisher

name: The Four Doors
description:
The Shadow Veil wants to cover the land with darkness, so your challenge in The Four Doors is to collect the relic from behind each door, then gather everyone at the beacon in order to light it.

On a turn, a player takes up to three actions: drawing a card, moving to an adjacent door, giving a card (or relic) to someone at your door, illuminating a shadow card from your door by discarding a card that bears a lantern of the same color, or finding a relic by discarding four cards of the color matching your door. Each adventurer has a special power that modifies an action or offers a new action.

Each door has a relic behind it, and once you find a relic, the holder can use its power by discarding a card bearing the relic's symbol, sometimes as an action on its own, sometimes not.

To end a player's turn, they draw two cards, then place "shadows" from the deck equal to the shadow level. If a fourth card would be placed on either side of a door, flip the card to its partially closed side; if the door would flip a second time, remove it from play. If the players don't already have this relic, they lose.

Each time players need to shuffle the deck, the shadow level increases — and this level will increase more quickly as the game progresses since some cards, such as spells that provide a one-time effect, are removed from play instead of being discarded. If you have no cards to shuffle or the shadow level tops out, the players lose.

name: Repulso
description:
Only the white action pieces bring movement into the game - and you need them to pool your playing pieces on the board in as few clusters as possible.

Your own game pieces can be placed on any unoccupied space, but never directly next to each other.

You can also use the small pieces to thwart your opponent's plans and disrupt their clusters. It is important to keep track of the game so that you can place your own pieces on the best spaces.

Once all the pieces have been placed, you count your points. The winner is the player who has managed to form their clusters most effectively, or the player who manages to play in such a way that their opponent is unable to make another move.

Repulso is a tactical game for two players that scores points with its straightforward rules, yet offers a great deal of game depth.

name: Rescate Animal
description:
Rescate Animal is a Chilean card game set collection and push your luck, in which you must rescue animals in different levels of preservation of the Chilean fauna. To do so, you must discover, preserve and conserve different species in order to obtain preservation points and help the local fauna. 
The board game is played in three phases 

     Preserve: In this phase you can rescue only once animals that you have in your ecosystem, but they must be part of the same collection of animals.
     Discover: You can do one of these two actions.
         From the central deck you reveal cards one by one but be careful if you have 3 of the same type or 5 of different types, the animals will run and fall in a danger zone.
         Preserve: Here you can rescue animals from the danger zone using your preservation points.
    
     Preserve: If you didn't do it in point 1 you can do it now.


Reaching 15 points triggers the end of the round and finally a round of Preservation only.

Come and help us to take care of the Chilean fauna.

name: Reservations
description:
Reservations is a trick taking game that shares DNA with traditional contract bidding games, such as Königrufen, Vira, Doppelkopf, etc. but with a "modern" feel.

In the traditional games, the scores are almost always zero sum, meaning if I am gaining points, you are losing points. In Reservations, the scoring is based on an area majority in the 4 different levels of contracts you can complete. Most of the contracts are 1 vs All (solo), however, when playing 4 players you can have 2 vs 2 (team) contracts as well. Completing a solo contract will let you place two cubes, where as a team contract lets each player place one cube. Be careful, any failed contracts will count against you at the end of the game!

Contracts also change how the card play system works. One contract might have you play Talon Exchange/Must Follow/Must Trump/Must Win while another contract will have you play Talon Reveal/Must Follow/May Trump/May Win.

There is also an advanced mode that includes a side board full of additional bonus contracts.

—description from the designer

name: One Last Fight
description:
One Last Fight is a card-driven roguelike, GM-less roleplaying game where 1 to 4 players take on the role of doomed adventurers on theit final quest to defeat their ultimate Nemesis or die trying.

Players create their own adventurer's backstories, establish the story of their Nemesis, and work together to overcome a gauntlet of Challenges 8both physical and personal) until they find themselves in their Nemesis' Lair. There the adventurers meet their fate and battle their nemesis head to head.

name: Rewild: South America
description:
Rewild: South America is a unique, medium-weight, card-driven, engine-building board game for nature enthusiasts with a heart for wildlife that can be enjoyed in 45-60 minutes.

The thematic focus of Rewild is on the fauna and flora of the South American ecoregions Caatinga, Gran Chaco, Cerrado, Pantanal, Amazon rainforest and Atlantic rainforest. These 6 ecoregions and all their inhabitants exhibit diverse interrelationships and dependencies. One of the core concerns of game author Bruno Liguori Sia, who lives in Brazil himself, was to depict and convey this complex network in a game.

In terms of game mechanics, Rewild has a straightforward foundation. On their turn, each player plays a card and chooses one of two depicted actions. After carrying out this action, the player can attract animals and plants on display to their ecosystem. As soon as a player has 8 (or 9) face-up animal cards in front of them, the end of the game is triggered.

However, you shouldn't be fooled by this essentially simple basis, as every game of Rewild features countless decisions and plays differently every time due to the enormous variety of cards. Questions that players are faced with include: 

    How do I generate enough resources (water, minerals, seeds) to expand my ecosystem? Where do I place which biomes so that their effects optimally promote the expansion of my ecosystem? Do I focus on one biome or several? Would it make sense to upgrade my existing biomes? 
    When do I get all my action cards back into my hand to have more options and resources available again?  Do I do this once, twice or even three times and what are my opponents planning? Will I still have enough time to play all my cards in time for them to count towards the effects of my animal cards? 
    Which animal and plant cards do I bring into my ecosystem to create an optimally linked ecosystem that generates as many victory points as possible? Are there any cards with immediate effects that would be interesting for a retrigger? Do I keep an animal species until the end, or do I immediately generate points by making it the target of a predator?


The player who best answers and masters all these questions in a game of Rewild receives the most victory points and wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Rex Atlantis
description:
In the aftermath of Atlantis's fall, ancient machines awaken to rebuild the empire from the floating ruins that remain. In Rex Atlantis, players take control of noble houses, guiding their automata to restore lost grandeur and seize power in a world reclaimed by nature.

Each turn, players move their automaton across eight distinct paths, representing different aspects of Atlantis's reconstruction. The main goal is to gather resources, and rebuild structures, while strategically positioning to gain influence over the empire's rebirth.

Each of the eight paths presents a range of crucial opportunities for players to shape the future of Atlantis. Along these paths, players can reprogram their automata to tackle complex objectives, adjusting their strategy as the game evolves. They can also activate advanced technologies, unlocking powerful abilities that can shift the balance of power in their favor.

Energy crystals, a vital resource, can be collected along the way, providing the fuel needed to carry out key actions. As players progress, they will also reconnect the floating islands, restoring the fractured landscape of Atlantis and opening new avenues for expansion. At critical points, they can contribute to rebuilding grand Atlantean structures, earning influence and cementing their house’s role in the empire’s resurgence.

Throughout the game, houses must balance their need for progress with limited resources. Only those who can outmaneuver their rivals and rebuild the most will secure control of the newborn Atlantean Empire.

The ending phase of the game begins when one player has used up all their markers. At the end of the following round, the house with the most influence (victory points) is declared the winner, cementing their legacy in the rebirth of Atlantis.

name: A Carnivore Did It!
publisher: Horrible Guild; Devir; DSV Games; IELLO; Popcorn Games
description:
A Carnivore Did It! promises a guilty meat-eater, but you will have to determine the culprit for yourself. Maybe an herbivore was actually behind the crime, or perhaps you're searching for two culprits — or even three?

For each case in this co-operative game, you're given a number of suspects, with each suspect being assigned a statement, e.g., "Shark is telling the truth" or "A carnivore did it". You know how many culprits you're looking for, and you have some idea of how truthful everyone is being. Perhaps only one suspect is lying, or perhaps 3-4 of them are telling the truth. Putting all of this information together, can you determine who did the crime?

A Carnivore Did It! includes two thousand cases, each with a single solution, with the difficulty increasing to have up to seven suspects, conditional statements, and varying levels of truthiness.

Also included is a campaign mode that links several cases together, with you scoring in them based on the amount of time it takes to find each solution...if you find them at all.

name: Rift Domination
description:
Rift Domination puts you at the helm of one of 20 asymmetric factions, each unlocking a different lineup drawn from 11 distinct unit types. Your faction shapes your approach — your decisions decide who dominates the Rift.

A turn‑based 4X strategy game, Rift Domination rewards precise planning and bold plays. Earn victory points through:

Epic fleet battles with fast, dice‑driven resolution
Tactical Occurrence cards with clear timing windows and high impact
System control & planet upgrades (choose from 8) to build economy and defense
Exploration & expansion across a contested galaxy

At its core lie fleet‑building and intense PvP interaction. Tailor your strongholds with upgrades like Artillery, Shield Generators, and Espionage Stations; time your OCC cards to turn the tide without bogging down the flow of play. With sharp faction identities, asymmetric unit access, and meaningful counterplay, Rift Domination challenges commanders to think ahead, adapt fast, and strike decisively.

Only one will rule the void. Will it be you?

-description from designer

name: Rift Zone: Contact
description:
Rift Zone: Contact is a sci-fi miniatures wargame where you command physical units on the table while a companion app handles combat and game logic in real time.

You move, position, and commit to every decision, while distance, terrain, armor, and damage resolve instantly around you. The focus stays on timing and tactics, not calculation.

The game supports both quick skirmishes and longer campaign play. Units gain experience over time, evolving across battles rather than resetting each match, which changes how you approach risk and positioning.

Set on a distant world, the conflict unfolds between two factions. The United Earth Defense Force relies on advanced technology, range, and coordinated tactics, while the Scry’Ox Collective adapts through pressure and close-range dominance with bioengineered units.

Rift Zone: Contact is designed to keep the battle moving. Turns resolve quickly, outcomes play out immediately, and the battlefield shifts continuously as you play.

name: Riftbound: The League of Legends Trading Card Game
description: Riftbound is a collectable Trading Card Game for 2-4 players where you join forces with your favorite League of Legends champions. Play out your army and conquer the battlefields of Runeterra to win.

name: Riftlands: The War Within
description:
Riftlands - The War Within is a fast-paced PnP MOBA-inspired game where two teams of heroes battle to defend their territory and destroy the enemy Nexus.Players collect Shards, fight monsters, and adapt to dynamic activation orders based on skill priority and dice selection.

Hero defeat unlocks new items and artifacts, strengthening yourself or your team.

With no fixed rounds, every move is a race for survival in an ever-changing battlefield.

name: Right on Time
description:
Right on Time is all about timing here because the aim is to come in second! In each round, you have to decide which card goes on the discard pile. Play a higher card individually or two lower cards at the same time — timing is the key!

—description from the publisher

name: My Murder Mystery: A Dead Monkey
description:
My Murder Mystery is a series of competitive investigation games recreating the magic of a murder mystery party in a compact box. You play as one of the characters, each of whom bears their own secret objectives — with one possibly being the murderer! Discover the secrets of each scenario: Can you solve the case...while keeping your own history a secret?

In My Murder Mystery: A Dead Monkey, Don Vito Sovetta, feared patriarch of the Sovetta crime family, has assembled a crew of trusted operatives for a high-stakes job: "Operation Jungle", a daring heist at Centralia Bank.

The prize? A priceless golden artifact known as the Wunderbar. The operation was fast and successful...or so it seemed. Back at the hideout, while the gang is enjoying their success, the power suddenly cuts out. And then, the body of Mr. Monkey is found.

Examine clues and exchange information with other players to discover secrets, while trying to leave yours untouched — or possibly get away with murder.

name: My Murder Mystery: The Final Protocol
description:
My Murder Mystery is a series of competitive investigation games recreating the magic of a murder mystery party in a compact box. You play as one of the characters, each of whom bears their own secret objectives — with one possibly being the murderer! Discover the secrets of each scenario: Can you solve the case...while keeping your own history a secret?

My Murder Mystery: The Final Protocol takes place in Silicon Valley in the year 2047. Olivia Clubberfunk, the visionary founder of the world's largest tech corporation, has invited a select group of guests to her high-tech residence for an exclusive party.

The evening unfolds amidst whispers of top-secret projects and long-standing tensions — but the next morning, a shocking tragedy strikes the party guests: Olivia's lifeless body is found! The exits have been sealed by the automatic security system, meaning no one can enter or leave...

Examine clues and exchange information with other players to discover secrets, while trying to leave yours untouched — or possibly get away with murder.

name: Rise of Babel
description:
Become the builders of the greatest Tower known to man! 
Use elephants to transport resources, spend gold to upgrade your deck and acquire influence as you compete to gain the highest score.

Assemble a deck of cards, tactically position resource tiles  on the Tower of Babel, and upgrade your warehouse to unlock a range of rewards.

—description from the publisher

name: Rise of the Oak Dell
description:
Rise of the Oak Dell is a strategic roll & write game in which the player takes on the role of a leader guiding a growing civilization in The Oak Dell. Rules will be translated into several languages, however the game itself is 100% language-independent.

Over the course of 13 rounds, they gather resources, develop technologies, explore new territories, and construct wonders of the world — monumental achievements that reflect the power of their people.

But progress comes at a cost: unexpected enemy attacks can disrupt plans, and an unhappy population may hinder development.

—description from the publisher

name: Rise of the Wastelands
description:
At the end of this century a rain of meteors have slammed into Earth, drastically altering the landscape, killing the majority of people and erasing almost all signs of civilization. A few years after the impact, the remaining survivors began to congregate in the ruins of cities where the meteor effects were less severe to try to rebuild and establish a new society.

Years have passed and some of those ruined cities have started to flourish, but their resources that could be salvaged are starting to run out. Infrastructures and developments are still too inefficient to generate the necessary resources for the growing population. So in order to survive, the people of these cities need to venture into the Wastelands.

The Wastelands is a vast land area that was severely impacted by the meteors and only now becoming safe enough to explore again. It is known that there are ruined cities to salvage resources from, but there are unknown dangers as well.

The need for resources, together with the different societies formed in these newly populated cities, has created conflict and distrust that has grown among these factions. So now a race has begun to gather resources, grow and develop as quickly as possible to become the dominant faction to rule, not only over the Wastelands, but over all the nearby factions as well.

Summary
Rise of the Wastelands is set in a futuristic post-apocalyptic world, where resources are scarce and the remaining human survivors fight to survive and rule the devastated lands. Players lead one of the four factions with their own unique abilities. Starting from their capital, they will explore the dynamically generated map, discovering new areas and establishing outposts to recycle materials. With these newly generated resources, they can construct buildings and units, all while striving to upgrade their technology and gain a strategic advantage. This will allow players to accomplish the ever-changing achievements and let them spread their influence to rule over the other players.

Winning the Game
The goal of the game is to spread at least 5 of your influence tokens among the other players. When the game is over, if only one player has been able to accomplish that, they are declared the winner. In the event that two or more players have achieved that, the player that has given away more influence tokens wins the game.

Gameplay
In Rise of the Wastelands there are no rounds or phases. Players take turns one after another until a player claims their 5th achievement at the end of their turn. Then, the rest of the players play one more turn.

On their turn, players do the following in sequential order:
1- Allocate influence. 
2- Perform actions.
3- Claim achievements.
4- Reset action points

—description from the publisher

name: Potion Explosion: Collector's Edition
description: Potion Explosion celebrates its 10th anniversary with a bang! This lush big box edition of the marble-drafting, tonic-brewing classic includes all the components from the core game, both The Fifth Element and The Sixth Student expansions, all mini-expansions released so far, as well as a brand new unique Potion, while also upgrading all tokens to wood.

name: Rising Dragon: Platoon Level Combat in the Invasion of Taiwan
description:
October 1, 2034 marks the beginning of the conflict that unfolds in Rising Dragon, a standalone game and campaign setting for the Armageddon War system. With the United States turning inward in the wake of the catastrophic ‘Armageddon War’, China seizes the moment to assert its territorial claims, letting the world know that it is now the unchallenged power in the region. This sets the stage for a military showdown that spans East Asia, with Taiwan at the epicenter.

Platoon Level
Scale of 150 meters per hex
15 minutes per turn
Continuous Chit-pull Activation
18 stamped dice for combat resolution
Naval, amphibious, and urban conflicts
Age: 14+
Players: 2
Playing Time: 1-3 Hours
Scenario based

The game introduces cutting-edge technologies, including hypersonic missiles, advanced amphibious operations, and features detailed maps that bring the battlegrounds of Taiwan and the wider region to life.Scenarios include the Chinese invasion of Taiwan, where hypersonic missile systems like the PRC Heaven Sword devastate Taiwanese defenses.

—description from the publisher

name: Railroad Tiles
publisher: Horrible Guild; Albi; Cranio Creations; GaGa Games; Game Harbor; HeidelBÄR Games; IELLO; White Goblin Games
description:
Railroad Tiles, a sequel to the roll-and-write series Railroad Ink, is a quick-playing tile placement game in which you pick tiles and place routes to build an interconnected community.

The game is played over eight rounds. You start each round by drafting your tiles from the sets available in the common pool, then you place your routes in front of you, trying to make as many connections as possible; be careful not to lock yourself in with choices that are too constraining. Each round, you can also place cars, trains, or travelers to populate the tiny little landscape you're creating - as long as you have free space on your tiles. The available actions change from round to round, so you need to prepare in advance!

The more pieces of the same kind each new placement connects to, the more points you earn. You can also score bonus points at game's end for placing tiles in a large rectangle without gaps and for creating sets of three adjacent city tiles.

—description from the publisher

name: RIVALS
description:
Rivals is a deckbuilding board game based on a Battle Royale gameplay. You play the chosen one of your clan and fight to save your people from extinction.⚔️

[The new V2 rulebook is now available for free as a PDF on the publisher’s official website.]

- Features -

To win the game, you just need to be the last survivor or to have obtained 5 victory points.

To obtain victory points, you will have to either kill an opponent or buy them using the resources you will obtain by collecting on the map.

Battle royale board game
Deck-building, the central element of the game
Collect resources to implement your strategy
Scalable map over the sleeves, be careful not to fall...

- The map -

Focus on the board and the interactions with the evolving map ! ??

RIVALS is played in several rounds, each divided into two rounds of play. During their turn, players have 2 action points to move, collect resources from a tile, play cards from their hand and interact with sponsors.

The WildTech (=map) is made out of 43 tiles. You can explore, collect resources and fight your opponents.

Crystal / Resin : These are harvest resources, they allow you to craft shields, uninstall cards from your deck and buy victory points !

Interface (black tile) : If you collect on this tile, you will be able to collect new cards for your deck and optimize it.

Anticipation : This resource allows you to recover additional dice to defend yourself from your opponents

The evolution of the map : At the end of each round (2 turn in a round), parts of the map will be destroyed, players will have to draw cards to discover the affected areas. Be careful not to fall...

- How does battle work ? -

The attacker gets 2 action points to use offensive cards.
The cost of the card is in the upper left and the distance to perform your attack in the upper right. Finally in the center of the card is the number of damage as well as the special effects.

Regarding cards, there are 2 types. Cards for physical damage and cards for mental damage. Finally you will be able to combine certain offensive cards with utility cards to add a boost to your attack.

For the defense part, when a player attacks you, you get 2 defense dice to block attacks. Throughout the game, you will be able to get up to 6 of them during an attack phase. In order to have more defensive dice, you will have to collect on tiles with “anticipation”. Finally, elements of the map such as the forest will give you an additional die if you are on the square.

- Lore -

AT THE DAWN OF 3221

Humanity is all over the galaxy. After centuries of research, science finally unraveled the secret of hyperspeed.

The Network, supreme political council, sealed the destiny of all clans. In order to avoid the conflicts and wars to come, each clans located on each planet of the Milky Way will designate an Ashak to stand for them in the WildTech, a hybrid arena : half-real, half-digital.

You embody one of these Ashaks and will carry your clan's hopes. The ultimate battle is yet to come and no one wants to discover what is hiding beyond the void.

name: River Rats
description:
River Rats is a cooperative, strategic hand-management game set aboard a luxurious futuristic riverboat, where the bionic River Rats, the upper-class guests, force the crew into high-stakes poker games for their amusement.

Players take on the roles of the crew, working together to outplay the Rich Rats by crafting stronger poker hands. Using teamwork, clever hand management, and strategic planning, they must manipulate the game to shift the odds in their favor.

Each of the four crew factions (♣️♦️♥️♠️) has unique abilities, and players must combine their faction powers with their own special actions to outwit the Rich Rats and send them back to their cabins a little poorer than before.

Defeat both River Rats by ensuring each accumulates five Debt before you collectively gain five Debt.

—description from the publisher

name: River Woods
description:
River Woods is a challenging and strategic tile placement exploration board game for 2 to 4 players.

Players take on the role of City Dogs travelling to explore the challenges in the forest and collect the gifts of nature. They will also get to meet local companions as guides to assist the players in achieving the best experiences in the River Woods.

The game is played within 5 rounds. Each player’s turn consists of the following phases:

1. Select Action - In each player’s turn, that player must place one of the numbered Action Discs to perform a Terrain Action, Companion Action, or Movement Action.

2. Check Objectives - At the end of a player’s turn, that player will need to check if the requirements of Terrain Objective Cards or Round Objective Cards can be met.

The round ends after players perform 3 turns, and then prepare the setup for the next round.

At the end of the game, the player with the most points wins the game.

—description from the publisher

Awards:
Bangkok International Game Festival 2025 - Best Strategy Game

name: Railroad Tiles: Collector's Edition
description:
A collector's edition of Railroad Tiles that supports up to 5 players! A single "big box" including all components from the core game, the World Expansion, and all other expansions available as add-ons, as well as additional components to allow for 5-player gameplay for both core game and expansions.

Contains base game + 9 expansions:

     Canal Expansion (Medium Complexity)
     Countryside Expansion (Hard Complexity)
     Desert Expansion (Medium Complexity)
     Energy Expansion (Hard Complexity)
     Forest Expansion (Easy Complexity)
     Lake Expansion (Easy Complexity)
     Monuments Expansion (Medium Complexity)
     World Expansion
     5th Player Expansion (Collector’s Edition Exclusive)
     Hospital & Local Market Promo Tiles (if the game was bought through the 2024 Kickstarter campaign)


—description from the publisher

name: Road Master
description:
Take the wheel of your truck and become a logistics master in this pick-and-deliver game where every cube counts and every detour costs.

Choose your contracts wisely, load your cubes efficiently, plan the most profitable routes, and adapt to the unexpected to maximize your deliveries and win the game!

—description from the designer

name: Roblins!
description:
"They steal from the rich and keep it for themselves!" There are two very similar goblin clans. One is mean and cunning, while the others see themselves as cunning and mean. And so the eternal struggle began.

In Roblins!, you take control of a goblin clan and its gold chamber. Your goal is to steal the enemies entire gold treasure.

Spend your own gold (or better your enemies) to hire new units and build landscapes full of traps to protect your deck of treasure cards against the enemy goblins, and rob all their gold to win the game before they do the same with you!

—description from the publisher

name: Robo Rescue: Origins
description:
Robo Rescue: Origins is the precursor to the Robo Rescue board game, where players face the heart-wrenching challenge of rescuing the very robots they create in Origins.

Play solo or compete with friends, each with their own deck. Get ready to put your engineering skills to the test! In Robo Rescue: Origins, you'll carefully select components to build your robot, aiming for the highest possible score. Each card represents a different part, with unique point values. Strategize, optimize, and create the most impressive robot to earn your place on the Martian expedition!


    Set Up Your Lab: Ready to engineer some amazing robots? First, set up your lab! This is your personal building space.
    Collect Parts: Next, it's time to COLLECT! Draw robot part cards from the main deck OR grab the perfect piece from the face-up display.
    Build Your Robots: Now, let's BUILD! Strategically place your collected parts in your Workshop or Storage.
    Score Your Lab: Time to SCORE! Once you've placed 8 robot parts, choose your 2 BEST scoring lab areas to tally your points for the round.


Win: After 6 rounds of robot-building, it's time to add up the points to see who's the top engineer! Surpass your own limits as a solo engineer, or beat your fellow gamers in a multiplayer game to win.

—description from the publisher

name: RoboKraft
description:
The year is 20XX. Humanoid robots have become commonplace and four companies have dominated the market. However, each manufacturer uses a proprietary power cell that can only be used with their product line. Robots without the right batteries won’t function and will just take up space in your home. Likewise, batteries that can only be used with specific models will do you no good unless you have the robots that power them. Additionally, the competition between these four companies is intense and even the act of requesting a specific brand can have a big impact on its value. All you want is some robot helpers with the proper power to run them, but nothing’s that simple.

RoboKraft is a must-follow trick taking game for 3-4 players, in which the relative ranking of the suits changes with each trick. There is no dedicated trump suit. Instead, depending on which suit is led, the value of that suit will go up or down in comparison to the rest. After all cards are played into a trick, the player who played the highest card of the highest value suit played will take the cards played and separate them into the different suits face up on the table. The player who played the lowest card of the lowest value suit played will take a Power Cell cube of the color which won the trick. At the end of the game, players will multiply the Utility Ratings on cards they have won in each suit by the matching discs they have acquired. Any cards and discs that do not have a match are negative points.

—description from the publisher

name: Roborover 2077: Last Hope
description:
In the year 2077, with the rapid development of technology and industrialization over the past few decades, Earth has given birth to a myriad of crises. The ecological environment has collapsed, artificial intelligence has begun to spiral out of control, governments have crumbled, populations have dwindled, and disasters are emerging incessantly. Earth and human society are gradually approaching the brink of collapse. In this moment of crisis, you are alone, yet fortunate. Alone because there are few people or places on Earth that can provide you with help or reliance; fortunate because you still have the fortress—a bastion of wisdom forged by the most advanced technology—which gives you the courage to persevere. Will you successfully escape Earth? Or will you act as the savior to resolve the crisis and turn the tide?

Roborover 2077: Last Hope is a cooperative board game designed for 1-4 players. Players take on the roles of brave explorers, venturing out from their fortress bases to gather resources, produce necessities, and earn hydrogen for survival.

During the exploration actions, players collect resource cards, tech-gear cards, survival token cards and bonus cards or buy repair cards.There are three types of resources: water, food, and energy cubes. Players match or sequence these resources to earn multipliers that boost their hydrogen score, which ultimately affects their victory points. Excess resource cards can be used to supply the fortress's production. Tech-gear cards are used to resolve unexpected events triggered by the app. The more tech-gear cards accumulated, the higher the probability of resolving events. Correct answers will be rewarded with hydrogen tokens. The production action is at the core of the game, where players need to interact with the physical fortress and combine resources to produce necessities, earning hydrogen points and other valuable items. For example, combining water with an energy cube creates energy water, while water and food can craft vitality soup. If the necessities decrease to zero, players will have to deduct hydrogen from their own scores. Therefore, they need to cooperate to keep the necessities always in the safe zone.

Driven by App-based events, the game progresses towards its climax. The events include natural disasters, interference, bonus, recalls, and many other types. They also coordinate with the fortress to create a fresh gameplay experience. For example, featuring a rotating robotic arm and automatic identification technology, Roborover's intelligent cards system allows the players to utilize high-tech gear cards to tackle various events in the App. During a recall event, players will be rewarded to use the walkie-talkie to discover the clues of survival token.

There are two strategies to finish the game. First, you can achieve this by repairing until all malfunctioning components are fully restored. Repair cards can be purchased using hydrogen tokens during the shop's open period. Successfully repair one component will be rewarded with one reputation token. Second, you must find the correct survival token card. The way to obtain the survival token card is by traveling through a wormhole to another player's zone, which requires strategic planning of your route, because in other zones your movement steps will be reduced to one. Simply input the number of hydrogen tokens, reputation tokens, and adjacent resource pairs each player has acquired, and the final game leader board will be directly obtained. This formula rewards players for their ability to manage resources and plan their moves strategically.

In solo mode, players will take on the role of a commander, and the four exploration team roles in multiplayer mode will be unified under the commander's control. Players will explore different locations, and upon successful completion, they can unlock the next location. Unlike multiplayer mode, in solo mode, each round is fixed at 60 minutes. In the story, each location faces a disaster at the end of 60 minutes. Only by successfully finding the survival token and accumulating enough hydrogen tokens and coins can the disaster be averted at the final moment, and players can proceed to the next destination.

-description from designer

name: Robotopia
description:
The Master Robot rules Robotopia with an iron fist - literally! Rebellion is brewing, and the robot guilds are looking for a new leader. Do you have what it takes to run the factory?

Robotopia is a worker-placement game about robots who want to rule. Each player is an ambitious robot working to usurp the Master Robot and take control of the factory.

Each round, you’ll place a robot on a factory location. This robot will stay at work on the board, and no longer belongs to you. The robot will activate any factory spaces it touches to collect resources, build generators, and influence the robot guilds. The bigger the robot, the more spaces it can use. When you run out of robots, power your generators to build more and move the Master Robot around the factory to crush robots into resource cubes.

Gain influence with the robot guilds by spending resources and completing schematics. The game ends once a player has achieved influence with all four of the robot guilds. The first player who does this, wins the game!

name: Rocky Mountain High
publisher: Blast City Games; Emperors of Eternal Evil
description:
In 2012 the state of Colorado voted to make the recreational sale of marijuana legal. While for a few years Colorado had made the sale of marijuana available for medical customers, now EVERYONE can buy weed!

YOU ARE GOING INTO BUSINESS! You'll need to buy a place to grow marijuana, and rent a storefront to sell your product. What kind of marijuana do you plan on growing? Are you going to grow low grade flower to appeal to low priced demand, or are you going to grow top shelf, kind bud? Oh, you should probably get some bongs and edibles, people need ways to smoke your weed, and a good many costumers like to eat it in candy bar form.

Can you navigate through the many costs of running a business in this new industry? Will you price your product to outperform your competitors? Will you be the richest tycoon in this new marijuana age?

Gameplay: Rocky Mountain High is played in turns, each turn will have many player actions. Throughout a game a player is managing their store, while also appealing to customers and the shop's safety. Customers have demands for cheaper prices, marijuana grades, supplies and more. A dispensary owner can build an edge by investing in better locations, growing more plants, having wider array of strains, stronger advertising and more. There is a balance to making a profit in this new marijuana industry. The player with the most money wins.

—description from the designer

name: Role to Reign
description:
In Role to Reign, every player creates a completely unique character and sets out to take control of a changing, unpredictable world.

You’ll draw a Race, a Role, and a Weapon to start. These give you your starting stats, gear, and abilities. You’ll track your Strength, Presence, Mana, Armor, Movement, and HP on your character sheet. As you play, your stats grow through gear, companions, mounts, and cards.

To make it easier, we built an online character tracker that does all the math for you. As you collect cards or take damage, the tracker updates your stats in real time. It also calculates your Initiative and Attack values automatically.

Initiative is based on the average of your current Strength, Presence, Mana, HP, and Armor. Your Attack is your current Strength plus Presence. In combat, you'll roll a d10 and add it to that number. The tracker handles all of this for you, so you can focus on strategy instead of number crunching. It works on any device and even saves your progress if you're playing a longer session.

Explore a Living Map

The board is made of 30 modular hex tiles that change every game. Each tile has different terrain and interactable locations. You’ll build a new map every time you play, so no two games feel the same.

As you travel, you’ll run into:

Campfires – quick PvE fights for gold and rewards

Towers – tougher fights with better loot like weapons and armor

Cities – can be fought, claimed, and upgraded to give you passive gold and healing

Beacons – roll with Presence to try and earn powerful rewards

Anvils – roll with Strength for game-altering upgrades and riskier options

Stables – non-combat areas where you can buy mounts and companions to boost your stats

You’ll use your Movement stat to travel across terrain, and terrain costs vary. Some areas are harder to cross, and others can be used strategically for defense or control.

Combat: PvP and PvE

You’ll fight in two main ways, against locations (PvE) and against other players (PvP).

PvE combat uses initiative and a d10 roll modified by your stats. You’ll alternate attacks with the enemy until someone is defeated.

PvP combat skips the d10. Instead, you compare your attack stat to the defender’s armor. Each player can spend Strength or Presence to roll a bonus die to boost their roll.

You can fight anyone on your tile at any time. Defeating another player earns you some of their gold and cards. If they’ve died six times to other players, they’re eliminated, and that could be your win condition.

If you die from a location, no penalty, but you respawn at your Stronghold or highest-upgraded city with full stats. You don’t lose your gear. If you die to another player, you do gain a death, and lose a small amount of gold an equipment.

Five Ways to Win

This isn’t a game where you’re chasing one goal. There are five different victory conditions, and you only need one to win:

Control all Strongholds

Control all Cities (solo or with an ally)

Reach 2500 Gold

Complete 18 Quest Points

Be the Last Survivor (all other players have died to PvP six times)

This means you can play aggressive, passive, sneaky, economic, quest-focused, or adaptable depending on what your character is good at.

Turn Structure and End of Turn Cards

Each turn has seven phases: collect gold, play a card or use mana, move, take an action, trade or upgrade, finish movement and heal, then draw an End of Turn card.

Those End of Turn cards are a big part of what keeps everyone engaged. After every turn, you draw one. Some hit the board hard with global effects. Some target individual players. Some give loot or help reposition players. Some are just chaos. With over 150 cards in the deck, the world constantly shifts around you. Even when it’s not your turn, you’re still in it.

What makes Role to Reign Unique?

Characters are fast to build but deep to master

The online tracker keeps everything simple and automatic

Turns are structured to keep things moving, and involve other players during their "down time"

The board changes every game

PvP and PvE are both strategic and rewarding

Victory paths are flexible so you’re never locked in, can ally, and pivot your goal as your character evolves.

Gear, quests, companions, and cards all feed into how you play

Whether you want to build an empire, quest your way to victory, or crush everyone in your path, Role to Reign gives you the tools and the freedom to play it your way.

—description from the designer

name: Roll a Gain
description:
Each player in Roll a Gain has their own player board, five dice, and tokens, and three mini-game boards are shared among all the players.

On a turn, you roll your dice, place a pair of them on your player board, then either stop or roll the remaining dice to get a higher result. As long as you keep getting higher numbers, you can move up your player board, which will give you points and symbols when you stop before busting. With the symbols, you cover spaces on the mini-games with your tokens, scoring points as you move or stack tokens.

You can acquire cardboard chits that are placed in notches in your game board that give you bonuses when you move past them with your dice.

name: Roll Initiative: The Elimination Party Game!
description:
This is Roll Initiative.

It’s not just a board game. It’s the spark that gets your game night going.

Imagine if rolling for initiative was the whole game. No campaigns to track or game master to guide you. Just dice, instincts, and a table full of people who are about to get very competitive. Add drinks to the mix, and now it matters.

The goal is simple. Survive the round.

To start a round, everyone grabs their die, their drink, and a random ability card. Then, all at once, everyone rolls, and the game begins. With no turn order, everyone must quickly play or scramble to stay in the game. Use your ability to boost your own roll, throw someone else off, or completely shift the round. Plans come together fast… and unravel even faster.

No turns. No downtime. Just quick decisions, perfectly timed plays, and the constant chance to flip the outcome in your favor.

Roll high and feel safe.
Roll low and be forced to get creative.

Because at the end of the round, the lowest roll doesn’t just cost you a life.

You drink it.

Each round captures the chaos of a classic fantasy encounter, stripped down to its most exciting moments. Rolling dice, unleashing abilities, and doing whatever it takes to survive.

No long setup. No waiting your turn.

Just grab a drink, roll some dice, and find out what kind of friend you really are when survival is on the line.

name: Roll or Stand: Forbidden Adventures
description:
Roll or Stand: Forbidden Adventures is a cooperative and solo roll-and-write, print-at-home game. It combines Blackjack-inspired mechanics with thematic route-building puzzles, offering a fresh twist on the roll-and-write genre. Embark on a replayable narrative campaign featuring 3 comic book-styled scenarios, each with multiple possible outcomes. Explore 12 unique puzzles, each thematically tied to a cinematic scene.

Each turn, you roll 2 dice and add the results to your previous rolls, aiming to get as close as possible to the target values without busting (going over), similar to Blackjack. Once you choose to stand, you extend lines in the active puzzle to work toward fulfilling its objective.

Note: Each scenario is contained on a single sheet of paper, with no crafting required. All you need is one pen per player and two standard six-sided dice to play the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Roll or Stand: Jurassic Adventures
description:
Roll or Stand: Jurassic Adventures is a cooperative and solo roll-and-write, print-at-home game for 1–100 players. It combines Blackjack-inspired mechanics with thematic route-building puzzles, offering a fresh twist on the roll-and-write genre. Embark on a replayable narrative campaign featuring 3 comic book-styled scenarios, each with multiple possible outcomes. Explore 12 unique puzzles, each thematically tied to a cinematic scene.

Each turn, you roll 2 dice and add the results to your previous rolls, aiming to get as close as possible to the target values without busting (going over), similar to Blackjack. Once you choose to stand, you extend lines in the active puzzle to work toward fulfilling its objective.

Note: Each scenario is contained on a single sheet of paper, with no crafting required. All you need is one pen per player and two standard six-sided dice to play the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Rollgeon Quest
description:
Rollgeon Quest is a roll-and-write adventure. In this game, you lead a loyal party of four heroes - a clever mage, a brave warrior, a sharp-eyed hunter, and a sly rogue - into the shadowy depths of forgotten dungeons. Their mission? Gathering shining treasure, and ancient secrets.

Game is played simultaneously for 12 rounds. In each of those rounds, players will roll dice and modify a pattern, that they will later place in their dungeon. They will be able to gather some of the treasure each time their heroes venture into the depths.

—description from the publisher

name: The Queen's Dilemma
description:
The Queen's Dilemma is a sequel to The King's Dilemma,, the award-winning (and Kennerspiel des Jahres-nominated) interactive narrative legacy game, and uses an improved Dilemma Card System to bring players an even more immersive experience.

Set a hundred years after the dramatic events of the first game and building upon the revolutionary Dilemma Card System, The Queen’s Dilemma introduces a brand-new story, improves the existing legacy mechanisms, and adds a lot of new exclusive features.

Take your seat at the Queen’s Council and choose your own persona from a pool of 6 unique characters. You will live the story from their perspective, whether as a cunning master of subterfuge, a fierce military leader, a greedy merchant, a philosopher advocating for progress, an aristocrat with a penchant for the occult, or a vicious lord tied to criminal activities.

Develop your character with exclusive personal abilities. Each character comes with Duchies or Marks under their direct control, and a deck of secret personal objectives and branching narrative paths that will define your story and future goals—which may intertwine with the destiny of the entire kingdom.

Shape the political identity of the Realm through the new ideology system. The policies you enact will alter the balance between six opposing political ideologies: Tradition against Progress, Force against Diplomacy and Order against Liberty. These also represent the moral values and agenda of your character: each one has a founding ideology they always root for, and other secondary interests whose importance varies from game to game, changing alliances at the table.

But that’s not all. The new keyword system allows the game to keep track of your personal choices: an unexpected act of forgiveness could secure you the eternal gratitude of the people, but a radical resolution could tarnish your reputation forever. Make your decisions wisely: the consequences of your choices will come back to reward or haunt your character later in the campaign.

Watch the map of the kingdom evolve as a result of your decisions! The events that unfold will change the world forever and unlock new game rules altering the flow of the campaign. Defend your interests when a Dilemma card directly involves the territories placed under your control, and construct buildings to gain new abilities and sources of revenue.

Manage the resources of your lands and trade with other players to achieve your goals: increase your political power, collect materials to improve your buildings, support the Queen’s Army in the war in the south, and provide for the needs of your people to avoid discontent, unrest, and revolts.

—description from the publisher

name: Rolling Pirates
description:
Set sail in Rolling Pirates, a modern Roll & Write adventure where cunning navigation, daring decisions, and the thrill of treasure hunting collide! Step into the boots of a bold pirate captain, exploring uncharted waters in search of lost riches. To prove you're the most legendary adventurer of the seas, you'll need to gather clues, outwit your rivals, and be the first to uncover the treasure’s secret location.

Each turn, roll three dice to navigate your ship, battle the wind, and upgrade your crew’s abilities. Explore mysterious skull-shaped rocks, plunder drifting wrecks and merchant ships, and face off against formidable Spanish galleons as you piece together the map to fortune. But treasure isn't found only at sea—bribe dockside sailors in rowdy taverns, trade stolen goods, and stock up on supplies in bustling ports. Multiple paths to victory ensure every journey is unique.

With open-map navigation, escalating tension, and a wealth of pirate-flavored choices, [i]Rolling Pirates[/i] offers a rich, replayable experience for adventurers who crave strategy, risk-taking, and legendary tales. Will you rise to fame or sink into obscurity?

—description from the publihser

name: Roma Victrix: Campaigns of the Roman World
description:
We find that the Romans owed the conquest of the world to no other cause than continual military training, exact observance of discipline in their camps, and unwearied cultivation of the other arts of war. - Publius Flavius Vegetius Renatus, De Re Militari

City. Republic. Empire. Roma Victrix – “Rome Victorious”.  Rome was forged in war.  Even the story of its legendary founding was rooted in a fratricidal conflict.  From her humble origins to her ultimate fall, Rome was either in a constant state of war, or preparing for it. Beginning with the Punic Wars until the deposition of the last emperor in the West, Rome was the dominant force in the Mediterranean basin.

Roma Victrix is a grand strategic, moderate complexity wargame covering a time period ranging from 218 BC to 533 AD in twenty separate historical and hypothetical scenarios.

Roma Victrix is a game which endeavors to re-create the conflicts between Rome and her neighbors to achieve and maintain that dominance.  A simple interactive sequence of play guides  each player through the process of revenue collection, recruiting and maintaining military forces, conducting land and naval operations, diplomacy, field battles and sieges.  Special rules are included to emphasize the importance and effects of leadership, cavalry superiority, mobility and attrition. Random events are also represented, adding an element of unpredictability to even the best laid plans and the likelihood that no scenario will ever play the same.

Seventeen historical scenarios range from the 2nd Punic War through the attempted reconquest of the lost Western territories by Justinian in the mid-6th century A.D.  The rivalries of the later Republic, the Year of the Four Emperors, Imperial expansion and civil war, the Parthian and Persian frontier, the upheaval of the third century and the Germanic invasions are all represented. Three hypothetical scenarios are also included in which players can create their own history. Of the twenty scenarios in Roma Victrix, two are ideally suited for solitaire play.

Product Information:
    Complexity: 5 out of 10
    Time Scale: 1 year per turn
    Area Movement Map
    Unit Scale: Legions, Legionary Equivalents, Barbarian Warbands
    Players: one to six
    Playing Time: 3-8 hours depending upon scenario

—description from the publisher

name: Ronin
description:
Stripped of your title and cast out from your clan, your journey begins as a ronin, a masterless samurai wandering a world that no longer claims you — but the path of redemption is not closed. Through careful strategy and unshakable determination, you can reclaim your honor and rise once more as a true samurai.

Ronin is a game of resilience, growth, and the pursuit of purpose. Every choice shapes your destiny — will you restore your name and find your place in the world again?

During the four rounds of the game, you will place your ronin in different cities on the map, trying to expand their influence in the regions of the Japanese empire. With collected resources and clever placement, you will be able to complete missions that will grant you special abilities and victory points.

—description from the publisher

name: Rook & Ruin
description:
A solo PnP puzzle game blending chess tactics & dungeon grids! Primarily played by printing & cutting unique Grandmaster cards for a true deckbuilding feel. Alternatively, jump straight into the action using the innovative "Flowing Arsenal" sheet system! Acquire chess piece movements to solve intricate labyrinth challenges. Think like a Grandmaster!

—description from the designer

In the game, players need to get their pawn out of a maze by using movement cards that are obtained through a deckbuilding mechanism.

name: Rookling Heroes: Training Grounds
description:
Discover the world of the Rooklings, adorable but determined little heroes of stone and steel! Choose your squad of 3, and face off with their unique special moves that change the battlefield around them - with patches of ice, underground tunnels and more!

Rookling Heroes is a short and snappy battling card game for 2-players. This ‘Training Grounds’ starter set is the start of your Rookling battle training and everything you need to start duelling with your Rookling teams!

Players set-up opposite each other with their 3 Rooklings in a row, facing off against their opponent's row. In between players there is the shared Battlefield Deck, where energy is drawn from by both players. When a Rookling's Valor runs out, their card is turned over.

Once you flip over all your Rooklings, you lose the game.

—description from the designer

name: Rotation Rumble
description:
GAME SYSTEM

    
    
         This entry is to allow for discussion/rating of the game system as a whole. It is not for a specific product or release. Versions will appear on the individual item pages.

    



 In Rotation Rumble you take over the role of a guild coach, that hires and commands mercenaries in the weekly rumble fights for money, cheesecake and glory. Chose wisely which fighters, challenges and inventory you combine to form the best possible pack of reckless rumblers.

Rotation Rumble is played with a pre-constructed deck of squared cards, which have 4 different actions on each side (in rare cases there are just 2) which can be activated by rotating them. This allows for endless combinations, possibilities and threats.

The first player to 12 Victory points wins.

—description from the designer

name: Rough Shapes
description:
Do you have what it takes to turn a mess into a masterpiece? The game is simple: make the best use of your rough shape in just 45 seconds. It’s not the shape that matters — it’s how you use it. One player holds up a secret word card (they don’t know what it is), revealing the word to the other players who race to grab a card with a funky shape from the center. Using their dry erase markers, players illustrate the secret word incorporating their shape. After 45 seconds, they reveal their drawings. If the guesser can figure out what the word is, they award the card to whoever they think used the shape best. The more creative, the better shape you’ll be in to win.

How to play:

     Spread out the funky shape boards
     One player holds up a secret word card (they don't know


what it is, revealing the word to the other players

     Race to grab a shape card, and using their dry erase markers, players illustrate the secret word incorporating their shape.
     After 45 seconds, they reveal their drawings. • If the guesser can figure out what the word is, they award the card to whoever they think used the shape best


—description from the publisher

name: Roughly
description:
Get ready for ludicrous guesses, ridiculous comparisons and argument-inducing approximations in this fast-paced party game.

Quick to answer and hilarious to quarrel over, these aren't your regular quiz questions. With 300 cards and 900 questions to choose from, challenge your opponents to wacky guesstimations like how high the Eiffel Tower is in adult male ostriches, or how long the longest ever human hair was in French fries. Who will get roughly the right answers to win the game?

—description from the designer

name: Rove
description:
Ah, another Rover! Another pilgrim of change and purveyor of death who seeks to wrest the fate of Chorus away from the untamed wilds. Will you perish there in the hinterlands or will you make it out with more than your life? There is something out there. Something worth seeking for, but it will be up to you to determine what precisely that is. Maybe it’s purpose. Maybe it’s knowledge. Or maybe it’s just nothing but trouble. But it’s not up to me. So, go on. Get out there and seek, before someone or something makes the decisions for you.

Welcome to Rove, an immersive campaign adventure. Explore the high fantasy world of Chorus, a wild and vibrant planet full of flora, fauna, and other things… that all want to kill or eat you. Rovers, a loosely-formed collective of sojourners and adventurers, struggle to maintain a tenuous balance. The natural predators of Chorus roam the wilds, threatening to prevent the people of Chorus from thriving.

As Rovers, players will adventure through a branching story filled with consequence, where choices affect both individual adventures and the state of the world. But beware, the paths left behind don’t fade away. They linger and fester until what was once the promise of a threat evolves into something else entirely.

Along the way, players will unlock new skills, equipment, and classes in strategic, turn-based combat. Adversaries will not stand idly by, though, and let Rovers traverse Chorus without hindrance. A unique behavior table will dictate how adversaries react based on the state of the encounter. This extra dimension of gameplay demands more careful consideration from the players without increasing upkeep. Spend less time managing the game and more time playing it. And Rove’s inspired skill card mechanic makes learning the game easy but provides complex strategic decisions for even the most veteran of players.

Master these mechanics and work together as a team. It might just be enough for you Rovers to leave a lasting mark in a world that forgets quickly and forgives rarely.

name: Row Your Goat
description:
Move fast, make matches, and get ready to scream!

Row Your Goat is a rapid-fire picture-matching, fast slapping game. Get rid of your cards by placing them in a grid. The second you see a matching set of 3 in a row, slap the nearest Lifesaver. Hurry, there's only a few of them. And if you don't grab one fast enough, you're left collecting cards. When you're down to one card, scream “ROW MY GOAT”, play your card, and slap a Lifesaver to win.

It's fast, frantic, and fantastic as a party game, kid game, or a showstopper for family game night.

—description from the publisher

name: Moon Bunny
description:
In Moon Bunny, you take on the role of a master bunny alchemist inspired by folklore. Your task is to guide your bunny assistants on a journey through the lunar landscape to gather rare Asian herbs. Each assistant has their own unique hopping movement pattern, and it is up to you to choose the right ones for the task at hand. Once you have collected the necessary ingredients, bring them back to your workshop and arrange them in a specific pattern to brew the ultimate elixir of life. The bunny who is able to gift this elixir to the world, bringing health and happiness to all, wins the game!

Moon Bunny is played in rounds. During a round, each player takes one turn, starting with the first player and going clockwise. On your turn, move your Bunny and bring the Herb or Recipe it landed on back to your workshop board. Optimize points by matching the public and private Recipes. The game ends when either the bag or Recipe stack is empty: players complete the current round, play one more round, and compare scores. The player with the most points wins.

—description from the designer

name: Royal Hospital
description:
Royal Hospital is the premier hospital in the world—a place where the globe’s most infirm patients come to seek the very best medical treatments on the cutting edge of science.

At the heart of Royal Hospital’s success is a worldclass medical team, led by the world’s premier physician, The Director.

Change is in the air, and Royal Hospital is in need of a new director. The board is considering a small list of candidates who are currently running high-end facilities around the globe.

You and a small group of the world’s best hospital managers will be put to the test to identify the next leader of this storied institution.

In Royal Hospital, each player oversees the management of a hospital. Players make decisions about how to structure their hospital, how to treat their patients and where to invest their resources.

At the end of the game, the player with the most victory points will be chosen as the new director to lead the Royal Hospital project.

name: Flash Point: Legacy of Flame
description:
Step into the heat of the action with Flash Point: Legacy of Flame, an immersive narrative-driven co-operative board game in which every decision counts and time is of the essence!

Legacy of Flame is an interconnected series of games, with players guiding a team of firefighters as they progress from rookies to seasoned veterans, unlocking upgrades and special abilities throughout the campaign. Uncover hidden information with sealed envelopes that are unveiled at pivotal moments and with a rulebook that adapts and transforms with each playthrough. The impact of player decisions in each game resonates across future sessions, creating a unique gameplay experience.

—description from the publisher

name: Impostor Syndrome
description:
Impostor Syndrome is a hilarious game of bluffing, blending in, and BS! Each round, players will have to pick a person and modifier card from their hand to compete in a randomly selected challenge. The twist? One of you is an Impostor, who doesn’t know the challenge when they pick their competitor! The challenge is revealed once everyone has selected their cards, and now everyone must present their argument for why their competitor is the perfect candidate for this challenge. Keep a careful eye on your opponents! You’ll only score points for correctly identifying the sneaky Impostor. And if you’re the Impostor…? Don’t let anyone know that you know nothing!

—description from the publisher

name: Ruler
description:
In Ruler, your goal is to reach 30 points first by “tasting” different types of Material cards. Brown, green, or yellow, each Material can be boosted with Paraphernalia and Support cards to create legendary combinations that will skyrocket your score. But don’t get too comfortable, your rivals will be trying to sabotage you using Munchies and Trick cards, stealing points for themselves or cutting your score in half.

Each round, a new Ruler takes charge and reveals a different Event that changes the rules of the game, forcing everyone to adapt their strategies on the fly. Will you play it safe, build massive combos, or disrupt your opponents at the perfect moment? Timing, hand management, and clever decision-making are key to victory.

Ruler is a competitive, fast-paced card game set in a fictional cannabis association. Its blend of set collection, hand management, and take-that interaction creates a mix of humor and strategy that keeps players on their toes from start to finish. Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate “taster”? Welcome to Ruler!

—description from the publisher

name: Rumble Planet
description:
Rumble Planet is a wacky, chaotic take on the battle royal genre with no player elimination. Land on the planet, loot weapons and armor, and duke it out on the battlefield!

Each player takes control of a single contestant in this deadly popularity contest. During their turn, they can move around the hex grid of the battlefield, open “loot boxes” to receive new equipment and attack their opponents with the weapon they found. However, all items are hit with planned obsolescence, and will quickly be discarded over the turns.

Each action can earn them Prestige Points, and the first player to reach 18 points wins the game. Being KO’d doesn’t remove the player from the game but will give their assassin a big bonus in Prestige Points.

-description from publisher

name: Rummathon Royale
description:
Be the first player to complete all 12 rounds in this Rummy Style game. In case of a tie, the player that completes the 12th rounds with the highest score is the winner.

Each round all players are dealt 12 cards. The goal is to complete your objective and get rid of all your cards to score the round.

In Rummathon Royale, players compete to form SETS & RUNS while cleverly disrupting their opponents' strategies. Each round presents new challenges as you balance building your hand & attacking others. The game’s dynamic mechanics ensure that every move counts, keeping the tension high until the final card is played. With the right mix of skill, luck, and deception, you can outsmart your rivals & claim victory.

name: Rummy Snap
