description: Introducing Rummy Snap – a strategic rummy game unlike any you have ever seen. Rummy Snap utilizes 55 octagonal-shaped, firm rubber, interlocking tiles that mimic the behavior of the playing cards in a classic 52 card deck. Challenge your friends and family to be the first one to use all your tiles by forming gin rummy style sequences and sets. Rummy Snap is an amalgamation of numerous table game classics: part Gin Rummy, part Uno, part Mexican Train Dominoes, and part jigsaw puzzle. Aspects of Gin Rummy: Players create or build upon sequences of consecutive tiles of the same suit (a run) or sets of two or more tiles of the same rank (a set). As in Gin Rummy, players strategize their tile (card) play to maximize their run and set creations while minimizing the number of turns to rid themselves of their tiles and thus claim Gin (Rummy Snap).

name: Runar
description:
“They saw The Dreki of Odin and the other Gods in the grey sky. They came to save the beloved Mannheimr from the bloody invasion of the Jotunn. The Gods came down from the sacred ship, gliding on their shields, surrounded by flaming embers. I spent my whole life looking for the place where they landed and where the battle took place, I’m finally sure I found it!” The sound of the horns cuts off the old Alfarinn. The Drekar from each clan depart the Roskilde harbor, bringing on board the most valiant and skillful heroes. The hunt for the mysterious Runic Gems, fragments of divine power, has just begun!

Runar is a competitive board game with high interaction and comic-style miniatures. Each player forms and guides a Warband of three Viking Heroes through frozen and harsh lands, teeming with savage and lethal creatures.

Earn victory points by defeating powerful Enemies, retrieving valuable Runic Gems, completing various objectives, and defeating opposing Heroes. Destiny Cards mark the unique moments of the game and trigger the final round. The Warband of Heroes with the most victory points wins the game and grants access to Ragnarok!

Play epic single matches, with Heroes at full power, or play a 5 episodes campaign, evolving your Heroes during the journey.

—description from the publisher

name: Runebeasts: Deck-Building Game
description:
In the Runebeasts Deck-Building Game, capture and summon creatures in your quest to be the ultimate beast-tetherer.

Runebeasts gives players the chance to evolve their beasts to make them stronger. Players can even try to catch the coveted legendary runebeasts! To win the game, players will have showdowns with their opponents around the table.

In this twist on classic deck-builders, each player will start with an asymmetric deck full of beasts. They will use those beasts on their turn to fight and attempt to collect more powerful beasts in the market, to collect gems and get bonuses, or to power up and evolve their beasts!

Each of the 10 different beast types provide different benefits, so you can customize your deck to fit your play-style. Will you roll the die and take your chances with legendary beasts, or take a more conservative approach?

Halfway into the game, players will start to engage in showdowns; programming their beasts in their hand and gaining points for every battle won. Earn 10 points to win the game!

—description from the publisher

name: Runes: The Game
description:
You and your fellow players are brave Vikings who discover an ancient black box filled with mystical rune stones, powerful rituals, and shiny coins. By laying the rune stones wisely, you can unleash the power of the runes.

RUNES The Game is a quick-to-learn and entertaining tile placement and strategy game for 2 to 5 players. Place rune stones beside one another. The more rune symbols match, the more coins you may lay on them. If you place a golden rune stone, you can double the number of coins. And if you form a line or a circle, you can put additional coins on it.

Rituals add an unpredictable twist and keep the game full of surprises. For each black ritual stone you place, you draw a ritual card. You can play rituals at any time — even if it’s not your turn. Use rituals to your advantage — or drive your opponents to the brink of game madness.

To Win, you’ll need to make the right moves, time your rituals wisely, and have a bit of luck. Be the first to place all your coins on the rune stones to become the Master of the Runes.

Why RUNES: Simple rules, high replayability, tactical depth, and fast rounds make RUNES The Game dynamic and engaging gameplay experience.

—description from the designer

name: RUSE
description:
RUSE invites you on an adventure in a fox-themed mid-weight Euro-style strategy game.

In Ruse, players take the role of a fox mother trying to raise her pack of kits more efficiently than other players.

Over 4 rounds, players go through Destiny, Collection,  and Action phases to ensure the growth and accelerate them developing their instincts in your den. The game design uses worker placement, territories exploration, resource management and dice management.

The player who accumulates the most victory points wins the game.

name: Invincible: The Card Game
description:
Invincible: The Card Game puts you in the role of young superheroes as they struggle to become the new Guardians of the Globe. Working together as a team, each player gets to control an iconic character from the Invincible comic universe as you battle to protect Earth from escalating encounters with the series' many supervillains. Unlike most deck builders, players in Invincible: The Card Game never shuffle their decks, so you fully control your own insanely powerful combos.

In each battle, you start with a character-specific deck of cards and a unique special ability, then it's up to you to build up your deck, charge your power, and choose your strategy wisely. Your enemy won't be taking it easy on you, unleashing hordes of minions to take you down, launching attacks to destroy the city around you, and forcing you to adapt to their unique special abilities. How hard could it be? Well, all you have to do is stay alive, protect Earth, and defeat the universe's most powerful villains.

The game can be played as a single battle or in a campaign mode of over four fully customizable and expandable battles by adding heroes and villains from many planned expansions. As you progress in the campaign, you'll gain powerful team attacks and combo abilities to strengthen your team — but your enemies won't be resting either! After each fight, the villains grow stronger, forcing players to adapt their strategies continually. The battles will be chaotic, and random turn order means teamwork is crucial to determining your optimal team strategy.

Players lose if their health goes to zero OR the Villain meets any specific win conditions as outlined on Villain cards.

—description from the publisher

name: Rust and Revenue
description:
Rust and Revenue is a solo roll-and-write game inspired by the economic tension of 18XX titles, distilled into a streamlined, one-sheet format. Using just three dice and a pencil, you’ll invest in railroads, build track, and upgrade trains—all while competing against two streamlined AI opponents with distinct behavior.

Each turn, you roll three dice to choose a company and an action—build, buy, or invest. Shares become more expensive over time, and companies receive dividends based on route performance. As newer trains enter the game, older ones rust, pushing you to optimize timing and anticipate obsolescence.  Each action pushes a railroad to produce less revenue for the President of that company.  Timing share and operational actions is nuanced and based on the dice and the game state.

With multiple maps, procedural setup, and minimalist rules, Rust and Revenue offers meaningful decisions in a compact, replayable system. It rewards players who enjoy economic planning, route optimization, and clever long-term thinking—without needing a full table or multi-hour commitment.

Designed for solo players who love 18XX, cube rails, or tight economic puzzles, this game captures the spirit of railroad expansion with elegant constraints and a touch of rust.

—description from the designer

name: Révolte!
description:
Inspired by the novel and role-playing game Wastburg, Révolte! is a trick-taking game in which nobles get you points, rascals steal coins, blaggards can be corrupted to become trump, and citizens can revolt and cancel a trick.

In more detail, the deck contains forty cards: ten unnumbered citizens and three families of cards (nobles, rascals, and blaggards) numbered 1-10. Each player starts with 1 coin and a hand of cards. The active player leads a card of their choice, then the next player can play a card of the same family, play a citizen (even if they could play a matching family), "cut" (ditto), or (if they can't follow) play off-family; to "cut", pay 1 coin, then play a blaggard as a trump. If a blaggard is played, the highest one wins, and if not, the highest card in the family led wins; additionally, the player of the highest noble receives 1 point, and the player of the lowest rascal receives 1 coin.

However, if more citizens are played than the members of any one family, then the citizens revolt! No one wins the trick, and no points or coins are awarded. The lead player of that trick leads the next one.

When all tricks have been played, score 1 point for each trick won. After three rounds, whoever has the most coins receives 2 points, then whoever has the most points wins.

name: Invincible: The Card Game (Kickstarter Edition)
description:
The Kickstarter edition comes packaged with The Old Guard Expansion, New Recruits Expansion, and promo guards.

The Old Guard Expansion consists of: 2 Heroes (Cecil, Immortal), 1 Villain (Doc Seismic), 38 player cards, 1 city (Mt. Rushmore), 1 team attack card, 1 deck box, 1 card divider.

There were 21 daily milestones, some of which make up the New Recruits Expansion while the others are exclusive to the campaign.

name: Sadowa 1866
description:
Sadowa 1866: a name that sounded like a thunderclap at the turn of the 19th century. Also known as Königgrätz in the German world, it was the largest battle in the Western world after the Napoleonic Wars and up until World War I. It also marked, and contrary to what all observers expected, the fall of the power that had dominated the Germanic world for four centuries. After barely more than a week of campaigning and a series of minor battles that had severely hampered the Austrian army, 220,000 Prussians faced 180,000 Austrians allied with 20,000 Saxons positioned on high ground, their backs to the Elbe. The defensive situation chosen was both interesting and perilous.

The Prussians were not yet regrouped at the start of the day, but they nevertheless launched the attack. The victory was resounding and final for the Prussian troops. It would forever change the face of Europe. By the end of July 3, 1866, 21,000 Austro-Saxons were out of action and another 20,000 were taken prisoner: a quarter of the Habsburg Empire's northern army was eliminated, and the rest retreated in great disorder to cover Vienna. The Prussians suffered "only" 9,000 losses despite a tense situation at midday. Austria was definitively rejected from the Germanic world, which would finish building German unity around Prussia four years later.

This wargame represents the final battle in the series dedicated to the 1866 war in Bohemia. A campaign system — available for download from the website  — allows players to play through the first six battles (VaeVictis issues 157, 166, and 174) in succession, resulting in a potentially different situation from the historical one.  Based on the series The Great Battles of Napoleon III (VaeVictis issues 55, 73, 138, 157, 166, and 174), the system is simple and dynamic, emphasizing the engagement of troops in the face of deadly defensive fire.

Game turn: one hour
Units: regiments and battalions
Map: one hex. = 750m
Complexity: 5/10
Solitaire: ​​7/10

name: Sagas: Bretland
description:
We are in the 800s. The Anglo-Saxons of Bretland are living peaceful lives, unaware of the imminent danger that is coming. Hundreds of Warriors and Shield Maidens from all over Scandinavia are sailing for the mainland, setting foot for the first time ever on English soil. Led by the most powerful Viking leaders, they set about raiding and pillaging everything in their way. Their goal is simple: Gather as much wealth, land, and fame as possible to become the next Great Viking Leader.

Sagas: Bretland is a game for two to four players where each player forges their saga as they raid Bretland in search of wealth, land, and fame.

Starting with a small raid party on the shores of Bretland, each player will explore the land, expand their colonies, gather resources, and raid Anglo-Saxon settlements while battling any other Viking leaders that may stand in their way.

At the end of the 8th round, the player with the most victory points wins Sagas: Bretland. These can be earned by building new Viking villages, raiding existing Saxon settlements, raiding other player’s settlements, and completing specific objectives.

Who will be the next Great Viking Leader?

—description from the publisher

name: Sakana Stack
description:
Sakana Stack is a climbing/shedding card game in which players play stacks of seafood from their hand with the aim of having the most valuable stack in play.

Stacks can be played of matching numbers, but they must match the last played card by suit or number. Players score the top card from their stack if the next player passes, so the bigger the stack, the higher the scoring opportunity. Play continues until a player sheds all cards in their hand, or the draw pile runs out twice and all cards scored are counted and recorded. Play a number of rounds equal to the number of players to determine the most successful market vendor.

—description from the publisher

name: Sakura Dice
description:
Art is an integral part of Japanese culture. Not only in martial arts, music, painting or drama, but also in horticulture, they have developed their skills to a very high level. That is why gardeners are said to be artists in their field. It was their job in imperial times to design gardens so meticulously and to care for the trees so carefully that the emperor would always be pleased. Harmony and balance were two of the most important aspects of growing a tree. By the time of SAKURA the trees were bursting with beautiful flowers, celebrating renewal, beauty and peace.

In this game you play as Japanese gardeners and your task is to grow the most balanced cherry tree possible, so that by the time the cherry blossoming called SAKURA begins, your tree is the most beautiful.

name: Salamandra
description:
The scholars are rushing to participate to Litha's festival. Send your apprentices to collect ephemeral and magical resources.
Restore life to the sacred vegetation, show yourself worthy of the goddess Salamandra and become the Great Druid.

Salamandra is played in 4 rounds (alternating day and night).
Each round, you have a set number of apprentices at your disposal to be placed and put to work to generate resources and Veneration Points, which are the victory points of this game.
It is a "Definitive worker placement" game in which you will activate your apprentices to create ephemeral resources to be used in the current turn to:

     build new tiles that allows to obtain the blessing of the Bear and Eagle divinities
     activate Cauldron tiles, generating Veneration Points and scrolls so you can gain points at the end of the game
     pray the Salamanders goddesses to obtain powerful bonuses
     pass and study Groves


Everything in Salamandra is a source of rewards, but you will have to play at your best to bring your strategy to its end and win the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Salami
description:
Salami is a fast-paced hybrid party game that plunges players into the lively atmosphere of a bustling tavern.

Players take on the roles of sneaky adventurers trying to snatch as many salami slices as possible without getting caught by the watchful tavern keeper.

With easy-to-learn mechanics, real-time action, and quick, hilarious rounds, Salami brings light-hearted fun and a unique blend of physical and digital gameplay to the table.

—description from the publisher

name: Sally Face: Strange Nightmares
description:
Bring the world of Sally Face to the tabletop with Sally Face: Strange Nightmares. Strange occurrences are happening at Addison Apartments. Explore the apartments as Sal and his friends, and work together to investigate the surrounding mysteries.

Play through different episodes with events and characters that echo the video game. Players must solve mysteries, stop cultists and prevent the Red Eyed Demon from spreading corruption while advancing through the story.

Players roll custom dice and use the results to perform a variety of actions to solve mysteries but if they dabble too much the powers of evil may become too strong to stop. Unsolved mysteries allow the Red Eyed Demon to spread corruption and the heroes may lose their lives or sanity. However, death and insanity aren’t the end. Heroes may persevere while mad or as ghosts. Such a fate brings the Red Eyed Demon ever closer to his goal of total domination. Players who complete the story face a climax which is a different challenge in each chapter.

-description from the publisher

name: Salsacia vs Conservia
description:
The conflict in the Despénsico Sea between the nations of Salsacia and Conservia was a long and tumultuous war. Every conflict has a story behind it, and fortunately, this one ends with a happy conclusion.

Salsacia vs Conservia includes 3 games that tell the story of the conflict: The Conquest of the Tower, The Training Field, and The Reconciliation Match.

In The Conquest of the Tower, you'll have to battle the opposing team for possession of the tower. Use your skill and aim to knock down the opponent’s cans and achieve the objective.

In The Training Field, you'll learn about the origins of the conflict. Practice your skill and precision to position your cans as close to the puck as possible. But be careful not to leave them exposed, as your opponent might use your cans as targets for their shooting practice.

In The Reconciliation Match, the happy ending of the story will be revealed. Use your skill and strategy to win the most chaotic soccer match in the Despénsico Sea. Score more goals than your rival using your cans as true athletes.

Game based on the successful Chilean TV comedy show "31 Minutes".

—description from the publisher

name: Salsicha
description:
Salsicha is a modern card game where the winner is the one who best uses their turns to make the smartest card choices and complete the "combina-cães" before their opponents.

At the beginning of each round, each player receives 5 cards, and another 5 are placed face-up in the discard area, along with 3 random "combina-cães" and the "Perfect Salsicha". On their turn, a player can draw 2 cards—either from the discard pile or the deck—and must discard one, checking for any extra effects (if the card is a head or a tail).

When a player has a complete "combina-cão" using all the cards in their hand, they can go out, ending the round, earning points, and starting a new one. If a player manages to present a "Perfect Salsicha", they end and win the game!

name: SAME DiffeRent
description:
SAME DiffeRent is a hilarious and thought-provoking party game where players try to think alike—or completely differently.

Each round, teams respond to playful or challenging prompts by writing down answers in secret. Match all your teammates with the same answer and earn big points. Give all different answers? You’ll still score, but less. Anything in between? Nada.

Designed for deep laughs, surprising insights, and unexpected connections, SAME DiffeRent is perfect for game nights, group bonding, or sparking conversation. Includes a mix of light-hearted, serious, and 18+ questions. First team to 31 points wins—but really, everyone wins with this much fun.

—description from the designer

name: Sherlock: The Game Is Afoot
description:
A crime most heinous has been committed in foggy London. The greatest minds in the city race to identify the criminal. The first to solve the case will earn eternal notoriety as London’s greatest deductive genius. The game is afoot!

Sherlock: The Game is Afoot is a quick-paced game of competitive deduction. Step into the role of one of many beloved characters from the Sherlock Holmes novels as you race across London, questioning your opponents and exploring leads that crop up around the city. Keep careful track of the clues you gain in your notepad, because only the quickest detective to suss out the missing culprit card will win.

—description from the publisher

name: The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: Blackout
description:
A supernatural spin on the beloved mystery game genre! Step into the world of the Magnus Protocol podcast and investigate the details of a unique, supernatural incident. Players must work together to read through the provided evidence, listen to the audio files (requires a paired website for the audio), and inspect pictures to piece together the truth of the case. Each case comes with one or two puzzles that must be solved, in order, to unlock all the necessary evidence. With their immersive, atmospheric gameplay, The Magnus Protocol Mystery games are perfect for anyone who loves deduction and horror, whether they've listened to the podcast or not!

In 1940, a boy is trapped alone in the dark with a broken camera. In 2022, with energy prices rising out of control, a strict blackout curfew is imposed upon the residents of an apartment building, and a student goes missing from his flat in The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: Blackout.

name: The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: Six Feet Under
description:
A supernatural spin on the beloved mystery game genre! Step into the world of the Magnus Protocol podcast and investigate the details of a unique, supernatural incident. Players must work together to read through the provided evidence, listen to the audio files (requires a paired website for the audio), and inspect pictures to piece together the truth of the case. Each case comes with one or two puzzles that must be solved, in order, to unlock all the necessary evidence. With their immersive, atmospheric gameplay, The Magnus Protocol Mystery games are perfect for anyone who loves deduction and horror, whether they've listened to the podcast or not!

In The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: Six Feet Under, a small-town therapist goes to the doctor for chest pain and discovers that her lungs are filled entirely with dirt.

name: SandCastle
description:
Build the most beautiful sandcastle by wisely spending your action minutes across 5 locations: construction, protection, water collection, crab fishing, and tantrums.
Anticipate the waves to prevent them from destroying your creations and collect shells, crabs, and equipment to maximize your score.
After 6 rounds, the player with the most points (castle, wall, bonuses, collections) wins the sandcastle contest!

—description from the publisher

name: Santorini: Pantheon Edition
description:
Pantheon Edition includes all material from the Golden Fleece expansion, as well as every promo card and many new cards. A lot of cards are revamped, reworked and rebalanced.

Santorini is an accessible strategy game, simple enough for an elementary school classroom while aiming to provide gameplay depth and content for hardcore gamers to explore. Santorini features variable player powers layered over an otherwise abstract game, with many thematic god and hero powers that fundamentally change the way the game is played.

The rules are simple. Each turn consists of 2 steps:


    Move - Move one of your builders onto an unoccupied neighboring space that is a similar level, up one level, or down any number of levels.  



    Build - Construct a building level adjacent to the builder you moved.  When building on top of the third level, place a dome instead, removing that space from play.   


If one of your builders moves from a lower level to the third level, you win. Or, if your opponent cannot move, you win.

name: Santorini: Second Edition
description:
This entry is for the retail edition that has 32 gods and 4 mode cards, as compared to the Santorini: Pantheon Edition with 100 gods and 12 mode cards.

Changes from the first edition include: upgraded buildings and hero figures. God cards have been revised and rebalanced.

name: The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: The Doppelganger
description:
A supernatural spin on the beloved mystery game genre! Step into the world of the Magnus Protocol podcast and investigate the details of a unique, supernatural incident. Players must work together to read through the provided evidence, listen to the audio files (requires a paired website for the audio), and inspect pictures to piece together the truth of the case. Each case comes with one or two puzzles that must be solved, in order, to unlock all the necessary evidence. With their immersive, atmospheric gameplay, The Magnus Protocol Mystery games are perfect for anyone who loves deduction and horror, whether they've listened to the podcast or not!

In The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: The Doppelganger, a man is terrified to see himself dancing in a club with his ex-husband, while a rash of bad luck tears its way through his friend group.

name: Scare BnB
description:
Scare B&b is a microgame played by two to four players. It is a simple game based on bluffing, take-that, and memory mechanisms. In this game, the players set up each other's B&Bs and then try to get all their guests out first. However, if any player finds the exit before finding the key, the building rearranges itself.

This game is designed for ages five and above and is a fast, light game that everyone in the family can enjoy.

—description from the designer

name: Scavengers
description:
Scavengers is an entry-level sci-fi strategy board game where 2-4 players compete for dominance on a hostile alien planet. The goal? Be the first to collect 10 Warpium, a rare and powerful energy source. With four streamlined phases per turn, players deploy units, expand territory, and engage in tactical battles, making for a fast-paced yet deeply strategic experience.

The game’s modular tile system ensures that no two playthroughs are ever the same. With over 8 trillion possible battlefield configurations, each session offers fresh challenges and opportunities. Players must adapt their strategies on the fly, exploring new terrain and navigating the ever-changing environment.

Adding to the excitement, the fate of Warpium and the dreaded Dreadclaw strikes are determined by a unique D12 and D4 dice system, keeping players on edge with dynamic and unpredictable events. Every turn presents new risks and rewards, forcing players to balance calculated strategy with adaptability.

Whether you're a seasoned strategist or new to tabletop gaming, Scavengers delivers an accessible yet engaging experience. With intuitive mechanics, endless replayability, and high-stakes decision-making, it’s a game that will keep players coming back for more. Will you outthink your rivals and claim victory, or be left scavenging for survival?

—description from the designer

name: Scenery
description:
Waterfalls, cliffs, wildlife, foliage, snow peaks, and panoramic views populate the Alpine landscape. Lay out hiking trails with the most beautiful scenery!

In SCENERY, players create hiking routes through hexagonal landscape tiles that have varying altitudes. To set up, create a market of face-up tiles, with each player having a compass token next to the market. Each tile has an height above sea level value (200-3500 m), one or more paths, and possibly a flower or animal.

On a turn, take a tile adjacent to your compass, move the compass, then fill the empty space with a new tile; a player can't choose the tile at the back of their compass. You place tiles one by one into a personal landscape, trying to create walkable closed routes across 3-7 hexes, with the landscape tiles not differing too much in height based on the length of the route (so that routes are accessible to hikers). When you complete a route, take the highest valued route token for the size of the route, then mark each tile intersection on the route.

Based on how your hexes are combined, you'll add waterfalls, cliff faces, and viewpoints, each of which scores differently. From a viewpoint, you want to see animals and flowers in the valley below, and a waterfall scores based on the number of route tokens at its base. Flowers and animals also score for route tokens adjacent to them. For variety, you can play with optional goals such as most unique animals, tallest waterfall, and most dead ends.

name: The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: The Grinning Corpse
description:
A supernatural spin on the beloved mystery game genre! Step into the world of the Magnus Protocol podcast and investigate the details of a unique, supernatural incident. Players must work together to read through the provided evidence, listen to the audio files (requires a paired website for the audio), and inspect pictures to piece together the truth of the case. Each case comes with one or two puzzles that must be solved, in order, to unlock all the necessary evidence. With their immersive, atmospheric gameplay, The Magnus Protocol Mystery games are perfect for anyone who loves deduction and horror, whether they've listened to the podcast or not!

After a car accident, a man is hospitalized and in a coma — but even through his vegetative state his face is locked in a rictus smile in The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: The Grinning Corpse.

name: Schaf nachgedacht
description:
When the sheep step out of line...

This game with the charming design looks absolutely harmless, but “Schaf nachgedacht” has it all. The aim is to form rows, always at least 3 sheep together with your own shepherd. This is not easy, as the shepherd may always move, but his sheep can only be moved if the shepherd is able to see them.

Once a valid row has been completed, a white sheep is exchanged for a colored one. As the sheep are constantly moving out of line due to the other player's actions, it is important to keep an overview.

—description from the designer

name: Schattenwald
description:
Visit the magic school on the edge of the Shadow Forest! ✨

Over eighteen chapters in Schattenwald, you'll be sent on adventures that get trickier and trickier — teamwork is required here! Find rare ingredients, master magical spells, and stay away from the forest spirits...

name: Schatz des Phönix
description:
In Schatz des Phönix, you try to grab the more valuable treasure away from your fellow players.

In each of three rounds, you play cards one by one onto three phoenix nests until you've played two cards onto each nest. If the cards don't match in color or value, your "strength" for this nest is your highest card played; if the colors or values match, add the cards for your strength; if both color and value match, create a two-digit value from those cards, e.g., two 3s becomes 33 strength. Players claim a treasure from a nest based on their strength relative to one another.

name: Schnitt
description:
Schnitt is a fast-paced card word game in which you flip cards and find a Schnitt word, a word that fits all the categories shown.

Play against each other or in teams in different modes of difficulty to be faster than everyone else. Or try your hand at the various puzzles and challenges together or solo.

—description from the publisher

name: Scourge of the High Seas
description:
Take to the seas Pirate Captains! The merchants are over burdened with goods and money and need your assistance to relieve them of their troubles. But be leery! The King's navy is on the lookout for the Jolly Roger. Get your loot, sell it, and be the one with the most wealth at the end of the season by any means necessary!

Scourge of the High Seas is played over 5 rounds where players will move their ship to attack merchants, islands and the navy in order to gain supplies to sell at market in trade for money. Once sold, bury the money and treasure to keep it safe for the end of the game. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game wins.

FEATURES

     3-6 players
     90-120 Minute Playtime
     200+ Pieces and Tokens
     Deck of treasure cards


GAMEPLAY
Three to six players can set sail on the ocean to try and gain the most money. Players will search out merchant ships or royal held islands and plunder them for supplies, treasure and money. With the supplies, the players can deliver them to nearby markets for selling to further increase their money. However, a captain's fortune is not safe until they can successfully bury it on the hidden island. Do not hold onto too much loot or another player may decide you are an easier way to grow their fortune.

Each player will have crew tokens to assign positions on their ship board in secret. When all players have made their assignments, everyone reveals their choices and whoever has the most speed will move first. Crew assignments may depend on many factors including wind direction, nearby targets to attack, other players and the navy ships out on patrol.

Each round the merchants and navy move around on trade routes, while the King's islands produce more supplies to be sold at market. Each market has its own demands for the four different types of supplies and it changes as player's sell their ill-gotten goods. In addition, every round has shifting winds making every decision in every round impactful.

Will you go for the island that has a bunch of one resource in hopes the market demand is high? Or will you risk confrontation with the navy to steal from the merchant ships? Perhaps that other pirate ship is too encumbered by its own fortunes and is ripe for the taking. The choice is yours and each game has a different starting layout giving unending variety.

—description from the designer

name: The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: The Last Supper
description:
A supernatural spin on the beloved mystery game genre! Step into the world of the Magnus Protocol podcast and investigate the details of a unique, supernatural incident. Players must work together to read through the provided evidence, listen to the audio files (requires a paired website for the audio), and inspect pictures to piece together the truth of the case. Each case comes with one or two puzzles that must be solved, in order, to unlock all the necessary evidence. With their immersive, atmospheric gameplay, The Magnus Protocol Mystery games are perfect for anyone who loves deduction and horror, whether they've listened to the podcast or not!

In The Magnus Protocol Mysteries: The Last Supper, a famous young chef who specializes in cooking organs is found dead in her apartment, with an organ missing from her own body.

name: Top Tier
description:
Top Tier is a light party game based on the internet phenomenon of tier lists. Each round, one player will be the Tier Wizard, and secretly draw a category card from the deck. This will be the category they are ranking all the contenders in for this round –anywhere from who would be best at fighting a bear to who would have the most unread emails in their inbox! Without knowing the category, the remaining players will pick 8 contenders for the round. These can be characters, celebrities, or even personal friends. The Tier Wizard must rank the contenders by how good they’d be in the category, and once they’re done the category is revealed, but not their rankings! The rest of the players must do their best to rank the 8 contenders the same way the Tier Wizard did, scoring points for every card placed correctly! If you can get all eight contenders right, you’ll truly be Top Tier!

—description from the publisher

name: Scratch & Catch
description:
Play your cards wisely to score points with Cat cards, get rid of your Flea tokens, or give them back to your opponents.
The game ends as soon as a player has no more Fleas or when the draw pile is empty.
Have the most points to win the game.

Tonight is party night at Château de Chatnonceau! All the Cats are dressed to the nines, but here comes the Itchy Cat to a disco beat — and this rascal fully intends to shake things up!

Dive into the wacky world of Scratch & Catch, a fast, funny, and tactical game where stylish cats face off against an unexpected guest: the mischievous Itchy Cat! Each turn, play your cards to build sequences and get rid of your Fleas, or stack columns to win precious cards. But watch out for the Itchy Cat, always ready to stir up chaos among your opponents! Bluff, timing, and sneaky tricks lie at the heart of this fun and interactive experience. Easy to learn yet clever, Scratch & Catch delivers fast-paced games full of twists and turns — perfect for family or friends. Careful… this Cat’s got bite!

—description from the publisher

name: Aeon's End: Beyond the Breach
description:
Aeon’s End: Beyond the Breach expands on the beloved expedition system with a brand new FIGHT FIVE. This means a brand new tier of nemesis difficulty and a brand new type of treasure cards players can earn for surviving this gauntlet of challenges. This box is a standalone product with new mages, nemeses, supply cards, friends and foes, and treasures that will enhance anyone’s collection.

—description from the publisher

name: Sea & Steel: Columbus' Voyages
description:
THE HISTORICAL CONTEXT
In the late 15th century, European powers, particularly Spain and Portugal, were driven by a desire for new trade routes to Asia. The traditional overland “Silk Road” was becoming increasingly difficult and expensive due to the rise of the Ottoman Empire. This spurred a quest for a westward sea route to the lucrative markets of the “East Indies” (Asia), rich in spices, gold, and other valuable goods.

Christopher Columbus, believed he could reach Asia by sailing west across the Atlantic Ocean, a concept considered improbable by many at the time who underestimated the Earth’s circumference. After years of seeking patronage, he finally gained the support of the Spanish monarchs, King Ferdinand II and Queen Isabella I. They had just completed the Reconquista, expelling the Moors from Spain, and were eager to expand their influence, wealth, and spread Catholicism.

Columbus set sail on August 3, 1492, with three ships: the Niña, the Pinta, and the Santa María. After a long and challenging voyage, land was sighted on October 12, 1492. Instead of reaching Asia, Columbus had stumbled upon islands in the Caribbean, specifically an island in the Bahamas (which he named San Salvador, though the indigenous people called it Guanahani).

His arrival marked the beginning of a profound encounter between the Old World and the New. Columbus believed he had reached the Indies, hence his naming of the indigenous people as “Indians.” He encountered various native groups, including the Lucayan, Taíno, and Arawak peoples.

This initial voyage, and the subsequent ones, ushered in the Age of Exploration, leading to centuries of European colonization, the transatlantic slave trade, and the “Columbian Exchange” – a massive transfer of plants, animals, culture, technology, and unfortunately, diseases between the Americas, Europe, and Africa, with devastating consequences for the indigenous populations of the Caribbean.

GAMEPLAY AT A GLANCE
The game is a strategic experience for one or two players that immerses you in the historical encounters between the Spanish conquistadors and the native peoples of the Caribbean during Christopher Columbus’s four voyages. It covers the period between 1492 and 1505, when the Spanish Crown financed these voyages, leading to the conquest of the main Caribbean islands inhabited by the Taíno and Carib peoples. Players can choose to lead the ambitious Spanish Side to conquer the paradisiacal Caribbean islands, or lead the indigenous Taíno and Carib forces (who are not always cooperative) to eliminate the new threat from across the sea, while also managing internal conflicts among their forces.

Objective and how to win:
In the game, there is only one Victory Point (VP) tracker. The Spanish Side advances on the VP tracker when they gain Victory Points. Conversely, the Indigenous Side aims to reduce that score, moving the tracker backward each time they gain VP.

Specifically, when conquering a new area:
•The Spanish Side adds 1 VP or 2 VP if they gain control of an area.
•The Indigenous Side subtracts 1 VP or 2 VP from the Spanish VP tracker each time they gain control of an area.

Automatic Victory: A game ends automatically if the last unit of one side is removed from the map, granting victory to the opposing side. For the Spanish side, a Citadel on the map counts as a unit for this purpose.

At the end of the game (game turn 6), you’ll need to check various conditions related to leaders, citadels, and royal support to determine modifications to your final Victory Points.

Spanish Victory: The Spanish Side wins if their PV score is equal to or exceeds 15 PV.
Indigenous Victory: The Indigenous Side wins if the PV score is less than 15 PV.

Sequence of play:

Game Turn 1 (“1492”): A Destiny Card is revealed, determining Columbus’s initial landing and deployment of Spanish units, followed by immediate combat and a gold search. The turn concludes, moving to Turn 2.
 Game Turns 2-6: Each turn follows five main phases:
1. Destiny: Reveals the turn’s special event, sets the number of actions (impulses), and other turn-wide conditions.
2. Event: Both players secretly choose and reveal Event Cards, resolving their effects and deploying immediate reinforcements.
3. Reinforcements & Replacements: New units arrive or existing ones are strengthened, based on the Event Cards played.
4. Impulses: Players alternate taking one action per impulse (e.g., movement, combat, area activation, building, raiding, gold search), with the Indigenous Side always acting first.
5. Final: Checks are performed for automatic victory (if a side has no units left) or, at the end of Turn 6, for final Victory Point condition.
Key decision/challenges:
The designer aimed to create a “simple, but not simplistic” design, featuring an agile mechanic and a simple turn sequence. This design choice makes it suitable for introducing new players to wargames, while still offering “variable strategic options” and “agonizing” decision-making dilemmas that experienced wargamers will enjoy. The game is designed for quick play, with sessions lasting between 60 to 90 minutes.

The Extended Movement is a very important mechanic. This allows units to activate an area and move, and if they arrive in an area without enemy units, that new area can be activated again for another movement, potentially creating a “chain” of activations. This indeed enables rapid expansion and movement across the map. Mastering this mechanic is crucial for both the Spanish and Indigenous sides, as the game emphasizes maximizing the effects of decisions.

Despite its quick pace, this game delivers intense, nail-biting matches. You’ll need to keep pushing relentlessly by making good strategic decisions, even when things look grim, as the tide can turn in an instant, leading to a dramatic victory. Many games are decided in the very last moments, a tension players consistently rave about.

WHAT’S IN THE BOX?
1 Mounted Map
180 Counters
52 Cards
6 6-sided dice
3 Player Aid Sheets
6 Cloth bags
1 Rulebook

—description from the publisher

name: Sea Beasts: A Bloody Voyage
description:
Embark on a thrilling cooperative voyage in SEA BEASTS, a vibrant yet relentless Ocean Crawler for 1-2 players! Play as Vikings sailing cargo through treacherous, beast-infested waters to fortify your struggling tribes! Unleash your blood rage to conquer the horrors of the deep and prove your legacy!

—description from the publisher

name: Secession 1861
description:
Secession 1861 is a solitaire effort to parry Abraham Lincoln and the powerful Union military and political efforts to subdue and defeat the Confederacy. You command the military, political and industrial forces of the South as you try to become the Confederate States of America, from Secession in 1861 to Appomattox Court House (or a different outcome?).

You have a variety of tools at your disposal, including ironclads to challenge Union supremacy at sea, a qualitatively superior army (at least initially), and opportunities to flex some political and industrial potential. And Secession 1861's unique tactical battle system gives you an opportunity to re-fight the Civil War's decisive battles.

The main action plays out on the 28" x 22" game board, where Union armies advance into the south, and various tracks tally Northern home front morale, abolition sentiment, the naval blockade, southern industrialization, ironclads and more. Battles are fought out on a separate 8.5" x 11" "Battle Board".

name: Second World War at Sea: North Cape
description:
Adolf Hitler launched his sneak attack on the Soviet Union in June 1941. The Red Army reeled back from the assault, losing thousands of tanks, guns and planes. On 21 August 1941 the first convoy loaded with equipment and weapons left Iceland for the Soviet Arctic port of Archangel. For the next two years, the Royal Navy would force through convoys to the Soviet far North against enormous risks and terrible odds.

North Cape covers the Allied attempts to push convoys through the Norwegian and Barents Seas while German aircraft, submarines and surface ships try to stop them. Famous convoy operations like those of PQ12 and PQ17, British carrier raids, German-Soviet destroyer skirmishes along the Arctic coast — all of these and more are included. Like all games in the series, this one come stuffed with scenarios and variations on them.

North Cape follows the same story-arc structure as other new Second World War at Sea games, with history and scenarios interwoven to tell the story. Operational scenarios take place on the huge operational map covering the Norwegian and Barents Seas from Iceland in the southwest to Novaya Zemlya in the northeast, from the Norwegian coast to the Arctic pack ice.

When task forces make contact, play moves to the Tactical Map, where ships fight each other with guns and torpedoes. Battle scenarios start here, and let you get right into the action and shoot at the enemy (if you make explosion sounds, we won’t tell).

Most operational scenarios are very straightforward — each side knows what the other must do. The Allied player has large convoys of vital merchant shipping that must reach their destination. The Axis player has bases in Norway well-placed to intercept them, with submarines and aircraft that can hit them almost continuously. Aircraft are drawn in a semi-random fashion so neither player has perfect intelligence about their numbers and location. German surface ships are few in number, but there’s a lot of open sea in which they can hide and strike the convoys at vulnerable moments. And with war raging simultaneously on many other fronts, the convoy escort forces are stretched very, very thin.

The Germans have the battleship Tirpitz and battle cruiser Scharnhorst, plus cruisers like Admiral Scheer and Admiral Hipper and a flock of destroyers in support. The Allies have powerful British and American battleships like Washington, Duke of York and Alabama, but it's rare to see more than one of them enter the combat zone by herself. They also have aircraft carriers, but when the weather turns nasty, these become little more than inviting targets for U-boat skippers. And the weather's nasty most of the time.

North Cape includes a huge 22x68-inch map, 550 pieces (210 double-sized ship pieces and 340 normal-sized square ones) and 42 scenarios.

Note: North Cape is a thoroughly re-imagined edition of our old Arctic Convoy game.

—description from the publisher

name: Secret Recipe
description:
Grandma, the best baker in town, has decided to retire and pass on her book of recipes, which she has carefully selected and perfected over the years.

Interested?

Well, it looks like you’re not the only one, as the family and friends are all secretly hoping the book will be theirs!

But Grandma has a test for you! She has sent out letters containing recipes to everybody. But wait – it looks like the letters only contain parts of the recipes! Can you get the missing information from your family and friends by trading in some of your information, and bake Grandma’s famous dessert?

Prepare for a series of deciphering clues and sealing pacts, to see who will impress Grandma the most and become a worthy successor to her recipe book!

In Secret Recipe, each player receives one or two pieces of the recipe with 4 hidden ingredients that only they know. The goal of the game is to impress grandma and score Grandma’s points (GPs). You can do that by discovering other people’s ingredients, which moves you forward on the score track.

You also gain points and other bonuses for communicating your ingredients so that other people discover them. This marks the progress you are making in baking your part of the recipe and brings you point tokens. These points are revealed at the end of the game. The player with the most GPs wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Flash Point: Golden State Heroes
description:
California is a place unlike any other, with sunshine, celebrities, forest fires, earthquakes, and everything in between. Unique situations call for unique heroes. An elite firefighting squad trained to deal with the unusual situations that only a place like this can produce. Operating out of the beachfront city of the sun-drenched SoCal city of Los Aventura, these brave firefighters are ready for anything. When danger arises and requires the utmost skill, determination, and grit, Gold Company gets the call.

Flash Point: Golden State Heroes is a co-operative game of bravery and heroism. Included are six unique game boards representing a gauntlet of challenges for the courageous Gold Company in Southern California.  Additionally, this set provides action-packed boosts and new customizable gear to create countless combinations of unique firefighting heroes.

During each game, all players are on the same team, winning or losing together. To win, the players must rescue trapped victims before the fire gets out of control or the scene breaks down completely.

Flash Point: Golden State Heroes is a standalone game that introduces the "Ignition System", a non-legacy method of creating endless customized firefighters and using thematic event decks tied to each map in the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Segnum
description:
Not all hands are created equal but in this game, you get to rewrite your fate. In a high-strategy twist on classic Daifugō, players use special “segments” to alter the digital numbers on their cards, transforming weak hands into powerful plays. Whether you're adding bars to a 1 to make it a 7, or trimming a 9 into a 3, the key to victory lies in clever rewiring.

Segnum is a ladder climbing and shedding game inspired where players manipulate the numeric values of their cards using physical segment chips. Each turn, players may play cards, pass to earn segments, or spend them to modify card values in order to form valid sets. But there’s a cost to hoarding resources: unused segments at game end result in penalties, while perfect efficiency brings bonus points. Planning when to pass, how to reshape your hand, and when to strike adds a layer of tactical depth that rewards foresight and flexibility.

name: Selfish: Dungeon Edition
description:
Sharpen your swords, ditch your friends, and escape to freedom in Selfish: Dungeon Edition, a treacherous challenge from Ridley’s Games!

You and your fellow heroes must escape the deadly lair of the Dungeon Lord. In the pitch-black dungeon, your torch’s dying flame is all that stands between you and total darkness. There are three ways out of this place, but only one of them will grant you freedom without cost. And only the first person to find their way out will survive.

This devious strategy game is a race through dangerous passages battling against spiders, minions, hangry dragons, and, worst of all, each other! Attempt to reach safety while keeping your torch lit, wreaking havoc on your companions’ plans, and trying not to join the dreaded Skull Legion along the way.

Made for fans of fantasy, strategy, and sabotage and anyone who loves the thrill of the chase.

—description from the publisher

name: Seljuk: Byzantium Besieged, 1068-1071
description:
Anatolia, 1068. Romanos Diogenes has assumed the imperial throne of the Eastern Roman Empire. Ferocious armies of Seljuk Turks are on the doorstep, ravaging the border cities of the East and sending yearly raids and campaigns into Roman lands. Beset by political intrigue in Constantinople and assuming command of a fragile military, Romanos has only a short time to assemble the largest Roman army in over a century to drive off the forces of the Sultan Alp Arslan before the Empire collapses. 


Seljuk: Byzantium Besieged, 1068-1071 —Volume V in Volko Ruhnke’s Levy & Campaign series—brings players into the challenges of medieval logistics and maneuver across Asia Minor during the clash between Orthodox Christian and Muslim power in the lead-up to the climactic Battle of Manzikert. Players will assume the role of either the Eastern Romans or Seljuk Turks as they seek to make their mark on this historic land. Asymmetric victory objectives and new and unique additions to the Levy & Campaign system mean a dynamic game of cat and mouse between these two great powers.

The Seljuks are on the offensive with vast numbers of Turkic horse, speedy mounted units adept at ranged combat with composite bows. A loose alliance of local vassal states loyal to the Sultan’s cause and steppe tribes from central Asia unite under one banner to ravage the Roman state and carry off bounties of loot back to their homelands. The Romans field a much more heavily armored contingent of infantry and mounted Tagmata, but their frontier garrisons, the Themata, are few and not easily replaced. The Romans will have to use these stationary units judiciously to either defend against Seljuk ravaging or protect the walled towns and cities of the Empire from Turkic siege.

And both sides have to confront the very real possibility that some of their allied Lords might switch sides… Can one final, epic clash make the Seljuks think twice about conquering Anatolia, or can the Muslim armies of the East win one of their greatest victories and capture the Emperor of the Romans on the field of battle?

—description from the publisher

name: Sengoku Jidai
description:
Sengoku Jidai (Warring States Period) is a solitaire strategy game set during the final decades of Japan’s Warring States Period, leading up to the decisive Battle of Sekigahara.

As the player, you will take on the roles of Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu in turn, guiding their rise to power. Your goal is to conquer territories controlled by rival clans, overcome political and military challenges, and ultimately unify Japan under a single rule.

GAME COMPONENTS


     Game Rules
     One map (60x46 cm)
     30 Event cards
     37 Tactics cards
     40 Battle cards
     12 Clan cards
     167 counters (20x20mm)

name: Sequence: Jacks Go Wild
description:
A MODERN UPDATE TO A CLASSIC FAVORITE: The timeless strategy game just got a little wilder. The new deck of 52 Wild Jacks adds new powers to the game that break the rules in all sorts of ways. Get new Jacks by playing to the special spaces on the board. Be the first player or team to complete your SEQUENCES to win!

—description from the publisher

name: Seven Secret Supervillains
description:
Seven Secret Supervillains is a thrilling 1-4 player turn-based deck builder and deck deconstructor card game where players take on the role of super evil supercomputers bent on world domination. The goal is simple: be the first to amass four of the Seven Secret Supervillains and claim victory.

In the game, each of the seven supervillain crews has its own unique powers and abilities, providing strategic depth and variety. Players use their bots to gain power, recruit minions, and strengthen their deck, all while aiming to win over the supervillains in their crew. Knowing when to keep a powerful minion in reserve and when to unleash it to win over a Supervillain could be the key to outsmarting your rivals and securing victory!

Victory is achieved through careful deck management, strategy, and cunning as you outmaneuver your opponents and prove you're the ultimate mastermind in the race for world domination.

—description from the designer

name: Invincible: the Card Game – Aftermath
description:
Invincible: Aftermath is a cooperative deck building game where your deck is never shuffled. Your goal is to defeat the Boss before it destroys your team or the Homeworld you’re defending. It is a standalone expansion but can be combine with Invincible: The Card Game.

In each battle, you start with a character-specific deck of cards and a unique special ability, then it's up to you to build up your deck, charge your power, and choose your strategy wisely. Your enemy won't be taking it easy on you, unleashing hordes of minions to take you down, launching attacks to destroy the city around you, and forcing you to adapt to their unique special abilities.

The game can be played as a single battle or in a campaign mode. As you progress in the campaign, you'll gain team attacks and combo abilities to strengthen your team. After each fight, the villains grow stronger, forcing players to adapt their strategies continually. In addition to new Bosses, Cities, Inventions, Combos, and Team Attacks for Expedition Mode, an all new mechanic is added - Bystanders!

Players lose if their health goes to zero OR the Villain meets any specific win conditions as outlined on Villain cards.

—description from the publisher

name: Shadow Cards
description:
In Shadow Cards, players secretly predict how many points they want to score in that round. Before each trick-taking round, two cards from their hand are chosen, whose value also determines the points to be scored. The question always arises: Do I set aside the high numbers to score a lot of points at the end, or do I keep them to make it easier to win tricks during the game? Those who combine instinct and strategy can prevail and win after three rounds.

—description from the publisher

name: Shadow Tactics: The Board Game
description:
The new Shogun seized power over Japan, bringing peace to the land. However, harmony is a fragile concept, so to silence the voices of conspiracy and capture the dreaded warlord Kage-Sama, the Shogun recruits a few remarkable individuals, who specialize in deception, assassination and sabotage.

Take control of 5 unique characters with vastly different skill sets and fight your way through the forces of the Daimyo, who relies on superior numbers of soldiers and samurai. Hide in bushes and sneak in the shadows as you try to infiltrate enemy camps and castles. Utilize your special skills, lure your enemies into traps and deceive the guards so your friends can swiftly penetrate defenses and deal with the leaders of the rebellion.

But on the other side of the table sits the Daimyo, who is prepared for all your moves and gets new abilities gradually as you move toward your target. Every mission comes with different maps and objectives, so you have to adapt your tactics according to the situation.

Highlights


     5 unique ninja characters, plus several Daimyos(villains) and guards, each with their own plastic miniatures
     Engaging story-based episodes: play through multiple missions, complete achievements and collect bonuses. Your actions will have consequences in future missions!
     Tactical stealth gameplay and character abilities based on the acclaimed Shadow Tactics video game.


—description from the publisher

name: Shadows Deep
description:
Shadows Deep is a cooperative strategy board game for 1-4 players, where each player assumes the role of a Vampire striving to defeat the Hunters, manipulate the Citizens, and seize control of the city.

Outwit your archenemies—human and werewolf Hunters—in rounds that feature deck building, combat, feeding, and thematic, emergent gameplay. Strike down your foes and claim the city with your sinister influence.

Set in a 18th century Victorian city, you and up to three other players take the form of Vampires, feeding on unwary citizens, raising Ghouls and enthralling Servants as you engage in a deadly game of cat and mouse with a cast of tenacious Hunters, each with their own unique hunting strategy.

The Vampires will need to work together to maintain control over the city and prevent the Hunters from nurturing enough Faith that the population turns against its Vampire lords. That said, this ruckus presents a rare opportunity to seize control from the other Vampires.

Invest in Vampiric powers of varying value and strength, balancing your efforts to repel the hunters with your own pursuit of power. Carry out forbidden Quests to enhance your own power and exploit the positions and vulnerabilities of other Vampires to gain an edge.

Build your deck to shape your abilities, command your Servants and complete macabre Quests to claim your position as the dominant Vampire of the city.

—description from designer

name: Journeys Afar: The Ketsueki
description:
Welcome to Journeys Afar, where infinite worlds filled with boundless possibilities are connected by a single road: the Ketsueki. Along this path, brave heroes venture forth, each journeying to distant, mysterious lands. On their travels, they explore sites of great importance, acquire powerful items, make offerings to benevolent spirits, sharpen their skills, battle fearsome ronin, and form lasting bonds. But in the end, only one will be remembered as a legend.

Journeys Afar: The Ketsueki is a sandbox game of epic adventure, where the journey matters more than the destination. Each player is a unique hero from a distinct world. Your world defines everything in the game: encounters, quests, threats, upgrades, and special rules that reshape every session into a new experience. As heroes travel across The Ketsueki, they impact the worlds they visit and discover who they truly are.

The game includes six fully-realized worlds:

    Memori, the Garden of Sleep — where dreams are born and the Ancients call home
    Shards of Hansha —  where a society of incredible artists devote their lives to crafting starglass
    Horobi, Twilight Unending — where the sun never rises, and darkness spreads unchecked
    Kakurega, Home to Beasts — where skilled Hunters track monstrous prey
    The Island Nation of Shima — where the Great Houses vie for the Sky Throne
    Unmei-Unmei, the Dancing Parade — where the flip of a coin can change fate itself

name: Ice and Idols
description:
Embark on a thrilling expedition for knowledge in Ice & Idols! Your expedition has discovered an ancient temple cloaked in ice and dust, containing a labyrinth of ever shifting pathways. Time is of the essence as you navigate this frozen maze, uncovering Idols that hold powerful secrets.

Ice & Idols is a unique pick-up and deliver game for 2-4 adventurers with a twist—literally! Rotate the temple ruins and manipulate pathway tiles to your advantage, strategically positioning yourself to research the Idols and harness their hidden powers. Every move you make could lead to groundbreaking discoveries or unforeseen obstacles.

—description from the publisher

name: Shadows Over Europe 1920
description:
Shadows over Europe 1920 is a game set in the heart of Europe in the aftermath of the Great War. All countries are in a period of restoration, while their governments stand on fragile legs, providing an opportunity for various cults to seize power and do as they please. 
In this game, you shall embody the president of a clandestine society formed to thwart the cults that seek to summon forth from the shadowed realms various creatures and beings. Their ultimate endeavor is to perform a ritual that will eventually conjure one of the eldritch gods from beyond the stars. To that end, you will manage resources, funds, and assets, employing investigators and dispatching them across Europe to thwart the cultists in their dark designs.

This is a single-player game that employs the so-called 'state of siege ' mechanics, where on various fronts you must prevent attacks from different creatures and factions.

Objective of the game:

During the game, the investigators' task is to fight against the cult and follow clues that will help them destroy the cult itself. They do this by preventing monsters from wreaking havoc across Europe, restoring political stability in the countries, and ultimately discovering the necessary artifacts for a ritual to prevent Eldritch gods from entering our world. 
Specifically, this is possible after the investigators complete both expeditions (in the Amazon and in Nepal).

Game turn sequence:

Each turn in the game consists of three main phases: the Event Phase, the Action Phase, and the Cleanup Phase.

During the Event Phase, you will draw one card from the top of the main deck (which you prepared according to the instructions) and resolve everything written on that card, from top to bottom.

During the Action Phase, you may perform two types of actions: actions undertaken by the investigators and actions of your secret society (special actions). 
Depending on their location on the map and with whom (or what) they share their place in the country, the investigators may perform one of the these actions: 

     Investigate one Rumour
     Attack one cultist
     Unmask one Cult
     Do a Political agitation
     Do a Monster Hunt
     Venture through Expedition


And, depending on the number of Resources secret society has, it can:

     Move Investigators
     Provide Ship and/or Airplane Tickets
     Employ Investigators
     Employ Police and/or Soldiers 


After all Investigators have spent their one action (or you decide to skip their action) turn has ended and it's time to re-fresh and cleanup the game-board. Do this in this order:

     Return all rumour Tokens that doesn't have a top right 'timeless' icon to their supply
     Flip all used tokens from your Charm and Supply placeholders
     Flip all Investigators to their 'ready' side (side with their portrait image)


You win the game at the end of the turn where both Expedition tokens are on the last numbered spot (5). This means that your Investigators have successfully found ancient relics that will help them to perform a powerful ritual that will cleanse Europe from the Cult and their attempt  to bring and Elder god to our world.

Another way you can possibly 'win' is if you go through the whole deck of cards with at least one Investigator still alive on the map. If this happens, consult the end of this game-book about the story of your endeavor and the of the Europe.

—description from the designer

name: Shady Lady
description:
The long‑awaited Shady Lady is a card game of bluffing, deduction, and psychological battles for 2–6 players. Read the cards, outwit your rivals, and smile slyly as your plan unfolds.

If you secretly assemble a strong hand, declare “Try”. If you suspect someone else has completed their hand, call “Jack”

name: Shake It Meerkat
description:
In the grasslands of Africa, bigger meerkats command more attention—but sometimes size is just a bluff. In this cheeky battle of wits, players take on the roles of clever meerkats trying to rise to the top of the pack. But not every claim to size is real. Can you play your cards right or call out your opponents' lies and come out on top?

Shake It Meerkat is a climbing and bluffing game where players aim to shed their hands by playing increasingly stronger sets. Each card has a numeric value and an illustration of a meerkat. The bigger the number, the larger the meerkat image. Players can lie about what they played, but others can challenge their declaration. If the bluff is called correctly, the liar is punished; if not, the challenger suffers instead. Victory goes to the player who empties their hand first, while others lose points based on remaining cards.

name: Shall We Dance
description:
Gentlemen and ladies take to the floor in Shall We Dance, with you trying to pair them off, in addition to specializing in certain types of dancers.

The game contains seven colors of dancers, with each color having ladies on half that color's cards and gentlemen on the other half.

On a turn, play 1-3 cards of the same gender of either a single color you don't have in front of you or only colors you already do have. In the latter case, if you can now pair a gentleman and lady of the same color, do so. Then for each color you played, if you have any "free" (i.e. unpaired) cards, see whether another player has a free card of the same color and opposite gender; if so, take one of these cards to create a pair in front of you, with the holder of the "stolen" card being compensated by 1-2 points from the reserve.

To end your turn, refill your hand to eight cards by drawing 1-3 cards, one each from different stacks. When enough stacks have been depleted, the game ends, with each player revealing one more card to try to make a final pair.

Score 1 point for each pair in front of you. Additionally, each player with the most cards in a color receives 3 points, with 1 point going to whoever has the next most cards. Whoever has the highest score wins.

name: Shallow Regrets
description:
Strange fish swim beneath your boat. Things with too many eyes, too many teeth. These eldritch anomalies are worth a small fortune, provided you’ve got a dauntless heart and an iron stomach.

Shallow Regrets is the leaner cousin of  Deep Regrets. Pull up unsettling curiosities in this strategic horror fishing game. Who knows what strange creatures lurk below the water's surface?

Each turn, the active player reels in 2 fish from the shoal(s) of their choice. They may choose one to keep in their boat. Unkept fish return to the shoals. Each fish has a strength value: to keep it, the player must have a number of hooks in their previously caught fish to meet the strength value. Most fish have otherworldly abilities that impact play. These can be used by exhausting the fish, turning it sideways to show that its ability has been used.

When all the fish have been caught all players tally up the total value of their caught fish. Some fish are considered foul, and whoever caught the most foul fish takes a scoring penalty for their poor efforts. The fisher with the highest total wins the game!

name: Perch
publisher: Inside Up Games; 999 Games; Game Harbor; IUVI Games; Maldito Games; Matagot; Skellig Games; Steinbock Brettspiele; Tabletop KZ; Yellowstar Games
description:
In Perch, players fight for control of locations by commanding birds of their own and other players' flocks. Earn points and command woodland creatures by having the most birds on a location, pushing your foes off the perch, and breaking ties to take the lead.

Each round, players add their birds into a shared bag. Players then draw birds of their own, and other players take turns stacking birds on location tiles. Each location tile will award variable points for majorities and sometimes grant players a unique ability.  The game ends after five rounds, and the player who has earned the most points wins.

With a modular tile configuration and a variety of woodland creatures to control, each game will present a new tactical challenge.

name: Crits & Tricks
description:
Take a seat at the most dangerous card table in Eldris.

In the shadowed corners of The Gutter’s End, every shuffle of the deck could lead to riches or ruin.

Crits & Tricks is a high-stakes trick-taking game where the quests you embark on each round will reward you with loot. Each quest you draft has a unique objective you’ll strive to complete by pairing your rolled dice with mercenaries from unique classes, Each class not only sets the win condition for the trick but also possesses a powerful CRIT ability that could shift the odds of the game in your favor.

Rise to the Barkeep’s Challenge in every round, winning the right number of tricks to claim extra loot. Lighten the pockets of your new 'friends' to win the game—but be wary, or you might walk away with more rivals than riches.

—description from the publisher

name: SHASN: AZADI
description:
SHASN: AZADI is a semi-cooperative political strategy board game in which players play as revolutionaries, trying to free their country from the grip of a tyrannical imperial power. If they succeed, only one will emerge as the leader of the new nation.

Each player must work with their compatriots to topple the Imperials and gain freedom for their nation — but every time a player takes a turn, the Crown will march forward and the Imperials will take a turn, launching devastating attacks against the revolution.

Players can combat the Imperials by resolving Azadi cards. From Jallianwala Bagh to the battle of Yorktown, each Azadi card is a unique event from history that has two sides, presenting players with two divergent paths of resistance. Will players take the path of peace and sit on a hunger strike, or will they take up arms and assassinate their oppressors? Each choice in an Azadi card belongs to a certain Ideologue. Players must choose their path wisely, for their choice will unlock a new zone and a Resistance card belonging to that Ideologue, strengthening that Ideologue for the rest of the game.

For every action you complete on an Azadi card, you will gain legacy. Spend your legacy to erect monuments to your sacrifice and earn new powers once your nation gains Azadi. If players resolve the number of Azadi cards required by their difficulty as well as a final Foundation card before time runs out, Azadi will be theirs. Even so, the new sovereign nation will need a leader. Players must compete in the first democratic elections of their country to see who will be declared winner.

What will you stand for? And what will freedom cost?

name: Kalypso
publisher: Inside Up Games; HOLYSWORD GAMES; Pegasus Spiele
description:
Kalypso is a tile-laying survival game where players build floating settlements in a world swallowed by the sea. With Earth’s surface lost beneath rising waters, survivors must salvage what they can to endure storms, overcome scarcity, and adapt to a shifting oceanic landscape.

Each round, players draft tiles and expand their settlement, managing resources, placing structures, and guiding survivors across platforms of rusted metal and driftwood. Strategic placement unlocks new opportunities, while weather events and shared objectives push players to cooperate, or compete, for precious supplies.

Play solo, cooperatively, or competitively. With modular objectives, and escalating difficulty, Kalypso offers a new challenge each time you set sail.

—description from the publisher

name: Thieves of Eldris
description:
In Thieves of Eldris, fortunes are forged in the shadows, one stolen coin at a time.

Amid the chaos of bustling merchants, you lurk in the shadows, eyes locked on your target, ready to slice their coin purse and make off with the spoils. The Thieves' Guild has taken notice of your talents, but earning your place among them won't be easy. To prove your skill, you must outwit your rivals, steal from your targets, and keep your true identity hidden.

Roll the dice to navigate the crowded square, rearranging townsfolk and setting up daring heists. Slip past rival thieves undetected, and when the time is right, liberate your targets of their precious coin. But beware, one wrong move and your rivals might expose you, stealing not only your newfound riches, but your invitation to the Thieves' Guild.

Will you become the guild's newest initiate, or will your ambitions leave you penniless in the gutter?

—description from the publisher

name: SHIFTED
description:
SHIFTED is a fast-paced, highly interactive social deduction wallet game where players take on the roles of blue-collar space workers called GEWPERS, tasked with doing busy work around their ship. However, one of them is the SHIFT, a shape-shifting alien bent on converting all life into its kind, and another is the VOID, a nihilist who would rather see everything fail.

Each turn, a Job Coordinator must complete a task by playing a poker-style hand. However, each job requires help from other ship members to complete the hand. One must decide who is genuinely working toward success and who is secretly manipulating the mission for their own win condition.

The game ends when one of the three teams reaches their goal: GEWPERS win by successfully completing jobs, the SHIFT wins by converting other players, and the VOID claims victory when enough jobs have failed.

—description from the designer

name: Tug of Roar
description:
The roar of battle echoes across Eldris.

The feud between the Elkyr and Lycarans has raged for generations, but this clash could reshape the future of Eldris forever. Townsfolk across the land are watching, ready to lend their skills to the clan they trust to lead them into a new age.

As the leader of your clan, you’ll command your Captains to bid for powerful recruits, deploy warbands to contested regions, and inspire your forces to push the Roar Track in your favor, intimidating your rival and hindering their plans. Unleash the unique class abilities of your recruits to outmaneuver your opponent and seize control of the battlefield. Each victory raises more of your clan’s banners, bringing you closer to claiming the throne of Eldris.

Only one clan will rise to power, will it be yours?

—description from the publisher

name: SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI THE BOARD GAME
description:
Journey into a post apocalyptic world and fight to gain control of a demon infested Tokyo. Use your abilities to negotiate with demons and take control of regions in Tokyo, and then compete in an epic battle.

This new strategic board game is based on the world of SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI.
  
In SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI THE BOARD GAME players compete to gather demonic allies to their side by using demon negotiating abilities and then using demon fusion to create even more powerful beings iconic to the SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI video games.  Players need to use their judgement wisely throughout the game to help mold their destiny.

This game will feature detailed and high quality demon figures.

—description from the publisher

name: Shogun Solitaire
description:
Shogun Solitaire is a card game for one player. Your mission in Shogun Solitaire is to lead a coalition of four clans to unite feudal Japan. Each clan must secure three objectives within their territory to achieve unification under a single Shogun. To accomplish this, you'll need to deploy armies in strategic combinations, outsmarting your enemies.

The game's object is to become the Shogun by unifying all the clans of feudal Japan. Each clan has 3 objective locations on their board in the following order from bottom to top; port, village, castle.
