There are 3 objective counters for each clan that start on the boards and are removed when they are seized.

Seizing Objectives:
Your goal is to unify Japan under one Shogun. To do this each clan must seize the 3 objectives of its color on its board. To take an objective location on a board, you must play three Shogun cards of the same color in a row.

name: Short Circuit
description:
Short Circuit is an abstract tile-laying game in which the players race their meeples across a board to pick up point-scoring tiles. At setup, piles of point tiles and the players’ meeples are placed on the board according to the number of players. The players define the length of the game by choosing what number of score tiles collected by at least one player triggers the end of the game. The recommended number is six. You can score additional points depending on the order in which you collect the score tiles. The winner is the player with the highest number of victory points.

At the core of Short Circuit are tiles that form paths along which you can move your meeple. On your turn, you can place up to three path tiles on the board and use them together with the path tiles placed in previous turns by all players to reach and claim score tiles. Instead of placing path tiles on empty cells of the board, you can also use them to replace, rotate, or remove tiles that are already there.

Action cards help you collect score tiles by allowing to break some of the placing and moving rules.

—description from the designer

name: Shred of Redemption
description:
Shred of Redemption follows the journey of a corrupt medieval noble, who decides to make amends towards the end of his life and challenges the player to answer: What can make up for a life full of violence and betrayal? The design mixes bag building with dice manipulation in a tight 15 minute playtime.

To win, you must use card and token abilities to create combos and adjustments so that all your vices are matched with virtues.

—description from the publisher

name: Shrinkopolis
description:
Humanity had a rough time. Climate change, overpopulation, hunger — you name it, we messed it up. So the world’s brightest scientists got together to fix everything the best way they knew how. With a shrink ray. One mysterious lab accident later, and boom — everyone on Earth woke up fun-sized.

Shrinkopolis is a resource management tile-placement game for 1-4 players and 15 - 45 minutes.

Each player will build their own district inside the great living room. Win the hearts of your fellow micro-citizens, and you’ll be crowned the very first mayor of Shrinkopolis.

On your turn, choose two adjacent cards (a city card and a reward card) from the circular offer. Place one to expand your city and gather resource dice by creating connections with already placed cards. Then, optionally spend a specific die to get a reward card of the same color from the common or personal supply. Collecting different animals gives you cute meeples to share other players´ resources. Getting useful tools allows you to manipulate with resource dice. Build sets of the same type of cards to unlock even better actions and receive more points.

After 5 rounds, tally up all points earned from reward cards and public and personal goals, and whoever has the most points wins and becomes the Mayor of Shrinkopolis!

-description from designer

name: Brink
description:
The Moonrakers are on the brink. They have thrown off the oppressive yoke of the Utopian Alliance, but they are in a constant struggle to stay independent and find their identity. Alliances are formed and factions arise as the Moonrakers agree to turn their focus outward instead of squabbling over what little they have. Captains push out into unknown corners of the system in attempt to gain resources, influence, and power. The tenuous alliances will only last so long and soon someone must emerge to lead or they will fall.

Brink is a worker placement, trading, and hidden voting game that brings the world of Moonrakers to a new genre. It combines the strategy and planning of a worker placement game with the negotiation and “above the table” play found in Moonrakers and Fractured Sky.

Each turn, players will place one of three different sized ships (workers) onto a grid of hexes. Each hex will gain the player resources and actions, but even more importantly, it will give them power within a faction based on the color of the hex. At the end of each round, players will vote on which faction will score points, which is then multiplied by the amount of power each player has in that factions color on the board.

Players will upgrade their ships, hire ambassadors, explore new systems, and spend influence to complete faction objectives, granting them new abilities. Each game, the map will reveal in a totally new way as regions are explored, presenting new strategies as well as strengths and weaknesses to existing strategies. The player with the most prestige points at the end of 3 rounds wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Siberian Manhunt
description:
During the height of the Cold War, the U.S. mounted a surveillance program over the Soviet Union, flying U-2 spy planes at high altitude to avoid radar and fighter interceptors. Not every pilot returned...

Siberian Manhunt is an asymmetrical hidden movement game for two players. One player takes the role of a U-2 spy plane pilot who has crashed behind enemy lines and must escape across the border into China. The fugitive must use their wits to navigate the dangerous landscape, survive encounters with predatory animals, and avoid starvation and hypothermia, all while being pursued by the KGB. Do they dare enter towns, risking detection by the local authorities, or will they strike out into the wilds and rely on their wilderness survival skills to stay alive?

The other player is a Soviet general assigned to capture or kill the fugitive. At their disposal is the full might of the USSR: KGB agents and Yakut trackers, the Red Army, aerial searches, road blocks, and propaganda campaigns. But the Soviet government is fickle and not all Russians are loyal communists — and sometimes the hunted is deadlier than the hunter.

—description from the designer

name: Sibille
description:
In Sibille 2 to 4 fortune tellers strive to obtain divine approval.
4 deities will be randomly extracted during the game setup, each providing a different game-ending goal. The first player to fulfill two of these four goals wins the game.

Players have a personal deck of 22 almost-always available tarot cards, each related to a specific action. In a round 3 cards are chosen and played form the deck to take the related actions, and three are played face down to guess opponents plays.

Taking the actions printed on the played tarot cards, players interact with the game components: 
Customers (resource-generating engines disputed between the players), 
Artifacts (power-ups to be acquired),
Tarot cards (to manage their availability),
tracks, resources, tokens, and many more.

Most of the gaming experience is about predictive bidding, combos, chains of actions, and interaction.

—description from designer

name: Siege Works
description:
The guns are loaded. The trenches are dug. The enemy fortress looms ahead, its walls standing between you and victory. As a British commander in the Napoleonic Wars, your mission is clear: reduce the enemy stronghold to rubble and take it by storm before time runs out.

In Siege Works, a solo roll-and-write wargame, you will oversee every aspect of the siege. Dig trenches to advance under fire, deploy artillery to batter the defenses, and choose your moment to launch a final, desperate assault. Every decision counts, do you bombard the walls for a major breach, risking delays, or charge through a minor gap before reinforcements arrive? The defenders won’t sit idle; expect sudden counterattacks, deadly sorties, and unexpected setbacks from the event chart.

Featuring action allocation, point-to-point movement, dice-based combat, and siege attrition mechanics, Siege Works puts you in command of a tense Napoleonic siege. Every decision matters as morale dwindles and time runs out. Will you claim victory, or be forced to abandon the siege in defeat? The fate of the fortress and your army rests in your hands.

name: Sigil
description:
Sigil is an abstract strategy dueling game.

Place stones to surround and crush opposing pieces. A board of Sigil is populated by 9 random spells. If you fully control a spell, you may sacrifice your stones in it for a powerful effect.

A game of Sigil ends either when one player has a 3-stone advantage, or when either player casts their 6th spell. Whoever has the most stones wins.

-description from publisher

name: Graft
description:
Graft is a card-drafting game in which 3-5 players race to collect sets of valuable goods and ship them back to Zenith.

Players simultaneously draft and play cards into their cargo manifest. Push your luck and chain combos of cards for high scores! But beware the cargo restrictions on some cards that limit what additional goods you can play - you’ll bust if your next hand has no valid option.

Ship your cargo to score points and claim bonus badges for specific sets of goods. Prepare additional groups of cards until the deck runs out. The player with the most points is recognized as the best pioneer by Zenith.

name: Pillars of Fate
description:
Pillars of Fate  is a 2-player lane battler with a twist of deduction, misdirection, and asymmetric powers, set in the Veiled Fate universe.

Send your champions on quests by playing cards in three lanes, until each player has played three cards in each lane. Each quest has two possible outcomes — gaining or losing points — that are determined by the suits of the cards played in that lane. Play your cards wisely to win (or purposely lose) quests.

Hide your intentions with one face-down card per lane. Use your divine abilities at the opportune time to gain the upper hand. Only one will emerge victorious at the end of three rounds!

name: Scales of Fate
description:
Scales of Fate is a 2-player deduction duel filled with heart-pounding mind games, set in the Veiled Fate universe.

Guide the rise and fall of nine demigods. Send them on quests to seek favor with the gods or smite their rivals. Secretly pledge your allegiance to two demigods, scoring based on their shared position or the distance between them.

There’s a catch: your opponent may share your allegiance to one (or both!) of the same demigods. After three rounds, correctly guess their demigods to gain extra points. Can you disguise your intentions and tip the Scales of Fate?

—description from the publisher

name: Tend
description:
In Tend, players take on the role of a pioneer working for the Zenith corporation to start a homestead on a new alien world.

Tend is a "flip and write" game where players are each building up their own farm and collecting the greatest selection of goods to send back to Zenith HQ for study. All players will be using the same deck of action cards each round to simultaneously take actions on their own sheets.

As the game progresses new cards will be added to the shared deck, changing what actions are available for the whole table throughout the course of the game.

Players earn victory points for collecting badges, completing season objectives, being the best neighbor, and filling up their Cargo Manifest with goods to send back to Zenith HQ. In the end, the player with the most victory points wins!

—description from the designer

name: Simsala Spin
description:
In Simsala Spin, little witches and wizards get to work with cauldrons, but before the best potions can be created, the right ingredients are needed! These ingredients are well hidden, though, and must first be found and uncovered in line with the recipe.

In this co-operative memory game, the position of the potion ingredients you are looking for changes during the game. Anyone who still manages to find all the ingredients for a potion recipe can unlock valuable bonus effects, but you win together only when all the potions have been brewed!

name: Sinauli: Unearthed
description:
Delve into the soil of ancient India in Sinauli Unearthed, where players become rival archaeologists unearthing the secrets of a Harappan site.

Each turn, you send meeples to excavate deeper levels of the Sinauli Soil Board, unearthing relics like vases, weapons, burial boxes, and the legendary chariots. But digging is just the start: relics can be traded for coins, used to fulfill museum contracts, or published as groundbreaking research. As you manage influence, coins, and your crew, you’ll sway political favor to determine the final award criteria for India’s prestigious Bharat Ratna.

The player with the highest point total, wins.

With variable player order, rare finds, and high replayability, Sinauli Unearthed blends real archaeology with clever Euro mechanics for an engaging print-and-play dig into history.

name: Singularity Hex
description:
Singularity Hex is a sci-fi horror survival game where 4 players work together to escape an ever-changing ship.

The goal of the game is to collect 9 artefacts by defeating monsters avoiding obstacles and using your character's special abilities all while working together because you are connected and if one of you dies everybody dies.

—description from the designer

name: Singularity Sky
description:
Singularity Sky is a sci-fi adventure game of exploration, trading and combat set in the universe of the same name, as depicted in the novels by Charles Stross, Singularity Sky and Iron Sunrise.

Players take on the roles of undercover spies and travel the Galaxy as merchants, trading goods to earn money, completing missions for the big factions, battling enemies or other players and exploring the uncharted corners of the Universe. Being successful in your ventures is rewarded with money, reputation and victory points.

The game is played over rounds, until one player wins, with each round being divided into 5 phases - Navigation, Movement, Action, Business and Recovery. During the Navigation phase, players secretly and simultaneously choose their actions for the rest of the round, then they resolve them, either one by one or simultaneously.

Singularity Sky is a victory points sandbox, where the first player meeting the victory conditions is the winner. The victory conditions vary depending on the chosen scenario. With multiple ways to win and a galaxy that changes every time you play. Singularity Sky offers a high level of replayability that will have you coming back for more.

—description from the publisher

name: Time to Panic
description:
History has been shattered! Your team of multiversal agents must work together to reconstruct the timeline before it’s too late.

 Time to Panic is a co-operative card game for 1-4 players where you arrange cards in order from numbers 1 to 36.

On each turn, place a number card back into the timeline and activate its ability. Then, reveal the top card from the panic deck, sowing extra chaos in the game.

The fewer mistakes you make, the better your final score. With limited communication and three levels of difficulty, can you overcome the odds to score a perfect game?

name: Sir Ocelot's Cave
description:
Sir Ocelot and Professor Penguin are exploring a newly discovered cave system and competing for precious gemstones found inside. To locate and collect gemstones, players use tools — compasses, lamps, and pickaxes — and their trusty companion's good instincts. Gemstones, geodes, celestites — the deeper the rivals go into the cave, the more valuable the treasures to be found!

To set up Sir Ocelot's Cave, place the amethyst tokens for each of the three cave levels into their appropriate bag, then randomly place the level 1, 2, and 3 cave tokens on the empty spaces in the appropriate levels. Each player starts with a companion and a set of fifteen double-sided tool tokens that have different tools on opposite sides.

Each turn, place one of your tokens — either tool or companion — on the game board. After placing a tool or your companion, check to see whether any cave token is "seen" on three different sides by all three tool types. If so, you claim that token by removing it from the board. If you collect a geode or a complete set of celestites, you draw a random amethyst tile from the bag matching the appropriate level. Each amethyst has a fixed value or scores based on the cave tokens you collect or the cave tokens left behind.

Once both players have taken sixteen turns and placed all of their tokens, the game ends, and whoever has the more valuable collection of gemstones wins.

name: Sirens: The Deep Sea
description:
A full coop adventure and exploration board game for 1-4 players in the beautiful and dark deep sea. Explore and collect resources, construct buildings, build supply chains, develop your Sirens and fight against different cultures, monsters and bosses. Choose between scenarios and freemode. There are different options and random events that will change the course of your game each time you play. SIRENS has a variety of mechanics, but you don't need them for every scenario.

You can also explore sunken ships, lost caves or go on "scale hunt" for the giant Na'Waakaai (old'being) to receive artifacts and legendary equipment. Hide from strong streams, whirlpools and earthquakes or use them to your advantage.

Develop your sirens and build your own asymmetric ability tree with active and passive abilities by using life stream. Use magical spirit points to unlock powerful special abilities like the Sirens singing (a strong group ability) or unlock different bonus dice in your battle against different cultures

name: Honor's End
description:
Honor's End is a 1–4 player cooperative deckbuilding adventure set in a medieval world overshadowed by a mysterious truth. You can play it as a standalone session or as part of an episodic campaign that gradually unlocks new content and challenges.

Players must band together to overcome escalating threats. By wielding hero, action, and equipment cards, they’ll strike at their foes while fending off dishonor—brought on by danger dice rolled each round by their enemies.

Each knight chooses a path of Valor, Fortitude, or Wisdom, building a deck that shapes their abilities and tactics. Enemies, forged from the traits of Wrath, Deceit, and Despair, create unpredictable and unique battles every time you play.

Victory demands more than raw power. Success lies in balancing honor, clever deckbuilding, and shrewd use of the Temple and Monarch reward tracks. Defeat all three enemy champions to claim victory—or watch your honor slip away.

—description from the publisher

name: Realm of Reckoning
description:
The realm was once a magnificent afterlife, ruled by the Queen of All Souls and held together by the Five Pillars — relics embodying the land’s guiding forces. But civil war shattered the Queen, scattered the relics, and plunged the realm into ruin, leaving five warring factions vying for dominance.

In Realm of Reckoning, players compete in the great reckonings. Each turn, you’ll draft action cards, gaining unique abilities and collecting sets of artifacts. These cards can also trigger reckonings, forcing players to spend resources in a high-stakes struggle for power. The victors claim the power to shape the game’s victory conditions.

As players build monuments, reclaim relics, and maneuver for control, they determine how power is measured, and in turn, the fate of the afterlife.

In Realm of Reckoning, you lead 1 of 5 factions competing for influence in an afterlife of shifting powers and alliances. The game unfolds across 3 ages, with players strategically maneuvering to shape the scoring rules and accumulate victory points. The game ends after 3 ages. The player with the most victory points at the end of the third age wins the game

—description from the designer

name: Soar
description:
Soar is a bidding game for 2-5 players set in the Fractured Sky universe. Players will commit bidding tokens to quests, balancing risk and reward, timing and deception.

Each turn, place two bids: one for yourself and one that empowers the mysterious Skyborne. Win quests with your bids to gain victory points and powerful special tokens, but beware: the player in last place doesn’t lose… necessarily. Instead, they claim the Skyborne’s final score.

It’s a quick, tense battle with simple rules and heart-racing reveals. Will you fight desperately for the lead or quietly align yourself with the Skyborne for the unexpected climactic reversal?

—description from the publisher

name: Skifildol Italian Brainrot Trading Card Game
description:
A card game based on the Italian Brainrot memes that were all the rage in 2025. Rules, binders, and card packs were sold in Italian newsstands. Each card shows an illustration from the meme gallery. Cards are divided into Characters and Help cards. Character cards have a value in Follia ("Insanity") and possibly bonuses in attack and/or defense. Help cards describe various effects.

The players create decks with 17 Character cards and 3 Help cards. Players alternate being the attacker and the defender. Players draw a card at the time; if it is a Character, they'll use it in the upcoming duel; if it is a Help card, they keep it and continue drawing until they get a Character.

The attacker and the defender play the Character they have in hand. Next, first the attacker and then the defender can activate effects and/or use Help cards. Whoever has the highest Follia score at the end wins the round and places their Character at the bottom of their deck, while the loser discards their Character out of the game.

The player who eliminates all of the opponent's Characters wins the game.

name: Black Clover: Star Festival
description:
In the magical world of Black Clover: Star Festival, players join the annual Star Festival, a high-stakes competition where the Magic Knight squads compete to prove their valor and skill. Each player steps into the role of a squad leader, commanding their team through challenges across bustling cities, serene forests, and ancient ruins. From quests to gathering favors and recruiting knights, every decision shapes your squad's journey in a quest for stars—the ultimate symbol of victory. As rivalries grow and strategies are tested, only the most strategic squad will rise as champions of the festival.

A customizable worker placement game, Black Clover: Star Festival has you placing customizable squads in different locations for both location and worker actions. Gain the most stars to become the ultimate champion of the festival.

—description from the publisher

name: Skirmish: Battle for Draconia
description:
Six factions. One legendary resource. Endless reasons to go to war.

The realm of Draconia stands on the edge of transformation. Beneath its rivers, forests, deserts, and frozen peaks lies Draconium — a rare, mythical resource that, when forged into weapons or armor, grants unmatched power and strength. Kingdoms rise or fall by its presence, and now the last known veins of Draconium have been revealed.

War is inevitable.

Skirmish: Battle for Draconia is a fast-paced tactical card battle game where players command one of six distinct factions, each defined by culture, battlefield philosophy, and ruthless ambition. Every clash is a brutal test of timing, sacrifice, and strategy as rival forces collide to claim Draconium and shape the future of the realm.

In Skirmish: Battle for Draconia, 2–4 players take command of rival factions from the war-torn realm of Draconia, each with a unique battle deck representing their faction’s strengths and strategies. Every round, players simultaneously choose three cards to play, revealing them together to determine the order of attacks and how clashes unfold on the battlefield.

On your turn you must balance speed, strength, and tactics: use fast cards to strike first, powerful attacks to deal heavy damage, or cautious maneuvers to out think your opponent. Each card’s value and ability, from ambush and supply to command and poison, influences how damage is calculated and how your forces perform.

Combat continues round after round as you and your rivals trade blows, target specific cards in play, and leverage faction skills to gain the upper hand. The goal is simple: reduce your opponent’s health to zero before they destroy yours.

With its fast pace, simultaneous action selection, and deck-based tactical depth, Skirmish delivers the feel of a battlefield duel where every card choice matters and victory is earned through clever planning and smart sequencing of attacks.

—description from the publisher

name: skitter
description:
skitter is a magnetic dexterity boardgame. You flick with metallic rings ("skitts") on three colored, magnetic fields on the other side of the board. The goal is to get points by different kind of rules.

The game is versatile, easy rules for kids and very different rules for adults from beginner to pro. You can add playing-cards for strategic or luck variations and play different kind of gameplays.

name: Skiwi
description:
Skiwi!

This Kiwi loves skiing, but the weather on the mountain changes quickly. Help the Kiwi navigate the tracks while braving the sun, rain, snow, and lightning. Keep an eye on the weather and work together to help the Kiwi conquer the ski track.

Each player starts with an open card and takes turns. On your turn, connect your card to the other cards on the table to extend the track. After placing your card in front of you in the way you choose, draw a weather card. It rotates your track card, forcing you to connect it in a new way. Watch the weather carefully: there are only two cards of each type, so remember which ones have already appeared.

The game ends when the weather deck runs out for the second time. Add up your final points to see what kind of skier you are. Work together to build the best route and make the Kiwi the ultimate skier!

1-7 Players, 8 Years older, 15-20 minutes
Rulebooks available in English, Dutch and German
Can be played by people of other languages without issues
Cooperative game.

—description from the publisher

name: Skulls of Sedlec: Essential Collection
description:
Sedlec Ossuary, 16th Century AD.

The Black Plague and Hussite Wars have overcrowded the graveyard. Help the Bone Collector, a half-blind monk, by exhuming graves and arranging the skulls inside the crypt.

You are novice monks, competing to create the best arrangement of skulls.

Dig up graves from the graveyard to reveal cards, take cards into your hand to collect skulls, and arrange the cards from your hand into a stack. Whoever better honors the deceased’s last wishes will score more points.

The Bone Collector will then judge each player’s completed stack and declare one as the most exceptional.

—description from the publisher

name: Sky Totems
description:
Sky Totems (スカイトーテム) is a 3-dimensional strategy game, where players compete to build the best altar by completing the requirements of altar cards while acquiring the blessings of one or more powerful totems.

Each round, wooden pedestal cubes are drawn from a bag to form several stacks on the central board, and players take a stack of cubes to use for their own altars. Once taken, pedestal cubes can be placed on the cloud tiles that make up an altar's foundation, stacked atop a matching cube, or exchanged for more cloud tiles to build upon later on.

As players build their altar, they will aim to complete the missions given by various altar cards while also attracting totems that cap off sections of the altar, each with its own requirements for attraction, scoring bonus, and helpful ability to further enhance their altars.

name: Heart of Crown: 2nd Edition
description:
Heart of Crown: 2nd Edition brings modern updates both in graphic design and gameplay to the deck-building game. Many cards have updated texts, some cards have been removed, and new cards (Attendant Maids) have been added.

Seven Princess in line for succession, but with only one coronation, who will be the one to save the Empire from chaos?

In a deck-building game, every player starts with the same deck of cards, but your individual strategy will determine the cards you purchase to strengthen your deck. Be the first to crown your princess in the Coronation Ceremony.

Everything you need to play Heart of Crown comes in this stand-alone box, but the game is compatible with all previous Heart of Crown releases!

name: Lupin the 3rd: The Italian Adventure
description:
Embark on an adrenaline-fueled adventure through Italy's scenic landscapes in Lupin III: The Italian Adventure! You and four other daring thieves have just stolen a priceless gem from Italy’s most powerful criminal cartel. Now, you’re on the run with Inspector Zenigata of the ICPO hot on your trail! Outsmart rivals, face high-stakes decisions, and use clever strategies, high-tech gadgets, and a touch of luck to make your getaway.

This game is perfect for fans of thrill-packed strategy and anyone who loves the Lupin III universe. With iconic characters, unique abilities, and dynamic gameplay, it combines the thrill of a heist with the challenge of evading capture in an immersive, replayable experience. And to complete the adventure, all games come with officially licensed sleeves and playmats, enhancing your gameplay with high-quality accessories.

Each session feels like a new escape as you roll dice to strategize, confront unique Opposition cards, and unlock powerful upgrades with character-specific packs, acrylic standees, and collectible cards. The high-quality components, stunning artwork, and immersive playmats capture the pulse-pounding world of Lupin III, making every move feel like part of the story.

name: Skytear Horde: Campaigns
description:
Stand-alone expansion of Skytear Horde.

Play 1-off games or try the new mini-campaigns of 4 connected games for a "rogue-like" experience.

name: ZU Tiles: Fruits Basket – Starter Set 1
description:
ZU Tiles: Fruits Basket turns the popular zodiac cursed family into a strategic tile placement game. Comprise your team with various members of the Soma family who have been possessed by the Japanese Zodiac animals and take family rivalry to a whole new level!

Players can capture tiles thought compatibility matches or battles. The first to collect 12 zodiac animals to join their banquet wins the game. To achieve this, players will place their tiles down in combination with actions and battles.

This ZU Tiles: Fruits Basket 1st Edition comes with a ton of components and limited run Kickstarter items! The tiles and other components feature the fantastic artwork of the Fruits Basket animated series!

Each Set has everything you need to start playing right out of the box. There are 2 decks in a Starter Set for a total of 6 Soma family members per Set. Players strategize to obtain points through battle or by mending family relationships and matching everyone's compatibility with one another. Earning enough points will break the curse of the Japanese Zodiac and allow members to finally become free.

Keep adding to the collection with Zu Tile Slabs, which are found in ZU Tiles: Fruits Basket – Booster Pack! Each starter set comes with one booster pack.

Starter Set 1 consists of the Rabbit, Boar, Ram, Dog, Horse, and Tiger tiles.

Starter Set 2 consists of the Dragon, Snake, Rooster, Rat, Ox, and Monkey tiles.

name: Hunter X Hunter: The 287th Exams
description:
Prepare to test your resolve, resourcefulness, and resilience just like Gon and friends! Welcome to Hunter x Hunter: The 287th Exams, a dice-rolling adventure that challenges you to experience the high-stakes journey of earning a Hunter License.

In Hunter x Hunter: The 287th Exams, players take calculated risks, face setbacks, and develop their characters’ skills as they roll dice to overcome the gauntlet of trials that define the Hunter Exams. Players work together to get through the exams, using their skills and rolls to help each other out. If your teammates fall, the trial is over in this tough-as-nails adventure.

—description from the publisher

name: Street Fighter V: Champion Edition Legends
publisher: Blacklist Games; Kess Co.; Kolossal Games
description:
Street Fighter V: Champion Edition - Legends is a cooperative game of brawling action.

In each game, you will take on the role of your favorite Street Fighter characters and work together to defeat your rivals and overcome your nemesis. Build your combos, upgrade your abilities, and create your legend.

The Four Kings are up to no good and it falls upon the World Warriors to stop them. Choosing a fan-favorite fighter, such as Ryu or Chun-Li, players will perform powerful attacks and build epic combos on their way to defeating the king at the end of each stage. Combining modular style decks and familiar special moves unique to each fighter, there is no shortage of options for toppling the kings, one by one.

Featuring a huge roster of characters and stages from Street Fighter V: Champion Edition in an all-new cooperative setting, players will be able to experience Street Fighter like never before.

—description from the publisher

name: Slice: A Pizza Game
description:
Slice - A Pizza Game is a high-energy card game where players race to grab matching pizza slices and complete their orders before anyone else. Whether you’re blocking opponents with Hot Sauce cards or using Combo cards to get ahead.

In Slice, players try to complete randomly drawn pizza cards form ingredients in the Draw pile.  Once a new ingredient card is drawn, players race to be the first to cover the card with their hand.  If they are first, they claim that ingredient card. But be careful - claim an ingredient you don't need and you lose ALL your ingredients.  Block opponents with Hot Sauce cards or using Combo cards to get ahead.

The player who completes three pizza cards first, wins!

—description from the designer

name: Slime Artist
publisher: 桌遊鬍子 POKI Design; Taiwan Boardgame Design
description:
In Slime Artist, players use the clay and their imagination to create the best work of art!
Can you comprehend the insightful meaning of other players’ pieces of art? Is your masterpiece understandable to others?
Craft your best artwork and show them what it takes to be the No. 1 Slime Artist!

Every round, each player draws a number card to determine which topic (one of the six in the topic card) they are going to "create" with their clay. After all players finish creating within the time limit, they secretly guess other players' topics. For each correct guess you make, you score 1 VP. If at least one player guesses your topic correctly, you score 2 VP. After 5 rounds, the player with the most VP wins!

name: Sly Mole
publisher: CREARDO; Lemada Light Industries; Lifestyle Boardgames Ltd; Piatnik; Red Cat Games; Reflexshop; Verlag Arbeitsmittel für Lehrer und Schüler
description:
A whole family of moles has made the farm their home! The new neighbors prefer to live underground, so their eyesight is far from perfect. During their excursions topside they sometimes visit the garden patch and unwittingly snatch a vegetable... or two.

Finding the mole responsible is not an easy task! But luckily the hardworking bumblebee is always somewhere nearby collecting pollen. If anyone can help, it’s him! However, even though he can tell you some of the details, it’s up to you to solve the case!

—description from the publisher

name: Small-Time Heroes: Base Box
description:
The once-peaceful community we call home has fallen under the shadow of an evil force, and the courageous protectors who defended our town have set off on their own pursuits of fame and fortune. In their place, a band of unlikely heroes have emerged - the Small-Time Heroes. These are not your typical heroes, with bulging biceps and chiseled jawlines. No, these heroes are more like the underdogs, with quirky personalities and oddball skills.

In this cooperative deck builder, you’ll take on the role of one of the Small-Time Heroes and work together to defend the town. With each battle, you’ll build up your deck of cards, choosing from a variety of cards that represent your hero’s unique abilities. As your power builds, you will defeat waves of minions and end with a final boss battle. Defeat the boss before they defeat you!

Play a one off session by battling through three waves of minions and a final boss or turn it into a campaign and battle through all 3 bosses.

name: Small-Time Heroes: The Rogue
description:
The once-peaceful community we call home has fallen under the shadow of an evil force, and the courageous protectors who defended our town have set off on their own pursuits of fame and fortune. In their place, a band of unlikely heroes have emerged - the Small-Time Heroes. These are not your typical heroes, with bulging biceps and chiseled jawlines. No, these heroes are more like the underdogs, with quirky personalities and oddball skills.

In this cooperative deck builder, you’ll take on the role of one of the Small-Time Heroes and work together to defend the town. With each battle, you’ll build up your deck of cards, choosing from a variety of cards that represent your hero’s unique abilities. As your power builds, you will defeat waves of minions and end with a final boss battle. Defeat the boss before they defeat you!

Play a one off session by battling through three waves of minions and a final boss or turn it into a campaign and battle through all 3 bosses.

name: Small-Time Heroes: The Warrior
description:
The once-peaceful community we call home has fallen under the shadow of an evil force, and the courageous protectors who defended our town have set off on their own pursuits of fame and fortune. In their place, a band of unlikely heroes have emerged - the Small-Time Heroes. These are not your typical heroes, with bulging biceps and chiseled jawlines. No, these heroes are more like the underdogs, with quirky personalities and oddball skills.

In this cooperative deck builder, you’ll take on the role of one of the Small-Time Heroes and work together to defend the town. With each battle, you’ll build up your deck of cards, choosing from a variety of cards that represent your hero’s unique abilities. As your power builds, you will defeat waves of minions and end with a final boss battle. Defeat the boss before they defeat you!

Play a one off session by battling through three waves of minions and a final boss or turn it into a campaign and battle through all 3 bosses.

name: Tamagotchi Collections
description:
A UFO full of Tamagotchi characters unexpectedly crash-landed on Earth, and now it’s up to you to help raise them! In Tamagotchi Collections, 2-4 players roll dice to feed, play, and care for these quirky new friends. Tamagotchi need a lot of care so make sure to keep up with the attention each one needs. Host too many at the same time and you might have a big mess on your hands!
 In the world of Tamagotchi Collections, happiness is the name of the game! Can you host as many happy Tamagotchi characters as you can to score the most points?

—description from the publisher

name: Snack Time
description:
Snack Time is a Roll and Write game for an unlimited number of players. Each round a player will roll 5 dice which will include appendages to add to your creatures as well as sewer pipes to guide them to the surface.

Players are scored based on their ability to take a small bite out of people passing by and the quality of the people you snack on. If you aren't careful then the pedestrians will fight back and your creatures will be injured in their quest for food.

At the beginning of the round the pedestrians will move down the street visiting different locations. Someone will roll the dice and all players will add traits to their creatures and add pipes to their sewer. Then everyone will check to see if one of their creatures can take a bite out of a pedestrian! This depends on being in the right location and having the right traits to overwhelm your prey!

The Game ends when one player has completely fed all of their monsters or when a player gets caught by the authorities! Scores are based on the quality of food... I mean, people you ate, as well as how much damage your creatures sustained.

Keep your monsters healthy and happy and don't alert the authorities or you will incur heavy penalties because snitches get stitches.

name: The Cast List
description:
What’s your favorite movie? How about your best friend’s favorite? Your brother? Your sister? Just how well do you know what THEY know?  
 Welcome to ‘The Cast List’: The movie deduction game where your memory of which actor was cast in which movie becomes more important than ever. 
 Designed by a former world champion of movie trivia, ‘The Cast List’ puts the tools in your hand to try and stump your opponents with well placed strategy and movie knowledge. 
 When it’s your turn, your opponent will pick a card at random with 5 movies on it. There is 1 common actor between those 5 films. They’ll then pick 2 movies listed on the card and read their titles to you. It’s then up to you and your team to determine which common actor appeared in both films. If you don’t guess correctly in the 30 seconds given, don’t worry. There are 3 more movies on the card to help you solve the ‘cast list’ puzzle. However, be careful how many clues you ask for. Each additional movie you hear before answering correctly reduces your score by 1 point. 
 The player or team asking the questions gets to pick the order of the movies they want to ask, testing their knowledge of what the other player or team knows.

—description from the publisher

name: Sneaky Supper
description:
It’s 2am, everyone’s asleep, but your tummy’s rumbling... A quick trip to the kitchen in the dark, what could go wrong?

IT’S SUPPER TIME!

Sneaky Supper is the ultimate push-your-luck game where stealth is key! Tiptoe through the kitchen, grab snacks, and collect ingredients to whip up a mouthwatering meal. Maybe you’ll munch on some potato chips for quick points.

The game ends when someone hits 20 points, but only the sneakiest player with the most points will claim victory.

But watch out! Drop your utensils or accidentally step on the family cat, and it’s game over... with your midnight feast confiscated, and the whole house awake (and angry)!

Can you create your dream supper without waking everyone up? Or will you stumble and fumble your way to bedtime empty-handed?

Let the sneaking (and snacking) begin!

—description from the publisher

name: Snorkeling
description:
There’s nothing like SNORKELING to discover the wonders of the ocean. Stay underwater as long as possible to swim among Coral, Turtles, Lanternfish… But the other divers only want one thing: to enjoy the beauty all for themselves and force you back to the surface!

Snorkeling is a card-shedding game where players play cards onto others to score the most points.

On your turn, you may play a card that is exactly one value higher than the top card on the center pile. Alternatively, you can play one or more cards that match the color of the top card on the center pile, regardless of their value.

After playing cards to the center pile, you may then play exactly one card onto any other player’s personal pile if your card’s value is exactly one less than the top card on their pile. The color does not matter for this step.

The round ends immediately when any player receives a value 0 card on their personal pile. At that point, each player scores points equal to the value of the top card in their pile, which are added to their previous total. The first player to reach or exceed 12 points wins the game. If there is a tie, another round is played.

—description from the publisher

name: Snow Colony
description:
Build your own snowy paradise as a Penguin City Planner!

Compete against other players to develop the most attractive Snow Colony — and earn the most Victory Points by the end of the game!

Roll, move, and grow your town every turn.
Roll dice and choose which ones to use for movement. Each time you land on a building, you’ll collect resources or Victory Points — and you can invest in expansions to make future visits even more rewarding.

Attract demanding visitors from distant lands.
Travelers will stop by with unique requests for building combinations or amenities. Fulfill their needs and earn bonus Victory Points for your penguin-level hospitality!

—description from the publisher

name: Snowp
description:
Snowp is a fast-paced dexterity and set-collection game where players flick metal rings across a snowy board to capture colorful bells.

On your turn, place your ring on your starting arc, aim, and flick! Any bells that land inside your ring are yours to keep. Collect multiples of the same color for higher scores, but beware — the color left on the board at the end of the round is worth nothing. Clever timing and accurate shots are key to snatching high-value sets and triggering the Color Clear Bonus by removing the last bell of a color.

Play lasts over three rounds, with players carrying over a limited number of bells between rounds. At the end, the player (or team) with the highest total score wins.

With its mix of precision flicking, tactical collection, and unpredictable rebounds, Snowp delivers a refreshing, winter-themed competition that keeps kids and adults alike hooked until the very last shot.

—description from the publisher

name: So, You've Been Cursed.
description:
NOTE: This is a game for 0 - 2 players. The BGG database does not allow a player count of 0. Zero-player games are also known as autonomous simulation.

So, you've been cursed.

It happens in the wizarding business. Occupational hazard. It is also the only logical explanation. At first, it seemed like that feast last night must have caused the headache and the heartburn...but as you were about to brew the third digestive potion of the morning, it dawned on you.

You can't remember how you got home, and what you actually had for dinner. Then, you noticed the sheep bones in the kitchen, the sheep bones on the dinner table, the sheep bones in the washroom, the unidentified bones in the bedroom, the blood stains in...just about everywhere in the house.

It did not help that the town crier passed by your house, announcing the missing sheep from Scott's farm, the gouged-out stonework at the town hall, the missing merchant from across town.

So, there is a monster running around town at night, terrorizing the villagers and what's worse, eating them. Luckily for them, it seems to be a nice, local monster rather than one from out of town, so no worries there, they are safe from outsiders. Unluckily for you, it seems that the monster is, well, you.

But no need to despair! There is a cure! Maybe! You just need a whole lot of ingredients to brew and mix the potions listed in your spell book, and you need to get them by any means necessary before it is too late and your nocturnal form persists in its ravenous pursuit for long enough to permanently transform.

And who knows what the monster inside of you is thinking?

Or, rather, who knows what the monster is eating?

So, You've Been Cursed. is a game for 0 to 2 players: two players can play against one another, one player can compete against a bot in either of the asymmetric roles, or a human can have the two bots play one another, which could be ideal for learning the game's mechanisms.

name: Sock Pile
description:
Sock Pile is a simultaneous-play, sock-scoring card game of chaotic laundry collection. Each player controls a team of quirky Sock Monsters, battling over piles of mismatched socks across shifting locations. With identical decks, players secretly assign monsters to three locations each round — hoping to outwit opponents with clever abilities, timing, and a dynamic Laundry Line tiebreaker.

Each game plays over four fast-paced rounds, with every turn unfolding in three phases: Planning, Rush, and Cleanup. Location effects, sock card values, and objective bonuses constantly mix up the tactics. Players collect, pair, and score sock cards based on matching types and values, with extra points for fulfilling hidden objectives. The rotating Laundry Line — a unique sock-type priority track — breaks ties and keeps strategies fresh.

After 4 rounds, score your socks by making pairs and multiplying their values together, then claim objectives. Whoever has the best sock pile wins!

With fast setup, and simultaneous turns, Sock Pile offers quick, satisfying decisions in a small, handcrafted package—perfect as a thematic filler with surprising depth.

—description from the designer

name: Soda Jerk
description:
Soda Jerk is set amidst the bustling vibrant American soda fountain era of the 1950s. Each player embodies the spirit of a soda-slinging hero, poised to mix, shake, and serve their way to glory. Armed with personalized decks of cards, Soda Jerks scramble to match symbols and gather the precise ingredients needed to craft the perfect drink, all while racing against their opponents to serve waiting customers promptly.

As the clock ticks down and closing time looms after two rounds, victory awaits the player who has amassed the most coin — a taste sweeter than the finest pop in town!

—description from the publisher

name: ONE PIECE: Dawn of Liberation
description:
ONE PIECE: Dawn of Liberation is a new cooperative board game based on the globally popular anime and manga franchise. Developed in partnership with Toei Animation, the game adapts the Land of Wano arc into a large-scale, narrative-driven adventure for one to four players.

The project brings the world of ONE PIECE to an expansive tabletop format, combining character-driven crew building, mission-based progression, and resource management. Players form teams using characters from the Land of Wano storyline and work together to complete objectives, gather materials, and recruit allies on their journey toward confronting Kaido. Designed for multi-hour sessions, the game also incorporates a built-in pause-and-resume system that allows groups to break up the experience without losing progress.

—description from the publisher

name: Solacia 2: The Ice Demon – A Solitaire Fantasy Game
description:
Solacia was at peace until the Ice Demon arrived. He spread evil across the land, conjuring up all kinds of horrors and freezing the land permanently so that nothing would grow. The Queen has called for a group of Heroes to find and kill the Ice Demon, and to return the land of Solacia back to its beautiful former glory.

Solacia 2: The Ice Demon places you in control of that party of Heroes, consisting of Warf, a tough fighter; Erica, a skilled spear thrower; a mysterious Mystic; and Tooth, a huge powerful beast. The game should be played as an Adventure (campaign) which strings together a series of five quests for your party to undertake. Quest selection is randomised to keep the game fresh and different on each Adventure attempt. In addition to random quest selection, the quests themselves play out very differently each time, adding to replayability.
Victory is achieved if you manage to reach and win Quest 5 and destroy the Ice Demon.

This game is a solitaire hex and counter fantasy game. You play the game by controlling what your Heroes do, and the game will provide Enemies and other challenges for your Heroes to face. You will need two, or preferably three, standard six-sided dice to play.

—description from the publisher

name: Solar Eclipse
description:
Solar Eclipse is a trick-taking game of cunning combinations as players play two cards to every trick. There are two suits in this game, sun and moon cards. Sun cards are always played face up, but moon cards can be used to deceive and be played face down. The ultimate combination is a pair of sun and moon cards which share a value.

In order to achieve victory, players must skillfully deceive their opponents and predict how many tricks they'll win each round.

—description from the publisher

name: Campy Creatures: Volume 1 (Third Edition)
description:
The ghastly game of bluffing, deduction, and set collection is back with all-new frights.

A mad scientist’s work is never done! You need a constant supply of mortals to fuel your weird experiments and a fiendish horde of campy creatures. But be warned - some mortals won’t go down without a fight. And be warned again - you’re not the only mad scientist in town (and your rivals command creatures of their own and are after the same mortals you are).

This all-new updated edition of the classic game of bluffing, deduction, and set collection features creepy new monsters (with sneaky new powers), updated townsfolk (with surprising new abilities), and otherworldly new scene locations that score like never before.

The creatures are coming back to town – and they’re dying to play with you.

—description from the publisher

name: Solatro
description: Most people love Balatro, and EVERYONE loves Solitaire (obviously), so here’s a cheeky way to play a SOLO version of that addictive indie computer card game with just a regular deck of cards, Solitaire style, all by yourself on a Friday night!

name: Soldier's Chess
description:
Soldier’s Chess is a military strategy game.

Soldier's Chess places you in charge of an infantry platoon, just as it makes contact with the enemy. Every decision you make will be crucial to the outcome of the battle.


    In solitaire mode, you can achieve victory according to your mission objectives (the parameters of the scenario).
    In duel mode, the first player to reach 20 victory points wins (1 point per enemy wounded and more points per enemy KIA depending on the type of unit).


With seven different unit types (each with unique traits and abilities) and no dice, you can play each game according to your strategy - but be careful, you must contend with the will of your enemy. The 7 unit types, each with distinct movements, attack ranges, and special abilities, include: Private, Machine Gun, Sergeant, Medic, Mortar, Sergeant First Class, and Lieutenant. Soldier's Chess is played on a 16x16 square board, four times the size of the board in traditional chess. The game is also played with 6 terrain tiles, which hinder or benefit nearby units.

Some key game mechanics of Soldier's Chess include: Players may order three units to act per turn. Movement and offense are separate actions, and units can also perform special actions. Pieces interact: Sergeants can lead formations, Medics can heal wounded units, Lieutenants can inspire other units, and Sergeants First Class can lead grand formations.

—description from the designer

name: Solo Leveling: Board Game
description:
Solo Leveling: Board Game is a cooperative tactical board game for 1 to 4 players based on the popular webtoon and novel 'Solo Leveling.' Players take on the roles of Hunters from the series, tasked with clearing dungeons inhabited by various bosses. Following in the footsteps of the protagonist Sung Jinwoo, players confront bosses he has previously defeated, who now stand in their way once more.

The game starts with the instant dungeon's Blue Poison Fang Kasaka and progresses through selected dungeons and bosses, culminating in defeating the Architect. Each dungeon features unique mechanics, requiring players to strategize differently each time. Additionally, there are 9 Hunters, including Sung Jinwoo, each with distinct personalities and abilities, ensuring a fresh experience with each playthrough.

Solo Leveling: Board Game includes two game modes: Cooperative Mode and Solo Leveling Mode. In the cooperative mode for 2-4 players, each player selects a Hunter from the original series to form a team and navigate dungeons sequentially. While non-Sung Jinwoo Hunters cannot level up, they can enhance their equipment to prepare for greater threats ahead. The Solo Leveling Mode allows players to experience the game alone, taking on the role of Sung Jinwoo to clear dungeons as in the original story, utilizing the abilities of the Shadow Monarch.

name: Solomons Campaign 1942-43
description:
W101 Solomons Campaign is a solitaire game covering the campaign in the Solomons in 1942-43, during and after Guadalcanal.

The player controls US forces, while the game system controls the Japanese via random actions. Ground units on both sides are regiments and battalions, air units are wings or squadrons, and naval units are individual ships in the case of fleet carriers and battleships, and divisions or squadrons for all other types.

World at War Magazine #101, March 2025

name: Soul Dice
description:
Soul Dice sparks a competition for the souls of humanity! Will you, as angels, lead people into the light? Or unleash their dark side as the devil? Use your dice and crystals with strategy and skill to draw the souls into your ranks. But be careful: no soul is like the other! Unique special abilities help you outsmart the other side.

—description from the publisher

In Soul Dice entfacht ein packender Wettstreit um die Seelen der Menschheit! Werdet ihr als Engel die Menschen ins Licht führen? Oder als Teufel ihre dunkle Seite entfesseln? Setzt eure Würfel und Kristalle mit Strategie und Geschick ein, um die Seelen in eure Reihen zu ziehen. Aber Vorsicht: Keine Seele ist wie die andere! Einzigartige Sonderfähigkeiten helfen euch dabei, die Gegenseite auszutricksen.

—description from the publisher (German)

name: Soul Raiders
description:
Tomorrow is the day: you will pledge yourself to the ancestral order of the Soul Raiders, in the heart of their mighty fortress. As a powerful warrior-mage, you will vow to watch over the world of Kivros and its inhabitants, explore the ruins of forgotten civilisations… And above all, send tortured souls back beyond the Veil, where they belong.

Are you ready, young apprentice, to forfeit any hope for glory, wealth, and the tranquillity of an ordinary life? Will you honor your pledge to this order, and take arms to face this world’s countless dangers?

Embark for a mysterious and breathtaking journey, full of thrilling adventures and stunning revelations... Join the Soul Raiders.





Soul Raiders is a story-driven cooperative game, created by best-selling author Marc André (Splendor) and a team of talented artists, such as Guillaume Tavernier (De Architectura) or Magali Villeneuve (Magic The Gathering). 

In this fast-paced narrative game, the players become powerful heroes. They will be able to roam freely in a variety of settings, cooperating to overcome the threat of an impending doom before it is too late!

				
				
					An epic narrative game
    Soul Raiders immerse the players in a high-fantasy setting; as powerful heroes, they will overcome the many threats to their order of warrior-mages and the universe as a whole.
    Designed like a book, the game is divided in chapters, or game sessions (1 to 2 hours per session). Each chapter depicts a specific setting in which players will complete quests, collect information and increase their power to progress through the overarching story. 
    Soul Raiders will spread on several chapters, woving an epic tale around the players and their characters from one book to the next. 


				
				
					A fast-paced and cinematic game system
    The game system features a fast-paced and streamlined gameplay', entirely geared towards the experience of a story-driven, cinematic and cooperative adventure.
    The players act simultaneously to explore their surroundings. Without turn order, they can progress together or split the party as they see fit to hop from one scene to the next.
    Each setting is composed of a set of tiles, places where the heroes can interact with their environment. Taking a variety of actions while battling the forces pitted against them, they jump from one tile to another as the story unfolds, sometimes spread out on different scenes, always focusing on the heart of the action.


				
				
					Building cooperative tension
    The heroes live and die as one. Their health points is a common pool, tracked on the side of the board: each time a player takes damage, the marker progresses. If it goes too far, the whole party fail at completing the chapter.
    Even if they manage to stay safe, time runs out fast... The Threat track is another timer that brings the heroes to their demise. It progresses as they encounter new creatures and events, leading to their capture if they stay idle for too long. 


				
				
					Narrative story with a strong replay value
    If they cooperate efficiently, any path can lead to the completion of the current chapter, as the players do not have to follow a specific set of events, but try to achieve independent and interwoven quests. 
    If the party fails, it can still move onto the next chapter, triggering a unique setback. Only the final chapter of the story needs to be completed successfully — or else they will go back to the beginning of the tome.  
    This non-linear approach to a narrative system, combined to the time pressure and the possibility to push the story further,  ensure a very good replay value to the gaming experience.


				
				
					Soul Raiders offers you:
    More than 1000 cards illustrated by a team of talented artists, such as Guillaume Tavernier (De Architectura) or Magali Villeneuve (Magic The Gathering),
    Innovative story-driven cooperative game,
    Streamlined and fast-paced system,
    Strong narrative elements with good replay value.


—description from the publisher

name: Soulshards: Grand Tourney
description:
Grand Tourney is a game that mixes worker-placement elements with card driven combat. It explores a piece of the Soulshards universe in which each player controls a character that has been invited to participate in a grand battle tournament.

During gameplay, players will make the most of their limited amount of turns by carefully placing characters and mercenaries. After the last day of preparation, the characters will fight until only one remains.

Grand Tourney combat features a card driven combat system, where players balance attacking, defending, and refreshing their hand. Each action has its own timing to consider, which further diversifies combat.

Soulshards is a fantasy setting focusing on the ups and downs throughout the history of the Keridwyn Empire. Grand Tourney takes place during one of the ‘ups’, a celebration of 100 years spent in relative peace following a brutal civil war. New characters will add their marks to the world just as previous characters have left theirs. Although each game and novel in the setting adds to the tapestry, no previous familiarity is required.

—description from the designer

name: South Mountain 1862
description:
South Mountain 1862 is Volume VI in Worthington's Civil War Brigade Battle Series. 
With streamlined mechanics the series rules, and battle specific rules, gamers can refight the Battle of South Mountain in 2 to 3 hours.

Brigade Level Detail:
Each infantry and cavalry piece is a brigade with each strength point 100 men, color boxes surrounding the strength show morale of green, veteran, or crack.  Each artillery piece strength point represents 2 cannon.

Mounted Game Map:
HARD MOUNTED 22 inch by 25.5 inches game board that is historically detailed at 250 yards per hex.

2 Counter Sheets:
Based on extensive research of the order of battle, the counters accurately reflect the armies of North and South.

This game will provide countless replays and hours of enjoyment to history buffs trying to see if they can recreate, or change history.

—description from the publisher

name: Sovereign: Bretwalda
description:
796 AD. Dark Ages Britain. Viking raiders are conquering swathes of land, paganism is being replaced by Christianity. And the four largest Anglo-Saxon kingdoms – Northumbria, Mercia, Wessex, and East Anglia – are in a constant game of diplomacy, alliance building, and conflict to claim the crown of Bretwalda, ruler of Britain.

Bretwalda is a fast-paced area control game with unique miniatures and beautiful, evocative components. You take charge of one of the four asymmetric kingdoms. To achieve victory, you will need to take control of key areas on the board, complete secret objectives and construct special buildings. To do that, you will collect taxes, develop your kingdom, use your diplomatic skills, mobilize armies, and lead them to glorious battles.

The game lasts a maximum of 12 seasons, each season limited to just two out of four available actions, meaning each decision is critical. Will you bide your time, developing your economy, expanding your knowledge, and building alliances, or will you immediately create a great army and rush forward to claim new lands and riches?

—description from the publisher

name: Sovereign: Fall of Wormwood
description:
Every tribe on Apsyntion has the same origin story - the same apocrypha retold for generations. That once, our people came from the stars. That their homeworld was lost, swallowed by Wormwood, and the ancestors built the arks in a last desperate gasp, releasing them to the sky like so many seeds in the wind. That the people of the ark, so roughly deposited on the soil of an alien Eden, fought for the right to rule this new world and remake it in their own image.

Sovereign is an expandable card game where each player controls a burgeoning far-future civilization at the brink of war. You will build an empire from the ground up, managing civilians and military units, along with facilities unique to your faction's way of life.

Each player controls one of ten factions, with a personal ideology represented by a prebuilt deck. A deck has 30 unique cards specific to that faction, and 20 cards called Echoes- remnants of the ark that brought humanity to this world.  Score ten Echoes and you win the game, but an Echo is always vulnerable in the meantime, whether it's in your hand or on the table. You'll defend your own Echoes with units and facilities you build, or steal them from opponents by attacking where you think the Echoes are hiding. Forge them yourself or steal them from other players- build or conquer, it's up to you.

The game is designed so that the backs of the cards are used as much as the front, since each card back is used to track construction progress from turn to turn, without revealing the card underneath. Citizens are represented by double-sided tokens used initially for building cards, but when flipped become lower class workers, who might power facilities, or become soldiers to fuel your dominance.

Sovereign is great as a 2 player game, but optimized for 3-4, with an array of cards that can be used to hinder or help opponents - encouraging fragile, temporary alliances. The game combines the best elements from worker placement games and CCGs, to create a dynamic hybrid experience where a society can rise and fall in under 2 hours, with over 300 unique cards.

name: Space Driller
description:
Interstellar Extraction Corporation just got a new mining permit for a sector that is rich in asteroids with a generous amount of metals and other rare minerals, but there is a problem. That sector is swarming with aliens that will tear every ship to shreds if they find it too close to their nests. If we want to get to the valuable materials we cannot wake them up.

You’re one of many driller operators in Interstellar Extraction Corporation. You are tasked with excavating as many minerals as possible without alerting the Swarm. Will you accomplish your task and come back rich or will you have to leave everything behind, running from the aliens.

In Space Driller, create patterns to drill through the asteroid, collect materials, explore the asteroid mines and avoid the alien eggs.

name: Space Freight
description:
Space Freight is an exhilarating board game where you step into the role of a space freighter captain, exploring the vast expanse of unknown space in search of fortune. As you navigate the cold black of the 'verse, you'll mine ore, salvage debris, trade and influence markets, complete missions, and confront the temptation of space piracy to amass your wealth in gold.

In this fast-paced game for 2-5 players, each captain takes two actions per turn, moving their ships between their base, space, planets, and trading ports. You'll mine, salvage, swap, and trade resources, all while managing the limitations of your crew. Expand your capabilities by recruiting new crew members, gain advantages with rare officers, and execute powerful turns with boosts. The game concludes when all the gold is in player storage, so you'll need to race to complete missions, trade for gold at the exchange, and leverage your crew and boosts to outmaneuver your opponents and engage in space piracy.

A typical game lasts about 15 minutes per player, ensuring a unique experience every time. Space Freight combines worker placement, deck building, pick-up and delivery, missions, and a dynamic trading exchange based on dice values to create a rich and engaging gameplay experience.

name: Space Gits
description:
SPACE GITS is a dexterity-based miniatures skirmish game about drunk-ass space orcs lootin', shootin' and scootin'.

You play as a gang of drunk-ass space orcs rioting through the megacity of Gnork. You are out for a thumpin' good time, and to loot whatever isn’t nailed down.

SPACE GITS features a host of unique and innovative dexterity mechanics, supports 2-5 players and plays out in under an hour. It welcomes and encourages kitbashing, and can be played as a drinking game. It includes rules for drunken orc-on-orc combat, a full-on campaign system, and vehicle rules. (Planet Smasher Games does not condone drink-driving, except in 28mm scale). It is extremely fun.

—description from the publisher

name: Parks (Second Edition)
publisher: Keymaster Games; Arclight Games; Feuerland Spiele; Games7Days; Lavka Games; MTS Games; Tranjis Games
description:
Welcome to Parks, where every trail leads to new marvels, every stream runs with new life, every sun sets over a new memory, and every mountain looms with new possibility as you explore the stunning beauty and wild wonders of the 63 U.S. National Parks.

This expanded, enhanced second edition of the best-selling game features all-new illustrations by artists Josh Emrich and Lisk Feng, offers new gameplay elements from designer Henry Audubon, and incorporates the most interesting ideas from each of the Parks games and expansions: the additional camping module from Parks: Nightfall, the animal integrations from Parks: Wildlife, and a comprehensive selection of players’ favorite gear, challenges, and mechanics from the five-year history of Parks (along with some new surprises).

Over the course of three rounds (called Seasons), your two hikers will make their way along the path, stopping at trail sites, collecting resources to visit parks, taking photos of beautiful vistas, and encountering wildlife. Along the way, you’ll get gear to upgrade your experience, spend a night at a campsite, fill your canteen for special bonuses, and indulge your unique passion for the outdoors.

At the end of the third Season, the hike (and the game) is over! Count up your points and see who had the greatest experience in Acadia, Grand Teton, Mount Rainier, Crater Lake, Everglades, Denali, Canyonlands, and all the rest of our national parks.

Grab your pack and lace up your boots. The trail awaits!

—description from the publisher

name: Space Lite: Starship Nightmares
description:
Space Lite: Starship Nightmares is a cooperative survival game for 1 to 5 players. You play as seasoned space patrol soldiers responding to a distress signal from a commercial ship carrying hundreds of civilians—and now swarming with terrifying alien creatures. Enemies appear from all directions, and tension rises quickly. To survive, you’ll need tight cooperation, smart use of resources, and bold tactical decisions.

Each mission presents a unique layout and objectives. Players control a squad of five soldiers, regardless of player count, exploring the ship by revealing new terrain, facing dynamic events, and pushing forward through waves of enemies. You’ll need to heal, reload, and share gear while constantly adapting to new threats and managing time.

Gameplay is divided into two phases. During the Event Phase, unexpected challenges emerge, such as locked doors, system failures, or infected attacks. Then, in the Player Phase, each soldier can move, fight, heal, or interact with the environment. Attacks are resolved with dice, and different weapons, grenades, and action cards can turn the tide—if used wisely.

But the greatest threat may be infection. Wounds and contact with the creatures can spread a parasite that mutates its host. If too many soldiers are infected, the mission may fail—no matter how many enemies you kill. Complete your objectives, stay alive, and hope you’re still human by the end.

—description from the publisher

name: Hanami
description:
Pack your bento box, grab your picnic blanket, and find the perfect spot under the treetops. The sakura blossoms are in full bloom and people from all over are gathered in the park for Hanami (or “flower viewing”) a centuries-old Japanese springtime tradition.

In Hanami, you’ll be picnicking in parks all across Japan and Tokyo city in the springtime, fighting the crowds to celebrate the floral spectacle. Players will place their tiles out to reserve spots near the various activities found there.

Each tile represents a picnic blanket set out by a member of your group to claim a spot in the park. Tiles indicate the strength of your group (the number of pips on the tile), and the favored activity of the group (viewing sakura, eating onigiri, or an evening under the lanterns). You’ll collect Activity Tokens once they’re surrounded by Player Tiles, if your tiles have a higher strength than any other player’s. Earn Victory Tokens at the end of the game for each activity by having the most of the corresponding Activity Token. Earn the most Victory Tokens to win Hanami!

Hanami is a new reimagining of the classic game Samurai, designed by Dr. Reiner Knizia. This updated game tells a new story: One of relaxing picnic lunches among the cherry blossoms and paper lanterns of Tokyo city parks or the lush countryside of Japan. It brings new strategies and two distinct ways to play: The Japan map allows players to enjoy the classic Samurai ruleset, and the Tokyo setup gives players new challenges, new abilities, and new tiles.

—description from the publisher

name: Spanish Ulcer
description:
Spanish Ulcer is a wargame that covers the seven year (1808-1814) campaign of the French Army against the Spanish, Portuguese & British Armies within the Iberian Peninsula.  It is a card-driven game with a point-to-point that features the important cities, towns, ports & fortresses of the campaign.

Both sides underestimated the difficulties and importance of this campaign - can you learn from their folly and do better?  Or will you suffer needlessly from The Spanish Ulcer?

name: Parks Europe
description:
Welcome back to Parks, where every trail leads to new marvels, every stream runs with new life, every sun sets over a new memory, and every mountain looms with new possibility as you explore the stunning beauty and wild wonders as you venture through the national parks of Europe.
Over the course of three rounds (called Seasons), Parks Europe will challenge your hiking skills in new ways, enticing you to hook into the Via Ferrata along the Trail, collecting resources and fatigue along the way - visiting Parks or stopping off at the Chalet to rest and take in the wonder. Explore new systems for taking Photos, expand your experience on the trail by supporting Conservation Projects, and enjoy in hike bonuses from a new set collecting element with Park Cards.
At the end of the third Season, the hike (and the game) is over! Count up your points and see who had the greatest experience visiting the natural beauty of Europe from the shores of the Wadden Sea to the Dolomiti cliffs.
Grab your pack and lace up your boots. The trail awaits!

—description from the publisher

name: Speed Bac: Kids
description:
Speed Bac Kids is the perfect fast-paced party game to get kids (and grown-ups) thinking and laughing!

Each player starts with 5 letter cards. A fun and easy theme is revealed — like “A funny animal,” “A color in the rainbow,” or “A silly job.” The 3 quickest players can shout out a word that matches the theme and starts with one of their letters. If it fits, they discard that letter. The first player to get rid of all their letters wins the round!

Simple, quick, and filled with giggles, Speed Bac Kids is a great way to spark creativity, develop vocabulary, and encourage quick thinking. With child-friendly themes and easy rules, it’s ideal for family game night, classroom play, or a fun session with friends.

Recommended from age 7 and up, it’s designed to entertain kids and grown-ups alike — whether you’re playing with the little ones or joining in for some fast-paced fun yourself.

—description from the publisher

name: Speedcicleta
description:
Speedcicleta is a competitive tabletop bicycle racing game.

Players move bicycles along a randomly generated track of hexagonal tiles using movement cards, and contend with obstacles in the forms of pedestrians, automobiles, and animals. Players will also sabotage their fellow players with flat tires, broken wheels, and bicycle accidents.
The player crossing the finish line first wins!

The track is constructed from 30 track tiles allowing for excellent replayability while the obstacle cards add a take that element to the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Spellcrafter
description:
Let the fire burn and cauldron bubble!  Use familiars and other forms of sorcery to craft “spells” in this word building game for two to five players. Draft cards from a shared pool then use the letters and special powers collected to craft the most valuable word.  Prove you are the strongest spellcrafter over four rounds to be named High Priest or Priestess of the coven!

Each letter card is assigned a suit (Familiars, Sigils, Cauldrons, and Moons) along with a numeric value (similar to Scrabble).  Bonus points are awarded for long words, words in the same suit, or both!  Special cards allow you to change the suit of letters, duplicate letters, or add a wildcard letter.

—description from the publisher

name: Spellstorm
description:
A tactical deckbuilder for 1-4 players, from the creator of Dragon Bridge.

Set in the Gem Wizards Universe (Gem Wizards Tactics, Dragon Bridge). Spellstorm features the ninja bug-man Omar Evans, the Business Demon Intern Derby Pocket, radical activist skeleton Eve Williams, and a bunch of exciting new characters, each with their own powers and gameplay mechanics.

In Spellstorm, 1-4 wizards do battle, casting a sequence of spells in order, slowly unfolding their tactics and overwhelming the opponent with powerful summons, using a never-before-seen kind of deckbuilding system paired with a simultaneous action system.

Eight Wizards have met at the Spellstorm to obtain the Storm Shards, powerful magic artifacts that can only be gained once every 1,000 years. Who among you is skilled enough to weather the vicious storm?
