Combat features a familiar dice rolling experience that uses each players individual equipment and skills to provide greater depth.

Studium | No Exit is intended to be played in multiple play-sessions, with player characters evolving over time. Shaping each character are milestones that provide vital enhancements to survivability. Milestones can reflect the accumulation of knowledge, the honing of battle crafts, the cohesion of working as a team, or even romantic bonds forged between two characters. Additionally, a unique “Reflection” system allows players to leverage the Studium’s abundant resources to forge formidable weapons, armor, and accessories.

Explore an ever-changing labyrinth of terror and battle unspeakable horrors. Unlock the secrets of the Studium, upgrade your gear, and join forces with fellow survivors if you hope to make it out alive... Studium | No Exit aims to be the horror-filled board game adventure that you won't soon forget.

—description from the publisher

name: TomaToss
description:
Tomatoss is a fast-paced card and token game set in a lively tomato festival, where players grab, toss, and splatter their way to victory. Play tomato cards to meet target conditions, score points, and push your luck with daring “quick tosses” for bigger rewards.

On your turn, place tomato tokens to pick up new cards or toss them at targets. Complete target card conditions to claim points. Take a chance on a quick toss by playing some (or no) cards and then revealing the top of the deck, hoping for the perfect match. Manage your hand, earn basket bonuses, and adapt to changing targets.

When the target deck runs out, the festival ends and the player with the most points wins. With its simple rules, quick turns, and chaotic push-your-luck moments, Tomatoss captures the joy and mess of a real tomato fight.

—description from the publisher

name: Stupor Mundi: Master Print Edition
description:
Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor and King of Germany and Italy, was a man of extraordinary culture, energy, and ability. His contemporaries called him "stupor mundi" ("the wonder of the world"), and many historians consider him Europe's first modern ruler. The kingdom Frederick established in Sicily and southern Italy ran on an efficient bureaucracy similar to modern, centrally governed kingdoms.

As one of Frederick II's vassals in Stupor Mundi, you will summon allies from around the Mediterranean, build structures in your castle, and promote specialists to improve your kingdom. You may improve your chances by upgrading your castles: towers house additional allies, walls store more resources, and keeps aid in managing action cards. Through a clever card-selection mechanism, you will have to choose actions carefully, some of which will trigger edicts that affect Frederick's palace, and determine the rewards players may receive from their allies. Do you stay loyal to the Emperor, or do you support independent allies? Keep a close eye on what your opponents do and form alliances at the right time — or go your own way when things get too heated...

The Master print edition of Stupod Mundi is a special, limited edition that contains:


     Deluxe components, which depending on the edition, are either chunky wood or PVC minis of the Castle pieces, Specialists and ships
     A special Master print box, with unique artwork by Maciej Janik
     The Miracula expansion, which contains two modules that will expand your Stupor Mundi gaming experience. 
     A special insert designed by Black Magic Inserts, including individual player trays, a resource tray and room for all components of the game, including the expansions.

name: STYX
description:
Each player takes on the role of an overlord vying for the Throne of the Underworld.

A game of STYX is divided into turns called Audiences. During each Audience, 2 Emissaries from the Tribes of the Underworld are sent forth to pledge their allegiance to the Throne. Each player secretly chooses a token determining their chosen course of action toward the Emissaries. Depending on the players’ choices, they may gain the allegiance of the tribe, influence, gold, and the Elements they need to win the race to the Throne. They may also choose to betray the Emissaries, slaying them in order to harvest their souls and slow their competition down.

—description from the publisher

name: Sub-Zero
description:
As a faction of Arctic animals take over territories and stockpile food to survive the winter. Fight the cold, avoid humans, and escape the polar bears!

In Sub-Zero, you lead a faction of arctic animals chosen from Walrus, Goose, Musk Ox, Bald Eagle, Arctic Fox, and Lemming.
The first player of the turn rolls a set of dice indicating the actions available for that turn, the players in clockwise order choose which dice to use and remove it from the pool available to the others.
From the season's black dice set, you can then place your animals on the board, collect food from a territory and lower its value, use your faction's special action (each faction is different from the others), spend a point to choose a specific action of the dice
From the blue die of the season, freeze a territory by lowering its value, grow grass on a territory by raising its value, place a human scientific expedition on a territory, collect food, or send a Polar Bear against the animals of the other factions.
The game takes place in 15 rounds divided into 3 seasons: spring, summer, and autumn.
At each change of season, the actions guided by the dice make the game more and more "tiring" for the animals, decreasing the proliferation of animals, reducing the possibility of collecting food, increasing the possibility of the presence of ice, humans and bear attacks Polar

Food points are earned by maintaining a majority in territories, collecting food during the game, and collecting components for game objectives, which are selected at the start of the game.

At the end of the 3 seasons, the player with the most points will have won the game and let his faction's pets get through Sub-Zero's cold winter!

name: Subito
description:
Ready - Set - GO!
Secure the points from as many task cards as you can by placing more cards there than your opponent. But keep a cool head in the rush of cards and don't let your hands get ahead of your mind!

name: Sublime Dark
description:
A cooperative storytelling horror adventure game for 1-4 players where players must uncover secrets about the town of Blackfell. The art, themes, and imagery in the game may be disturbing and are not deemed appropriate for children.

Sublime Dark is played over a series of connected games, or delves, which together make up a campaign. In each Delve, the Caro must explore as far as they can, and survive for as long as possible, discovering and uncovering clues and relics as they go, all while evading the horrendous, murderous entities called Eremites, which stalk Blackfell. Each scenario links to the next one to gradually reveal a larger story (and sometimes new game elements) about the world of Sublime Dark.

In Sublime Dark players take turns to play an action, such as moving to a new area, exploring their current location, uncovering mysteries, hiding from various dangers, solving puzzles, and collecting items and resources to help them defeat the scenario's objectives before time runs out or before they die in the attempt.

Welcome to Blackfell.

-description from designer

name: Submachine
description:
Submachine is a competitive card game. Gameplay consists of building a maze of rooms with other players. The goal is to be the first to play all cards from your hand.

It's based on the video game series of the same name. This puzzle and adventure series, created over a 10-year span from 2005 to 2015 has captivated the imagination of millions of players. It was brought to the big leagues with a complete remaster released on Steam in 2023.

One of the players takes on the role of the dealer. The deck is shuffled and each player gets dealt 9 cards. 
The first player after the dealer places one room card on the table. This card initiates the rooms grid shared by all players. If the first player doesn't have a room card - the next player with a room card starts the grid.

Players take turns to place their room cards from hand to the table, assembling a grid of rooms one by one. They also use functional cards to manipulate the rooms grid, block or open passages, create new passages, or even block target players.

The game ends when one of the players wins by placing last card from their hand.

—description from the designer

name: Sugar Heist: Crib of Thieves
description:
Sugar Heist: Crib of Thieves, a stand-alone and combinable expansion of Sugar Heist, is an action-packed heist game where players collect, trade, and steal candy cards. Quick-to-learn and strategic, Sugar Heist: Crib of Thieves can be played on its own or mixed in with Sugar Heist to create even more great gameplay opportunities!

On your turn, lay down matching sets of candies from your hand and try to draw, steal, and barter for more! The more candy you collect, the closer you are to locking it safely into your Vault. Sometimes though, other players may not want to give you their confectionary treasures and you might have to play a Battle Card. The all new Accessory Cards and Vault scoring add even more variable powers to your game. Execute your strategies and plan your next move to score the most points and win the game! Beg, barter, steal, and battle your way to supremacy in this wacky set collecting game.

-description from publisher

name: Sugarrr!
description:
The quiet morning air is disturbed by the sounds of growling stomachs as the valley awakens - the Fruit-O-Saurs are hungry!

Skilfully gather a combination of Fruit-O-Saurs and their favourite fruit to be crowned the Win-O-Saur in Sugarrr!

Sugarrr! is a card game for 2-4 players. On your turn you can either swap fruit cards from your hand with fruit cards in a market row, or play fruit cards to one of the five columns in the play area. Each fruit card played must match either the colour or number of the previous fruit card in the column. Then, if the number of the last fruit card played matches the number of fruit cards in the column you will gather all the fruit cards in the column into your scoring pile. If the number on the last fruit card played does not match the number of cards in the column, you will instead attract a number of Fruit-O-Saur cards equal to the number of cards you played. When the game ends, each Fruit-O-Saur will multiply the value of their favourite fruit from your score pile. The player with the most points is crowned the Win-O-Saur!

name: Suit and Tie
description:
Suit and Tie is a game where you strategically build your hand and play combinations until you reduce the style points of all other players, called designers.

Suit and Tie is ideal for 2-5 designers, and the goal of the game is to reduce the Style points of every other Designer until they are "out of fashion" and you are the only one with Style points left, making you the most fashionable for that round.

—description from the publisher

name: Sunset
description:
In the city, by the sea, across the desert—once again, the sun sets today. Before night falls, in this fleeting twilight, Shadows intertwine and then scatter. This is such a game. Even the cards you place may unexpectedly merge together...

Sunset is a must-follow trick-taking game with five suits, each numbered 0 to 9 (10 cards per suit) where half of your hand visible! Before the game begins, half of each player’s hand is revealed, arranged in three columns in front of them (only the top card of each column is considered part of their hand). If a player has a card of the lead suit in their visible area, they must play it first before choosing from their hand.

name: Toy Battle
publisher: Repos Production; ADC Blackfire Entertainment; Choo Choo Games; Gém Klub Kft.; Korea Boardgames; Mindcastle Games; MIPL; Nasza Księgarnia
description:
On land, on sea, in clouds, and even in space, battles are breaking out between toys. Your troops need your tactical talent to lead them to victory. Your mission? Be the first to reach the enemy headquarters or control more territories than your opponent.

On your turn in Toy Battle, you either draw two toy troops or place a troop on the board and apply its effect. When you place a troop, you can place it on an empty base, a base that you control, a base that the enemy controls with a lower-valued troop than the one you're placing, or the enemy's headquarters; however, in all cases you must place on a location that has a continuous path to your own headquarters through bases that you occupy, that is, that have your troop on top. If you occupy bases that form a continuous path around a region, you claim the medals within this region. (You don't lose these medals if the enemy later occupies one of these bases.)

The game ends as soon as you occupy your opponent's headquarters or win the required number of medals based on the current game board. If a player cannot draw or place a troop, the game ends, and whoever has the most medals wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Venture
description:
Year 22XX. Two centuries of fierce competition in the delivery industry have encouraged massive strides in Earth's transportation system. Private ownership of trucks, ships, airplanes, and even spacecraft are now common.

Humanity can now pass the Milky Way, far into space, and reach their destination in the timeliest of manners. We have reached civilizations innumerable. Many of them desire to make use of Earth's delivery technology and efficient fuels. As a result, a deluge of orders has been sent to the corporations of Earth, and the age of rocket deliveries begins. There is opportunity for all, but only one can succeed.

In Venture, you must manage your corporation while competing against others for deliveries. In each of three rounds, players need to collect resources, hire personnel, upgrade their rocket, take orders, and make investments, after which they launch into space, moving to various planets to make deliveries, hire alien employees, and more before returning to Earth.

name: Super Squad High
description:
Super Squad High is a cooperative teen superhero strategy game for 1 to 4 players. A crime wave has struck the city, and only Super Squad can save the day! Fight crime, keep up your grades, and become besties or sweethearts with your classmates to learn clues and unmask the villain behind the crime wave. The twist — the villain is secretly one of your classmates!

Features:

Narrative social encounters. Chat with non-player classmates to learn their likes, fears, and feelings, then use what you know to win them over as besties or sweethearts.

Fresh take on crime fighting. Your super powers and crime fighting gear are limited. Make difficult choices between saving the city buildings and citizens, taking bruises, or running late to class. Push your limits just like classic teen heroes from the comics!

Tense, thematic gameplay. Manage your time between schoolwork, fighting crime, and forming relationships with your classmates. Every choice matters as life pulls you in multiple directions.

Heroic teamwork. Use powers and costumes to back each other up. Patrol to get the drop on crime or face danger head-on to protect your teammates.

—description from the designer

name: Brushwood
description:
Brushwood is a peaceful yet strategic set-collection game for 2–4 players. Players take on the role of hikers navigating a vast, ever-changing forest trail to observe local wildlife, pick up berries, and forage for mushrooms.

On each turn, a player moves the shared hiker meeple one to three spaces forward along a trail of forest card stacks, then claims the top card from the trail space where they end their movement. When moving more than one space, they must place a berry token on each card they pass, making those cards more valuable for whoever lands there later. As the players collect the trail cards, they build a personal hiking route, a linear tableau which they strategically arrange to maximize their end-game points from animal sightings and mushroom foraging. When foraging, players can aim for high-value mushroom tokens by collecting enough cards of a specific type or act quickly to secure available tokens before others do.

The game ends when the forest trail begins to thin out, and players score points based on their berry majorities, mushroom tokens, animal sightings, and clever use of binoculars and birdhouses.

—description from the publisher

name: Superfarmer: The Dice Game
description:
The legendary Superfarmer is back — now in a thrilling, laugh-out-loud party edition! Roll the vibrant dice, turn them in your hands, race against your friends, and feel the adrenaline as every round turns into a mad dash for victory. Quick reflexes and sharp eyes make all the difference.

Your goal? Be the first to match the exact arrangement of animals and colors on the revealed card using your dice. The fastest player scores a token — but beware! Some reward cards hide hungry wolves. Lose focus and you might lose one of your hard-earned animals… unless you’ve got a loyal dog card to keep you safe.

But the chaos doesn’t stop there. Special challenge cards will turn the game upside down: can you rotate the dice only with your thumbs, or remember that in this round a horse counts as a cow (and vice versa)?

Stay sharp, stay quick, and get ready for a wild dexterity game packed with twists, laughter, and nonstop action!

—description from the publisher

name: Superficial
description:
'Superficial - The Skin-Deep Game for Shallow People' - is a cooperative adult party game for ages 18+, 2 to 10 Players. Superficial is the one game where you can let your inside thoughts have an outside voice. Go ahead and let those snap-judgements fly! Make sure to invite that one friend who has no filter--you know who I'm talking about! Superficial is perfect for any size group of 2-10 players or more!

If Cards Against Decency and Guess Who It Is had a baby--it would be Superficial! Superficial is a hilarious new adult party game made to liven up even the most boring party. Its easy to learn, very engaging, and perfect for your next gathering, gift, or game night! The game comes equipped with 50 Question Cards and 90 diverse Character Cards. The questions are um....intrusive, and each character has their own completely unique vibe.

While Superficial can’t be summed up in a sentence or two, here’s the gist: 30 character cards, including ONE “mystery person” are laid out face up. The players will then ask questions as judgey as a wealthy aunt in hopes of sussing out the mystery person. Sample questions include *Is this person a vegetarian? *Does this person shave their pubes? *Does this person play video games til 3am?

The ones who don’t meet the judgey standard, will flipped over. The aim of the game is to flip every card BUT the mystery person. If you’ve judged correctly you’ll be left with the mystery person, and you WIN! If not, your lose. But don't worry, either way, you can play again!

—description from the designer

name: Supershazam!
description:
Supershazam is the heartbeat of your next gathering! It blends the best of two worlds: the fun of strategic board games and the universal appeal of music.

It's a dynamic and engaging game where players race to identify songs/artists while using their Instant cards or Game changer cards to outwit their opponents with smart tactics, strategic thinking and game-changing twists.

Whether you're hosting a friends party, a family get-together, or any other event, Supershazam is designed to create unforgettable memories filled with friendly competition. You need at least 4 players to play. The maximum? It's up to you! Basically, pretty much everyone can join in the fun, making it the perfect game for any group size, any setting.

How to play?
1. Choose a host. The host defines the teams, picks the songs to be guessed and manages the card usage and distribution.
2. When the song starts, players raise their hands as soon as they believe they know the title or artist for that song.
3. The host pauses the music and defines the priority to answer, starting by the team who raised the hand first. 
4. At this stage the players have the chance to play any immediate cards they see fit, in order to shake things up and shift the game in their favor. Any amount of immediate cards can be played until the players guess both the title and the artist - if the same team guesses both, it's a SUPERSHAZAM!
5. Before the next song, any team can use a Game Modifier card to tailor the game to their advantage, increasing their odds to score more points.

By guessing songs, combined with the strategic usage of the cards, you the teams will earn points. The first team to achieve 30 points, wins the game!

-description from publisher

name: Supervolcano
description:
Only a small number of Supervolcanos exist across our planet, but have the potential to prove catastrophic for mankind if ever to erupt.

You have been contracted by the government to tackle the Supervolcano threat. Establish your operation and harvest super heated steam from deep inside the volcano.

Balance the challenges of building a heat network and growing local populations, whilst keeping the magma chamber pressure under control. Fail to meet your quota and the resulting eruptions and quakes will see those precious populations disappear!

—description from the designer

name: Surikata
description:
Place the termite mounds on the empty gameboard. The first playing piece also brings the meerkat into the game, and from its position it always looks horizontally and vertically in all four directions - but never over one of the termite mounds!

You cannot place pieces on the spaces it can see! However, a termite mound blocks its line of view and you can place pieces on the spaces behind it.

The playing pieces are placed alternately, and the gameboard becomes busier and busier. With each turn, the meerkat moves to a new position and the lines of view shift accordingly.

In Surikata, the aim is to place your own pieces strategically in order to block the spaces your opponent needs.

name: Survival of the Fittest
description:
Survival of the Fittest is a wildlife themed, fast paced, strategy game which will see you square off against your friends and family as you battle it out to see who will survive. As with all things wild, there is an element of luck involved, as the roll of the dice will prompt your next move, but then comes the strategy; do you attack or defend, run and hide, or stalk and pounce? Every decision has a consequence, every move could be fatal, so keep your wits about you as you prepare to strike.
Survival of the Fittest can be played with 2, 3 or 4 players, and each variation requires a new strategy and a new way of surviving. Depending on the type of lion you are, the game plays between 30 - 45 minutes and keep in mind that there are obstacles that are introduced during the game, so be careful not to get blocked in… or out!
The third big element to the game: can you convince the other players to help you when you need it, even though you both know you are doing your best to try to eat each other’s prey? Survival of the Fittest is an interactive game where having alliances will definitely help you…but look out for the double cross!

—description from the designer

name: Survive Alive
description:
Survive Alive is a competitive medium weight strategy based draw and write game set in a post-apocalyptic world lasting six rounds.

Each round, survivors (players) need to manage their resources drawn from the community bag, build facilities for their characters in order to increase the community health and morale and most importantly defend their base to protect from the Zeds.

Players may scavenge the map for influence or befriend characters to boost their resource pile and grow the community.

At the end of each round, hordes of Zeds will be looking for flesh and if you can’t beat them, you may be joining them!!

The player with the most influence points at the end of the sixth round is declared the winner.

-description from designer

name: Survive the Tombs of the Cryptids
description:
A dungeon crawler tile based game that can be played solo or co-op with fellow wannabe survivors!


     Embark on a spine-chilling journey through ancient tombs, where every turn could be your last.



     Face off against 35 different terrifying cryptids in this survival horror board game. Whether you brave it solo or team up in co-op mode, the challenge is relentless!



     With 30 event cards, where YOU make the choice, every decision shapes your escape route, ensuring that each playthrough offers a unique and unpredictable adventure. Shuffled tiles and cards guarantee no two games are ever the same, keeping the experience fresh every time.



     Level up as you confront cryptids, boosting your skills and unlocking powerful items like the Time Reversal Artefact, Ancient Armor, Charmed Daggers, a Crystal Staff, and 40 more!



     Master this eerie labyrinth with strategic dice rolls, facing monstrous cryptids while unlocking ancient mechanisms to escape. With endless combinations, can you survive the Tombs of the Cryptids?


—description from the publisher

name: Survivor: The Tribe Has Spoken
description:
Survivor: The Tribe Has Spoken is meant to replicate the fun, drama, and excitement of the long-lived television reality show without you needing to sleep in the jungle or eat bugs.

To survive, players must collect advantages, find hidden immunity idols, form secret alliances, and face devastating blindsides, while surviving Tribal Council eliminations, in which players decide who should be voted out by using the game box as a "voting urn" in which players secretly cast votes. Cards let you look at opponents' hands, steal cards, manipulate votes, declare yourself tribal council leader, protect you from elimination, and more.

The last two players standing must make a case to all eliminated players as to why they deserve the title of "Sole Survivor".

The game includes player cards featuring memorable contestants from the 47 seasons of Survivor that have aired as of 2024.

name: Sushi Otter
description:
Sushi Otter is a poker-like game where cards represent sushi.
Each round, players select cards from their hand to form a hand and compete with other players for the highest score. The score is the sum of the hand value, the selected cards themselves, and any bonuses from enhancement cards.
Early on, you won't get strong hands unless you're incredibly lucky. However, by acquiring enhancement cards each round, you'll be able to build unbelievably powerful hands.

—description from the designer

name: Coffee Rush: Winter
description:
As the frosty days grow shorter, your cozy café becomes the ultimate refuge for customers seeking comfort from the cold. In Coffee Rush: Winter, the high-stakes barista business returns with a seasonal chill, challenging players to balance the frantic pace of peak hours with the delicate art of crafting winter specialties. Fulfilling orders earns you precious "like" cards and points, but fall behind, and those disgruntled customers will leave "dislikes" that count against your final score. Whether the game ends because the order deck is depleted or a barista accumulates five penalties, only the player who manages the winter rush with the most efficiency will be crowned the top barista.

While fans of the original Coffee Rush will recognize the core "Overcooked-style" tension, this winter edition introduces several key differences:
Modular Board Chaos: Unlike the fixed layout of the original, the ingredient tiles are now modular. You can set up with "Main board chaos!" or "Windy day" variants, randomly placing ingredients to ensure every game requires a new movement strategy.
Seasonal Drinks: The menu has expanded to include winter-specific items.
Component Changes: The game features thematic updates to its components. Fruit (depicted as orange slices) is newly added to the ingredients, and the Ice tokens are now shaped like Snowmen to fit the winter theme.
New Upgrades: With the newly introduced upgrade tiles, you can now choose four out of six available upgrade tiles for each game.
Scoring: Scoring has been revised so that points are now awarded as +2 for each "like" card and +5 for each activated upgrade, with a -1 penalty for each "dislike".

—description from the publisher

name: Dixit: Kids
publisher: Libellud; asmodee; Gém Klub Kft.; Korea Boardgames; Ігромаг
description:
In the cooperative children's game Dixit Kids, you work together to invite as many guests as possible to the Swift Rabbit's big birthday party! In each round, one of you takes on the role of the Swift Rabbit. They visit a rabbit burrow and choose one of the rabbits to be their birthday guest. The Swift Rabbit then selects a card from their hand that matches the guest's mood: this card is the invitation.

All the other players are courier rabbits. They have to deliver the invitation to the rabbit the Swift Rabbit didn't choose. Then they have to find the invitation so that as many guests as possible can make it to the party in time. If enough guests arrive before the week is over, you win the game together.

Dixit Kids perfectly translates the gameplay of its big brother into a child-friendly version. The 84 new cards, specially illustrated for children, are compatible with all other games in the Dixit universe.

A child-friendly adaptation of the classic game Dixit.

Cooperative game: Everyone works together to interpret the rabbits' moods.

Beautifully illustrated cards, as always.

Picture cards are also compatible with all other games in the Dixit universe.

name: Switch To
description:
You just have to get rid of all your cards. Easy, right? Not quite. You also have to declare how many turns it’ll take. Every action costs a precious token, and every token misused (or unused) costs you points. Precision is everything. Miscalculate, and you might pass too early... or too late.

Switch To is a fast-paced shedding game for 2–4 players with a unique declaration mechanic. Players “bid” how many turns they think it will take to shed their hand. Each turn you play cards, you spend a token. Each pass lets you flip a token into a wild card (switch it!), reducing your declared count.

But if you run out of tokens too early, you’re forced to pass. If you don’t use all your tokens by the end, that’s a penalty. And don’t forget: unplayed cards = lost points. Planning, flexibility, and bold estimation make this an incredibly tight game of hand management and tempo control.

name: Swords of God: Wargaming Battles of the Crusades
description:
Swords of God is a narrative wargame centred on the Age of Crusades (1100-1400). 
Rather than attempt direct simulation of the physical aspects of warfare, the rules instead take inspiration from chansons de geste and other romantic literature of the time and aim to create a faster-flowing, more abstract struggle still worthy of a song.

The game aims to fit battles of around 20-30,000 men a side onto a 6’ x 4’ table, but any size of table can be used if your unit bases are smaller than the Impetus standard of 120mm by 40mm, or more numerous than the sands of the sea! 
Centred as it is on the command and control of key personalities in each army, any size of battle is possible with the easy-to-use points system provided. The game also provides a quick chart to help you pick the right size of table for your battle.

Inspired by psychohistorical studies of the Crusades like Avner Falk’s Franks and Saracens and Vincent Baker’s seminal Apocalypse World rules engine, the game’s deep but simple mechanics promote meaningful tactical choices while ensuring the action always moves forwards.

Among other things, it features:

     A unified mechanic based on the roll of 3 six-sided dice.
     Gridded movement to get the action started quicker. The sides of each square are equal to half the width of a unit base.
     Scenario generation that takes the table’s terrain into account.
     More than half a dozen sets of special rules based on the army commander’s relationship with the divine. In an era of personal oaths and charismatic authority, these special rules extend to their army as well.


Army lists for campaigns in Iberia, the Baltics, the Languedoc, Bohemia and the Levant feature curated spreads of generic unit types, while the Faith Trees available to generals of any religion grant special rules based on their emotional connection to the divine and the religious war that has ensnared them. Each one gives an army a different feel, providing a great deal of replayability even within the same campaign.

—description from the publisher

name: Sykes-Picot
description:
During the First World War, the British and French made a secret agreement to carve up the Ottoman Empire – literally drawing on a map in red and blue ink – without respect to the peoples, culture, or history of the region. This would have devastating effects over the next century.

In Sykes-Picot, two players take on the roles of infamous diplomats Mark Sykes and Francois Georges-Picot, using red and blue markers to carve out territories to control and to influence on a dry-erase map. Trick-taking card play and table-talk negotiations drive the proceedings, with the winner of each trick choosing one of the two cards to implement, and the loser consoling themselves with the remaining card. Each player has a set of hidden objectives they're trying to achieve. Players may be as co-operative or as competitive as they wish in pursuit of these goals.

Tonally, the game is light, reflecting the distance and cavalier attitude of these imperialist powers. We feel there's something horrifying in that, and this approach captures some of that horror.

—description from the publisher

name: Magicats
description:
It’s the annual Great Magic Cat Tournament at Felinor School of Witchcraft and Wizardry!

In Magicats, players represent four prestigious cat clans battling to claim supremacy in the arena.
The game consists of two distinct phases: the Preparation Phase and the Battle Phase.
In the Preparation Phase, players position their cats on the board and equip them with magical powers, by strategically drafting from 11 different magic tokens. Each cat is equipped with four magic tokens to prepare for the fight ahead.
During the Battle Phase, the combat takes place at each turn, allowing the game to move fast and stay exciting. Players move their cats up to four spaces to engage opponents, with the distance between cats changing the dynamic of each encounter. When a cat takes two damages, it loses a magic token to the opponent who dealt the second hit. If a cat loses its final token, the cat itself is captured as a trophy.
The game ends when only one clan remains on the board, and the player who collected the most trophies (magic tokens and captured cats) is the winner.

—description from the publisher

name: Syncanite Foundation
description:
Syncanite Foundation - The ultimate strategy & conspiracy board game A game, designed and written by Timon Thöne, lead visual design by Polarwiesel // M. Rockatansky and TEAM SYNCANITE - based on the upcoming novel FLUX – ZUGZWANG by Timon Thöne

SYNCANITE FOUNDATION is a deep economic strategy and area control game with variable victory conditions and no player elimination for 2¬–4 players (1-6 with expansion). Force the crisis of your choice to exploit its momentum and win. Want some example? Trigger a war and annihilate your rivals! Or trigger a revolution and get crowned as supreme chancellor—the choice is yours!

				
				
					Intro:Syncanite—materialized power. For the masses it is the main source of energy. For the elites it is the key to immortality. As an independent trade league, the Syncanite Foundation regulates the mining and distribution of the syncanite mineral, ensuring political, economic and military stability. But behind the noble guise lurks a secret society of machiavellian oligarchs. At the levers of power, it is easy for them to push the continent into mayhem. How far will YOU go?

				
				
					How to Play:Easy to learn: Syncanite Foundation is a complex game that is not complicated to play! 
Fight your power struggle in four phases per cycle:

				
				
					I. Conflict phase: Claim regions & resources"Only those who dominate can shape the future." 
            Soric Flasyra, Guardian of the Rhielian Imperium

Every member of the Syncanite Foundation commands a private army. Use it to occupy regions of the continent to claim the resources there. But be careful; other players can outbid your military contingent. As long as this cold war prevails, the troops cannot fight, only displace each other. In addition to sheer mass, the clever use of operations and doctrines are decisive for this phase.

				
				
					II. Offering phase: Use profits for corruption"With the right contacts, momentum becomes a method."
            Wator Abrius, Chairman of the Tycan Conglomerate

The market prices for your resources are in your favor? Sell or buy stock for capital and use your profits in a bidding contest against the other players to win over the continent’s dignitaries. Their powerful effects will drastically change the course of the game. In the later game, this phase holds many more offers and opportunities for the players.

				
				
					III. Parliament phase: Manipulate and assasinate"When good words are not enough, clearer messages are needed." 
            Maverid Czylark, Speaker of the Avadian Conclave

Influence the course of the continent by intervening in parliamentary votes. How many votes you have is entirely up to you and your abilities: prevent laws that stand in your way and pass those that benefit you. Damage your competitors with a variety of means, from denunciation to insidious assassination.

				
				
					IV. Foundation Phase: Pull the levers of power"When the Nations collide, we profit." 
            Attributed to the founder of the Syncanite Foundation

Use the unique power of your Role to steer the continent in a direction that benefits you: invest in infrastructure, censor the media, manage democracy, steer the markets or control the military of a faction of your choice. Eventually, prepare for the next cycle: a new conflict phase awaits—and maybe even a crisis.

				
				
					How to win—the unique Crisis MechanicsThis world is a powder keg. Every operation, every law, and every market driven to extremes can trigger crises. A single spark can ignite the Continent. Immediate events create unstoppable chaos and add crisis-specific mechanics to the game phases, opening the way to multiple victory options. There are five crises in total with unique paths to victory:

				
				
					Revolution - The Diplomatic VictoryUse your parliamentary privileges to your advantage. Drive the integrity of parliament into crisis and provoke hard measures. With the Revolution crisis, you can eliminate your political opponents and be elected ruler of the continent.

				
				
					Monopoly - The Economic VictoryLiberalize the parliament, privatize the institutions and reap gigantic profits. If by legal and ethical means is entirely up to you. With the Monopoly crisis, you lay the foundation for a plutocratic system of oligarchs who bid with obscene wealth for the last remnants of the once-almighty state.

				
				
					War - The Military VictoryUse force against your opponents. Ignore the conventions of war and place yourself above the laws of parliament and nobility. With the War crisis, you can enforce the law of the strongest and eliminate your rivals.

				
				
					Triage - The Hero VictoryReduce access to resources and drive up their prices immeasurably. Provoke hunger and want. Push the population to the limits of their endurance. With the Triage crisis, you and your rivals will face considerable costs to save the people. Who of you will become the people´s savior and direct the anger of the masses against those in power?

				
				
					Tyranny - The Story VictoryGive in to your greed for the syncanite and make a pact with the Order: Help its leader to the emperor’s throne and serve under him to your own advantage. With the Tyranny crisis, you face a final boss scenario that circles around one question: Will you accept the emperor and win alongside him, or will you all join forces at the right moment to restore the Foundation?

name: Synthesis: The Molecular Journey
description:
In Synthesis, you play as a scientist exploring the mysterious planet Kepler-452b, aiming to unlock the secrets of newly discovered chemical elements. Each turn, you roll two dice to guide your choices: the bond dice determine the shape of bonds you’ll draw on your personal formula board, while the mutation dice introduce special rules for how you can modify these bonds. As you draw, you’ll use one of four colors—each representing a unique element—and build toward completing hexagonal molecules on your board.

But here’s the twist: it’s not just about finishing molecules. The points depend on the colors used within each molecule, challenging you to create the most effective pattern. Do you complete that green molecule with three green lines now, or wait to make it blue for higher points? Each turn, this small but strategic choice adds a layer of depth, creating a satisfying puzzle that keeps gameplay addictive.

With its vibrant sci-fi theme and simultaneous turns, Synthesis is perfect for groups of up to 8 players. The blend of accessible mechanics and strategic decision-making makes every roll feel exciting, whether you’re new to games or a seasoned player.

—description from the designer

name: T10: Animals
description:
In this must-follow and trump trick-taking game, teams compete to win tricks, all while avoiding the dreaded 4s in the deck. Along the way, when players lose tricks, they can upgrade their cards to the trump suit. Teams are trying to control the flow of the trump suit, and they’re competing to catch tricks, but not all tricks, since 4s are negative points.

In trick-taking parlance, this is a mix of trick-taking and trick avoidance. Your team wants tricks, but the right tricks. Namely, you always want to avoid tricks with more than one 4. But otherwise, it is always good to take tricks. There's a balance to be had: you want (and indeed need) to take tricks. But you don't want to overdo it, because you’ll end up capturing the cards worth negative points.

This is the teams version of Kansas City: The Trick-Taking Game.

—description from the designer

name: Table Fables: Big Bad Wolf
description:
Table Fables: Big Bad Wolf is a solo/cooperative game that puts players in the role of narrator attempting to untangle misplaced fairy tales and guide them to their proper endings before time runs out.

The game takes place over 16 turns, and on each turn you will swap 2 of the cards in the 4x4 grid, trying to simultaneously fulfill the 3 win conditions:

     Red Riding Hood has visited the Bakery. 
     Grandma, Red, and The Woodcutter are adjacent to Grandma's House.
     The Three Pigs are adjacent to the House of Bricks. 


But watch out as the Big Bad Wolf and various obstacles are lurking around the grid as well. With a random grid each game and 2 game variants this fairy tale can be experienced again and again.

—description from the publisher

name: Tabletop Climber
publisher: ハレルヤロックボーイ (Hallelujah Rockboy)
description:
In a strange little kingdom of competitive climbers, each team evolves through five seasonal battles. With each match, new cards are added, and the rules change — demanding clever adaptation and precision planning to reach the top.

Tabletop Climber is a climbing game played over five rounds, where players build a hand from an expanding pool of cards. Each round introduces a new rule that reshapes which plays are strong or weak. Victory depends on crafting the right hand for the moment, managing card strength and combos, and outmaneuvering rival teams through changing conditions.

name: Tabletop Inc.
description:
In Tabletop Inc players take on the role of board game publishers collecting the perfect mix of artwork, components, and mechanisms to build the greatest board games in the world. Enter an alternate 1970s where Mumans and humans have co-existed for millennia. The mix of human ingenuity and muman industriousness has created a new golden age of tabletop games, and you are in the right place at the right time.

As CEO of a board game production company, you will be assigning your workers to jobs across a fabulous board game factory. Hiring Specialists, crafting components, and manufacturing mechanisms all in a bid to publish the most popular games, win tabletop awards and, of course gain victory points. Tabletop Inc offers a novel take on the worker placement mechanism where players are rewarded for paying attention to and predicting the actions of their opponents.

On your turn you will be placing your workers to specific jobs, hiring new specialist employees with unique powers, building board games from components, artwork, and mechanisms, and submitting your games for prestigious awards. Tabletop Inc is board game all about board games!

Tabletop Inc is a fast-paced worker placement style game which is quick to learn but offers a rich depth of experience in the gameplay. A huge design emphasis was placed on replayability with multiple paths to victory, a wide player count, and nearly 70,000 unique starting conditions.

name: Dice Words
description:
In Dice Words, each player begins by choosing a set of seven letter dice that each represent a different iced beverage. When the timer starts counting down, players attempt to form the longest and most valuable word possible.

Don't have the letters you need? Don't worry! You can re-roll any of your dice up to two times before the round ends — but in addition to your individual letter dice, you must also try to incorporate the most "target letters", that is, the letters revealed on four ice cube-shaped letter dice that are revealed at the beginning of each round. The colder your drink thanks to the incorporation of ice, the higher your score!

name: Tack
description:
Out on the open sea, a small boat navigates the temperamental winds. Summon a powerful gust of wind to push your sails to victory. 
In this short strategy game, players will move dice up and down within a grid to equal the required dice total. Block your opponents, line up your dice, and activate the wind to earn one point per dice. The first player to harness 9 points wins!

—description from the designer

name: Taco Loco
publisher: Helvetiq; Fabrika Igr; Popcorn Games; YaoPlay; 游隙时光
description:
In Taco Loco, you want to stuff others as full of tacos as possible.

Each player has a hand of three cards, and on a turn you add one of your fillings to a taco in play, keeping all of the cards visible. If the taco now sums exactly 11, give this taco to another player, who sets it aside. If the sum is less than 11, nothing happens, and if the sum is higher than 11, you've overfilled the taco and ruined it; take the cards yourself, and set them aside. If you wish to play a card of the same value as the most recently played card in a taco, set this card aside to form the base of a new taco.

The game includes two special cards: the "legendary taco" card immediately fills the taco to 11, allowing you to give these cards to someone else, whereas the "lonesome taco" allows you to bring the sum of a taco to 0 or to respond to someone playing a legendary taco, forcing them to take it.

When all the cards have been played, the game ends, and whoever has the fewest cards wins.

name: EXIT: The Game – Advent Calendar: The Magic of Christmas
description:
Peace, the scent of pine, not a soul in sight – a long hike through the unspoilt forest is just what you need. You're happy to have escaped the hustle and bustle of the pre-Christmas season and are resting in a picturesque clearing when you hear a loud bang and everything goes black.

When you wake up, the forest around you is enchanted, and you are surrounded by snow! Red baubles hang in the trees; lights twinkle in the undergrowth. Then, shock hits you: Your hands! They're completely covered with green fur...

EXIT: The Game – Advent Calendar: The Magic of Christmas is both an EXIT game and an adventure story. To find out what has happened to you and the forest, you open a door of the calendar every day. Behind each door, you'll find a new riddle, the solution to which will take you to the next day's door. Only if you follow the clues and solve all 24 riddles will you be able to uncover the secret of the forest.

name: Marbleous
publisher: KOSMOS; IELLO; Swan Panasia Co., Ltd.; Thames & Kosmos
description:
Each turn in Marbleous, you choose a marble card on display, then roll those two or three marbles into your grid. If three or more marbles of the same color are touching, they pop, with you grabbing the scoring card matching the color and size of the group — and if you form another group after removing those marbles from the grid, those pop, too.

Make large groups, and you earn bonus markers that allow you to drop a marble of its matching color into your grid, giving you a better chance of scoring a large group. The player with the most points at the end of the game wins.

In the advanced game, you earn a star whenever you pop two or more groups on a turn, allowing you more choice over the scoring card you grab, in addition to earning extra points at game's end for the stars you've collected.

Similar to many digital match 3 games like Candy Crush.

name: TacTile
description:
TacTile is an engine building abstract strategy game where you move pawns on a board to trigger bonus actions from your tableau of cards.

Your goal is to cross the modular 4 color board and score both your pawns in your opponents home first. 
   • As you advance across the board you can gain resources and buy colorful action cards.
   • Action cards are permanently added to your tableau and can give one free action per turn, but you must activate them by landing on a matching color tile.
   • Build your action engine and use clever positioning to activate your cards in this combo-tastic game of tile tactics!

4p mode is a competitive 2v2 team battle with special cooperative abilities including the ability to push your ally's pawn and swap cards with your ally.

—description from publisher

name: Tadoba: Wildlife Safari
description:
In Tadoba: Wildlife Safari, players venture into the dense jungles of India’s famed Tadoba Tiger Reserve, rolling dice to traverse a vibrant hex-based map filled with varied terrains like forests, hills, and reservoirs.

As they move, players reveal hidden Spotting Tokens that might lead to critter sightings or false alarms, creating moments of surprise and tension. Collected critter cards — birds, reptiles, and mammals — are carefully arranged into the Field Guide’s zones like Photography, Jungle Diaries, Observers, or secret Wild Habitats, each scoring differently and offering unique bonuses.

With clever movement choices, risk management, and set collection, Tadoba delivers an immersive wildlife adventure packed into an accessible print-and-play format.

—description from the designer

name: Oh My Word
description:
Oh My Word is a real-time, word-based party game that features a constantly changing playing field, a random timer, and unusual categories.

Each round starts with someone pulling a random letter from a bag, choosing a category among those visible on the table, then giving a word or term starting with the drawn letter that fits the category. Once you cover the category, the next player goes, doing the same thing with the same letter and a different category. While you're all doing this, a random timer is counting down, and the player taking their turn when the timer expires receives a "bad luck" token. Try not to end up with the most tokens!

name: TAH WARS: Dice Tower Game
description:
Far away and long ago, an asteroid slammed into the planet TAH. It brought death, and changed the world for the descendants of those who survived. Remnants of the ancient impact are found as seams of purple crystal imbedded within the strata of native stones. This crystal, called Neonite, possesses mystic properties.  Properly harnessed Neonite can levitate objects of unlimited mass and size. Kings, and warlords, revolutionaries and despots seek out neonite, each seeking absolute control of their people and their rivals.   Massing their armies in huge flying castles, they push the borders of their realms, expanding into the territory of their enemies at the vanguard of ruthless armies.

Take control of one of 6 Races and use your flying castle to send out farmers, miners, and armies to prove that you are the rightful ruler of TAH. Gather resources, complete quests, and buy stronger armies. Rotate and move your castle (Dice Tower) on one of 4 different maps.

Align your dice tower chute with an opponent’s dice tower and deploy your armies (dice) to attack their defenses. Earn 5 Crowns before any other player to win the game, and rule TAH, until the next War. Can you defeat your enemies and secure your title as ruler of TAH?

—description from the publisher

name: Tai Chi Tiger
description:
In the first light of the new year, the tigers gather in the ancient forest to test their strength! Immerse yourself in an epic tournament where timing, memory, and tactical skill determine the path to victory.

In Tai Chi Tiger, all players gather a team of masterful tigers who try to outdo their opponents with graceful movements and powerful combos. If you don't keep the rhythm of the chi, you could lose your tiger — but your remaining tigers will give their team new strength for the next exchange of blows.

—description from the publisher

name: Take Cover
description:
Take cover is a fast playing card game for two players. Gamers should be able to play several battles over a one hour lunch!!!

Overview: Two German squads battle two Russian squads on the tabletop battlefield.  
Players perform actions to improve their squad’s combat effectiveness by attaching Weapon, Leader, Terrain cards, and by advancing on and firing on the enemy. 
Event cards are played to damage or impede the enemy squad. The 10-sided die (d10) resolves combat and Event card results. 
The game is won by eliminating both of the opponent’s squads.

With only 2 pages of rules and 72 cards gamers will be up and battling in no time.  Rules for special weapons, leaders, and terrain are all there.

—description from the publisher

name: Take Time
publisher: Libellud; ADC Blackfire Entertainment; asmodee; CMON Global Limited; Galápagos Jogos; Geekach LLC; Gém Klub Kft.; Rebel Sp. z o.o.
description:
Take Time is a cooperative game where players either win or lose together.

To succeed, you must strategically play 12 cards facedown around a Clock, following specific rules for each Test. You can work together through a series of games to pass all 40 Tests available in the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Takeover: Ladder Climbing Tactics
description:
Takeover is a small box game about building the best hand, deploying powers, and playing all your cards first. As a syndicate manager, you play freelancers (cards) and use tactical actions to vie for control of the last publicly traded city.

Be the first to play all your cards and you win the game!

Game feel and features:

-Build a better hand from a shared market of cards
-Use Specialists to steal, go first, and disrupt other players
-Sequence your card plays to pressure rivals and empty your hand

Now includes Override, a clearer, leaner, and slightly meaner rules variant in the same box. This variant accelerates an already fast game with punchier play and smoother pacing. The  Override mechanic also adds extra interaction, deduction, and psy games.

—description from the publisher

name: Tales of Nine: La Montagne Noire
description:
Tales of Nine is a narrative puzzle game for 1 player only.

Explore places, fight monsters, collect treasure and experience an Adventure in 3 Chapters.

La Montagne Noire (The Black Moutain) -
Countless years have passed since the Great Black Dragon seized the legendary dwarf city of Dugrimmar... But today, you, Paladin of the Kingdom, have decided to defy him and take the Sceptre of the Ancients, to offer your people a glorious future!

The game turn is divided into 3 phases:


     The Hero phase, in which the player moves the Hero card to another card and pays the latter's entry cost. Then retrieve the card from his "backpack".
     The Monster phase, in which any monsters that can, move closer to the Hero.
     The Adventure phase, when the player completes the game zone.


You'll need to anticipate your moves and apply the various card effects to reach your goal and find your way out.

The player win when the "Exit" card get to the "backpack".

An “Infinite” mode is also available, allowing players to play one game after another, trying to achieve the highest score.

—description from the publisher

name: Wildblooms
description:
In the tactical game Wildwuchs, you want to make the colorful wildflower meadow bloom, ideally with several flowers at once because as many as possible should flourish here.

Clever decisions are required in this interactive gaming experience that features short waiting times and special combo effects. Whoever has the largest wildflower meadow blooming at the end wins — and as a special treat for nature fans, you'll have your own 3D wildflower meadow!

name: Tanares Expeditions: Central Sea
description:
Step into the turbulent waters of the Central Sea, where a dark and sinister force threatens to engulf the entire realm in chaos. Pirates and sailors alike are losing their minds, driven mad by an ancient evil rising from the depths. In this 1-4 player epic pirate adventure, you are the most feared pirate of the seas, the only hope against an upcoming doom that seeks to drown the world in corruption and despair.

This crawler offers one of the most exciting and strategic experiences, blending the depth of classic dungeon-crawlers with the dynamic excitement of roguelite mechanics. As you sail through perilous quests, your hero will grow stronger both during and between adventures, allowing you to create devastating combos that turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Customize your Sea Lord with unique powers and strategies, creating powerful synergies. With engaging, fast-paced gameplay and a richly immersive narrative, every turn brings new challenges and opportunities to prove your dominance over the seas and reshape the fate of the world.

—description from the publisher

name: Tanbo
description:
As you wanted to live closer to nature, you have decided to start cultivating rice in Niigata Prefecture, Japan.

Snakes are commonly found in paddies. These reptiles are considered sacred creatures that help the rice to grow.

The more snakes there are, the greater the harvest will be. However, you will need to control the snake population in order to harvest the rice.

Tanbo is a two-player abstract game with a Japanese theme. The primary mechanic resembles Mancala, which have been played since ancient times. However, in this game, the mancala has evolved into something unusual and mysterious, creating elements that feel like worker placement, expanding options, area majority, and set collection.

Winner of the Rakuichi Fresh Dragon Award in 2023

—description from the publisher

name: Tank Chess: Portable
description:
Coming with a smaller board than the base game, Tank Chess: Portable is a standalone expansion ideal for traveling, playing in reduced spaces, or in a time constraint.

The games played on a 12 x 12 in / 29 x 29 cm square board play out quicker, the gameplay is usually more dynamic, and tense, as the Command Tank's escape is looming from the first few turns, and clashes and first casualties can be expected, basically, from turn 2. You’ll want to pay close attention to corridors closing due to vehicle destruction at all times, as you don’t want to block your own pieces from preventing a quick escape of the opponent's Command Tank.

There is the same set of pieces and flags as in the Standard version (2 x 16 pieces), so you can create many completely different custom setups and get an infinitely replayable game out of this single expansion.

name: Tank Clash: Eastern Front
description:
The stage is set for the largest clash of late-war heavy armour.

The Red Army is spearheaded by the powerful Russian tank corps with units like the T34, SU100 and IS2. Germany pins her hopes on the last of the panzer divisions to stop the Soviet advance. The Wehrmacht fields its fearsome tanks like the Stug III, Nashorn and Tiger II for the upcoming battle.

Tank Clash : Eastern Front is the new standalone casual warfare strategy game for 2 players that a noob or skilled player can enjoy. It features its trademark checkers-style armour tracking system with dice rolling and hand management for tactical choices.

It is designed to be modular and 100% compatible with its predecessor Tank Clash : Western Front. Combine Western Front with the Eastern Front for 12 different tank types to battle on a huge terrain map with up to 4 players! Plus all of Eastern Front's new features like battlefield tokens and event cards can be used in Western Front.

All Tank Clash games are designed to be easy-to-learn, quick to setup and played within an hour. Replayability is high as there are different secret missions, tactical & morale cards and modular terrain boards. There is now also a solo mode for both Western and Eastern Front games.

—description from the publisher

name: Tarqui: An Honorable Peace?
description:
“An honorable peace?” is a straightforward recreation of the Battle of Tarqui, which took place on the plains of Tarqui near Cuenca, in present-day Ecuador, on 27 February 1829. This battle was fought between the armies of Peru and Gran Colombia, which at the time included the modern-day countries of Colombia, Ecuador, and Venezuela. Although little known outside these countries, it was a key battle in defining the spheres of influence of the countries.

During each turn, players will alternate activating their units one at a time until all units are either exhausted or the players choose to stop activating them. Each activation allows a unit or stack to perform one action: movement, combat, or fire. After each activation, units must always check their readiness status. Victory conditions involve the elimination of enemy units and control of key geographical objectives.

-description from designer

name: Tartaria 2030
description:
Enter a post-apocalyptic world teetering on the edge of destruction. Tartaria 2030 is a rich, story-driven strategy game that merges the immersive depth of a classic board game with the innovation of cutting-edge digital gameplay.


     Plan. Battle. Dominate.


Lead powerful units, face catastrophic natural disasters, and make game-changing decisions as you fight to survive and conquer in a world consumed by chaos.


     The Ultimate 3-in-1 Game Experience



     Physical Board Game – Tactical battles, disaster cards, and unit upgrades on a beautifully designed hex-based battleground.



     Digital Companion Game – Real-time disasters, AI challenges, and immersive missions that sync with your tabletop experience.



     Standalone Digital Game – Go solo or battle friends online in fast-paced, turn-based warfare anytime, anywhere.



     Whether you're commanding on the tabletop, surviving digital disasters, or battling online in the app — your strategy, adaptability, and courage will define your fate.


—description from the publisher

name: Temple Twist
description:
A cryptic notebook leads your archaeological expedition deep in the jungle to an ancient temple rumored to hold incredible artifacts. Your goal: Explore the rooms of the temple and escape before your energy runs out!

But that's easier said than done because the temple is a maze of movable walls and mysterious mechanisms! Now it's time to work together. Using your action cards, you'll navigate through this unique structure, move walls, and even rotate the entire temple!

In the action-packed co-operative game Temple Twist, players take turns choosing an action card from their hand to strategically manipulate the three-dimensional temple and move the explorer cube through the maze of rooms. Play through a series of increasingly difficult expeditions, or pick up some challenge cards and dive right in. This game combines strategy, co-operation, spatial reasoning, and hands-on action with a first-of-its-kind 3D-maze-gameboard that changes as you play.

name: Taxi: The Game of "Fare" Play
description:
Taxi is a light strategy, route building, tile placement game with a little bit of take that mechanics mixed in.  Players play the role of taxi drivers, navigating a growing cityscape. The goal is simple yet challenging: create an unobstructed route from a starting location to an ending location, as shown on your Fare card, using a variety of road segment cards laid out in a shared grid.

But the road to success is filled with unexpected detours! Your opponents are crafty, setting up roadblocks like parades and traffic jams. And if that wasn't enough, watch out for those special cards that could have you sidelined for speeding or making way for an ambulance.

It's a race to be the first to build an unobstructed path, and maintain it for one round of play.  The first player to do that, wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Taïki
description:
Taïki is a family-friendly must-follow trick-taking game.
At the beginning of a round, you get an equal number of Sun and Moon cards (depending on player count) then an additional card at random.
Each round you try to get as many tricks in the Sun suit as in the Moon suit. Achieving that gives you two Balance tokens per pair of tricks. Ending a round with an unbalanced number of tricks in each suit results in you discarding as many Balance tokens as the difference between your number of tricks in each suit.
After three rounds, the player with the most Balance tokens wins.

Some special cards can be played as either suit. Some others can be either the highest or the lowest of its suit.

name: The Crew: Journey to the Ends of the Earth
description:
Travel around the world in a race against time on the hunt for Charlemagne's secret treasure. Follow clues that will lead you up Mount Everest, through the Amazon Rainforest, and beyond. It's up to you how your story will end. Will you make it in time, or will you be too late? The only way to find out is by playing.

The Crew: Journey to the Ends of the Earth is a co-operative trick-taking game in which players attempt to complete missions together. This game features a 25-stage journey.

name: Team Quack
description:
Team Quack is a cooperative game where sharp observation and clever hints are your keys to victory!

Work together to convey secret images using subtle clues and fun noises. Each round, you'll try to gauge how clear your hints are and predict how easily your teammates can guess your secret card.
Be careful, as too many wrong guesses will cost you valuable lives. Aim for the medal playing as many rounds as possible!

1. Choose image cards that describe your Secret Card best. 
Draft the image cards you don't use.

2. Share with your team how obvious your pick is!

3.Can you match the Secret Cards to the correct players…or will you guess wrong and lose a life token?

—description from the publisher

name: The Gang: Deluxe Edition
description: The Gang: Deluxe Edition is a blinged-out edition of the co-operative card game The Gang that includes the base game, the The Gang: More Players expansion that brings the player count to ten, as well as three expansion packs for more variability in game play. This edition also features ceramic poker chips, casino-quality cards, and a custom playmat.

name: Dark Tomb: The Ice Chasers
description:
Dark Tomb: The Ice Chasers is the third adventure in the Dark Tomb series. It's an ultra-portable tabletop dungeon crawler in which a group of uniquely skilled characters must navigate to the Ice Cavern of Mount Varconen and defeat the vicious Ice Chasers.

Characters are fully interchangeable with the other Dark Tomb games, and work collaboratively though four stages collecting items, battling monsters, and exploring tiles. On each turn characters can choose from a variety of attacks, movement, or other abilities in addition to utilizing items encountered.

If the party fully explores a stage and defeats all monsters they conquer it and move on to the next. If they fail in their quest, they can recoup and try again. Map tiles, monsters, and items are randomized, so every play-though is unique.

—description from the publisher

name: Tech Race
description:
Tech Race is a medium-weight Euro-style strategy game that brings the fast-paced, high-stakes world of tech startups to your tabletop. In Tech Race, players step into the shoes of ambitious startup founders, hiring employees, developing futuristic technologies, and racing to achieve the highest company valuation.

The game takes place over 9 rounds, each comprising 3 phases: Staffing, Action, and Lobbying.

1. Staffing: You hire and train employees to unlock new abilities and build your company. Each employee needs a salary, so keep an eye on your payroll costs!

2. Action: You use your employees’ actions to drive demand, expand your territories, obtain new customers or steal existing ones from your competitors, and collect materials to develop futuristic technologies. These resources are limited, so you may have to bargain with other players!

3. Lobbying: Compete in bidding wars to implement new policies that can earn you rewards or trigger chaotic events. Collusion is not just allowed, it's essential!

The game is for players aged 14 and up, supports 2-5 players, and typically plays in about 90 minutes.



Why you will love Tech Race:Deep Dive Into The Startup World
Tech Race captures the thrill of building a startup with gameplay inspired by real-world tech industry challenges. Designed by Ionah Hang Nguyen, an indie board game designer with an MBA and extensive work experience in business and the tech industry, the game reflects the highs and lows of building a tech company. Learn to manage cash flow, make hiring decisions, adapt to market shifts, and more - all in a way that’s engaging and accessible.

Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics
This medium-weight Euro game is a strategic delight, blending engine building, resource management, trading, and bidding mechanics. It’s designed to strike the ideal balance between depth and accessibility, making it a great fit for both seasoned gamers and newcomers.

Striking Visual Design
WE DO NOT USE AI IN OUR DESIGN. Oksana Mykytiuk, our talented illustrator, brings her incredible skill to Tech Race, crafting stunning visuals that immerse you in the high-stakes world of tech startups. From vivid tech tokens to enchanting character art, every piece adds depth and vibrancy to your gameplay.

Humor That Stands Out
Tech Race isn’t just about strategy - it’s got a cheeky side, too! With parody company names and clever policy cards, we’ve infused plenty of humor to keep your game nights fun and light-hearted.

name: Tecmo Bowl
description:
Experience the legendary Tecmo Bowl like never before—in a fast-paced tabletop board game version! Choose your team, call the plays, and battle for victory in this authentic adaptation of the iconic original video game. Take control of the Offense and push down the field to score Touchdowns (7 points) or Field Goals (3 points), while the Defense tries to predict plays and shut down drives. Every decision counts as you work to outmaneuver your opponent in a game of strategy, skill, and classic Tecmo Bowl football action. With nostalgic pixel-style art, easy-to-learn rules, and fast-paced gameplay, Tecmo Bowl delivers a timeless football experience for all players! Add it to your next family game night and watch the competition unfold.


     NOSTALGIC GAMEPLAY STRAIGHT FROM THE TECMO BOWL VIDEO GAME: Relive the magic of Tecmo Bowl in this 2-player, head-to-head tabletop board game adaptation, featuring authentic play-calling mechanics and classic football strategy. Choose your actions wisely and watch the competition come to life!


 

     FAST-PACED FOOTBALL ACTION: OUTSMART YOUR OPPONENT: Each team gets one offensive possession per quarter, making every play critical to the outcome of the game. The Offense tries to gain yards, score touchdowns, or kick field goals, while the Defense attempts to predict plays and force turnovers. The team with the most points claims victory! 



     BIG ACTION CARDS CREATE GAME-CHANGING PLAYS: Big Action cards give each team the ability to break tackles, force turnovers, or shift the game's momentum.. These cards bring unpredictable, energetic moments to every match. Each team has a limited number of Big Action cards per half, so use them wisely! 



     EASY-TO-LEARN RULES AND DICE-ROLLING MECHANICS: Both Offense and Defense select plays simultaneously, then implement the results by flipping their cards and rolling distance dice. Plays happen quickly, making the game engaging and perfect for all football fans and board game fans. 



     ULTIMATE NOSTALGIA FOR CLASSIC GAMERS AND SPORTS FANS: With its timeless, classic look and simple, engaging gameplay, Tecmo Bowl is a great choice for lovers of the original video game, casual football fans, and families looking for competitive board game fun. Add it to your collection of board games for the whole family to enjoy.


—description from the publisher

name: Tectonic Tribes
description:
In Tectonic Tribes, five tribes are trying to find their way through the mysterious land of Joldu. A world where the terrain is still forming and shifting tectonic plates are constantly creating new surprises. Each of these Tectonic Tribes aim to secure areas for themselves. Which tribe will be victorious when the terrain comes to rest?

The players take turns playing cards in the ever-expanding area between the players. The various areas, such as forest areas, water areas and diamond mines, can grow. Because the cards are placed on top of each other, the areas can also be interrupted. A player can use a tribe card to border an area and score points this way. But be careful! You only score points if your tribe has the majority of tents next to an area. Does another tribe have more tents bordering the same territory? Then your opponent gets the points and you get nothing at all.

The order in which the cards are placed is determined by the number in the corner of the card. The player who plays the lowest card is the first to place a area or tribe card in the territory, whereby at least one and a maximum of five of the areas on the card must overlap with a card or cards that are already on the table. Try to expand your own territories in a clever way and interrupt the territories of your opponents so that you end up as the largest tribe and win the game.

—description from the publisher

name: How to Save a World
publisher: Burnt Island Games; Frosted Games; Lucrum Games; Night Ferry Studio
description:
As one of the leading scientific researchers in the galaxy, you're in high demand. You've spent the last two years on Alarria, a small terrestrial planet several light-years from Earth. You've been studying the diverse indigenous fauna, and your field research has already yielded some incredible results. However, your days as a simple scientific researcher are about to end.

An asteroid roughly the size of a small country has been picked up on radar hurtling towards Alarria — a planet killer. Your research work has been put on hold as the greatest minds on the planet have been recruited to develop plans. Time is running out as each second brings the asteroid closer to Alarria. Where will you focus your efforts? Which plan has the best chance to succeed? There's no time to waste. If something isn't done soon, the planet itself might cease to exist. Three distinct plans have been set into motion, each with a razor thin chance of succeeding:


    A powerful laser is tracking the asteroid's approach and will fire as soon as it comes within range in hopes of reducing it to a mere pebble.
    An energy shield might be just enough to deflect the approaching asteroid, altering its course and saving Alarria.
    In a final desperate attempt to preserve some of the unique species of the planet, an evacuation plan has been ordered. The nearby forest moon, Fortuna, has been tested and can support life, and thankfully it's out of the blast zone. You just need to move as many of the species as possible before impact.


How to Save a World is a worker-placement game with hand-building and resource management. Each turn, you assign workers to perform critical tasks or spend action cards to help advance your goals. At the end of each round, the projects will be assessed and the asteroid will move ever closer. Can you make the right decisions to avert disaster in this competitive science-fiction game?

—description from publisher

name: Temple of Five
description:
You, the leaders of rival clans, are to carry out the most important task of the ruler who longs to revive the former glory and prosperity of the city. In the heart of the ancient land, you will build majestic pyramids decorated with symbols of divine power and wisdom. Each pyramid will become not only an architectural wonder, but also a sacred place where the prayers and hopes of your people will be embodied.

Each player builds a pyramid on their board using tiles. As you build, try to place the tiles so that the decorations on them form chains of the decorations with the same colors. Use these chains and your priests to win blessing cards, which will earn you victory points or usefull bonuses. Whoever gets the most victory points by the end of the game wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Lairs
description:
You’ve worked hard to earn your spot in the Adventurers Guild, but one last obstacle remains. You must square off with a cunning rival guild hopeful in an exam of precarious paths that will test your skills at building a devious dungeon...and exploring one. To pass, you have to complete the tricky labyrinth your opponent has created full of dead ends, traps, enchanted monsters — oh, and if you can find it, valuable treasures. You enter their dungeon with your own set of skills and over the course of this challenge, you'll grow as an adventurer. Will it be enough to map the right path, defeat the monsters in your way, and escape with the most valuable collection of treasure? Your spot in the Adventurers Guild depends on it!

Lairs is a two-player game for ages 10 and up that plays in about 35 minutes. Players begin with a set of walls, traps, treasures, and monsters, then use them to create a challenging catacomb for their opponent to explore while at the same time attempting to navigate their opponent's dungeon using guile, deduction, and a little bit of luck.
