     In Kilea's Wrath, you must find a way to appease the fire god before a volcanic eruption destroys the island paradise.
     In Frenzy at the amusement park, you try to secure the prize of all prizes.
     In The Curse on Camelot, you embark on an epic quest to restore the glory of the kingdom of Pendragon.

name: Unlock!: Short Adventures – The Ocean's Heart
description:
Unlock! Short Adventures: The Ocean's Heart! November 1800. As Captain Laurent drifts off to sleep in his cabin, a strange dream begins to take shape… A mysterious presence, forgotten symbols, a call from the depths. In this short and immersive adventure, set off on a journey as mysterious as it is unsettling.

Unlock Short Adventures are 30 to 45 minute Unlocks in a small format, ideal for pocketing or giving as a gift. Unlock! is a cooperative card game inspired by escape rooms. Unlock! brings these experiences into your home, around a table. After familiarizing yourself with the context of the scenario, you begin your adventure in a room (a location map showing various numbers). Search the room for objects! Beware: some may be hidden! Visual and audio puzzles slow your progress. It's up to you to cooperate with your partners to advance and finish on time.

To play, you need the free Unlock! app, compatible with Android and iOS phones and tablets. It allows you to obtain clues, locate hidden objects and enter the codes you discover. The app makes the game very real. It adds to the atmosphere, with music dedicated to each adventure, audio puzzles, terrible penalties and a fatal countdown.

Unlock! Short Adventures: The Ocean's Heart is a scenario of difficulty 2 out of 3.

name: Unlock!: Short Adventures – The Song of the Sea Spray
description:
A romance between two animals that are complete opposites, where poetry and mystery intertwine.

Unlock! Short adventures is a series of escape adventures for up to six players. With 30 to 45 minutes on the clock, players work through a deck of 30 cards as a team, searching for clues, combining objects, and solving puzzles. The free Unlock! companion app runs the timer while also providing clues, offering hints, and confirming successes. Once the team has reached a solution and entered the correct code into the app, they will escape and win the game!.

Immerse yourself in the romantic world of an impossible love story 
between two people who have nothing in common. Written in alexandrine, this romance offers a memorable experience where poetry and mystery intertwine. A touching and original theme!

name: Fallout: Power Play
description:
Welcome to Fallout: Power Play!, in which you control one of four factions from the Fallout universe: the Brotherhood, Raiders, the Enclave, and Super Mutant. You are all vying for control of locations within the Wasteland.

You will spend your turns attempting to gain the most influence in locations on the board, winning points at the end of each round for each location where you have the most influence. To gain influence, play agents into locations, play and complete quests (which come with other rewards as well), use "power play" cards to respond to opponents, and struggle against the Wasteland itself as each turn a randomly drawn card brings an unpredictable change to the game, from sudden atomization to a surly deathclaw rampaging through your home base. The first player to gain 10 points wins.

name: Cyberpunk Edgerunners: Combat Zone
description:
Fans of Cyberpunk will be able to bring their favorite characters, such as Maine, David, Lucy, Rebecca, and more, to the table for epic battles against Adam Smasher and the Arasaka Corporation. Cyberpunk Edgerunners: Combat Zone features a brand new 2-Player Starter box that is fully loaded with beautiful, full-color acrylic StandUpz™, a rule book, scenarios, double-sided game board, scenery, game cards, dice, limiters, and tokens, allowing players to play cinematic games straight out of the box, with minimal setup.

Using Monster Fight Club’s acclaimed [RE]action System, Edgerunners is 100% fully compatible with the existing Cyberpunk RED: Combat Zone game, giving players who wish to play anachronistic “what if” games the full freedom to do so.

Edgerunners will launch alongside supporting products, such as a full range of miniatures for hobby enthusiasts and Combat Zone veterans, as well as a special collector’s miniature of the moment Adam Smasher makes his infamous introduction.

—description from the publisher

name: The Witcher: No Man's Land
description:
The Witcher: No Man’s Land is a thrilling miniature skirmish game set in the brutal and mysterious world of The Witcher, drawing from both CD PROJEKT S.A.’s acclaimed video game series and Andrzej Sapkowski’s legendary books. Officially licensed and rich with lore, the game plunges players into gritty battles across the war-torn lands of the Continent, where monsters roam and survival is never guaranteed.

Designed for two players, the game begins with an epic starter set that makes it easy for both newcomers and seasoned skirmish veterans to dive into the action. Players command warbands composed of iconic characters and factions from The Witcher universe, engaging in fast-paced, tactical combat across diverse and treacherous terrain.

Gameplay is driven by the innovative [RE]action System, which eliminates traditional rounds and phases in favor of a dynamic flow where players act and react in real-time. Characters can be wounded mid-battle, reducing their effectiveness and creating dramatic tension and urgency. This system promotes cinematic, narrative-rich moments where every move counts.

The ultimate goal? Outfight and outwit your opponent in scenarios full of danger, strategy, and dark fantasy flavor, proving your dominance in a world where no one is safe and every choice has consequences.

—description from the publisher

name: Parks & Potions
description:
Players step into the boots of Park Rangers whose expertise in botanical alchemy transforms the wilderness into a sanctuary for healing. With the roll of the dice, players gather extracts from the park's flora, concocting potent potions to treat the ailments of animals from different biomes. Successfully healing animals and performing experiments earns points, directly reflecting your role in maintaining the park's well-being. Aim for animals in similar habitats to unlock bonus points, reflecting the depth of your commitment to conservation — or take the path of experimenting to find new potions.

Parks & Potions plays over 5-6 rounds, each representing a day of work. The game is divided into phases in which players roll dice to discover flowers to extract, manage their inventories, and use potions to fulfill objectives and cure animals. Strategic potion mixing and objective completion are key to becoming the most renowned ranger.

The player with the most points at the end of the game is crowned as the guardian of nature!

—description from the designer

name: Dragon Scrolls
description:
After centuries of slumber, dragons have awakened and returned to the realm.

Rival guilds now seek to reassemble the ancient dragon scrolls, legendary texts said to contain the long-lost secrets of taming these powerful beasts. With only partial sets in their possession and no way to succeed alone, guilds must exchange fragments to complete their scrolls and claim mastery.

Choose carefully. The right piece could bring you closer to control. The wrong one might lead your opponent astray… exactly as you intended.

In Dragon Scrolls, players compete over three rounds to build the most powerful scroll. At the start of each round, players are dealt a hand of three scroll fragments. All players simultaneously select one fragment to draft to their own scroll and one fragment to pass, face down, to both of their neighbors.

Finally, players must flip one of the fragments passed to them face up, choose to keep it, or push-their-luck and discard it to draft the remaining fragment!

—description from the designer

name: Loom
description:
In Loom, players take turns weaving vibrant threads into a growing fiber mosaic. By aligning and connecting different color swatches, players form patterns of Loops, Weaves, and Chains. The more intricate the pattern, the more points it earns.

Points are scored as patterns are completed, and the player with the highest score after all swatches have been placed is declared the Master Weaver.

name: UNSCREWED
description:
Due to dwindling ratings, the Blammo! Network can only afford to keep one of their notorious Saturday morning cartoons on the air, but they can't decide which!
​
​You control the misfit characters from these cartoons in a televised fight to the death, concocting schemes and watching them go hilariously wrong. You'll try to out-scheme each other, using game changing Quirks, and an arsenal of cartoon weaponry to attack each other and survive a map that's out to kill you - all to keep your show from being cancelled.

The last player standing wins!

name: Wizard Community College
publisher: Magical Meerkat Games; Moon Saga Workshop
description:
Wizard Community College is a card game with role-playing elements for 3-8 players that can be set up and taught in under 2 minutes.  Play as student wizards who are trying to work together to solve their college problems by casting spells they have little control over.

Players will take turns casting spells based on the spell cards in front of them by saying what they intend for their spell to do.  They then randomly draw a disc from a drawstring bag which will have a color and symbol on it.  The player matching the color of the disc will say what actually happens when the active player tried to cast their spell using the symbol on the disc as a guideline.  Most of the time, the spell will not go as planned and there will be a magical mishap!

Players win if they complete the objectives given on a Major Event cards within 2-3 rounds, but they will have created a fun story together whether the objectives were completed or not.

The standard game plays in 20 minutes and provides an exciting and complete story for the player characters.  For a deeper role-playing experience, there is also an epic game included that plays in 90-120 minutes.

—description from the publisher

name: Slay to Win
description:
Slay to Win is a fast-play  monster-hunting fantasy card game with a touch of light optional roleplaying.

In the game, you and your companions strike out to save your kingdom from the monsters who threaten its peoples. But...each of you also secretly wants to go down in history as the greatest monster hunter of all time. And that means you need to score the killing blows against the monsters to gain as many trophy points as possible.

At the end of the game (or a longer campaign of multiple games), whoever has the most trophy points becomes forever known as the greatest monster hunter who ever lived.

Team up, but also go it alone when needed, so you can Slay to Win!

—description from the designer

name: Unvention
description:
It is the turn of the 19th century, and the world is surging forward into the Second Industrial Revolution. Mechanization, electrification, and bold innovation are reshaping society at an unprecedented pace. Nations rally their greatest minds to craft inventions that will define the future. To celebrate this new age of discovery, the most prestigious International Invention Exhibition has been established—an extraordinary event where visionaries from around the world gather to showcase their ingenuity. Here, only the most daring ideas will earn their place in history. You have been invited to compete, and the prize is a future of your own design.

Unvention is a competitive roll-and-write game where players take part in a prestigious weekend-long invention competition. Over the course of three days —Friday through Sunday— players journal their designs, gather parts, and construct mechanisms to bring their most ambitious inventions to life. At the end of each day, players present their inventions to the judges. The earlier an invention is unveiled, the more impressive it is — but timing is everything. Will your designs capture the spotlight?

At its core, Unvention is a polyomino puzzle game, where players build the polyomino shapes themselves. There are three core game systems, all heavily interlocked towards a single goal of creating elaborate inventions:
1. Journals: Mini sudoku puzzles where players try to gather wrenches; the resource required to build mechanisms.
2. Workshops: Players gather parts here, and use wrenches to connect them together and build polyomino-shaped mechanisms.
3. Inventions: The polyomino shapes of mechanisms are used in invention patterns, giving players full control to puzzle them in for most victory points, with each invention’s unique scoring criteria.

name: UPPLES
description:
On planet U, there live some strange beings, called komupples, who love some very curious fruits called upples. These fruits have a shape similar to a square apple, of various colors, which grow from the earth, and in many cases have very peculiar effects on these beings. Have fun changing shape, jumping, eating dozens of delicious upples and being the most gluttonous.
Millions of possible configurations await you, where thanks to your intelligence and a pinch of luck, you will test whether you are the biggest upple eater.

Upples is an original strategy game, for 1 to 4 players. In which you will have to eat as many super upples as you can, while planning strategies, clever movements and fun combinations of jumps. At the same time, you compete with your friends and opponents for the most delicious upples.

The objective of the game is to eat as many super upples as you can while using the best strategy of jumps and card combinations, to be the player with the most super upple points.

Starting with the youngest person at the table and going counter-clockwise (only the first time, in subsequent games the first person must rotate). Each player has one turn, which can be extended as many times as they are able to eat or use super upples or special upples that allow an extra jump. The super upples obtained are kept by each player, and the rest of the tokens are returned to the top of the box, face up. And only if the box runs out of tokens, they will be available again, shuffling them and placing them face down beforehand.

In each valid jump, the player will “eat” the tokens on which they fall and remove them from the board (except for tunnels, or other players' character tokens).

At the end of each turn, each player is responsible for ensuring that there are no gaps left on the playing field behind them before the next player's turn begins. In other words, if the pieces are eaten or removed, they must be replaced by randomly drawing new pieces from the box at the end of each turn.

If a player is unable to make any moves in their current state, their turn ends and they are transformed into the opposite state. That is, if their state is shy (white komupple), they will become angry (red komupple with red hair), and if their current state is angry (red komupple), they will become shy (white komupple with white hair). If they are unable to make any moves in the next turn, even in this new character state, they will be swapped with the opposite card on the playing field (for example, if they were in a corner, they will be swapped with the card in the opposite corner, losing their turn again).

In GLUTTON MODE, the game ends when the cards in the box are finished and the last card is placed on the playing field. The person or team that has managed to eat the most super upples, taking into account their value, wins the game, adding up the total of their points.

There are 4 crazy game modes, it is designed for up to 4 players or teams, from 8 years old and up:

In training mode, you will have the opportunity to practice the best combination jumping strategies. Designed for a single player.

In glutton mode, with 2 to 4 players or teams, you will have to show who is the biggest upple eater on planet U.
In naughty mode, in addition to eating as many upples as you can, you can take some of the collected upples from other players by jumping over them.

In survival mode, you must collect as many upples as possible as quickly as possible, before a golden super upple is eaten, and the player with the fewest super upples on the table is eliminated.

—description from the publisher

name: Upshot: A Disc Golf Game
description:
Take your disc golf game to the table with Upshot: a Disc Golf Game! A game for 1-4 players to design their own elite courses and take them to the table. What courses can you create?

Utilize each part of the game box to design your own unique course. Send your discs flying toward the hole while avoiding obstacles and hazards along the way.  You can add more obstacles to the course by using household items.

Navigate around trees and fly over water traps in this tabletop disc golf game designed for the disc golf enthusiast. As in real life, the player with the lowest score wins.

—description from the designer

name: Urban Battle: Main Square
description:
Urban Battles is a game whose concept goes back to Panzer Strike: France 1940 and later Tank Chess. Each playing piece represents an individual tank or armored unit. Set up takes no more than 1-3 minutes and is scenario dependent.

Urban Battles is designed for two players. The goal of the game is determined by each Mission, provided in the Brochure. Each Mission has several game setups.

Three modes of play are offered for the gamers tastes:

     Basic Mode – a relaxed and fluid game with the influence of luck via dice
     Absolute Mode – no dice with a greater tactical and strategic feel to gameplay
     Realistic Mode – the game now drills down to realistic firing angles via more detailed lines of sight requiring a ruler or some type of straight edge.

name: Urban Operations: Second Edition
description:
Urban Operations: Second Edition is a game that simulates modern tactical combat in a range of historical and hypothetical urban settings. It uses unique mechanics for chain of command, logistical support, collateral damage and close-quarters combat resolution. Blocks for units and concealed (face-down) elements of the board capture the fog of war.

The game was initially developed as a training tool for France's National Centre of Excellence for Urban Warfare Training. It will appeal to anyone interested in learning and applying modern urban combat fighting techniques, and re-creating the action from the 16 scenarios in the game, including:


     Mogadishu (1993) - six scenarios of Western units battling Somali militia
     Fulda (1985) - six scenarios of a hypothetical WW3 battle between Soviet and NATO forces
     Other single scenario settings including USMC in Fallujah (2004), the British in Basra (2003), and the Russians in Groszy (1999).


The Second Edition has the following changes:

     New player aids
     Clarification of key rules and all errata incorporated into 


a new rulebook

     Updates to boards and maps to improve 3D effects and ease of line of sight assessments
     New advanced rules for Combined Combat actions
     Various other minor improvements to playability

name: Urban Sketchers
description:
From the streets of the world to your gaming table!
Urban Sketchers is a mid-weight eurogame where players travel the world, sketching iconic urban scenes, managing resources, and competing for prestige by publishing reports.

In Urban Sketchers, each player is an artist trying to create reports that will be published to earn money and prestige. The more money they earn, the more travel and resources they can afford to continue publishing sketch reports, earning the most prestige points and thus winning the game. 
In each round there is a shared dice roll, and each player takes turns choosing one die to perform an action: travel, obtain resources, buy cards, play cards (illustrations) in their sketchbook, or publish their sketchbook report.
When each player has chosen two of the dice, the first player is passed around clockwise and another roll is made. The game continues for an unspecified number of rounds and ends when a certain number of reports have been published, depending on the number of players.

Cities are your canvas. Resources, your tool. Do you have what it takes to become the best Urban Sketcher?

—description from the publisher

name: USC: Reach
description:
USC Reach is a competitive turn-based space journey game for 2 to 4 players, where you discover the marvels of the universe, rescue rookie space travelers, scavenge resources, and improve your Crew and ship, by using deck building, hand management, and variable phase order mechanics.

Your goal is to secure a safe landing on the new planet and collect the most points to win the game. To do that, gather your crew and allocate them strategically to your ship departments to overcome the challenges of space before others while keeping an eye on your landing requirements.

—description from the designer

name: Usolli: The Strategic Game About Salah
description:
Pronounced “oo-sol-lee”, Usolli thematically captures the experience of trying to do Salah (Islamic daily prayer) on time throughout the day. the game is built on the idea that passing on Islamic heritage and tradition can be a fun and engaging family experience. Usolli features beautiful hand-drawn art with minimal text to create an immersive playing experience. Created using modern board game design principles, Usolli creates pleasant memories associated with Salah and provides an opportunity for parents and educators to talk about the importance of this pillar of faith.

In Usolli, players take turns to one of the following:
- Either move to collect a card,
- Or discard cards to perform a Salah to get points. Praying on time and with Khusyu’ provides bonus points.
Watch out for Event cards that can help or hinder, and be mindful that the clock is always ticking! Just like in real life, you can't pray in advance, so aim to pray on time or make up for it if it's past the time.

To win, you strategically collect cards to perform the 5 daily Salah and obtain Hasanat (or points). The game ends when the Adhan tracker goes past Isha. Once the game ends, players add up their collected Hasanat. The player with the most Hasanat wins!

The default setup is simple with no downtime, perfect for beginner and younger players. An advanced mode offers more in-depth choices during your turn, suitable for older players or those more strategically-inclined. For example, Musafir cards that allow you to combine prayers, Sunnah prayer cards for bonus scoring, and special movement rules.

-description from designer

name: Vacations to Greek Islands
description:
Summer is here, so why not take a three-day trip to some of the most famous Greek islands? Explore, go hiking, admire the landscape and take photos, or simply rest and relax. Vacations to Greek Islands is a competitive roll and write, print and play game.

In Vacations to Greek Islands, players plan their route and visit different locations on a Greek island over the course of fourteen rounds. At each location, they can explore, hike, or admire the landscape. However, they only have three days to plan before their vacation ends, so they must choose their routes carefully to ensure they spend enough time at each location without sacrificing the opportunity to visit others. Of course, they can take pictures and rest to regain strength and plan a bigger route for the next day. Their goal is to have as much fun as possible and earn the most points by the end of the game.

The player with the most points at the end of the game wins and can boast about having the best vacation ever!

—description from the publisher

name: Valencia
description:
Valencia is a reimplementation of Strasbourg, which has been redeveloped & revised.  It now plays with 2 players, and will contain new game content.

Valencia retains the already streamlined gameplay, with the following improvements:

Modular gameboard allowing for variable setup.
Newly developed 2 player-variant
Completely new artwork by "The Mico"
10 new task cards
Updated round structure
5 new "Edifices", which will be fountains in Valencia

-description from publisher

name: Valheim: The Board Game
description:
Valheim is a co-operative board game in which survival depends on teamwork and strategy. Gather your fellow companions and venture forward to explore, build, collect resources, forge weapons, equip sturdy armor, battle enemies, and carve your path towards facing the ultimate evil. Take on a role in which you help tailor the adventure to your liking. The fate of everyone lies in your hands!

Your objective is to summon and defeat the Forsaken, but you will need to prepare before facing the challenge. To get ready, you’ll need to gather materials and craft gear, upgrade your house, and defend yourself against creatures while doing so.

Every session of Valheim is featured around a unique mission. Each features a map layout, a story introduction, a mission objective, and a few guidelines. To summon the Forsaken and progress to the endgame, you will need to complete the objective. If you fail to do so, you lose.

There is an option to play “campaign mode,” where you progress through a series of scenarios, or to design your own scenarios.

name: Gwent: The Legendary Card Game
publisher: No Loading Games; Broadway Toys LTD; CD Projekt RED; Geekach LLC; Gém Klub Kft.; Gen-X Games; MIPL; MNKY Entertainment; Pendragon Game Studio; Rebel Sp. z o.o.; Xzone
description:
Experience The Witcher universe in an entirely new way with Gwent: The Legendary Card Game. Inspired by the iconic mini-game from The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, this official physical edition brings the strategic, faction-based card game to your tabletop.

In Gwent, two players build decks from factions such as the Northern Realms, Scoia'tael, Monsters, Skellige, and Nilfgaard, each with its own unique set of cards and abilities.

The goal of the game is to win two out of three rounds. The battlefield features multiple rows to which players will deploy their units and special ability cards to battle it out. Players must skillfully bluff, manage their resources, and read their opponent's moves in order to wisely choose when to push aggressively to win a round — and when to hold back and play for the long game.

name: Valpiedra: Descensus ad tenebras
description:
Valpiedra is a cooperative adventure and tactical combat game set in a cursed village overrun by demonic creatures emerging from an infernal rift. From 1 to 4 players take on the role of heroes descending into the catacombs to retrieve a sacred relic and seal the portal to hell before the world is lost.

Throughout the game, the group will explore levels filled with enemies, make critical decisions, and carefully manage their health, equipment, and resources. Combat is resolved with dice and unique hero abilities, as players face creatures that evolve, summon reinforcements, or bend the rules of the game.

The goal: descend to the depths, recover the relic, and ascend before corruption or death consumes you.

Valpiedra offers constant tension and high replayability through creature cards, optional modes, and random events. Will you dare to go down… and return?

name: VANEA: Guardians of the Eldertree
description:
Welcome to VANEA. A mystical and fairytale world. This game takes place in the ElderForest. You are a Guardian of the ElderTree and must defend it against scary monsters, bosses and the spreading darkmoon rot. Explore the ElderForest. Collect 6 different elemental orbs to master all of these elementals. Find magical orbs to learn new abilities and collect ore to craft powerful and legendary equipment. It's all about LOOT guys!!! Hunt these monsters, let your monster farm grow and get your cute elemental companion.

Mechanics
Explore the ElderForest (every game you play you will build a different and random hex field map)
Collect more and more of the 6 different elemental spirits to master these 6 elements
Elemental battle system
Get your cute elemental companion
Find magical orbs to learn new abilities
Collect equipment pieces to create powerful and legendary equipment
ElderTree mode: Defend the AelderTree against all monsters and elemental bosses
Monster farm mode: Hunt monsters and let your monster farm grow
Defend your castle: Each Guardian must collect points and keep an eye on his own castle
Scenario "All vs All or Team vs Team": Each Guardian or team has its own task, and whoever completes it first wins
...and don't let the Loot Monster get away ;)
It's all about LOOT guys!!!

name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners – Hunted
description:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners - Hunted is a TIMER-BASED BOARD GAME where players take on the roles of EDGERUNNERS trying to escape while being chased by the Maelstrom gang, NCPD, and the notorious Adam Smasher.

It can be played solo or with up to four players COLLABORATIVELY.
This game emphasizes coordination, quick decision-making, and survival under pressure.

Players must EXPLORE Night City, BATTLE enemies, and PERFORM missions before finding the escape.
During the Edgerunners’ turn, players act in any order, perform actions and move on the map.
During the Enemy phase, enemies relentlessly pursue and attack the players.
 Successfully collect gigs and REACH THE EXTRACTION POINT before the timer runs out to claim victory in this adrenaline-pumping race against time.

—description from the publisher

name: Nature: Big Box Edition
publisher: North Star Games, LLC; Yaofish Games
description:
Nature is a streamlined, deeper, and more forgiving redesign of the blockbuster Evolution, built from the ground up to be seamlessly expandable. Its core innovation is a modular system that lets players create and explore a different ecosystem every time they play.

To showcase this modularity, Nature was first released on Kickstarter as the Nature Big Box edition. Nature Big Box includes the core game, the first five modules, and one mini-module.

Adapt to a Changing Environment:
In Nature, players compete to grow thriving populations in an ecosystem where food is scarce and predators are ever-present. Evolve traits such as Fast to escape danger, Climbing to reach fruit high in the canopy, or Pack Hunting to bring down larger prey.

Create a Unique Ecosystem Every Game:
Nature core is an accessible gateway into a world of dynamic ecosystems. Despite its strategic depth, Nature can be taught and played with casual gamers in under an hour. Experienced players can customize each session using modules that dramatically change the ecosystem. Add Nature: Flight for people who prefer to avoid conflict, Nature: Jurassic for a more aggressive game, or Nature: Arctic Tundra for a survival game on the edge of the livable world.

With five modules and two mini-modules, Nature currently offers 96 possible ecosystem combinations. Following the 2026 release of the Climate module and two additional mini-modules, players will be able to explore over 700 unique ecosystems.

How to Play:
Nature is a card-driven tableau builder played over four rounds (five rounds when using one or more modules). Each round is divided into two phases: the Adapting Phase and the Feeding Phase.

Adapting Phase:
Use five cards as actions to:
 - Increase Population
 - Increase Body Size
 - Play Traits to evolve your species
 - Save cards for use as food during the Feeding Phase

Feeding Phase:
Feed as much of your population as possible. At the end of each round, players score 1 point for every population they keep alive. The winner is the player who sustains the most population across the game.


Nature Digital: Learn to play with an interactive tutorial on the free-to-try Nature app (iOS, Android, and Steam).
https://www.naturedigitalgame.com/


A Living Game System:
NorthStar Studio will release the Climate module in 2026, followed by one to two new modules per year for the next decade.
Vote for future modules here:
https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/308/blogpost/166360/future-nature-modules-poll


Designer Diary
Dominic Crapuchettes discusses the inspiration behind Nature, which began during his time as a professional Magic player.
https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/1/blogpost/179068/designer-diary-the-evolution-of-nature

name: Veggie Match
description:
War has been declared between your fields and those of your neighbors!

Each turn, play a plant card on your field... or on the fields of your opponents and try to align 3 identical plants!

Everyone then harvests the plants on their fields, even if they are rotten!

The farmer with the most points at the end of the game is declared the winner!

Each person's crops yield varying amounts of points. Take advantage of the various free plots of land to plant vegetables and harvest the crops that are on your land.

Grow plants with few points on your opponents' land and hope to win the most fruitful crops.

—description from the publisher

name: Veggie Patch
description:
Veggie Patch is a  quick solitaire, dice rolling, tile laying, dice placement game.

Roll dice to get your seeds. Play cards to create vegetable beds in your garden and place the dice in them to sow the seeds.

Decide which dice to place where in order to maximise your harvest.

Use your watering can, garden fork and a friendly crow wisely to help you grow enough veggies to win the game.

—description from the designer

Veggie Patch was an entry in the 2025 9-Card Nanogame Print and Play Design Contest where it was voted 2nd Best Solitaire Game and 3rd Best Overall Game.

name: Velmohra: Im Bann der Tiefe
description:
In this Write and Move adventure, starting from the centre of your playmat you connect hexagonal spaces, forming shapes.
Every space depicts a number indicating how many sectors your diver moves clockwise. 
Upon arrival, your diver collects the top pearl tile if you have formed its depicted shape on your playmat. Then you shade this shape as it can only be used to collect one pearl.
Pearls are a lucrative source of points.

Many spaces on your playmat award you with small discoveries such as shells, corals or crabs. These earn you points at the end of the game – if your route passes through upgrade spaces you increase the value of these discoveries. 
Special rewards are waiting to be discovered in the four corners of your playmat.
Have you spotted the sea monster on your route? The more sightings of it you have, the more points you get.
The game ends as soon as one of you has discovered three corner space rewards or has four sea monster sightings, or when a stack of pearls is empty and one of you has discovered two corner space rewards.
The player whose undersea adventure has earned the most points wins the game.

In diesem Write and Move Abenteuer verbindest du ausgehend von der Mitte auf deinem Spielplan im Laufe des Spiels Felder, um Formen zu bilden. 
Jedes Feld gibt an, wie viele Sektoren dein Taucher im Uhrzeigersinn zurücklegt. Im Zielsektor sammelt dieser das oberste Perlenplättchen ein, wenn du die darauf abgebildete Form auf deinem Spielplan vorweisen kannst. Diese Form schraffierst du, da du jede nur einmal für eine Perle verwenden kannst. Perlen sind eine lukrative Punktequelle.
Viele Felder auf deinem Spielplan bringen dir kleine Entdeckungen wie Muscheln, Korallen oder Krabben. Diese bringen dir am Spielende Punkte – führt deine Route über Upgradefelder, erhöhst du den Wert einer dieser Entdeckungen.

Besondere Belohnungen wollen in den vier Ecken deines Spielplans entdeckt werden.

Hast du das Seeungeheuer auf deiner Route gesichtet? Je mehr Sichtungen, desto mehr Punkte bekommst du dafür.
Das Spiel endet, sobald jemand von Euch drei Eckfeldbelohnungen entdeckt hat oder vier Seeungeheuersichtungen vorweisen kann oder ein Perlenstapel leer ist und jemand von Euch zwei Eckfeldbelohnungen entdeckt hat.
Wessen Unterseeabenteuer mehr Punkte ergeben hat, gewinnt das Spiel.

name: Vendée 93
description:
At the beginning of 1793, after the execution of King Louis XVI, France was drawn into a war against a coalition of most European monarchies. On 24 February, the National Convention decreed the mass draft of 300,000 men to defend the eastern borders. Throughout the country, revolts broke out against this conscription, everywhere they were brutally repressed with success. However, an insurgent territory, called the "Vendée Militaire" resisted. Determined to engage in a trial of strength with the new revolutionary regime, the Vendéens gradually organised themselves until they formed a "Catholic and Royal Army".

Vendée 93, a card driven two player wargame, takes you back to this particularly epic period in the French history, which pitted the young French Republic against the Royalist insurgents from March to October 1793.

"White" or "Blue", choose your cause and take command of your troops!
"White": you will have to take the advantage quickly at the risk of seeing the Republican forces inexorably strengthen, forcing you into a sinister "Virée de Galerne".
"Blues": time is on your side, resist the first assaults of the "brigands" to then be able to face the hell of the bocage in order to definitively extinguish the insurrection.

—description from the publisher

name: Veneficus: The Secret Game of Psychics
description:
Veneficus: The Secret Game of Psychics is a game full of introspect, trust, and deceit where each player takes on the role of a psychic trying to prove they are the greatest of them all.

Each turn, one psychic will become the sitter for a reading about their life, but only they know they are the sitter for that turn. A Card of Truth will be revealed that says something about the sitter's life - possibly their past, present, or future. The card will have two choices for the psychics to choose from while making their blind reading of the sitter. The sitter will secretly choose the option that they know to be their truth. Meanwhile, all other psychics will select the option they feel gives them the best chance to match the sitter. Once everyone has selected one of the options, the sitter will reveal themselves along with their truth. Now it is up to the psychics to convince the sitter they correctly predicted their choice and made the proper reading. The sitter will then choose one of the psychics they trust and that psychic will reveal their reading.

In early rounds, psychics will likely choose the option they feel a majority of players would select in order to give themselves the best chance of matching the sitter's answer. As the game progresses, there will be fewer possible sitters available which allows the psychics to make more informed selections for each reading.

If the reading was correct, the sitter and all of the psychics who made the correct reading will earn a Clairvoyance Card. If the psychic deceived the sitter and did not make the correct reading, then this psychic and all others who had the incorrect reading will earn a Clairvoyance Card instead. Additionally, the psychic who deceived the sitter will earn the Veneficus Token which is worth bonus points at the end of the game. This token can be stolen each time a psychic deceives a sitter.

Once all psychics have been the sitter once or twice depending on the amount of players, the game will end and the psychic with the most clairvoyance cards has proven to be the most powerful in the world.

—description from the publisher

name: Fair Trade Souvenirs
description:
You have traveled to the Fair Trade Town of Kamakura! As your train home rapidly approaches, you must hurry and buy souvenirs. You want to buy sets of 3, but whenever you spot a Fairtrade product, you can't resist picking it up! Along the way, kids, cats, and all kinds of unexpected trouble arises... In this traditional-style board game, made with environmentally friendly paper, you can also learn about Fairtrade.

Fairtrade Souvenirs is an adaptation of Oink Games' 2024 release, Souvenirs from Venice. Roll the dice and move your piece while searching for souvenirs. Your goal is to collect 3 of the same souvenir (from 6 different types) before all of the tiles have been flipped over.

Up to here, it's the same as "Souvenirs from Venice, but in Fairtrade Souvenirs special souvenirs with the Fairtrade Mark*¹ have been added. These special souvenirs cost 2 coins to purchase, but if one is included in a set of 3 matching souvenirs, you earn bonus points. You might be collecting a different type of souvenir, but then come across a souvenir with Fairtrade Mark and want to buy it. Or you might notice when another player secretly buys something for 2 coins. This brings a new layer of fun to the game.


    1 Products that meet standards such as fair payment to manufacturers and protection of working conditions carry The FAIRTRADE Mark.

name: Order Overload: Oink Games
description:
Order Overload: Oink Games is a cooperative memory game where players work together to fulfill customer orders.

In this SPIEL 2025 promo version, the game features multilingual cards in German, English, and Japanese, and replaces café items with titles from Oink Games' portfolio. Players must remember which items are in others' hands and call them out to complete orders. The game progresses through levels, each increasing in difficulty, and is lost if all players are eliminated before completing the final level.

•••

Order Overload: Oink Games ist ein kooperatives Gedächtnisspiel, bei dem die Spieler gemeinsam Kundenbestellungen erfüllen. In dieser SPIEL 2025 Promo-Version enthält das Spiel mehrsprachige Karten in Deutsch, Englisch und Japanisch und ersetzt Café-Artikel durch Titel aus dem Portfolio von Oink Games. Die Spieler müssen sich merken, welche Artikel sich in den Händen der anderen befinden, und diese nennen, um Bestellungen abzuschließen. Das Spiel verläuft in Levels, die jeweils an Schwierigkeit zunehmen, und wird verloren, wenn alle Spieler eliminiert werden, bevor das letzte Level abgeschlossen ist.

name: Verdant Arizona
description:
A Mint Tin game that has you competing to collect cacti and organize them in your cactus garden.

The fun of this cut-throat puzzley game is the card selection mechanism which not only sets you up for the card you want, but determines which cards are in reach for your opponent.

—description from the publisher

name: Verdun
publisher: Dragon Dawn Productions; Dragon Dawn Games
description:
Verdun is a 1v1 and 2v2 partnership card game revisiting the German and French armies fighting in the World War I battlefields of Verdun. As their hands dwindle, players will also have to play cards that help the other side, timing  it strategically to minimize their own casualties. The teams alternate being the Attacker, mirroring the back-and-forth nature of the Verdun battles, bringing costly decision-making to the table. Every card played has consequences, and every round is a tension-filled challenge.

A game of Verdun consists of 1 to 3 Rounds. Before the first Round, each team secretly organizes one of their Assets behind each or their five Fortifications. Then each player receives a hand of 12 cards, which they then play in a series of 12 tricks.

In each trick, each team tries to minimize Casualties on their side while protecting their Assets and Fortifications. A team scores points for Overrunning the opponent’s fortifications and capturing their Assets and for protecting their own Fortifications and Assets. And each team loses points for their Casualties. After three Rounds, the team with the most points (or whose score is the least negative) wins.

name: Verso
description:
Flip your cards in Verso to uncover vibrant landscapes of land, sea, or sky while trying to create sequences and form squares.

To set up, create a deck with 15 cards per player. Each card is double-sided, with a color (blue, green, or orange), a value (1–6 or a joker), and victory points (1 or 3) on one side; the reverse side will have a different color, the other VP value, and an adjacent number (4 or 6 if the front side is a 5) or a joker.

On a turn, either draw a card or bank a sequence. If you draw, take the top card of the deck and either keep it without looking at the back or flip it; add it to your display, keeping each color in its own row. If you would place a card identical to what you already have, discard it instead.

If you have 2-6 cards in sequence in a single color, you can bank them. Take VP tokens from the reserve equal to the sum of the VP on the sequenced cards, then discard the two highest cards in your sequence. Each neighboring player must flip their highest non-joker card in this same color, discarding it if it matches a card they already have and otherwise placing it in the correct row.

If you ever have a 3x3 square of cards — that is, three cards in each of the three colors — you score 7 VP, regardless of whose turn it is. You must bank a sequence before you can score a square again.

When the deck runs out, each player banks one sequence (without causing their neighbors to flip anything), then the player with the most points wins.

You can also play Verso solo, alternating turns with a simulated opponent that may flip one of your highest cards to a different color. Try to top the designers' top score of 64.

name: Vesta
description:
It is the year 2049 and mankind has reached the point where space travel to the moon and Mars is commonplace.  The next frontier is the asteroid belt.  Enter Vesta, one of the largest asteroids in the main asteroid belt, and surveys show it is loaded with Helium-3 (valuable as fuel for the latest fusion reactors) and various valuable rare-earth minerals. So, like the 1849 California gold rush, the rush is on to mine these valuable resources from Vesta.

Vesta is a cooperative game where players will work together to mine resources from one of several available mines and use them to build their base, use in their fusion reactors, or sell.  The mines consist of layers of tiles representing five different types of resources.  Players mine these minerals by removing pairs of matching tiles, except when using mining tools that allow them to break the normal mining rules.  Then regolith, rock, or metals are used to build up their bases and Helium-3 is used in your reactors for energy.  Building bases involves stacking tiles from the mine. Each type of material has special rules for how they can be stacked or flipped in your base. But watch out because there are asteroid pirates hidden in the mine who also want the valuable minerals, and they will attack you and cause damage to your base when revealed.  You can fight them off if you spend some of your earnings on weapons or force fields.

Players also get to play as characters who each have special abilities such as Gunther Hammer a mining specialist or Biff Parsec, a Space Ranger who is very handy at fighting off pirates.

To win, the players must build ten fusion reactors.  The players will lose if the mine becomes depleted or locked up where the players don't have the mining tools to break things loose.  The players can also lose if they build their base poorly and can't build anymore or if the pirates do too much damage to their bases.

-description from designer

name: Vicious Gardens
description:
Vicious Gardens is a card game that combines the joy of gardening with the thrill of being a total jerk. Strategically cultivate your garden, harvest plants, and sabotage others in a competition to become the Official Master Gardener.

In Vicious Gardens you grow a garden of mischief by placing plant cards in front of you into different plots. While these plants are worth points, you must decide the opportune time to harvest them for Victory Cards and gain more abilities to help your garden.

Of course, there is the option to sabotage your opponents by using Specialists. These take up space in your hand and often come at a price, so you'll need to balance your hand accordingly.

Vicious Gardens is quick to learn, easy to play, and has a satisfying balance of strategy and luck. The last round can be filled with dramatic point swings as gardeners contend for victory. Gameplay is kept fresh through varying abilities each play through and the team-play option for 4 or 6 players.

—description from the publisher

name: Victory Lane: A Thunder Rolls Card Game
description:
Victory Lane: A Thunder Rolls card game is a fast and fun stock car racing game by Richard Launius. The game uses a card driven system similar to Thunder Rolls in a compact and faster package.

Victory Lane emphasizes fast-paced action, meaningful decisions, and a smaller play area, making it accessible and engaging for both casual and experienced players. ​ Looking for a high-octane racing experience with streamlined rules and dynamic gameplay? Victory Lane is the one for you!

—description from the publisher

Sadly, the Kickstarter campaign limited fulfilment to the US. The project was cancelled on 2026-02-08. Message by the designer:

[...] I had hoped that the thematic strength and quality game play would be something that gamers were seeking, and maybe that would be the case if we had done more advertising, or if it was just published and distributed. This is one of my favorite designs, and a passion project for me and a game that I will always enjoy, but it is just not funding.  Therefore, we are ending the campaign and, at present there is no plan to bring it back to crowd funding. [...]

name: Vigilante: Story Mode
description:
In Story Mode, you and your friends each lead a team of heroes in an ever-changing campaign to rid the city of crime.

You will start off as agents working together in this 10-chapter campaign. Each chapter brings fun new twists, as you recruit new heroes and find useful equipment to bring from chapter to chapter.

In Chapter 1, The Agency is putting you to the test. Choose your weapon and work with your fellow agents as you combat mechanical foes.

In Chapter 2, take to the streets to take down Dino Gambino and his criminal empire. Meet new heroes, find useful gadgets, and save those in need - how you win is just as important as winning!

Vigilante: Story Mode is a standalone cooperative campaign that is compatible with Vigilante, featuring hundreds of new cards and other content to enhance your game.

-description from designer

name: Vikings: Ascent
description:
King Ragnar Lothbrok is dead! He is survived by his sons, each with competing claims to the throne. In Vikings: Ascent the enemy in front of you is less of a threat than the friend at your back.

On a player's turn they move through the following three phases:
1) Draw: draw up to 8 cards.
2) Recruit: recruit freemen (including: warriors, farmsteaders, and skalds) to their house.
3) Fate: take actions by exerting their freemen and/or playing cards from their hand to increase their bid for the throne.
The game ends when a player attains 100 Fate points (victory points)

A player increases (or decreases) fate points during the fate phases of each players' turn. The first to ascend the Wheel of Fate and attains 100 fate points wins the game.

name: Vikings: Become the Legend
description:
The Vikings, Become the Legend core game is a competitive solo to two player wealth building game. Each game turn clans competing to settle, develop their settlements and earn resources.

A key part of the game is planning and then successfully executing your actions. You decide when to build and what to build from warriors to ships and settlement structures.  You decide where to send your Raiding or Long Ships and when & how to “Trade”, “Raid & Pillage” or “Raid & Settle” with each of these ships and their warriors.  The opposing clans may also be your targets from time to time. But, use this option with caution, a blood feud does neither clan much good.

Battles are fought using the Battle Board.  Raid Cards and the Attacking and Defending forces.  Are placed on the board and the number of attacking rounds determined.  Raid cards are simultaneously declared for the battle then unique battle dice are rolled to determine casualties.  Shields defend, archers are resolved followed by berserkers (double axes) and then single axe-men.

As a solitaire war game, the game system "A.I." called “Automa” handles an enemy clan which may thwart or interfere with your mission plans. You will have to respond to the unexpected events and resistance within your new settlements. When you incorporate one or more expansions you may choose to have more than one Automa opponent and or multiple live opponents.

The game ends when one player has 15 Silver on the Silver Tracker and has in play three settlements, one with a Market, one with a Ring Fort and one with a Mead Hall.  Clan leaders then score their achievements with the high point total winning the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Village Pillage: Big Box
description:
The Village Pillage Big Box comes with every Village Pillage card ever printed and can hold them all (sleeved) in a new box.

Includes:

     Surf and Turf Expansions
     Robbin Hood Expansion
     Dark Arts and Crafts Expansion
     All Promo Cards and Tokens


Not content to just be a complete version of Village Pillage and a supremely efficient storage solution, the Village Pillage Big Box also comes with three exclusive mini-expansions of its own.


     The Festivals Expansion adds new jumbo custom wooden meeples that move around the board and power up villagers with new powers and interactions.
     The Cultists Expansion infiltrates Village Pillage with new cultist cards, each with strange new powers. The more cultists played in a round, the more powerful they grow...but when they're played directly against one another, strange things occur.
     The Feelings Expansion finally allows villagers to feel feelings. Each player draws a Feeling card at the start of the game to give them a unique play style.


—description from the publisher

name: Vineyard: A Winemaking Game
description:
Welcome to wine country! Vineyard: A Winemaking Game is a 1-4 player game about making wine in a delightful, sun-washed valley. Move workers through the winemaking steps and choose your upgrades. Become a specialist, find the perfect moments to benefit from the activities around the vineyard, and enjoy a streamlined experience of crafting wine!

Set out on a winemaking journey to create sumptuous wine! Choose how to leave your impression by playing action cards, collectively moving workers to locations around the vineyard, and deciding your unique upgrade path. Will you push your luck to get more done, or focus on building up improvements?


     Shared Worker Placement allows all players to move every worker, setting up future actions and benefits to try to take at the best time.
     Quick, Engaging Turns keep gameplay moving for everyone with open information as you maximize your important role in the winemaking process.
     Unique Location Actions provide ways to gain advantages and leverage other players' decisions or use clever tactics to temporarily block workers.
     Ongoing Upgrade Choices give you ways to upgrade-as-you-go with unique specialties and improvements to build your own path to victory.


What is Shared Worker Placement? All players at the table are able to play action cards to move the workers around the vineyard. You do not play a specific character, but choose how to best guide all of the workers! There may be turns when you set up an excellent upcoming action... But will you be the first to take advantage of it? Keep an eye on your fellow players and find the best moment to showcase your winemaking expertise!

-description from publisher

name: Virtus!
description:
“Fatti non foste a viver come bruti, ma per seguir virtute e canoscenza.”
Dante Alighieri - Canto XXVI verse 119 of Inferno

"You were not made to live like brutes, but to follow virtue and knowledge."

Throughout history, thinkers and philosophers have sought the path to a balanced and enlightened life, exploring human potential through the Seven Virtues—Charity, Faith, Hope, Courage, Justice, Temperance, and Prudence. These ideals are more than abstract principles; they are forces in constant struggle, shaping those who dare to master them.

Virtus is a game of strategic mastery, where players compete to control these Virtues, gaining power and recognition. By securing majorities in specific Virtues, players unlock powerful effects and earn points, but the path to victory requires careful planning and tactical decisions.

Each turn, players select cards that represent different Virtues, striving to embody them more fully than their rivals. The player with the most influence over a Virtue gains its unique ability and high-value rewards, while others must adapt their strategy to stay competitive. With set collection, majority control, and variable powers, Virtus offers fast-paced yet deeply tactical gameplay.

Designed for 2-7 players, Virtus is easy to learn but rich in strategic depth. Whether you seek a quick, engaging filler or a deeper battle of wits, every match is a test of wisdom and foresight. Will you rise above your opponents and prove your Virtue?

name: Visit Porto
description:
In Visit Porto, you play the role of a tourist exploring the city of Porto. The aim of the game is to plan a sightseeing route as efficiently as possible, selecting and including different tourist attractions. When it is your turn, you can either carry out one of the actions on the board or take a break and skip your turn.
VisitPorto is played over as many rounds as it takes for one player to successfully complete 5 routes.

The game Visit Porto was commissioned by Porto's City Hall and will have a minimal distribution on the market.

—description from the designer

name: Viva Catrina
description:
Immerse yourself in the festive and colorful atmosphere of Mexico's Día de los Muertos, where traditions, joyful spirits, and fantastical creatures come together to honor the departed under the watchful eye of La Catrina.

Viva Catrina offers a strategic tile-laying experience in which each tile you place shapes the growth of your village. Each turn, you'll carefully choose from the available tiles, create paths to connect butterflies and visitors, build pedestals to attract chimeras, and launch balloon flights to maximize your points.

Efficiently constructing a connected network is key: a poorly placed tile could block your paths or make your objectives unreachable. Racing for chimeras and balloon tiles adds a light, but constant tension. The game flows smoothly, and the real satisfaction comes from watching your village expand and come to life throughout the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Voice of the Woods
description:
An experienced druid can command animals and hear the voices of natural phenomena. However, mastering the language of plants, understanding what an ancient oak says or what an ash tree asks, is not a simple task. Only the High Druid can achieve this skill. In Voice of the Woods, you will compete with other players for this title.

Voice of the Woods combines area majority with a word puzzle. Players put on the table tree cards with letters. Each turn, opponents place their action cube on the letters to form a word, which they write down on the player sheet. Players then count cubes on the letters and claim the tree cards they captured that turn. Then new letters are added to the table. The player with the most tree cards at the end of the game wins and becomes the High Druid!

—description from the publisher

name: Petiquette
description:
Humans are curious creatures. Even when cards are randomly lined up, we can't help but find patterns...and ideally we're thinking along the same lines.

Each round in Petiquette, players look at a line-up of five random cards — with cards showing one of three animals that is wearing one of three hats, with a number from 1-5 at top — and try to find some logic or pattern within them. Each player secretly chooses the card they think would most properly fit into that pattern. For example, if the sequence is "red, red, yellow...", you might feel that yellow should come next. If it's "dog, cat, bird...", then maybe dog feels right...but what about "dog, cat, dog, cat, bird"? No single answer is correct, but if someone chooses the same card as you, you both earn points.

Petiquette can be played either competitively or co-operatively.

name: VoidRoll: A Year-Long Voyage
description:
VoidRoll is a medium-weight solo sci-fi strategy game about commanding a starship and managing complex systems. Designed to hit a strategic sweet spot, it evolves the accessible dice placement of Roll4Rum with the combo-heavy engine building of Fleet: The Dice Game and the interconnected depth of Hadrian’s Wall—all without the spreadsheet fatigue.

—description from the designer

name: Volle Kanne!
description:
In Volle Kanne!, each player wants to water the plants in their personal garden as well as possible.

Each player has a water die that they roll each turn, with a separate die being passed from player to player so that someone always rolls two dice on a turn.

Most flowers on your garden sheet want a precise amount of water, and you score should you succeed, whereas the lucky clover will take as much water as you give it and the cacti wants as little water as possible. Complete all the requirements in a particular area to gain bonuses.

Two different garden sheets are included.

name: Vomitland
description:
Vomitland is a board game that has players pushing their luck (and stomachs) as they whirl through roller coaster maneuvers trying to accumulate emotions and experiences without throwing up!

Use every opportunity available at the amusement park to have the most extreme day of your life, and of course, make your friends squirt vomit out of their nostrils!

Vomitland is a push your luck game for 3 to 6 player. Player will choose which place of the theme part to go. When going into the roller coaster, the main attraction of the game, they will open maneuver cards that award emotion symbols used either to complete objectives or make the player vomit. Once all objectives seleceted at the start of the game are completed, the game ends and the player with more victory points is the winner.

name: Vroom Vroom Quokka
description:
A group of quokkas boards a bus in search of the perfect new home. Each round, they secretly slip tickets into their wallets, hoping to grab the ideal nest - but only those with the best timing and the boldest guesses will come out on top. Can you outwit the others and become the happiest quokka?

Vroom Vroom Quokka is a trick-taking game where players use partially hidden ticket cards and try to outguess each other's choices. Each turn, a player inserts a ticket card into their wallet so only half is visible, then players take turns doing the same. When revealed, the ticket's effect activates, and the highest-numbered ticket matching the destination color wins the trick. Reading opponents, timing reveals, and managing hidden information are the key to winning the most tickets.

name: Pick 'n Packers
description:
Pick 'n Packers is a balance game where two players work together to carry a drone stacked with presents. Each player uses only one finger to pinch and lift a wooden drone piece. Even the slightest difference in finger pressure causes the drone, and the presents on top, to shake, sparking excitement at the table!

Staying calm and moving in sync is the key, but the drone never quite behaves as you expect, which often leads to hilarious moments of laughter.

Meanwhile, the other players aren’t just watching. They’re guessing how far the drone will make it, cheering on the carriers, or playfully trying to make them laugh and throw off their balance!

Whether you’re refining your teamwork, encouraging or heckling your friends, steadying your nerves to stay focused, or just bursting into laughter as the presents topple off, the whole experience is packed with fun.

—description from the publisher

name: Walking in Osaka
description:
Transcending the barriers of time and space, traveler Fanny finds herself in medieval Osaka. It is 1620, and the Tokugawa shogunate is rebuilding the castle fortifications. As she strolls through the bustling city streets, Fanny immerses herself in the unique atmosphere of the castle town. She discovers how the different districts supported one another in ancient times and creates a vivid panorama for her photobook.

Walking in Osaka is a card drafting and tableau-building game. Draft town cards, layer buildings, and explore strategic scoring opportunities across beautifully themed districts, as you recreate the interconnected prosperity of a historical Japanese city.

—description from the publisher

name: Wally Drag Racing
description:
Wallace Gordon Parks (January 23, 1913 – September 28, 2007) was the founder, president, and chairman of the National Hot Rod Association, better known as the NHRA. He was instrumental in establishing drag racing as a legitimate amateur and professional motorsport. In 1951, he founded the National Hot Rod Association, which stands today as the largest motorsports sanctioning body in the world. The winners of National Hot Rod Association national events are awarded a trophy statue nicknamed the Wally. Wally Drag Racing is a tribute to Mr. Parks for establishing this awesome sport of drag racing, and is a fun and exciting easy to play solo dice game replaying seasons.

—description from the publisher

name: Tropichaos
description:
Tropichaos is a game about collecting and selling fruit in a world where the seasons are out of control, with winter being completely absent and the other seasons coming and going at random. Players take on the role of fruit sellers and try to get points by selling fruits at the right time during their peak season. The player who earns the most points wins.

During a player's turn, they may do either of the following actions:
- Buy fruits. To do so, they pick up a fruit chip from among the three revealed fruit chips to add to their inventory, then replenish it by drawing a chip from a bag.
If this results in three chips of the same fruit being displayed in the market, they must replace one of them with a different fruit from their inventory and also as punishment take a deduction chip.
If a season chip is drawn, the season marker on the season board progresses by 1, then the turn player draws another chip from the bag.

- Sell fruits. To do so, they place all fruit chips they wish to sell in front of the colored area of their chip holder corresponding to the current season. The number of chips in their inventory determines how many fruits they may sell.
If the number is uneven, they must sell all fruit chips.
If the number is even, they may choose to sell either all or half of their fruit chips.

If a player has five chips, they must choose to sell and cannot choose to buy.

The game ends when the season marker reaches the last spot on the season board. Then points are calculated: each fruit gives different amounts of points depending on the season it was sold in. The player with the most points wins!

—description from the publisher

name: War and Peace: 7th Edition
description:
Mark G. McLaughlin's classic game on Napoleonic conquest is here. Revitalized and enhanced with completely updated graphics and production, all new campaigns covering all of Napoleon's career, and a completely revamped rulebook that incorporates all known errata, and the best official variants and optional rules, along with a few new surprises.

From the rainy opening months of 1796 through the climactic summer of 1815, the entire decades-long conflict between France, England, Austria, Prussia, Russia, and Spain is recreated in 13 separate scenarios.

Each historical scenario is presented as a separate two-player game with an average playing time of 2–3 hours.

Also included is the grand campaign game that covers the 10-year conflict of empires from 1805 to 1815.

—description from the publisher

name: War in the Pacific: A WW2 Roll & Write Game
description:
The year is 1942. Japan has rapidly expanded across the Pacific, bombing Pearl Harbor, capturing key territories, and threatening to dominate Asia. The United States, determined to halt this advance, begins a daring island-hopping campaign to weaken Japan’s hold and force their surrender. Can you lead the American forces to victory, or will the Japanese resistance force the United States to a negotiated settlement?

In War in the Pacific, you'll allocate limited resources to launch attacks, conduct strategic bombing, maintain supply lines, and seize key islands. Your strategy must be swift and decisive, targeting objectives like Guadalcanal, Iwo Jima, and Okinawa.  As the war intensifies, you can divert critical resources to the 
Manhattan Project, researching and developing nuclear weapons. The race to build atomic bombs could be the key to ending the war. Can you balance the demands of the Manhattan Project with the immediate needs of your campaign?

Once you've gained a foothold, you’ll face a crucial choice: invade mainland Japan in a costly land assault, or use strategic bombing and nuclear weapons to force Japan’s surrender. Each option is risky as an invasion could end the war quickly, but at great cost, while bombing and nukes may hasten Japan’s 
surrender, but could come too late.

With fast-paced dice allocation, resource management, and mounting pressure, every decision could mean the difference between victory or failure in your quest to force Japan’s capitulation.

—description from the publisher

name: Warfig
description:
Warfig is a new fresh table top war game with a focus on quick deployable tiles combined with customistable cards!

Warfig is targetted at games who enjoy warfare and strategy and who like to flexibility of customising their armies with different weapons, spells and commands

Simple ruleset with the complexity at the card level

Warfig is focused on being the game for everyone

Warfig, built by Wargamers by Wargamers

name: Warfront
description:
A classic fantasy wargame… in your pocket!
Warfront is a 2D wargame designed to be fast and played on the go!
Your typical 3D models associated with well known fantasy wargames are reimagined as 2D unit cards within a standard sized deck of cards.
Deploy, move and activate these unit cards across a war torn fantasy battlefield.
The perfect introduction to wargaming and the perfect light distraction for veteran players. All the essential elements of wargaming distilled into a punchy and engaging package.

In Warfront, take command of the righteous Zenith Guard to protect the kingdom or lay waste to the land as the Corrupted Legions led by Belzen the Corruptor.
These two factions, and all future expansions, are designed as a reimagining and homage to classic, beloved fantasy tropes.

Warfront is going to particularly appeal to:

     Gamers new to wargames wanting to play and enjoy the genre without the usual enormous barriers to entry.
     Gamers looking to be able to play fantasy wargames on the go, on holiday, during their lunchbreak etc without carting around their delicate models.
     Gamers looking to introduce fantasy wargaming to their friends and relatives without scaring them away!
     Any gamer looking to enjoy a fun, fast-paced and thematic board game!


—description from the publisher

name: Wriggle Roulette
description:
In Wriggle Roulette, players take turns reaching into a bag filled with eel- and snake-shaped wooden pieces, trying to pull out as many eels as possible — but if the number of snakes grabbed by all players exceeds the limit, a "snake outbreak" occurs, and the player who grabbed the most pieces loses all of their eels.

You want to grab more than everyone else to score big, yet a snake outbreak would be devastating. Will you grab a bunch? Just a few? Or back out entirely? Read your opponents' expressions and control your own greed to make the right call.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Onslaught
description:
Desperate battle in the far future.

Set in the grim darkness of the far future, Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Onslaught is a tense, tactical board game based on the smash hit series of video games. Take control of an elite force of Blood Ravens Space Marines and fend off waves of Orks with blade and bolter. If you love the video games, this is a great way to take the action from the screen to the tabletop. Play solo, or grab up to three of your friends, choose your heroes, and work together to defend Humanity against seemingly endless alien hordes.

Cooperative, tactical board game for one to four players


     Nine highly detailed plastic miniatures which can be assembled without glue
     Fast-paced strategic gameplay, challenging combat, and objective control
     Includes everything you need to play – including game board, dice, cards, and tokens
     36-page booklet includes game rules, and model assembly guides


—description from the publisher

name: Warhammer Quest: Darkwater
description:
It’s time to take up your sword, unite with your friends, and battle against the foul forces of Nurgle, the Plague God, in Warhammer Quest: Darkwater, an all new co-operative dungeon crawler for one to four players set in the Mortal Realms.

Deep within the verdant wilds of Ghyran something evil is festering – the Daemon Prince Gelgus Pust, the Prince of Sores, has laid claim to the ruins of the Jade Abbey, within which lies the source of the Everspring – a bounteous well of life energy linked to Alarielle the Everqueen herself. Only a diverse band of heroes have skills and determination to journey into the labyrinth of the Jade Abbey and stop the corruption.

A thrilling cooperative dungeon-crawler for one to four players set within the Age of Sigmar, Warhammer Quest: Darkwater is a brand new boxed game designed to be replayable over and over. You’ll pick a hero, open the 38-page lay-flat map book to match your chosen scenario, and use miniatures, cards, and dice to battle for the fate of the Everspring.

This new Warhammer Quest game is quick to learn and easy to play, perfect for game night with your friends and family. Simply pick your heroes and jump into a 30-minute skirmish against the disgusting followers of Nurgle – a perfect bite-sized chunk of gaming for tempting friends into another session, and another, and… hey, why not play a whole campaign? If you want something meatier, you can play through the whole story in about 10-14 hours over multiple days – or one marathon session, if you bring plenty of snacks.

These campaigns are thrilling three-act adventures through the infested ruins of the Jade Abbey, where you’ll play through multiple scenarios, unlock new heroes and rewards, and eventually test yourselves against the loathsome might of Gelgus Pust. Victory isn’t certain, but you shouldn’t let loss put you off! Campaigns are designed to be replayed, and because you only use a portion of the cards on offer each time, every playthrough will be a unique combination of heroes played, encounters fought, events overcome, and rewards looted.

—description from the publisher

name: Warlords of the Steppes
description:
Warlords of the Steppes is a competitive, easy to learn and roll to slay game. You play as a legendary warlord with unique powers who wishes to be the next Great Khan. You draw recruits from the deck, train your warriors as dice and slay monsters with rolls.

The game is set in a steppe landscape, enriched with mythological elements. Players aim to increase their fame and glory, and secure the people's support to etch their names in history in golden letters. The steppe is a perilous land, constantly under siege by mythological foes. Warlords send warriors recruited from the youth to face these enemies, earning glory for each defeated foe. However, some enemies are ancient nemesis of the people, and any Warlord who allows them to breathe must bear the burden of shame.

When all threats are eradicated and the legendary creatures of prophecy called omens have emerged, the time comes to crown the next Great Khan.

The game features heroes, creatures, gods, spells, and warlords inspired by real-world steppe mythology and legends.

—description from the publisher

name: WarTiles
description:
WarTiles is a strategy game where up to 4 players face off, each commanding a unique faction from the world of Aëran. Every unit, terrain, and spell is represented by a tile placed on a 7x7 battlefield, where every move and action carries significant weight.

The game is defined by its core mechanic: Shift. Instead of moving freely, units are affected by the battlefield itself shifting whenever a tile is destroyed. An entire row or column slides to fill the empty space, constantly reshaping the layout of the board. This unique dynamic forces players to anticipate changes and seize every tactical opportunity.

The game ends when a player successfully eliminates an opposing hero, earning him victory.

name: Watercolor
description:
Watercolor is a game of gentle oneupsmanship. Two players will play higher and higher numbers in hopes of being the first to run out of cards in their hand and collect a Prize card. Players will use digit cards to compose their numbers (for instance, a 5 and a 3 can make a 53 or 35).

Every time a player plays a number, they’ll have to take a card that was already on the table into their hand, which means their best-laid plans will oft go astray in dynamic and exciting ways.

Players will get a new Skill card each round, and can use them to disrupt their opponent or buttress their own plans. The first player to collect two prize cards wins the game.

name: Waves
description:
Atlantis is in turmoil. Leaders of the most powerful Houses are in constant conflict, vying for control of the city Lately, their focus has turned to the Council of Elders, an ancient institution that rules Atlantis from the shadows.

As the head of one of these Houses, you will need to send out Agents to try and persuade the Elders to ‘see things your way’. You will need to skilfully navigate the Council’s ever-changing laws to secure your grasp on the world’s most magnificent city.

Players will split into 2 teams (or choose the All versus All mode). Each team tries to be the first to collect the 5 different Elder cards.

Elders are collected by playing the right card from your hand as either a Follower or Rebel. Followers take priority in collecting Elders, but Rebels can swing the Councils majority. This can be a huge deal, because the Council will determine which special rule will be active for the rest of the round.

At the end of each round, all the cards that were played advance to the Council and become the new Elders for the next round.

—description from the designer

name: We All Take from the River
description:
We All Take from the River is a game of resource management and social deduction. You play as neighbors along a river, each with a unique set of objectives to complete over the course of ten seasons. Sometimes you and your neighbor's objectives will overlap and sometimes they will clash.

Turns begin at the top of the river and proceed downstream. Players build and move structures along the river to control when they act, competing for the best spots available.
