Meanwhile, the extradimensional Chronofiends — entities that consume paradoxes and everything caught within them—are slowly devouring the time loop, creating a tense race against time.

In Chronofiends!!, players explore the station, searching for essential items and room rewards needed to close the time paradox and escape before they’re erased. Each character possesses unique abilities that alter time and space, enabling them to interact differently with obstacles, allies, and the hostile aliens roaming the station. The game's mechanics emphasize resource and time management, as players take actions by moving through connected rooms, resolving obstacles, and accumulating skill points that enhance their abilities. However, every encounter with a Chronofiend reduces the available time, accelerating the station’s collapse.

Adding to the tension, Chronofiends!! incorporates a countdown mechanic via the Time Track, where each player’s remaining actions are limited. If players can navigate through the challenging rooms, gather scenario-specific items, and use their skills effectively, they have a chance to fix the paradox and escape. But if the loop resets or time runs out, everything they've achieved unravels, and they must start anew with only the knowledge they’ve gained in prior attempts. This collapsing cycle tests teamwork, strategy, and quick adaptation. This is a pure cooperative game, where all the players win, or they all lose.

—description from the designer

name: Cid Campeador: Warlord
description:
Cid Campeador: Warlord is a strategic-level wargame set in the tumultuous Moorish Spain of the late 11th century. Players step into the shoes of iconic figures from the era, vying for supremacy on the Iberian Peninsula. The game spans the dramatic 15 years from 1085 to 1099, a period marked by El Cid's exile, the expansion of Christian kingdoms, and the growing influence of the Almoravids.

Cards grant players initiative, operation points, and the ability to trigger game-changing events. Treasure, acquired through conquest and plunder, provides additional benefits. Player interaction is intense, with strategic alliances, betrayals, and direct confrontations shaping the outcome. Fate cards add an element of chance and unpredictability.

While designed for four players, Cid Campeador: Warlord can be enjoyed with fewer. The AI takes control of absent factions, ensuring a challenging experience for solo or two-player games.

Victory is determined by accumulating the most victory points, earned through territorial conquest, strategic objectives, and controlling key locations.

-description from designer

name: Widget's Workshop
description:
Instant Workshop...  Infinite Possibilities!

Build adorable robots and golems, with just one finger!

Widget’s Workshop is a “drop-style,” spatial set collection, card crafting board game. You start the game by dropping 80 part cards onto the table, creating a giant, messy pile of parts in the center. Players take turns pulling parts from the pile, using one finger only, attempting to find the best parts for their robots and golems under construction in their workshop bays. Once a bay contains each of the 5 required pieces, the parts are combined to reveal a unique construct and its name.

You win the game by completing the most optimized set of constructs in your workshop!

Prepare to drop some parts and build awesome constructs!

Highlights:

     Innovative "drop-style" game set in the Dungeon Drop universe
     Highly portable, small-box game playable in under 30 minutes
     Elements of card crafting and set collection
     Real-world, spatial gameplay


On your turn you will draft either 1 face-down part card from the pile, or 2 face-up parts (choosing one to keep and then tossing the other back onto the pile face-up). Drafted part cards are added to one of your three "bays" where you're constructing these robots and golems. Once you have all 5 parts necessary to complete a construct, you assemble it (consolidate the cards, allowing the completed construct picture to show through the transparent areas of the cards) and move it to your "showcase" area. Once a certain number of constructs have been completed the game end triggers - the player with the highest scoring constructs wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Citadels Duel
description:
Welcome to Citadels Duel, a tense head-to-head contest of cunning and ambition. Two rival city planners compete to shape the future of the Citadel, striving to design the district plan that generates the greatest wealth and earns lasting renown.

Construct powerful buildings across diverse districts—from bustling Commercial hubs to formidable Military strongholds—while enlisting influential figures such as the cunning Queen, the deadly Assassin, and the ruthless Warlord to your aid. Every ally you recruit is an advantage your opponent may also claim, so anticipate their moves and act decisively.

When the final building rises, the planner with the most gold claims victory.

—description from the publisher

name: Cities of Venus: Civil War
description:
It's the year 2322, a century after the communication blackout with Earth, the once-unified Venusian cities have found themselves fragmented and divided. The collapse of the republic had given rise to individual city-states, each ruled by powerful factions vying for dominance and control. The valuable Venite resource drives the conflict, as factions fight for literal power and control. Amidst this chaos, the International Innovation Station (IIS) thrives as a neutral entity, offering technological advancements to all factions. Its influence is immense, capable of shifting the tides of war. But complications arise. The singularity, which once took hold of Earth, has found its way to Venus. It manipulates and controls some of the factions, adding an additional layer of complexity to the struggle for dominance.

In Cities of Venus: Civil War, you'll navigate the treacherous landscape of Venus mining Venite while leading your faction in the quest for supremacy. Alliances may come and go, as necessity drives your decisions. Choose how to outfit your gargantuan airborne fortress to scavenge Vnite on Venus to escape the dust and darkness before time runs out. Among your unique rival factions simply collecting Vnite will not be enough to save you, you’ll need to conserve it, trade it, protect it, and even steal it to ensure you’ll be the one to reign.

Utilize the ever-evolving technologies offered by the IIS, but be cautious of their potential consequences. Balancing the acquisition of power and the practical implications of tactical battles will be vital to your success. As you compete against rival factions, both controlled by players and influenced by the enigmatic singularity, your decisions will shape the future of Venus. Establish a new order, one that brings stability and prosperity, or plunge the world into further chaos and division.

Can you lead your faction to victory in this intense struggle for control? The fate of Venus lies in your hands.

—description from the designer

name: Pendragon: Glory of the Round Table
description:
Pendragon: Glory of the Round Table is a self-contained card game of questing, honor, combat, legends, and all manner of knightly virtues. This new card game features key elements from Greg Stafford’s Pendragon tabletop roleplaying game, incorporated into a fun and adventurous multiplayer experience.

Players take on the role of virtuous knights who must complete quests on their path to earn the most glory.  Each quest is represented by a series of tasks taking place over years of time, capturing the essence of the role-playing game. Hire on brave squires that will assist by pledging to your cause. Use your strength, constitution, and appeal to be the next knight selected to join King Arthur’s illustrious round table.

The Knights contained within are each unique, with their own boons and tactics, making each play experience a different one. Harness their key abilities to complete quests and earn glory or trade in gold to purchase a different path to victory. Cards have multiple ways they can be played.

—description from the publisher

name: Citytrip Junior
description:
As a tour guide in Theme City you want to create the most memorable trip by visiting exciting attractions, wonderfull shops, wild animals, restaurants and more.

Citytrip Junior is a flip & write game that is quick to setup and easy to play. With a basic and advanced scoresheet, 15 starting points and 30 different missions, no 2 games will feel the same!

One player flips the upper card of the action stack. Simultaneously everybody chooses 2 actions that are horizontally or vertically adjacent (=7 possible combinations). Each player creates a road and circles achieved goals which give points on the scoresheet. The game ends when the action stack is empty. The player with the highest rating wins Citytrip Junior.

-description from publisher

name: Citytrip Paris
description:
Citytrip Paris is the third game in the 'Citytrip series' featuring new gameplay elements.

As a tour guide you want to create the most memorable trip by visiting famous buildings and musea, events, restaurants and more.

Citytrip Paris is a flip & write game that is quick to setup and easy to play. With a basic and advanced scoresheet, 23 starting points and 44 different missions, no 2 games will feel the same!

One player flips the upper card of the action stack. Simultaneously everybody chooses 2 actions that are horizontally or vertically adjacent (=7 possible combinations). Each player creates a road and circles achieved goals which give points on the scoresheet. The game ends when the action stack is empty. The player with the highest satisfaction score wins Citytrip Paris.

—description from the designer

name: Pirates of the High Teas
description:
Pirates of the High Teas is a whimsical set collection game in which players are pirates competing to win their Captain's treasure by serving the most delicious afternoon tea. Players collect and match dishes with tea cards to serve the Captain a perfect meal. To acquire these dishes and teas, players select actions through a strategic worker placement mechanism on the pirate ship that determines turn order and number of cards.

But don't forget, as pirates, there are lots of ways to break the rules! Players can smash their dishes together, creating ridiculous combinations that still pair perfectly. They can also use their cannon to blow up the available cards, send their monkey to steal a card off the top of the deck, and deploy a parrot to smuggle a single card directly to the Captain for points.

At the end of 9 rounds, count your doubloons. The pirate with the most treasure wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Doom Guard
description:
Doom Guard is a cooperative board game for one to five players, who don the mantle of Earth's mightiest heroes and villains as they are forced to work together in order to protect Earth from total annihilation!

Defeat the minions of Cthulhu, fight the spread of corruption, and beat back the forces of evil through 45-60 minute scenarios that can be played individually or as part of a complete campaign.

—description from the publisher

name: Wandering Galaxy: A Crossroads Game
description:
Explore space like never before in Wandering Galaxy, the newest addition to Plaid Hat's "Crossroads Game" universe.

In the game, players are members of a ragtag starship crew traversing the edge of charted space in search of fame and riches. Together the players command and control a ship as they set off on a world-jumping campaign, taking on jobs too dangerous (or too insane) for the average space traveler. Come aboard and fly across the galaxy to see whether your crew can make enough profit to pay off their ship and become masters of their own cosmic destiny!

—description from the publisher

name: Ashes Ascendancy
description:
Ashes Ascendancy is the next era of the expandable card game Ashes; a new entry point for the series and a continuation of Ashes Reborn. Fully compatible with all of Ashes Reborn, Ashes Ascendancy marks the introduction of two new magic types for Phoenixborn to wield, the same competitive card play you know and love, plus a new type of foe for players to take down in solo or co-op battles.

Ashes is an expandable card game where players take on the role of Phoenixborn, demi-gods and protectors of the world of Argaia.

—description from the publisher

name: Club Spooky
description:
Its a busy night at Club Spooky and you’re trying to assemble the coolest group of ghouls. Here’s hoping your Rivals don't steal them... and they actually stick around...

Each round you’ll be using your “Talking Point” tokens to bid for the attention of the Creatures entering the Lobby. One-up your rivals long enough and you’ll get to add them to your clique. Each creature has a set of traits and a goal. If your clique meets their goals at the end of the game, you’ll score points. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game, wins.

—description from the designer

name: Coalition: Councils of the Republic
description:
Four Parties with competing interests (Clergy, Nobles, Merchants, and Rebels) wheel and deal to shape their city-state's new Constitution via a shared-scoring system. Meanwhile, Independent players seek to achieve their own unique objectives.

Parties primarily earn points by adding Articles to the Constitution that align with their party’s Virtues. Every Article corresponds to one of four Virtues: Order, Wealth, Freedom, and Justice. Since each Virtue is shared between two parties, no one scores alone! While your party is small, you share common goals with almost everyone. Winning requires shrewdly building and breaking alliances, and manipulating the convention’s processes.

Players are split into Councils. Over five rounds, each Council’s members bid Influence to determine which Article their Council will add to the Constitution The player at the top of each Council board is the Council Chair, a position with powerful privileges. Persuading the Council Chair to act in your interests (or ousting them) is key. The Council Chair breaks ties and resolves Edicts, special laws that are passed as Articles are added to the Constitution.

—description from the publisher

name: Coalitions
description:
Coalitions is based on the series of conflicts known as the Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars. Players, representing major European powers, compete against each other to shape the future of the Continent. The innovative and elegant game system allows a historical recreation of the conflicts, but better yet, can also create plausible alternative histories. The Alliances may take different forms, the campaigns may be fought along different lines of approach, but what the players witness is still a believable version of history.

Coalitions brings the whole continent of the Napoleonic Wars into a fast, playable system.  Multiplayers—with NO downtime. Each turn, EVERY player is doing something… but doing something ‘different.’  This sets up an unexpected cycle like nothing you’ve ever played before.  Cool wooden pieces, or a “Deluxe” version with some of the most beautiful miniatures you’ve ever seen. Kickstarter backers get exclusive sculpts, an extra player expansion, plus an extra game covering a slightly different period!

Throughout the period, Britain formed coalitions with almost any nation that would stand against France. Whenever a coalition was defeated, Britain sought to form a new one with states that would carry on the fight. Nations also had other motives to fight wars, often seeking to expand their own borders at the cost of their neighbors. Britain itself fought the French in Portugal and Spain and, with almost total control of the sea, sent military expeditions wherever there was a chance of harassing the French. Can the Emperor of Austria protect the German Reich and Northern Italy from the Revolutionary Armies? Will the Prussian King and Russian Tsarina join as allies or not? Will the Ottoman Empire be able to protect Egypt, the Balkans and Caucasus from the aggressive neighbors?

When you play Coalitions, you decide the destiny of Europe; your decisions will make history. Will you guide France to greatness? Will you galvanize and unite Europe to bring an end to the infant republic and restore the Ancien Régime? Or maybe there is a Metternich in you, able to deceive others and bluff your way to victory with a cunning smile?

Each player controls one of six asymmetric factions: France, England, Austria, Prussia, Russia or Turkey. They then try to form an alliance, insisting that it will be beneficial to all, although only one player can actually win. Throughout the game, players try to capture and consolidate key positions, which will earn victory points during the relevant phase.

—description from publisher

name: Coalitions: Realpolitik
description:
The Realpolitik Expansion is a standalone game that brings all the great features and mechanics of Coalitions to a lower player count. It’s based on the Austro-Prussian (1866) and Franco-Prussian wars (1871), conflicts that made the unification of German a reality. Players take on the roles of leaders of France, Prussia, Austria and Italy to try to reshape the map of Central Europe to their advantage one more time. The scale of the game may not be as epic as in other expansions or the base Coalitions, but the stakes are high nonetheless!

The Realpolitik Expansion is designed for 1-4 players, with a new solo mode and an emphasis on the competitive 2-player mode in which both players control two nations. The Activator system is modified to fit this mode and the overall theme of the expansion is a bit different – let’s just say, we’re not forgetting to take into account the massive impact of mid-19the century railways.

Realpolitik also introduces more asymmetry between the nations than in the Coalitions base game, from highly militant Prussia and economically strong France, to newly but not fully united Italy, and multi-ethnic Austria.

As with the other standalone expansions, Realpolitik comes with its own set of components, including a new Wheel of War and a new game board.

—description from the publisher

name: Coast Watchers: Allied Field Intelligence in the South Pacific, 1942-1943
description:
Coast Watchers takes you into the World War II South Pacific’s struggle between Allied intelligence teams and Japanese security forces. Standup blocks hide coastwatching stations, guerrillas, refugees, and stranded Allied crew. Facedown counters hide the buildup of Japanese forces, which the coastwatchers seek to observe and report to headquarters. Other counters show where Japanese patrols are searching for coastwatchers or go into and get drawn from cups to run Japanese searches and Allied delivery missions.

Each side has Mission cards. Allied Missions assign side tasks to the coastwatchers. Japanese Missions lay out secret military objectives for victory points, including air and sea operations against which the coastwatchers are to warn Allied forces. By hunting coastwatchers while building up military readiness and guiding operations, the Japanese player seeks to slip through the enemy intelligence net. Players also draw Asset cards: special abilities to augment actions and perhaps add victory points.

Coast Watchers offers 15 standalone “Situations” plus 4 campaigns to tie them together. The Situations span the early-1942 Japanese incursion into the South Pacific to the neutralization of their great base at Rabaul by the end of 1943.

A solitaire system is included.

—description from the publisher

name: Codenames: Critical Role Adventures
description:
Enter the world of Exandria, a land of infinite wonder and unexpected champions, and experience the Critical Role adventures through Codenames. Assemble a party of heroes from the first three Critical Role campaigns, embark on missions, and level up your characters to defeat the final boss.

Codenames: Critical Role Adventures is a unique take on Codenames inspired by the Critical Role universe. It’s a fully cooperative version of the game where one GM (game master) leads their party through perilous missions, each with its own twist and take on the classic Codenames rules and featuring a new set of themed words. Play the game in three separate campaigns, choose from seven Critical Role characters, and, by levelling them up, unlock new abilities and equip items to use during missions.

name: Super Auto Pets Card Battle: Classic Pack
description:
In Super Auto Pets Card Battle, players build teams of cute pets with unique abilities, then match them against a friend's team in a short and sweet auto battle.

Each game is played over six rounds, beginning with players receiving coins to spend on pet and food cards. After shopping, the players arrange their teams in secret and chooses their placement for battle. The round ends with players revealing their stacks and playing cards one at a time in auto battle style, knocking out pets and resolving abilities to eliminate the opposing team.

After six rounds, whoever has the most trophies wins the game! Super Auto Pets Card Battle is a fast and furious dueling game that is easy to learn and filled with tons of variety. Each Super Auto Pets set is a standalone game for two players, with new collections of pets, food, and crazy abilities. Mix sets for zany combinations or to let more players jump in on the action!

—description from the publisher

name: 23 Knives
publisher: Play to Z; Ediciones MasQueOca; Studio Supernova
description:
It's 44 BCE, the pinnacle of the Roman Republic. At the end of Julius Caesar's civil war, he is left holding enormous power. He has the love of many, but for others, there is only fear. This fear leads Caesar's friends and allies to question his intentions. They're stoking a fire of conspiracy, a conspiracy that will end on the Ides of March, with 23 wounds, a republic in ruin, and the birth of an Empire.

In a game of 23 Knives, you take on the role of a Roman citizen with one of three allegiances: a loyalist to Caesar, a liberator of Rome, or an opportunist biding their time. Throughout the game, you travel through Rome, manipulating other citizens and swaying them to your cause.

At the end of the game, if 23 or more knives are in the Curia, Caesar is dead and the liberator most committed to killing Caesar wins. With fewer than 23 knives, the loyalist most dedicated to saving Caesar wins. Opportunists are those who linger, waiting to shift the fate of Caesar at the last moment, and if they do, they win as a team.

—description from the designer

name: Colonize: The New World
description:
As you carve out colonies in the New World, you’ll face competition from the native inhabitants defending their homes and European powers on the same quest as you. Whether your colony establishes peaceful trade or wages war with these rivals, the choice is yours.

But beware — as your power grows, your king’s goodwill turns to jealousy, and soon your people will demand freedom from his rule. If you’re bold enough to declare independence, prepare for a fierce battle. Only those who can outwit and outfight the king’s formidable army will secure victory, forge a new nation, and win the game!

Each turn, players work to strengthen their foothold by gathering resources, forging alliances (through a robust treaty system), and developing their settlements — all while facing off against native tribes, royal forces, or even rival players. When a player believes their colonies are strong enough, they can risk it all and declare independence. If they manage to defeat the King’s Expeditionary Force, they’ll break free from tyranny and claim victory in the game!

—description from the designer

name: Colosseum: Ave Titus
description:
Colosseum: Ave Titus is a new standalone game that is being built from scratch—out of pure love for the classic Colosseum. The original designers will return with the addition of Jonny Pac. Ian O'Toole will do all of the illustrations and graphic design work. The goal of the game is to bring a fresh, highly-thematic, mid-heavy gamers’ game to your table, with a familiar setting of organizing great spectacles in the Colosseum. This time the game will take place in the specific era of Emperor Titus, who celebrated the inauguration of the Colosseum in 80 AD with a series of games and spectacles that lasted for 100 days, often referred to as “The Games of Titus.” These games were a lavish display of entertainment and were intended to demonstrate the wealth, power, and generosity of the emperor. They showcased a diverse array of entertainment and were among the most significant and memorable events in the Colosseum's history.

As a master impresario, you will have the chance to carefully orchestrate all possible means that you have, to organize the most epic and glorious grand spectacles of the Colosseum. Your moment in the sun has come...

—description from the publisher

name: Colosseum: The Grand Spectacle
description:
In Colosseum: The Grand Spectacle, each player takes the role of a Roman impresario, producing dazzling spectacles in their arena to attract the largest crowds and earn lasting fame. By upgrading their venue, recruiting talented performers, and impressing powerful nobles, including the Emperor himself, you’ll compete to earn the title of Grand Impresario, with your name echoed across the empire.

Set in 80 AD during the 99-day inauguration of the Colosseum, the game unfolds as gladiators clash, exotic beasts prowl, and musicians from every corner of the empire perform for a roaring crowd. As Emperor Titus settles into his seat for the final day, all eyes turn to you — this is your moment to shine.

Colosseum: The Grand Spectacle is a deluxe new edition of the classic Colosseum. It features new artwork, streamlined rules, upgraded components, and brand-new solo and two-player modes. Returning fans can also play with the original rules, and the game includes a new module, The Lion, adding a lion figure and fresh gameplay twists.

This edition introduces several major changes: the game now plays in four rounds instead of five, requiring a rebalanced economy and faster arc. Players share a central Colosseum, contributing their own gates to the structure instead of using individual arenas. New event tiles have been added, star performers are now screen-printed meeples with six new characters, and the introduction of the Mercury pawn refines bidding and trade interactions. Players also build "Temples of Fortuna" around the board and manage upgraded player boards to score points and organize assets.

Every element has been carefully reworked to bring new life to a modern classic, while preserving the spirit of the original.

—description from the publisher

name: Animal Rescue Team
publisher: Play to Z; Ediciones MasQueOca; Fentasy Games
description:
Calling all animal rescuers! When disaster strikes, animals will need your help to escape floods, fires, and earthquakes. Do you have what it takes to succeed in Animal Rescue Team?

Test your skills against the worst disasters that nature has to offer. Can you free a cat trapped in a collapsed building, rescue a goat from a rushing river, or save a pair of dogs caught behind a fire line?

In this fully cooperative game, you'll work with a team of expert specialists to safely evacuate animals to shelters, before time runs out and a second team must arrive to save the day!

Animal Rescue Team is the first title in the "Shut Up & Sit Down Presents" game line.

name: Combat! Brécourt Manor
description:
Brécourt Manor simulates the famous action of June 6th, 1944, in which American paratroopers, primarily from E Company of the 2nd Battalion of the 506th Regiment, destroyed a German artillery battery firing on Utah Beach.

The system uses AI to make for intense combat situations as well as unlimited replays. As the paratroopers’ commander, you will attack a determined foe. Can you succeed?

The game has four scenarios and is designed as an introduction to the Combat! series.

Combat! Brécourt Manor is part of Paper Wars Issue #114.  The magazine also includes the complete Combat! Series Rules, so that gamers who have Brécourt Manor have everything they need to begin enjoying the Combat! game system.

name: Combat! Crete
description:
Combat! Crete is a stand-alone solitaire game of man-to-man combat in WWII.  The player commands a squad of British Commonwealth troops or German Fallschirmjäger in various engagements.  The included scenarios are set on the islands of Crete and Leros but full-war OOBs are included for both factions.

A comprehensive Random Scenario Generator further expands the gaming possibilities and will generate a limitless supply of unique scenarios.  The Random Scenario Generator is self-contained, or can be combined with Combat! Eastern Front and/or Combat Tunisia & Sicily to create an even more expansive Combat! experience.

In addition, the included Campaign Game allows the player to lead a squad of men through 10 battles, gaining experience along the way.

Other new features in Combat! Crete include:
Off Board Artillery rules including air support
New Terrain types including Vineyards, Weapon Pits, and an Airfield
Parachute Drops, with a massive four map paradrop scenario
Australians, New Zealanders, and Maoris for extra fun with the Commonwealth OOB
Scenarios on Leros which feature Fallschirmjäger armed with FG42s
Competitive Play rules for head to head battles
Armed Cretan Civilians give the Fallschirmjägers a nasty welcome

—description from the designer

name: Combat! Tunisia & Sicily
description:
Combat! Tunisia & Sicily is a stand-alone solitaire game of man-to-man combat in which the player commands an American or Italian squad. Although the 11 scenarios in the game center around the fighting in Tunisia and Sicily, full-war Orders of Battle are included for the Americans and Italians. With this module then, gamers can play scenarios involving the Americans or the Italians from any year of the war. The included Random Scenario Generator and Campaign Game allow for an amazing gaming system which is self-contained, or can be combined with Combat! Eastern Front to create an even more expansive Combat! experience

Other new features found in this game include:

     Advanced Street Fighting rules such as flat roofs, sprinting through alleys, balconies, and more.
     National Traits for both sides that model their fighting traditions, formations, and equipment.
     New Weapons for both sides, including the M1 Carbine and the Italian armaments.
     New Terrain rules for River, Ford, Bridge, Cactus, and Scrub, plus Weather rules.
     Defenses such as Pillboxes, Strongpoints, Minefields, and Wire.


Competitive Play rules for head-to-head battles!

—description from the publisher

name: Come Out Fighting
description:
Come out Fighting is a miniatures game rulebook about squads and tanks in World War Two.

The introductory game presents nine step-by-step learning scenarios based on the real exploits of the 761st Armored, a pioneering African-American tank battalion. The advanced game offers comprehensive rules for all the major forces in the war, using 15mm figures and bases that are compatible with other miniatures games set in this period.

Games are compact, with 6 or fewer models on a side. Combat is swift. Timing and manuever are everything. The mechanics are inspired by  Band of Brothers. They are compatible with the published Band of Brothers scenarios and unit profiles.

Optional rules unlock 28mm scale, campaigns, solo play, team play, and more.

—description from the designer

name: Comete
description:
It's the St. Lorenz's night and as per tradition, people gather under a starry sky to see their wishes granted by the shooting stars. What most people don't know is that, in order to realize a particular wish, you need cunning and strategy. You will have to capture the right comets to make your dreams come true. But be careful: if you chase love you will hardly realize the desire for richness, the same its true for those who chase fame, at the expense of virtue... Plan your moves carefully, and avoid the traps of your opponent: who first realizes two wishes... wins the game!

Comete is a language-independent, highly thematic strategy game, which hides a fascinating and delicate depth of play.

Comete is a "perfect strategy" game, where all the information is known to all players and the resources available for each player are identical: your choices will make the difference. But it's not an abstract game, shooting stars are elusive and unpredictable, and so they are in the game. No one can know what will be the next fallen star to appear in the sky, even less when the comet you need will appear. Moreover, they exist as in the past comets harbingers of feast or famine and often it will be up to the player to decide how to unravel the celestial message.

To capture a comet you will have to «attract» it to you by matching its colours. You have several «wish fragments» (acrylic gems) to play each turn, which you must tactically place by line of the celestial horizon: if a comet passing next to them has the same colours, you have captured it!

—description from the publisher

name: Comic Book Crisis
description:
Comic Book Crisis is a cooperative worker placement/action game for 1-4 players that can be played on ANY comic book thanks to a patent-pending method.

You play as a member of the heroic B-TEAM, superheroes who attempt to thwart an evil villain's plot. Place your hero's poses onto the comic page, collect resources, and spend them to activate your powers against the villain and their henchmen! If you can work together against the forces of evil before the story reaches its end, you WIN!

Comic Book Crisis comes with four superheroes, each with their own unique pose tokens and deck of power cards. The game also comes with several villains, each of increasing difficulty and their own deck of schemes.

Comic Book Crisis comes with an EXCLUSIVE comic book but the most exciting feature is that thanks to a patent-pending method, COMIC BOOK CRISIS can be played on ANY comic book ever published! You can literally play hundreds of thousands of games of Comic Book Crisis and never have the same experience twice!

—description from the designer

name: Better Letters
description:
Come up with words that meet the criteria set forth by the Word Rule cards. Score points for difficulty and meeting personal objectives.

Better Letters starts with a 3 x 3 grid of Word Rule cards, and gets larger in later rounds (up to a 5 x 5 grid). Set up the game by shuffling and dealing out nine Word rule cards into a 3 x 3 grid into the middle of the play area. Shuffle the personal objective cards and deal out three to each player. Each player will select two to keep and discard the other.  These are kept secret from other players. Give all players six tokens in their player color.

Better Letters is played in 60 second rounds with all players acting at the same time. Each player’s goal is to form a word(s) by following the restrictions listed on one or multiple cards. You may begin with any card and continue utilizing cards connected orthogonally. Write down your word(s) on your score sheet in the corresponding boxes. All players must finish discovering up to three words before the timer runs out. When the timer expires, everyone makes sure they have one word checked from their list and will be the word they submit for the round.

Custom scoring commences and the game is played over five or six rounds, depending upon player count.

—description from the designer

name: Computer Junkyard
description:
You found a box of old computer games at a yard sale and can’t wait to play them with your friends. To your dismay, modern computers won’t run them. Instead, you each race to build your own vintage computer out of spare parts. Welcome to the Computer Junkyard, the perfect place to find all the components you will need! Scavenge for parts, sabotage your opponents, trade  with your friends, and do it all with the cash in your pockets. Be the first to complete a computer good enough to run your game!

In Computer Junkyard, players assemble hardware tiles to construct a vintage computer. The first player to have a complete, bug-free computer, which meets the specifications necessary to run their unique computer game, is the winner.

The primary mechanic of Computer Junkyard is the physical assembly of hardware tiles. Each player attaches their hardware together like puzzle pieces, connecting them up to a central motherboard tile to fit within a 9x9 chassis grid.

Players collect hardware by purchasing tiles randomly drawn from the central Junkyard, or by freely making trades with other players. Players begin with a limited amount of money, which they must manage as hardware tiles increase in price as their supplies decrease.

During their turn, players may purchase hardware, attempt to steal hardware from their opponents, or sabotage an opponent by attaching a computer bug tile to their computer.

—description from the publisher

name: Concrete Canvas
description:
Move stealthily around the city, collecting Rattlecans (Spray Paint) and using them to create paintings, while placing your “stickers” on walls in each borough of New York City as you go. Earn street cred for your paintings and for being the most iconic artist in each borough. If you have the most Street Cred when one player gets caught (runs out of legal moves) you win!

On their turn, a player may either move or paint.

To move, one of their two characters must move to an adjacent borough tile, and either up or down one subway line. For example, if the player's character pawn is currently on the 2 line, they may move to an adjacent tile's 1 or 3 line. After moving, they collect the rattlecan associated with the space, and place a player marker over the resource space. These markers count toward influence in that borough, as well.

To paint, a player may spend, back to the supply, the required rattlecans depicted on the art card and takes that card. That card has street cred points as well as icons that help a player's secret goal card.

Players take turns until one player has no legal moves, which triggers the end game. Each remaining player takes one more turn and whomever has the most street cred from their paint cards and from the majority points given from the boroughs is the winner.

—description from the publisher

name: Conquerors and Conquests
description:
Conquerors and Conquests is a dice rolling game where you will compete to solve quests, battle monsters, and even fight other players. Cast spells and move around the game board to become the next champion of the land.

With a starting hand of spell cards you can upgrade throughout gameplay, each player becomes more powerful, giving more opportunity to battle stronger monsters and complete harder quests. Make each game unique by choosing a different hero with special abilities, different starting spells, and even change the game board by rearranging the tiles that make up the play space.

Conquerors and Conquests is a Dungeons and Dragons campaign without the roleplaying, choices only being able to be made from the spell cards in front of you and the items in your hand, entirely played in 90-120 minutes. The pixel art on each card brings an element of 1990s video games to life, bringing old arcade games and dungeon crawlers to your tabletop.

—description from the publisher

name: Twisted Trumpets
description:
Twisted Trumpets is a lively, competitive tile-laying game where you vie for the prestigious title of “Royal Bugler” by crafting the most whimsical trumpet in the kingdom!

On your turn, choose from three actions: draw a basic pipe tile from the face-down stack, trade for face-up premium tiles, or lay tiles on your player board to build your trumpet. As you go, you’ll create a fantastical, Dr. Seuss-like horn that twists and turns in all directions. Adorn your trumpet with flags, birds, and musical notes to meet various scoring criteria.

Additionally, you’ll race to complete any of the three public Royal Decrees before your rivals to earn extra points. Collect private Queen’s Plans cards, which challenge you to build your trumpet in specific ways by the end of the game to score additional points.

As you build your trumpet, you’ll trigger special bonus actions by covering “King’s Favor” scrolls on your player board. These scrolls let you choose one of these powerful bonuses: take a free premium tile, perform two additional actions, or gain an extra Queen’s Plans card. Each time you trigger the same favor, it becomes less powerful and eventually unavailable, so timing is everything!

The game ends when a player completely fills all but three squares on their player board. You’ll finish that round, then all players take one final turn. Everyone tallies their scores based on the length of completed pipes, sets of flags, notes surrounding birds, public objectives, and private goals. The player with the most points wins and becomes the new Royal Bugler!

-description from designer

name: Xenology
description:
An alien mothership has arrived at an uncharted planet brimming with mystery and discovery. As a member of this extraterrestrial crew, you must deploy precise away teams to gather knowledge, collect vital specimens, and erase all traces of your presence. Every decision shapes your quest for enlightenment, driving you closer to earning a place among the revered Elders. Will you unlock the secrets of this enigmatic planet?

—description from the designer

name: Corporate Breakfast
description:
Corporate Breakfast is a family-friendly, ridiculous, short card game with classic draw and discard mechanics, where players use word and suffix cards to create fun new breakfast cereal names, which they pitch to the other players to earn their votes. It's easy to learn and typically plays in under 20 minutes.

—description from the designer

name: Corps of Discovery Duo
description:
A stand-alone game for 2, based off the hit deduction game, Corps of Discovery, this game has 2 players working together to create a map by following specific logic rules.

Players know some communal logic rules, but also each have some hidden behind their screen. Can you communicate only through your card placement what your rules are to your partner, while trying to figure out their rules?

On your turn you play one of your cards onto an ever-expanding map. If you don't like where your partner played a card because it violates one of your logic rules, then you can pay the current penalty (which is discarding cards from your deck) to remove any card in play.

If either player has no more cards to play, then the game is over and you both lose.

If at least 1 of each of the 10 terrains is in play, then either player could play the fort card - in a location that adheres to its own logic rule. Then review to see if all the cards on the map follow all the logic rules in the game - and if they do - you win!
It includes an Upgrade system as you progress from game to game, while also adding hazards that add new challenges each time you play.

—description from the designer

name: Cosmo
description:
Build your best poker hand by strategically recruiting the perfect crew for your Mission to Mars. Simply draw Cards from any of the six decks! The twist: Some of the players' cards are visible, others are hidden. Can you really be sure the others will end up with a better crew than you?! Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand … uh, crew wins the ticket to Mars.


     Draw cards from any of the six decks and aim for the strongest poker hand.
     Bet on the best hand before drawing your last cards. 
     Once everyone has five cards, it’s time to shine. The strongest hand wins.


—description from the publisher

name: Cozy Cat Cafe
description:
Cozy Cat Cafe is a tile placing game and players need to strategically place their cats and furniture in the right position to entice the customers and gain extra points by bringing ambience into the cafe. Players will compete to be the first to attract big spenders, shake things up by activating cat abilities and pull off perfect combos to transform their cafe with maximum ambience.

Each player starts with an empty Cozy Cat Cafe, gathering resources over a total of 3 rounds each with 9 turns.

Players take turns to either adopt cats, buy furniture or invite customers into their cafe. Adopting cats will cost you cookies but allow you to play cat cards, buying furniture will cost you coins but inviting the customers will bring you in resources as well as points.

Cozy Cat Cafe has 16 goal tiles for different bonus combinations each game and a variety of different customer cards for increased variability.

name: Cozy Stickerville
publisher: Unexpected Games; Rebel Sp. z o.o.
description:
Explore the land, uncover mysteries, and follow your residents’ personal stories. Build your Village with over 800 stickers featuring houses, farms, shops, animals, and so much more! As your village grows, so do your options: go fishing, explore the mine, find true love, and more!

Create your legacy as your choices unlock new options and can have lasting repercussions in future games. The buildings you choose have unique effects, and each decision creates new possibilities in future years.

Explore and Discover as you help residents pursue personal stories, go fishing, explore the mine, and 
uncover hidden mysteries.

A Game For Everyone!

—description from the publisher

name: Crash Site
description:
Genre: Fully cooperative Sci-fi Action Dungeon Crawler

Players: 1-4 (Ages 13+)

Estimated Weight: 3

Summary: Each player is a super soldier in the year 4335, part of an elite squadron known as Bravo Team. They are stranded on a long-abandoned world teeming with hostile wildlife. After disastrously crash landing in a region classified as "American Northeast" without any backup to come for years, players will have to survive by...

+  Exploring the overworld one location at a time, triggering story choices followed by combat missions

+ Collecting Items such as weapons and armor to add to their character's tableau, which resembles a walking arsenal, each Operative a living weapon

+  Finding Allies to recruit based on story choices and mission performances

+ Working as a team to overcome an assortment of challenges, but with no requirement for a full team. Solitaires can even help Bravo Team conduct its operation as an army of one and still follow the entire team's story in true solo mode, meaning some of the combat action thematically happens "off-screen"/ off-board for 3 players or less

+  Taking on an assortment of nightmarish creatures in small skirmishes or large-scale battles to reclaim this world one step at a time, no matter the cost...

Objective: Get to the northernmost location on the overworld map and accomplish its mission... which will be unique based on choices players make throughout the game leading up to that point.

Game Elements: CYOA story with an open overworld map to explore through a campaign with a "save" system for multiple plays (does not contain legacy elements.) Story branches change the game world, ensuring no two campaigns are the same. Missions include fast-paced tactical combat with simultaneous player actions on square grid arenas and their tactical reactions to an ever evolving Event deck unique to each mission. Players manage a tableau of cards and tokens to resemble each player's personal arsenal, character stats, and unique skills they can perform against enemies. Difficulty scales up for higher player counts.

Mechanics: exploration with an organic open world, CYOA narrative, action selection (menu of character combat skills to choose from), dice rolling, dice manipulation/ luck mitigation, square grid movement, RPG (stats building, item collecting, character skill strategy), dungeon crawling (unique arenas for tactical combat with a loot and progression system)

Main components: 1 region map (overworld), 1 game book (~100-page Mission Book), 30 Secret Sheet maps (for combat and exploration), 1 deck of enemy cards, 1 deck of Ally cards, 12 Event card decks, ~90 enemy and ally figures, 4 player figures, 4 player pads, tokens, tracker pads and tracker cubes for a dynamic stat tracking system (health bar, action points, etc.) The game book contains the campaign narrative adventure and mission details, such as enemy behaviors and environmental rules for each combat scenario

name: Criminal City
description:
Criminal City, 2019.

Here, every day, the eternal struggle between the Law and the "Interstellar Mob" is rekindled without respite and shows no signs of dying out, also due to the scarce resources available to the police.

The 3 powerful interstellar criminal factions are fighting to command the entire city, fueling the black market, the corruption and the sense of insecurity of citizens, while few but brave space policemen face them every day to try to stop them.

And which side are you on?

Criminal City is a partially asymmetrical and semi-collaborative game for 3-6 players divided into a number of rounds depending on the number of players participating.

In each game a single player chose to be the head of a criminal faction(in this case he is playing as a "Interstellar Mob" Player) or, alternatively, can control policemen (1 or more, depending on the number of players).

The players who lead the criminal factions win individually by accumulating more Dominion Points (DP) than their rivals and trying not to be arrested by the space police. 
The policemen win if they manage to capture all the factions fighting for the city's control within two consecutive turns or if, at the end of the game, they managed to limit the Criminals by accumulating at least 5 DP more than the most powerful faction.

—description from the designer

name: Crimson Keep
description:
Two clans, divided from the trials of being exiled, have held onto twin sacred amulets, prophesized to guide them back to their rightful kingdom. On a rare Fire Moon eclipse, both amulets have lit up, guiding them to the Boiling Sea and a mysterious monolith. Upon reaching the monolith, the light from the amulets ceased, and the monolith lit up, pointing each clan at two separate locations on the distant mountain. The two clans now race each other to build the Crimson Keep and summon the fabled dragon to rule over their newly reclaimed kingdom!

Crimson Keep is a fantasy, tower-building, card placement, set-collection, strategy game. To begin the game you'll draw five cards from your deck and choose 3 to keep. Each turn you'll take two actions, Place or Replace a card, Flip a Card over (to activate it) or Draw Cards, Use a Special Ability or Attack, or Move. Each of these actions has a track that you'll be moving up, which will gain you bonus actions when you reach the top of the track! Carefully manage your actions and hand, because if you end your turn with no cards in hand, you'll automatically draw up at the beginning of your turn, instead of wasting an action on drawing cards!

There are three different types of cards, Building, Combat and Cavern. When you are Placing a card, you always place it on the inactive side. Once Flipped, the card is on the active side, and you'll be able to use its special ability. When you place a building card, you'll be building up your Keep! You'll want to make sure its tall, strong and fortified! Combat cards will be how you attack the rival clan! And cavern cards will let you have enhanced actions!

The actions you take throughout the game, winning combats, building up your keep, and more will allow you to discover runes, which you will need to summon the mighty dragon! You'll need to pay attention to your Summon Board to focus on the actions that will get you the highest value runes possible! The higher the total value of runes you acquire, the more powerful dragon you'll be able to summon. But you'll need to keep a close watch on your rival's rune discovery progress to make sure they don't beat you to the punch!

Once one of the clans summons the dragon,  an epic final battle ensues! The dragon will now face off against the other clan's fortress. Have you built it well enough to withstand the dragon's fearsome attacks? Each time you repel an attack by the dragon, you will injure it! If your fortress manages to defeat the dragon, you will rule over the kingdom! But if your keep falls, your rival will take control of the land!

name: Crispy Critters
description:
Once, happy critters thrived in peace until one day a fire dragon claimed their treasures and homes. Now, hope rises! Assemble your band of fearless critters, sneak into the dragon’s fiery domain, and snatch back the riches of your ancestors!

In Crispy Critter, players send their critters deep into the dragon’s cave, stacking any duplicate cards to grab the most treasure. The more critters in your stack, the bigger the haul. But beware! The longer you stay in the cave the greater the risk of waking a hungry dragon, eager to turn your brave adventurers into a crispy snack!

Play your cards wisely, activate powerful abilities, and balance risk and reward in this high stakes, push your luck adventure. If you escape with the most treasure before the deck runs out, you will be crowned the winner.

Will you outsmart the dragons and claim victory, or will your luck run out in a blaze of fire?

—description from the publisher

name: Meeple Vacation: Water Park
description:
Ever wonder what your meeples do when the worker-placement game ends? THEY GO ON VACATION! Welcome to Meeple Vacation, the wildest waterpark worker...uh, vacation-placement game ever!

Each day starts with the funnest thing of all: rolling down the massive park slide and seeing how you land. Flopped? Standing? Headstand? Your pose decides where you can go and what you might do!

Send your family members to the Arcade for awesome prizes, bump rivals off The Plunge for points, race on the Slip & Slide, fill jungle rafts together, chill in the Lazy River, and score HUGE with perfect cannonball splashes! Along the way, you'll team up with lifeguards for extra fun, grab secret photocards for mementos, and turn every flop into opportunity over three hilarious vacation days!

Meeple Vacation: Water Park is 2–4 players, 45 minutes, ages 8+, and contains modular boards with two wildly different sides, and the most satisfying meeple slide you’ll ever own. Get ready to splash, laugh, and score like never before!

—description from the publisher

name: Crop Rotation
description:
Crop Rotation is a card game that is fully playable in hand, in which two competing players slip into the roles of vegetable gardeners who share a plot of land and who both strive to outdo each other with their harvests.

In order to achieve this, you will have to cleverly exploit the benefits of efficient companion planting as well as using crop rotation after your opponent’s season to your best advantage to grow your collection of plant shoots into a luscious and verdant garden of delicious vegetables.

Do you have the green thumb necessary to come out ahead in this interactive head-to-head race for a bountiful harvest?


     Crop Rotation was an entry in the 2025 In-Hand Game Design Contest, in which it was voted #1 Best Overall Multiplayer Game


—description from the publisher

name: Crown: The Succession War
publisher: BinaryStar Studio; BO3 Studio; Bifrost Games
description:
Crown: War of Succession is a competitive board game that combines action point allocation, area movement, and hand management mechanics. Players will take on the role of animal heroes participating in the battle for the sacred forest relic — the Crown.

The game consists of multiple chapters, where each player can take actions during their turn, such as traveling, resting, playing action cards, or using action points to enhance their attributes for more powerful skills. Players will accumulate combat experience, gather resources, and acquire items to strengthen their characters through battles or by conquering settlements.

There are three different ways to win: accumulate 15 victory points, control 6 settlements, or raise your combat skill to the final level.

name: Cry Baby
description:
"Plot with the Square Queen, the King Let,
the enchanter Roger Rob-It and the dragons
Bert, Nerd and Bianca, to succeed and have
control over the kingdom!"

Chouineurs is a trick-taking game played in 4 rounds of 7 tricks in which there are colors, trump cards and supertrump cards! But more important, cards are two-sided, with one color and value on the upper side and others on the bottom side of the cards, and they may rotate!

At the start of each round, you must choose the orientation of your hand of cards and bet on the number of tricks you think you can win during the round. If you win your bet, you will gain a lot of points. Otherwise, you can Cry, it helps a lot…

The "Cry" mechanic is triggered when you play a card with the lowest value of the trick. By doing that, you can choose to just win a point for that round, or to rotate one car of your hand ! So it allows you to change your hand of cards and adapt it to win only the number of tricks you aim, the one you bet.

At the end of the round, you will score 1 point for every time you Cry about your hand, and much more points if you manage to match your bet.

At the end of the 4th round, the player with the most points wins the game.

So... Ready? Steady? Crybaby!

—description from the publisher

name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches
description:
Cthulhu: Death May Die returns with an all-new core box, Cthulhu: Death May Die - Forbidden Reaches!

In addition to new Investigators, Episodes, Elder Ones, and Monsters, Forbidden Reaches introduces Campaigns, a dynamic new mode that can be played with any Episode and any Elder One, unfolding across a three-act structure, creating a unique narrative experience with every playthrough.

name: Culture Cue
description:
Culture Cue is an experience-sharing board game designed to connect people through storytelling. It was created as a way for players to communicate with others by sharing their experiences. Designed with a familiar game style and mechanics this board game can easily bring different people of different backgrounds and generations to enjoy a fun-filled time on game night.

By sharing stories and experiences the players are rewarded by being able to move forward a certain number of spaces. Players can choose not to share and have to move back spaces. The first player to move their tokens to Generational Enlightenment, the final circle, wins the game!

—description from the designer

name: Cultured Swines
description:
It’s nineteen-sixty-something, late on a balmy Summer afternoon in Pork Springs. You and your plus one have been invited to the annual Pork Springs Social, an intimate gathering of the city’s cultural heavyweights. As budding socialites, this is a golden opportunity to rub shoulders with some very influential swines and dazzle them with stimulating conversation and sophistication in your food and beverage choices. Can you out-schmooze and out-manoeuvre the competition to earn your place amongst these Cultured Swines?

Cultured Swines is a push-your-luck social strategy game played in pairs with 4-8 players. Mingling poolside, you and your plus one will boost your credibility with guests by weighing in on a range of topics from art, language and social commentary. In your conversation, you will order your own thoughts, try to validate your partner's opinions, and impress guests with your apparent wealth of knowledge. Race to the buffet for preferential service to match food and beverages with complementary flavor profiles. A perfect pairing will paint you and your plus one in a more favorable light and may help your in your next conversation. Every guest wields influence in their own way, and the impression you make will ripple through their circles. You must choose your conversations carefully to out-manoeuvre the competition, schmooze the right guests at the right time, and earn the favor of the crowd to cement your status as Cultured Swines.

—description from the publisher

name: Cursed Village
description:
In the cooperative board game Cursed Village, up to 4 players must work together to defend their village from monstrous threats. As the village's chosen heroes, you'll need to defeat a formidable boss and the creatures lurking in the surrounding lands.

You'll use clever strategy and resource management to recruit villagers, each with unique abilities, into your party. As you build your team, you'll also build your bag of tokens, which you'll use to perform various actions. Every choice you make, from who you recruit to how you prepare for battle, will be crucial to your survival.

Can you defeat the darkness and save the village from its cursed fate?

—description from the publisher

name: Cyberpunk Legends
description:
Before Silverhand blew up Arasaka Tower and Rache Bartmoss destroyed the internet, Night City still had Legends. It's your turn to make your mark in the world of Cyberpunk.

Here’s what we’ve got for you. A campaign based, narrative driven co-op card game that you can learn and set up within minutes of opening the box. You’ll get storytelling, character progression, puzzles, meaningful choices… And of course you’ll also get to smash, blast and charm your way to becoming a Legend.

Play as a team against a central scenario deck that will guide you through the story and give you the opportunity to carve your own path through Night City.

When you come up against an obstacle, that’s when the real fun begins. As a group, you’re going to try to create a cooperative poker hand, one with all sorts of twists. But when the bullets are flying, communication isn’t always perfect, so you’ll have to find clever ways around the tabletalk rules to make your plans come together.

If that doesn’t leave Trauma Team scraping you off the pavement, you’ll be customizing your character, crafting your deck, and making choices that will haunt you for scenarios to come…

See you in Night City, choom.

—description from the publisher

name: Cyberpunk Trading Card Game
description:
Mix and match your favorite Cyberpunk characters to create an unstoppable edge running crew. Over come your opponent not just by doing damage, but by completing gigs, gaining eddies, and increasing your rep as Night City Legends.

Your crew of three legends start in play face down as Eddies. You can sell 1 additional card from your hand to place it face down as an Eddie each turn.

Play units and gear using Eddies, or flip one of your legends, unlocking its unique abilities.

At the start of each turn, you'll roll one of your gig die and add it to your pool. When you attack another player with one of your units, if your attack isn't blocked, you steal one of their gigs.

The first player to begin their turn with 6 gigs wins!

name: Seoul Journey
description:
Welcome to Seoul Journey, where you embark on a day trip to Seoul, South Korea and plan your days wisely to visit iconic locations, indulge in festivals and food, shop for souvenirs, and summon mystical guardians for bonuses.

This is a heartfelt, strategic card game inspired by the neighborhoods, food, and hidden corners of Seoul. You’ll travel across the city, collect experiences, and build your own story of discovery through clever card play and tableau-building choices. It’s designed to feel cozy, meaningful, and smart—something you’ll want to play again and again.

Seoul Journey blends strategy, set collection, and market manipulation in a colorful, thematic package that captures the essence of Hallyu (Korean wave) with vibrant artwork inspired by Seoul's blend of tradition and modernity.

name: Cysmic
description:
Cysmic is an epic sci-fi strategy wargame set amidst a crumbling planet. Players assume the role of one of the factions on the planet that is fighting desperately to survive. Throughout the game, players gather resources, capture enemy units, and work to construct their colony ship. Once built, the colony ship must be launched once all of your units are evacuated. The faction to do so first not only escapes with their lives but also ends up destroying the planet with the force of their ship's ignition. There are no points in Cysmic. The winner is the player who completes the objective first.

THE STORY:
"The Space Exploration Expedition Network (SEEk) selected several leaders in various fields to lead an odyssey to Kepler-62e for terraforming and civilization planning. Some of the members were chosen and funded by the World Council while others self-financed their way to have influence or presence in the new world. Industry experts, religious leaders, entertainers, scholars, businessmen, politicians, and entrepreneurs all took part in the mission. Once there, the project worked beautifully at first. The different groups of people lived and worked together as a familiar society with all of the benefits and growing pains one would expect from a newly formed civilization. It had its share of infighting and corruption, but even those issues never threatened the delicate balance of this new world. It was slowly becoming the utopia many had hoped it would.

As the project moved forward, an unexpected instability in the terraforming process started wreaking havoc on the landscape. The news broke quickly that their efforts to terraform and create a better world had destabilized the planet. Their new Eden was doomed.

When the colonists realized there was no hope in saving their dream of a new civilization, chaos broke out among the hundreds of thousands of people as they turned to their respective leaders for salvation. Those in leadership roles... either voted in by public opinion, volunteered at will, ascended through capitalism, or ordained by faith... now rise to the occasion as wartime leaders.

Massive Terraformers that once bent the landscape to their will have now been taken over by powerful organizations and converted into colony ship construction and launch platforms. These rival factions compete for information and resources across the dying planet as their last hope to escape offworld in the original Colony Ship plans that brought them there to begin with.

After society splintered, the information splintered with it. Each faction holds part of the module plans to build the colony ship but must retrieve the others to finish their build. Instead of working together, they now battle for resources and information. Workers and civilians are hastily trained in combat to protect the individual faction bases from each other while still performing their regular job duties. Soldiers are tasked with capturing enemies with the knowledge of providing blueprints for the construction of the colony ship modules.

Once the leaders obtain the blueprints and construct their colony ship, they must launch it before the impending destruction of their homeworld. The immense energy exerted from a single colony ship launch will likely doom the rest. Which faction will gain the resources necessary to escape first?
If this new world war doesn’t destroy this utopia, the planet surely would."

GAMEPLAY SUMMARY:
Gameplay consists of managing your empire until you can safely evacuate your people offworld. Players must recruit units, explore their surroundings, wage war against enemies, manage their economy, and obtain the resources necessary to construct their Colony Ship. The game is played in rounds made up of 5 turns per round. Each turn, players play one Unit card or Tactic card and then perform a bonus action. Each round ends when all players complete 5 turns. The next round starts with whomever currently holds the first player token.

OBJECTIVE FOR WINNING THE GAME:
Be the first player to build their colony ship and launch off the planet. Be careful evacuating your units before launching or else your conscience may not allow you to leave.

name: D.O.T
description:
In D.O.T, you secretly play cards into personal and shared pools, manipulating colored dot totals to gain the highest scoring Difference.Over.Time.

The twist? The goalpost shifts. Sometimes you're rewarded for being far off the mark, and at other times for getting as close as possible.

Master the shifting logic, outwit your opponent, and disrupt their plans at just the right moment to claim victory.

—description from the publisher

name: Dakalio
description:
Dakalio is an abstract strategy game for 2 players set in space, the board acts as a planet gravity surface, so it works similar to a spherical board.

Players place Asteroids and move their spaceships around the planet creating paths in order to get Dakalio crystals and take them out while trying to block each other.

There are 2 ways to trigger end game.

Features:
-High replayability
-Offensive & Defensive win conditions
-Circular linked board
-Path building and blocking
-Exhaustion of pieces
-Portals
-Notation System

Four types of pieces:
-Spaceships
-Dakalio Crystals (Red & Blue)
-Asteroids
-Portals

Player turn, perform one of the following actions:
-Enter (place new spaceships on the board)
-Move (move spaceships already placed on the board, may trigger a portal move)
-Dakalio (take Dakalio crystals from planet)
-Asteroid (Place remaining asteroids on the board)

(Game end/Victory conditions)
Game ends when a player deliver 2 Dakalio crystals to control zone, or when the opponent can't move a spaceship with Dakalio crystal.

Dakalio Studio Discord Community: Go to -> Dakalio Studio
This is going to be official place to talk about the game and play online.
Features:
-How to play (rules, videos, tutorials)
-Async games
-Real time games
-Play against Dakaliobot
-Learn Dakalio notation system
-Sandbox mode (Explore the game alone and/or create modules)
-Discussion channels and forums.
-Download game states for future analysis.

name: Danger Forward: The Battle of Gela, July 1943
description:
Danger Forward is a complete game covering the Battle of Gela that took place between 10-12 July, 1943 in Sicily. Following the initial landings of Operation Husky, the Italians and Germans were determined to throw the American forces back into the sea. They launched a vigorous attack that nearly succeeded, shelling the beaches with tank fire. The American ground forces, supported by the Royal Navy and US Navy offshore, fought hard to prevent defeat. Not resting on their laurels, the Allied forces had to push inland to secure ports and airfields to ultimately take the island. Taking Sicily quickly led to the invasion of Italy and ultimately the downfall of Mussolini. All of that hung in the balance based on the results of the fighting at Gela.

The game showcases the unique forces involved at Gela, including the infamous Hermann Göring Panzer Division, the US 1st Infantry Division ("Big Red One"), US Rangers, and the Italian Livorno Division that acquitted itself well. The terrain depicts the unique Sicilian landscape, from the invasion beaches, the rough mountains inland, and the ubiquitous olive orchards that dotted the island.

Danger Forward is ideal for gameplay: a single map, a handful of formations, and a three turn game. Yet the situation and game variables allow for replayability. Veteran players will see dynamic situations as challenging for each side, and new players will learn the ropes of how to perfect strategy and tactics. The maps and counters use the larger format as in Arracourt. It's ideal for setting up and completing in a single game session.

Scenarios:

The Battle of Gela (Campaign)
Cent Beach (Intro Scenario)
Dime Beach (Small Scenario)
American Husky (Historical Ground Entries)
Bitter Victory (All Historical Setup)

—description from the publisher

name: Siege Perilous
description:
Sally forth into a living Arthurian world, a competitive sandbox teeming with knights and courtiers, sorcerers and warlords, giants and dragons – all drawn from over five hundred years of literature and lore. Deeds of derring-do await the worthy, but winning the famed seat known as the Siege Perilous will require more than a powerful sword arm. The knight who claims the chair will be an exemplar of both skill and virtue. Gird fast your harness, gather your arms and retinue, and forge a new legend – your own!

In this expansive (and expandable) Euro-style board game, 1 to 4 players will traverse 12 kingdoms that compose Arthur’s Britain, each kingdom containing unique interactable locations, including castles, churches, training towers, ports, markets, fountains, dungeons, and the famed Forest Sauvage. The map itself changes throughout the game, as new events arise, foreign campaigns become available, and Merlin appears with a task that needs doing.

As a player, you will choose from among 6 Player Characters: Dame Britomart, daughter of King Rience; Sir Claudin, son of the Gaulish tyrant; Sir Galleron, proud son of the Northern wilds; Dame Marfisa, warrior queen of the East; Sir Morien, hailing from distant Africa; Sir Priamus, descendent of Judas Maccabeus and Hector of Troy; Sir Sadok, former vassal of the foul King Mark; Sir Wigalois, a lost son of Camelot. Each character begins with a unique set of statistics, which you will endeavour to increase throughout play, plus a starting quest unique to them. From there, embark upon your knightly career as you see fit:

At one of 6 Tournament and Politick castles, test your Skills against one of 100 Courtiers and Knights to earn rewards, allies, and perhaps enemies.

Visit Churches to increase your Virtues, earn blessings, and heal wounds. Visit Training Towers to hone your Skills, earn spurs, and shed dishonour. Pass through a Market to earn coins and purchase one of 100 combat, court, horse, and nature assets to add to your equipage.

Take ship and seek adventure and glory abroad on one of 20 Foreign Campaigns: accept a diplomatic mission to Rome, destroy a sorceress’s deadly bower in Ireland, take the pilgrim’s road in Spain.

Undertake one of 20 intrigues for Merlin: solve the mystery of the Hound Knight, investigate a ship of Solomon, explore an ancient city beneath the waves.

Pay fealty to the High King Arthur at Camelot and be granted one of 20 Quests. Should you meet with success, you’ll choose from Earthly, Divine, or Wisdom rewards. Sanctify the ill-favoured Chapel Perilous, venture into the Otherworld to rescue a kidnapped damsel, end the curse of the lady who bathes in the blood of innocents.

Drop your reins and let your fate lead you to strange adventures and deadly peril in one of 30 Forest Sauvage encounters: visit a faerie market, decide the fate of a wounded giant, track and slay the ferocious Cath Palug, and perhaps receive a test – and if ye be worthy – a mighty gift from the Lady of the Lake.

Win and wield one of 22 Treasures – magical weapons, artifacts, creatures, and conveyances: the ancient spear of Lugh, the Chariot of Morgan Mwynfawr, the lord of hounds Cavall.

End your turn by visiting a Fountain for healing and reward, a Dungeon to imprison captured villains, or a Contest Site to test your mettle against your fellow players.

Earn Arthur’s favour to win one of 40 Titles to strengthen your claim to the Siege Perilous.

And that is just the base game. Undertake one of 6 Legendary Tales that introduce new challenges, characters (including new Starting Characters), and treasures: endeavour – collaboratively – to keep Arthur’s kingdom intact during a time of rebellions and invasions, wage an epic war against the emperor of Rome, thwart the nefarious plans of Morgan Le Fay, meet the challenges of Gloriana, the Faerie Queen.

Every element of the game – each character you meet, treasure you claim, weapon, follower, mount or animal companion you acquire – has been hand-painted using traditional Mediaeval techniques, pigments, and gold leaf by renowned artist Jay Johnstone – more than 250 original paintings in all, each of which conveys additional lore in its details.

Likewise, every narrative piece is derived from extensive research of Arthurian literature and adjacent texts—from Irish myth and ancient Welsh folklore, to the historical chronicles of Geoffrey of Monmouth, the courtly romances of Chrétien de Troyes, and the work of Thomas Malory. The game’s story elements incorporate mediaeval tales from Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and the Netherlands, all the way up through the Elizabethan allegory of Edmund Spenser’s The Faerie Queene.

But, in the end, this is your tale to weave, one threaded with each decision you make, each die you roll, as you explore the realm, increase your virtues and skills, and, ultimately, write a new legend by claiming the fabled – and deadly – Siege Perilous.

name: Darkwoods
description:
Without darkness there is no light, but darkness is all that is engulfing us and it has been spreading for years from the forest.

During the late evening we hear mournful screams and during night we see the silhouettes walking toward the town…

The sanctified items in the church are hot, we can’t even take them in our hands to fight the evil. What is happening, what is advancing toward no one knows! We need God’s merciful to save us from what is lurking from the Darkwoods!

Step into the role of valiant defenders guarding the last bastion of a fading empire, standing firm against the encroaching darkness of the foreboding Darkwoods. Alternatively, embrace the sinister allure of the demons and choose to align with the forces of darkness in this cooperative and competitive gaming experience.

In a world where each night brings forth hordes of bloodthirsty demonic creatures, the town's morale and faith must be upheld to survive. You can opt to maintain the flickering flame of hope within the town's people. Or, you can cast your lot with the corrupted Cults, collaborating with the demons in their relentless quest to obliterate humanity.

This deck-building and strategy game immerses you in a dark fantasy realm deeply inspired by the folklore, legends, and myths of Eastern European mediaeval history. Choose your path wisely, for the fate of the last remnants of humanity rests in your hands.

—description from the designer

name: DAVOS
description:
Welcome to the forum, and to this meeting in particular. It is an honor to sit here with those who represent the big capital in the world through your megalomanic investment firms.

Tonight in DAVOS, we are going to play out our activities for the coming 3,5 years. One by one we will be taking over the world's largest corporations in one of the 4 blocs; In America, Europe, China, or the Global South, infiltrate their governments and increase our influence through… other means. To make the world a better place... naturally!

Corporations don't just generate income. You'll need to make sure to pass favorable bills in parliament. You need to invest your assets strategically, balancing between corporations and politics. And balancing between reaching goals directly, or investing for improving your power position in future years.
