Do you crave more? Advance your game via the back room and gain control of institutions. Play together in the collaborative variant, or become dissident and follow an anti-agenda, disrupting other players.

name: Dawn of the Zeds: Designer Edition
description:
The world you knew is gone. Don't look now, but the dead are marching.

A deadly virus has turned ordinary people into vicious, zombie-like killers - the Zeds. They are now converging on your isolated hometown of Farmingdale. The National Guard is fighting its way to you, but you're alone, cut off, and the horde arrives now.

This isn't a game of simply surviving; it's a desperate fight to become the hope of all humankind.
The Defense of Farmingdale

In Dawn of the Zeds: Designer's Edition', you must coordinate and deploy the best defense possible across the town and its surrounding villages. As the Zeds advance along multiple, distinct avenues of approach, you'll depend on the bravery of ordinary citizens, who — with the right leadership — can emerge as stalwart heroes.

Your goal is two-fold:

     Hold the Line: Halt the Zeds' advance by “re-killing” them before they breach the crucial Town Center.
     Find the Cure: Research, discover, and implement a cure for the vile scourge that drives these monsters, thus helping save the remnants of humanity before it’s too late.


Every decision is a test of skill and nerve. Can you fight off the waves of Zeds while also protecting the townspeople? Will you survive long enough to unearth the cure? In this apocalyptic fever dream, the nightmare ends only with you being either a savior... or merely another zombie snack.

What's New in the Designer's Edition?

Dawn of the Zeds: Designer's Edition is a solitaire and cooperative survival horror game heavily influenced by the iconic States of Siege series. This new edition is a re-imagining of the first and second editions, serving as a comprehensive renewal of the franchise:


     Updated Mechanics: The game design has been re-engineered for a quicker, smoother, and more accessible experience.
     One Rulebook: All rules are consolidated into a single, concise book, making it easier for both new and returning players.
     New Content: Most of the original characters and events are back, alongside a sprinkling of brand-new heroes, units, events, and modes of play.
     Uncompromised Horror: This edition maintains the deep horror narrative, thematic events, and engaging fun that made the Dawn of the Zeds franchise a classic. The traditional horror mood is alive and well ... errr, I mean ... undead and not-so-well.


—description from the publisher

name: DC Breakout: Arkham Asylum
description:
Make a mad dash out of Arkham Asylum – again! You've broken out before, though, so to make things more interesting, you've challenged your fellow rogues of Gotham City to a race to freedom. Can you make your daring getaway before your opponents?

In DC Breakout: Arkham Asylum, each player gets five villains from Batman's history, then chooses two teams of two villains, with each team competing in one of two races. Hundreds of possible duos exist, with each villain having a unique power that can be supplemented with gadgets to gain the upper hand over your rivals. Whoever wins the second race wins the entire game.

name: DC Super Heroes United
publisher: CMON Global Limited; Spin Master Ltd.
description:
The greatest heroes in the DC universe unite to thwart the villains' plans in DC Super Heroes United, a fast-paced, family-friendly co-operative game.

Build your team of legendary Heroes to thwart the master plan of the most powerful Villains in the universe. Simple rules, deep strategy, easy setup, quick playtime, variable difficulty, eye-catching artwork, and amazing miniatures.

A cooperative fighting game where players attempt to defeat the team of villains.

—description from the publisher

name: DCeased: A Zombicide Game
publisher: CMON Global Limited; DC; Guillotine Games; Spin Master Ltd.
description:
Not even the most powerful Super Heroes in the universe are safe from the the Anti-Life Equation, a techno-organic virus that quickly spread around the world’s digital networks. The Justice League has been torn apart (quite literally) and now former enemies join forces as old allies must be put down before they can sow even more destruction. So, assemble you Super Hero team, muster all the power you can, and stand against the DCeased!

DCeased – A Zombicide Game is a cooperative game where players control the last uninfected Super Heroes facing off against Zombie Heroes and the zombie hordes controlled by the game itself.

The goal is to complete Mission Objectives, defeat the Enemies, and rescue Bystanders. Eliminating zombies gives you the experience needed to become an even more powerful Super Hero. But the stronger you are, the more zombies appear to hunt you down! Only by working together and pushing their powers to the limit can the Super Heroes hope to put an end to the Anti-Life threat!

name: Soothsayers
description:
You are a powerful mystic in a tense race against rivals to control the fate of the universe. Capture the Empress, the Moon, even Death itself, and harness the arcane powers of the tarot to bend destiny to your will.

On your turn, choose an action: earn coins, draft cards, ascend to higher levels, or capture a tarot card. Rival soothsayers may choose to follow your action, but if you have a higher level, they must pay you for the privilege.

Each tarot card you capture grants you a new game-changing ability. Combine these with your leveled-up actions to create unstoppable combos.

Seize the tokens of Fate before your rivals to win the game!

—description from the publisher

name: Tales of the Arabian Nights: 40th Anniversary
description:
The newest version of the Tales of the Arabian Nights celebrating its 40th anniversary. Enter the lands of the Arabian Nights alongside Sindbad, Scheherazade, Aladdin, and the other legendary heroes of the 1001 Tales. Travel the world encountering imprisoned princesses, powerful `efreets, evil viziers, and such marvels and the enigmatic Magnetic Mountain, the terrifying Ape Island, and the lustrous Crystal Palace.

The classic, award-winning storytelling game returns with you choosing your actions. While gameplay remain essentially the same, updates include 200+ new paragraphs in the story book, gender neutral game play, additional encounter cards, shortened status time periods, new terrain encounter rules, faster time of day shifts, and faster game play with fewer Destiny and Story points needed to win.  Solo adventures may be purchased separately.

—description from the publisher

name: DeckHand: Race for Infamy
description:
Over five quick rounds, you'll trade rum, gather weapons, and tame wild creatures in your quest for infamy!

Each round has two key phases: drafting cards to plan your strategy, then building to expand your fleet and compete for Infamy cards. Every card you build strengthens your fleet, unlocking new opportunities and expanding your reach.

Simultaneous play keeps games fast and lively, even with up to five players.

—description from the designer

name: DECKO
description:
To win in this surreal deckbuilding game players buy supernatural poker cards, burn cards to thin their decks and bend the rules using a plethora of jokers.

The game is structured like a traditional poker game, players bet chips on their poker hands by raising or calling the bet, or fold to get a free new card. Players also get to permanently remove one card from their deck per hand by doing the burn action. After each hand is played all players that didn't win or fold get to buy new special playing cards and jokers, increasing their chances of winning in later rounds.

As the game progresses players will become increasingly powerful and asymmetric in their abilities. The player who has the most poker chips after twelve rounds wins the game.

—description from the designer

name: Wee Folk
description:
In the hush of twilight, where moonlight threads through ancient leaves, the Wee Folk stir. They dance in patterns unseen by mortal eyes, leaving trails of magic etched in shape and shadow.

Wee Folk is a two-player game of gentle rivalry, where you’ll slide cards like stones across still water, weaving polyomino patterns to echo the hidden sigils of the fae. Where strategy wears the robes of story, and each game is a spell softly cast.

Wee Folk is a 2-player card game where you are attempting to arrange various Wee Folk into pattern in order to collect them.

Collected cards might include actions which may be spent to alter a player's personal tableau. Cards shift in a "Candy Crush" style whenever sets are removed from the play area.

—description from the publisher

name: Defiance: 2nd Russo-Ukrainian War 2022-? Volume 1 – Miracle on the Dnipro 2022
description:
Defiance: 2nd Russo-Ukrainian War 2022-? Volume 1: Miracle on the Dnipro 2022 (“Defiance”) covers the initial 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine with the Kyiv and Chernihiv campaigns from February 24, 2022 to roughly April 1, 2022. Defiance builds upon Victory Games’ (Mark Herman’s) Flashpoint Golan (1991), adds a strategic political component (David Dockter's) Triumph of Chaos (2019), and updates the system for modern multi-domain warfare/the expanded revolution in military affairs (eRMA). As a first draft of history, Defiance strives to simulate an ongoing conflict; a significant design challenge, but one worth tackling.

At its core, Defiance is a simulation where players purchase formation chits with logistics points, pull chits from a cup of chaos, and play by activating a formation to conduct movement & combat, while avoiding enemy detection & response. HQs figure prominently in the game by providing operational points to their units, summoning assets (air, missiles, drones, helicopters) and utilizing capabilities to compliment formation performance.

In Defiance, there are no victory conditions per se. The object of the simulation is for the Russian side to displace the Ukrainian government from Kyiv (“Displacement”), while the Ukrainian side strives to prevent.

Scenarios:


     The game includes multiple two-player scenarios, including several shorter scenarios plus a campaign game.
     A bot for Russia allows solitaire play of the Ukrainian side in each scenario.


Scale:

     Operational/Strategic
     Time: 3-4 days
     Formations: Brigade/Armies
     Units: Battalions and companies


—description from the publisher

name: Denkō
description:
Spirits benevolent, mischievous, and malevolent descend from Mount Denkō to spread mayhem. Your mission as a samurai in the game Denkō: Drive them from your lands...even if that forces them into your rivals' domain.

Reveal the attacking Yōkai cards and strike them at the right time and in the right place. Simple, but the Curses of the Yōkai introduce new mechanics every turn!

Can you master all the rules, or will you end up overwhelmed?

name: Der Wanderzirkus
description:
Combine clever deck building with the domino principle to create spectacular card chains and make every performance a highlight!

You manage a traveling circus that tours European cities, hiring performers and tailoring each show to a city’s specific tastes and requirements.

Across a series of rounds players select the next city, recruit a new artist into a growing deck, tell the audience what to expect, and then stage the performance by playing cards domino-style to form chains. Scoring rewards meeting the city’s goals, creating long color-matched links, and leveraging individual artists’ abilities, so timing and card order become tactical as your deck evolves. The highest total score wins.

The game supports 1–6 players and includes solo and advanced variants.

name: Detectives Vs Criminals
description:
In twentieth-century Europe, the best Criminals of all time have come together to steal some extraordinary treasures such as the Sword of Napoleon, The Ingots of the Orient Express or The Bracelet of Osiris. Only the most shrewd Detectives will be able to arrest them!
Choose which character to play, including, for example, the magician Zoltan Kovács, the archaeologist Maia Ioannidis, the former police commissioner Zac Clifford and the zoologist Naira Nandez.
Play in the Detective team to give instructions to the Police Officers, find Clues, follow the tracks of the Criminals and try to arrest them.
Wanna choose the Criminals instead? Move in the shadow, but mind no to reveal your moves and have your thugs guard your back while you reach the cities where treasures are kept!

—description from the designer

name: Devious
description:
Devious is an anti-set collection card game. Build the strongest faerie alliance over five rounds and claim the crown. To do so you must play and hold in your tableau a single faerie from each of the faerie tribes, of the highest rank possible. But be wary, a second faerie of a given tribe negates your score - and more than two plunges your score into the negatives. Seek only the highest ranking faerie from each tribe for the strongest alliance possible. But each tribe has a unique power and the ability to manipulate faeries from around the table, including your own. Gaining the upper hand will be both chaotic and devious.

To set up before the game, players decide which six faerie tribes to use in the game from the 13 suits included in the box. They can be mixed and matched so game play varies from game to game.

In each round, all players are dealt three cards. But interestingly, they are not yours, they are your opponents. You look at them, decide  the order in which to stack them - and therefore in which order your opponent will later encounter them, then pass that stack in the direction of play. Likewise, you'll receive your stack in the same way.

Then look at the top card of the three-card stack and announce your intention to keep the card for your tableau or discard it, hoping for a better card your opponent may have buried deeper. If you choose to keep, discard the remaining stack of cards, without seeing them. If you choose to discard, look at the second card and choose to keep or discard. If the first two are discarded, the third card MUST be played. Did your opponent trick you into playing the worst card at the bottom of the stack. Was the best card the first card, which you discarded?

Once everyone has chosen their faerie card for the round, they are played in order of their Rank. The highest Rank plays their card into their tableau and executes the faerie's ability. Some Faerie Powers are only important for scoring purposes at the end of the game. Others have effects that target one or more faeries in play. A cunning player may choose to pass on a high ranking faerie for an ability that is more powerful when played later.

After the fifth round, players score each faerie suit in their alliances:

1 card of a Tribe: Score its Rank (from 1 to 5, depending on the card).
2 cards of the same Tribe: Score 0 points.
3-4 cards of a given Tribe: Lose points equal to the highest Ranking faerie in the Tribe.
5 or more cards of a Tribe: Score the summed value of all the fairies in the Tribe.
The player with the highest favor score wins.

Then, change the faerie bands in the deck, with their own unique powers for a new challenge and constant variety in play.

name: Devour the Heart!
description:
In the wake of the Marrow Queen's murder, Mecinar has been thrown into chaos. With the throne vacant and the city in turmoil, you must gain influence and snatch enough gold in order to seize power in just five short days, before the coronation of the next Monarch!

Use your Agents to infiltrate the city, start fights in the shadows with your Troops, and enlist common folk to your cause with the promise of fresh water and wealth in this 2-4 player asymmetrical territory-control game. After five rounds of corrupting, fighting, and looting, victory points are tallied based on a combination of spread corruption, amassed gold, and public objectives.

Do you have what it takes to Devour the Heart of Mecinar and ascend to the throne in this game of strategy?

—description from the designer

name: Bacon Lettuce Throwdown
description:
Welcome to the fast-paced world of sandwich-making and throwing things at your friends.

Bacon Lettuce Throwdown is the perfect recipe that combines Spoons, Overcooked, and the POWER OF BACON into one unforgettable game night!

Race other players to collect ingredients that match a shared pool of recipe cards. Everyone plays at the same time, passing and collecting meats, cheese, and veggies to claim as many recipes as possible.

Win a recipe with bacon as an ingredient? Grab the bacon plush, toss it at a friend, and force them to discard their whole hand.

Claim the most recipes and points over five rounds and be declared the ultimate sandwich-maker!

—description from the publisher

name: Dice Commandos
description:
Listen up, warriors. We didn’t fly halfway around the world, crawl through mosquito-infested hell, and bleed on foreign soil just to play it safe. You were chosen because you’re the best, not the prettiest, not the friendliest, the best. Out there in the green, it’s not just insurgents with AKs and bad attitudes. It’s worse. There are things moving in those trees that don’t show up on recon. Things that shouldn’t exist. But the mission stands. You infiltrate, eliminate, extract… whatever it takes. You leave nothing but smoke and shell casings in your wake.

Now lock and load, because this ain’t a peacekeeping stroll, this is war turned up to eleven. You’ll face warlords drunk on power, creatures straight outta nightmares, and something hiding in the jungle that hunts like a ghost and kills like a machine. But you’re commandos, you’re elite, unbreakable, and armed to the damn teeth. They want to chew you up and spit you out? Then let ’em choke on shrapnel. Welcome to the jungle. Time to make some noise.

Dice Commandos is a solo action and stealth dice puzzle game where you control a team of Commandos trying to complete objectives and complete your mission. You will use your dice to move around the map, combat with enemy dice and use special abilities and actions found on Events, your Commandos and Load Out cards.

—description from the designer

name: Dice Horde
description:
Dice Horde, is a solo tower defense roll-and-write where you lead the charge against a wild incursion of dice-headed beasts bursting through fresh rifts to crash your last bastion!

Each round starts with a dice roll that sets the horde's march: those cube-headed critters pushing forward like they're late for a raid.
The same roll hands you your defenses – quick battlements, quirky ward-towers, and gadgets thrown together by frantic engineers – all to keep the tide from flooding your stronghold.

Enemies arrive as dice marching across your board, their pips driving the assault: higher numbers send them charging ahead fast-most of the time-slamming your nearest tower like a horde storming the gates.

But you're in control! Chip away at their values with attacks to slow 'em down and knock 'em out. When a die drops to zero, it tumbles into the graveyard – your handy pile of shattered bits and odds and scraps.

Collect those pieces to boost upgrades, spring sneaky traps, shore up barricades, or rally elite guards. Master the dice-tweaking tango against these rift-spilling fiends, and you could slam those portals shut. Mess it up? The Dice Horde overruns everything, turning your realm into a really big mess!

Sharpen your pencil, shake those cubes, man the walls and defend your kingdom!

—description from the publisher

name: Dice Quest: The Tower of the Elephant
description:
In Dice Quest: The Tower of the Elephant, you dive into a legendary sword and sorcery tale inspired by Robert E. Howard’s classic story. With just 55 cards and a few dice, you’ll climb the tower, face deadly traps, and battle supernatural creatures while managing your dice to survive each challenge.

In Dice Quest: The Tower of the Elephant, you embark on a daring adventure of exploration and dice management inspired by classic sword and sorcery tales. You’ll travel through perilous locations, facing guards, traps, and strange creatures as you make your way toward the mysterious tower. Along the journey, you’ll recruit allies, gather powerful items, and train your abilities to prepare for the final challenge. Your ultimate goal: reach the top and steal the wizard’s gem before he vanishes with it forever.

—description from the publisher

name: 13 Leaves
publisher: Cranio Creations; CMYK; Elznir Games; Gigamic; Portal Games
description:
Enjoy the foliage, discover all the colors and shapes that nature can offer, and create a beautiful and satisfying grading sequence!

In 13 Leaves, players can play one or more cards of the same value that align with the sequence on the table. The cards must be of a value equal to or lower than the lowest card in the sequence, or of a value equal to or higher than the highest card in the sequence.

The game consists of several rounds. Each round is divided into turns that proceed clockwise. On their turn, the active player, if they can and if they want, plays one or more cards of the same value from their hand. Multiple cards of the same value are stacked on top of each other to show how many cards of that value are present on the table. Cards of different values are placed in numerical order forming a sequence on the table.

The first player to play all the cards in their hand wins. At the end of the rules, you'll find the expert variant, which consists of playing multiple games in a row with a scoring at the end of each game.

—description from the publisher

name: Dicequest
description:
Dicequest is a dice-pool builder for 1 to 4 players in which each player assembles a party of up to three heroes to face quests, gain items, and earn victory points.
The game unfolds over three acts, each raising the stakes and expanding the players’ tactical options.

In Act I, players begin their adventure by recruiting their first heroes and attempting introductory quests.

During Act II, quests become more challenging, heroes level up, and players acquire powerful items that enhance their party’s abilities.

Finally, in Act III, legendary heroes become available as players prepare for the final showdown against the ultimate boss.

At the end of the final battle, the player with the highest score is crowned the victor.

Game play modes: competitively, cooperatively, or solo.

name: Age of Galaxy (Second Edition)
description:
Age of Galaxy is a strategic 4X game that places you in control of an interstellar alliance consisting of three factions with unique powers. You can explore systems, colonize planets, research technologies, build galactic cruisers, and much more. You have many potential paths to victory based on how your factions work together and the main ideology of your alliance. The five ideologies:


    Supporters of Science commit themselves to lifelong research on new technologies, convinced that knowledge is the only way forward.
    Upholders of Militarism are merciless aggressors who conquer by might, regarding wars as a means to an end.
    Keen adopters of Diplomacy prioritize relations between factions, acting tactfully while competing to become the head of the Congress.
    Factions that value Industrialism undertake ambitious construction schemes to turn planets into highly-developed cities and industrial complexes.
    As for factions that advocate Culturalism, they take pride in cultivating spiritual and cultural growth, always curious about the insights the mysterious "relics" might offer.


Faction cards can be played in multiple ways, with players either integrating them into their empire or sacrificing them for one-time benefits through agreements. More than thirty factions are included in the game.

This second edition of Age of Galaxy introduces an enhanced solo mode, new graphic design, and improved components to enrich the gameplay experience.

name: Digging Bandits: Founders Edition
publisher: Think Inside The Box Creative Inc.
description:
Saddle up for DIGGING BANDITS, a competitive Wild West board game of treasure hunting and treachery. An ancient map whispers of a golden fortune buried deep beneath the shifting sands, but you ain’t the only bandit listening! Expect direct conflict and strategic card play: block paths, steal loot, and collect WANTED posters to eliminate the competition. Will your mix of luck and cunning lead you to find the GOLD and cash it in first, or will you outlast your rivals to be the last bandit standing? Only the desert knows!

Players move clockwise around the game board by rolling two dice. The digging mechanic is central to the game, with players using Dig cards to uncover layers of land, seeking valuable items like gold and WANTED posters while avoiding hazards such as dynamite. The game also includes a rich layer of strategy, with Draw cards that allow players to hinder each other, build and destroy bridges, or steal items, creating an intense, ever-shifting battle for victory. Special "db Doodad" power-up cards give players game-changing boosts, while bluffing, alliances, and out-of-sequence card play add psychological and social elements to the experience.

The game is designed for 2-4 players, ages 10 and up, with an average playtime of 30-60 minutes. It includes both competitive and cooperative play modes, with a 2v2 team variant and a quick-play option for shorter sessions.

—description from the publisher

name: Bohemians
publisher: Portal Games; Devir; DSV Games; Gém Klub Kft.; IELLO; Old Dawg; Pegasus Spiele
description:
In Bohemians, players take on the roles of artists wandering the streets of Paris at the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries, striving to create masterpieces while facing the challenges of daily life. Bohemians is a card-driven game in which players collect cards to find inspiration, seek muses, and manage everyday necessary tasks.

In each round, players must plan that day's routine and decide whether they will go on a date, participate in a social event, meet their muse, create new art, or...go to work. Each card offers them various bonuses and inspiration, so carefully managing your card supply and the order in which they're played is crucial to getting the most inspiration. Players then spend their inspiration to purchase cards and build their deck with new habits, inspiring muses, or new achievements in their career. The artist who acquires the most achievements from the achievements deck wins.

The prototype of Bohemians won three nominations and one award (Best Presentation, Best Innovation, Best Game) at Fastaval, Denmark's largest convention for board games and roleplaying games.

—description from the publisher

name: Cthulhu: Dark Providence
publisher: CMON Global Limited; HIT Games; Portal Games; Reflexshop; Rexhry
description:
Set in the Cthulhu: Death May Die, Dark Providence is a competitive game in which players take on secret roles of Investigators, Cultists Or Dissidents from the most influential cities of the United States during the Great Depression. While the Cultists explore the nation's vulnerability seeking to remake it into a twisted version of itself by consorting with unspeakable beings from nightmarish dimensions, Investigators take the opposite side, standing against this dark providence. Meanwhile Dissidents are no longer part of either side. Dissidents score points for assassinating Agents and for sealing and protecting Gates.  As enemies of both sides of the struggle, concealing their identity is paramount.

Each player's secret alignment determines how they’ll score points at the end of the game, however, this is not a cooperative game. During the game players use Influence cubes to bid for the right to claim Asset cards, take control of cities, and gather Mythos cards. Each new Asset card acquired improves the players’ deck and therefore the resources and actions they can perform during a turn. At the center of Dark Providence’s deck building mechanics lie the Asset cards. All players start the game with the same 10 initial cards. Regardless of their strategy, acquiring new Asset cards is fundamental to improve their decks.

Trying to keep their identity secret and avoid insanity, players perform a multitude of actions, swaying Hired Agents to their side of the battle, assassinating other players’ Agents, gathering additional help from Mythos cards, blocking other players from claiming cards, and sealing or protecting Gates, among others to gain Victory Points. At the end, only the player with the most Victory Points of the dominant side of the battle will win the game!

Dark Providence also has a brand new solo version in which a single player comes face-to-face with an Elder One attempting to corrupt the nation. The player takes the side of Investigators and plays against 1 of 6 Elder Ones, each with unique features and goals.

—description from the publisher

name: Emberleaf
publisher: The City of Games; Cranio Creations; DSV Games; Mosaico Jogos; Portal Games; Skellig Games
description:
Emberleaf is a competitive card-dancing and tile-placement board game.

As a brave Emberling, your mission is to rebuild your home in the heart of an ancient forest. To succeed, you'll explore the wilderness, gather resources, clear dangerous areas, and construct new homes for your kin. Along the way, you'll recruit heroes into your fellowship, each bringing unique skills that will help empower your team. But beware - space in the forest is limited, and other Emberlings have their own plans.

The game features:


     Card Dancing: Place hero cards within your moving grid to activate skills and enhance your fellowship. Slide cards to trigger powerful combinations and charge them at the perfect moment for even greater effects.
     Tile Placement: Build vibrant villages to address the diverse needs of your villagers.
     Engine Building: Recruit heroes to acquire new skills and empower your existing fellowship.
     Resource Management: Navigate the forest, clear dangerous areas, and collect essential resources.


Every decision you make shapes the destiny of your people. Can you rise to the challenge, guide your village to prosperity, and win the heart of your fellow Emberlings?

—description from the publisher

name: Eternal Decks
publisher: Tricktakers Games; asmodee; Boardgame Ban Fan; HIT Games; Pixie Games; Portal Games; Portland Game Collective; Salt & Pepper Games; Strohmann Games; 桌遊拌飯
description:
Eternal Decks is a limited communication co-operative game in which players try to complete the stage objectives before any one player cannot take an action. Players start the game with five cards in their deck, but will quickly look to acquire more cards from the various Eternals (characters within the game) who each have their own unique eight-card deck. On your turn, you must perform one action:


     Play a card (on the field, on the river, or by using an ability)
     Generate a jewel
     Give a card to a teammate


There are restrictions when playing a card. All three rows in the field cannot have cards of the same color or same number next to each other. Additional restrictions are applied to a row based on the stage you are playing. Jewels are used to negate the negative effects brought on by the Eternals.

The game has six stages, and the various stages will have you collect points, survive a ghost town, navigate a labyrinth, defeat a boss, and more to win the game!

name: Disco Heist Laundry
description:
Travel back in time to the radical 1980s where you'll put together a crew of criminals for the heist of the decade. Play a Crew member to your tableau, move about the city to avoid the cops, gather intel, and then grab the most cash when the window of opportunity opens.  After you've stolen your big score, you'll need to cash out and launder that money to win the game.

In Disco Heist Laundry, you control a Kingpin and their gang of thugs aiming to launder the most money and get away with it so that they can retire in infamy. On your turn, you play a Crew card to your tableau, move about the city, and activate any abilities in your tableau to recruit, heist, extort, and escape from the cops. The perfect heist isn't the one with the most money, but instead the one you get away with. This game is your chance to compete with other criminals to recruit the perfect crew for the biggest score, and launder that money so you can retire in the lap of luxury.

—description from the designer

name: Discovery: The Expandable Card Game
description:
Discovery is a 1v1, constructed, duelling card game, set in a fantasy world where four guilds battle for control over a mysterious island that’s risen from the sea. Leaning heavily into thematic design, it allows players to pull from faction and archetype-specific mechanics to create their perfect decks, with a variety of win conditions to choose from.

Assuming the role of a powerful Hero, each of your chosen Minions and Spells will follow your every command as you set out to complete your Quest. The Quest system is an elegant marriage of mechanics, art and short-form storytelling that streamlines resource systems and deck building, while offering strategic depth and making the genre more accessible.

—description from the designer

name: Neuroshima Hex: Battle
description:
Neuroshima Hex: Battle is a fast-paced and dynamic version of Neuroshima Hex designed for two players to enter this rich world.

The box features the armies of Steel Police and Beasts. The Steel Police brings law and order fanatics clad in experimental power armor with a unique reflection ability that turns enemy attacks back on them. The Beasts represent feral survivors of Moloch's attack, introducing friendly fire mechanisms and a primal, unpredictable style of play. Both factions add unique strategies and flavor to this intense two-player experience. The game includes a playing mat, two armies, tokens, and a new rulebook.

—description from the publisher

name: Race to Berlin (Second Edition)
description:
Race to Berlin is a game portraying the last months of World War II in Europe as Western Allied armies cross the borders of the Reich after forging the Rhine and the mighty Red Army prepares for its final offensive toward Berlin.

Players take on the roles of Soviet and Allied commanders, competing to capture strategic regions of Germany and ultimately claim the capital of the Third Reich. The game was first released in 2015, and this Portal Games' edition features significantly improved components, a revised rulebook, and some rule adjustments based on experience with the first edition.

—description from the publisher

name: Zombicide: White Death
publisher: CMON Global Limited; Geekach LLC; Guillotine Games; Hobby World; Portal Games
description:
Zombicide: White Death is taking the medieval fantasy setting out into the cold, to the icy lands of a city known as Wintergrad. In addition to the new environment, Zombies, and Survivors, this new installment also brings updated rules and new thrilling mechanics that will send a chill up our spines!

Zombicide: White Death is a cooperative game where players face hordes of Zombies controlled by the game itself. Each player controls 1 to 6 Survivors in a fantasy city besieged by Zombies. Once a Quest (a game scenario) has been set, the goal is simply to have fun completing the objectives, surviving and killing as many Zombies as possible!

Zombies are slow and predictable, but there are a lot of them. Watch out for their Abomination and Necromancer bosses, too! Survivors use whatever they can get their hands on to kill Zombies. The better the weapon, the higher the body count, but the more Zombies will appear, attracted by the onslaught.

Survivors can trade equipment and players can share tactics. Only through cooperation can players achieve victory! Battling Zombies is fun, and Survivors will have a lot to do while exploring the besieged Wintergrad: rescuing fellow Survivors, protecting vital areas, neutralizing dire threats, and much, much more!

—description from the publisher

name: DJ Icon
description:
Spin your way into the hearts of fans as you battle to become an iconic DJ!

DJ Icon is a board game for casual gamers and hobby enthusiasts alike. Featuring a rotating record and an intuitive card system, players rotate the record, their opponents, fans and themselves in a battle to win the best set of fans. While easy enough for those who are unfamiliar to the new age of board games to pick up, DJ Icon also features variations that create deeper gameplay for those who want more of a challenge.

DJ Icon is for 2-8 players, takes 30-70 minutes to play depending on player count and launched on Kickstarter on 10/14/25.

name: Don Quixote
description:
Don Quixote sets out in pursuit of noble ideals, charging ahead with passion and conviction.
Yet not every victory brings glory, and blind ambition can easily lead to folly.
In this game, winning a trick is often a risk rather than a reward. Try to avoid taking tricks whenever you can. If you cannot, take exactly what is required — no more, no less. And it is wiser to claim a trick that holds points.
Careful judgment, not reckless triumph, is the key to success.

—description from the publisher

name: Doodlebugs!: The First Week of Operation Eisbär, 1944
description:
Doodlebugs! is a solitaire game in which the player controls the British response to the V-1 rocket (nicknamed Doodlebugs, also Buzz Bombs) launches of Flak Regiment 155 located along the coast of France across the channel. Their target...London!

The game covers the first week of Operation Eisbär, which began on June 13, 1944. The game concludes after the last phase of the game is completed for June 20. The actual campaign continued until March 1945. At its peak, more than one hundred V-1s a day were fired at southeast England, 9,521 in total.

The goal of the player (playing the British side) is to prevent the Germans from gaining a victory, which would bring a tremendous propaganda coup for Nazi Germany.  This done by shooting down the V-1 rockets as they cross the channel heading for London, as well as suppressing  fires started as a result of V-1 rockets hitting their target.

—description from the publisher

name: The Green Conquest
description:
The Green Conquest is a grid-based strategic boardgame where you take control of a clan made up of steampunk vehicles to collect a mysterious resource : Trimetium. The game mechanics are centered around combining the vehicles’ special abilities and an innovative damage calculation system we call "Momentum."

In The Green Conquest, your goal is to collect the four resources on the board: a Trimétium-charged mushroom, an underground deposit, a mutant flower, and a Trimétium crystal. The first player to collect all four resources wins the game.

Beware, however: Dreamare Island is inhabited by dangerous mutant creatures. And the other players won't hesitate to charge you with their combat vehicles to destroy you and eliminate you from the game!

—description from the designer

name: Dr. Finn's Book of 2-Player Strategy and Word Games
description:
Dr. Finn's Book of 2-Player Strategy and Word Games contains eight two-player games that can be played in the book without cutting them out. Each game uses one sheet of paper and requires only a pen or pencil. The book contains eight unique set-ups for each of the eight games.

You can play theses game on a plane, in a cafe, or almost anywhere! Bring along on your next your vacation!

The eight games include 5 strategy games and 3 word games. The strategy games are:
Speculators
Starry-Eyed
Fish Mongers
Detectorists
Tic-Tac-Dough

The word games are:
Eloquacious
Quill Seeker
Spell Track

—description from the publisher

name: Dr. Science
description:
In Dr. Science, each player is a brilliant PhD competing to earn prestige by playing tricks, building hypotheses, and validating their findings. On your turn, you’ll play a card to the current trick — choosing from your hand or tableau — and optionally add cards to your hypothesis (your personal tableau of sets and runs), then draw a new card from the display. Score points by taking tricks and validating 2–4 cards at once, but only if your entire hypothesis remains valid.

Every player has their own Specialty suit, acting as a personal trump that can shift the tide of any trick — but only one trump can be active at a time! Balancing trick play with long-term tableau building creates rich decisions every turn. Will you spend a card to win a trick, or save it to complete your next big breakthrough?

Play smart, validate often, and become the most celebrated scientist!

—description from the designer

name: World Order
publisher: Hegemonic Project Games; Bumble3ee Interactive; Gém Klub Kft.; Giant Roc; HIT Games; Lavka Games; Portal Games; Super Meeple
description:
The year is 2010, and the world is drastically changing. While the once-unrivaled influence of the United States is beginning to wane, other major powers are eagerly stepping onto the stage, ready to claim their piece of the geopolitical pie. In the East, Beijing is rising to become a global powerhouse. Simultaneously, Moscow is entangled in an intricate chess game with Washington, ready to counter its every move. And amidst these tumultuous waters, the European Union is trying to carve out its identity and role in the international stage.

The world is undergoing a drastic shift, while power is being redistributed on a global scale — but who will take the lead in this rapidly changing world order?

The board game World Order simulates modern international relations, with players taking control of one of the four dominant global powers of the 2010s: the United States of America, the People's Republic of China, the Russian Federation, and the European Union. Utilize your diplomatic power, economic strength, and military might to expand your influence across the globe. Form regional alliances, entice other nations through clever economic dependencies, or become the military juggernaut no one dares to mess with.

World Order blends academic theories with thrilling gameplay, creating a never-before-seen experience of international relations! Join the fight and show the other powers that a new era is dawning!

name: Ministry of Lost Things: Case 1 – Lint Condition
description:
Embark on a journey through the Elusiverse, a realm of forgotten treasures and misplaced memories. As a scout for the Ministry of Lost Things, your mission is to find and return an item mistakenly taken from your world. To do so, you’ll need to uncover details about the item and its owner, navigating the landscape of a place where lost items weave a grand tapestry of stories.

Lint Condition is the first case in the Ministry of Lost Things series. It contains four envelopes which need to be solved in sequence, each revealing more about the lost item and its companion as you solve the puzzles. At the end of each envelope, verify your solutions online in the M.O.L.T website portal to progress to the next step.

—description from the publisher

name: Pandora's Legacy
description:
Pandora’s Legacy, TED-Ed’s first physical game, is an innovative experience that combines elements of jigsaw puzzles, escape rooms, puzzle hunts, and legacy board games into 12-15 hours of immersive, cooperative gameplay for 1-4 players.

Assembling the jigsaw is only the beginning. To progress, you’ll need to solve puzzles found within the jigsaw, escape-room style. Some solutions will reward you with gorgeous and perplexing physical artifacts that are themselves puzzles that must be solved. Others will unlock the next set of jigsaw pieces that expand the illustration and propel the story forward.

In this adventure, Pandora doesn’t just accept her fate after giving in to curiosity and opening her box; she is determined to set things right. That’s where you come in. Playing as Pandora, with the help (and hindrance) of your favorite Olympians, your mission is to corral the chaos you created when you opened the box. There's just one more problem...well, actually, 17 “problems”.

Pandora’s Legacy contains 17 boxes. Box Alpha contains the pieces of the main section of the jigsaw. Once you assemble that, you’ll receive clues for solving the first puzzle hidden within the jigsaw via a companion website. Solving the puzzles unlocks more boxes. Some contain physical artifacts that are themselves puzzles. Others will reward you with more jigsaw pieces, filling in more of the illustration and advancing the narrative. The puzzles are challenging, but accessible to solvers of all experience levels. If you get stuck at any point, the in-game hint system includes more than 200 hints designed to gently nudge you in the right direction.

Countless surprises await, all leading up to the climactic finale of Pandora's quest to set right the chaos she unleashed upon the world.

—description from the designer

name: Emerald Echoes
description:
Emerald Echoes is a narrative puzzle adventure featuring beautifully-illustrated puzzles and tactile artifacts. Through the eyes of a historical researcher, players uncover the story of a legendary alchemist and her companions. Told over four chapters, Emerald Echoes is a standalone sequel to The Emerald Flame.

Within each chapter, there is a collection of unlabeled items, along with a series of green puzzle folders labeled numerically in the order they should be solved (1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and so on). There are thirteen puzzle folders in total. There are also some blue folders that do not contain any puzzles but should be opened as part of the same numerical sequence to reveal more pieces of the story.

Each green folder contains at least one written document to investigate — this should be used as a jumping off point as you piece together which items are needed to solve the puzzle. Within each puzzle folder is also a pocket with a card labeled “Analysis,” featuring incremental hints, as well as the solution, for each puzzle.

—description from the designer

name: Dragon's Domain
description:
In Dragon's Domain, players embark on an epic adventure into the depths of a treacherous dungeon to confront the fearsome dragon, Arathor. Each game session features 4 unique heroes, each equipped with customizable skills from two categories, allowing for strategic play and character development. Additionally, each hero has a unique, powerful skill that can be used once per game, adding a layer of tactical depth and excitement.

The dungeon is constructed from double-sided tiles, revealing new threats and puzzles as the heroes advance. Treasure cards add another layer of strategy and excitement, providing temporary bonuses such as healing potions, strength potions, and other magical items. Beware of trap cards that can hinder your progress!

With varying dungeon effects and monster behaviors, every game offers a fresh and challenging experience. The ultimate goal is to navigate the dungeon, overcome its many hazards, and defeat the dragon to retrieve the legendary Crown of Eldoria, bringing unity and prosperity to the land of Eldoria. The game combines strategy, teamwork, and narrative elements, making it an engaging experience for both new and seasoned players.

—description from the designer

name: Ministry of Lost Things: Case 2 – Finders Keypers
description:
Ministry of Lost Things is a tabletop puzzle adventure series that blends escape rooms, board games, and interactive fiction. Finders Keypers is the second standalone case in an episodic exploration of the Elusiverse: a realm where every lost item has a story.

In Finders Keypers, Jenna loses the carabiner holding all her keys and keychains. Almost immediately, it seems like her life starts falling apart. Can you help Jenna get out of this disaster?

The game contains five envelopes which need to be solved in sequence, each revealing more about the lost items as you solve through the puzzles. At the end of each envelope, verify your solutions online in the M.O.L.T website portal to progress to the next step. Hints can also be accessed through the website portal.

—description from the publisher

name: Drawing Dead
description:
After meeting an untimely end in a saloon poker game turned deadly, you awake in Purgatory. Imbued with new powers, and a set of poker cards made from your very soul, you must play your way through the three gates of Purgatory and into the afterlife.

Before the game, choose your character, each with their own abilities and upgrades.

Deal cards into the river and resolve enemy effects. Then draw 3 cards and use them to manipulate the river, unlock gates, and fill your bank.

Activate abilities by forming poker hands. Use those abilities to defeat enemies.

Gain rewards by defeating minions, and level up by defeating bosses.

Escape Purgatory by unlocking three gates and defeating the boss behind each!

-description from publisher

name: Dreadful Dragons
description:
Outwit rival dragons and build a hoard of glittering gems in this fast double trick-taking game for 2-6 players!

Play cards from your hand that match at least one dragon on the Lead Card. Each round offers new chances to collect glittering games through Crests and the value of the dragons you play - high or low. But beware... your fellow dragons are dreadfully tricky.

—description from the publisher

name: Dreamwood
description:
Dreamwood is a worker placement game where each player represents an animal species.

During each round, and event card is revealed and players will secretly place their workers on their player board to advance on 5 different tracks that represent the progress of each specie. The tracks are food, offspring, exploration, shelter, and leisure.


    Food track awards one time (x2) bonuses to worker placements.
    Offspring track awards additional workers.
    Exploration track awards a random income each round.
    Shelter track awards secret endgame bonuses.
    Leisure track awards immediate random advances on tracks. 


The game ends when at least 1 player reaches the end of a track. Players score victory points depending on their position on each track (relative to the other players). The player with the most victory points wins.

—description from the designer

name: Drillers
description:
In Drillers, players explore an abandoned mine using their mechs, trying to find and excavate anything useful or valuable left behind by a forgotten mining corporation. Each level of the mine brings new opportunities and new challenges—as fuel runs low and decisions become tighter. By collecting cards, players improve the drilling capabilities of their unique mech, unlock new actions, and push their operation further underground.

Mined minerals can be sold for profit also by use of drones, allowing players to refine their strategy and invest in better tools. Every decision affects everyone, often creating new opportunities for players.

Drillers is a game about planning ahead, tough decision-making, and knowing just how far you can afford to drill. Will you be the first to extend the horizons and uncover what the depths hide?

—description from the publisher

name: Drinking Quest: Sky Rum
description:
The Next Installment in the Drinking Quest Series!

Like a typical Role Playing Game you have a character sheet, roll for saving throws, fight monsters and find treasure BUT when your character dies in the game you have to chug your drink in real life! It adds a real level of tension and excitement to the battles. Everything matters.

This new installment brings back the sidekick mechanics
and 4 new quests. a Skyrim Parody, an alchemy gone wrong parody, a public drunkeness quest and a cthulhu thirst trap quest.

The battles are a series of one-on-one fights to the death. You either kill the monster earning coins and XP or your character dies and you must chug your drink!

The cards act as the GM (So everyone can drink) and the heroes go through four themed quests in each game - each getting progressively difficult and more likely to drink. However as this is a light RPG and a light Drinking Game there is a one chug per quest maximum which prevents Drinking Quest from being a "Pass out in 10 minutes" kind of drinking game. Over the course of 2 or 3 hours, a typical game averages 2 or 3 chugs.

Whoever gets the most XP wins! Whoever loses had to chug the most so it's sort of like everybody wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Ducks in a Row
description:
Visit the quacktion-packed pond of Ducks in a Row! In this game of deducktive reasoning, All of the ducks have gotten out of order! It is your job to play cards and learn about the locations of your fellow player's ducks. While swan diving, ducking for cover, and quacking jokes, make sure to keep your ducks in a row, or you might get caught off guard by the goose!

Ducks of Legend! The Conducktor has ordered these ducks in a row, and it is up to you to discover the correct order!

Play cards to find where these Ducks are, and if your guess is closest to the correct order, you win!

But be careful not to draw the Goose card! Or the round might be over quicker than you think!

—description from the designer

name: DUDO Amigo
description:
Meanwhile in Veracruz … a variety of pineapple, once thought extinct, has recently been rediscovered. This golden pineapple is a true concentrate of energy, known to increase strength and agility. Luchadores are crazy about it and would do anything to get their hands on this vitamin-packed fruit !
To get slices of this golden pineapple, the 2 teams of luchadores have to guess what's in the Piñata.

Modern Dudo with competitive Teams and no elimination. Two teams of Luchadores try to estimate how many candies, of one type, are inside the Piñata.

To adjust your estimations you have : 
• your cards which you can consult at any time
• the card you gave to your teammate after consulting
• the backs of your teammates and opponent's cards

At your turn you can denounce the previous player or announce a superior number, by adding +1, of one candy of your choice : Papagayo, Cocodrilo or Chihuahua ! And, obviously, you can bluff !

The team of the player who is right gets 10 pineapple slices points for the first round then 20 for rounds 2,3,4 and 30 points for rounds 5,6,7,8. First team to have 100 win the game !

70 cards (45x90mm) :
• 53 Piñata Cards (27 single-color backs, 18 two-color backs,8 three-color backs) 
• 8 Team Cards
• 8 Point Cards
• 1 Memo Card

—description from the publisher

name: Dunderheads
description:
Dunderheads is the chaotic, fun mashup of deck-building strategy and Yahtzee-style dice rolling you never knew you needed. Choose your hero, build your deck, and face off against monsters (and each other) to earn point cards! It's an easy-to-learn card and dice game where you roll, reroll, and combo your way to victory! Designed for quick games, perfect for younger players and those who don't want to spend an hour learning the rules.

Choose a hero that matches your play style. Want all the cards? Choose the Squire who can hold 6 cards. More interested in hitting harder without managing cards? The Golem is a perfect choice. Collect item cards that compliment your hero and luck tolerance. Item cards require different dice combos and the dice used are not standard d6 dice. Each has modified odds with "1's" being the most common while "3's" the most rare. As you collect item cards, you must balance dice quantity with roll difficulty.

Battle Monsters to earn point cards by dealing more damage than the health displayed on the card. Damage is dealt by completing dice combos on items cards within 3 dice rolls.

Collect 10 points worth of defeated monsters first to win!

—description from the designer

name: SCUM: An Eclipse Phase Board Game
publisher: Moose With Cup Creative; Posthuman Studios
description:
SCUM is a co-op/competitive board game where players fight to defend their habitat from a mysterious threat bent on its destruction. Use your skills and rep to build a powerful tableau, then blow it all up to unleash an epic turn! Based on the RPG Eclipse Phase, SCUM doubles down on the evocative world-building of the original game.

Manipulating your rep, commanding your AI muse, and calling in favors with the denizens of the Scum swarm, you must uncover the mastermind behind the plot and hatch a crazy plan to defeat them before the multiplying threats unleashed upon the swarm overwhelm it and force the unthinkable. Swap morphs, fabricate black market gear, run illicit software, and inflate your rep. From the very first turn, challenging tactical decisions and an intricate web of resource and hand management will have you walking a razor-thin line between victory and defeat.

The core game concept is to upgrade your player board and then unleash it. SCUM is driven by action selection mechanics building up your playerboard with volatile morphs, fabricated schematics, and inventive AI shenanigans, all while managing your rep upon the swarm to gain favors with its denizens.

If the players manage to reveal the mastermind through enough investigation, and complete a set number of objectives on the 3 random Plan cards, the mastermind is defeated, and the Scum swarm has been saved. The winner is the player that has the most Renown at the end of the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Dungeon Cube
description:
A competitive fantasy adventures game, played only with a single cube.

Dungeon Cube is a game for 1-4 players, campaign driven, that let you live an entire story of adventures for you and your friends.
Each player chooses a hero, represented by one face of the cube, then the heroes must accomplish the same mission, represented by a sequence of goals to be fulfilled by the heroes. To fulfill a goal, a player must rotate layers of the cube to obtain a specific configuration on his face.
The first hero that fulfill the last goal, is the winner.

—description from the designer

name: Dungeon Pages: Underboss
description:
Dungeon Pages: Underboss is a standalone, print and play adventure that brings new layers of tension, strategy, and replayability to the tabletop. Underboss deepens the series’ core ideas — simple mechanics, smart decisions, and tight design — while introducing fresh twists. It’s for fans who love the compact strategy of Dungeon Pages, but want to explore new tactical challenges from the perspective of the evil underlord. This time, instead of raiding the dungeon and defeating monsters, you'll build traps and deploy monsters to protect your domain. You'll even drop into the dungeon yourself to be sure the job is done right.

As the heroes crawl over the catacombs, you must balance building traps, deploying defensive forces, and when to attack with your own unique boss powers. You do this by rolling dice, strategically marking the results as traps, monsters, and powerful effects to defeat heroes, gather soul gems, and build your forces.  The dice also activate the heroes’ positions and attacks that you will have to mitigate. Defeat all the heroes to win!

Each game sheet will feature a unique configuration of familiar heroes. The heroes will try to break down your defenses and run off with your gold. If they do, you'll be defeated. But if you can eliminate the invaders, you'll reign supreme and finally be declared the ultimate Underboss!

—description from the publisher

name: Dungeon Twister: 20th Anniversary Edition
description:
For its 20th anniversary, Dungeon Twister is back with a whole range of improvements.

In Dungeon Twister 20th Anniversary Edition, players take on the role of a team of heroes imprisoned by the Mad Archmage in an ever-changing dungeon riddled with deadly traps. Will you be up to the challenge of surviving and entertaining your jailer?  Players compete by strategically exploiting their adventurers' skills and the opportunities created by the maze's ever-changing shape. To win the game, eliminate your opponents by magic, force or cunning, and activate the mechanisms that will make them fall into a trap. Bring back precious treasures or escape alive to earn victory points.

With Dungeon Twister, strategy is at the heart of each and every one of your actions. The game features :


     A tactical action system: plan your turn and choose the best action card to optimize your moves. Keep track of the cards played by your opponents to anticipate their next actions.
     Multiple ways to win: take advantage of the enemy heroes' weaknesses and defeat them, control strategic points or dodge the battle and escape the dungeon to earn victory points.
     An evolutive and interactive board: adapt your tactics with each tile revealed. Activate mechanisms to rotate them to your advantage, open up new opportunities or block other players' strategies. Strengthen your heroes with magic items scattered throughout the labyrinth.
     Heroes with diverse skills: each adventurer has unique skills to overcome the maze's challenges or thwart your opponents' plans. Will you choose a skillful passe-muraille, a powerful ogre, or why not both?


Vary your Dungeon Twister games with this new edition, which includes the Paladins & Dragons expansion and the module for playing with up to 4 players. Diversify your team settings and take on even more challenges!


     Completely revamped illustrations and designs. 
     Never-before-seen miniatures.
     Improved materials and enlarged tiles.


—description from the publisher

name: Duālis
description:
The balance of power keeps shifting and only one team can prevail. Duālis is a tactical trick-taking game played between two teams of two. While easy to learn, nuanced decisions and surprising strategy are revealed with each new play.

Over thirteen tricks, each partnership must work together to win the same number of tricks as the coins they have collected. While playing a card, you may collect and use a coin to change your card's color and, possibly, make your partner’s card stronger. But be careful! Taking coins too quickly will limit your partnership’s flexibility in the important later tricks.

The game's mechanics explore the interconnected relationships between opposites: two teams of two, two suits each with two trump colors, and how the shifting balance between each affects the others.

Can you and your partner work together to unsettle your opponents and create harmony in an unsteady world?

(Includes a variant for 3 or 4 players playing individually.)

パワーバランスが移動するため、どちらかのチームが優勢になります。デュアリスは、2人でチームとなり、2チームで対戦する戦術的トリックゲームです。簡単にプレイできるのに、毎回、微妙な判断や驚きの戦術に気付きます。

13回以上のトリックの中で、それぞれのチームは、集めるコインと勝つトリックの数を合わせるため、協力しなければなりません。プレイ中、コインを集めたり、コインを使ってカードの色を変えることによって、パートナーのカードを強くすることができるかもしれません。でも気をつけて！コインを早く取ったり、取りすぎたりすることによって、この後のトリックでのパートナーの立ち位置が悪くなる場合があります。

このゲームの構造は、2人で構成されたチームが２チーム、2つのトランプカラーに2つのスーツ、そしてそれぞれが与える影響のバランスがどのように移動するか、こういった相反するものが互いに絡み合って、それをいかにうまく探求していくか、というものです。あなたとパートナーは、協力して敵を惑わし、この不安定な世界でハーモニーを生み出すことができるでしょうか？

First release: Tokyo Game Market, November 2025.

—description from the publisher

name: ZeroDay.exe
description:
The .RAT (Regime of Authoritarian Tetrarchs - the New World's government), has created the ultimate weapon - A Killswitch in case the world's A.i. gets out of hand, aptly named ZeroDay.exe. Unfortunately, the .RAT also doesn't think too far in advance. Their precious A.i. learned of this weapon and were...angry, to say the least. The A.i. decided to take control of the program and have started targeting our bio-cybernetics (cybers). At first, they only targeted the .RAT and those close to it here in Shijima - the capital city - so us commoners didn't care much about it - hell, some were even happy about it. But recently there have been attacks against anyone the A.i. deems a threat…which is basically every human with cybers. We didn’t want (or try) to get caught up in this fight, but here we are. Now, we’re on the A.i.’s shortlist, so the only thing left to do is infiltrate their databanks and destroy them before they get to us. And I guess if we save some lives, that’s a plus

Take on the role of one of 8 unique characters and fight to reclaim the city of Shijima in this Cyberpunk-syle, cooperative Rogue-lite dungeon crawler. On your turn, you will have 2 action points to spend on a variety of different actions. Game mechanics include: Deterministic Combat, Hand Management, Deck Building, Character specific actions (Programs), AI Threat level, Initiative track, and Strategic positioning.

Play 4 ways:

OP Mode - Play a random Operation. Upgrade your character and draft your deck throughout the Operation for endless replayability. (1-4hr)
Boss Mode - Draft a deck and customize your character before taking on a Boss! (1-2 hr)
OP + Boss Mode - Play a random Operation and use the upgrades you earn throughout the Operation to take on a Boss. (2-6 hrs)
Campaign Mode - Play through all 15 Operations over multiple sessions, upgrading your character along the using Virtu cards to streamline your deck into a more curated set of cards. (20-40+ hrs)

name: Bot or Not
description:
The robots are taking over! To stop them, your group needs to enter a shutdown code. But one of your teammates is secretly a robot trying to sabotage your efforts!

In order to avoid interception, you must communicate the code by answering prompts only a “real human” would know, and giving answers on a scale of 1 to 10.

Will you succeed? Can you uncover the robot? Or will the robots take over?

—description from the publisher

name: Dyson Sphere
description:
Imagine harnessing the full energy output of an entire star by constructing a colossal megastructure around it. In Dyson Sphere, that’s precisely what you do. Orbiting a star, you deploy self-replicating robots to build massive sphere segments, capturing vast amounts of solar energy to secure victory.

Dyson Sphere is a game of straightforward rules, quick turns, and tough decisions. On your turn, you move your orbiter as many spaces as you wish, then take two different actions on your new space. The modular board ensures that each game presents a fresh set of actions to choose from. The game is also interactive – you’ll gain bonus actions when other players land on the same space as you. Furthermore, each time you construct a sphere segment, you add a new action to the board, keeping things dynamic.

Your primary resources are various self-replicating robots, which can be upgraded throughout the game to help you use your resources in unique ways. You begin with a space station, granting you a unique power, and as the game progresses, you can recruit crew members to gain additional special abilities.

You’ll also advance along tech tracks to boost your resource production and unlock new technologies. Plus, planets and asteroids orbiting the star can be explored for their valuable benefits.

Welcome to the final frontier of civilisation!

—description from the designer

name: Echo Team: Spearhead
description:
Echo Team: Spearhead is a  card-driven, tactical wargame where battles take place in and around urban terrain. You take command of a Delta Force unit that conducts operations around the world. The opponents are, for example, Somali warlords, members of the Mexican Minola cartel or units of ISIS West Africa.

Two players play one or more "Command" cards from their hand to activate their units on the game board for various military functions or to trigger events. The players try to achieve victory by moving their combat units around the game board to attack common combat units, rescue hostages, destroy objectives or repel attacks. Variable turn events such as weather, reinforcements or the number of command points can vary and occur at random intervals to add a little uncertainty to each player's perfect plan.

SCALE: Each hex on an Echo Team: Spearhead map is approximately 150 feet long. Each full player phase abstractly represents several minutes of real time. Each full player phase abstractly represents 10-15 minutes of real time.

Each Delta Team unit is represented in-game as a single entity/person, along with their individual primary and secondary weapons. Enemy units are represented as a 2-man team or a 5-man team.

—description from the designer

name: Echoes of Astra
description:
In Echoes of Astra TCG, you play as a Sovereign uniting two factions on the war torn world of Elyrion. Magic and technology mix in a never-ending cycle of conflict. Command your troops to fight for resources, exert your influence, and achieve victory.

You earn points by controlling any of 3 combat zones in the middle of the battlefield. Your units will fight to control that territory by any means possible - Tactics, Counters, Equipment, and Territory modifiers will all contribute to your strategy.

Victory goes to the first player to achieve 20 victory points. Make smart decisions, expend your units efficiently, and predict your opponents moves to become the dominant Sovereign.

name: Edge Quest
description:
Enter the arena and prepare yourself for a dynamic, 3D battle unlike any board game you’ve ever played before! Edge Quest delivers a groundbreaking fusion of tactical strategy and physical action, offering a gameplay experience unlike any other. Players command fully articulating action figures on a 3D battlefield, where positioning and movement are just as crucial as card play and resource management. You'll use the dual-use cards to change your position, footwork, gain edge, and attack!

Mastering your position is key to executing precise attacks and defenses! Adjust your sword’s orientation and placement or adopt a guarded stance. Each move demands the right positioning for success!

Move your figure around the arena using footwork adjustment cards. Get yourself out of reach, or get within reach of your opponent to execute the perfect attack or defense! While there are rules about how to move, this is not a grid-based combat! You can move your figure freely around the arena!

There are several different victory conditions to choose from before you begin the match. Use your cards wisely to propel yourself to the win!

—description from the designer

name: Eight Nights
description:
Eight Nights is a fast-paced Hanukkah trick-taking game where players make predictions, play their cards, and try to light the most candles on the Menorah by the end of the game. Each round adds a new twist inspired by the holiday, from simple trump effects to team moments that feel like gathering around the candles together.

Every round of Eight Nights begins by revealing one Miracle Card. Each Miracle introduces a special rule inspired by a Hanukkah tradition. Each player makes a secret bid on how many tricks they expect to win. Hit your bid and you light a candle; miss it and you earn Gelt to spend on fun one-round powers. With special rules for three players and a cooperative mode where two players team up against Ner-Bot, a playful shadowy Menorah, Eight Nights brings the warmth and spirit of the festival into a fast, family-friendly card game that everyone can enjoy.

Players can win in two ways:


    Instant Win - Light all your flames before anyone else and win immediately.
    Endgame Win - When the Menorah is fully lit, the player with the most lit flames wins the Festival of Lights.


—description from the designer

name: Eldertide: A Thousand Lights
description:
The first board game of the Eldertide trilogy has arrived. Each game will be set in the same universe and will unfold across a connected timeline.

In Eldertide: A Thousand Lights, players lead one of five houses of a once-mighty seafaring nation, now rising to reclaim their homeland from a devastating supernatural storm that has raged for decades. With powerful ships at their command, they embark on a mission to rebuild a network of ancient-tech lighthouses across the scattered isles — restoring balance and retaking the archipelago.

In this pick-and-deliver board game, with elements of market fluctuation and civilization building, each player controls a Foundation Ship, sailing across several Ports to collect and transport resources. These resources can be either exported for immediate points, or invested in constructing Facilities on the player’s own Outposts, leading to more explosive endgame opportunities. The Storm acts as a hindrance, breaking Ports that can later be rebuilt, and posing a direct threat to ships themselves. Careful route planning and resource management are essential to succeed.

—description from the publisher

name: Elemental Dragons
description:
In the mythical realm of Elemental Dragons, players embark on a journey to harness the powers of the four elemental suits: earth, water, fire, and air. The goal? To amass a hoard of precious dragon gems, the coveted currency of this world. But beware, for amidst the riches lie hidden dangers in the form of dragon eggs, which bring negative scores to those unfortunate enough to acquire them.
In Elemental Dragons, players engage in a battle of wits, employing elemental powers to outmaneuver their opponents. Each round, players compete to win tricks by playing cards of higher value and utilizing the unique abilities of the powerful dragon cards.
At the outset, a dominant suit is randomly determined. Then, the first player to play a card sets the lesser dominant suit if their played card does not belong to the dominant suit. Thus, the order of precedence emerges: dominant suit, followed by the lesser suit, with the remaining two suits only useful in this round for their powers. The dragon's powers will enable you to change the dominant suit, steal gems from the trick, and poison the trick with eggs among other things. Each player plays a card either to try to win the trick, or to play a useful power for them, or both. Then there is a second round of card exchange, offering players the opportunity to exchange their initial card for another, only if the new card can win the trick. Players also can choose to "downgrade" their card for an egg card, poisoning that trick for the winner by nullifying gems from the final score.
This mechanic injects an element of bluff and double-bluff into the gameplay, as players must carefully consider when to reveal their most potent cards and when to conceal their true intentions.
As the game unfolds, players must carefully balance their pursuit of dragon gems with the risk of acquiring detrimental dragon eggs. Enter the world of Elemental Dragons and unleash the power of the elements in this thrilling trick-taking adventure.

—description from the publisher (translated)

En el reino mítico de los Dragones Elementales, los jugadores emprenden un viaje para aprovechar los poderes de los cuatro palos elementales: tierra, agua, fuego y aire. ¿El objetivo? Acumular un tesoro de preciosas gemas de dragón, la codiciada moneda de este mundo. Pero cuidado, porque entre las riquezas yacen peligros ocultos en forma de huevos de dragón, que otorgan puntuación negativa a aquellos desafortunados que los adquieren.
En Dragones Elementales los jugadores participan en una batalla de ingenio, empleando poderes elementales para superar a sus oponentes. En cada ronda, los jugadores compiten para ganar bazas jugando cartas de mayor valor y utilizando las habilidades únicas de las poderosas cartas de dragón.
Al principio, se determina aleatoriamente un palo dominante. Luego, el primer jugador en jugar una carta establece el palo subdominante si su carta jugada no pertenece al palo dominante. Así, surge el orden de precedencia: palo dominante, seguido por el subdominante, con los dos palos restantes solo útiles en esta ronda por sus poderes. Los poderes de los dragones te permitirán cambiar el palo dominante, robar gemas de la baza y envenenarla con huevos, entre otras cosas. Cada jugador juega una carta ya sea para intentar ganar la baza, o para jugar un poder útil, o ambos. Luego hay una segunda ronda de intercambio de cartas, que ofrece a los jugadores la oportunidad de cambiar su carta inicial por otra, sólo si la nueva carta puede ganar la baza. Los jugadores también pueden optar por "rebajar" su carta por una carta de huevo, envenenando esa baza para el ganador al anular gemas de la puntuación final.
Este mecanismo introduce un elemento de engaño y doble engaño en el juego, ya que los jugadores deben considerar cuidadosamente cuándo revelar sus cartas más potentes y cuándo ocultar sus verdaderas intenciones.
A medida que el juego avanza, los jugadores deben equilibrar cuidadosamente su búsqueda de gemas de dragón con el riesgo de adquirir perjudiciales huevos de dragón. ¡Entra al mundo de los Dragones Elementales y libera el poder de los elementos en esta emocionante aventura de captura de bazas!

—description from the publisher

name: Elite hockey card game
description:
EHCG is mainly deck construction, dice rolling and role playing strategy game set in world of ice hockey.

Your task as a manager of ice hockey club is to pick your coach and lineup of 12 players, assign the role for each player, choose the tactics, and lead your team to the victory.

Each player chooses unique situational cards, which can be used throughout the game. During the match, you have to guide your players in different situations from the faceoff to shot. Significant part of the game are 1v1 battles of players, where your preparation and skill can truly shine. If you are successful, you will gain many bonuses and you can affect the strategy of both teams. Additionally, as the manager, you have many options in every situation to change the course of the match and turn the result in your favor.

EHCG is game for 2 players, who can battle over and over again in a single match. However, it contains setup of 20 teams, therefore it offers option to integrate up to 20 people, who can compete in different modes such as tournament mode or season mode.

name: Finding Calm
description:
Finding Calm is a relaxing solo/cooperative game meant to still your mind and guide you towards a calmer, more mindful life.

Lay out a beautiful spread of oracle cards by placing each card you draw in a grid. However, each card you place flips surrounding cards and interacts with them in unique and unexpected ways. Your goal is to end the game with a single face-up card, which then reveals a meaningful intention to guide you for the rest of the day.

Finding Calm was developed in collaboration with Dr. Silvi Guerra, and features evidence-based therapy strategies that help you manage stress and reduce anxiety.

—description from the designer

name: Sprout
description:
Keep your plant babies alive!

You and your roommates have just adopted some new houseplants. Now you just have to keep them alive! But with an ever-growing plant collection, keeping your new plant babies happy and healthy is far from easy.

To succeed, you’ll need to give your plants the right amount of nutrients. But be careful! Give too much and you risk accidentally wilting your leafy friends!

Sprout is a game for 2-5 plant parents looking to adopt from over 100 unique and adorable houseplants!

2-5 Plant Parents, 45 min, Ages 14+

name: Encyclopedia of Monsters
description:
A very special Encyclopedia!

Hello Globetrotters! In this cooperative memory game, you will travel around the world in search of the monsters, spirits, and legendary creatures that inhabit it.
