As night falls, Grando stalks Kringa. If Grando stops at a location or home, unprotected workers will fall sick or even placed in the village's crypt. If the crypt fills up, the players lose.

Players have a limited time to discover how to destroy Grando by fulfilling the secret holder's objectives. Once a secret is discovered, you will learn one of Grando's weaknesses. Ready the weapons and set up a trap to lure Grando in. If you manage to successfully spring the trap and defeat the evil Strigoi, you win! If you fail, you doom Kringa to a fate worse than death!

—description from the designer

name: Kronologic: Babylon 2500
description:
Kronologic are modern alternatives to Clue: find the culprit, the weapon and the location. Each turn, the active player needs to interrogate a suspect (by aligning cards under perforated cardboard tiles), giving away information to everyone at the table, but giving the active player extra information (how many time a suspect visited a specific location, at what time, etc.)

Be the first to solve the mystery to win the game.

name: Kronos Epilogue Remastered: Kosmogonia 2086
description: In this remastered version of Kronos Epilogue you will find new mechanics and an overall improved version of the game. This deluxe edition comes with two expansions that will take your experience to the next level. The “Oracle of the Dead” that allows you to take on the role of Hades, King of the Underworld and become the Tyrant that the other players will fight. As well as the “Ursa Major” which allows you to take on the role of the demon Κallisto and include in your games her astral hideout that has gathered the most skilled adventurers of the universe.

name: Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit
description:
Kryptothera is a competitive adventure game set in an alternate reality where cryptids — creatures from folklore — are found, and their energy fuels a radical new form of technology. Rival hunters journey across treacherous terrain in pursuit of these elusive beings, navigating a world shaped by myth, invention, and escalating ambition. The setting is infused with dark mystery and an art deco-inspired aesthetic, where technological marvels pulse beneath a veil of secrecy and superstition.

Kryptothera offers a competitive PvE experience. Each player takes on the role of a hunter with unique skill competencies that influence dice-based outcomes during cryptid hunts and challenge events. Players navigate a mapped region filled with unfolding events, acquiring items and hiring crew to improve their chances of success. Successfully capturing a cryptid is only part of the challenge — hunters must also return it to their headquarters to secure it. In the later stage of the game, players can initiate duels — introducing a PvP element where hunters may attempt to steal cryptids from one another, adding a layer of high-stakes rivalry before the hunt concludes.

The aim is to secure the most valuable collection of cryptids before the hunt ends. Players must balance risk and timing — deciding when to explore further, when to return to base, and when to confront their rivals. Every action shapes the outcome, and no lead is ever safe. Kryptothera rewards strategic planning, adaptability, and a sharp instinct for opportunity in a world where power shifts with every roll of the dice.

—description from the publisher

name: Kumata
description:
Kumata is a fast-paced domino game that breaks the classic rules. Instead of aligning dominoes, you stack them to build a vibrant 3D jungle canopy where only the visible tiles score points. Outsmart your opponents by covering their tiles while protecting your own!

On your turn, play a domino from the top of your personal stack and place it on the board. Be careful: to be placed, each space on your domino must cover another space of the same value, regardless of clan: a 1 covers a 1, a 3 covers a 3, and so on. Empty spaces are wild: they can cover or be covered by any value. Once per game, you may play your totem to protect one of your dominoes and gain bonus points. The game ends as soon as a player can no longer play. The clan with the most visible points then wins the game.

The game includes two modes : Duel mode for tense head-to-head battles (2 players) and Multiplayer mode for more chaos (3-4 players).

To add variety to your games, you can also play two variants : Maze mode, which introduces new tactical challenges, and Alliance mode, for tense 2-vs-2 team play.

—description from the publisher

name: La Conquêste: The French and Indian War 1754-1763
description:
In 1754, a young George Washington blundered into an ambush in the woods of Ohio that killed a French diplomat and started a bloody six year war for control of France's vast Great Lakes empire in North America. In this exciting solitaire game by Charles S. Roberts Award winner R. Ben Madison, you sail your ships of the Line to keep supply lines open to France as the Seven Years War rages in Europe, India, and the Caribbean. Use French leaders like Governor Vaudreuil and General Montcalm to deploy your stealthy Indian allies, élite Marines, and plucky 'Canadien' militia to defeat or parry legendary generals like Wolfe and Amherst who besiege your forts on five different fronts from Nova Scotia to Ticonderoga to the Thousand Islands. King Louis XV of France orders you to stop the Thirteen Colonies from tipping the balance for Britain; it's your sacred task to deny the British Québec, Montréal, and "La Conqueste" - The Conquest of Canada in the French and Indian War!

—description from the publisher

name: La Cosecha
description:
It’s harvest time on Mallorca. In La Cosecha (Spanish for “the harvest”), you run your farm in the idyllic hamlet of Alpich near the town of Esporles. Each round, you harvest goods such as olives, grapes, and grain to mark boxes in different areas of your farm sheet. Fields need tending, the barn roof needs covering, and market carts want loading—your farm is full of opportunities!

Often, you’ll need upgraded goods such as food and wine, which you must first produce from harvested goods. You’ll have to balance short-term revenue against long-term planning. In addition, you can acquire tools and farm extensions with special abilities that may give you the decisive edge.

The player who manages to use their revenue most effectively, combine the strongest bonuses, and keep an eye on the competition will earn the greatest renown and win the game.

La Cosecha is set in the world of La Granja. It draws on elements you may already know from La Granja (Spielworxx, 2014), No Siesta (ADC Blackfire, 2016), and El Burro (Spielworxx, 2024), while still being a completely standalone game with fresh ideas and challenges.

The game includes two different farm sheets:
• La Fiesta, where you host a banquet, and
• El Camino, whose long road leads you to the Port de Palma.

Both share the same core rules, but each sheet offers its own challenges and level of difficulty.

You can also play La Cosecha solo. Face the imaginary opponent Leon and try to beat your own high scores.

-description from publisher

name: La Pâtisserie Rococo
publisher: Eagle-Gryphon Games; Maldito Games; Skellig Games; YOKA Games
description:
Welcome back to the Rococo era! Louis XV reigns in France and is hosting a grand festival in the gardens of Versailles. Everyone is clamoring for you to provide tantalizing and delicious pastries for the event. This isn't just about your pâtisserie – it's about creating a presence at the most prestigious festival of the era that provides the chance to gain everlasting fame, prestige, and opportunities to gain favor with important nobles.

In La Pâtisserie Rococo, players represent the pastry shops (les pâtisseries) and pastry chefs (les pâtissiers) that are preparing pastries for sale and for show at the Versailles Garden Festival. Using the unique deck-building mechanism from Rococo, players hire staff to create recipes, acquire quality ingredients, and bake delicious desserts. Then comes the challenging decision of whether to sell these delectable creations for profit or present them for possible awards. The player who creates the most acclaimed desserts will gain fame and the respect of the king and his nobles.

-description from publisher

name: Battle Monsters: Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
description:
Battle Monsters is a “major” restoration of the 1992 Battle Masters.

Set in the exciting world of the Monsterverse franchise from Legendary Entertainment. The game offers two core sets
Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah and Kong vs. Mechagodzilla. Each of the Titans is supported by a unique faction: Monarch, Apex Cybernetics, a horde of superspecies, and a team of skilled mercenaries led by Col. Alan Jonah. The Titans from either set can face off against one another.

The goal is simple:
Defeat the opposing Titan to win the game. To do that will take clever positioning, timely card play, and some lucky
dice rolls.

—description from the publisher

name: Battle Monsters: Kong vs Mechagodzilla
description:
Battle Monsters is a restoration of the 1992 Battle Masters.

Set in the exciting world of the Monsterverse franchise from Legendary Entertainment. The game offers two core sets
Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah and Kong vs. Mechagodzilla. Each of the Titans is supported by a unique faction: Monarch, Apex Cybernetics, a horde of superspecies, and a team of skilled mercenaries led by Col. Alan Jonah. The Titans from either set can face off against one another.

The goal is simple:
Defeat the opposing Titan to win the game. To do that will take clever positioning, timely card play, and some lucky dice rolls.

—description from the publisher

name: Thunder Road: Ignition
description:
Thunder Road: Ignition is a standalone game that uses the core game system from Thunder Road: Vendetta with tweaks to provide a familiar yet new, streamlined play experience.

Ignition features shorter road boards, new rubble terrain, barricades, and curved roads!

Ignition can also be used as an expansion to Thunder Road: Vendetta.

name: Landfall: A Cozy Volcano Island-Building Game
publisher: Evan and Josh's Very Special Games Company (Very Special Games)
description:
Race to build land formations with your volcanoes on a 3D island that grows as you play! Landfall is a light, learn-in-minutes game where you move volcanoes around a 3D island that grows as you play.

in Landfall, 2 to 4 players use their volcanoes to shape an island, with the goal of being the first player to build one each of the three formations: Mountain, Valley, and Plain. Your ability to plan ahead, block, and even steal tiles from your opponent will be your keys to victory!

-description from designer

name: Lands of Evershade
description:
Lands of Evershade is a hybrid RPG/board game experience that lets players enjoy grand, richly narrated open-world adventures without a dungeon master, while keeping the game approachable and easy to learn.

Start by building your perfect character using an immersive player's handbook. Choose from unique races and origins, dark secrets, and exciting classes with interesting advancements and specializations that ensure no two characters are the same. All decisions made during character creation — as well as later in the game — change how the world reacts to you, both in story and combat. Were you a nobleman or a common thief in your past? What's your secret or personal quest you hide from other players? New stories, interactions, and combat opportunities unlock at every step.

You can explore the game's multiple standalone story modules and scenarios in the order of your choice to create your own campaign that will lead you to different areas and significant events in the vast universe of Lands of Evershade. When necessary, engage in fast-paced tactical combat in which enemies react to your actions. Enjoy dozens of high-quality models that bring life to your party members and enemies.

Lands of Evershade is more than a game; it's a universe built over many years, a world of secrets buried in the shadow of the goddess Luada that will grow and expand with new content for years to come.

—description from the publisher

name: Unmatched: Hellboy
description: Unmatched: Hellboy brings four characters from Mike Mignola's Hellboy comic series to this expansive game series. Featuring cover art by the Hellboy creator, Unmatched: Hellboy includes two new battlefields and can mix and match with all other Unmatched sets.

name: Unmatched: Stars and Stripes
description:
A homage to the folklore and legends of American history, Unmatched: Stars and Stripes features three fighters from the Unmatched design contest. Rosie the Riveter is the final winning entry from the Unmatched deck design contest with John Henry, and George Washington as runners up.
A fresh take on the iconic Rosie the Riveter sees her donning a WWII-era mech suit while the steel-driving folk hero, John Henry, swings his mighty hammer as an emblem of the struggle for civil rights and labor. Wyatt Earp and Doc Holliday, legends of the Wild West, are ready to bring down justice with a quick hand and pre-Presidential spymaster George Washington and the Culper Spy Ring seek to gain the battle advantage.
The set features a double-sided board with two new historical battlefields, the White House and the Alamo.

name: Brave & Bold: Bag Building Combat Game
description:
For over 65 years, the Justice League has stood as Earth’s last line of defense against impossible threats. In Brave & Bold, that legacy becomes a head-to-head test of skill, nerve, and mastery.

Brave & Bold is a competitive bag-building combat game where every turn is a calculated gamble. Players draw tokens from their personal arsenal—deciding whether to stop safely or push deeper for devastating combos. Push too far, and the game pushes back.

Unlike traditional deck-builders, Brave & Bold replaces cards with tactile tokens drawn blindly from a personal bag, creating constant uncertainty and dramatic momentum swings. Players must manage not only what goes into their bag, but when and how much to draw from it—turning every action into a calculated risk.

Each turn plays out as a tense push-your-luck skirmish between rivals, where you draw tokens from your arsenal (bag)— combat, agility, focus, resources, character boosts, and crises deciding whether to keep digging or stop and trigger your character’s ultimate combos.

Surviving the draw lets you spend tokens to unleash character specific abilities, trigger jaw-dropping combos, and acquire stronger tech from the Hall of Justice. Quick turns, escalating
bags, and cinematic powers create a taut rhythm of risk, reward, and a spectacle worthy of your favourite superhero in every matchup.

Combat is fast, interactive, and highly asymmetric. Each player develops a unique engine over the course of the game, unlocking abilities, chaining effects, and building toward explosive finishing moments. Multiple game formats—from tense duels to large team battles—offer distinct strategic challenges while maintaining a tight competitive core.

Your goal is to be the last hero (or villain) standing. Your starting damage limit is defined by the game format. You win when you have defeated all other opponents first by injuring them, and then by reducing an injured opponent's damage limit to zero.

Designed with organized and competitive play in mind, Brave & Bold rewards skill, foresight, and adaptability. No two matches play the same, and victory belongs to the player who best balances aggression, restraint, and timing when it matters most.

Games unfold quickly but reward mastery. As bags evolve, strategies sharpen, and tension escalates, Brave & Bold delivers cinematic moments worthy of the DC Universe—whether in a tight 1v1 duel or a chaotic 3v3 team showdown.

About the game:
2-6 players in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 game formats.
45-minute playtime.
First of its kind bag-building combat game focused on character skirmishes.
2-character sets and 8-character combat vault configurations with new character expansions coming out regularly.
Push-your-luck style skirmishes where you draw tokens, allocate them to abilities, trigger damage and special combos. Build your bag by purchasing additional tokens each turn.
Every character wins in a different way in how fast they move, how they apply pressure and how they recover when things go wrong.

The game is easy to learn, deep to master and stable for organized play.

—description from the publisher

name: Last Week of Summer
description:
It’s the summer of 1986, you just graduated high school and you have one more week of summer before it’s time to head off to the real world.

Last Week Of Summer combines turn programming and worker placement with a variety of mini games. Each game, players set up their town using 4 or 5 of the possible locations: Pick up a movie at the Video Store, get high scores at the Arcade, grab some Fast Food, hang at the U-Mart, get the coolest (but not too cool) albums at the Music Store, or learn some tricks at the Skatepark. Each of these locations links 80's theme to a classic mechanism - set collection, tile placement, market manipulation, mancala, push your luck, dice rolling, and more.

Players plan their day and then simultaneously move from place to place as they compete to make friends with the coolest kids in town, get invited to the best parties, and complete location specific goals. As you complete goals you make memories by placing cassettes on locations (these represent the songs that bring you back to those summer days). Whoever has the most cassettes at the end of the week is the winner.

—description from the designer

name: Laužas
description:
Laužas is a cooperative, camping-themed game for 3-6 players. Players take on the roles of campers and must work together, telling stories to alleviate everyone's anxiety before the campfire dies out.

Each round, one player takes on the role of the reader. They will read a situation written down by another player. Then they secretly choose one of four cards and place it face down. The reader then provides a single clue to help the other players guess which card they have chosen.

If all other players correctly identify the hidden card, everyone benefits. Each player gets to remove one of their six anxiety cubes. The goal is for all players to remove all of their anxiety cubes from their personal supply.

Players must achieve this collective goal before the central timer, represented by the campfire, burns out. If they can successfully manage their anxiety by interpreting the clues and making correct guesses, everyone wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Le Vent Rouge
description:
The legendary thief Le Vent Rouge has challenged all scoundrels to rob the wealthiest man in France. Are you brave enough to enter his mansion, and skilled enough to escape with his treasures?

Le Vent Rouge is a dice roll & spend game. In this game, you will compete, negotiate, and team up with other players to take on increasing risks in a heavily guarded mansion full of gold and objet d'art.

The game ends in one of two ways. 

    Defeated guards: If a guard token is placed on a numbered clock space matching the number of players, the game ends.
    The boss is defeated: If the boss is defeated, the game ends during phase 6.


At the end of the game, whichever player has the most points across all their stolen goods is the winner.

—description from the designer

name: LEDA
description:
In the forgotten realm of Leda, the great species have awakened: cats, pandas, sharks, scorpions, and many more. Each animal clan has developed its own civilization, language, and ambitions. Through a strange energy grid pulsing in rhythm with the world, they build, evolve, clash — and seek to impose their vision of the future. In this world balanced on a knife's edge, war is not everything; cunning, adaptability, memory, and deep bonds with nature are the keys to triumph. Who will carve their name among the legends of Leda?

LEDA is an asymmetric card game for two players in which each player embodies an animal clan with its own rules, objectives, and playstyle. Each player begins with a 4x4 grid of basic tiles, which they will modify during the game by upgrading them and playing clan cards onto them. On each turn, the action tile determines a zone of the grid to activate, triggering the effects located in that zone. Players must optimize their activations, manage their food (the main resource), and improve their engine in order to fulfill their clan's unique victory condition — all while racing for military victory!

—description from the publisher

name: Legacy of Eastbrook Hills
publisher: Jet Games Studio; Lavka Games; Kolossal Games
description:
The Legacy of Eastbrook Hills is a dark detective series consisting of five related episodes. The game is fully cooperative. Players jointly control a group of characters. Control is about choosing the actions that the group will perform. Players choose an action, take the right card, read it, and receive new hints and opportunities. Most actions advance the game time, and when it reaches a certain point, the finale comes.

The events of the game Legacy of Eastbrook Hills unfold in a mystical and gloomy atmosphere of our world. It all starts with three students arriving in the abandoned mining town of Eastbrook Hills, filled with mysteries and frightening secrets. And all ends...

Wherever this story ends, its plot progression and ending will largely depend on your decisions and actions. Play as a team of live characters, meet new characters and chat with them on various topics to gain valuable information. You'll unravel many intricate stories and meet many interesting personas as you progress through large-scale, story-driven adventure.

name: Dracula's Curse
description:
Prepare to become a legendary Slayer in the ever-shifting depths of Dracula's Curse. This procedurally generated dungeon crawler plunges you and your fellow Slayers into a nightmarish realm, where no two playthroughs are ever the same. Choose from one of 7 Slayers each with their own unique abilities, backgrounds, and subclasses or embrace the darkness and play as Dracula himself, the ultimate lord of the night.

One among you will embrace the dark side as Dracula, with the power to summon minions, reap souls, set traps, and manipulate the castle itself. As Slayers, you must strategically work together, gathering items, enhancing your skills, and uncovering the castle's secrets. Yet, be wary — friendships can swiftly turn as fallen Slayers have the chance to join Dracula's legion, working against their former allies.

—description from the publisher

name: Keystone: North America – Second Edition
description:
In Keystone: North America, you and your friends will take on the role of biologists and work to build an interconnected ecosystem through the careful placement of cards. Use skills, introduce important Keystone animals, and perform wildlife research to maximize your points.

Keystone: North America (Second Edition) offers multiple ways to play, updated rules and refined style! Go head-to-head against your friends in multiplayer and see who can build the healthiest ecosystem. Or experience a narrative adventure that will take you on a journey across North America with the Field Journal. This fully illustrated book contains a solo or co-op campaign where you will solve puzzles, learn about amazing animals, and explore the different ecosystems that make up North America.

—description from the publisher

name: Birds on Birds
description:
One tree. A bunch of birds. What could go wrong? Find out in this light-hearted soirée of balancing adorably difficult birds for one to four players. Take turns selecting from your pools of oddly shaped birds, carefully balancing them on the rocking nesting tree. If the birds hold firm, you’re in the clear. The higher you climb, the more you score!

How to Play
- Select a bird from your supply to place (with one hand only!) 
- Balance your bird on the tree (seriously, with just one hand!
- Say, “Silly little squirrel, stay away from me!”
- If no birds have fallen, you did it! Score your points and end your turn.
- However – if any bird falls, add the fallen birds to your supply and end your turn.
- First player to run out of birds or reach 20 points wins!

name: Legends of the Seas
description:
Legends of the Seas is a family-friendly, narrative-driven, cooperative game that takes you aboard a ship to experience adventures and battle pirates. You play as the shipmates of the Arrow! Amid the crash of the waves and the thunder of cannons, you are the last stand against the ocean and its armies. Take the helm, man the cannons, patch the hull, for only your bravery can save the ship and forge its legend!

At your side stand Ely the lookout, Oldor the boatswain, and Captain Elara. They are brought to life through the companion app. It is through them that events unfold: enemy attacks, shifting weather, and the consequences of your choices on the ship and on your story.

Players move around the ship, fixing and upgrading it, fending off attacks (or attacking others) and rescuing treasure, and try to complete story driven quests.  But be warned! If the hold or the helm of the Arrow is destroyed, you lose the game.

An AI app is required to play this game.

—description from the publisher

name: Legends Untold: Illumination of Deepsorrow Novice Set
description:
The Illumination of Deepsorrow is a standalone expansion for the Legends Untold system which can be enhanced with the addition of the Weeping Caves and Great Sewers Novice Sets. It can also be combined with these products to create a massive catalogue of cards for self-build adventures.
 Deepsorrow introduces:
Four new playable Occupations and Cultures, along with a host of new Weapons, Kits, Outfits and Talents to let you build the character you want.

A new Focus system that allows you to use the mystic teachings of the Nabti Walkers to push your body and mind to the limits of endurance.

New Physiological Talents for the Wrathlander - use natural gifts to survive poison and even channel lightning!

A new Shock Condition that impacts both Heroes and Foes, beware that sparking floor tile!

A new Clues and Epilogues system that rewards exploration – will you brave that Vine Swing Barrier to reveal more about the multiple factions that have an interest in the ancient site?

New Boons and Backpack cards that let you expand your party’s arsenal of options, you must use them wisely to ensure your survival.

New Loot categories including Locked, Sealed, and Heavy, that require you to use all your wits to benefit from them.

A new Treasure deck system for those that always have to find every piece of loot.

A Cinematic Campaign of multiple Plot Arcs, that you must discover and interact as you explore Deepsorrow.

Exhausted, a messenger collapses on the steps of the temple. From his hand a single leaf drops to the floor and a shockwave echoes across the sanctuary. The Monks at Firesorrow have waited millennia for the sign - the Lost Forest has come to life - A Step into Darkness has begun.

Where the sky screams and black clouds roar 
Where the sand climbs high and eagles soar 
Secrets will travel by sail and oar
To Dip’Sa’Ra on distant shore

The violent wind whips sand across your face; overhead the constant lightning of the Wrathstorm earths into the enormous coral-like spires that tower above you. You are sworn to your quest: you must investigate the mysteries of Deepsorrow and find the ancient Illumolith so that you may shine a beacon of light and illuminate the approaching darkness.

-description from publisher

name: Legions of Kadmon
description:
Legions of Kadmon is a deathly strategic card game themed around necromancy. Enter Morbidia, a cursed realm where the line between life and death is no longer certain. Become a Death Summoner, tainted creatures born out of Kadmon's teachings. A group of talented individuals capable of wielding the Death Esa — the ability to control the Dead.

Players will face a gauntlet of bosses called the Sovereigns. These special units are hosts to Kadmon's Ichor. Players deal damage to the Sovereign to collect Kadmon's Ichor. At the end of the game, the player with the most Ichor wins.

Every turn, a unit will ambush each player. These units are a part of Kadmon's Legion. As a Death Summoner, you can summon your own unit or cast a spell. Every card in the game can act as both a unit or a spell in an intricate duality. You must choose carefully on how to use each card.

In this card game, players do not obtain cards in a conventional manner. In order to obtain cards, a player must kill a unit on the board. Then, those players put the killed units in their hands. Every unit on the table are valid targets, including those belonging to other players. As players progress further in the gauntlet, Sovereigns will be killed and obtained by players. Use their power in the battle against Kadmon.

—description from the designer

name: LEGO: NINJAGO – Destiny's Bounty Adventures
description:
LEGO: NINJAGO – Destiny’s Bounty Adventures is a co-operative family board game in which you and your fellow ninja will go on thrilling adventures, facing serpents, pirates...and even a bewildered postman.

In the game, villains are attacking the great ship Destiny's Bounty, and the ninja must defend their ship! To defeat the villains, you must unlock your ninja potential. Upgrade your skills and work together with your fellow ninja using your unique abilities to thwart the villains' plans to conquer the ship.

In more detail, at the beginning of the game, you choose an adventure. Each adventure has a different difficulty and set-up and brings plot twists, making players adapt and approach each adventure in different ways.

The villains try to reach the important areas of the ship, and if they do, you add the villains to the villain track. If this track is ever full, the ninja lose the game.

To win, the ninja do things like drink tea, read comic books, and defeat villains. As they do that, their victory tracks fill and unlock upgrades in the form of better spinjitzu and potential cards that give a character specific abilities. Which cards you choose and how you co-operate will be essential to winning.

name: Les Secrets de Warden Keene
description:
1925.
A cemetery on a hill in Illinois.
A strange notebook locked away in a drawer.
Recently appointed as the caretaker, you inherit it, and within its pages, you uncover the secrets gathered by your predecessor, Warden Keene. Mysteries abound, and your only clues lie in the epitaphs etched into each gravestone.
They tell the story of the small town through the final traces of its residents, now resting six feet under.
Using observation and deduction, you will soon realize these graves are not as silent as they initially seem…

—description from the publisher

name: Let's Go! To France
description:
You are travelers planning and experiencing your own dream vacations to France.
Explore Paris, soaking up art, history, and delicious food through its many tourist attractions and hidden gems.  Using over 100 beautifully illustrated cards, you will discover activities and strategically place them to create your six day itinerary. While puzzling out your optimal activities, you will plan your trip to one of four marvelous regions of France. Will you bask in the sun along the French Riviera or explore the historic castles of the Loire valley?
Play competitively or solo, earning victory points by successfully balancing the two halves of your vacation, making the most out of your interests, and managing your time well. The most points wins, but everyone has the chance to create a memorable vacation.

—description from the publisher

name: Lets Go Cadets!
description:
In the year 2500 C.E. (more or less), humanity has become, let’s say,  slightly clumsier and dull with the passing of time. Now, overwhelmed by the last Znorg’s invasion, humans are desperately looking for cadets up to the task. That is why you are here: a group of  uncoordinated and undisciplined new recruits, yet committed with a selfless willingness to serve with enthusiasm and loyalty   to “The Last Hope” left for humanity. Will it be enough?

A cooperative game from 2 to 4 players in a 30 minutes match on which you should manage “The Last Hope” spaceship while getting ready for the final battle against the Znorgs. Coordination, organization and teamwork are pivotal in order to survive in the ship. Will you be able to coordinate the numerous logistic tasks? Such as managing inventories, storing and keeping your food or even cleaning the bathrooms. Will you be able to do it while the occasional Znorgs’ inconvenient shenanigans disrupt the ship?

The game takes place during 3 stages where players will coordinate, upgrade ship modules and strengthen the team to defeat the Znorg in the Final battle.

The players will choose their dice simultaneously behind their screen. They will take turns declaring the number of the dice they are going to play, but not its color nor on which mission they will put them on to play. When everyone but the captain have declared their dice, the captain will say Lets, Go, Cadets! at which point everyone will simultaneously place their dice on a mission trying to fulfill the color and sum requirements, while trying not to damage the ship.

If players make it through the battle against the Znorg without destroying 4 ship modules, congratulations! You have saved humanity.

This game was the winner in the Party Games category at the recent Game Jam Latam Creativa 2021.

name: Limits of Glory: Donning the Sacred Heart
description:
This is a standalone game using the Limits of Glory system to examine the impact of events on the Civil War in the Vendee in 1793. Will you fight for the Republic or For God and the King?

The French Revolution was not welcomed by all in France. The staunchly Catholic and Royalist leaning Vendee Militaire was a region unwilling to sacrifice its youth to the voracious appetite of the Republic's military conscription machine, and the people of the Vendee were prepared to fight to defend their beliefs.

In Donning the Sacred Heart you take the role of either the Vendee Catholic Royalists, or the Republicans.

The Limits of Glory series examines the effect of 'skill and luck' on the commanders present in a campaign. A Glory rating is attributed to all the significant participants in the campaign, made up from the skill they exhibited and the luck from which they benefited. Players must make difficult decisions as to when to use their commanders Glory to mitigate the situation on the board to their advantage by attempting to change unfavourable events as the campaign unfolds.

—description from the designer

name: Lizzie Borden's Ghost: The Board Game
publisher: Best True Crime Books, Games & Video LLC
description:
Fall River, Mass. 1927: Elizabeth “Lizzie” Andrew Borden, the main suspect in the August 4, 1892, ax murders of her father and stepmother, has died of natural causes. She has left a faded letter to the four people who can finally solve the crime. One player takes the role of Lizzie Borden. The remaining take the roles of City Marshal, Judge, Neighbor, and News Reporter, called the “Seekers.” The Seekers move room to room while picking up 19th century equipment used for paranormal exploring. They attempt to capture Lizzie’s ghost as it travels the scene of the crime: the Borden home.

The game board is a map of the first and second floors, back and front yards of the Borden home, Massachusetts, circa late 1800s. Each room and noted areas is a “Hot Spot,” or haunting.
Seekers gather equipment for capturing Lizzie’s ghost moving room to room only by using marked doorways. Lizzie moves in secret using the "Hot Spot" location cards. By various means, the Seekers attempt to deduce and uncover Lizzie’s location.
A roll of the dice, a turn of a card, a decision to "seek" or "hover"- will a Seeker catch Lizzie's ghost and force her to admit her guilt? Or will she escape by haunting five hot spots without being found?

Adult themes of criminal activity, gore, paranormal
Mystery, roll ‘n’ play, selection
This game was created by an all-female team of talented writers, artists, and designers from all over the world. The game includes trivia, facts, and history of the case and the 19th century.

—description from the designer

name: Flock!
description:
Find your flock and a home to roost in this exciting new take on Rummy for two to five players. Compete to have the most birds gathered on your island. But beware, these fowls are quite fickle, as other players can play cards to attract birds from your flocks to theirs. Will you play it safe and send your birds home to roost, or risk it all in a bid for more points?


     Draw a Card
     Take Two Play Actions
         Flock (Play a Set of Three Matching Birds)
             Matching Birds Join Your Flock
             Birds from Your Flock Can Fly Away!
        
         Roost (Play a Run of Three Birds)
             Play from Hand or Board
             Roosted Birds No Longer Fly Away! 
        
    
     Take Free Actions
         Use Your Island Power
             Reset the Flap [discard pile]
        
         Use a Feather Token
             Draw a Card, Change a Suit, or Take a Third Action
        
    
     Discard 1 Card to the Flap
     Continue Until a Player Runs Out of Cards – Highest Score Wins!

name: Lodge
description:
Be sure to check your skis at the front desk!

From acclaimed designer Peter McPherson (Tiny Towns, Fit To Print) comes Lodge, a spatial puzzle game set in the beautiful Swiss Alps.

Draft room tiles from a sliding display and place them on matching floors to attract guests to your lodge. Gain bonus points for placing those guests on their preferred floors and by constructing amenities to keep them happy.

—description from the designer

name: Lone Corvette: A Solitaire Wargame
description:
It is late 1942 and the seas are dangerous and frightening. Allied convoys surge across the Atlantic, bringing vital supplies to Britain and Russia. But beneath the waves, Germany’s U-Boats are on the hunt, silent and deadly.
You are the captain of a Flower Class Corvette. Your mission is to escort and protect merchant shipping, evade aggressive U-Boats and survive the threat of German air power.
Aircraft patrol the skies and U-Boats roam the convoy lanes. Your four inch gun may sink a lone surfaced U-Boat within its limited firing circle, but your depth charges are your main weapon, as you drop them into the deep seas in the hope of destroying an unsuspecting U-Boat. The decisions you make will be crucial to your success as a Corvette captain.
This is a game of cat and mouse, timing, and nerve. You’ll manage movement, detection and damage across a range of different maps, using sonar sweeps, depth charges and gunfire, both at U-Boats and at the enemy in the skies above.

Can you complete your mission or will your Corvette become yet another silent wreck beneath the Atlantic?

How the game works
This is a solitaire wargame. You play the game, and the enemy is controlled by the game. You will need about 6 standard six-sided dice. It is recommended that the counters provided on the final page of the game are used to play this game (especially for the Ships, Aircraft and U-Boats). Simply stick them to card and cut them out.

Quick to set up, easy to play, very replayable but certainly challenging, this game should provide you with hours of fun.

—description from the designer

name: Lone Wolf: Vengeance of the Kai
description:
Lone Wolf: Vengeance of the Kai is an asymmetrical 2-player strategy game set in the world of Lone Wolf - the fantasy setting of the series first launched 40 years ago.  It encompasses the storyline of the first 12 books in the series, allowing players to relive the decisive battle between good (Lone Wolf and the Freeland Alliance) and evil (the Darklords of Helgedad and their allies) for the fate of Magnamund, with different outcomes every time.

The game lasts 6 rounds, with each side pursuing different objectives to win.  Game rounds consist of 3 phases - the Action Phase, Quest Phase and Refresh Phase.

The Freeland Alliance begins the game with less resources (troops, gold) and must survive long enough for Lone Wolf to succeed at five (5) Quests to recover the power and wisdom of his slaughtered Order (the Kai Lords of Sommerlund) to destroy the Darklords.

The Darklords possess a more powerful army and greater wealth, which they must use to conquer 5 of 9 strategic Freeland capitals before Lone Wolf succeeds at his Quests.  If neither side achieves their objective by the end of the 6th game round, the winner is determined by whoever accumulated more Victory Points, which are gained by succeeding at Quests (Freeland Alliance only), controlling strategic capitals or damaging/destroying enemy Leaders. The game has multiple sources of variability - mix of Leaders, starting territories, card draws - that allow for endless re-playability (no 2 games will ever be the same). The game play is tense, with every action a trade-off between advancing your own agenda or hindering your opponent's.  Seemingly inconsequential actions taken early in the game often turn out to have major repercussions in later rounds.

—description from the designer

name: Long Dark Sea
description:
Long Dark Sea is an exploration and adventure card game, where deck-building and resource management are its main mechanics.

Play solo or cooperatively with up to 4 players through an interactive board designed from a modular system that allows customization for each game.

Set in a bespoke science fiction universe, embark on adventures in the quest for ancient relics of great power through a campaign mode that divides each scenario into three distinct acts.

The use of the innovative system allows you to explore, battle, and obtain resources during raid cycles to later enhance your character during supply cycles.

Will you survive until the third act, face the final Nemesis, and escape with your life while claiming the loot?

—description from the designer

name: Pebbles
description:
Control the ice, collect pebbles, and find love in this chilly area-control game of the heart for two to four players. Play cards to both win hands AND strategically outmaneuver your foes on the frozen tundra board. Will your clever play win you the love and pebbles needed for victory, or will you be pushed aside by a more worthy rival?

How to Play

On Your Turn
Play a card to try and win a trick and gain a love token.
- Starting player establishes trump
- Highest value trump card wins the trick
- You do DON’T have to follow suit!

Take two actions …
- Place a unit on a space matching your played card
- Use a power of your played card
- Go Fishing for a new card and bonus fish token

Gain victory points by …
- Controlling spaces and territories
- Owning Love Tokens and Fish Tokens

name: Loose in the Library
description:
In Loose In The Library, the players are apprentices in a cursed library. Literary terrors have escaped from the books and are roaming the shelves. The long-suffering Librarian has set you a number of different challenges. Who will be the first one to capture the Kraken, Fenrir, or Grendel's Mother? Or terrors with specific symbols? Or use a fictional object? Each challenge is worth points, as are the terrors themselves. You will have both public challenges for which everyone competes and private challenges which you score only for yourself at the end.

You capture the terrors by drawing fictional and historical heroines into your hand. These inspirational women provide you with different symbols, and so you are looking for the right combination of symbols to allow you to capture the terrors currently visible in the middle of the table. You're after Martian Robots? That's two red hearts and two green ovals, please. Luckily Anne of Green Gables and Marie Curie have you covered! Succeed in capturing a terror, and you get a reward. It may be a magical object, or a piece of helpful library equipment — such as the photocopier, which allows you to duplicate symbols on your book cards, or the library clock, which gives you an additional action.

At the end of the game, add up the points gained from captured terrors and completed challenges. The player with the highest score wins.

Loose In The Library is played in multiple different ways. There are three chapters, with the possibility of more to come. Each chapter uses the same cards, but has slightly different mechanics. Chapter 1 is the base game. Chapter 2 introduces negative points. Chapter 3 includes drafting. Play them all in order, then decide which one will become your standard version!

—description from the designer

name: Lord of Loot
description:
Lord of Loot is a  cooperative family-friendly fantasy board game. Explore a vast land filled with treasures, powerful weapons, and dangerous monsters. Level up your hero, master magic, and cooperate with your party of heroes to complete daring quests and earn epic rewards.

Players take their turns alternating with the monsters. Our heroes use their 4 actions per turn to add land tiles to the map, draw loot from loot bags or fight with monsters. Monster fights are using attack and defense dice - which get stronger with better weapons.

Your party of Heroes must defeat the evil end Bosses before they grow too powerful. The time you have is represented by the Monster card deck running
out. But it’s not as simple as charging in swords blazing! To face the end Bosses, you’ll first need to complete their unique quests.

The Heroes win once they have defeated all Bosses. The Heroes lose if you run out of Monster cards or if Heroes get knocked out more than two times.

—description from the publisher

name: Lords of Heaven
description:
Vie for control of Jerusalem and the supremacy of the Middle East as one of the four major powers of the medieval world: the Latin Christian Crusaders, the Orthodox Christian Byzantine Empire, the Shia Fatimid Caliphate, or the Sunni Seljuks. Refight and change the history of the two first Crusades!

Lords of Heaven is an area control and card placement game. You, the leaders of each of the four asymmetric factions, will play action cards to take your actions such as build units, fortresses, and temples, move troops, fight battles, and develop your Middle East holdings.

The game is a combination of rivalry and cooperation between two blocks of factions – Christian and Islamic – where combat and conquest are not always the best ways to achieve success. Politically nuanced and steeped in its early crusades setting, Lords of Heaven will offer a couple of short scenarios and a campaign.

—description from the publisher

name: Lucky Xmas
description:
In Lucky Xmas you are allowed to use Santa's magic to alter the outcome of the biggest lottery ever. Our aim: give everybody a great Christmas. The winner will become Santa's helper.

On your turn you will choose 1 card to add to your tableau in row 1, 2, 3 or 4. Once a row consists of 3 cards, you raise money for Santa’s lottery. You try to maximize the score of each row by matching symbols: 4 of a kind, full house and special patterns of 6 cards. Depending on the row and the symbols on the cards of that row, you will gain Special Powers to alter the outcome of future rounds.

name: Lunch: The Game of Playground Politics
description:
Have you ever wanted to raise an army of third-graders for dominance over the playground? Ever dreamed of enlisting a tattle-tale to coup the de-facto leader of the slides?
Ever yearned to rig a presidential election by promising your buddies positions in your kiddie-cabinet? Well, now you can! Introducing Lunch, the game of playground politics.

Lunch is a deck-building war game for 2-4 players that takes place in an elementary school playground, featuring elements of deception, negotiation, and trade.

Players take on the roles of third-grade transfers into a new school with a unique custom. Come lunch time, the school courtyard becomes a war zone with kids fighting for every square inch of territory.

Over the course of a full school year, players take on the role of one of these kids, battling and negotiating their way to secure dominance over the playground.

When the bell rings, it's every kid for themselves.

—description from the designer

name: Luxor: Big Box
description:
On the hunt for fame and priceless treasures, groups of adventurers explore the legendary temple at Luxor. Their ultimate goal is the tomb of the pharaoh, but many treasures can be found as they search?

As the parties explore, the challenge unfolds: The player who manages to quickly get their team of adventurers to the tomb, while salvaging as many treasures as possible, will be the winner.

Luxor offers variable game play – the path that leads to the tomb is different for every game, and can even change during play!

A fast-paced family game with an innovative movement mechanism and an ever-changing game board.

Includes:
Luxor
Luxor: The Mummy's Curse 
Luxor: Queenie 1 – Swarm of Scarabs
Luxor: Queenie 2 – The Snake God's Boon
Luxor: Queenie 3 – Secret Missions
Luxor: Queenie 4 – The Treasure Chamber
Luxor: Exclusive Queenie (Queenie 5)
Luxor: The Gift of Luxor (Queenie 6)
New Surprise Queenie

—description from the publisher

name: Macaraccoon
description:
A wondrous land of sweet-toothed critters, Sugarmouth is home to Macaraccoon, the renowned Bakemaster! Ensuring sugary treats for all is no easy task, though, and one fateful day, Macaraccoon announces he is hanging up his apron, to pursue his childhood dream of collecting shiny trash. But before he leaves, he'll find a successor! A fresh batch of wonder has frosted everyone’s minds: who will be the next Bakemaster of Sugarmouth?

Welcome to the world of Macaraccoon, where aspiring pastry chefs bake off to become the most beloved critter in the kitchen. Craft delectable desserts for picky customers with the help of adorable animal chefs to become the smartest cookie in the jar. With its secret recipe of resource management, set collection, and adorable pastry-making critters, Macaraccoon is a family game but also has enough bite for serious gamers.

Pick transparent ingredient cards from a shared kitchen and layer them to watch your culinary creations come to life. But watch out – other chefs might grab them first. Combine bases, spreads, and toppings on your countertops to fulfill orders. Use your limited space to stack those ingredients in the right order or the dish can't be completed.

As soon as the Order Deck runs out, the game end is triggered. Players complete the current round, then play one more round. Count the number of Hearts shown on all your completed Orders, plus any Heart Tokens earned. The player with the most Hearts wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Machiavellian: The City of Masks
description:
Machiavellian is a big-box euro-style strategy game set in an alternate 1800s steampunk Venice. Niccolò Machiavelli and Leonardo da Vinci’s “Venetian Doctrine” has transformed the city into the heart of a global empire of gears, masks, and intrigue. Senators hide behind ornate masks, crime families thrive in the shadows, and every invention serves the state. In this world, power is theatre, and only the most cunning can rise to the top.

Players take the role of ambitious nobles vying to become the next Doge of Venice. To win, you must secure the loyalty of enough Senators through influence, bribery, and manipulation. The game revolves around Favor tokens, the currency of power across six domains (War, Trade, Finance, Politics, Technology, and Crime). You’ll spend Favors to play tech cards, scheme in government buildings, fund wars, bribe Senators, or trade across Venice’s far-reaching markets.

At the heart of the game is a dynamic mask placement and combo system: each round you send your masked agent into the halls of power, triggering narrative effects and chaining together bonuses that can shift the balance of the game. Tech cards can be played in multiple ways—discarded for powerful one-time effects, banked for long-term abilities, or cycled back into your hand for repeated use—giving you a wealth of tactical options.

The ultimate goal is to gather enough Senatorial support to seize the Dogeship. You can win instantly by assembling the right combination of Senators, or by building overwhelming reach across the Venetian Concordium. Every choice matters: will you rely on wealth and diplomacy, or intimidation and war machines? In Machiavellian, masks will fall, alliances will break, and only the most ruthless strategist will be crowned Doge-for-Life.

—description from the publisher

name: Madera Contra Acero: La Conquista de Canarias
description:
Madera Contra Acero: La Conquista de Canarias is a Strategic level board-wargame.

Masqueoca NAC wargames in its project to promote games with a national theme has been kind enough to include in its programme one with a hitherto unpublished and original theme, and as a Canarian designer it is a great satisfaction for me to present it.

Wood Against Steel: The Conquest of the Canary Islands. 
Already the title gives us a small clue of the inequality in weaponry on the sides involved in this war.  The wooden and stone weapons of the Guanches against the iron and steel of the conquerors of the Crown of Castile. But make no mistake, even though it was a very unequal struggle, the conquest of the whole archipelago lasted no less than 94 years, practically a whole century of fighting, precisely in the 15th century, which is enough to show that it was not a military stroll. By way of comparison, the conquest of America took about 40 years. It should be noted that the clash between the indigenous Canary Islanders and the Castilian troops was brutal. 
This war involved the Canary aborigines, called Guanches, and the conquistadors, on the one hand sent by the Crown of Castile and on the other sent by the Crown of Portugal. Both kingdoms coveted control of these islands, which were so strategic in their overseas territorial expansion.

It is a wargame for two players, where the Castilians slowly but continuously land on each of the 7 islands through the arrival of ships loaded with conquerors and the Guanches try by all means to stop and expel the newcomers to their earthly paradise. The game is played by secret and simultaneous orders and with the help of two decks of event cards, so the turns are a lot of fun and with variable strategy adapted to the moment.
The battles are resolved on a Battle mat with special rules for mountain regions. There are also naval battles. The Castilian player wins if he has conquered the 7 Canary Islands in the last turn.

—description from the designer

Masqueoca NAC wargames en su proyecto de fomento de juegos con temática nacional ha tenido a bien incluir en su programa uno con temática hasta ahora inédita y original, y que como diseñador canario es una gran satisfacción para mi presentar.

Madera Contra Acero: La Conquista de Canarias. 
Ya el titulo nos da una pequeña pista de la desigualdad en armamento en los bandos implicados en esta guerra.  Las armas de madera y piedra de los guanches contra el hierro y acero de los conquistadores de la Corona de Castilla. Pero que no llame a engaño, aun siendo una lucha muy desigual, la conquista de todo el archipiélago duró nada menos que 94 años, prácticamente todo un siglo de combates, precisamente el siglo XV,  ello es un indicador suficiente para entender que aquello no fue un paseo militar. Como comparación la conquista de America duró unos 40 años. Se hace necesario destacar que el choque entre los indígenas canarios y las tropas castellanas fue brutal. 
Esta guerra en la que intervinieron los aborígenes canarios, llamados guanches, y los conquistadores , por un lado enviados por la Corona de Castilla y por otro enviados por la Corona de Portugal. Ya que ambos reinos codiciaban el control de estas islas tan estratégicas en su expansión territorial de ultramar.
Es un wargame para dos jugadores, donde el castellano mediante la llegada lenta pero continua de barcos cargados de conquistadores va desembarcando en cada una de las 7 islas y los guanches intentan por todos los medios frenar y expulsar a los recién llegados a su paraíso terrenal. Se juega mediante ordenes secretas y simultaneas y con la ayuda de dos mazos de cartas de eventos , con lo cual los turnos son muy divertidos y con estrategia variable adaptada al momento. Las batallas se resuelven en un mapa de batalla anexo con reglas especiales para las regiones montañosas. También hay batallas navales.
El jugador castellano ganará si en el ultimo turno ha conquistado las 7 islas canarias.

—description from the designer (Spanish)

name: Maestro
description:
In the bustling Italian city-states of the early 1500s, art was not only beauty but power. Workshops competed fiercely for prestige, fueled by the rivalry of great masters like Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo Buonarroti. Artists labored tirelessly to create masterpieces—from sweeping frescoes to marble statues—each work a statement of skill and vision.

These creations were carried across courts and palaces, traveling the Italian peninsula to be exhibited in galleries and public spaces, where they dazzled the eyes of nobles and citizens alike. But art alone was not enough. Success depended on securing the favor of the wealthy and powerful. Through charm, reputation, and spectacle, workshops sought to influence Collectors, drawing them to their galleries and winning their lifelong support.

In Maestro Michelangelo and da Vinci’s workshops compete for fame and aristocratic attention in various courts and galleries across the Italian peninsula. During the game, the two workshops are either represented by a single player or a team of players.

Players take turns resolving their actions, creating Artworks, exhibiting their art across the northern provinces of the Italian peninsula, influencing the taste of the powerful Collectors and competing for publicity of the local elite. The workshop with the most victory points after 4 rounds becomes a winner and is declared the most iconic artist of the Renaissance!

—description from the publisher

name: Mafia Blitz
description:
Did the Rat escape? That's the question you and your friends will answer in Mafia Blitz, the lightning-fast bluffing game where every role has their own way to win. In just 15 minutes, players will scheme, deceive, and outsmart each other, all while dodging the Vigilante’s watchful gaze.

Mafia Blitz is a social deduction game played in a single round with no player elimination and role-drafting system for 6-12 players. A single player will take on the role of the Vigilante, a public role with a single objective: Make sure the Rat isn't shot by anyone. The rest of players will pick their role through a draft and the chosen role is the player's win condition for the game.

From there, the players discuss what happened, such as what roles they picked or passed to the next player. Of course, you don't have to tell the truth! It is an open discussion, although the Vigilante has the authority to prevent cross-talks or enforce silence periods. The Vigilante is equipped with Verdict cards and they place them in front of players they suspect are Goons. Once placed, the end the discussion by saying "Bang!" The selected players show their roles and any Goons not shot will now reveal themselves and attempt to shoot the Rat.

Each role has its own path to victory. Some are hunting others, while others are trying to keep their heads low. And some special scoundrels have their own agendas to fulfill – no matter the cost.

—description from the designer

name: Rook Requiem
description:
Every soul needs a guide. Usher spirits to the afterlife in this spooky trick-taking game for three to five players. Face off in a strategic duel for ghosts, each with unique modifiers you need the most. But beware of the powerful Rook lurking in each player’s hand, for they have the ultimate power to upset your plans.

How to Play
1. Determine Trump
2. Deal Cards
3. Reveal a Ghost
4. Play Tricks
- You must follow suit
- High card wins, unless trump is played
- Highest trump wins the trick, unless a Rook is played. Rooks have unique powers and copy the previously played suit.
5. The Winner Takes the Trick and the Ghost Card
- Ghost cards can be positive or negative, and have special abilities
6. Play a Round – Each round consists of 12 tricks. 
7. Count Scores and Reset – The Highest Score after 3 Rounds wins!

name: Making Monsters
publisher: Sky Lion Games LLC; Astoria Games
description:
In Making Monsters, players take on the role of mad scientists competing at the Monster Maker Science Fair, where only the most brilliant and bizarre creations will earn prestige and fame.

Each round, players secretly choose how many monster parts to order—hoping to outwit their rivals and gather the right materials. Then, using a push-your-luck bag-building mechanic, players simultaneously draw and assemble monster parts, trying to complete powerful creatures before their lab experiments collapse. Build too cautiously and fall behind, but push too far and your monster might fall apart in spectacular fashion.

Completed monsters grant points and special upgrades when re-animated, and each one adds to a growing tableau of increasingly wild and strategic upgrade and prestige point options. Players can also earn bonuses from their helpful robotic assistant, Lester, and manipulate the science fair for an edge in future rounds.

At the end of the game, the science fair concludes with a Grand Finale: a final simultaneous challenge where each player selects their five favorite monsters from their lab and attempts to build them from their remaining resources. Success earns prestige; failure can cost dearly. It’s a final test of strategy, memory, and risk management as players race to complete their ultimate monster squads before the fair closes.

name: Malagasy
description:
In Malagasy, four tribes live together peacefully, in symbiosis with nature. Spirit guides on the player boards help players explore the island and the ideal locations of the majestic baobabs that are considered sacred. During your turn, you can discover a new territory by placing a new biome tile receiving the favour of the spirits on the corresponding tracks or you can move your explorer to discover the animals and plants that live with you. When you interact with sea tiles, you collect new culture cards that favour your tribe. During this adventure, don't forget the sacred baobabs: if you can find the best place for each of them according to the patterns on the baobab cards, you will earn additional victory points.

—description from the designer

name: Maleficium: Fall of the Witch Hunters
description:
"Maleficium" is a strategy game where you play as a leader in the fight against the 17th century English witch hunts. A person who through reason saw the wrong doings, the maleficium, in what the witch hunters pursued. A person dedicated to bringing this horrible practice to an end and making the witch hunters fall from grace.

You play as one of the persons that saw beyond the hysteria in the society concerning witchcraft. By promoting Enlightened thought, Religious tolerance and Legal skepticism you will succeed and eventually your work will lead to changes in the law. You do this by gathering evidence, confronting witch hunters, dispelling hysteria, and championing justice, securing your legacy as the one that ended the witch hunts.

Buy cards from the market to acquire allies and evidence. The allies in your tableau give you actions and influence. Position yourself on the map to take actions and challenge witch hunters. Calm hysteria and thwart your opponent’s plans.

The game can be played competitively or as a solo game.

—description from the designer

name: Punch Bowl
description:
No one knows when the giant fruits started growing, but everyone agrees they make a legendary punch. Become the head of one of four factions — orange, lemon, grape, or strawberry — and lead a band of rollicking revelers to victory.

Compete with the other factions to bring the most desired ingredients to three massive punch bowls before they're served. Fish out your opponents' fruits, add droves of your own, and introduce special ingredients to tip the balance. When each punch is served, the winner adds some to their punch cup, along with coveted ice cubes for varying bonuses.

Punch Bowl includes elements of area control, as well as a unique deck-curation mechanism in which players manage an ever-diminishing deck. Outmaneuver your opponents to win eternal glory and an overflowing cup of punch!

Everyone starts the game with the same deck of 12 cards. Each round, draw three cards. Choose one to remove from your deck, one to keep for later, and one to play. At the end of each round, roll the serving die to add a ladle to a punch. The player with the highest value of fruit in their quadrant wins the punch and gets to add fruit to their cup. The game ends when a player runs out of fruit or you can’t draw three cards at the start of the round. The player with the most points wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Manila
description:
In the strategy game Manila, you explore the Philippine archipelago, cultivate fields, establish trading posts and factories, and seek influence in Manila — all while preparing for typhoons.

The game combines popular mechanisms from Amerigo with a novel action selection system and dice tower that creates excitement, strategy, and moments of surprise. The game plays over three rounds, with each round consisting of seven turns per players, then ends with an additional bonus round.

Points are awarded for Island, Manila tracks and tiles, Sets of Plants, Coins. The player with the most points wins.

name: Habemus Papam
description:
Step into the heart of the Conclave, where tradition, intrigue, and ambition collide. In Habemus Papam, players take on the roles of Cardinal factions, each representing distinct interests within the Catholic Church. Your mission? To influence the election of the next Pope by supporting a candidate whose traits align with your faction's public profile — covering their stance on the church, age, personality, and origin — while secretly pursuing a hidden agenda that might conflict with your stated goals.

Strategic use of influence is at the core of the game. This resource serves dual purposes; influence is the currency for playing powerful cards and swaying the vote, but it's also your points, so spend it wisely. Each round, you gain more influence by advancing your interests through candidates who garner widespread support, but negotiation is crucial.

Forge alliances, eliminate threats, and outmaneuver rivals to secure your faction's dominance. Deduction plays a vital role because uncovering the hidden motives of others can shift the balance of power.

At the end of each of the first four rounds, the Conclave may declare a "Fumata Blanca" — crowning a Pope and triggering final scoring — or a "Fumata Negra", signaling another round of intrigue. If no Pope is elected after five rounds, the game concludes with or without a Pontiff, and the final score is tallied.

—description from the publisher

name: Marcher: Empires at War
description:
Marcher: Empires at War, is a tabletop miniatures wargame set in an alternate history diesel-punk sci-fi setting deeply rooted in the retro-futuristic aesthetics of the early 20th century, where the industrial revolution happened much earlier than in real life.  The year is 1938 and players will recreate company-level battles from The Great War using 28mm heroic scale miniatures.

Marcher is a D10-based alternating activation wargame played on a board the size of a standard dining room table. It features immersive aspects such as armor facing, blast templates, and suppression, but is also designed for relatively quick games.

Key features:

    Armies: Each Player fields armies of infantry, vehicles, and artillery, usually consisting of around 10 unique Units, but can range greatly in army size with a maximum number of Units capped at 20.
    Actions: Each Unit may perform two different, standard Actions per activation from their available list. Some Units have unique Actions specific to their stat sheet.
    D10-based Checks: Outcomes of Actions are determined by Checks, which involve the roll of a D10. An unmodified roll of a 1 always fails, and an unmodified roll of a 10 always succeeds.
    Alternating Activation: Unit activation in Marcher is carried out in an alternating fashion - opponents alternate activating individual units one at a time.
    Command Squads: Officers are separate models but are attached to squads before the start of gameplay. Each Platoon includes one officer leading them into battle.
    Measurements: All measurements use the Imperial system and are taken from the bases or hulls of the models.

name: Marches & Batailles: Belgium 1815
description:
Marches & Batailles is an operational-level Napoleonic wargame played on historical canvas maps with wooden counters. No dice rolling is required - the game play, outcome of battles and morale effects are determined by the drawing of colored tokens.  Belgium - 1815 allows you to relive this epic battle through 6 scenarios and a campaign covering them all!

The map is marked with positions that are more or less distant from one another, where a certain number of units can be deployed, depending on the nature of the terrain. Your units move from one position to another. They are aligned along the connections between positions, giving the impression of marching columns across the map. Units have a different combat value depending on whether they are in column or deployed.

Counters represent around 4,000 infantrymen or 1,600 cavalrymen, and their 3cm front is to the scale of the map. The combat value of a unit varies from 1 to 9, and represents both the morale of the units (militia, line, guard) and the training of the soldiers (conscripts, regulars, veterans).
This value is used to resolve combat situations and morale tests.

The sequence of play makes scrupulous execution of your intentions uncertain. It alternates between marching movements and activations combining offensive, moves and attacks. As with the tests, the order of these actions is determined by colored tokens drawn from an activation bag.

You win by breaking the morale of the opposing army by routing its units, taking its communication points, even capturing its generals in chief.

—description from the publisher

name: Market Fresh
description:
Take the role of a vendor at your local farmers market and strategically stack Produce Crates to maximize your stock. Doing so will earn you points along the way but be mindful of the competition as each produce type will score bonus points at the end of the game for player who cornered the market!

Market Fresh is a stacking, tile-placement game for 1 to 4 players. On a players turn, they take a crate from the supply or one of the available face up crates and add it to their hand. They will then choose one of their crates from their hand to place into their stall and score points accordingly.

Points are scored when you place a crate into your stall. The more produce you match that is visible on your board, the more you'll score. Players earn bonus points at the end of the game for each produce type which they had the most crates of.

Market Fresh includes smaller market stalls and a "Crate Heights" variants which adds extra challenge to the game for players who want to build taller stands!

—description from the publisher

name: Marsh Hallow
description:
Marsh Hallow is a cooperative flip and write dungeon crawler game played over 18 rounds (each round is referred to as an hour of The Ritual).

Players draw cards and use revealed animals, represented as shapes, from the Animal Deck to navigate the Marshmallow Cultist campground within Marsh Hallow.

To win, players must reach the Pyre before the end of the Ritual and have enough water to douse the flame to save their families.

—description from the designer

name: Marvel: Remix the Cosmos
description:
Expand your Marvel Remix experience with new teams, new combinations, and new strategies. Players recruit heroes, allies, and locations from across the Marvel Universe, including The Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy, Captain Marvel, Silver Surfer, Doctor Strange, Ms. Marvel, She-Hulk, and more! Equip characters with iconic gear and face off against infamous villains like Venom and Doctor Doom.

Each player begins with a hand of seven cards representing characters, items, or places from the Marvel Universe.  On your turn, draw from the Hero deck, the Villain deck, or a shared discard pile, then discard one card from your hand.

Get ready for an epic Superhero battle!


     Designed by Bruce Glassco, Marvel: Remix the Cosmos is based on the acclaimed game Fantasy Realms, which was nominated for the 2021 Kennerspiel des Jahres! 
     Introduces Cosmic cards with immediate effects and big bonuses, including all six Infinity Stones! 
     Fully playable as a standalone game, or add to Marvel: Remix for even more explosive combos! 


—description from the publisher

name: Massive Darkness: Dungeons of Shadowreach
description:
Massive Darkness: Dungeons of Shadowreach takes the epic dungeon-crawling action of its predecessors and brings more thrilling adventures to this beloved setting. Step into the boots of six new lightbringers as you battle against the forces of Darkness in the depths of Shadowreach, a forgotten realm of endless danger and mystery.

This standalone, co-operative adventure for 1-6 players allows you to explore fantastical realms, facing a diverse array of enemies, formidable bosses, and insurmountable challenges. No game master is required for this board game adventure — gather your party and use your skills to survive the twisted caverns, battling vile monsters and mighty bosses in your quest to protect Shadowreach from the forces of Darkness.

—description from the publisher

name: Onoda
description:
Recreate the experiences of soldier Hiroo Onoda during his stay on Lubang Island — thirty years of adventures, danger, comical situations and tragic moments, life and death and, above all, a demonstration of the resilience of human beings in adverse conditions — in the solitaire game Onoda.

During six rounds of variable duration, you have to obtain a number of resources that will allow you to finish the turn without suffering penalties. In each round, you will also undertake a mission, earning honor points for it. During your adventures, you will experience some of the events that the real-life Onoda had during his stay in Lubang. If you manage to overcome the six rounds without going insane due to paranoia or dying due to ill health, it will be time to see whether you will be recognized a hero or fade into oblivion.

Onoda will get different results depending on the amount of honor you have accumulated solving missions, keeping your comrades alive, and keeping your squad in good shape.

—description from the publisher

name: Math Masters
description:
At the Magical Math Academy, everyone is excited for today's Math Masters competition.  In Math Masters, players solve math problems to reach the finish. Along the way, they can use strategy cards and special spaces to move ahead faster.

On their turn, each player draws a card from the draw pile and solves the math problem or uses the card's special effect. Players can choose to hold special cards for use later in the game. Some math problems require a die roll to supply a number for the equations, adding to this game's replayability. The rules allow for cooperative play (helping each other solve problems) as well.

The first player to cross the finish line wins.

One side of the double sided board uses addition and subtraction only.  The other adds multiplication and division problems to the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Maul
description:
Maul is a competitive two-player card game with a fantasy theme, based on a tournament between two rival teams.  Each team is comprised of 10 players that have varied skills and attributes to suit their position/role.

Players battle through 6 rounds of full-contact action, with the team holding the Detonator at the end of each round gaining points. The team with the most points after 6 rounds wins.

The play area has 5 slots on each side that are available for players, and the location of the cards in relation to each other determine how they can interact. Turn-based actions such as passing, supporting, and hitting are taken, and can be backed up with Boost cards that have different effects on play or players!

—description from the publisher

name: Mayor of Chicago
description:
It’s election year in Chicago, and as an aspiring politician this might be your golden opportunity to rise to the coveted position of Mayor. Will you gather enough money, popularity, and power to prevail?

Mayor of Chicago is a solitaire game of tight management and tough choices. Each turn, you draw a city card and decide whether you want to use it to expand your knowledge of the Windy City (by laying this card as part of the map), or hire the assistant depicted on the back of the card to benefit from their special power or scoring abilities. Only by managing shrewdly your resources and the powers of the assistants will you be able to gather enough votes to be elected.

—description from the publisher

name: Meadowvale
description:
Inspired by the landscape and wildlife of the British countryside, Meadowvale is a beautiful strategic tile-placement game.

Players build a shared countryside of woodlands, hedgerows, rivers and meadows, where animals behave according to their ecology: foxes hunt rabbits, owls sweep across open fields, and hedgehogs seek shelter along gardens and hedgerows. Through wildlife cards and habitat tokens, players enrich the landscape, creating thriving habitats that animals can inhabit and benefit from. Carefully position and move your animals, invest in species and habitats, compete for limited species tokens that unlock new ecological abilities, and anticipate your opponents as the countryside evolves.

Create balance in the countryside, claim your place among the wildlife, and become a Keeper of the Vale.

name: Mech Bunny
description:
You are a Mech Bunny. A cute, cuddly rabbit in an iron-clad war machine. After a malfunction on your spaceship, you find yourself on a strange planet full of blood thirsty predators looking for their next meal. So, now you must defend your ship long enough for the repairs to complete so you can get back home!

In this card crafting, rogue-lite game, you'll play through various scenarios full of hoards of encroaching monsters trying to destroy you and your spaceship. Each game, you'll upgrade your cards and find new weapons as you try to survive each encounter and win the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Medieval Madness
description:
Behind every great medieval story are unseen hands shaping its fate.
