Prophet Without Honor, is a courtroom showdown between an officer with a radical idea versus the military establishment keen to remind the world a prophet is without honor in his own home.

In this 2-player card and dice development game, you, as the prosecution or defense, must convince a military tribunal that American aviator, Colonel William (Billy) Mitchell, is guilty...or innocent.

The game begins in the courtroom where Colonel Mitchell of the Army Air Service is being tried for his alleged violation of the 96th Article of War, a catchall provision of military law that would decide if his incendiary, public remarks brought discredit upon the military service.

Players will draft and play cards which will help them strengthen their case with the jurors and recruit them to their side and find overwhelming evidence for or against the accused.

In the longest and most controversial court martial in US history (October 28-December 17, 1925), will the evangelist of Airpower be vindicated?

Or will the nation remain vulnerable to emerging enemies and have to wait 17 years for his predictions to be proven true...at Pearl Harbor.

This is a standalone game. It is volume 2 in the Trial Series by Green Feet Games (previous Volume includes Unforgiven: The Lincoln Assassination Trial).

America was built by people like Mitchell who questioned the status quo and believed that there was always a better way...that would fundamentally change how a nation secures its interests and projects military power.
   
—description from the publisher

name: Puppet Master: Return to Bodega Bay Inn
description:
When you and your friends decided to spend the night in this old hotel, you had no idea about the murders that had taken place years prior, and you certainly never could have imagined the animated puppets that caused it all. But you did accidently find the trunk that imprisoned those puppets for all these years, and you just couldn’t help yourself when you pried it open. The puppets are now trying to complete their dead master’s work by bringing his soul back, and all the puppets need are a few key items and an unwilling victim to be the body donor.

Puppet Master: Return to Bodega Bay Inn, is a cooperative, cat-and-mouse-style, survival game for one to four players, that uses Hand Management and Deck Hunting to influence its claustrophobic, skirmish gameplay. Explore the hotel as a modular game board you design each time, so every game is different. Each puppet has a unique personality and the “Puppet Behavior Dial” changes their strategy throughout the game. Having the right cards in your hand and a few doors strategically locked might just give you the time you need to escape but it’s a race against your quickly dwindling Deck to collect the information you need to stop the puppets before the puppets complete their agenda.

—description from the designer

name: Purgatorio: Men of Iron Volume VI
description:
The struggle between monarchs in Europe, particularly between the Holy Roman Emperor and the Pope, would spawn well over a hundred years of conflict in Italy. The Investiture Controversy caused a split between the Italian city states and even the people within the city states. Guelph was the name given to those who supported the Papacy—while the Ghibellines were the supporters of the Holy Roman Empire. Guelph cities tended to be farther away from the Papal States and closer to the Holy Roman Empire, and Ghibelline cities tended to be farther away from the Holy Roman Empire and closer to the Pope’s temporal power.

Battles raged across Italy from the mid-1100s to the mid-1300s with both sides ending up on top at one time or another. This sixth Men of Iron game covers some of those battles: beginning with Frederick Barbarossa trying to recapture rebelling provinces in Italy in the late 12th century, taking a spin through the 13th century with a few battles that spelled the end of direct Hohenstaufen rule of Italy, and ending with a war that myth says was fought over the theft of a bucket from one city by another!

The battles include:
Legnano 29 May 1176 – Frederick Barbarossa fights the Lombard League for control of northern Italy.

Cortenuova 27 November 1237 – Frederick II, grandson of Barbarossa, tangles with the second Lombard League for control of northern Italy.

Montaperti 4 September 1260 – Florence and Sienna fight one of the bloodiest battles in medieval Italy—as seen on TV, or in GMT’s Inferno!

Benevento 26 February 1266 – Manfred, King of Sicily, dies in battle in southern Italy against Charles I, also King of Sicily, securing Charles I in the title King of Sicily.

Tagliacozzo 23 August 1268 – Conradin III, King of Jerusalem, is captured and executed after a battle in southern Italy against Charles I, King of Sicily.

Campaldino 11 June 1289 – Florence and Arezzo fight in northern Italy. Famous Italian poet Dante Alighieri fought in the battle. Later, his brand of Guelph would lose power in Florence, and he would be forced into exile.

Zappolino 15 November 1325 – Modena and Bologna fight, not over an oaken bucket stolen from a well, but over a long standing feud replete with raids and reprisal that had occurred almost a century.

This game will use 9/16" counters.

—description from the publisher

name: Munchkin Big Box
description:
Munchkin is a satirical card game based on the clichés and oddities of Dungeons & Dragons and other role-playing games. Each player starts at level 1 and the winner is the first player to reach level 10. Players can acquire familiar D&D style character classes during the game which determine to some extent the cards they can play.

There are two types of cards: treasure and encounters. Each turn the current players "kicks down the door", drawing an encounter card from the deck. Usually this will involve battling a monster. Monsters have their own levels, and players must try to overcome it using the levels, weapons, and powers they have acquired during the game — or run away. Other players can chose to help the player or hinder by adding extra monsters to the encounter. Defeating a monster will usually result in drawing treasure cards and acquiring levels. Being defeated by a monster results in "bad stuff" which usually involves losing levels and treasure.

Munchkin Big Box contains the Munchkin base game, six expansions that were previously released on their own, and fifty new cards — more than 650 in all. Also included are a game board, a side board, standees, Kill-O-Meters, dice, other components required for play, and some stuff that's just for looks.

name: Puzzle Hungry: Umami Rush!
description:
Puzzle Hungry: Umami Rush! is a fast-paced jigsaw-meets-board game where players scramble to complete bite-sized puzzles while racing against their friends.

Each player assembles double-sided food puzzles, competing to serve dishes before the kitchen fills with chaos. Special tokens — like Wasabi (extra heat!) and Flies (a messy setback) — add spicy twists to every round. The ringing service bell signals when orders are up, keeping the table in constant motion.

With 19 unique puzzles, layered “server” challenges (Tray, Receipt, Payment), and wild interactive mechanics, Puzzle Hungry offer multiple challenges and ways to win.

—description from the publisher

name: Pyramis
description:
The aliens have destroyed their beautiful planet; the exodus is inevitable. Best organize your fleet of rocket-pyramids to bring some order to the chaos.

In this competitive card-placement game, optimize your layout to guide your fleeing alien fleet. Arrange your ships in a pyramid to trigger powerful synergies, while strategically flipping your cards — and those of your opponents — at the perfect moment. Earn points for every upright ship in your pyramid-rocket and for securing the alien majority. The player with the highest total wins!

—description from the publisher

name: Qu'arz
description:
Once a year, monsters from every corner compete in a showdown to be chosen for the academy and become disciples of the legendary QU'ARZ —the extraterrestrial being who flipped the world upside down. Prove your mob is unique, clever, and worthy of joining his cult of chaos! Are you ready to join the mob, munch on some power, and capture that crystal?

QU'ARZ is a capture-the-flag brawl that’s definitely NOT a kids’ game. Join the yearly tournament where every monster is out to snatch the Crystal Idol and get it back to the camp before time runs out.

Each player commands a trio of uniquely savage monsters, each sporting its own deck of action cards. Mix and match basic moves with your monster’s special flair to outwit and out-munch your foes. Swipe the Crystal Idol from the altar and sprint it back to your camp. Keep an eye on the clock, think fast. One slick move, and you win instantly — everyone else gets left in the dust.

If the clock hits zero without the Crystal Idol finding a home, victory points collected during the game will crown the winner.

-description from designer

name: Quarks: Particle Puzzle
description:
Quarks is a fast and fun tile placement game. Strategically match colors to score points, but watch out — the board is constantly shifting as tiles turn and connections change.

On your turn, draw a tile — lime green, red, or blue — and place it on the board. Then rotate the board:

Green – Go (clockwise)
Red – Reverse (counter-clockwise)
Blue – your choice

After each rotation, score points by creating chains of matching colors connected to your tile. The board is always changing, so no two turns — or games — are ever the same.

The player with the most points after all tiles have been placed, wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Purrfect Potions
description:
In this quick game, you are attempting to brew more potions than any of your friends. You have the help of your charming cat companions, but they aren't exactly under your control – they follow the whims of the moon.

On your turn, you'll roll the cat dice and then the moon die to see which potions the cats will help with. Then you'll roll the ingredient dice and try to complete as many potions as possible. When all the Major and Minor potions have been completed, the game ends. The player with the most points wins.

With whimsical illustrations by Naomi Lord (and questionable yet intriguing potion ingredients), Purrfect Potions is a superb family game that you'll want to play again and again.

—description from the publisher

name: Queen Alice
description:
Queen Alice is a Mid-Heavy Eurogame all about building engines to improve your actions.

Alice has received a strange call for help. Some words written backwards have appeared on the mirror in her living room: “Alice, we need a new queen”. Surprised, but without hesitating for a moment, she touches the mirror and realises that her hand can pass through it. Following her hand, the rest of her body is pulled to the other side of the mirror…

In Queen Alice, you belong to the ‘Court on the Other Side of the Looking-Glass’ and your mission is to prepare Alice's coronation banquet. Whoever does the best job will become the new Queen's right-hand person and therefore win the game. To achieve this, you must convince the different chess pieces that inhabit this world to help you with the preparations.

You will have a key influence on Alice's coronation. Depending on the color of the pieces that help most with the banquet, Alice will be crowned the White Queen or the Red Queen, or maybe even both! Will you manage to pull the kingdom's strings in your favor and have Alice crowned with the color that best suits your interests? Will you become the most influential person in the new era of Queen Alice?

Queen Alice is a game inspired by Lewis Carroll's Through the Looking-Glass, and What Alice Found There, using some of its characters and part of its narrative centered on chess and its pieces. However, we have created our own story and it is not intended to be a representation of the one Lewis Carroll presents in his book.

In your turn you will activate the different actions using chess pieces and their well-known movements with a card-driven system. During the game, you will obtain passive and instant benefits and take enhanced cards to your hand, which you will use to improve the actions when activating them. This is what we call the “Chess-building” system.

But you will find the most thrilling part of the game in the “race” for the color crown: only part of Alice’s Wishes (objectives which will score you victory points) will be accomplished (and scored) during and at the end of the game, so you will have to choose your actions wisely and advance accordingly the Influence on Alice to become Red or White Queen, while keeping an eye on your opponents who may choose to influence the opposite color!

—description from the publisher

name: Munchkin: Second Edition
description:
25 Years of Kicking Down Doors and Backstabbing Your Buddies!

After 25 years of kicking down doors and battling monsters, a Second Edition of Munchkin is here! We kept your favorite jokes and monsters – and added more!

This edition feels the same, but it plays faster, and the setup is simpler. A new game mechanic – Gold Pieces – allows players to get change when selling Items and to micro-bribe their friends. Reference cards for each player have been added, so no more fighting for the rulebook – unless you just want to.

All the illustrations – including the box, gameboard, and cards – have been updated by Munchkin’s original artist, John Kovalic.

And the best part? It’s backward-compatible, and guidelines for using cards from your First Edition collection are included!

Grab your friends (or enemies), because it’s time to kick down some doors!

What's new in Second Edition
Not only is there a ton of new art, Second Edition has redesigned cards, actual coins, fast setup rules, and more!

     New Illustrations and Card Designs



     New Icons


Icons! Icons! Icons!
You told us that icons would make the cards easier to read. We listened. Here's the chart from the rulebook.


     Updated Card Backs


Full-color card backs! 
The card backs echo the background color of the card types - blue for Doors, yellow for Treasures -, making them easier to sort no matter which side is up.


     Spiffy Gameboard


A Fresh Coat of Paint!
John Kovalic redrew the gameboard, where you'll start at the top and progress down toward that pile of loot at Level 10!


     Player Reference Cards


Munchkin Second Edition includes six player reference cards - one for each player color - so you can look across the table and see who is playing which color. This also means you won't have to open the rulebook as often.


     New Mechanic: Coins


Real (fake) Gold Pieces
Now you can get change when you sell an Item (which lets you level up a bit faster, which speeds the game). Coins can also be used to bribe other players - and even to level up. Add some coins to your next trade deal. Or hoard them. We know you want to!


     New Setup Rules


Set up the game and Kick Down The Door faster than ever before!
After choosing your player color, shuffle the marked Starting Cards. Deal one Door and two Treasures to each player. Shuffle the leftover starting cards into their respective decks, and give five 100 Gold Piece coins to each player. Everyone starts off at comparable strengths, ready to kill (small) monsters right away.


     New & Updated Phases


Listening just got more lucrative!
When you Listen at the door at the start of your turn, take one coin (100 Gold Pieces) and Draw one card from either the Door or Treasure deck, face down, and put it in your hand before you Kick Down The Door. After the hard work is done, it’s time to Loot The Room. And rather than drawing a card from the Treasure deck, a munchkin may roll the die and take that many Coins. Queue up that Loaded Die to maximize your return!


     Updated Win Condition


Who said you had to do it alone?
Munchkin Second Edition introduces an updated way to win! If you're going for Level 10, you may ask any one player to help you. If you win the combat, you share the victory – regardless of the helper's level, Role, or anything else. (But you don't HAVE to ask for help, if you think you can beat everyone else at once.)
This set is packed with rules tweaks to make it faster, clearer, and more exciting, with even more mayhem in the race to win!

CONTENTS

     150 Cards
     6 Double-Sized Reference Cards
     48 Coins
     1 Custom Die
     Gameboard
     6 Standees w/ bases
     Rules
     Upgrade Guide

name: Quickdraw: Battle for Silver City
description:
Bandits have stormed Main Street, and the Law stands as the town’s last defense. In this fast-paced, 18-card asymmetric dueling game, every showdown is a test of wit, risk, and tactical decision making. With clever team construction and ever-shifting strategies, no two duels play the same.

Each side — the Law and the Bandits — commands eight unique units. Select four to take the field, while the other four will load into your ammo deck. Do you play it safe with a steady hand, or gamble on high-risk, high-reward shots? With tense 5–10 minute rounds, every match provides a chance to test winning strategies and adapt for the next battle.

—description from the designer

name: Ascension Tactics: Inferno
publisher: Stone Blade Entertainment; GaGa Games; YOKA Games
description:
In Ascension Tactics' final battle for Deofol, the Champions defeated both Samael and Xeron. With Samael destroyed and Xeron now in hiding, the arch-devil Kythis has taken control of the infernal realm, forcing its people to submit to his might.

It is up to the Champions of Vigil, alongside a few rebellious monsters, to bring peace to the twisted lands, and set Deofol on a path to redemption in Ascension Tactics: Inferno!

Ascension Tactics: Inferno is a stand-alone expansion to Ascension Tactics. Ascension Tactics: Inferno includes all of your favorite gameplay mechanics found in the original game and introduces some new features to take gameplay to a whole new level:


     Four player co-op! In addition to solo, campaign, a team-based play, Inferno includes the ability for you and three friends to take on the game in the new four player co-op mode!
     A new faction: The Fallen. For the first time in the history of Ascension, a new, fifth faction is being introduced to the game! 
     Transforming Champions! If you complete the requirements to transform a Champion during the game, both its card and miniature will be replaced with a stronger version and new abilities!
     Quests! Each player will be given a Quest to complete during the game. Once completed, it transforms into a powerful Construct that can be equipped to your Champions!
     Dual-faction Champions! Discover Champions that have abilities from not one, but two factions!


-description from publisher

name: Race to Kepler: A Deckbuilding Space Adventure
description:
The 20 most populous world cities have launched into the cosmos, each racing to claim humanity's new home: Kepler-452b.

Rising temperatures have rendered our planet unlivable, but humanity always finds a way. In the twilight of Earth's habitability, this is humanity's greatest challenge yet.

In Race to Kepler, you'll lead one of these ambitious city-states in a high-stakes interstellar competition. Recruit elite crew members, bid for powerful Titans, and generate the energy needed to power your ship. Your mission: be the first to reach and colonize our species' last hope for survival.

—description from the publisher

name: Race to Mars
description:
Three centuries have passed since humanity planted its first flag on the Moon, and space is no longer a dream, it’s a frontier. Lunar bases have spread, orbital stations have multiplied, and Earth-Moon travel has become routine. But the Moon was only the beginning. The next step is farther, harsher, more expensive… and far more symbolic: Mars.

In Race to Mars, each player leads a private space company in a global race to be the first to reach the Red Planet. The game is a fast roll & write with a twist: instead of everyone simply using the same dice results, the dice represent limited actions and resources that all players must share. Each round, a pool of dice is rolled, and players secretly and simultaneously choose how to claim and combine them, trying to predict what others will do before revealing choices and writing results on their personal board.

To win, you must build the smartest route to Mars by balancing three key priorities: Travel to push your mission forward, Upgrade your spaceship to improve efficiency and unlock better options, and Research to gain powerful advantages and long-term momentum. With asymmetric characters adding unique strengths, every decision matters and reading your opponents can be the difference between a clean landing… and a mission that takes just a little too long.

—description from the designer

name: Radiance
description:
We ignored the darkness as long as we could. “It ebbs and flows,” we told ourselves. Then, multiple attacks within a single month. Those on the edge of Farhome report encroaching darkness. We could see it from home. The sky growing dark in the south and east. Farhome’s light has diminished severely. Something must be done. We must discover the source of this great darkness and put a stop to it, before we are all destroyed or corrupted. The problem is we’ve been a peaceful society for so long that we have no heroes. Luminaries is the word we used to use. We’re fresh out. But the darkness grows. We must send the best we have. Which means we must send the most virtuous among us. Virtue is what determines an individual’s inherent light source.  We send our new Luminary and pray. We’ll know the outcome soon enough, by watching the sky.

In Radiance, the player takes the role of a Luminary and embarks on an epic quest to defeat the Shade and protect the last of the Bright Cities. Upgrade your deck, learn new skills, master the elements, and discover explosive combos as you explore and fight your way through a tense and perilous adventure.

Radiance is a solo, puzzly adventure card game designed to create the feeling of an epic and sprawling overland adventure, but with the convenience of being stored in a small box. Players will interact with some familiar mechanisms like deckbuilding, skill trees, and exploration. In addition to some mechanical twists on the genre, including:


     Deck upgrading, which has you flipping existing cards in addition to adding new ones. 
     Geographic progression but on an abstracted map. A deck of 36 location cards - each with coordinates listing their physical location - but the deck is shuffled and you must forge a different path to your destination each game.
     The slightest bit of action programming: Your Attack card this turn becomes your Explore card next turn. 
     Economy of card play - you typically play only 3 cards per turn, each assigned to distinct roles. 


—description from the publisher

name: Raft Bridge
description:
Raft Bridge is a 2-player abstract strategy game.

Players place or move their raft and make a bridge from START to GOAL. The pllayer who moves his fairy pawn through the bridge to the GOAL token first, wins the game.

name: Rainbow Blvd.
description:
Build rainbows to make the city of Hopewell Springs beautiful while creating 3D masterpieces in Rainbow Blvd! In Rainbow Blvd. players are animal architects, tasked with completing city plans and private contracts with the goal of gaining the most prestige to become the next head architect at the rainbow factory.

Rainbow Blvd. is played over a series of days (rounds).  Each day begins with players acquiring city plan cards that will reward them for building specific rainbow segments and arcs around the city.  However, take on too many city plans, and there is a risk of losing prestige for uncompleted work.

While the rainbow factory pays well, there are always opportunities for private contracts to help.  The 6 local color companies that produce the materials used by the rainbow factory want their hues to be used whenever possible.  Each is willing to offer more prestige to whomever completes their various goals.

The player who manages to collect the most prestige points before spring is the winner and new head architect at the rainbow factory! Rainbow Blvd. utilizes several fun mechanics including action selection, hand management, a time track, set collections, and more, resulting in a wonderfully beautiful experience around any game table!

name: Rat Race
description:
Welcome to your first day at our innovative and exciting recruitment agency, explicitly tailored to our hardworking rat colleagues. As new employees, your mission is to assist our fellow rats in finding their calling in diverse industries—each with its own unique appeal. From the bustling sector of food scraps to the rustling sector of leaves and yard waste, you will guide your recruits toward their dream jobs in one of our esteemed trash-related industries. As you navigate this dynamic workplace, always remember that at our agency, every rat has the potential to become the Big Cheese!

In Rat Race, you’ll assume the role of a recruiter who tries to put your rats in the best position to succeed. Expand industries by building the trash pile. Assign new recruits to entry-level jobs. Encourage them to climb the corporate ladder (to earn a bonus when they become the Big Cheese). Or undermine the competition by reaching full employment before your opponents reach their full potential. You can win either way.

Rat Race is a highly interactive game with simple rules that yield a complex and dynamic game space. Filled with strategic and tactical depth, this game might leave your brain feeling like Swiss cheese.

—description from the publisher

name: Rats & Relics
description:
Beneath the fallen stones of an ancient cathedral, rival rat clans wage an endless struggle for control of the ruins.

In this dueling card game, players build rat clans by equipping their rats with powerful relics. 
The core mechanic revolves around combining rat and relic cards to form unique units, each with its own abilities and synergies.

On a turn, a player either draws cards from the rat and relic decks or plays a pair of cards from their hand, gradually expanding their presence on the table.
As the game progresses, each player controls an increasing number of rats, which begin to form an engine shaped by their chosen strategy. Different card combinations offer varied tactical approaches, creating multiple viable paths to victory in every match

To win the game, a player must successfully play one of several powerful relics while meeting its specific conditions. Relics are divided into Weapons, Arcane, and Trinkets, and each category represents a distinct victory condition, encouraging players to commit to a strategy while adapting to their opponent’s plans.

—description from the designer

name: Shards of Infinity: Saga Collection
description:
In Shards of Infinity, players must strategically tailor their decks, acquire new cards, and utilize allies and champions to reduce their opponents' health to zero. Only through meticulous planning and aggressive gameplay can one player emerge as the ultimate victor.

Shards of Infinity: Saga Collection is an entry point into the ever-expanding universe of Shards of Infinity as it contains the base game, all expansions, and all promo cards from the original edition, along with new and upgraded components. In addition to including the PvP, solo, and co-op modes, the Saga Collection introduces a new legacy mode that allows players to master gameplay from every set while delving into the game's lore. Additionally, the inclusion of a new Shard Master enables epic showdowns with up to six players.

name: Ravohria
description:
Ravohria is a competitive game featuring limitless strategies, character-building dynamics, resource management, and direct player interactions such as stealing, duels, and even killing. The game incorporates hidden leaders and battle royale elements, with various factors enhancing its replayability.

As mercenaries in a dystopian future, players are hired by an infiltrator to disrupt the Ravohria family's control. After successfully capturing a capsule and its blueprints from their research lab, they must escape the restricted area, evade the Ravohria sentinels, utilize resources to survive, and deliver the capsule to their leader — all while advancing their secret personal agendas.

It’s a relentless mission where each mercenary fights to secure all the reputation and glory for their leader, ultimately aiming to bring about Ravohria's downfall.

In the end, history remembers only the winners.

—description from designer

name: Re;MATCH: Marble Puzzle Fighter
description:
Play as a DJ with high impact beats, a Chef with elemental spirits, or an Trickster with explosive magic in this highly asymmetric 1 vs 1 fighting game fueled by a marble puzzle system!

Input your attacks each turn by clearing connected matching marbles from a 3 x 5 grid. Your attack corresponds to number and color marbles you cleared: The more marbles you clear the bigger the attack!

Every move changes the board state for what you allow your opponent to clear, and you can only clear from 2 of the 3 lanes, so every move has immediate consequences.

Deal damage to your opponent's 3 health bars, each corresponding to a different color of attacks: Red, Yellow, and Blue. Breaking a heath bars forces your opponent to spend a quarter to keep playing AND disables that color of attacks from being used!

But be careful, a broken health bar turns those corresponding marbles into WILD connectors allowing them to launch even more powerful attacks with their remaining colors, not to mention each cleared WILD marble restores health to that broken health bar, bringing it back into play.

Get ready for a depth of strategies and challenge your friends to Re;MATCH! the marble puzzle arcade fighting game!

Designed and self published by Brother Ming Games, illustrated by PsyOptima, and graphics by kimeimile.

(Originally known as SENTO, which debuted at Pax South in 2020. Read the article by Tycho, co-creator of Penny Arcade, here.)

name: Reactor Rescue
description:
In Reactor Rescue, players take on the role of engineers whose spacecraft have malfunctioned while en route to fix a failing reactor in the city of Electra. Each player must repair their own vehicle by building real electronic circuits, before returning to the city. Only one engineer will complete their mission.

To make repairs, players must collect electronic component cards that represent real electronic parts such as a LED, buzzer, switch, motor, sensors etc. These parts are then used to build actual working circuits using modular, magnetic Labbox blocks. 
There are three level of circuit cards, that represent specific circuit blueprints, that players need to complete by managing scarce resources.

Gameplay involves strategic card management, circuit-building, and a strategy to fix your vehicle first. Players can lock in components for future use, swap cards from the deck, and physically test whether their circuits function as required. The first player to complete all their vehicle’s circuit repairs wins the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Ascension Legends
description:
Ascension Legends is the latest stand-alone expansion of the acclaimed deckbuilding game, designed for both newcomers and long-time fans of the series. Step into the role of one of the legendary warriors of Vigil, charged with protecting your world from the forces of Deoful, the realm of monsters.

In this epic game for 1-4 players, you'll recruit mighty heroes and wield powerful constructs to aid you in battle against the monstrous forces of Deoful. As you recruit heroes and defeat monsters, you'll gain honor. The player with the most honor at the end of the game wins! Ascension Legends offers a quick setup, easy-to-learn mechanics, and immense replayability.

Ascension Legends introduces the legendary track, where players can advance by following in the footsteps of Ascension's greatest heroes, unlocking new abilities as they progress. Additionally, you'll encounter a new type of monster card called Remnants. Once defeated, these Remnants grant abilities to specific factions, representing the trials of the heroes as they become legends. The game also features the return of dual faction cards, allowing for even more strategic depth and variety in deckbuilding.

—description from the publisher

name: Rebuilding Chicago
description:
In Rebuilding Chicago, a standalone successor to 2023's Rebuilding Seattle, you're responsible for managing the zoning and expansion of a major neighborhood following the "Great Chicago Fire" of 1871.

Each round, your population grows, then you can either build a new building, expand into a new suburb, activate an event, or build a landmark, after which you earn profit based on your neighborhood's commerce. You'll buy building types from a shared market — looking to find shapes that fit your grid and types that fit your strategy — and construct landmarks on the right tile combinations. Suburb tiles connect to your grid however you like, creating uniquely shaped neighborhoods. Triggering citywide events can change the tide of the game, offering points, money, and expansions for the players ready for it. You can even enact laws to give yourself the advantage!

You earn points for building types, upgrades, landmarks, events, and remaining cash, and at the end of the game, whoever's neighborhood has earned the most points wins.

Rebuilding Chicago also comes with a solo player deck so that you can compete to build the best version of Chicago even with just one player. Enjoy gameplay against a deck designed to simulate the actions of a second player to discover strategies and configurations you can use to improve Chicago.

name: Red Alert: New World Order
description:
Red Alert: New World Order is a strategic, alternate-WW2 history board game that captures the explosive, over-the-top warfare of classic real-time strategy games. Players command powerful factions, build sprawling bases, manage resources, and unleash powerful units and structures — from tank divisions to Tesla-powered weapons — in a race for rare earth minerals with shifting alliances.

Red Alert: New World Order blends territory control, base construction, and tech-tree advancement into a deeply tactical tabletop experience. You’ll harvest resources, deploy, tanks, and air units, and upgrade your arsenal with experimental super-weapons. Whether you choose to align with the Allied Nations or the Soviet Bloc, your path to victory lies in striking the balance between defense, expansion, and overwhelming force.

Combat is fast-paced and cinematic, with streamlined mechanics that replicate the feel of real-time strategy while offering deep strategic choices. Every battle is dynamic—your opponents may deploy devastating bombardment form the Aurora Bomber, launch an Iron Shield defensive grid structure, or electrify an entire battlefield with advanced Tesla tech. Commanders must adapt quickly, or face annihilation.

With European classic battlefield maps, cities, snow terrain, naval assault maps and more, the gigantic maps, asymmetric factions, faction-specific abilities, and scenario-driven campaigns, Red Alert: Mew World Order delivers a nostalgic-yet-modern board game experience. It’s a tribute to the golden era of RTS games — now reborn on the tabletop with explosive detail and alternate-history flair.

—description from the publisher

name: Red Dog Junction
description:
Red Dog Junction is a fast-paced board game of high-stakes trading, crew-building, and strategic maneuvering in the far reaches of space. As the captain of a rogue freighter, players navigate the lawless frontier, mining valuable resources, salvaging lost cargo, and making high-risk trades at the notorious Red Dog Junction. Rival captains compete for fortune, and deception is always an option.

Each turn, players take two actions, moving their ships between bases, planets, the fence at Honest Joe's Haberdashery, the Red Dog trading exchange, and deep space. They mine for ore, salvage wreckage, trade on the ever-shifting market, and recruit crew members to improve efficiency. Upgrading ship storage, hiring specialist officers, and executing powerful one-time boosts provide strategic advantages. The game ends when all the gold is stored in player bases, making timing and resource management critical.

With a dynamic economy driven by player actions, Red Dog Junction offers a blend of worker placement, deck-building, pick-up-and-delivery, and market manipulation. The game plays about 15-20 minutes per player, creating a rich and highly interactive experience that rewards clever planning, risk-taking, and strategic maneuvering in a shifting economy.

—description from the publisher

name: Red Leaf University
description:
Red Leaf University is a 1–4 player worker placement game where you’ll recruit a team of bright young students and send them to specialized campuses to expand their knowledge, earn academic credits, and chase the ultimate honor: becoming Valedictorian!

Red Leaf delivers a streamlined euro-style experience: with your students, you’ll explore a university divided into six specialized campuses (Art, Business, Science, Architecture, etc.). Each campus allows players to recruit or upgrade a student of its discipline or engage in a unique minigame tied to its specialty.

The core gameplay revolves around sending one of your student tokens to an action space on the campus boards. Turns proceed clockwise until all students have been placed. Placing a student on an already occupied space costs more ressources for each student already present. Students can be trained to Levels 1, 2, 3, or Master: higher levels unlock stronger actions and bonuses, and Master cards provide unique effect along with the ability to be placed on occupied spaces without paying.

The game takes place over five rounds, each introducing new opportunities and challenges. By optimizing the combos between your students’ effects, the benefits from each minigame (some using a tile-placement mechanism), and the various end-of-round and end-game objectives, you’ll score the most promotion points and become the valedictorian!

name: Red Notice: Le million ou la prison
description:
Embark in a thrilling chase across the globe! Play as Angela Farbank, a genius counterfeiter traveling the world to cash $1,000,000 in forged checks, or Jessah Hope, an unyielding FBI agent who dreams of putting Farbank behind bars. Bluffing and anticipation are the key words in this gripping pursuit. Will you be able to thwart your opponent's plans and win before they do?

Playing as Angela, you must travel the world and cash counterfeit checks totalling $1,000,000. Use your personal world map to secretly record your movements and your fake identities to escape if you are captured.
As Jessah, blow Angela's cover by locating her, then arrest her before she can carry out her plan. Fortunately, you have the FBI's virtually unlimited resources at your disposal: as the checks are cashed, your superiors will give you new means to take action.

Regardless of your role, 4 randomly drawn Action cards determine the choices available to both of you each round. Take turns placing your tokens face down to plan when and how to act, then resolve the actions according to their value – travel to a nearby city, cash a check from your hand (if you're in the right continent), draw a new check, or add/remove radars and road-blocks on the map.

—description from the publisher

name: Red Tides: A Tale of New Caribbea
description:
Red Tides: A Tale of New Caribbea is a co-operative boss-battling naval strategy game. You and your fellow pirate captains begin with small ships, basic cannons, and a humble crew. Over the course of ten rounds, you hunt merchant ships, gather plunder, upgrade your vessel, and face increasingly powerful foes — including the dreaded Pirate Lords. Your ultimate goal is to take down the tyrannical pirate king John Davies and his monstrous flagship, The Dead Drifter.

Combat features tactical movement and dice-driven volleys at different ranges (long, medium, close), with opportunities to board and seize enemy ships. Plunder gains you cannons, gold, and upgrades, while faction-specific powers and fate dice add strategic flair.

The game escalates across three acts from scrappy survival to epic naval warfare, culminating in a final showdown. Win, and New Caribbea is free; lose, and you sail again another day.

—description from the designer

name: REFINED
description:
REFINED is an economic dice game where the various components of crude oil are represented by 100+ custom dice. In the game, you will be charged with the safe and efficient operation of your custom refinery. You will need to purchase processing equipment upgrades to expand your refinery's dice handling capabilities to optimize your production capacity and maximize your profits over several ERAs. Your strategic planning, puzzle solving and process management skills will be put to the test as you try to refine the most crude oil dice without spilling any dice and causing environmental damage. Optimize your refinery's output to produce the correct distillates required to fulfil specific real-world contracts and historic ERA demands. If you can successfully navigate the historic and operational challenges and generate the most profits, you will be crowned ... Refinery Tycoon!

—description from the designer

name: Ascension: 15th Anniversary Collector's Edition
description:
Celebrate fifteen years of Ascension with the definitive 15th Anniversary Collector’s Edition of one of the most influential deckbuilding games ever created.

This deluxe release features an embossed collector’s tin, an all-foil reimagining of Ascension and Return of the Fallen, premium components and Year One promo cards.

With its fast-paced gameplay, heroic champions, powerful constructs, and ever-evolving strategies, the Ascension Deckbuilding Game continues to define the genre it helped create. Whether you’re returning to Vigil or entering the fray for the first time, this edition delivers a truly historic Ascension experience.

name: Between Two Castles: Essential Edition
description:
Between Two Castles Essential Edition is a competitive drafting, tile-placement game for 1-8 players designed by Ben Rosset and Matthew O’Malley. It plays in about 45-60 minutes.

The Essential Edition combines the original game and the Secrets & Soirees expansion into one box.

The king demands a castle! You are a world-renowned master builder who has been asked by the king to help design his castles. Projects of such significance require the expertise of more than one person, so for each assignment you are paired with another master builder to execute your grandiose plans. Will your planning and partnership skills be enough to design the most impressive castles in the world?

Between Two Castles is a competitive tile-drafting game in which each tile is a room in a castle. You work together with the player on your left to design one castle, and with the player on your right on another castle. On each turn you select two tiles from your hand, reveal them, then work with your partners to place them.

At the end of the game, each castle is scored. Your personal final score is the lower of the scores of the two castles you helped design, and the player with the highest final score wins the game. To win, you have to share your attention between two castles.

—description from the publisher

Includes the following in the box:
Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig: Saxophone Room Promo Tile
Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig: Dice Tower Room Promo Tile
Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig: Bonus Card Promo Pack #1

name: Regulus: High-Fantasy Arena-Sports
description:
Regulus High-Fantasy Arena-Sports is a highly tactical skirmish boardgame. To win the game, player must score 10 victory points by: knocking-out opponents, score public objectives or have their characters standing in the Regulus zone, a king of the hill center of the map where points can be scored at the end of three rounds.

The unique initiative system lets players strategize when a character starts their turn. Playing a low numbered initiative card will let a character start early, dishing out some hard hits or eagerly avoid any potential danger.

When a character starts their turn they may do up to two actions, which include: movement, attacks, spells, laying down traps, healing and pushing and pulling your enemy's to spaces they don't want to go. Position your character's just right and you can even attack with powerful off-turn Reactions!

Regulus features 4 asymmetrical teams of 3 characters, which can be customized even further with equipment cards. Characters can bring 3 equipment cards with them, adding a once per game action and a lasting passive per card. This vastly changes the playstyle of a character and will lead to new and exciting gameplay opportunities.

—description from the publisher

name: Reichbusters Reloaded
description:
Reichbusters Reloaded is a mission-based cooperative board game with miniatures. Each game is a battle pitting the Allied Heroes you play against the soldiers of an alternative Third Reich full of Weird Science.

You control a highly trained, elite commando with extraordinary abilities. During your turn, you can play Action cards specific to each Hero to move them around the board and accomplish your mission objectives. You’ll face opponents who are superior in both numbers and firepower, and you’ll have to work with your comrades if you hope to emerge victorious. In Reichbusters, players win – and lose – together! During your missions, you can choose a direct or more discreet approach. However, be aware that the alarm will ring out through the base’s corridors sooner or later, and you’ll have to make your move!

The enemy forces are made up of Wehrmacht soldiers, but also terrifying mutant creatures from the Vrilmeisters’ experiments. All Enemies are controlled by the game and follow simple rules, after all the Heroes have taken their turn.

Rounds are played until an endgame condition is met and a winner is declared.

name: Reign of Hades
description:
Reign of Hades immerses players in a visually stunning and modern interpretation of Greek Mythology with its captivating blend of dungeon crawler elements and action-driven storytelling. In this enthralling, co-operative campaign game, you will take on the roles of fallen heroes who were once mighty Olympian Gods. Imprisoned in Tartarus by the cunning Hades, you and your fellow players must set yourselves free and navigate the treacherous realms of the Underworld together. Starting as mortal shadows of your former selves, you will fight to reclaim your divinity and strength, with one ultimate goal in mind: confronting Hades and taking back what's rightfully yours—Olympus.

Reign of Hades introduces a novel Dice-Grid System, which allows you to enhance your attacks by turning a combat die to a better facing or 
upgrading it to the next level. You will interact with the game by playing cards into your limited number of card slots, which allow for infinite variability and interesting choices while keeping the gameplay simple, intuitive, and easy to pick up. While the core gameplay focuses on the cooperation between teams of two, there will be a dedicated three-player variant and a thrilling solo variant for those seeking solitary adventures.

Will you and your fellow gods overcome the trials of the Underworld, reclaim your divinity, and restore balance to Olympus? The fate of the gods and the very fabric of the mythological world hang in the balance. Embrace your divinity within and embark on a quest you will never forget!

—description from the publisher

name: Finspan
publisher: Stonemaier Games; 999 Games; Arclight Games; Delta Vision Publishing; Divercentro; Feuerland Spiele; Ghenos Games; Grok Games; Lautapelit.fi; Lavka Games; Maldito Games; Matagot; MINDOK; MIPL; Rebel Sp. z o.o.; Surfin' Meeple China; Ігромаг
description:
You are a marine researcher seeking to find and observe an array of aquatic life in the colorful Sunlight Zone, ghostly Twilight Zone, and pitch-black Midnight Zone of the world's seas and oceans. In Finspan, the fish you discover over four weeks will generate a series of benefits as you dive deeper into the ocean.

Each dive site specializes in a key aspect of expanding your research:


     Grow your collection of fish.
     Discover freshly laid eggs.
     Hatch eggs into young and consolidate young to form schools.


The winner is the player with the most points gained from fish, eggs, young, schools, and achievements.

—description from the publisher

name: Requiem: Downfall of Magic
description:
“Anno domini 1530, Wittenberg, Holy Roman Empire.

10 years have passed since the dramatic action of Martin Luther, the new Protestant faction and the Catholic faction are still fighting for their doctrines. Rumor has it that a group of cultists has begun operating in the city. An apprentice necromancer, Cosma de Gubernatis, is leading this group of death worshipers, called Totentanz.
It seems that these heretics are aiming to evoke Death in the material plane, to bring divine judgment and cleanse the earth of the undeserving.
After the destruction of the Lodge of the Black Rose, a secret force, called the Order, has been created by the Roman Church. Their primary objective is to keep the nefarious Magic under control, preventing evil mages and powerful evocations to roam free all across the Empire. The Order recently found traces of Cosma, and now their goal is to discover his plans and stop this new threat for the Roman Church.”

Requiem: the Downfall of Magic is a cooperative map-based adventure game set in the same universe of Black Rose Wars: Rebirth, Nova Aetas Renaissance and Black Rose Wars, that will bring you to a fantastic and intriguing early 1500s Europe; asymmetrical characters will face crossroads campaigns, exploring territories and performing actions: depending on the players’ choices, successes, and decisions, the game can lead to a specific final battle and its corresponding ending.

Requiem: Downfall of Magic is a narrative campaign game where you will face unique quests and confront fearsome creatures. A Chapter Book will guide you, developing the plot and providing you with the specific rules for each quest.

The narrative chapters take place on an ever-changing gaming board, made up of hexagonal tiles, each containing artwork and game elements. As you explore these tiles, you will encounter enemies to face and events to solve. The events will lead you deeper into the world of Requiem through the Discovery Book, with challenges and mysteries. The enemies will be faced slightly differently, as special boss fights with different rules and maps for each encounter.

name: Restart
description:
Restart is a competitive, tactical, time-travel-themed engine-building game. In the near future, humanity collapses into a dystopia. In a last-ditch effort, scientists invent brain-connected nanochips that allow travelers to move through time and alter events. However, rival alternative futures clash and the prosperity of one means the ruin of another. Will you save your future?

The game unfolds across three timelines: the past, the present and the future. Each player controls a time traveler and their younger past self and has a personal mind board. On their turn, each player activates one of their four mind abilities.


    PERCEPTION: Complete missions on the spacetime grid by spending time.
    INTELLIGENCE: Acquire new missions by interacting with the dystopia.
    MEMORY: Gain resources.
    FOCUS: Upgrade actions by playing cards on your mind board.


Restart features four unique dystopias that are played individually. Each dystopia has distinct mechanics while maintaining the same core system, offering variety and replayability.

—description from the publisher

name: Restless
description:
"Rumors of a spreading corruption whisper through the streets of the once-serene Everion. Will you be the adventurers who break the cycle of chaos and become renowned heroes?"

Restless is a highly replayable fantasy adventure game where you and up to three other players lose yourselves in a vast open world brimming with dangers, treasures, and excitement. While it focuses on cooperative gameplay, it also includes a competitive variant.

Game Arc
Each playthrough is split into three chapters of roughly 45 minutes per player. Depending on player count and playstyle, it can be played as a one-shot or saved between chapters using the quick-save system.

Play style
Explore the boundless world of Everion and experience gripping adventures. Collect and trade resources, buy and upgrade powerful items, specialize in professions, and befriend animal companions along the way. As each chapter draws to a close, you will team up with the other players to fight a powerful boss.

Storybook
Restless is a storybook game with a focus on short, flavorful stories. Each player experiences their own unscripted adventure. Every session and every playthrough offers new choices, surprises, and challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

—description from the publisher

name: Restless Spirits
description:
Restless Spirits is an easy-to-learn tactical card game where you play as a Spirit Guide, and you're helping Lost Spirits find their way home. Combining elements of set collection, tactical card drafting, ability combos, and push your luck, it's a race against your opponent(s) to free the spirits.

There are 30 unique Light and Dark Spirits to encounter, with a different set of 3 Totem requirements listed at the bottom of each card. Every turn, you must decide where best to use your 2 Action Points: attracting Spirits to your board, buying Totem cards from a marketplace, and playing them to tick off a Spirit's requirements one by one.

You'll also be using powerful Spirit abilities to gain an advantage over your opponent - Light Spirit abilities will help you win even faster, whilst Dark Spirit abilities will slow down your opponents instead! But Spirit abilities can only be used once-per-game, so tactical timing is important to get the most out of them!

If you can meet all 3 of a Spirit's Totem requirements, it will be released into the Spirit Realm, becoming one of the cards you need to win the game! The first player to released the required number of Spirits (changes with player count), wins!

—description from the designer

name: Restoration
description:
🌿 Overview

Nestled within the Imperial City of Huế, Kien Trung Palace once stood as one of the grandest landmarks of the Nguyễn Dynasty. Its architecture was uniquely adorned with Khảm sành sứ, a traditional Vietnamese mosaic art made from broken ceramic and porcelain shards, handcrafted by artisans to decorate the palace’s exteriors with shimmering patterns.
Destroyed in 1947, it lay in ruins until its real-life restoration began in 2019.
Restoration: Kien Trung Palace invites players to relive that journey — to rebuild, innovate, and preserve this cultural treasure.

🧱 Gameplay

Across three years of construction, players act as restoration experts, balancing planning, craftsmanship, and influence.
Each year consists of two main phases:

Construction Phase: Place workers or artisans at warehouse gates (five interconnected rondel boards) to trigger actions and advance progress on various building projects.

Evaluation Phase: Compare influence across warehouse zones and community support to recruit new artisans and determine the next starting player.

Earn Achievement Points through completed buildings, technological advancements, management cards, and your growing team of artisans.

⚙️ Key Mechanics

Worker Placement & Area Control: Every placement impacts both your actions and your standing in key areas.

Five Interconnected Rondel Boards: The warehouse network forms the heart of the game — each rondel connects to others in many ways, creating replayability, dynamic chain reactions, and strategic movement puzzles.

Development Tracks: Advance in Technology for efficiency and new workers, or in Community Support to gain re-recruit ability

Management Cards: Provide flexible instant effects for strategic timing.

🏆 End of the Game

After the third construction year, players total Achievement Points from:

Completed construction boards

Both development tracks

Management cards bonuses

Recruited artisans (3 pts each)

The player with the highest score becomes the Master Restorer of Kien Trung Palace — the one who most faithfully revives history through skill, precision, and vision.

name: Return of the Living Dead's Zombie Punk Panic
description:
Grab your dice and crank up the volume—Zombie Punk Panic! is a fast-paced cooperative game of punk rockers versus the undead! Designed for 1–4 players, this dice-battling adventure drops you and your crew into a graveyard swarming with zombies, armed with nothing but guts, grit, and a few questionable snacks.

Work together to survive each location, power up your characters with Charge abilities, and unleash devastating combos to keep the horde at bay. Every fight brings you closer to the ultimate showdown with the legendary Tarman—beat him, and you save the world. Fail, and you’ll join the ranks of the living dead.

With a playmat, custom character and zombie dice, unique abilities, and boss battles that escalate the chaos, every game feels like a punk-rock horror flick come to life. Easy to learn, quick to play (30–45 minutes), and packed with over-the-top action, Zombie Punk Panic! is perfect for game night with friends—or a solo run when you’re feeling brave.

Are you ready to scream, roll, and fight your way out of the apocalypse?

name: Origin Story
publisher: Stonemaier Games; Arclight Games; Feuerland Spiele; Ghenos Games; Maldito Games
description:
Your inner superhero is ready to emerge, one chapter at a time. Reveal your backstory, gather gadgets and allies, develop a grudge against your archenemy, and unleash an ultimate ability as you transform. Use a combination of brains, love, speed, and strength to craft your origin story.

Origin Story is a 1-5 player competitive tableau-building, trick-taking game played over 5 rounds. Each round represents a chapter in your development and grants a new card to add to your player mat. Charge your cards and use their abilities to score more points than your opponents.

—description from the publisher

name: Revolution: State of War
description:
Revolution: State of War is a 2 player asymmetric military strategy on the Armed struggle for American Independence.  The primary objective is to establish and maintain the support of the population for your cause, but to do so often requires one to have control or possession of the territory where people live, and for that one must take command of your nation's forces, maneuver and engage in battles to secure the colonies.

Both sides have very unique and distinct advantages.  The British with their professional force and naval prowess can dominate coastal positions, but may have some difficulty when getting too far away from their coastal bases.  They know the longer the war drags on the more chances Americans will have to secure French support along with building up their forces to a higher standard.  As such, the British will want to hit the ground running and maintain the pressure, seeking out engagement after engagement to decimate the rebel forces so when they are better trained it will be immaterial at that point, or a day late and a dollar short.

The American's on the other hand need time to secure an alliance with the French and convert this rag-tag band of revolutionaries into a professional army to really flip the script but one doesn't always get the army they want, when they need it and have to fight with the army they have.  As such, to buy time and save face with the population the American forces will need to make the British advance as costly as possible by occupying advantageous terrain, leveraging the support of the population with Militia forces, and knowing when to simply run away.

The game incorporates cards but is not a card driven game, the cards provide enhancements and bonus abilities as well as enable deception actions that can really through a wrench in the works for your opponent.

When forces contest territory on the Game Board, the game zooms in to a unique battle sequence, which is a mini-game itself; units deploy into lanes of combat and roll dice to score hits and kills with bonuses and enhancements for aspects like rout, exposed flank (enfilade), and Dragoon Charge.

Can you lead your nations forces to victory?

—description from the designer

name: Revolutions: France 1820-1880
description:
Revolutions – France 1820-1880 is an immersive political simulation for 3, 4 or 5 players.

Get ready to relive 60 years of political conflicts, civil wars and major societal choices. Whether in the Chamber of Deputies or on the barricades, Ultras, Orleanists, Bonapartists, Republicans or Socialists clash to ensure the triumph of their ideals. Each faction has its own starting situation, objectives and assets. You’ll need to constantly adapt your strategy to the situation at hand, and convince allies to impose your vision of society.

It is a very simple game in terms of military operations but an exciting journey through this epic period thanks to the richness of the events portrayed and the multi-player focus of the game.

Each turn, players begin by taking their action cards, which represent their supporters. They use them to develop their influence in six Society zones: Songs, Newspapers, Notables, Peasants, Workers and Clergy. They can also modify Social Tensions, which determine the stability of the government.

If the regime is stable, a Chamber of Deputies is elected. Players take advantage of the influence they have acquired in the Society zones to obtain votes. These votes give access to the best seats in the Chamber. Players receive political influence tokens according to their posi¬tion. Political influence is the «currency» that enables legislative action to change the current regime.

If social tensions become too great, Paris will rise up, and a civil war will begin. Players mobilize Society zones to support the government or fuel the insurrection. If the revolution triumphs, the victorious insurgents can make more radical changes to the state.

Finally, players score victory points according to the ideological objectives they have achieved.

—description from the publisher

name: Riftblade
description:
Unleash cunning combos and outwit your rivals in Riftblade, a dynamic deckbuilding game. Forge powerful synergies by acquiring spells from The Rift – a shared, ever-changing marketplace of magic. Fueling these devastating plays are the strategic Riftstone dice; more than just randomizers, these custom dice offer primary powers to activate spells and crucial secondary abilities (like upgrading dice, drawing cards, or refreshing The Rift) for vital tactical flexibility, allowing you to sculpt your hand, control the flow of magic, and gain the upper hand.

The strategic heart of Riftblade lies in managing The Rift itself. Will you purchase powerful spells to build your engine for future turns, or Trigger their effects directly from The Rift for immediate, disruptive impact—perhaps denying a crucial card to an opponent or clearing the way for a better selection? Starter cards grant access to the versatile Void Aspect, essential for weaving diverse spell combinations from different magical Aspects (Infernal, Celestial, Soul, and Chaos), forcing a careful balance between a lean, consistent deck and broader strategic flexibility.

Each turn has 2 phases: Attack and Cleanup.  If your Life reaches 0, you're out of the game. Play until only one player has Life left — that player is the winner!

—description from the designer

name: Skirm
description:
MID-LEVEL SPOILERS for Vantage.

Skirm is a card-and-dice game found within the world (and every copy) of Vantage. Each player rolls 6 dice, selects 1 card to play, uses their card's ability, and gains points by (a) comparing the quantity of each skill type to the opponent, and (b) leveraging their card's scoring ability.

While intended as a game-within-a-game, Skirm is a fully-playable dueling game for 1-2 players on its own.

—description from the publisher

name: Smitten 2
description:
Smitten 2 is a cooperative micro-game for 1-2 players. The 9 new cards in this standalone sequel are designed by Ryan S. Davis. In Smitten 2, players work cooperatively with limited information/communication to complete two identical 3×3 grids of cards, each inspired by Stonemaier games released since the original Smitten and illustrated by The Mico. There are multiple difficulty levels and separate modes for solo and 2-player games.

Smitten's core design was inspired by comic book cards from Jamey’s youth, specifically a set where various cards formed a cohesive 9-card panorama image. In trying to complete two of these images in Smitten, there is no set turn order; rather, players indicate a preference to play or not play a card. The played card has instructions for the other player to place a card, which they must do or the game instantly ends.

—description from the publisher

name: Rise of Myths: Cthulhu
description:
Rise of Myths: Cthulhu ia roguelite deck-building game in which you will improve your deck after each attempt, as you face the Great Old Ones and their minions, while they try to destroy your body and sanity. Take on the role of one of the daring adventurers and face the threat that looms over you alone or as a team, inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft and his collaborators. Prepare yourself for an epic battle. Every move can make the difference between salvation or absolute doom. 

In RoM: Cthulhu, players will join forces to combat monsters in this deckbuilding game set in Lovecraft's world.  Each game will be different as you encounter randomly generated encounters and locations. Each player character and Great Old One location comes with unique attributes and mechanics, offering a variety of end-game possibilities. Rules also allow for different difficulty levels to suit each player.

name: Vantage
publisher: Stonemaier Games; Delta Vision Publishing; Feuerland Spiele; Keep Exploring Games; Kolossal Games; Maldito Games
description:
Vantage is an open-world, co-operative, non-campaign adventure game that features an entire planet to explore, with players communicating while scattered across the world. With nearly eight hundred interconnected locations on four hundred cards and over nine hundred other discoverable cards, the world is your sandbox.

You begin each game of Vantage on an intergalactic vessel heading towards an uncharted planet. After crashing far from your companions, you have complete freedom as to how you explore, discover, and interact with the planet. You view your location from a first-person perspective, and you can communicate with and support other players, but you are separated by vast distances, so only you can see your current location.

In addition to a mission victory, a destiny victory, or an epic victory (completing both the mission and a destiny), you may define success in Vantage through anything you pursue and achieve.

Vantage is not a campaign game. Each game is a standalone experience; you bring to future sessions only what you’ve learned about the world. It is completely self-contained with no expansions — just a few accessories like metal coins.

—description from the publisher

name: Risk of Rain: The Board Game
description:
Risk of Rain: The Board Game is a cooperative roguelike adventure set on the deadly planet of Petrichor V. Based on the acclaimed video game series, this tabletop adaptation challenges you to survive escalating waves of monsters, collect powerful items, and ultimately escape - or perish trying.

Each run spans four stages, with survivors fighting to locate and charge a hidden teleporter on each map before facing off against a stage boss. Complete three stages and reach Commencement, where the powerful Mithrix awaits as the final challenge. You can also save your progress at the end of any stage, allowing you and any fellow survivors to pick up the adventure at your leisure.

Each of you takes on the role of a Survivor, equipped with a unique deck of action cards. Every round these cards are placed into a shared action row alongside monster actions, revealing a turn order determined by card speed—creating fast-paced tactical decisions every round. As a survivor you can move, attack, and interact with the world around you, while monsters will attempt to strike back, block progress, and even multiply if left unchecked.

Each round concludes with the environment growing more hazardous: the planet's danger level increases, strengthening monsters and spawning more threats. If your team falls, you must start over — but with each run, you'll unlock powerful new content, including additional survivors, modular game expansions, unique discoveries, and dozens of new items that deepen and evolve the experience over time.

Risk of Rain: The Board Game is designed for nearly endless replayability, blending strategic depth with the unpredictable tension of a true roguelike.

—description from the publisher

name: Risk the Abyss
description:
Risk the Abyss is a 2-4 player dice game in which players compete to become the greatest Deep Sea Diver. Players take turns by rolling dice with a Yahtzee-style mechanism, and then executing the actions from the resulting dice. Each die face represents a different action that a player can take:


     Flippers and Anchors are used to move the Divers around the Ocean Grid.
     Harpoons and Keys are used to acquire Sea Creature and Treasure cards.
     Oxygen is used to hang onto face up cards.
     Radios are used to return to the Boat and bank cards.


Players must strategically collect sets of cards to gain the most points by the end of the game.

—description from the designer

name: Rival Seas
description:
Theme: Building a Maritime Empire

Welcome to Rival Seas, where you will command your very own maritime empire! Your mission is to chart the most efficient sea routes, fulfill the demands of bustling coastal towns, and secure a fortune in credits. Success in this cutthroat industry requires more than just navigation skills. You must strategically acquire shares in cargo companies, strive to become their CEO, siphon company wealth into your own hands and turn your portfolio into valuable assets. Only the savviest entrepreneur, who can acquire the highest capital by fulfilling demand and securing valuable stocks, will emerge victorious!

Gameplay Summary: Trade, Stocks, and Financial Mastery

Rival Seas is a strategic board game played over 3 intense rounds. Players manage a tight budget within a precious time limit as they race to dominate the seas.

On Your Turn: The core of the game is using your limited time on the Timetrack to perform actions. Each action you take moves your tracker further on the Timetrack. You can keep taking actions as long as you aren't the player who spent the most time. You can end your turn at any time as long as you aren't in the last position on the Timetrack.

Actions involve:
Build navigation points
Manufacture containers
Load containers
Influence demand of coastal towns
Invest in companies (and become CEO)
Acquire prestige and upgrades
Move your ship
Deliver containers (this also affects future container prices)

End of round:
Each round new cointainers enter play that can be loaded and delivered to coastal towns. Also the CEO of each company will receive his wage and if the company has enough funds left, the CEO can also decide to pay a dividend to all shareholders.

Scoring: After the third and final round ends, players calculate their final victory points based on their personal capital and prestige (Stock value, Credits, Investments).

Remark:
A Crucial Distinction => Company Funds vs. Personal Capital

A unique mechanism in Rival Seas is the strict separation between a company's funds and your personal credits. When you buy shares, the money goes to the company. Company funds are used to finance operations, such as placing Navigation points and the company will also get paid if players use these Navigation points. Your ultimate goal is to generate personal wealth (your Victory Points), which you primarily do by making deliveries and, critically, through the Payout Phase where the CEO receives a wage and decides dividends will be paid from the company's funds to shareholders.

—description from the publisher

name: Euphoria Essential Edition
description:
This essential edition of this colorful dystopian-themed game combines the original Euphoria core game with the expansion and includes some revised rules/components, particularly the board layout.

Euphoria is a worker-placement game where dice are your workers. The number on each die represents that worker’s knowledge, which you will compare to the knowledge of other players’ workers throughout the game. The more you send your workers throughout the city and the more workers you add, the more they discover about their twisted society. If they learn too much, they might desert your cause.

—description from the publisher

name: Valiant Wars: Call to Arms
description:
Valiant Wars: Call to Arms is a standalone Valiant Wars game with all-new champions and locations. It can be played by itself and combined with Valiant Wars.

Valiant Wars is an aggressive press-your-luck deck-builder where you must fight to capture lands of the once-great kingdom. Your rivals will resort to trickery and sabotage in their attempts to bring down your forces. Be warned! As you assemble larger armies and conquer more territory, you’ll be haunted by dark visions of a world in ruins; too many of these Dark Omens and withdrawal becomes necessary. Step up and claim the Valiant throne!

—description from the publisher

name: Valley of the Kings: Ultimate Edition
description:
When you die, you can take it with you!
Take on the role of Egyptian nobles at the time of the pharaohs, preparing for their death and burial in the Valley of the Kings. Using an innovative deck-building mechanic with a crumbling pyramid, players fill their tombs with food, canopic jars, statues, amulets and other treasures. The player who collects the most valuable artifacts in his or her tomb wins the game!

This boxed set consolidates ALL previous releases in the Valley of the Kings line plus an all new Archaeology expansion: 

     Valley of the Kings (also referred to as the base game)
     Afterlife
     Last Rites
     Necropolis Expansion
     NEW Archaeology


—description from the publisher

name: RoAR: Rise of Ancient Reptiles
description:
A strategic engine-building board game where you step into the role of a pioneering park director. Over three in-game years, you'll unearth fossils, incubate and hatch long-lost species, and build a thriving attraction filled with prehistoric wonders.

Your choices shape your park. Co-operative tasks, hidden personal objectives and shared competitive milestones keep every game fun, dynamic, and full of surprises.

—description from the publisher

name: Duelgeon
description:
Get ready for a truly unique 1-4 player game filled with insane loot, crazy battles and tons of dungeon crawling adventure! Push your luck playing Solo for high scores or fight with friends to see who can escape with the best loot!

Delve into treacherous ruins in this card-driven adventure, where deadly traps, fierce monsters, and powerful minibosses await. Will you challenge the Boss and snatch the loot, or roll to battle rival adventurers in a race for glory?

—description from the publisher

name: Robo Rescue
description:
In Robo Rescue, homesick robots race for home in this turn-based, programmed movement strategy board game.

2047. The human scientists have left. Silence echoes through the deserted Martian Research Facility. Four robots abandoned, embark on an adventure to reunite with their human creator back on Earth. Who will be the first one to repair the rocket engines of their spacecraft and blast off? This competition is fueled by homesickness, ingenuity, and the unwavering bond between robots and their creators.

Each player becomes an engineer, guiding their robot companion through the abandoned facility in search for resources using remote commands. Be the first to repair all 4 of your rocket engines to claim victory and blast off!

Each player’s turn consists of:

     Movement - Guide your robot with each carefully chosen command. Movement cards become your words, directing your robot to scoot forward, turn left, or take a daring right. Throw in a Blast! to blow up a Container Box, or activate a Levitate to glide over obstacles.
    Board Actions - Energy cells hidden in the old labs, spare parts scattered among the workbenches, and maybe even some leftover oil to grease those rusty gears. Scavenge for resources needed to repair your rocket engines.
    Conversions - Convert your collected resources into the essential components needed for your spacecraft.

name: RoboMon
description:
RoboMon is an exploration-focused, story-driven, open-world game of robot combat for 1-2 players.

After a series of wars and climate events, most of the world's animals went extinct. RoboMon were invented to piece the environment and ecosystems back together. But it wasn't long before people figured out they could be reprogrammed for some pretty sweet robot battles.

You pick things up 50 years after the world has been put back together. Take on the role of a brand new RoboMon trainer exploring the world and attempting to become a fully licensed RoboMon Ranger and the greatest trainer on the planet.

Explore the book of maps, and work your way through the adventure book to complete quests, solve puzzles, and defeat gym leaders. Earn enough badges to become a fully licensed RoboMon Ranger and win the game!

Each game session can take 5 minutes or 5 hours depending on how long you want to play.

name: Robot Like You
description:
Over a hundred years have passed since the humans have disappeared from the face of planet earth. Until now, robots have coexisted peacefully. But news that the earth's fuel has been running low, and greed for the fuel paired with fear of ending up in a junkyard has thrown the robots into a frenzy.

To survive, you spend your time foraging for parts with which to build weapons and force fields for protection.

Robot Ridge is a fast-paced, take that card game with several unique mechanics including custom designed robots, machine building to improve abilities, and scheming against enemy robots (see below).

Set-up:
Players choose  three cards to build their unique robot- head, body, and feet (or foot).

Gameplay:
On your turn, draft two cards from the junkyard and then play your cards in order to build shields, steal cards from other robots, or blow them to bits.
