The store owner is none other than Count Dracula himself! Each year, on Halloween night, he commands his monstrous employees—disguised as humans—to abduct customers and turn them into new creatures of the night. Their goal: expand the monstrous workforce and keep Dracula’s business thriving.

However, not everything goes according to plan. Suspicious tax inspectors and relentless monster hunters are lurking around, threatening to expose the truth and shut the operation down.

How the Game Works:
Players take on the roles of monstrous employees working under Dracula. They must secretly capture as many customers as possible while avoiding detection. But beware—among them may be undercover inspectors or hunters trying to sabotage the mission! Will you serve the Count loyally, or will the dark truth finally come to light?

—description from the publisher

name: Spooky Tower
description:
In Spooky Tower, ghosts have escaped from the tower to invade the town.

For centuries, a powerful amulet has kept ghosts prisoner in the old clock tower. But today, the amulet shattered and the ghosts escaped! Invisible to the naked eye, the only way to trap the ghosts is by taking photos of them. At nighttime, explore the town with your camera. Capture the hidden ghosts or mend the amulet to restore the protection spell and save the town from terror.

On your turn, roll dice and, depending on the result, take one of these two actions:  
take a card or flip your cards. Apply any revealed effects and check if you captured a ghost.
The first player to capture 5 Ghosts or collect 3 Amulet fragments wins the game!

-description from publisher

name: Sprites & Sprouts
description:
Sprites & Sprouts is a magical farming game for 1-5 players designed by Manny Vega (Flamecraft). Players take on the role of Sprites, helping the Farmer tend and grow their sprouts!

Over a series of rounds, guided by the Farmer's journey across the seasons, players take turns during the Sunrise phase, strategically placing their Sprite workers to Plant, Tend, Prep, or unleash Magic. Each action allows you to manipulate the vibrant Sproutling tiles on the 8x8 game board, aiming to complete Crop Challenge cards for points and powerful skills.  But beware! During the Sunset phase, the Harvest arrives, removing sections of the board and challenging your carefully laid plans.  Anticipate the Farmer's next move, adapt to unpredictable weather and events, and maximize your harvest to emerge as the most successful Sprite!

—description from the designer

name: Hummingbirds
description:
In Hummingbirds, you'll guide your birds to claim flowers that hide sand timers, then reveal those timers to check for nectar. If the sand timer has run out, collect a nectar token of the same color. The longer you wait, the sweeter the reward! But be careful: if the sand timer is still ticking when you check, you'll lose one of your lowest-value nectar tokens.

—description from the designer

name: Spyworld
description:
After years of amassing riches and consolidating power, you dream of ruling the world. Because of course, you deserve to! Unfortunately, rivals think they can steal your spotlight. You must protect the secrets of your success by building your lair, installing traps, and recruiting sentries. You will also need to thwart your opponents’ plans by stealing their secrets.

But beware! Their lairs will also be heavily secured, so prepare carefully before breaking in.

—description from the publisher

name: Stakeout
description:
Private eye, gumshoe, shamus you’ve heard all the names. Don’t care for any of ‘em. When you’ve got a case, you’re more like a dog with a bone. You pull up your collar and adjust your hat. The pelting rain seeps in anyway. Of all the nights to get that call. This case’ll take some finesse. Too bad you haven't got much of that. Maybe Lady Luck will be on your side  and if not, there’s always your trusty .38. Sometimes, you’ve got to make your own luck.

Stakeout is a competitive noir-themed game of dice placement and manipulation. In Stakeout, you step into the shadowy world of a 1930s private detective, vying to complete investigations and close cases.  Roll and spend dice to investigate leads, wiretap or go on a stakeout. Hot Tip cards give you dice manipulation powers you can use to gain an edge over your opponents. Careful timing can trigger powerful combos that can mean the difference between shaking down a suspect and going home empty handed.

Players collect claimed Investigation cards to match cases they are investigating. The game ends when a player has closed 3 cases.

name: Stalingrad Relief: December 1942
description:
Stalingrad Relief: December 1942 is a division/regiment-level game covering German efforts in December 1942 to open a supply corridor to German 6th Army and 4th Panzer Army units surrounded at Stalingrad.

The rules for Stalingrad Relief are based on the Series: Battles in the East series of games spanning many of the World War II Eastern Front battles between 1941 and 1945. Some are well known, while with others recent archival material allowed them to be accurately recreated for the first time.

The game mechanics are an evolution of the SPI classics Four Battles of Army Group South and Panzergruppe Guderian. These have been updated and incorporate later game mechanics, such as SPI/TSR/DG Cobra: Game of the Normandy Breakout.

Game scale is 3–5 miles (5–8 km) per hex. Each game turn is 2 days. Most units are German regiments and brigades, Romanian divisions and regiments, and Soviet mechanized and tank brigades or infantry and cavalry divisions, with some specialty battalions and other formations.

Originally published in World at War magazine #107 (Apr-May 2026).

Game Scale:
Game Turn: 2 days
Hex: 3-5 miles / 5-8 kilometers
Units: Regiment to Division

Game Inventory:
One 22 x 34" full color map
One dual-side printed countersheet of 276 5/8" counters (4 are blanks)
One 16-page full color rulebook

Solitaire Playability: High
Complexity Level: Medium
Players: 2 or more
Playing Time: 4-8 hours

Note: Players will need to provide one 6-sided die for game play.

name: Stamp Showdown
description:
In Stamp Showdown, you’re battling for the win of a high-profile stamp competition. Each round, all players secretly choose a stamp to trade with the market, then reveal together. In ranking order, each trade reshapes the market by pulling in all matching suits and ranks before joining it. Will you strengthen your own collection, or block your opponents at the perfect moment? After seven tense rounds, the final showdown begins, and only the most dazzling poker-style stamp collection will win!

—description from the designer

name: Good Dog, Bad Zombie (Second Edition)
description:
In Good Dog, Bad Zombie, you bark, sniff, and lick your way through the apocalypse to save the humans you love. Zombies roam the city, but you and your dog friends have found refuge in Central Bark. You’ll have to cooperate as a pack of dogs to sniff out humans in hiding and bring them back to safety. But beware! The danger of the city could turn your pack feral before you get a chance to build your forever home.

The second edition version of the game features new art, upgraded components, and new playable dog characters!

GDBZ aims to provide players with an immersive dog's-eye-view of the zombie apocalypse. Track down the humans from their smells, lick one another for boosts of energy, and bark at anything and everything!

On their turns, each player may take two actions, which can consist of running to different locations, playing energy cards from their hands, sniffing scent tokens, and giving each other licks in order to draw more energy. Each energy card has an ability, such as: Run, Herd, Bark, Chew, and Good Dog, the last of which allows each dog to perform a unique and powerful ability. Some cards can be chained together for elaborate, tactical turns. At the end of each player's turn they will have to roll the dice in order to add another zombie to the board, which may eat unsuspecting humans or get into Central Bark.

If too many humans are eaten or too many zombies get into Central Bark, the Feral Tracker will reach 10 - and we become wild dogs, forgetting our love of humanity . However, if the players rescue enough humans(6 on easier difficulties, and 8 on expert modes), we all win the game!

name: Escape the Dark Castle: Second Edition
description:
An improved and updated Second Edition, boasting greater variety, better balance, and new gameplay features, released to coincide with the 10th anniversary of initial release of Escape the Dark Castle.


    The base game now features mechanics formally restricted to expansions, plus more chapters, more items, and more bosses than 1st edition.
    Items of equipment and armor steadily degrade as you them. 
    Stamina is a new luck-mitigating resource each player must manage, spending it freely to re-roll or dodge damage, and restoring it by resting. 
    Each prisoner now has a simple, unique, once per game special ability.


The essence of the game remains the same: Escape the Dark Castle is a simple, cooperative game of retro-atmospheric adventure.

The goal of the game is for players to complete every chapter in the castle deck, then defeat the final boss. To win, they must keep every member of the team alive - if any player is killed, the game ends immediately!

name: Star Trek Ascendancy: The Final Frontier
description:
Star Trek Ascendancy: The Final Frontier is the ultimate collection of the most thematic 4x space game in the universe.

Star Trek Ascendancy: The Final Frontier is a big box collection of every Star Trek Ascendancy expansion ever made as well as:


    3 brand new civilizations: The Gorn, The Tholians and The Terran Empire. 
    2 brand new ways to play with:



        Campaign Mode, featuring unique Scenarios offering endless replayability.
        Non-Player Civilizations, allowing you to play solo or add even more players to your odyssey across the stars.



    An enhanced rulebook.

name: Star Trek: Captain's Chair – To Boldly Go
description:
In Star Trek: Captain's Chair, you go head-to-head against an opponent, each stepping into the shoes of an iconic leader from across the history of the Star Trek galaxy. Command ships, crew, and away teams, while you manage resources and alliances!

Star Trek: Captain's Chair – To Boldly Go is a new game that can be played on its own or combined with Star Trek: Captain's Chair to create even more captain competitions.

With To Boldly Go, you can play as James T. Kirk, Khan Noonien Singh, Philippa Georgiou from Star Trek: Discovery, Rebner, the Pakled Commander from Star Trek: Lower Decks, and more. Each of the six captains comes with a unique, asymmetric deck of cards that matches that leader's personality, abilities, allies, and assets. These decks can be expanded with cards available to both players, cards representing the people, items, planets, and events that characters encounter in iconic storylines. Each deck creates different strategic directions based on which common cards are available and what strategy your opponent deploys.

Prefer to fly solo? Take on the galaxy with a challenging single-player mode built to test your skill and strategy!

True to Star Trek, antagonism will not win every game. You will need to pursue diplomacy, exploration, and science, with different captains excelling at different paths. With hundreds of unique, deeply thematic cards, you'll want to explore the galaxy again and again. The chair is yours, captain!

—description from the publisher

name: Starclash
description:
Starclash is a base-building battle board game. Delve into a lore-rich planetary conflict where you are Commander in your faction’s fight to merely exist in a galaxy with few livable planets and many formidable factions vying to carve out a swathe of territory by which they may survive. Play competitively or in 1-2 player co-op scenarios! Brimming with asymmetry, play as one of four factions. You must collect resources to create structures and units so you can command your forces and conquer your enemy!

The Starclash gameplay experience is very rich, but it boils down to the 3 C’s each turn: 
 
     Collect Biosteel for constructing units and structures. Gather energy to power skills and upgrades. 
     Command your units. Units can move, build, attack, and use powerful abilities. 
     Conclude your turn as you watch your buildings complete construction…and await your adversary’s attack.


Deep on your side of the various maps offered is your base. Balance your offensive strikes with your defensive efforts because you win if you destroy your opponents' base but lose if yours is destroyed!

Be mindful to keep the area majority with your units in Mainframe areas to acquire precious Data at the end of each round! The first player to gather 6 Data points wins!

—description from the designer

name: Escape the Dark Forest
description:
Running on the new 'Second Edition' game engine, this standalone core set takes you on a brand-new adventure deep into the twisted landscape beyond the Dark Castle - adding new 'Fear' and 'Darkness' mechanics to the classic gameplay of its predecessor.

The goal of the game remains the same as for the other games of the Escape the Dark series : the up to 4 player group has to complete every chapter in the castle deck, then defeat the final boss. To win, they must keep every member of the team alive - if any player is killed the game ends immediately.

name: StarDriven: Gateway
description:
In StarDriven: Gateway, 1-4 players each control their own starship and crew while determining the fate of distant colonies near an ancient alien gateway. The game can be played competitively, co-operatively, or in solo mode depending on which episode you select at game set-up.

Your objective is to be the most renowned and respected Crew by gaining the most points. You gain points by increasing your reputation with the Council Worlds, promoting your Crew, researching Anomalies, recruiting Freelancers, and completing Missions. All of these brave endeavors will score you points and lead to your victory. Running your starship entails assigning crew to different stations on your ship board, which allows you to assign dice to those stations to activate ship actions. Move and explore space, encounter raiders, face anomalies, and use your crew abilities and skills to fulfill mission requirements and activate their bonuses. Manage your ship's power, weapons, and shields, and recruit and promote crew members to enhance your ship and achieve objectives to ensure your side prevails.

Each round of the game, each player takes a turn in clockwise order. On your turn, you must take 2 actions (and any free actions that you want) before ending your turn by passing or spending 1 to recruit a freelancer or promote a Crew on your ship. The round ends with each player Activating the Warbound. When any end game condition is met, players calculate their final score to determine who wins.

—description from the designer

name: StarDriven: Saga
description:
StarDriven: Saga is the story of a plucky crew lost in an uncharted galaxy, a crew that is barely surviving after losing most of their resources when their ship crashed on a harsh world. This crew of smugglers and misfits must band together to repair the ship and discover new worlds amongst the stars before they run out of supplies. Crew members will spend time aboard the ship and visit planets to unravel the mysteries of the galaxy and find their way home.

StarDriven Saga is a 1-6 player co-operative, science fiction adventure that features eight crew classes that can be combined with different alien species to create a variety of unique characters. The game's campaign features branching storylines and a multitude of worlds and star systems to discover.

—description from the designer

name: Starline Hill
description:
Discover stories yet untold by the stars in Starline Hill, a simple-to-learn and quick-to-play strategy game in which you and your opponent will spot stars in the night sky to form constellations!

Place your stars carefully to solidify your territory - restricting your opponent's options while trying to form constellation shapes yourself.

When you claim a constellation using your stars, neutral stars are left behind which can be spotted in straight lines. This could lead to a big positional advantage for you - or your opponent, if they're well prepared.

Rules include the full version of the game, which typically runs 40-60 minutes, as well as an easy-to-set-up quick version that typically runs 20-25 minutes.

—description from the designer

name: Stars of Ilumeïa
description:
In Stars of Ilumeïa, players compete to become the most powerful god in a distant galaxy. To do so, they must win the favour of the many civilisations and fulfil their prophecies.

The players collect star cards and assemble them into constellations according to certain placement rules. For this, they receive victory points or other bonuses from the civilisations. On the star cards, not only the number and position of the stars must be considered, but also other characteristics such as comets, symmetry, flaming stars and much more. New star cards can be acquired from a display. Particularly large constellations score a lot of points, but it can also be advisable to quickly create many small constellations. It is also important to remember to generate additional divine energy with certain constellations, which enables more actions per turn. If a constellation has special characteristics, energy cubes can be used to claim particularly strong bonuses from some civilisations, but the amount of available energy is limited.

—description from the publisher

name: Statecraft
description:
After the fall of the Berlin Wall and the division caused by the Cold War, the world opened up gradually  to a period of globalized economy in which the modern powers began to vie for world hegemony.

In Statecraft, you will manage the destiny of one of those great powers in its struggle for hegemony. Your first choice will be to select a leader for your power. Then, it will be time to prepare your agenda: use your votes in international organizations to secure their support, obtain allied governments with the help of your influences and have your spies ready in case of conflict. But try to get a good public image achieving your leader's objectives in each round... or everything will become more difficult.

Statecraft is a deeply interactive political board game that reproduces some of the most relevant situations of recent history. It is played in four rounds plus a final bonus points round. At the end, the power with the highest score will be declared the winner of the game.

—description from the publisher

name: Status: A Victorian Affair
description:
Status: A Victorian Affair is a worker placement game set in 1888 London, where you compete to build the most prestigious name in high society. As the day progresses round by round, you will place social tokens to take actions such as acquiring furniture and art from a shared market, hosting soirées, and attending grand events tied to the specific time of day. As you build out your estate, you will physically place estate pieces into a unique three-story player house, creating an immersive table presence and unlocking powerful room bonuses on your player board.

The game rewards careful planning and foresight. Interaction is centered on competing for cards in a shared market and carefully timing when to host and join events, rather than direct conflict. Each player chooses a unique character board that provides a special social ability and a distinct set of room bonuses. Replayability is high due to the variety of cards, the unpredictable timing of grand events, and the different combinations of player boards at the table. Victory belongs not to the wealthiest, but to the player who can most cleverly navigate the social season to earn the ultimate prize: Status.

—description from the designer

name: Steel Front: Sherman 1944
description:
Steel Front: Sherman 1944 is a solitaire wargame that puts you in control of a Sherman tank during the Battle of France in 1944. As the tank crew, you'll face off against a game-controlled German side.

Each mission is designed to be replayed, with changing weather conditions, different enemy setups, and dynamic objectives that ensure no two games are the same.

Steel Front: Sherman 1944 is perfect for those who enjoy solo wargames with a strong emphasis on historical accuracy and tactical depth.

name: STEERY: Steer the story
description:
STEERY is the party game of stories that will never be told again.

Drop ludicrous plot twists, spark seemingly impossible conflicts, and hijack the narrative with your cards to score points. No tale is too weird, and no ending too unhinged.

In STEERY, you score points by steering the story of one or more characters, using the story cards that you have in hand. To amplify the element of surprise, the game also includes special cards hidden in the main deck to prompt you to introduce new characters into the story or to straight out end it when you least expect it.

Learn it in 5 minutes. Bond with your people over unpredictable stories. Unleash your creativity and wit.

STEERY contains character cards and story cards (with point values). The first player starts the story by revealing a character card, introducing the character in the story, and playing story cards from their hand to get the ball rolling. From then on, players take turns in moving that same story forward by playing their story card(s), incorporating the concept of the card(s) they're playing in the story, and scoring points along the way. The game ends when "The End" card is drawn and announced.

STEERY is balanced between strategic and casual gameplay and the sweet spot between collaboration and competition. The game has also been designed to be family friendly, but it can easily take a NSFW turn if players wish to go that way.

—description from the publisher

name: Stellar Ventures
description:
Stellar Ventures is a highly-interactive economic game set in space. Players are investors in space-based corporations that compete for dominance over a multitude of planets. Corporations spend their invested capital to expand their network and purchase spaceships, which in turn increase the company value and shareholder dividends. By exploring alien planets, corporations can gain access to additional technologies to give them an edge in the space race.

Corporations may elect to sign The Agreement with the aliens, accepting a one-time special dividend to all shareholders in exchange for a promise of peace. However, the more corporations that sign this lucrative pact, the more likely it is that the aliens will double-cross them and take over all company assets.

At the end of the game, the player with the most money wins.

name: I C E: Collector
description:
The I C E: Unlimited Box contains the Collector version of the base game as well as the Collector version of the two expansions, Edifices & Guilds and Relics, all within the same Big Box and featuring deluxified components like Collector meeples and metal coins.

Note: the box has the title I C E: Collector

name: Stem & Branch
description:
Stem & Branch (Thiên Can Địa Chi) is an approachable & fast playing strategy card game inspired by the animals and elements of the 60-year Eastern zodiac calendar. It was lovingly crafted for families and gamers alike in hopes of creating a rewarding and fun way to enjoy the depth of the Eastern zodiac.

You and the other players will compete or cooperate on a shared tableau to rebuild the calendar from beginning to end. By utilizing the elements and supporting the animals, players gain years throughout the game. Spend your time wisely as the player who contributes the most years will win.

Game Summary

The Stem and Branch cycle is represented in the 60-card deck, with each card symbolizing a year guided by a Spirit Animal and one of the Five Elements. As an Immortal, your sacred task is to nurture the Tree of Time by summoning and ascending the Spirit Animals from the Stream of Time and recording their progress in the Scroll of Time.

The cost to summon a Spirit Animal depends on its rank and Element Type, paid by expending matching Animals and Elements you control. Once summoned, Animals already on the board can share their Element Type, making it easier to summon and ascend more Animals.

In cooperative play, you work together to help all the Spirit Animals complete their journeys before the Stream of Time runs out. In competitive play, you compete for control of the Animals and Elements to devote the most years to the Tree of Time. The game ends when the Stream of Time runs out. You then add the years you gained and the one who has the most years will be the winner.

—description from the publisher

name: Founders
description:
In the midst of a windswept, snowy landscape, a group of explorers discover a gigantic cave with a massive structure that radiates out from it. Around this Hearth, the Master Founders lay the foundation for what will become The City, home to the powerful Guilds of I C E!
Following the directives of the first Founders' Council on the Design of the City, as well as the Requests of the first Guilds, you will design and create this famous City from scratch!

Founders is a strategic and innovative game of tile placement where each player is in a hidden alliance with 2 other players they don't know. Each player has two design objectives. You must arrange your tiles to achieve objectives, help you hidden allies, but avoiding giving too much information to your opponents. There is a cooperative scoring system, but only 1 player can win.

—description from the publisher

name: I C E: Second Edition
publisher: This Way!; A-Z kiadó; Old Dawg
description:
Ice as far as the eye can see. In this frozen world, swept by blizzards, a lone city clings to life. Every year during the summer season, the City's guilds organize expeditions. Their destination: the Valley of the Nuuka, where vestiges of an antediluvian civilization might be buried. Looking for answers, prestige or riches, every guild has its own motivations.

I·C·E is a game of exploration, 3D tile mining, and collection. Players are archeologists exploring tiles that they can remove. Archeologists dig these tiles in order to collect artifacts which gave them reputation points.  There are 3 levels of tiles in the game. The first one corresponds to the ice sheet level. The second and third represent surface and deep artifact levels. The bottom layer level is the City of Azulia.

The ice sheet tiles removed by a player can be played as a helping action for him. The edifice tiles are game changing rules and represent legacy material to discover as we go along.

The game stops when a first edifice tile is fully discovered. Then players count their reputation points, which determine the winner. The goal is to validate Requests and score Decrees from the City to get the highest number of Renown points when the fourth Day is over.

—description from the publisher

name: Story of Many
description:
Story of Many is a cooperative fantasy adventure board game for 1-4 players about exploring a vast land, combating deadly foes, and delving into mysterious adventure sites. With over 400,000 words of adventure text, and limitless possibilities for creating and advancing your own character, brave a world filled with profound lore and hard choices. Story of Many emphasizes exploration, storytelling and challenging combat, making it an engaging experience for all board game and table-top RPG fans.

Open-world exploration is a core element of Story of Many designed to capture the sense of freedom and discovery. The world map represents the expansive and interconnected regions of Varda - each with its unique landscape, challenges, and opportunities. These regions include dense rainforests, uncharted islands, desolate ruins, sprawling eldritch cities, and treacherous dungeons. As players progress, they will uncover the game's intricate lore, and influence the unfolding story. Their choices will lead to different branching paths and outcomes.

Combat is fast, unforgiving, and delivers a fresh experience every time, as the players will pit against more than 200 unique enemies. Combat is resolved using dice and miniatures. By defeating enemies and exploring, characters gain experience to develop their abilities. Character development is achieved through a massive, interconnected web of nodes encompassing passive traits, abilities, spells, trigger actions, setting it apart from any other game of the genre. No fighter will ever be the same!

CREATE YOUR HERO. EXPLORE THE LAND. CHOOSE WISELY.

—description from the designer

name: Strange Bedfellows
description:
Strange Bedfellows - The Card Game of Political Dirty Tricks is a satirical foray into the tumultuous world of Presidential politics full of unexpected twists and turns.

Create your candidate, take positions on controversial issues, compete for endorsements, and get out the vote to strengthen your base and build a winning campaign.  And no presidential run is complete without slinging some mud at your opponents and engaging in a war of political Dirty Tricks to take your seat in the Oval Office.

Strange Bedfellows gives players a chance to create their own political world, and like election cycles no two games are alike! Every Dirty Tricks card has multiple uses allowing the players to decide how vicious or amicable your campaigns will be. With Muckraking Journalism, Media Spin, Fake News, and Digging Dirt, immerse yourself in a game of political humor and unpredictable political campaigns while competing in a run for the White House!

Look for the KickStarter June 2024

—description from the designer

name: String Theory
description:
Throughout history, some subsets of the population have believed wildly improbable things. These are often referred to as conspiracy theories and the threads holding those theories together are often tenuous at best. In this game you play as a radio show host trying to convince the public of ridiculous conspiracy theories. Weave your way between people, places, events, and things to spin a tall tale that surely must be true. Game play involves moving a string and bobbin around a peg board to connect conspiracies and collect evidence, using that evidence to prove conspiracies and convince sheeple to follow your fledgling podcast! The podcaster with the most sheeple following their podcast at the end wins!

—description from the designer

name: Stubborn Sheep
description:
The sheep, with four different colours wool, are grazing in a circle around the table, spread across grass fields and players’ stable fields. Each player controls a stable made up of two fences placed in front of them, while the spaces between players form shared grass fields that also hold sheep.

Players aim to collect sets of sheep of the same colour in their own stable fields. By scoring sheep the player earns small bonusses to be used in future rounds.
On your turn, you place one fence on top of an existing fence anywhere around the table — either on one of your own fences or on an opponent’s. Each fence shows arrows indicating which sheep colours jump to the left and which jump to the right when that fence is activated.
After placing a fence, you immediately activate it and move the indicated sheep. Then, you also activate your own fence or fences that have not yet been activated this turn. 
There are four different sheep breeds, each with its own special behaviour. Some sheep may bring another sheep along when they move, while others will kick a sheep out of a field when they arrive. Mastering these unique behaviours — and predicting how they interact — is key to clever herding, and scoring.

Variant: The Wolf
For players seeking a tougher challenge, the Wolf can be added. Each turn, the wolf prowls the Highlands and steals sheep from the fields, leaving less to lead into the stable.

Stubborn Sheep is a tactical game of positioning, timing, and controlled chaos, where every fence placement can shift the balance — and no sheep ever goes exactly where you expect.

—description from the publisher

name: Subversia
description:
Subversia is a quick card game of simultaneous espionage. Everyone plays action cards at the same time to plot attacks, steal intel, and topple their neighbor's regimes. Subversia combines the simplicity and hand management of classic games like Uno, with the deception of hidden reveal games like Coup, and the chaos of party games like Exploding Kittens.

Players manage a hand of 5 Actions, secretly selecting 2 they wish to play during a Round. Simultaneously, everyone will flip 1 of their 2 Actions - those effects taking place instantly. Attack other players, steal their points, flip the direction of play, and more.

Be the first to collect 5 Intel points to claim victory or eliminate all the other factions to rule supreme!

Only one can claim dominion. Will it be you?!

—description from the designer

name: Sudden Conflict
description:
Sudden Conflict is a two-player miniatures skirmish game where players control teams of unique characters from across a multiverse that lurches on the edge of annihilation. Players battle each other across various battlefields, and can create their own teams using characters from multiple Sudden Conflict sets.

There are three separate core sets that each unveil a distinct reality awaiting exploration. Each core set can be played separately, or combined to give players access to a greater pool of character to specific build teams or to create a drafting experience which challenges players to build teams in a way comparable to building decks in trading card games.

Players engage in intermittent turns, directing one character at a time to influence the dynamics of the battlefield. With each strategic move, you either push your opponent closer to defeat or capitalise on setbacks, accumulating momentum dice. These momentum dice serve as valuable assets, empowering you to shift the tide in your favour in future conflicts.

Each set of Sudden Conflict contains six custom miniatures, six character cards, ten action dice, ten momentum dice, a double-sided battlefield, rulebook and numerous tokens to track various conditions and game states.

CORE SETS 

Sudden Conflict: Valrona presents a dark Renaissance fantasy realm, where a land grapples with the twin challenges of a deadly plague and horrific beasts.

Sudden Conflict: Ukyo invites you to a Far East domain inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, all under the rule of an oppressive government.

Sudden Conflict: Galactic Throne immerses you in a space opera setting, where the omnipotent Galactic Tyrant — Empress Melar — strives to assert dominance across all realities.

EXPANSION SETS

Sudden Conflict: Exiled brings six more characters into the mix. Exiled includes 3 pairs of characters which thematically fit into the worlds of Valrona, Ukyo and Galactic Throne, and may be added or swapped into teams to create unique battles. Sudden Conflict: Exiled is not playable without one or more Core Sets.

—description from the publisher

name: Sudds & Malone
description:
In the shadowy alleys of New York, the Sudds & Malone Detective Agency unravels a city-wide conspiracy, where every clue reveals deeper danger.

Dive into a medium-light competitive Euro game where strategic card management, tactical dice drafting, and clever set collection drive the action. With hidden information adding layers of intrigue, every decision matters as you piece together clues and navigate the murky world of 1938 New York. Feel the suspense build as you uncover secrets and solve mysteries.

On your turn, draft a die from the pool and choose your action. Improve your skills with Office, talk to suspects with Calendar, investigate the city for evidence, use Flimflam to distract the cat or gain extra clues, dive into new cases, stock up on bullets, or just sit back and read the newspaper for additional hints.

—description from the publisher

name: Sugarworks
description:
The conveyors are out of control and there is candy all over the place. Sugarworks employees rush to adjust the conveyors to coax the unruly candy into the appropriate packages. Fulfilling orders will earn points. Unfortunately, the candy lines are all mixed up and the candy is colliding and moving all over the place. How will you fill your orders?

Players are each given objectives in the form of Orders, which are worth points at the end of the game. Three conveyor lines are moving candy along them toward their destination packaging, and several candy outputs keep putting more candy onto the conveyors. As the candy collides, it will jump to different locations based on the candy involved in the collision.

The conveyors can be manipulated in an effort to properly fulfil your orders. Other players, unfortunately, are also trying to complete different orders which may not align with yours. As soon as one type of candy has been completely processed, the packages will ship, and the players will score their completed orders.

-description from publisher

name: Sunday Manager
description:
Sunday Manager combines banter, unique atmosphere, multiple layers of strategy and the joy of managing a Sunday league team.  You’ve just been appointed as the manager of a struggling amateur club, and the pressure is on. With only one month until the new season kicks off, your team is missing four crucial players. Management is nervous, wondering if you can pull the squad together in time. The fate of the season and the club's reputation is in your hands. Although this is your first season as a manager, the fans believe in you. Who will emerge as the best of all Sunday Managers?

In Sunday Manager, players take on the role of football club managers competing to achieve the highest prestige points. Prestige represents the club's success, measured by acquiring skilled players, managing resources effectively, and completing specific in-game objectives. The game spans four weeks, simulating the intense final days of pre-season preparations.

The game progresses through rounds, each broken into daily activities like auctions, events, and training. Managers start with unique resources, including financial funds, a sponsor, and club philosophy. Over the course of the game, they engage in auctions to secure players, use event cards for strategic advantages, and sell unwanted players. Key mechanics include careful resource allocation, tactical card usage, and strategic auction bidding.

At the end of the game, all accumulated prestige is tallied. This includes squad prestige, bonuses from completed objectives, training progress, and any remaining funds. The player with the highest total prestige is declared the winner. In the event of a tie, various criteria such as locker room composition and transfer achievements are used to determine the winner.

name: Super
description:
Over a decade ago, the legendary superhero agency "The Guardians" closed its doors, shaken by a political scandal of unparalleled magnitude. To this day, no other superhero group has managed to captivate the masses in the same way and come close to its fifty million followers. The disappearance of The Guardians left a vast void, an empty throne at the pinnacle of superhero glory waiting for the one who can rekindle the flame of universal admiration.

You, the ambitious director of a major Super agency, are determined to change that and inscribe your name and that of your agency in history. The race to surpass the mythical threshold of fifty million followers is on, and you're at the forefront, ready to take on the challenge.

Your arsenal? A collection of Supers with unmatched talents, each proudly displaying the colors of their alliance, demonstrating their power through the number of stars that glitter next to their name, and most importantly, possessing unique powers that, under certain conditions, can turn the tide of a mission. Every recruitment is a step closer to glory, every mission accomplished a chance to gain new followers.

Completed missions allow you to acquire various bonuses and precious resources to strengthen your agency, but the ultimate reward is not measured in material wealth; it's measured in millions of followers.

The goal of Super? Attract fifty million followers as quickly as possible. How? By recruiting superheroes. Each hero has their color, their strength represented by stars, and a special power that can aid during missions. The missions themselves provide bonuses and, most importantly, can earn you millions of fans.

It's a race against time to become the number one superhero agency. Every choice counts, and every second is precious, so are you ready to take on the challenge and make history?

—description from the publisher

name: Citizens of the Spark
description:
The fate of creatures touched by the spark of intelligence hangs in the balance. You must recruit strong animal allies to your city and unlock the potential of your citizens if your settlement is to survive the days to come.

Citizens of the Spark is a variable set-up card game in which players take turns attracting citizens, taking actions, and claiming sparks. The more citizen cards a player has of a specific type, the more powerful that citizen's action becomes. The player with the most sparks in their city when the deck runs out wins!

Play with 7-10 animal citizen types per game, chosen from 30 available creatures and combined into one shared deck. Every citizen type has distinct powers, making each game's action combos uniquely variable.

On your turn, recruit multiple citizens by selecting an available group of cards, placing them in your city tableau, and grouping like citizens together to grow their action strength. Next, select one type of citizen in your tableau to activate, taking the effect of the card and discarding it from your city. But keep watch on rival cities, because when you activate a citizen, all players can follow your move and activate a matching citizen of their own!

name: Emerald Skulls
publisher: Gém Klub Kft.; Mandoo Games; Rawstone; Thunderworks Games
description:
In the grimy depths of Kulbak Prison, where the greatest Dragul warriors are confined, inmates gather around Nargash the goblin and his bone-carved dice. Best to keep your wits about you. A game of Emerald Skulls is about to begin…

Emerald Skulls is a push-your-luck, dice gambling game. Attempt to fill the skull board with dice and place speedy, real-time wagers on the outcomes of your opponents’ rolls.

On your turn as the tumbler, roll dice and use tricks to place them on the five ascending tiers of the skull. But be warned - once you place dice, you can no longer put them on lower tiers for the rest of your turn!

During your opponents’ turns as tumbler, you are a gambler. Swiftly place bets and counter-bets on the results of the tumbler’s rolls. You may wager twice per round, but can only bet while the dice are in the tumbler’s hands. So think fast and bet smart - the quicker your wager, the bigger your payout!

When the pot of gears runs out, the player with the most claims the victory.

—description from the publisher

name: FlipToons
publisher: Thunderworks Games; Geeks N' Orcs; Hobby World; Rawstone; Rexhry; Strohmann Games; Sylex
description:
It’s time to cast the next great animated show! A top talent agent like you knows a star when you see one, and the director needs you to fill six roles for the big production. Search Flip Valley for the perfect toon characters, and make sure they’re ready to work together on the silver screen!

FlipToons is a quick deck-building game. You’ll begin with a deck of hopeful toon actors. Each round, flip six of these toons out from your deck into your screen grid to audition together.

Each toon card in your 3-by-2 grid has different talent effects. Some are resolved as soon as they are flipped. Many will interact with one another and (hopefully) earn Fame for your studio. But they won’t all have that special on-screen chemistry you’re looking for. Some won’t work well together at all!

After each Flip, tally up your current grid of toons’ Fame points, then spend them to hire more stars for your cast. Purchase these new toon cards from the market and add them to your deck. Or, spend some of your Fame to dismiss a card, and get that bad actor off the stage. Sorry kid, you just don’t have what it takes to be a star in this show.

If your Flip is the first to generate 30+ Fame, you’ll earn the Critic’s Choice award (worth extra Fame points) and trigger the end of the game. After that turn’s market phase, it’s time for one Final Flip. The player who earns the most Fame during the Final Flip is declared the winner. Applause!

2026 American Tabletop Awards - Casual Games: RECOMMENDED

name: Super Team
description:
Super Team is a highly tactical football game where each player takes control of a unique team and captain, managing offensive and defensive moves through a deck of cards filled with powerful tactical abilities. Every match is fast, exciting, and filled with strategic decisions.

In Super Team, players take turns playing 1-3 cards from their hands. Each card’s actions are resolved by rolling dice, with the number of dice rolled depending on the team’s stats, which are set at the start of each half. From perfect passes to game-changing saves, every action can turn the tide of the match.

Resource management is key: Teams gain morale (stars) by performing successful tactics, which can then be spent on critical events — whether it’s an extra movement, a decisive chip shot, or a game-winning play. The more you manage your resources and make smart tactical decisions, the closer you get to victory!

—description from the publisher

name: Suriya: The Last Horizon
description:
Suriya is a competitive deck-building board game set in a distant galaxy where civilizations battle for dominance over a resource-rich planet. Players assume the roles of four unique factions, each with distinct abilities and playstyles, vying to control the planet Suriya and its rare minerals that hold the key to ultimate power.

At the start of the game, players choose a faction: the resourceful Humans, the territorial Scarab, the calculating Syntron, or the vengeful Crytaas. Each faction comes with its own deck of cards, unique generals, and abilities that define its strategy. Players customize their playstyle by building their decks and adapting to their chosen faction's strengths.

On their turn, players use their deck to perform actions such as deploying units, claiming territories, gathering resources, or upgrading their faction's abilities. The planet Suriya is divided into contested zones where battles and resource management take place. Controlling these zones is critical, as they contain the rare minerals needed to fuel your faction's objectives.

Victory is achieved by dominating key regions, amassing rare resources, and outmaneuvering your opponents through clever deck-building and tactical decisions. With high asymmetry and multiple strategies for each faction, Suriya: The Last Horizon offers endless replayability as players explore new tactics and forge their path to victory. Will you seize the horizon, or be lost in the depths of the galactic conflict?

—description from the publisher

name: Swindler's Chest
description:
The Swindler's Chest includes all gameplay content from Emerald Skulls and Goblin Vaults. The chest also includes a double-sided playmat (one side for each game) and 3 plastic trays for easy game setup and storage. Additionally, the larger box supports sleeved cards for both games!

This Swindler's Chest includes the following items (all sold separately):

Emerald Skulls (base game content)
Emerald Skulls: 7-8 Player Expansion
Goblin Vaults (base game content)
Goblin Vaults: Gundur Pack + Chaos & Order (Mini Expansions)
Swindler's Playmat

Admin Note: This entry is set up to reflect the above but the Swindler's Chest was also sold with only Emerald Skulls and its expansion. This entry is also meant to represent that version too.

name: Survivalist
description:
Survivalist drops two to six empty-handed players into the brutal wilderness for ten nights. Each day forces a decision: stay warm at the fire, recover in the nearby clearing, or push into the backcountry and gather what’s needed to prepare for seven threats. As the game progresses, these threats grow worse and nearer: thirst, storms, hunger, illness, wildlife, fatigue, and isolation. The game plays out as a tense survival simulation where every round is a balancing act of action selection and resource management, shaped by limited time, limited backpack capacity, and the constant threat of injury.

On their turn, players take one action. They may “gather” specific resources along the ridge, “forage” for random supplies in the valley, or “craft" items using specific resource recipes. Choosing an action also means choosing how much risk to accept, because each option requires drawing deadly discs from a bag. These bag draws make every turn a press-your-luck calculation: push deeper into the wild to get what you need, or play it safe and risk being unprepared later. Regular airdrops add even more pressure to scramble into the backcountry for an assortment of bonuses and buffs.

After eight rounds of preparation, a ninth round reveals each player’s hidden talent. This allows players to spend a unique resource type they’ve gathered during the game to adjust the danger levels of the game’s threats. Then comes the finale: a tense endgame in which players face the seven threats one by one. Crafted items and remaining health determine who withstands the ordeal and who falls - from drawing more "wound" discs than they can fit on their playerboard.

The game ends when only one person is left standing. Whoever endures the longest is the true survivalist—and the winner.

-description from designer

name: Sword and Snow
description:
A war strategy-based board game for 3-4 players set in the fantasy realm. Players must outwit their rivals to seize coveted territories, all while fending off the relentless advance of the Undead. One wrong decision could plunge your ambition into the chilling realm of the undead.

Embark on an epic journey in this dynamic war strategy board game, where cunning cooperation meets fierce competition. As a determined prince in a chilling realm plagued by undead, joins forces with an ally to claim strategic regions and outsmart both rivals and the relentless undead. Every move becomes a strategic dance, testing loyalty and tactical wit.

In the icy embrace of winter, unity is your strength against the dual challenges of betrayal and undead forces. The throne awaits the shrewdest tactician in this riveting battle of minds, where every decision shapes your destiny. Will you emerge victorious through clever cooperation or cunning competition?

Game Highlight

Liquor Ceremony 
In an intriguing twist, players also have the option to forge alliances through a liquor ceremony, fostering mutual benefits throughout the game, which takes place during spring.

Summer Explore
The game then commences in summer, granting each player the opportunity to select an action phase. Players might also inspect all the cities to explore skill cards and relics.

The War Begin
As autumn arrives, the battleground ignites with the clash of rival princes.  Get ready for the excitement to unfold, as players engage in negotiations, deploy their skills, and unleash powerful relics, all in the pursuit of winning this war.

Undead Rising
The war ends and the snow has falls, it’s cold embrace serves as a poignant reminder that victory comes at a price. During winter, players must prepare for the imminent awakening of the undead, who will now launch attacks against all the players. Can you take the advantage in this chaotic season?

—description from the designer

name: Synchro Horizon
publisher: New Game Entertainment Pte Ltd.; Board Zeppelin
description:
Centuries ago, three worlds merged through crystal magic, an event remembered as the Synchro Horizon. For generations peace endured, until the prophecy of the “Mad Sage” reached its final day: the Fifth Calamity rises, storms coil above Stellaris, and a Celestial prepares a dark ritual to unmake the realm. Strange beasts spread across the land, and only you and your companions can stop the ritual before the last weeks of winter run out.

Synchro Horizon is a 1–4 player cooperative JRPG-inspired roguelike board game of tactical combat, modular exploration, and evolving heroes. Play solo or together, guiding a party of four heroes from the capital city of Luminaria to Stellaris itself—facing monsters, leveling up, and forging synergies before the Celestial awakens in a climactic battle.

Phases of Play

Every playthrough unfolds across three repeating phases:
    •    Journey Phase — Choose your path across a branching map of cities and landmarks. Each move advances the seasonal calendar and sets up the next challenge.
    •    Battle Phase — Confront monsters in fast, tactical combat using the game’s Shard system. Heroes spend crystals of raw magic to unleash skills, shift positions, and trigger class abilities. Randomized initiative and rising exhaustion make every fight tense and unpredictable.
    •    Location Phase — After victory, visit villages to recruit new heroes, awaken items, or learn from masters, and explore landmarks offering unique rewards, risks, and legendary opportunities.

What You Will Do
    •    Travel across a branching map of cities and landmarks, each with unique challenges and rewards.
    •    Explore villages, mines, towers, and ruins, gaining items, potions, and masterful teachings.
    •    Battle swarms of monsters in fast, tactical combat using the Shard system—crystals of raw magic spent to unleash skills, shift positions, and trigger class abilities.
    •    Recruit & Level Up over 30 heroes, upgrading skills and items, and combining them with masters to forge powerful builds.
    •    Survive & Adapt as initiative order changes each round, exhaustion builds, and every decision brings you closer—or further—from your goal.
    •    Face the Celestial in a climactic final battle to determine whether Valentia survives the Fifth Calamity.

Why It Stands Apart
    •    30+ heroes across three classes, each with distinct shard affinities and playstyles.
    •    50+ skills and 30+ items to master, upgrade, and combine.
    •    28 monsters and 4 Celestial bosses with escalating abilities and multi-stage fights.
    •    Dynamic landmarks and villages that reshape the journey each run.
    •    Roguelike replayability—branching routes, evolving hero rosters, and adaptive strategies.
    •    Play solo or cooperatively with up to 4 players (expandable to 8 with the Beyond Journey expansion).

Survive through four seasons of 12 weeks each—defeat the Celestial before the final winter week, or Valentia falls to the Fifth Calamity.

name: Synthetic Sins
description:
Survive the Shadows of Neo Colombo. In a city where secrets are currency and danger lurks in every shadow, Synthetic Sins invites you to take on the role of Garrett Takao, a fixer framed for a crime he didn’t commit. Navigate a gripping solo adventure of stealth, action, and survival as you uncover the truth behind a sinister conspiracy. With over 25 handcrafted missions, you’ll sneak past guards, disable high-tech security, and outsmart ruthless foes—or dive into thrilling firefights when the stakes are high. Modular maps and strategic gameplay make every mission a tense and immersive challenge. From the shadows of back alleys to the sterile halls of corporate towers, every moment brings high-stakes action in a world where technology and survival collide.

In Synthetic Sins, each mission has a preprogrammed setup and objectives.  Modifier cards are drawn through out each mission, adding randomness and replayability.  If players fail to achieve the objects or lose all their Health points during a mission, they lose.  However, missions can be replayed after reshuffling the Modifier deck. An optional, non-lethal mode is also available to play.

—description from the publisher

name: Tenpenny Parks: Collector's Edition
description:
Expand your thrilling theme park with Innovation and Winter Lights & Spooky Nights, featuring amazing art from Vincent Dutrait!

Innovation Expansion:
Mayor Tenpenny invites you to his office. "Simple amusements may have been good enough for last year's guests," he tells you, "but the theme park patrons of today demand novelty and innovation!"

Winter Lights & Spooky Nights Expansion:
The holiday season is approaching for Fairview. In the heart of autumn you will compete to build the spookiest atmosphere.
And when winter arrives, you'll work to fill every guest's heart with holiday cheer!

Tenpenny Parks Collector's Edition includes every expansion and mini-expansion, plus custom storage all in one box!

Includes:

     Tenpenny Parks (Inside Box)
     Winter Lights & Spooky Nights (Inside Box)
     Innovation (Inside Box)
     Deluxe Components (Inside Box) (13 Screenprinted Worker Meeples, 12 Screenprinted Discs, 1 Coth Concessions Bag, and 15 Additional Tree Markers)
     Fairview Challenges (Inside Box)
     Fast Pass
     Custom insert and trays


—description from the publisher

name: Take the Throne
description:
In Take the Throne, you play as rival houses competing to take the throne and leave a lasting legacy on the realm. In this fast paced card game you will be constantly second guessing your opponents in a race to reach 8 victory points.

The best way to gain victory points is to sit on the throne each round but only one player can hold the throne as the Monarch.  Each turn, players select one card to play - The Monarch aims to retain the throne and all the house players try to play a card that will take the throne from them.  All cards can impact each other so selecting the right card is key to victory!

Try to outthink your opponents and play the best card that will get you onto the throne in order to gain the most victory points!

Can you master the right tactics to take the throne and leave your legacy?

name: Legends of the Arena
description:
Legends of the Arena is a fast-paced brawling board game for 2–6 players (1-6 with solo expansion), inspired by fighting games like Super Smash Bros. Choose your Legend, read your opponents, and knock them out of the Arena to win!


     Competitive and strategic, but quick to learn
     Simultaneous play keeps the action moving
     8 Unique Legends with distinct moves & ultimates
     One minute setup with a compact, table-friendly footprint
     Quick to play, only 8 minutes per player
     Play 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or free-for-all


Enter the Arena as a unique Legend, armed with powerful abilities. Coordinate your skills to build a strategy and anticipate your opponents’ moves. Select three action cards, reveal them simultaneously to execute your plan, then repeat. No lead is safe, and no comeback is impossible!

—description from the publisher

name: Super Trains
description:
The robot city of Gearland is under attack! The evil semi-truck ROLLAR is damaging the city and tormenting the wonderful robot citizens.

Players will take control of a superhero train and help save the city by delivering gears and passengers to specific locations, upgrading their train, solving emergencies, completing missions and battling Rollar. Once Rollar is defeated the Super Train with the most stars at the end of the game is the winner!

From the designer of the critically-acclaimed The Quest Kids comes a fast and fun pick up and deliver train game for young conductors 7 years old and up.

Super Trains features giant colorful train miniatures that players will move around the colorful city of Gearland. The main resource in the game are the magical gears, which are generated every turn by the rolling of the Gear Die. What gears a player receives is based on how they have upgraded and organized their unique train player board.

But watch out, because the Rollar Die is rolled every turn as well, which determines where an emergency will appear on the board.

—description from the publisher

name: Tally Up
description:
Tally Up! is a fast-paced, push-your-luck dice game built around managing risk and timing your exit. The objective is to accumulate points from the rolls of the Tally Dice – six colorful dice each offering varying point values and risk levels (stars). Everyone plays and can score every round, with one player rolling each round. All players start each round IN. The core tension lies in the IN or OUT mechanic: after every roll from the active player, all players can choose to stay IN and risk it for a higher score on the current round's running total, or go OUT and safely bank the accumulated points.

The active player chooses three of the six dice to roll, selecting from Low, Medium, or High Risk dice. Low-risk dice offer smaller points but are safer, while high-risk dice boast bigger numbers but carry a greater chance of busting. If two stars are rolled in the main roll it is a Bust and everyone still IN scores 0 points for that round. Otherwise, the numbers rolled are added to the running total. Any circled numbers trigger rolling the Up Die, which can deliver a bonus or penalty to the running total, or extra dice rolls further escalating the risk. If two or more stars are rolled across the main roll and the Up die roll, it is a bust. A special bonus occurs if three stars are rolled on the main roll only. When that happens the first player to yell “Tally Up!” scores a bonus (even if they are OUT), and everyone else who is still IN scores a smaller bonus.

To win Tally Up!, you must be the first player to reach a score of 2,500 points or more at the end of a round. Victory hinges entirely on your nerves — knowing when to go OUT and bank the running total before the inevitable bust zeroes it out.

—description from the publisher

name: Tameri
description:
In Tameri, you will experience everyday life in ancient Egypt, exploring a classic theme from an original angle that emphasizes agriculture, traditional life, and the high importance of weather cycles in the Nile Valley. In this game, you will farm the land, construct buildings, assign priests in different temples, build sphinxes, and so much more!

Tameri is a competitive 1-4 player medium-weight game that utilizes a unique mechanism of marble balls flowing through a pyramid on the game board to determine the weather, which in turn determines the crops and farming output of each player. Tameri blends classic Eurogame mechanisms, including resource management, tableau building, set collection, worker placement, engine building, and more in a fresh and highly thematic way.

Are you ready to outplay your opponents in ancient Egypt and rule the Nile Valley?

—description from the publisher

name: Mana Mania
description:
Mana Mania is a light set-collection card game with hand-management and drafting gameplay. Players collect colored cards matching their own elemental identity, which changes as they shift on a linear board called the Leyline. Across 6 rounds, they’ll burn, block, and freeze fellow players as they gather from a refilling Mana Pool. Utilize nine elements with unique playstyles and effects to sabotage other players' plans. In the end, only one spirit will amass enough energy to claim victory.

Players start each round by refilling their hand (tableau) with elemental cards from a shared deck. A shared resource pool called the Mana Pool is also filled. Players are randomly assigned to spaces along a board called the Leyline. Their position shows their current "Alignment." A player's elemental alignment determines how they score at the end of the game, but also what abilities they can use. The aligned element and its two adjacent elements on the Leyline form that element's "Range."

Players take turns completing 3 actions to move, acquire cards, and use effects. They can only use the effects of elements within their range. Between rounds, hands refill and the Mana Pool is refreshed. The last rounds provide boosted versions of the 3 actions. After the final round, players will count points from cards in their hand that match their elemental alignment. The player with the highest point total wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Tavern of Thieves
description:
Tavern of Thieves is a fast-paced, cutthroat game of thievery, and suspicion management.

You and your fellow players are thieves competing to steal the most valuable loot from unsuspecting tavern patrons — without drawing too much attention.

On your turn, you can attempt daring steals, lay low to reduce suspicion, or scheme to gain the upper hand with clever action cards. But there’s a catch:

    Fail a skill check, and your suspicion rises, making future heists harder.
    Go after the same loot as another thief, and you’ll have to out thief them or walk away with nothing.


Each round consists of 3 phases: Plan, Reveal, and Resolve.  These continue until someone wins.

The objective of the game, is to steal items from patrons to gather Loot Tokens.  The first thief to get 15 Loot Tokens, wins.

—description from the publisher

name: Antiques Ghost Show
TEKKEN: The Board Game
description:
In TEKKEN – The Board Game — a fighting tabletop game that translates the dynamic and tactical experience of the TEKKEN video game series — two unique characters fight in one of various stages, using different attacks and performing spectacular combos.

A unique card-driven duel system ensures that every character retains their signature playstyle, while custom decks, combos, heat, and the "rage moves" system add layers of tactical depth, challenging you to manage your hand of cards to move across the board, attack your enemy, and ensure they can't anticipate your next move. Combine cards in the correct order to create an epic combo, activate your special moves, and use the stage special rules like wall break, floor break, and wall blast to your advantage.

The base mode works for 1-2 players, but the game also has a tournament mode for 1-8 players.

—description from the publisher

name: Tekton Dash
description:
Tekton Dash is a competitive racing-building game for 3-6 players that combines puzzle-building and racing mechanics with a dynamic sabotage system – imagine a race where you can both build your path and disrupt your opponents! Players race to complete blueprint missions while navigating obstacles, avoiding traps, and disrupting opponents' progress.

—description from the designer

name: House of 1000 Corpses
description:
In House of 1000 Corpses, an co-operative board game based on the movie of the same name, players take on the roles of the Firefly family. They must scour their house, looking for the people hiding there, and bring them to Dr. Satan before too many rounds pass. They do this using an action system that penalizes the players for doing too many of the same action in a row.

During the game players use their Action cards to Move, Search, Kill, or Capture their victims hiding in the house. The game includes 3 different difficulty modes with varying victory conditions, as well as solitaire rules.

—description from the publisher

name: Template of War
description:
Temple of War is a heavy wargame using an innovative combat and skirmish system. The game will come with several full-fledged campaigns and can be played from 1 to 10 players (or more). The campaign is built in such a way that the players can play different stages at the same table or individually at home, and update the state of the game/world based on their progress. It's possible to drop out or jump into any game at any time, as each player controls their own army/faction. The game can adapt to any situation on the fly, without the need to restart or wait for each other. The game will come with an app, so you will be able to engage in a campaign with anyone around the world.

The theme of the game is based on a never before used (in boardgames) high-fantasy IP that will be revealed later next year.

—description from the designer

name: Immortal
description:
Players arrange flowers in a graveyard by placing tiles according to the rules, adding new flowers only to a single row or column at a time. The first player to place all their flowers is the winner!

—description from the publisher

name: LA-1
description:
Most detective work done in the city of LA-1 takes place under the perpetual dark clouds that still linger from the bombs. Even so, you plan to work together to gather clues, interrogate suspects, and go on stakeouts in a world that is divided by class and dominated by status. Use your skills to solve the case before the all-consuming darkness closes in forever.

In the story-driven, co-operative adventure game LA-1, you take on the role of detectives working for Mace & Doyle Investigations who are helping one another to resolve cases in the post-apocalyptic city that was once Los Angeles. Each case can be played individually or as part of a campaign. Because of the multiple cards that can send investigations in different directions, it's possible to play each case more than one time, having different situations and outcomes each time.  But cases must be solved before the Darkness closes in on all the investigators.

—description from the publisher

name: Terminus Frontier
description:
Terminus Frontier is a cooperative adventure game featuring tactical squad combat missions, impactful narrative choices, and open-world space exploration.

Take on the role of a Drift Hunter, an elite vigilante and soldier of fortune!  Travel the stars collecting bounties on wanted fugitives and performing contracts for competing stellar factions. Your squad will perform heists on maximum-security compounds, engage in deadly firefights with xeno kill teams, and fly to the uncharted reaches of deep space on their mission for fortune and glory. You will be forced to make difficult decisions and face treacherous betrayals as you do business with the notorious denizens of the outer planets.

Take the helm of your ship and prepare to discover your destiny among the stars! Experience over 60 hours of game play in this massive space odyssey! Progress along a persistent story campaign over multiple sessions, unlocking new secret content that can only be discovered by the choices you make along the way.  Your progress is easily saved between sessions.

Terminus Frontier features scenario-based missions. Players win by completing the scenario objectives (rescue the hostages, survive 4 turns, breach the door, etc). At the start of each round, the players will decide on their activation order (called Squad Formation). This determines that player's Initiative and Action Points. On a player's activation, that player can play Skill Cards from their hand to perform actions (move, shoot, melee, etc) or equip permanents into play. Combat is resolved using our dice-less Dual Weapon Ammo Deck system.

name: Terra Altera: a Song of the Forgotten Kingdoms
description:
In an alternate world where history took a different path, new civilizations are ready to rise. In Terra Altera, you lead your people as they build realm, discover powerful technologies, manage resources, and shape the future of the world. Starting with just a few workers and simple tech, you’ll develop your realm by growing your population, gathering vital resources like energy, rock, gold, culture, and influence, and advancing through a rich technology tree. You'll build wonders, inspire your civilization with legendary leaders, and guide your people through both peaceful and turbulent times. But you won’t be alone. Competing civilizations will challenge your power. Through wars, aggressions, and clever diplomacy, you’ll have to defend what’s yours—or take what you need. Trade routes through caravans and smart planning will help your empire grow even stronger. Terra Altera combines the strategy of worker placement with the flexible choices of imperial cards, offering new actions and diplomatic options every turn. Every decision matters, and no two games will ever be the same. The game is played on a detailed main board along with individual player boards, and is designed for 2 to 4 players. Whether you expand through culture, strength, or influence, your goal is the same: to lead your civilization to greatness in a world unlike any other. The future of Terra Altera is in your hands. Will your empire stand the test of time?

This is a prototype board game. All game mechanics have been thoroughly tested and are approximately 98% complete. For now, we are using AI-generated images to help us move forward with the game design. We understand the concerns surrounding AI-generated artwork and deeply value original artistic expression. I have shared more thoughts on the use of AI in game development and its implications in a dedicated forum post.

—description from the designer

name: Terraria: The Board Game
publisher: Paper Fort Games; Re-Logic; Geekach LLC; Lavka Games
description:
Terraria: The Board Game is a co-operative adventure game for 1-4 players. Whether you’re a novice Terrarian or a long-time fan, you can now experience Re-Logic’s magnum opus on your tabletop, solo or with friends. With simple deckbuilding at its heart and a flexible action point system, choose your own playstyle and create memorable moments as you dig, fight, explore and build in a thrilling sandbox world!


     Explore ever-changing biomes, creating a unique world every time you play
     Dig to mine ores and gems as you spelunk below the surface
     Fight enemies to collect loot and obtain new cards
     Complete objective chains and trigger epic boss showdowns
     Build a base to unlock new crafting opportunities and NPC bonuses
     Craft powerful new accessories, tools and weapons
     Upgrade your character with tougher armor sets and useful buffs


Be vigilant; time marches on and the world is dangerous. To win, complete your chosen objectives before the threat level gets too high.

Terraria: The Board Game feels like Terraria, distilling the fun of the digital gameplay loop while adding the satisfying tactility and in-person excitement of modern tabletop games. So, whether you’ve played the videogame or not, clear your table, invite your friends and bring the fun of Terraria to game night!

name: Terrorscape 2
publisher: ICE Makes; Ediciones MasQueOca; Galakta; Grimspire; IELLO; Niza Gams
description:
The nightmare doesn’t end — it evolves.

Terrorscape 2 builds on the original asymmetric horror system with deeper mechanics and expanded strategy. Survivors still hide, scavenge, and plan escape routes or a final stand, while the Killer hunts using sound, deduction, and fear.

This sequel introduces 3 new Killers characters and 5 new Survivors characters, each with unique abilities that reshape how both sides play. New stages with new weapon and medical search locations, expanded item decks, and more dynamic interactions create meaningful choices each turn.

Survivors gain new paths to victory, including repairs, escape options, and direct confrontation. With varied maps and layered objectives, every game becomes a tense battle of strategy and survival.

—description from the publisher

name: Texas: Card Games Inspired by the Lone Star State
description:
Texas: Card Games - Inspired by the Lone Star State is an illustrated book of six modern games for fans of card games, board games, and the Lone Star State.

All you need is a deck of cards to scurry for grub as an armadillo, pick out constellations in the sky, race across Texas as a roadrunner, and more. Created by San Antonio high school sweethearts as an ode to the natural beauty and warmth of the Lone Star State, these six games are a great way to dive into a world of fast and fun games with a familiar set of components:


    Roadrunner — Card shedding, 3-5 players
    Armadillo — Set collection, 2-8 players
    Prickly Pear — Drafting, 1-3 players
    Bluebonnets — Tile laying, 1-2 players
    Echolocation — Trick taking, 4 players
    The Stars at Night — Area control, 3-4 players


—description from the publisher

name: That's an Order
description:
Command your mint-tin sized army on the battlefield and lead them to victory! 
 That's an Order is a mini programming game of tactics, timing, and bluffing for 1 to 2 players.  It's designed by Jonathan Carnehl and Ryan Sromek with art by Jonathan Carnehl.

Set up the battlefield using a variety of terrain.  Then, each player chooses their first three commands and sets them face-down in order.  They are revealed and executed in alternating turns.

Commands allow you to do things like deploy, maneuver, and attack.  Or you can play your That's and Order! card to gain your TAO token for a future turn.  The TAO token allows you to execute a more powerful version of one of the commands.

Have one of your soldiers standing alone on the enemy's base at the end of your turn to claim victory!  This game has many modes and lots of modularity for a very sandboxy war game experience that plays quickly.

—description from the publisher

name: That's the Spirit!
description:
You and your friends have died, and one of you is probably to blame! Trouble is, you’ve all forgotten what happened, and you're not sure if it might have been you...

You’ve got five minutes to figure out which of you is responsible for your accidental death. When the game starts you’ll be dealt a hand of cards that gives you some information about what happened, but importantly, not enough information to know if it was you or not. So you’ll have to carefully ask questions and do some deduction to figure out who’s responsible without outing yourself if it turns out it’s you.

—description from the designer

name: The Adventurers: Collector's Edition
description: The Collector’s Edition gives you the full Adventurers experience of the standalone Temple of Chac, Pyramid of Horus, and Tomb of the Pirate Queen. All 3 games use a core system that allows Adventurers and gears to be used across all three games.

name: The Adventurers: The Pyramid of Horus
description:
Buried in the sand for millennia, the pyramid of the Pharaoh Sanakht was just uncovered during an archaeological dig on the plateau of Abu Rawash, overlooking the life-giving Nile. But death has always surrounded the legend of Sanakht, whose worship of the Egyptian God Horus and other deities allegedly gave him power over life and death. Inscriptions translated outside the tomb suggest Sanakht, his bride Initkaes, and his architect Imhotep might live again if the tomb is breached. And that, Adventurers, is exactly what you’re here to do. For what is the threat of the living dead against the possibility of so muchtreasure? Escape with the gold and your lives from the Pyramid of Horus!

Enter the Pyramid of Horus, newly uncovered in the sands of Egypt. Ancient mummies patrol dark corridors while crumbling ceilings threaten your escape. Loot forbidden treasures hidden within sarcophagi, avoid curses, and outwit your fellow adventurers to escape with untold riches before the pyramid claims your soul.
